using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using GdDictionary=Godot.Collections.Dictionary;using GdArray=Godot.Collections.Array;namespace Cthangover.Core.Events{/// <summary> Global event bus. Autoload Node, survives scene changes. Two subscription layers: 1. Typed (C#): Subscribe&lt;T&gt;/Publish&lt;T&gt; — dispatch by type. 2. String (GDScript): subscribe/publish — key + Callable/Dictionary. Auto-bridge: Publish&lt;T&gt; additionally broadcasts on the [EventKey] string so GDScript subscribers receive the same events as C#. Cleanup: ClearForMod(modId) on mod unload removes its subscriptions. </summary>
public partial class ModEventBus:Node{/// <summary>Live autoload instance; null outside the Godot runtime (the typed layer still works there, the GDScript bridge does not).</summary>
public static ModEventBus Instance{get;private set;}/// <summary>Registers the autoload singleton on tree entry.</summary>
public override void _EnterTree()=>Instance=this;/// <summary>Clears the autoload singleton reference on tree exit.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){if(Instance==this)Instance=null;}// ── typed layer (static, for C#) ──
private static readonly Dictionary<Type,List<TypedSubscription>>_typedSubs=new();private static readonly object _lock=new();/// <summary> Subscribe to a typed event. <paramref name="priority"/> only meaningful for [LifecycleEvent] — lower values fire first. Otherwise ignored. <paramref name="modId"/> — mod ID for ClearForMod. </summary>
public static void Subscribe<T>(Action<T>handler,int priority=0,string modId=null)where T:ModEvent{var type=typeof(T);lock(_lock){if(!_typedSubs.TryGetValue(type,out var list)){list=new List<TypedSubscription>();_typedSubs[type]=list;}var subscription=new TypedSubscription{Handler=e=>handler((T)e),Original=handler,ModId=modId,Priority=priority,};// Lifecycle subscribers go after the last one with a priority not above theirs: ties keep subscription order (List.Sort is unstable and reshuffled them once a list outgrew 16 entries).
var index=list.Count;if(type.GetCustomAttribute<LifecycleEventAttribute>()!=null){while(index>0&&list[index-1].Priority>priority)index--;}list.Insert(index,subscription);}}public static void Unsubscribe<T>(Action<T>handler)where T:ModEvent{var type=typeof(T);lock(_lock){if(!_typedSubs.TryGetValue(type,out var list))return;list.RemoveAll(s=>s.Original is Action<T>typed&&typed==handler);}}/// <summary> Publishes event to typed subscribers, then auto-bridges to the string layer for GDScript. Typed (C#) subscribers are always invoked — even without a live autoload <see cref="Instance"/> — so unit tests and headless code paths can observe events. The GDScript bridge is a no-op when <see cref="Instance"/> is null (bridge requires the Godot node). </summary>
public static void Publish<T>(T evt)where T:ModEvent{List<TypedSubscription>snapshot;lock(_lock){if(!_typedSubs.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var list)||list.Count==0)snapshot=null;else snapshot=new List<TypedSubscription>(list);}if(snapshot!=null){foreach(var sub in snapshot){try{sub.Handler(evt);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT_BUS",$"Typed handler for {typeof(T).Name} failed (mod='{sub.ModId}'): {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}// The GDScript bridge creates Godot Dictionary/Callable objects, which is only legal on the main thread. During the background mod-load phase no GDScript subscribers are registered yet, so skipping the bridge off the main thread is a no-op in practice and keeps the load thread safe.
if(GameEnvironment.IsMainThread)Instance?.BridgeToGdScript(evt);}// ── string layer (instance, for GDScript) ──
private readonly Dictionary<string,List<CallableSubscription>>_stringSubs=new();/// <summary> GDScript: ModEventBus.subscribe("scene_entered", _on_scene, 0, "my_mod") </summary>
public void Subscribe(string eventKey,Callable handler,int priority=0,string modId=null){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventKey)||handler.Target==null)return;lock(_stringSubs){if(!_stringSubs.TryGetValue(eventKey,out var list)){list=new List<CallableSubscription>();_stringSubs[eventKey]=list;}list.Add(new CallableSubscription{Handler=handler,ModId=modId,Priority=priority,});}}/// <summary> GDScript: ModEventBus.unsubscribe("scene_entered", _on_scene) </summary>
public void Unsubscribe(string eventKey,Callable handler){lock(_stringSubs){if(!_stringSubs.TryGetValue(eventKey,out var list))return;list.RemoveAll(s=>s.Handler.Equals(handler));}}/// <summary> GDScript: ModEventBus.publish("cooking_meal_ready", {"dish": "wolf_stew"}) </summary>
public void Publish(string eventKey,Godot.Collections.Dictionary data){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventKey))return;List<CallableSubscription>snapshot;lock(_stringSubs){if(!_stringSubs.TryGetValue(eventKey,out var list)||list.Count==0)return;snapshot=new List<CallableSubscription>(list);}foreach(var sub in snapshot){try{if(sub.Handler.Target==null)continue;sub.Handler.Call(data);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT_BUS",$"String handler for '{eventKey}' failed (mod='{sub.ModId}'): {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}// ── cleanup ── <summary> Removes all subscriptions for a mod — both typed and string. Called on mod unload/reload. </summary>
public void ClearForMod(string modId){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return;lock(_lock){foreach(var kvp in _typedSubs)kvp.Value.RemoveAll(s=>s.ModId==modId);}lock(_stringSubs){foreach(var kvp in _stringSubs)kvp.Value.RemoveAll(s=>s.ModId==modId);}GameLogger.Log("EVENT_BUS",$"Cleared all subscriptions for mod '{modId}'");}/// <summary> Unload pass by code ownership rather than by declared mod id: removes typed subscriptions whose handler lives in a dying mod assembly and subscriptions to event types declared there. Most mods subscribe without passing their id, so <see cref="ClearForMod"/> alone leaves their handlers behind — and every such handler pins the mod's load context. Returns the number of removed subscriptions. </summary>
public static int RemoveOwned(Mods.Unload.AssemblyOwnership ownership){if(ownership==null||ownership.IsEmpty)return 0;var removed=0;lock(_lock){var ownedTypes=new List<Type>();foreach(var type in _typedSubs.Keys){if(ownership.Owns(type))ownedTypes.Add(type);}foreach(var type in ownedTypes){removed+=_typedSubs[type].Count;_typedSubs.Remove(type);}foreach(var list in _typedSubs.Values){for(var i=list.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(!ownership.Owns(list[i].Original))continue;list.RemoveAt(i);removed++;}}}return removed;}/// <summary>Wipes every subscription on both the typed and string layers. Test/setup helper — not part of the normal unload path.</summary>
public void ClearAll(){lock(_lock)_typedSubs.Clear();lock(_stringSubs)_stringSubs.Clear();}// ── internals ──
private void BridgeToGdScript(ModEvent evt){var type=evt.GetType();var keyAttr=type.GetCustomAttribute<EventKeyAttribute>();if(keyAttr==null)return;var eventKey=keyAttr.Key;List<CallableSubscription>snapshot;lock(_stringSubs){if(!_stringSubs.TryGetValue(eventKey,out var list)||list.Count==0)return;snapshot=new List<CallableSubscription>(list);}Godot.Collections.Dictionary data;try{data=ModEventPayload.ToDictionary(evt);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT_BUS",$"GDScript bridge cannot convert {type.Name} for '{eventKey}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return;}foreach(var sub in snapshot){try{if(sub.Handler.Target==null)continue;sub.Handler.Call(data);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT_BUS",$"GDScript bridge handler for '{eventKey}' failed (mod='{sub.ModId}'): {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}private sealed class TypedSubscription{/// <summary>Type-erased handler; the generic wrapper casts back to the event type.</summary>
public Action<ModEvent>Handler;/// <summary>The subscriber's own delegate: identity for <see cref="Unsubscribe{T}"/>, ownership for <see cref="RemoveOwned"/>.</summary>
public Delegate Original;/// <summary>Owning mod id for <see cref="ClearForMod"/>; null for engine subscriptions.</summary>
public string ModId;/// <summary>Delivery order for [LifecycleEvent] event types (lower = earlier).</summary>
public int Priority;}private sealed class CallableSubscription{/// <summary>GDScript callable invoked with the bridged Dictionary payload.</summary>
public Callable Handler;/// <summary>Owning mod id for <see cref="ClearForMod"/>; null for engine subscriptions.</summary>
public string ModId;/// <summary>Reserved for parity with the typed layer (the string layer delivers in subscription order).</summary>
public int Priority;}}}

using System;using System.Collections;using System.Reflection;using System.Text;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Events{/// <summary> Converts a typed event into the Dictionary GDScript subscribers of the <see cref="ModEventBus"/> bridge receive: one snake_case key per public property. <see cref="Variant.From{T}"/> dispatches on the static type, so a value held as <c>object</c> must be converted by its runtime type here — calling it with <c>object</c> throws for every value, which is how the bridge used to fail on every event with a payload. Enums become their names, collections Godot arrays, other objects nested dictionaries; null properties are left out. </summary>
public static class ModEventPayload{/// <summary>The public instance properties of <paramref name="source"/> as a snake_case Dictionary.</summary>
public static Godot.Collections.Dictionary ToDictionary(object source){var data=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary();foreach(var prop in source.GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Instance)){if(prop.GetIndexParameters().Length>0)continue;var value=prop.GetValue(source);if(value!=null)data[SnakeCase(prop.Name)]=ToVariant(value);}return data;}private static Variant ToVariant(object value){switch(value){case GodotObject godotObject:return godotObject;case string text:return text;case bool flag:return flag;case int number:return number;case long number:return number;case float number:return number;case double number:return number;case Enum enumValue:return enumValue.ToString();case IEnumerable items:var array=new Godot.Collections.Array();foreach(var item in items)array.Add(item==null?default:ToVariant(item));return array;default:return ToDictionary(value);}}private static string SnakeCase(string pascal){var result=new StringBuilder(pascal.Length+4);for(var i=0;i<pascal.Length;i++){if(i>0&&char.IsUpper(pascal[i]))result.Append('_');result.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(pascal[i]));}return result.ToString();}}}

===== FILE Core/Factories/EntityKindAttribute.cs =====
using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories{/// <summary> Declares which entity kind a JSON-deserializable DTO describes. The kind is the sole type discriminator of the mod data pipeline: every data JSON carries a top-level <c>"Kind"</c> string in its <c>FileData&lt;T&gt;</c> envelope, and <see cref="EntityKindRegistry"/> resolves the kind to exactly one DTO type. This replaces the old convention where the directory a file lived in implied its type — a convention that broke down when several index files (characters, enemies, actions, skills) shared the <c>characters/</c> directory and every factory ended up parsing its neighbours' files. <para/> One kind maps to one DTO, and one JSON file declares one kind. Files that are not mod data (manifests, collections, live2d models, scene definitions) simply do not carry a kind and are never parsed by the entity resolver. </summary>
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class,Inherited=false,AllowMultiple=false)]public sealed class EntityKindAttribute:Attribute{/// <summary> The canonical lowercase kind string (e.g. <c>"skill"</c>) that matches the <c>"Kind"</c> field written in the DTO's JSON files. </summary>
public string Kind{get;}/// <summary> Creates the attribute. The kind is normalised to lowercase so that authoring case differences never split one entity type into two caches. </summary> <param name="kind">Canonical kind string, e.g. <c>"skill"</c>.</param>
public EntityKindAttribute(string kind){Kind=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(kind)?null:kind.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();}}}

===== FILE Core/Factories/EntityKindRegistry.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories{/// <summary> Maps entity kind strings to DTO types declared with <see cref="EntityKindAttribute"/>. The registry is the authoritative vocabulary of the data pipeline: the entity scanner asks it whether a file's <c>"Kind"</c> is known before routing it, and factories resolve their own kind from their DTO type. <para/> The reverse map (kind → <see cref="Type"/>) is built lazily by scanning every loaded assembly, because entity DTOs also live in Roslyn-compiled mod assemblies (<c>StatusEffectInfo</c> being the first example) that only exist after mod loading. <see cref="Refresh"/> is called when the resolver cache generation turns over, so a mod reload re-discovers the vocabulary. </summary>
public static class EntityKindRegistry{private static readonly object _lock=new();private static Dictionary<string,Type>_byKind;/// <summary> Returns the kind declared by <paramref name="type"/>, or <c>null</c> when the type carries no <see cref="EntityKindAttribute"/>. Reads the attribute directly so it works for types in dynamic mod assemblies that the AppDomain scan may not have reached yet. </summary>
public static string KindOf(Type type){return type?.GetCustomAttribute<EntityKindAttribute>(false)?.Kind;}/// <summary> Returns the kind declared by <typeparamref name="T"/>, or <c>null</c> when the DTO is not annotated. </summary>
public static string KindOf<T>(){return KindOf(typeof(T));}/// <summary> Resolves a kind string from a JSON file to its DTO type. Returns <c>false</c> for unknown kinds so the scanner can report the file instead of silently dropping it. </summary>
public static bool TryResolve(string kind,out Type type){EnsureBuilt();return _byKind.TryGetValue(kind??string.Empty,out type);}/// <summary>True when the kind is declared by some loaded DTO.</summary>
public static bool IsKnown(string kind){EnsureBuilt();return kind!=null&&_byKind.ContainsKey(kind);}/// <summary>All known kinds, for diagnostics and validation.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyCollection<string>KnownKinds{get{EnsureBuilt();return _byKind.Keys.ToList();}}/// <summary> Discards the reverse map so the next lookup re-scans the AppDomain. Called by the entity resolver when mods are (re)loaded. </summary>
public static void Refresh(){lock(_lock){_byKind=null;}}private static void EnsureBuilt(){if(_byKind!=null)return;lock(_lock){if(_byKind!=null)return;var map=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var assembly in Reflections.LoadedAssemblies()){Type[]types;try{types=assembly.GetTypes();}catch(ReflectionTypeLoadException ex){types=ex.Types.Where(t=>t!=null).ToArray();}catch(Exception){continue;}foreach(var type in types){var kind=KindOf(type);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(kind))continue;if(map.TryGetValue(kind,out var existing)){if(existing!=type)GameLogger.Log("ENTITIES",$"kind '{kind}' is declared by both '{existing.FullName}' and '{type.FullName}'; keeping the first",LogLevel.Error);continue;}map[kind]=type;}}_byKind=map;}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories{/// <summary> Lightweight JSON-driven factory. All data discovery is delegated to <see cref="EntityResolver"/>, which scans every mod file once and routes entities by their declared kind (read from <typeparamref name="T"/>'s <see cref="EntityKindAttribute"/>). Nothing is cached here: the resolver keeps the collected dictionary until the next mod reload, so every lookup sees the data of the running mod set — also from a factory whose mod stays loaded across a reload. </summary>
public abstract class FileFactory<T>:IFileFactory<T>where T:class,IIdentifiable{/// <summary> Returns the entity registered under <paramref name="id"/>, collecting the kind-routed dictionary from the entity resolver on first use. Unknown or empty ids return <c>null</c>. </summary>
public T Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;// Entities.Collect is cached by the entity resolver until the next mod reload; holding a copy here kept serving the previous mod set's data to factories of mods that stay loaded across a reload.
Entities.Collect<T>().TryGetValue(id,out var item);return item;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Singleton registry that discovers and indexes all IScenarioAction implementations via reflection. Actions are keyed by their Name property (e.g. "quest.set_status"). The single instance is owned by the AppServices composition root in a Lazy&lt;T&gt; slot for thread-safe initialization via Reflections.FindAndCreate which scans all loaded assemblies. RegisterAssembly allows mods to inject custom actions at runtime. One Name has one winner: the action of the mod loaded later (kernel actions rank below every mod), so a mod overrides core actions and a dependent mod overrides its dependency's — the same rule as every other mod resource. The rank is the mod's load index, not the moment of registration: GDScript actions register after all assemblies, yet a GDScript action of an earlier mod still loses to a later mod's C# one. The factory is consumed by ActionScenario (dialog action) which bridges the dialog system to these atomic scenario commands. </summary>
public class ScenarioActionFactory{/// <summary> Facade over the AppServices-owned instance; kept as the public API during migration. Laziness and thread safety come from the owning Lazy&lt;T&gt; slot. Construction triggers a full assembly scan for all IScenarioAction implementations via Reflections.FindAndCreate and registers each by its Name. </summary>
public static ScenarioActionFactory Instance=>AppServices.Current.ScenarioActions.Value;private readonly Dictionary<string,IScenarioAction>actions=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,int>ranks=new();/// <summary>Rank of the kernel's own actions: below every mod.</summary>
private const int KernelRank= -1;/// <summary> Guards <see cref="actions"/>. The factory is a shared singleton reached from parallel test collections and from GDScript registration paths; without the lock a GetAll snapshot racing a Register resize throws "Destination array is not long enough" — observed as a rare flake in ScenarioActionFactoryTests. </summary>
private readonly object actionsLock=new();internal ScenarioActionFactory(){foreach(var action in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IScenarioAction>()){Register(action,KernelRank);}lock(actionsLock){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"loaded '{actions.Count}' scenario actions");}}/// <summary> Looks up a registered action by its Name (e.g. "quest.set_status"). Returns null and logs an error if no action with the given name is registered. This is the primary entry point for the dialog engine — ActionScenario calls Get() with the command name from the scenario script and invokes Run() on the returned action. </summary>
public IScenarioAction Get(string name){lock(actionsLock){if(actions.TryGetValue(name,out var action))return action;}GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"ScenarioAction '{name}' not found",LogLevel.Error);return null;}/// <summary> Looks up a registered action by its Name and fails fast when it is missing. This is the fail-fast twin of <see cref="Get"/>: scenario content playback must stay resilient (a typo in a mod's scenario degrades to an error log and a skipped command), but engine-critical code — tools, boot wiring, validators, tests — resolves actions by names that are contractually known or already validated, and there a null return would only postpone the failure to a harder-to-trace spot. The same Get/GetRequired split exists in <c>CharacterTemplateRegistry</c>; <c>BattleCoreRegistry</c> throws unconditionally for the same reason. </summary> <exception cref="KeyNotFoundException">No action with the given Name is registered.</exception>
public IScenarioAction GetRequired(string name){lock(actionsLock){if(actions.TryGetValue(name,out var action))return action;throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Scenario action '{name}' is not registered ({actions.Count} actions loaded). "+"Check the action Name spelling or make sure the mod that defines it is loaded.");}}/// <summary> Registers an action of <paramref name="modId"/> (null: no mod, ranked with the latest registration so far). It replaces an action of the same Name from a mod loaded earlier or from the same mod, and loses to one of a mod loaded later; both outcomes are logged when the types differ. </summary>
public void Register(IScenarioAction action,string modId=null)=>Register(action,RankOf(modId));private void Register(IScenarioAction action,int rank){lock(actionsLock){if(actions.TryGetValue(action.Name,out var previous)){if(rank<ranks[action.Name]){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"scenario action '{action.Name}' of {action.GetType().FullName} ignored: a mod loaded later defines it ({previous.GetType().FullName})",LogLevel.Warning);return;}if(previous.GetType()!=action.GetType())GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"scenario action '{action.Name}': {previous.GetType().FullName} replaced by {action.GetType().FullName}",LogLevel.Warning);}actions[action.Name]=action;ranks[action.Name]=rank;}GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"registered scenario action '{action.Name}'");}private int RankOf(string modId){if(modId==null){lock(actionsLock)return ranks.Count==0?0:System.Math.Max(0,ranks.Values.Max());}var order=Mods.ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds();for(var i=0;i<order.Count;i++){if(string.Equals(order[i],modId,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return i;}// A mod outside the ordered set (a test assembly, tooling) ranks after every mod.
return order.Count;}/// <summary> Scans all types in the given assembly for non-abstract IScenarioAction implementations, instantiates each via Activator.CreateInstance, and registers them. This is the extension point for mods — mod assemblies call this at startup to inject custom scenario actions into the dialog engine, ranked by <paramref name="modId"/>'s load order (see <see cref="Register(IScenarioAction, string)"/>). </summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories{/// <summary> Core binary-asset factory with LRU-bounded caching and multi-extension mod file scanning. Implements <c>ICacheLoader</c> so that cache misses trigger a fresh scan of all mods — each registered file extension is tried in order and the first matching asset wins. The <c>factoryKey</c> passed to the constructor is used to look up a cache size override from <c>ModConfig</c>, allowing per-asset-type memory budgeting without hard-coding sizes per subclass. Subclasses implement <c>ConvertFromBytes</c> to transform raw file data into Godot resources. Falls back silently for <c>_albedo</c> / <c>_depth</c> suffix lookups (normal-map companion textures that may legitimately not exist for every sprite), avoiding log noise for optional secondary textures. Cached payloads are Godot resources (<c>Texture2D</c>, <c>AudioStream</c>, <c>PackedScene</c>) whose native/GPU memory outlives a plain .NET reference, so the LRU cache is wired to a disposal hook (<see cref="ReleaseResource"/>): when an entry leaves the cache and no engine object (sprite, audio player, ...) holds a native reference any more, the resource is disposed immediately instead of waiting for the .NET GC finalizer. Without the hook, VRAM and audio memory of evicted assets stay allocated until the next collection — which manifests as a leak during long sessions with frequent location changes. </summary>
public abstract class PrefabFactory<T>:IPrefabFactory<T>,ICacheLoader<string,T>where T:class{private readonly BoundedCache<string,T>_cache;protected PrefabFactory(string factoryKey,int fallbackCacheSize){var size=ModConfig.Instance.Cache.GetCacheSize(factoryKey,fallbackCacheSize);_cache=new BoundedCache<string,T>(size,this,ReleaseResource);}/// <summary>Mod asset group this factory scans (e.g. <c>"music"</c>, <c>"backgrounds"</c>); ids are relative to it.</summary>
public abstract string GroupName{get;}/// <summary>Converts raw mod file bytes into the Godot resource this factory produces.</summary>
protected abstract T ConvertFromBytes(string id,byte[]data,string extension);/// <summary>File extensions tried in order during the mod scan; the first matching asset wins.</summary>
protected abstract List<string>Extensions{get;}T ICacheLoader<string,T>.Load(string id){foreach(var extension in Extensions){var result=LoadFromMods(id,extension);if(result!=null)return result;}if(id==null||(!id.EndsWith("_albedo",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !id.EndsWith("_depth",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"resource from factory '{GetType().Name}' with id '{id}' - not found in group '{GroupName}'!",LogLevel.Error);return null;}/// <summary> Returns the cached asset for <paramref name="id"/>, loading it through the LRU-bounded cache on first access. Missing assets are logged — except the optional <c>_albedo</c>/<c>_depth</c> companion lookups, which may legitimately not exist. </summary>
public virtual T Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;var result=_cache.Get(id);if(result==null&& !id.EndsWith("_albedo",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !id.EndsWith("_depth",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"resource from factory '{GetType().Name}' with id '{id}' - can't get in group '{GroupName}'!",LogLevel.Error);return result;}/// <summary> Drops the cached asset <paramref name="id"/>, so the next <see cref="Get"/> reads the file again — for an asset whose file was replaced while the game runs. A value still shown by an engine object stays alive there (see <see cref="ReleaseResource"/>); only new lookups get the new file. </summary>
public void Invalidate(string id){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))_cache.Invalidate(id);}/// <summary> Drops every cached asset of this factory (same rules as <see cref="Invalidate"/>). Used after files of the group were added or replaced in bulk, together with clearing the file list (<see cref="FileListResolver.ClearCache"/>) that maps ids to files. </summary>
public void Clear(){_cache.Clear();}/// <summary> BoundedCache eviction hook: releases the native/GPU memory of an evicted payload. Godot resources are ref-counted natively and the cache's managed wrapper owns exactly one of those references, so the resource is disposed only when that reference is the last one (<c>GetReferenceCount() == 1</c>) — a texture still assigned to a sprite or a stream still played by an audio player keeps its native owner and is left intact, its wrapper is finalised by the GC later. Direct external disposal of a cached value (mod code calling Dispose itself) is tolerated via <see cref="GodotObject.IsInstanceValid"/>. Consequence for callers: values must be handed to engine objects (node properties, players) rather than stored as bare C# fields for the whole session, otherwise an LRU eviction may dispose a wrapper that is still referenced from managed code only. </summary>
private void ReleaseResource(T resource){if(resource is RefCounted refCounted&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(refCounted)&&refCounted.GetReferenceCount()==1){refCounted.Dispose();}}/// <summary>Scans the group's collected files for <paramref name="id"/> plus the given extension and reads the matching mod file's bytes.</summary>
protected virtual T LoadFromMods(string id,string extension){var files=Files.Collect(GroupName);string matchedKey=null;string ext=null;if(extension!=null){matchedKey=id+extension;}else{foreach(var key in files.Keys){if(key==id||key.StartsWith(id+".",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){matchedKey=key;break;}}}if(matchedKey==null|| !files.TryGetValue(matchedKey,out var entry)){return default(T);}ext=Path.GetExtension(matchedKey);var bytes=ModManager.Instance.ReadFileBinary(entry.ModId,entry.FullPath);if(bytes==null){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"resource '{GetType().Name}' with id '{id}' - failed to read binary!",LogLevel.Error);return default(T);}return ConvertFromBytes(id,bytes,ext);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories{/// <summary> Specialised <c>PrefabFactory</c> for <c>.png</c> and <c>.jpg</c> textures. Creates a temporary <c>Image</c> to decode pixel data via Godot's built-in loaders, then immediately wraps it in an <c>ImageTexture</c> and disposes the intermediate <c>Image</c>. This two-step pipeline is necessary because Godot does not provide a direct "byte array to Texture2D" method — the <c>Image</c> holds CPU-side pixel data while <c>ImageTexture</c> uploads it to the GPU, and keeping the <c>Image</c> alive would double memory usage for every loaded sprite. </summary>
public abstract class Texture2DFactory:PrefabFactory<Texture2D>{protected Texture2DFactory(string factoryKey,int fallbackCacheSize):base(factoryKey,fallbackCacheSize){}/// <summary>Texture extensions from mod config (typically .png and .jpg), tried in order.</summary>
protected override List<string>Extensions=>ModConfig.Instance.TextureExtensions;/// <summary>Decodes PNG/JPEG bytes into an <c>ImageTexture</c>; unsupported formats are logged and return null.</summary>
protected override Texture2D ConvertFromBytes(string id,byte[]data,string extension){var image=new Image();if(extension?.Equals(".png",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)==true)image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(extension?.Equals(".jpg",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)==true||extension?.Equals(".jpeg",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)==true){image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);}else{GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"unsupported image format '{extension}' for '{id}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();return texture;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Core.Games{/// <summary> The mods one game boots with, computed from the game's current collection definition — never stored — so editing the collection changes the next launch. public sealed class GameModSet{public ModCollection Game{get;private init;}/// <summary>Mod ids that stay loaded.</summary>
public HashSet<string>ModIds{get;}=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>Mods the game needs but which are not installed.</summary>
public List<string>MissingMods{get;}=new();/// <summary>Resolver problems of the game collection (missing blocks, cycles, ...).</summary>
public List<ModCollectionProblem>Problems{get;}=new();/// <summary> Pure computation over discovered mods; returns null when <paramref name="gameId"/> is not a known game collection. </summary> <summary>The front-end alone: every <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Frontend"/> collection's graph.</summary>
public static GameModSet ComputeFrontend(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>discovered,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabled,IReadOnlyCollection<string>withMods=null){var set=new GameModSet();var any=false;foreach(var frontend in(collections?.Values??Enumerable.Empty<ModCollection>()).Where(c=>c?.Kind==ModCollectionKind.Frontend)){any=true;set.AddCollection(frontend,collections,discovered,disabled??Array.Empty<string>(),keepProblems:true);}if(!any)return null;foreach(var extra in withMods??Array.Empty<string>())AddWithDependencies(extra,set,discovered);return set;}public static GameModSet Compute(string gameId,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>discovered,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabled,IReadOnlyCollection<string>withMods=null){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameId)||collections==null|| !collections.TryGetValue(gameId,out var game)||game==null||game.Kind!=ModCollectionKind.Game)return null;var set=new GameModSet{Game=game};disabled??=Array.Empty<string>();set.AddCollection(game,collections,discovered,disabled,keepProblems:true);foreach(var frontend in collections.Values.Where(c=>c?.Kind==ModCollectionKind.Frontend))set.AddCollection(frontend,collections,discovered,disabled,keepProblems:false);foreach(var extra in withMods??Array.Empty<string>())AddWithDependencies(extra,set,discovered);return set;}private void AddCollection(ModCollection collection,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>discovered,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabled,bool keepProblems){var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,collections,discovered,disabled,new List<CatalogExportEntry>());foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){if(node.State is ModCollectionNodeState.Missing or ModCollectionNodeState.InCatalog){if(!MissingMods.Contains(node.ModId,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))MissingMods.Add(node.ModId);continue;}ModIds.Add(node.ModId);}if(keepProblems)Problems.AddRange(graph.Problems);}private static void AddWithDependencies(string modId,GameModSet set,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>discovered){var pending=new Stack<string>();pending.Push(modId);while(pending.Count>0){var id=pending.Pop();if(!discovered.TryGetValue(id,out var info)){if(!set.MissingMods.Contains(id,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))set.MissingMods.Add(id);continue;}if(!set.ModIds.Add(id))continue;foreach(var dependency in(info as ModInfo)?.Manifest?.Depends??new List<ModDependency>()){// An optional dependency joins only when it is installed.
if(dependency.IsValid&&(!dependency.IsOptional||discovered.ContainsKey(dependency.ModId)))pending.Push(dependency.ModId);}}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Diagnostics;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Games{/// <summary> Starting, loading and switching games, shared by the launcher (args after boot) and the menu mods. Starting enters the active game's entry scene; loading falls back to it when the saved scene no longer exists (its mechanic was removed from the game). Switching to another game replaces the mod set in-process (<see cref="SwitchToAsync"/>); the menu warms the mod sets of the games up in the background beforehand (<see cref="WarmUp"/>), so the switch only loads cached assemblies. </summary>
public static class GameSession{/// <summary>Resets the runtime and enters <see cref="ActiveGame.EntryScene"/> through the base shell.</summary>
public static void StartNew(Node host){GameData.Instance?.StartNewGame();EnterScene(host,ActiveGame.EntryScene);}/// <summary> Loads <paramref name="fileName"/> from the active game's saves and enters the saved scene (or the entry scene when the saved one is unknown). Returns false when the save could not be loaded. </summary>
public static bool LoadAndEnter(Node host,string fileName){if(!SaveService.Load(fileName))return false;var sceneManager=host.GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("/root/SceneManager");sceneManager?.Initialize();var scene=SaveService.LastLoadedSceneName;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(scene)||scene=="unknown"||sceneManager?.HasScene(scene)!=true){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scene)&&scene!="unknown")GameLogger.Log("SAVE",$"Saved scene '{scene}' is not part of the game any more, entering '{ActiveGame.EntryScene}'",LogLevel.Warning);scene=ActiveGame.EntryScene;}EnterScene(host,scene);return true;}/// <summary>True while <see cref="SwitchToAsync"/> runs; menus ignore further switch requests meanwhile.</summary>
public static bool IsSwitching{get;private set;}private static CancellationTokenSource warmUpCancel;private static int warmUpRuns;/// <summary>True while a background warm-up (<see cref="WarmUp"/>) is compiling.</summary>
public static bool IsWarmingUp=>Volatile.Read(ref warmUpRuns)>0;/// <summary> Compiles the mod sets of <paramref name="gameIds"/> into the assembly cache in the background, one game after another, while the player is in the menu (<see cref="ModManager.WarmUp"/>). Picking a game then only loads cached assemblies instead of compiling them behind the loading screen. A running warm-up is replaced; <see cref="SwitchToAsync"/> cancels it, and the switch finishes whatever mod it was compiling. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(IReadOnlyList<string>gameIds){StopWarmUp();if(gameIds==null||gameIds.Count==0)return;var cancel=new CancellationTokenSource();warmUpCancel=cancel;var args=GameLaunchArgs.Current;var manager=ModManager.Instance;Interlocked.Increment(ref warmUpRuns);Task.Run(()=>WarmUpGames(manager,args,new List<string>(gameIds),cancel.Token));}/// <summary>Stops the background warm-up between two mods; already compiled mods stay in the cache.</summary>
public static void StopWarmUp(){warmUpCancel?.Cancel();warmUpCancel=null;}private static void WarmUpGames(ModManager manager,GameLaunchArgs args,List<string>gameIds,CancellationToken cancellationToken){try{WarmUpEach(manager,args,gameIds,cancellationToken);}finally{Interlocked.Decrement(ref warmUpRuns);}}private static void WarmUpEach(ModManager manager,GameLaunchArgs args,List<string>gameIds,CancellationToken cancellationToken){foreach(var gameId in gameIds){if(cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)return;var watch=Stopwatch.StartNew();try{manager.WarmUp(args.WithSelection(gameId,null),cancellationToken);GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Warm-up: mods of '{gameId}' are in the assembly cache ({watch.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms)");}catch(OperationCanceledException){GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Warm-up of '{gameId}' stopped: a game is starting");return;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Warm-up of '{gameId}' failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}}/// <summary> Switches the running process to <paramref name="gameId"/> — a new game, or <paramref name="loadSave"/> of it — without a restart: the window shows <see cref="ModSetTransitionScreen"/>, the game's mod set is prepared (compiled) in the background, mods that leave the set are unloaded and their contexts released, the new ones load, and the game is entered exactly as a cold <c>--game</c> launch would. Mods shared by both sets (the front-end, common engine mods) stay loaded. When the new set does not compile, the running set is untouched and the screen lists the errors with a way back to the main menu. Returns whether the game was entered. </summary>
public static async Task<bool>SwitchToAsync(Node host,string gameId,string loadSave=null){var tree=host.GetTree();var manager=ModManager.Instance;if(IsSwitching||manager.IsReloading){GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Switch into '{gameId}' ignored: a mod-set switch is already running",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}IsSwitching=true;StopWarmUp();try{GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Switching into game '{gameId}' ({(loadSave == null ? "new game" : "load " + loadSave)}) in-process");var selection=GameLaunchArgs.Current.WithSelection(gameId,loadSave);var screen=ModSetTransitionScreen.Show(tree);var prep=await manager.PrepareReloadAsync(selection);var result=manager.ApplyReload(prep,tree);if(!result.Applied){screen.ShowErrors(result.Errors,OpenMainMenuDeferred);return false;}await manager.VerifyReloadAsync(result,tree);var anchor=tree.Root.GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("SceneManager");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(loadSave)){StartNew(anchor);return true;}if(LoadAndEnter(anchor,loadSave))return true;GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Save '{loadSave}' of game '{gameId}' could not be loaded",LogLevel.Error);OpenMainMenu(tree);return false;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Switch into '{gameId}' FAILED: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);OpenMainMenu(tree);return false;}finally{IsSwitching=false;}}/// <summary> Enters the title screen. The menu scene is provided by the <c>menu_base</c> mod and resolved through the runtime tscn pipeline (which also applies scene patches); if even that cannot be built, the engine loader runs anyway so a broken mod set degrades to a loud log instead of a crash. </summary>
public static void OpenMainMenu(SceneTree tree){var path=GodotSceneService.GetScenePath(GodotSceneType.MainMenu);var node=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(path);if(node!=null){tree.ChangeSceneToNode(node);return;}GameLogger.Log("LAUNCHER",$"main menu scene '{path}' could not be built by any mod — falling back to the native loader",LogLevel.Warning);tree.ChangeSceneToFile("res://"+path);}private static void OpenMainMenuDeferred(){if(Engine.GetMainLoop()is SceneTree tree)OpenMainMenu(tree);}private static void EnterScene(Node host,string scene){var sceneManager=host.GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("/root/SceneManager");if(sceneManager==null){GameLogger.Log("GAME","SceneManager autoload not found, cannot enter the game",LogLevel.Error);return;}sceneManager.PendingSceneName=scene;host.GetNodeOrNull<GodotSceneService>("/root/GodotSceneService")?.LoadShell();}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Items{/// <summary> GDScript-facing snapshot of an <see cref="IItem"/>. Godot scripts cannot implement or inspect the managed <c>IItem</c> interface, so the engine wraps it in this <c>[GlobalClass]</c> <c>RefCounted</c> with plain fields before handing it to a GDScript's <c>use(item)</c> callback (see <see cref="GDItemAction"/>). <see cref="Inner"/> keeps the real item so the bridge can resolve it back for inventory calls; <c>Sprite</c> and <c>Properties</c> are deliberately not exposed — scripts work with ids and plain data only. </summary>
[GlobalClass]public partial class GDItem:RefCounted{/// <summary>Item identifier (path-style id, e.g. <c>"food/ration"</c>).</summary>
public string Id;/// <summary>Display name.</summary>
public string Name;/// <summary>Tooltip/description text.</summary>
public string Description;/// <summary>Purchase price.</summary>
public int Cost;/// <summary><see cref="ItemType"/> flags as a plain int (flags survive the bridge better than enums).</summary>
public int ItemType;/// <summary>Back-reference to the wrapped managed item; internal by design.</summary>
internal IItem Inner;/// <summary> Wraps a managed item into the GDScript snapshot. Returns an empty wrapper (null fields) for a <c>null</c> input rather than throwing, so a missing item definition degrades to a harmless no-op in script code instead of crashing the bridge. </summary>
public static GDItem From(IItem item){var gd=new GDItem();if(item==null)return gd;gd.Id=item.ID;gd.Name=item.Name;gd.Description=item.Description;gd.Cost=item.Cost;gd.ItemType=(int)item.ItemType;gd.Inner=item;return gd;}}}

A mod script that provides <c>get_item_action_id()</c> is registered under that id (the bridge constructs this class); <see cref="UseAction"/> then marshals the managed item into a <see cref="GDItem"/> snapshot and calls the script's <c>use(item)</c>, whose return value becomes the success flag (returning <c>false</c> keeps the item unconsumed). </summary>

===== FILE Core/Items/ItemActionBridge.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Items{/// <summary> Core-side delivery bridge for GDScript-declared item actions (registered by <c>ModGDScriptLoader</c>, which runs before the items mod is ready). They are buffered until the items subsystem binds its sink — typically from <c>IModInitializer.OnModResourcesReady</c>; after <see cref="Bind"/> registrations are delivered straight through, so a bind is safe at any point in the boot pipeline. C# actions do not pass here: the items mod collects them from mod assemblies with its own assembly consumer. </summary>
public static class ItemActionBridge{private static readonly object Gate=new();private static readonly List<IItemAction>PendingActions=new();private static Action<IItemAction>_actionSink;/// <summary>Delivers one action to the bound sink, or buffers it until <see cref="Bind"/>.</summary>
public static void Register(IItemAction action){if(action==null)return;lock(Gate){if(_actionSink!=null)_actionSink(action);else PendingActions.Add(action);}}/// <summary> Installs the sink (typically the items mod's action factory) and flushes everything buffered so far. Subsequent registrations go straight to the sink. </summary>
public static void Bind(Action<IItemAction>actionSink){lock(Gate){_actionSink=actionSink;foreach(var action in PendingActions)actionSink?.Invoke(action);PendingActions.Clear();}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Localization{using System;/// <summary> One reading of language codes for every place that gets one: the saved setting (<c>SettingsData.Language</c>, <c>game_config.json</c>), locale file suffixes, collection <c>lang</c> entries and the boot messages. Only the primary subtag counts — <c>en</c>, <c>en-en</c>, <c>en_US</c> and <c>EN</c> are the same language — because the settings have been written in all of these forms over time (the menu once saved <c>ru-ru</c>, the config ships <c>en-en</c>) and an exact match silently fell back to Russian. </summary>
public static class LanguageCode{/// <summary>Languages the game ships locale files for, in settings menu order.</summary>
public static readonly string[]Supported={"ru","en","zh"};/// <summary>Lowercase primary subtag (<c>"en-US"</c> → <c>"en"</c>); null for an empty code.</summary>
public static string Primary(string code){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))return null;var trimmed=code.Trim();var end=trimmed.IndexOfAny(new[]{'-','_'});return(end<0?trimmed:trimmed.Substring(0,end)).ToLowerInvariant();}/// <summary>The supported language <paramref name="code"/> means (one of <see cref="Supported"/>), or null.</summary>
public static string Normalize(string code){var primary=Primary(code);return primary!=null&&Array.IndexOf(Supported,primary)>=0?primary:null;}/// <summary>True when both codes name the same language (same primary subtag).</summary>
public static bool Same(string a,string b){var left=Primary(a);return left!=null&&left==Primary(b);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Localization{/// <summary> Static loader that assembles Godot <c>Translation</c> resources from <c>.properties</c> files distributed across mods. Chose the <c>.properties</c> format (plain <c>key=value</c>) over Godot's CSV translation format because it requires no editor round-trip and is trivially editable by mod authors in any text editor. Merges entries from <b>all</b> loaded mods into a single <c>Translation</c> — later values overwrite earlier ones via <c>Dictionary</c> assignment — so mods can selectively override base game strings without copying the entire locale file. File matching is by suffix (<c>_{locale}.properties</c>) allowing mods to organise translations however they like as long as the filename ends with the correct locale code. On locale switch, the previous <c>Translation</c> is removed from <c>TranslationServer</c> and disposed to avoid leaking Godot resource handles across language changes. </summary>
public static class LocaleLoader{private static readonly Dictionary<string,Translation>_translations=new();/// <summary> Reads the language saved in <see cref="GameData.Settings"/>, reads it through <see cref="LanguageCode.Normalize"/> (<c>en-en</c>, <c>en_US</c> and <c>en</c> are all English; an unsupported one falls back to <c>"ru"</c> with a warning), and delegates to <see cref="LoadLocale"/>. </summary>
public static void LoadCurrentLanguage(){var settingsLang=GameData.Instance.Settings.Language;var locale=LanguageCode.Normalize(settingsLang);if(locale==null){GameLogger.Log("LANG",$"unsupported language '{settingsLang}' in the settings, using 'ru'",LogLevel.Warning);locale="ru";}LoadLocale(locale);}/// <summary> Merges the <c>.properties</c> files of every loaded mod for the given locale into one Godot <see cref="Translation"/>, replaces any previous translation for that locale on <c>TranslationServer</c>, and sets it as the active locale. Safe to call again to switch languages. </summary>
public static void LoadLocale(string locale){var master=new Dictionary<string,string>();MergeCollectionLocales(locale,master);MergeModLocales(locale,master);if(_translations.TryGetValue(locale,out var old)){TranslationServer.RemoveTranslation(old);old.Dispose();_translations.Remove(locale);}var translation=new Translation();translation.Locale=locale;foreach(var kv in master)translation.AddMessage(kv.Key,kv.Value);TranslationServer.AddTranslation(translation);TranslationServer.SetLocale(locale);_translations[locale]=translation;GameLogger.Log("LANG",$"Loaded {master.Count} strings for locale '{locale}' from mods");}/// <summary> Texts of collection packages (<c>collections/&lt;id&gt;/locale/</c>): names and descriptions a game picker shows before the game's mods are loaded. Merged before the mods, so a mod may still override a key. </summary>
private static void MergeCollectionLocales(string locale,Dictionary<string,string>master){foreach(var collection in ModCollectionStore.LoadAll()){if(collection.Package!=null)MergeLocaleFiles(collection.Package,locale,master);}}private static void MergeLocaleFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string locale,Dictionary<string,string>master){var suffix=$"_{locale}.properties";var exactName=$"{locale}.properties";foreach(var filePath in provider.ListFiles("locale").ToList()){if(filePath.EndsWith("/"))continue;var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileName(filePath);if(fileName==exactName||fileName.EndsWith(suffix))LoadPropertiesFromMod(provider,filePath,master);}}private static void MergeModLocales(string locale,Dictionary<string,string>master){ModManager.Instance.Initialize();foreach(var modId in ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds()){if(!ModManager.Instance.Mods.TryGetValue(modId,out var modInfo))continue;MergeLocaleFiles(modInfo.FileProvider,locale,master);}}private static void LoadPropertiesFromMod(IModFileProvider provider,string path,Dictionary<string,string>target){var text=provider.ReadFileText(path);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return;var count=0;foreach(var rawLine in text.Replace("\r\n","\n").Split('\n')){var line=rawLine.Trim();if(line.Length==0||line[0]=='#')continue;var eqPos=line.IndexOf('=');if(eqPos<0)continue;var key=line.Substring(0,eqPos).Trim();var value=line.Substring(eqPos+1).Trim();if(key.Length>0){target[key]=value;count++;}}if(count>0){GameLogger.Log("LANG",$"Merged '{provider.Mod}' -> {count} keys from '{path}'",LogLevel.Debug);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Determines whether the running main scene is the pre-game launcher. When the game starts directly into <c>scenes/menu/launcher.tscn</c>, the launcher renders its boot overlay first and drives the whole boot pipeline itself through the Boot orchestrator (pure .NET work on a background thread, Godot-bound work on the main thread). Every other entry point — integration tests, direct scene launches for debugging — keeps the synchronous autoload path. This class is only about boot-mode detection: mod readiness now lives in <see cref="ModRegistry.IsInitialized"/> and the Boot phases, and the wait-handle mechanics were removed together with lazy initialization. The flag is read from arbitrary threads and therefore stays volatile. </summary>
public static class BootController{private static readonly object detectLock=new();private static volatile bool _detected;private static volatile bool _isLauncherBoot;/// <summary>True when the current main scene is the pre-game launcher.</summary>
public static bool IsLauncherBoot{get{Detect();return _isLauncherBoot;}}/// <summary> Idempotently resolves the effective main scene path and flags a launcher boot. A positional <c>*.tscn</c> command-line argument (used by direct scene launches and tests) overrides the project <c>application/run/main_scene</c> setting. </summary>
public static void Detect(){if(_detected)return;lock(detectLock){if(_detected)return;_detected=true;if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineArgs();string scene=null;for(var i=0;i<args.Length;i++){var arg=args[i];if(arg.StartsWith("--"))continue;if(arg.EndsWith(".tscn")||arg.EndsWith(".scn")||arg.EndsWith(".escn"))scene=arg;}if(scene==null)scene=ProjectSettings.GetSetting("application/run/main_scene").AsString();_isLauncherBoot=scene!=null&&scene.Replace('\\','/').EndsWith("scenes/menu/launcher.tscn",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches{/// <summary> On-disk cache manager for shader files extracted from zip mods. Godot's <c>GD.Load&lt;Shader&gt;</c> requires a real filesystem path — it cannot read shader source from a byte array or a zip stream — so shaders shipped inside zip mods must be extracted to <c>user://mod_cache/shaders/&lt;mod&gt;/</c> before loading. The copy belongs to the mod that shipped it: a same-named shader of another mod lives in its own folder, and the resolver decides which mod wins. The extraction step also copies <c>.gdshaderinclude</c> files alongside their owning <c>.gdshader</c>, because Godot resolves shader includes relative to the shader file's location on disk. Without this co-location, any shader using an include directive would fail to compile. Extraction follows the content: a file is rewritten only when its bytes differ, so an updated mod gets its new shader on the next launch while unchanged files are not touched (no needless shader recompilation). </summary>
public static class ModCacheManager{private const string ShaderGroupDir="shaders";/// <summary>Returns the globalised cache root path from <c>ModConfig</c>.</summary>
public static string GetCacheRoot(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return Path.Combine(System.Environment.GetFolderPath(System.Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),"cthangover","mod_cache");return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(ModConfig.Instance.Cache.Root);}/// <summary>Directory path where a specific shader's files are cached.</summary>
public static string GetShaderCacheDir(string modId,string shaderName){return Path.Combine(GetCacheRoot(),ShaderGroupDir,modId,shaderName);}/// <summary>Full file path where a specific shader is expected to be cached.</summary>
public static string GetShaderCachePath(string modId,string shaderName){return Path.Combine(GetShaderCacheDir(modId,shaderName),shaderName+".gdshader");}/// <summary>True if the shader already exists in the on-disk cache.</summary>
public static bool IsShaderCached(string modId,string shaderName){return File.Exists(GetShaderCachePath(modId,shaderName));}/// <summary> Extracts shader files from a mod (typically a zip mod) to the on-disk cache so Godot can load them. Shader includes are copied alongside each shader because Godot resolves include directives relative to the shader's location. </summary>
private static bool WriteIfChanged(string path,byte[]bytes){if(bytes==null||(File.Exists(path)&&File.ReadAllBytes(path).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(bytes)))return false;File.WriteAllBytes(path,bytes);return true;}public static void ExtractShaders(string modId,IModFileProvider provider){var files=provider.ListFiles(ShaderGroupDir);if(files==null)return;var shaderExts=ModConfig.Instance.GetShaderExtensionSet();var includeData=new Dictionary<string,byte[]>();var shaderEntries=new List<string>();foreach(var entry in files){if(entry.EndsWith("/"))continue;var relativeName=entry.Substring(ShaderGroupDir.Length+1);var dotIndex=relativeName.LastIndexOf('.');if(dotIndex<=0)continue;var ext=relativeName.Substring(dotIndex);if(!shaderExts.Contains(ext))continue;if(ext==".gdshaderinclude"){var bytes=provider.ReadFileBinary(entry);if(bytes!=null)includeData[relativeName]=bytes;}else{shaderEntries.Add(entry);}}foreach(var entry in shaderEntries){var relativeName=entry.Substring(ShaderGroupDir.Length+1);var dotIndex=relativeName.LastIndexOf('.');var shaderName=relativeName.Substring(0,dotIndex);var targetDir=GetShaderCacheDir(modId,shaderName);Directory.CreateDirectory(targetDir);var changed=WriteIfChanged(Path.Combine(targetDir,relativeName),provider.ReadFileBinary(entry));foreach(var(incName,incBytes)in includeData)changed|=WriteIfChanged(Path.Combine(targetDir,incName),incBytes);if(changed)GameLogger.Log("CACHE",$"Cached shader '{shaderName}' from mod '{modId}'");}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches{/// <summary> On-disk and in-memory cache for mod preview icons fetched from remote catalog entries. Each icon is keyed by <c>mod_id</c> and stored as a PNG file under <c>user://mod_cache/icons/</c>. Three-tier lookup for <see cref="GetOrDownloadAsync"/>: <list type="number"> <item>In-memory <see cref="Texture2D"/> dictionary (fast repeat access)</item> <item>On-disk PNG file (survives game restart)</item> <item>HTTP download from the catalog's <c>icon_url</c> field</item> </list> <see cref="Clear"/> drops both tiers and is called by <see cref="CatalogService"/> when the catalog is force-refreshed, so stale icons for removed mods don't linger on disk. </summary>
public static class ModIconCache{private static readonly System.Net.Http.HttpClient _httpClient=new(){Timeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15),DefaultRequestHeaders={{"User-Agent","Cthangover/1.0"}},};private static readonly Dictionary<string,Texture2D>_memoryCache=new();private const string IconsSubDir="icons";/// <summary>Globalised mod-cache root (<see cref="ModConfig.Cache"/>.<c>Root</c>), with an OS-profile fallback outside the runtime.</summary>
public static string GetCacheRoot(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return Path.Combine(System.Environment.GetFolderPath(System.Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),"cthangover","mod_cache");return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(ModConfig.Instance.Cache.Root);}/// <summary>Icons subdirectory under the cache root.</summary>
public static string GetIconsDir(){return Path.Combine(GetCacheRoot(),IconsSubDir);}/// <summary>Disk path of the cached PNG preview for one mod id.</summary>
public static string GetIconPath(string modId){return Path.Combine(GetIconsDir(),$"{modId}.png");}/// <summary> Returns the cached <see cref="Texture2D"/> for the given mod, downloading it from <paramref name="iconUrl"/> if necessary. Returns <c>null</c> when <paramref name="iconUrl"/> is empty or the download fails. </summary>
public static async Task<Texture2D>GetOrDownloadAsync(string modId,string iconUrl){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconUrl))return null;if(_memoryCache.TryGetValue(modId,out var cached))return cached;var diskPath=GetIconPath(modId);byte[]imageData=null;if(File.Exists(diskPath)){imageData=File.ReadAllBytes(diskPath);}else{try{imageData=await _httpClient.GetByteArrayAsync(iconUrl);if(imageData!=null&&imageData.Length>0){var dir=GetIconsDir();if(!Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);File.WriteAllBytes(diskPath,imageData);GameLogger.Log("ICON_CACHE",$"Downloaded icon for mod '{modId}'");}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("ICON_CACHE",$"Failed to download icon for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}}if(imageData==null||imageData.Length==0)return null;var texture=DecodeImage(imageData,modId);if(texture!=null)_memoryCache[modId]=texture;return texture;}/// <summary> Synchronous version. In non-runtime (test) mode, downloads block the calling thread. In runtime, this is a fire-and-forget wrapper best used from callbacks that don't need the result. </summary>
public static void GetOrDownload(string modId,string iconUrl,Action<Texture2D>onComplete){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconUrl)){onComplete?.Invoke(null);return;}if(_memoryCache.TryGetValue(modId,out var cached)){onComplete?.Invoke(cached);return;}_=DownloadAndCompleteAsync(modId,iconUrl,onComplete);}private static async Task DownloadAndCompleteAsync(string modId,string iconUrl,Action<Texture2D>onComplete){var texture=await GetOrDownloadAsync(modId,iconUrl);onComplete?.Invoke(texture);}/// <summary> Drops all in-memory cached textures and deletes the on-disk icons directory. Called by <see cref="CatalogService"/> on force-refresh so that icons for removed or renamed mods are re-fetched from the updated catalog. </summary>
public static void Clear(){_memoryCache.Clear();var iconsDir=GetIconsDir();if(Directory.Exists(iconsDir)){try{Directory.Delete(iconsDir,recursive:true);GameLogger.Log("ICON_CACHE","Cleared icon cache");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("ICON_CACHE",$"Failed to clear icon cache: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}}private static Texture2D DecodeImage(byte[]data,string modId){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return null;var image=new Image();Error error;if(data[0]==0x89)error=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(data[0]==0xFF)error=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);else return null;if(error!=Error.Ok){image.Dispose();return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();return texture;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON DTO for a single mod entry in the online catalog. Designed to be embedded into the <c>"mods"</c> array of a catalog file hosted on a web server. Every field maps directly to the catalog schema researched from the in-game mod list UI: name, description, dependencies, thumbnail URL, download metadata, and two SHA256 checksums for integrity and modification-detection. <see cref="Depends"/> and <see cref="ConflictsWith"/> use the same string format as the local <c>manifest.json</c> (e.g. <c>"cthangover_game>=1"</c>, <c>"ui_base>=1?"</c>). </summary>
public class CatalogExportEntry{/// <summary>Canonical mod identifier (from manifest.json).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable mod name.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("name")]public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod author credit string.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("author")]public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Semver version string (e.g. "1.0.0").</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("version")]public string Version{get;set;}/// <summary>Short description of what the mod does.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("description")]public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary> Localized name/description entries. When populated the game picks the best match for the player's current language: requested lang → "en" → first available → flat fields. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("locale")]public List<CatalogLocaleEntry>Locale{get;set;}/// <summary>Category (or comma-separated combination of categories, e.g. "Library, Gameplay") for filtering and grouping. Serialised as enum name(s).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("category")][JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]public CategoryType Category{get;set;}/// <summary>Search tags (e.g. ["cooking", "crafting"]).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("tags")]public List<string>Tags{get;set;}/// <summary>Full URL to the mod's preview icon (PNG or JPEG).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("icon_url")]public string IconUrl{get;set;}/// <summary> Versioned dependency strings in the same format as local manifest.json (e.g. "cthangover_game>=1", "ui_base>=2?"). </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("depends")]public List<string>Depends{get;set;}/// <summary>Mutually exclusive mod IDs.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("conflicts_with")]public List<string>ConflictsWith{get;set;}/// <summary> Version-specific download entries with mirror URLs and per-version checksums. Multiple entries allow downloading older versions of the mod. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("downloads")]public List<CatalogEntryDownload>Downloads{get;set;}/// <summary>Release status: stable, beta, deprecated, archived.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("status")]public string Status{get;set;}/// <summary>Minimum compatible game version (semver).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("min_game_version")]public string MinGameVersion{get;set;}/// <summary>Maximum compatible game version, or null if unbounded.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("max_game_version")]public string MaxGameVersion{get;set;}/// <summary> Catalog URLs this entry was fetched from. Filled by <see cref="CatalogService"/> during refresh (one URL per catalog that published the mod) and persisted in the on-disk cache so the UI can show where a mod comes from without a network round-trip. Null for entries built for export — exporters omit it. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("source_urls")]public List<string>SourceUrls{get;set;}/// <summary> Set when several catalogs publish the same id with the same version and title but different content hashes. Such entries are not merged: each variant stays a separate entry flagged for the UI to highlight, because one of the catalogs is likely serving a modified build. Null (omitted) for normal entries so catalog export JSON stays clean. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("variant_conflict")]public bool?VariantConflict{get;set;}/// <summary>Display name for the language: matching locale entry, then "en", then the first entry, then the flat <see cref="Name"/> (or id).</summary>
public string GetLocalizedName(string language){var locale=ResolveLocale(language);if(locale!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(locale.Name))return locale.Name;return Name??Id;}/// <summary>Description for the language: matching locale entry, then "en", then the first entry, then the flat <see cref="Description"/>.</summary>
public string GetLocalizedDescription(string language){var locale=ResolveLocale(language);if(locale!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(locale.Description))return locale.Description;return Description??string.Empty;}private CatalogLocaleEntry ResolveLocale(string language){if(Locale==null||Locale.Count==0)return null;return Locale.FirstOrDefault(l=>l.Lang==language)??Locale.FirstOrDefault(l=>l.Lang=="en")??Locale[0];}}/// <summary> Version-specific download entry with mirror URLs and per-version integrity checksums. Multiple mirrors for the same version are supported — the game will try each URL in order. </summary>
public class CatalogEntryDownload{/// <summary>Semver version this download entry provides.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("version")]public string Version{get;set;}/// <summary>Mirror URLs for the mod's .zip archive. The game tries each URL in order until one succeeds.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("urls")]public List<string>Urls{get;set;}/// <summary>File size of the downloadable archive in bytes, for progress-bar display before the download starts.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("size_bytes")]public long SizeBytes{get;set;}/// <summary> SHA256 checksum of the downloadable .zip archive for this specific version. Used to verify download integrity. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("archive_sha256")]public string ArchiveSha256{get;set;}/// <summary> SHA256 checksum of the mod's extracted content for this specific version. Compared against the locally-installed copy to detect player modifications. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("install_sha256")]public string InstallSha256{get;set;}/// <summary>Optional changelog describing what changed in this specific version.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("changelog")]public string Changelog{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Pure merging rules for the online mod catalog. Extracted from <see cref="CatalogService"/> so the conflict/provenance logic is unit testable without network or Godot. <para/> Normal case: all catalogs publishing the same mod id are combined into one entry — the newest version wins, downloads of every version are merged and <see cref="CatalogExportEntry.SourceUrls"/> lists every catalog that published it. Exceptional case: the same id, version and title appear in several catalogs with <b>different content hashes</b>; those are kept as separate entries flagged with <see cref="CatalogExportEntry.VariantConflict"/> (each carrying its own source URL) so the UI can warn the player about a likely counterfeit build instead of silently picking one. </summary>
public static class CatalogMerger{/// <summary> Tags a freshly fetched entry with the catalog URL it came from, preserving URLs already present. </summary>
public static void TagSource(CatalogExportEntry entry,string url){if(entry==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)||url==entry.SourceUrls?.FirstOrDefault())return;entry.SourceUrls??=new List<string>();if(!entry.SourceUrls.Contains(url))entry.SourceUrls.Add(url);}/// <summary> Merges raw catalog entries (possibly from several catalogs) into the deduplicated, conflict-aware list consumed by the UI and downloader. </summary>
public static List<CatalogExportEntry>MergeAndDeduplicate(List<CatalogExportEntry>entries){var result=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();if(entries==null)return result;foreach(var group in entries.GroupBy(e=>e.Id)){var list=group.ToList();if(!HasVariantConflict(list)){result.Add(MergeGroup(list));continue;}foreach(var variant in list.GroupBy(GetVariantKey)){var merged=MergeGroup(variant.ToList());merged.VariantConflict=true;result.Add(merged);}}return result;}/// <summary> Selects the entry to install. When conflicting variants share an id, the caller passes the source URL of the chosen one; without a source (or when it matches nothing) the first matching entry wins. </summary>
public static CatalogExportEntry FindEntry(IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>entries,string modId,string sourceUrl){if(entries==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return null;CatalogExportEntry fallback=null;foreach(var entry in entries){if(!string.Equals(entry.Id,modId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;fallback??=entry;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceUrl)||entry.SourceUrls==null)continue;foreach(var url in entry.SourceUrls){if(string.Equals(url,sourceUrl,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return entry;}}return fallback;}/// <summary> True when two entries describe the same mod (id, version, title) but their content hashes differ — one of the catalogs is serving a modified build or a different mod under the same name. </summary>
private static bool HasVariantConflict(List<CatalogExportEntry>list){for(var i=0;i<list.Count;i++){for(var j=i+1;j<list.Count;j++){var a=list[i];var b=list[j];if(!string.Equals(a.Version,b.Version,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(!string.Equals(a.Name??a.Id,b.Name??b.Id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(!string.Equals(GetVariantKey(a),GetVariantKey(b),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return true;}}return false;}/// <summary> Content identity of an entry: its own version plus the hash of that version's download. Entries with the same key are the same build and may be merged across catalogs. </summary>
private static string GetVariantKey(CatalogExportEntry entry)=>$"{entry?.Version ?? "?"}|{GetVersionHash(entry, entry?.Version)}";private static string GetVersionHash(CatalogExportEntry entry,string version){if(entry?.Downloads==null||entry.Downloads.Count==0)return"nohash";CatalogEntryDownload match=null;foreach(var download in entry.Downloads){if(string.Equals(download.Version,version,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){match=download;break;}}match??=entry.Downloads[0];if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.InstallSha256))return match.InstallSha256;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(match.ArchiveSha256))return match.ArchiveSha256;return"nohash";}private static CatalogExportEntry MergeGroup(List<CatalogExportEntry>group){var best=group.OrderByDescending(e=>e.Version??"0.0.0",Comparer<string>.Create((a,b)=>VersionHelper.Compare(a,b))).First();var allDownloads=group.SelectMany(e=>e.Downloads??new List<CatalogEntryDownload>());best.Downloads=MergeDownloadVersions(allDownloads);best.SourceUrls=MergeSources(group);if(group.Any(e=>e.VariantConflict==true))best.VariantConflict=true;return best;}private static List<string>MergeSources(List<CatalogExportEntry>group){var sources=new List<string>();foreach(var entry in group){if(entry.SourceUrls==null)continue;foreach(var url in entry.SourceUrls){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)&& !sources.Contains(url))sources.Add(url);}}return sources.Count>0?sources:null;}private static List<CatalogEntryDownload>MergeDownloadVersions(IEnumerable<CatalogEntryDownload>downloads){var merged=new Dictionary<string,CatalogEntryDownload>();foreach(var dl in using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON envelope for the online mod catalog. Expected structure: <code> { "catalog": { "version": 1, "updated_at": "2026-..." }, "mods": [ ...CatalogExportEntry... ], "collections": [ ...ModCollection... ] } </code> <see cref="CatalogService"/> fetches this from each configured URL, deserializes, and merges the <c>"mods"</c> and <c>"collections"</c> arrays independently. The <c>collections</c> key is optional so catalogs written before collections existed keep working. </summary>
public class CatalogRoot{/// <summary>Catalog-level metadata (version, last-updated timestamp).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("catalog")]public CatalogMeta Meta{get;set;}/// <summary>List of mod entries available in this catalog.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("mods")]public List<CatalogExportEntry>Mods{get;set;}/// <summary>Curated mod collections this catalog distributes; see <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("collections")]public List<ModCollection>Collections{get;set;}}/// <summary> Metadata about the catalog file itself — version of the format and when it was last refreshed on the server. </summary>
public class CatalogMeta{/// <summary>Schema version of this catalog file.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("version")]public int Version{get;set;}/// <summary>ISO-8601 timestamp of the last update on the server.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("updated_at")]public string UpdatedAt{get;set;}}}
