using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Fetches, caches, and merges online mod catalogs from the URLs configured in <see cref="ModConfig.CatalogUrls"/>. Multiple catalogs are merged via deduplication by mod ID — the entry with the highest <see cref="CatalogExportEntry.Version"/> wins. Two-tier caching: an on-disk JSON cache at <c>user://catalog_cache.json</c> avoids network round-trips on every open of the Network tab; the cache is loaded eagerly on first access and refreshed when the user presses the Refresh button or when <see cref="ModConfig.CatalogUrls"/> changes. <see cref="OnRefreshed"/> / <see cref="OnRefreshFailed"/> fire on the main thread after an async fetch completes so that UI subscribers can safely rebuild their node trees. </summary>
public static class CatalogService{private static readonly System.Net.Http.HttpClient _httpClient=new(){Timeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),DefaultRequestHeaders={{"User-Agent","Cthangover/1.0"}},};private static List<CatalogExportEntry>_cachedEntries;private static List<ModCollection>_cachedCollections;private static bool _isFetching;private static DateTime _lastFetchTime=DateTime.MinValue;private static readonly TimeSpan FetchCooldown=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);/// <summary>The current merged catalog data, or null until first load.</summary>
public static List<CatalogExportEntry>CachedEntries=>_cachedEntries;/// <summary> The current merged collection list from every catalog, or null until first load. Consumed by <see cref="ModCollectionStore.LoadAll"/>. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>CachedCollections=>_cachedCollections;/// <summary>True while an async refresh is in flight.</summary>
public static bool IsFetching=>_isFetching;/// <summary>Fired on the main thread after a successful refresh.</summary>
public static event Action OnRefreshed;/// <summary>Fired on the main thread with an error message when refresh fails.</summary>
public static event Action<string>OnRefreshFailed;/// <summary> Loads cached catalog data from disk if available. Safe to call multiple times — subsequent calls are no-ops. </summary>
public static void LoadCache(){if(_cachedEntries!=null)return;var path=GetCachePath();if(File.Exists(path)){try{var json=File.ReadAllText(path);if(TryLoadEnvelope(json)){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Loaded catalog cache: {_cachedEntries?.Count ?? 0} mod(s), {_cachedCollections?.Count ?? 0} collection(s)");return;}_cachedEntries=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<CatalogExportEntry>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Loaded legacy catalog cache: {_cachedEntries?.Count ?? 0} entr(y/ies)");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Failed to load catalog cache: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}}/// <summary> Reads the two-list cache envelope. Returns false for the legacy array-only format (a bare JSON array), which the caller then parses as a plain mod list. </summary>
private static bool TryLoadEnvelope(string json){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json))return false;var trimmed=json.TrimStart();if(trimmed[0]!='{')return false;var root=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CatalogCacheRoot>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(root==null)return false;_cachedEntries=root.Mods??new List<CatalogExportEntry>();_cachedCollections=root.Collections??new List<ModCollection>();return true;}/// <summary> Fetches all configured catalog URLs, merges the results, and fires <see cref="OnRefreshed"/> on the main thread. Clears the on-disk cache if <paramref name="forceRefresh"/> is true before fetching. Cancelling <paramref name="cancellationToken"/> aborts the in-flight HTTP requests and suppresses the completion events, so a caller whose window is closing is never called back. The <see cref="IsFetching"/> flag is always cleared — on success, cancellation, and unexpected exceptions alike — otherwise a single failed merge would permanently block every later refresh. </summary>
public static async Task RefreshAsync(bool forceRefresh=false,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){if(_isFetching)return;var sinceLast=DateTime.UtcNow-_lastFetchTime;if(!forceRefresh&&sinceLast<FetchCooldown){var remain=(FetchCooldown-sinceLast).TotalSeconds;GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Skipping refresh (cooldown, last attempt was {sinceLast.TotalSeconds:F1}s ago, {remain:F1}s remaining)");return;}_isFetching=true;_lastFetchTime=DateTime.UtcNow;try{cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(forceRefresh){ClearCache();ModIconCache.Clear();}var allEntries=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();var allCollections=new List<ModCollection>();var errors=new List<string>();var urls=ModConfig.Instance.CatalogUrls;if(urls==null||urls.Count==0){_cachedEntries=new List<CatalogExportEntry>();_cachedCollections=new List<ModCollection>();OnRefreshed?.Invoke();return;}GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Starting catalog refresh from {urls.Count} URL(s)...");foreach(var url in urls){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))continue;try{GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetching catalog from '{url}'...");var json=await _httpClient.GetStringAsync(url,cancellationToken);var catalog=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CatalogRoot>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(catalog?.Mods!=null){foreach(var mod in catalog.Mods)CatalogMerger.TagSource(mod,url);allEntries.AddRange(catalog.Mods);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetched {catalog.Mods.Count} entr(y/ies) from '{url}'");}if(catalog?.Collections!=null){foreach(var collection in catalog.Collections)CatalogCollectionMerger.TagSource(collection,url);allCollections.AddRange(catalog.Collections);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Fetched {catalog.Collections.Count} collection(s) from '{url}'");}}catch(OperationCanceledException)when(cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested){throw;}catch(Exception ex){var msg=$"Failed to fetch catalog from '{url}': {ex.Message}";GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",msg,LogLevel.Error);errors.Add(msg);}}if(allEntries.Count>0||allCollections.Count>0){_cachedEntries=CatalogMerger.MergeAndDeduplicate(allEntries);_cachedCollections=CatalogCollectionMerger.MergeAndDeduplicate(allCollections);SaveCache(_cachedEntries,_cachedCollections);GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Catalog refresh complete: {_cachedEntries.Count} total mod(s), {_cachedCollections.Count} collection(s) merged");OnRefreshed?.Invoke();}else if(_cachedEntries==null&&errors.Count>0){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG","Catalog refresh failed: all URLs returned errors",LogLevel.Error);OnRefreshFailed?.Invoke(string.Join("\n",errors));}else{GameLogger.Log("CATALOG","Catalog refresh complete: no new entries");OnRefreshed?.Invoke();}}finally{_isFetching=false;}}/// <summary> Deletes the on-disk cache and clears in-memory state. The next call to <see cref="RefreshAsync"/> will fetch everything from scratch. </summary>
public static void ClearCache(){_cachedEntries=null;_cachedCollections=null;var path=GetCachePath();if(File.Exists(path))File.Delete(path);}/// <summary> Compares a locally-installed mod against its catalog entry. </summary> <param name="localVersion">Installed mod version string.</param> <param name="localInstallSha256">SHA256 of the installed mod's content, computed by <see cref="ModHasher.ComputeInstallSha256"/>.</param> <param name="remoteEntry">Corresponding catalog entry.</param> <returns>The relationship between the local copy and the remote version.</returns>
public static RemoteModStatus GetRemoteModStatus(string localVersion,string localInstallSha256,CatalogExportEntry remoteEntry){if(localVersion==null)return RemoteModStatus.NotInstalled;var download=FindDownloadForVersion(remoteEntry,localVersion);var remoteVersion=remoteEntry.Version;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteVersion)&&VersionHelper.IsGreaterThan(remoteVersion,localVersion))return RemoteModStatus.UpdateAvailable;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(localInstallSha256)&&download!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.InstallSha256)&& !string.Equals(localInstallSha256,download.InstallSha256,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return RemoteModStatus.ModifiedLocally;return RemoteModStatus.Installed;}private static CatalogEntryDownload FindDownloadForVersion(CatalogExportEntry entry,string version){if(entry?.Downloads==null)return null;foreach(var d in entry.Downloads){if(string.Equals(d.Version,version,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return d;}return null;}private static void SaveCache(List<CatalogExportEntry>entries,List<ModCollection>collections){try{var path=GetCachePath();var root=new CatalogCacheRoot{Mods=entries,Collections=collections};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(root,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CATALOG",$"Failed to save catalog cache: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}private static string GetCachePath(){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("user://catalog_cache.json");return"catalog_cache.json";}}/// <summary> Relationship between a locally-installed mod and its remote catalog counterpart. </summary>
public enum RemoteModStatus{/// <summary>The mod is installed and up-to-date with the catalog.</summary>
Installed,/// <summary>A newer version is available in the catalog.</summary>
UpdateAvailable,/// <summary>The mod is not installed locally.</summary>
NotInstalled,/// <summary>Same version, but the local content differs from the catalog's <c>install_sha256</c> — the player has edited the mod locally and overwriting would lose their changes.</summary>
ModifiedLocally,}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods;/// <summary> Catalog category — or a combination of categories — used to group mods in the online catalog and in the mod manifests. Declared as a bit-flag enum so one mod can belong to several categories at once (e.g. a battle engine is both <c>Library</c> and <c>Gameplay</c>). JSON serialisation via <c>JsonStringEnumConverter</c> keeps single categories as plain names (<c>"gameplay"</c>, fully backward compatible with catalogs written before combinations existed) and writes combinations as a comma-separated list (<c>"library, gameplay"</c>). Parsing is case-insensitive. </summary>
[System.Flags]public enum CategoryType{Story=1<<0,Characters=1<<1,Gameplay=1<<2,Visual=1<<3,Audio=1<<4,UI=1<<5,Locale=1<<6,Library=1<<7,Engine=1<<8,Overhaul=1<<9,Tools=1<<10,Editor=1<<11,Debug=1<<12,Other=1<<13,}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Pure merge rules for collections published by several online catalogs, the collection counterpart of <see cref="CatalogMerger"/>. Collections carry no content hashes, so the rules are simpler: entries with the same id collapse into the one with the highest version, and every catalog that published the id is recorded in <see cref="ModCollection.SourceUrls"/> so the UI can show provenance (and future per-source variants). </summary>
public static class CatalogCollectionMerger{/// <summary> Tags a freshly fetched collection with the catalog URL it came from, preserving URLs already present. </summary>
public static void TagSource(ModCollection collection,string url){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return;collection.SourceUrls??=new List<string>();if(!collection.SourceUrls.Contains(url))collection.SourceUrls.Add(url);}/// <summary> Merges raw catalog collections into the deduplicated list consumed by <see cref="CatalogService.CachedCollections"/>. Returns a new list; the winning collection objects are mutated in place with the merged sources. </summary>
public static List<ModCollection>MergeAndDeduplicate(List<ModCollection>collections){var result=new List<ModCollection>();if(collections==null)return result;var byId=new Dictionary<string,ModCollection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var collection in collections){if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id))continue;if(!byId.TryGetValue(collection.Id,out var existing)){byId[collection.Id]=collection;result.Add(collection);continue;}if(VersionHelper.Compare(collection.Version??"0.0.0",existing.Version??"0.0.0")>0){MergeSources(collection,existing);var index=result.IndexOf(existing);if(index>=0)result[index]=collection;byId[collection.Id]=collection;}else{MergeSources(existing,collection);}}return result;}private static void MergeSources(ModCollection target,ModCollection other){if(other.SourceUrls==null)return;target.SourceUrls??=new List<string>();foreach(var url in other.SourceUrls){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)&& !target.SourceUrls.Contains(url))target.SourceUrls.Add(url);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Loads and persists scheme layouts from <c>user://collection_layout.json</c>. The file holds one <see cref="ModCollectionLayout"/> per game id, so the player's arrangement of the "РПГ Новелла" canvas is independent from any other assembly. Layouts are UI-only: if the file is missing or broken the editor simply falls back to its default packed layout, and nothing in the collection documents is affected. <para/> Follows the <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/> warm-up pattern: the user path is resolved once on the main thread because <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> is Godot API and is not available from worker threads. </summary>
public static class CollectionLayoutStore{private const string UserFilePath="user://collection_layout.json";private static Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>_cache;private static string _resolvedPath;/// <summary> Resolves the user storage path once on the main thread before the background mod-load phase, mirroring <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(){_resolvedPath=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(UserFilePath):"collection_layout.json";}private static string ResolvedPath=>_resolvedPath??(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(UserFilePath):"collection_layout.json");/// <summary>Returns the saved layout for a game, or a fresh empty one. Never null.</summary>
public static ModCollectionLayout Load(string gameId){var all=LoadAll();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameId)&&all.TryGetValue(gameId,out var layout)&&layout!=null)return layout;return new ModCollectionLayout();}/// <summary>Stores the layout for a game and flushes the whole file.</summary>
public static void Save(string gameId,ModCollectionLayout layout){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameId)||layout==null)return;var all=LoadAll();all[gameId]=layout;SaveAll(all);}private static Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>LoadAll(){if(_cache!=null)return _cache;_cache=new Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var path=ResolvedPath;if(!File.Exists(path))return _cache;try{var json=File.ReadAllText(path);var parsed=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(parsed!=null)_cache=new Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>(parsed,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Failed to load collection layouts: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}return _cache;}private static void SaveAll(Dictionary<string,ModCollectionLayout>all){try{var path=ResolvedPath;var dir=Path.GetDirectoryName(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)&& !Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(all,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Failed to save collection layouts: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Implements the collection text convention: a <c>name</c>, <c>description</c>, include <c>label</c>/<c>note</c> (or a locale entry) that starts with <c>'@'</c> is a translation key (e.g. <c>"@collections/novel_template/name"</c>), registered by <see cref="LocaleLoader"/> from the <c>locale/*.properties</c> files of every mod. The remainder after <c>'@'</c> is looked up through Godot's <c>TranslationServer</c>; when no translation is registered the raw text after <c>'@'</c> is shown instead, so an untranslated collection never renders as a bare key or an empty string. <para/> The class is the Godot-dependent half of the convention: <see cref="StripKey"/> stays pure for tests and headless tools, while <see cref="Resolve"/> is what the collections screen passes to <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/> as its <c>translator</c> argument. </summary>
public static class CollectionText{/// <summary>Prefix marking a field value as a translation key.</summary>
private const char KeyPrefix='@';/// <summary> True when the raw field value is a translation-key reference (starts with <c>'@'</c>). </summary>
public static bool IsKey(string raw)=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw)&&raw[0]==KeyPrefix;/// <summary> Translation key without the leading <c>'@'</c>, or null when the value is not a key reference. Pure — safe outside the Godot runtime. </summary>
public static string StripKey(string raw)=>IsKey(raw)?raw.Substring(1):null;/// <summary> Resolves a raw field value for display: plain text is returned unchanged, an <c>'@'</c>-prefixed value is translated through the Godot <c>TranslationServer</c>, falling back to the stripped key text when the key is not registered (or when no Godot runtime is available, e.g. in unit tests). Never returns null for non-null input, so UI code can bind the result directly. </summary>
public static string Resolve(string raw){var key=StripKey(raw);if(key==null)return raw;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return key;try{// The provider returns null when Godot echoes the key back, which is its signal for "no translation registered".
return GodotTranslationProvider.Instance.Get(key)??key;}catch{// Godot API unavailable on this thread or not initialized — degrade gracefully to the human-readable key text.
return key;}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> A curated set of mods that together implement a game mechanic ("card novel", "developer tools") — the game-construction unit the mod catalog is organized by. Unlike <see cref="CategoryType"/>, which labels a single mod, a collection describes a composition: the same mod can be a required backbone in one collection and an optional layer in another. <para/> Collections are packages of their own (<c>collections/&lt;id&gt;/collection.json</c> with a cover and texts), shipped with the game, fetched from online catalogs or created by the player (<c>user://collections/</c>) — see <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>. The dependency graph shown to the player is not stored here: it is derived from the mods' own <c>depends</c> by <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/>, with <see cref="Mechanics"/> only telling the graph view how to group the nodes. </summary>
public class ModCollection{/// <summary>Canonical collection id, unique across all sources.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable collection name.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("name")]public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Author credit string.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("author")]public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary> Where this collection belongs in the assembly pyramid. Missing values deserialize to <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Game"/> so documents written before kinds existed keep appearing as playable games. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("kind")][JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]public ModCollectionKind Kind{get;set;}=ModCollectionKind.Game;/// <summary>Short description of the gameplay or toolset the collection assembles.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("description")]public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>Free-form search tags ("systems", "cards", "2d", ...).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("tags")]public List<string>Tags{get;set;}/// <summary> Capability ids this collection implements ("character_system", "inventory", ...). Used by the scheme editor to suggest compatible blocks; resolution does not enforce them. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("provides")]public List<string>Provides{get;set;}/// <summary> Capability ids this collection needs from its siblings. The resolver reports a <see cref="ModCollectionProblemKind.RequirementMissing"/> problem when no resolved block provides them. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("requires")]public List<string>Requires{get;set;}/// <summary> Child collections this one is assembled from, each with its slot role and optional flag. Includes are the recursive edge of the pyramid: the same collection may be included by several parents with different roles, and a parent may also declare its own <see cref="Mechanics"/>. Resolution flattens both into scheme groups. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("includes")]public List<ModCollectionInclude>Includes{get;set;}/// <summary>Semver version, used to pick the newest of identically-named catalog collections.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("version")]public string Version{get;set;}/// <summary> Ordered mechanics that make up the collection. The order drives the top-to-bottom layout of the graph view; one mod belongs to the first mechanic that lists it. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("mechanics")]public List<ModCollectionMechanic>Mechanics{get;set;}/// <summary> Where a new game of this collection starts. Only meaningful for <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Game"/>; null falls back to the historical <c>start_scene</c>. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("entry")]public ModCollectionEntry Entry{get;set;}/// <summary> Game parameters mods read through the kernel's active game (e.g. <c>"battle.core": "card_battle"</c>). Keys are owned by the mods that read them; unknown keys are ignored. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("settings")]public Dictionary<string,string>Settings{get;set;}/// <summary>Cover image for the game picker, a path inside the collection package (e.g. <c>cover.png</c>).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("cover")]public string Cover{get;set;}/// <summary> Catalog URLs that published this collection. Filled by <see cref="CatalogService"/> during refresh; null for local files. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("source_urls")]public List<string>SourceUrls{get;set;}/// <summary> The package the document was read from (a folder or zip under <c>collections/</c> or <c>user://collections/</c>); resolves <see cref="Cover"/> and the package's <c>locale/</c> files. Null for catalog collections. Set by <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>. </summary>
[JsonIgnore]public IModFileProvider Package{get;set;}/// <summary>Where this instance was loaded from; set by <see cref="ModCollectionStore"/>.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public ModCollectionOrigin Origin{get;set;}/// <summary>Safe UI label falling back to the id.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public string DisplayTitle=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name)?Id:Name;/// <summary> Localized name/description entries, same shape as catalog mod entries. [JsonPropertyName("locale")]public List<CatalogLocaleEntry>Locale{get;set;}/// <summary> Name for the given language: requested locale entry -> flat name -> English locale entry -> first entry -> id. public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Collection display description with the translator applied; raw '@key' when no translator was given.</summary>
public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>Total mods the collection needs, transitive dependencies included.</summary>
public int TotalMods{get;set;}/// <summary>Mods already installed, enabled and satisfying any version pin.</summary>
public int InstalledCount{get;set;}/// <summary>Ids of the mods counted by <see cref="InstalledCount"/>.</summary>
public List<string>ReadyMods{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids that are neither installed nor available in any catalog — the plan cannot fix them.</summary>
public List<string>MissingIds{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids whose installed version (or available download) does not satisfy the collection pin.</summary>
public List<string>MismatchIds{get;}=new();/// <summary>Resolution inconsistencies (missing blocks, cycles, role conflicts, unmet requirements).</summary>
public int ProblemsCount{get;set;}/// <summary>Mods <see cref="ModCollectionPlan"/> would download and install.</summary>

public bool IsReady=>TotalMods>0&&MissingIds.Count==0&&MismatchIds.Count==0&&ProblemsCount==0;}/// <summary> Read-only aggregation layer over the merged collection store for the game gallery UI: resolves every <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Game"/> collection through <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/> and folds the resulting graphs and plans into one <see cref="ModCollectionGameSummary"/> per game. There are no hardcoded collection ids — everything comes from the store passed by the caller (<see cref="ModCollectionStore.LoadAll"/>), so mods, catalogs and player documents all appear without code changes. <para/> Like the resolver the class is pure: every input is an argument, which keeps the summaries testable without Godot. </summary>
public static class ModCollectionGallery{/// <summary> Builds one summary per Game collection in the store. Component and Toolset collections are building material, not playable games, and are skipped. Entries are ordered by display name, then id, so the gallery renders deterministically regardless of store order; the <paramref name="translator"/> (e.g. <see cref="CollectionText.Resolve"/>) resolves '@key' display text, and null keeps raw keys for tests; <paramref name="language"/> (the UI locale) picks the collections' own locale entries, null keeps the flat (English) text. </summary>
public static List<ModCollectionGameSummary>Build(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>localMods,IReadOnlyCollection<string>disabledIds,IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries,IReadOnlyCollection<string>sessionInstalled,Func<string,string>translator=null,string language=null){var result=new List<ModCollectionGameSummary>();if(collections==null)return result;foreach(var pair in collections){var collection=pair.Value;if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id))continue;if(collection.Kind!=ModCollectionKind.Game)continue;var graph=ModCollectionResolver.Resolve(collection,collections,localMods,disabledIds,catalogEntries,sessionInstalled,language,translator);var plan=ModCollectionPlan.Build(graph,catalogEntries);var summary=new ModCollectionGameSummary{Collection=collection,Name=Translate(collection.GetLocalizedName(language),translator),Description=Translate(collection.GetLocalizedDescription(language),translator),TotalMods=graph.TotalCount,InstalledCount=graph.InstalledCount,ProblemsCount=graph.Problems.Count,PlanInstallCount=plan.Install.Count,PlanEnableCount=plan.Enable.Count,};foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){switch(node.State){case ModCollectionNodeState.Installed:summary.ReadyMods.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.Missing:summary.MissingIds.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.VersionMismatch:summary.MismatchIds.Add(node.ModId);break;}}result.Add(summary);}result.Sort((left,right)=>{var byName=string.Compare(left.Name??left.Collection?.Id??string.Empty,right.Name??right.Collection?.Id??string.Empty,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(byName!=0)return byName;var leftId=left.Collection?.Id??string.Empty;var rightId=right.Collection?.Id??string.Empty;return string.Compare(leftId,rightId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);});return result;}/// <summary> Answers "which games use this mod?" for the mod-side cross links: returns a map with a single entry keyed by the normalized mod id (version constraints are stripped, comparison is case-insensitive) whose value lists the ids of <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Game"/> collections that reference the mod — directly through a mechanic's mod list or transitively through their includes. Entries are sorted by collection id; a game-less mod yields an empty list, and an empty <paramref name="modId"/> yields an empty map. </summary>
public static Dictionary<string,List<string>>FindGamesUsingMod(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,string modId){var result=new Dictionary<string,List<string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var target=NormalizeId(modId);if(collections==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(target))return result;var games=new List<string>();foreach(var pair in collections){var collection=pair.Value;if(collection==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(collection.Id))continue;if(collection.Kind!=ModCollectionKind.Game)continue;if(ReferencesMod(collections,collection,target,new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))games.Add(collection.Id);}games.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);result[target]=games;return result;}/// <summary> Walks a collection's own mechanics and, through its includes, the mechanics of every reachable block, looking for the mod id. The visited set turns include cycles into a plain "already seen" stop. </summary>
private static bool ReferencesMod(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,ModCollection collection,string modId,HashSet<string>visited){if(!visited.Add(collection.Id))return false;foreach(var mechanic in collection.Mechanics??new List<ModCollectionMechanic>()){if(mechanic==null)continue;foreach(var raw in mechanic.Mods??new List<string>()){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))continue;if(string.Equals(NormalizeId(raw),modId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return true;}}foreach(var include in collection.Includes??new List<ModCollectionInclude>()){if(include==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(include.Ref))continue;var childId=NormalizeId(include.Ref);if(TryGetCollection(collections,childId,out var child)&&ReferencesMod(collections,child,modId,visited)){return true;}}return false;}/// <summary>Strips a version constraint ("<c>app&gt;=1</c>" -> <c>app</c>), keeping comparison version-free.</summary>
private static string NormalizeId(string raw){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))return null;var dependency=ModDependency.Parse(raw);return dependency.IsValid?dependency.ModId:raw.Trim();}/// <summary>Case-insensitive lookup mirroring the resolver's tolerance for loosely-keyed stores.</summary>
private static bool TryGetCollection(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,string id,out ModCollection collection){collection=null;if(collections==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(collections.TryGetValue(id,out collection)&&collection!=null)return true;foreach(var pair in collections){if(pair.Value!=null&&string.Equals(pair.Key,id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){collection=pair.Value;return true;}}return false;}/// <summary>Applies the optional translator; null output keeps the raw value.</summary>
private static string Translate(string raw,Func<string,string>translator){if(raw==null||translator==null)return raw;return translator(raw)??raw;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Resolved, render-ready form of a <see cref="ModCollection"/>: the mods it needs (including transitive dependencies), the dependency edges between them, and each mod's availability state. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Shared "apply a collection plan" routine for every surface that can install a collection: the mod hub gallery, the scheme editor and the main menu's game picker. Downloads every <see cref="ModCollectionPlan.Install"/> item through <see cref="ModDownloader"/> in graph order and, when all of them succeeded, re-enables the <see cref="ModCollectionPlan.Enable"/> ids in <c>disabled_mods.json</c> — the same file operations the collections screen has always performed on apply. Ids of mods installed during this session are added to the caller's set so both the registry-blind UI and a restart banner stay honest until the next launch. </summary>
public static class ModCollectionInstaller{/// <summary> Applies the plan; returns true when every download succeeded and the enable list was written. Never throws for download failures — they are logged and reported through the return value. </summary>
public static async Task<bool>ApplyAsync(ModCollectionPlan plan,ISet<string>sessionInstalled){if(plan==null||plan.IsEmpty||plan.Missing.Count>0)return false;foreach(var item in plan.Install){bool success;try{success=await ModDownloader.InstallAsync(item.ModId,item.Version,item.SourceUrl);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MOD_COLLECTIONS",$"Install '{item.ModId}' failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);success=false;}if(!success)return false;sessionInstalled?.Add(item.ModId);}var disabled=DisabledModsStore.Load();var changed=false;foreach(var id in plan.Enable)changed|=disabled.Remove(id);if(changed)DisabledModsStore.Save(disabled);return true;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Action plan that turns a resolved <see cref="ModCollectionGraph"/> into concrete steps for the collections screen: which mods to download, which disabled mods to re-enable, and what blocks a full apply. The split keeps the decision logic testable — actual file writes and downloads stay in <c>ModDownloader</c> / <c>DisabledModsStore</c> / the UI. <para/> Enable list contains mods that are already on disk but disabled; mods in <see cref="Installed"/> state are left untouched. <see cref="Missing"/> and <see cref="Mismatches"/> are informational: the UI shows them as warnings and blocks applying while something is missing, because enabling a mod whose dependency cannot be loaded would only make the registry drop it at next boot. </summary>
public class ModCollectionPlan{/// <summary>Mods to download and install, in graph order (foundations first).</summary>
public List<ModCollectionInstallItem>Install{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids of installed but disabled mods to remove from <c>disabled_mods.json</c>.</summary>
public List<string>Enable{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids that are neither installed nor available in any catalog.</summary>
public List<string>Missing{get;}=new();/// <summary>Ids whose installed version does not satisfy the collection's pin, or that have no satisfying download.</summary>
public List<string>Mismatches{get;}=new();/// <summary>True when applying the collection would not change anything.</summary>
public bool IsEmpty=>Install.Count==0&&Enable.Count==0;/// <summary>True when the collection cannot be assembled completely.</summary>
public bool HasProblems=>Missing.Count>0||Mismatches.Count>0;/// <summary> Builds the plan for a resolved graph using the same merged catalog the downloader will read. Pass the catalog list the graph was resolved with so node states and chosen downloads stay consistent. </summary>
public static ModCollectionPlan Build(ModCollectionGraph graph,IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries){var plan=new ModCollectionPlan();if(graph==null)return plan;var catalogById=IndexCatalog(catalogEntries);foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){switch(node.State){case ModCollectionNodeState.InCatalog:AddInstall(plan,node,catalogById);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.Disabled:plan.Enable.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.Missing:plan.Missing.Add(node.ModId);break;case ModCollectionNodeState.VersionMismatch:plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);break;}}return plan;}private static void AddInstall(ModCollectionPlan plan,ModCollectionNode node,Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>catalogById){if(!catalogById.TryGetValue(node.ModId,out var entry)){plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);return;}var download=SelectDownload(entry,node.Dependency);if(download==null){plan.Mismatches.Add(node.ModId);return;}plan.Install.Add(new ModCollectionInstallItem{ModId=node.ModId,Version=download.Version,SourceUrl=FirstSource(entry),});}/// <summary> Picks the newest download that satisfies the collection's version pin. Downloads are ordered newest-first by <see cref="CatalogMerger"/>, so the first satisfying one is the best choice; without a pin the newest download is used as-is. </summary>
private static CatalogEntryDownload SelectDownload(CatalogExportEntry entry,ModDependency dependency){if(entry?.Downloads==null||entry.Downloads.Count==0)return null;if(!dependency.IsValid||string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependency.VersionRaw))return entry.Downloads[0];foreach(var download in entry.Downloads){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.Version)&&dependency.IsSatisfiedBy(download.Version)){return download;}}return null;}private static string FirstSource(CatalogExportEntry entry){if(entry.SourceUrls==null)return null;foreach(var url in entry.SourceUrls){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return url;}return null;}private static Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>IndexCatalog(IReadOnlyList<CatalogExportEntry>catalogEntries){var index=new Dictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>(System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(catalogEntries==null)return index;foreach(var entry in catalogEntries){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry?.Id)&& !index.ContainsKey(entry.Id))index[entry.Id]=entry;}return index;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> One inconsistency found by <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/> while expanding a collection pyramid. Problems are runtime-only: they are recomputed on every resolve from the live registry and the collection store, and the scheme editor renders them on the "Проверка" tab. Fields carry enough context to jump to the offending element: (<see cref="ParentCollectionId"/>, <see cref="Ref"/>) for includes, <see cref="CollectionId"/> for requirements and <see cref="ModId"/> for mod-level issues. <see cref="GroupKey"/> matches <see cref="ModCollectionGroup.Key"/> when the problem belongs to a rendered group. </summary>
public class ModCollectionProblem{/// <summary>Problem category; drives severity and the icon in the UI.</summary>
public ModCollectionProblemKind Kind{get;set;}/// <summary>Short localized-ready title, e.g. "Блок «rpg_2d» не найден".</summary>
public string Title{get;set;}/// <summary>Longer explanation with the fix hint.</summary>
public string Detail{get;set;}/// <summary>Collection the problem belongs to (requirement owner, cycle node, role host).</summary>
public string CollectionId{get;set;}/// <summary>Parent collection of a broken include; null for other kinds.</summary>
public string ParentCollectionId{get;set;}/// <summary>Raw include reference of a broken include; null for other kinds.</summary>
public string Ref{get;set;}/// <summary>Rendered group key when the problem can be highlighted on the canvas.</summary>
public string GroupKey{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod id for mod-level problems; null otherwise.</summary>
public string ModId{get;set;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Kinds of inconsistency <see cref="ModCollectionResolver"/> can find while expanding a collection pyramid. The scheme editor groups them by severity (errors block applying, warnings do not) and offers "show" navigation to the offending group or mod. </summary>
public enum ModCollectionProblemKind{/// <summary>An <c>includes[]</c> reference points at a collection nobody provides.</summary>
MissingCollection,/// <summary>Include chain references a collection already on the active stack.</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Builds a <see cref="ModCollectionGraph"/> for a collection by combining four live sources: the installed-mod registry, the disabled-mods store, the merged online catalog cache and — for collections composed of other collections — the merged collection registry. The collection file itself only declares includes and mechanics; the dependency arrows come from the mods' own <c>depends</c>, so the graph always reflects reality even when a mod author changes dependencies without touching the collection. <para/> The resolver is pure and takes its sources as arguments, which keeps the graph testable without Godot. Includes are expanded recursively into <see cref="ModCollectionGraph.Groups"/>: each included block becomes one contour with its mods flattened inside (nested blocks collapse into the nearest ancestor so the editor always shows a two-level pyramid), while the root's own mechanics become leaf groups. Cycles, missing blocks, role conflicts and unmet capability requirements are reported as <see cref="ModCollectionProblem"/> instead of throwing, because they are exactly what the player has to fix on the scheme. </summary>

its mods must not leak into the node list or the install plan while it is off.
if(!selected)continue;foreach(var raw in mechanic.Mods??new List<string>())AddDeclaredMod(raw,collection.Id,mechanic,group,context);}AddDependencyClosure(graph,nodes,edges,localMods,disabledIds,sessionInstalled,catalogById);foreach(var(from,to)in edges)graph.Edges.Add(new ModCollectionEdge{FromModId=from,ToModId=to});CheckRequirements(graph,resolved,provides);return graph;}/// <summary> Mutable state shared by the recursive walk. A private container keeps the public resolver signature small while still passing a single argument through the recursion. </summary>
private sealed class ResolutionContext{public ModCollectionGraph Graph;public Dictionary<string,ModCollectionNode>Nodes;public HashSet<(string From,string To)>Edges;public HashSet<string>Provides;public List<ModCollection>Resolved;public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>Collections;public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IModInfo>LocalMods;public IReadOnlyCollection<string>DisabledIds;public IReadOnlyCollection<string>SessionInstalled;public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,CatalogExportEntry>CatalogById;/// <summary>Locale used for localized group names/descriptions; null keeps flat fields.</summary>
public string Language;/// <summary> Optional display-text translator (resolves '@key' references); null keeps raw values so headless tests stay deterministic. </summary>
public Func<string,string>Translator;}/// <summary> Expands <see cref="ModCollection.Includes"/> of a parent into groups and flattens each child's subtree into its group. private static void ResolveIncludes(ModCollection parent,ResolutionContext context,List<string>stack){var includes=parent.Includes??new List<ModCollectionInclude>();var roleOwners=new Dictionary<string,ModCollection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var include in includes){if(include==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(include.Ref))continue;var dependency=ModDependency.Parse(include.Ref);var childId=dependency.IsValid?dependency.ModId:include.Ref.Trim();var groupKey=$"i:{parent.Id}:{include.Ref}";if(childId==parent.Id||stack.Contains(childId,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){context.Graph.Problems.Add(new ModCollectionProblem{Kind=ModCollectionProblemKind.Cycle,Title=$"Cycle: '{parent.Name ?? parent.Id}' -> '{include.Ref}'",Detail="The include chain references a collection that is already being expanded.",CollectionId=parent.Id,ParentCollectionId=parent.Id,Ref=include.Ref,GroupKey=groupKey,});continue;}if(!TryGetCollection(context.Collections,childId,out var child)){context.Graph.Problems.Add(new ModCollectionProblem{Kind=ModCollectionProblemKind.MissingCollection,Title=$"Block '{childId}' is not available",Detail=$"Required by slot '{include.Role}' of '{parent.Name ?? parent.Id}'. private static void FlattenCollection(ModCollection collection,ModCollectionGroup group,ResolutionContext context,List<string>stack){AddProvides(collection,context.Provides);if(!context.Resolved.Any(c=>string.Equals(c.Id,collection.Id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))context.Resolved.Add(collection);var nextStack=new List<string>(stack){collection.Id};foreach(var mechanic in collection.Mechanics??new List<ModCollectionMechanic>()){if(mechanic==null|| !mechanic.IsSelected)continue;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(mechanic.Id))mechanic.Id=$"mechanic_{mechanic.Mods?.Count ?? 0}";foreach(var raw in mechanic.Mods??new List<string>())AddDeclaredMod(raw,collection.Id,mechanic,group,context);}foreach(var include in collection.Includes??new List<ModCollectionInclude>()){if(include==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(include.Ref)|| !include.IsSelected)continue;var dependency=ModDependency.Parse(include.Ref);var childId=dependency.IsValid?dependency.ModId:include.Ref.Trim();if(childId==collection.Id||nextStack.Contains(childId,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){context.Graph.Problems.Add(new ModCollectionProblem{Kind=ModCollectionProblemKind.Cycle,Title=$"Cycle: '{collection.Name ?? collection.Id}' -> '{include.Ref}'",Detail="Nested include references a collection that is already being expanded.",CollectionId=collection.Id,ParentCollectionId=collection.Id,Ref=include.Ref,});continue;}if(TryGetCollection(context.Collections,childId,out var child))FlattenCollection(child,group,context,nextStack);}}/// <summary> Applies the optional translator to a display string. private static void RegisterRole(ModCollection parent,ModCollectionInclude include,ModCollection child,Dictionary<string,ModCollection>roleOwners,string groupKey,ResolutionContext context){if(include.Optional||string.IsNullOrEmpty(include.Role))return;if(roleOwners.TryGetValue(include.Role,out var owner)){context.Graph.Problems.Add(new ModCollectionProblem{Kind=ModCollectionProblemKind.RoleConflict,Title=$"Slot '{include.Role}' is claimed twice",Detail=$"'{owner.Name ?? owner.Id}' and '{child.Name ?? child.Id}' are both required in '{parent.Name ?? parent.Id}'.",CollectionId=parent.Id,ParentCollectionId=parent.Id,Ref=include.Ref,GroupKey=groupKey,});return;}roleOwners[include.Role]=child;}/// <summary> Creates the node for a mod declared by a mechanic and appends it to the owning group. Add a compatible block to the scheme.",CollectionId=collection.Id,});}}}private static string ParseCapability(string requirement){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requirement))return null;var dependency=ModDependency.Parse(requirement);return dependency.IsValid?dependency.ModId:requirement.Trim();}private static bool TryGetCollection(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModCollection>collections,string id,out ModCollection collection){collection=null;if(collections==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(collections.TryGetValue(id,out collection)&&collection!=null)return true;foreach(var pair in collections){if(pair.Value!=null&&string.Equals(pair.Key,id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){collection=pair.Value;return true;}}return false;}/// <summary> Walks the dependencies of every known node, adding edges and pulling unknown dependencies into the graph. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Loads and persists <see cref="ModCollection"/> definitions. A collection is its own distribution unit — a <b>package</b> next to the mods, not a file inside one: a folder or zip named after the collection id that holds <c>collection.json</c>, the cover image and an optional <c>locale/</c> with the collection's texts. A game is an assembly of mods by many authors, so no mod owns it; anyone can ship a game without touching the mods it uses. <list type="bullet"> <item>built-in packages — <c>collections/</c> of the game directory (<c>res://collections/</c>);</item> <item>the player's packages — <c>user://collections/</c>: edited and duplicated collections, downloaded ones;</item> <item>online catalogs — documents cached by <see cref="CatalogService"/> (no package: no cover or locale files).</item> </list> <see cref="LoadAll"/> merges the channels by id with explicit precedence: user &gt; built-in &gt; catalog, so a shipped game overrides an outdated online one and the player can edit any collection locally. Packages are read through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>, so folders and zips behave the same. Mods do not ship collections. </summary>
public static class ModCollectionStore{/// <summary>Name of the document inside a package.</summary>
public const string DocumentName="collection.json";private const string BuiltInRoot="res://collections/";private const string UserRoot="user://collections/";private static string _builtInPath;private static string _userPath;/// <summary> Resolves the package roots once on the main thread before the background mod-load phase, mirroring <see cref="DisabledModsStore"/> — <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> is Godot API and is not available from worker threads. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(){_builtInPath=Resolve(BuiltInRoot,"collections");_userPath=Resolve(UserRoot,"user_collections");}private static string Resolve(string godotPath,string fallback)=>GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?GamePaths.Globalize(godotPath):fallback;/// <summary>Absolute folder of the built-in packages.</summary>
public static string BuiltInPath=>_builtInPath??Resolve(BuiltInRoot,"collections");/// <summary>Absolute folder of the player's packages.</summary>
public static string UserPath=>_userPath??Resolve(UserRoot,"user_collections");/// <summary>The player's collections (edited, duplicated, downloaded); empty when the folder is absent.</summary>
public static List<ModCollection>LoadUser()=>LoadPackages(UserPath,ModCollectionOrigin.User);/// <summary>Collections shipped with the game.</summary>
public static List<ModCollection>LoadBuiltIn()=>LoadPackages(BuiltInPath,ModCollectionOrigin.BuiltIn);/// <summary> Replaces the player's collections with <paramref name="collections"/>: each becomes the package <c>user://collections/&lt;id&gt;/</c>, and player packages not in the list are removed. A collection that came from another package (a fork of a built-in game) takes that package's cover and <c>locale/</c> files along, so the copy shows the same. </summary>

public static class GodotGeneratorHost{private static readonly object _generatorLock=new object();private static Type[]_godotGeneratorTypes;private static readonly GeneratorLoadContext GeneratorContext=new GeneratorLoadContext();/// <summary> Locates the Godot source generator assembly shipped with the <c>godot.sourcegenerators</c> NuGet package (or copied next to the game binary). </summary>

Every <c>Microsoft.CodeAnalysis*</c> request binds to the Roslyn instance the game itself runs on, so the loaded generator types implement the very <see cref="ISourceGenerator"/> this host filters by. Version-based binding (a plain <c>Assembly.LoadFrom</c>) may instead pull in or reject a second Roslyn copy depending on the host process, leaving the filter with zero matching types — silent loss of all generators. Everything else (<c>System.Collections.Immutable</c> first of all) resolves through the load context Roslyn itself lives in: Godot loads the game assembly into its own plugin context with app-local copies of those libraries, and a generator bound to the default context's copy sees a different <c>ImmutableArray&lt;T&gt;</c> — its analyzer overrides stop matching and the type load fails (seen on the Linux export). </summary>

protected override Assembly Load(AssemblyName assemblyName){var name=assemblyName.Name;if(name==null)return null;if(name.StartsWith("Microsoft.CodeAnalysis",StringComparison.Ordinal)){// The game's own Roslyn wins: same instance the filter's typeof(ISourceGenerator) comes from. using System;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Compilation{/// <summary> Supplies <c>build_property.project_dir</c> to the Godot source generator so it computes script paths relative to the project root exactly like the main <c>dotnet build</c> does. </summary>

value=string.Empty;return true;case"build_property.godotsourcegenerators":case"build_property.godotdisabledsourcegenerators":// No generators disabled.
value=string.Empty;return true;}value=null;return false;}}}

Cache entries are named <c>&lt;modId&gt;_&lt;hash&gt;.dll</c> plus a paired portable PDB. The hash mixes the mod's own sources with its dependency signature, the kernel assembly MVID and a codegen marker, so any of those changing forces a recompile instead of a stale load. Every DLL is stored together with its PDB and loaded from disk (file-backed) so a debugger binds line-level breakpoints in mod code. </summary>
public static class ModAssemblyCache{/// <summary> Absolute path to the assembly cache directory (<c>user://mod_cache/assemblies/</c>). Resolved once at static init time with a fallback to the OS temp folder. </summary>

public static readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<string,string>CurrentArtifacts=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary> Builds a deterministic signature of a mod's dependencies for the compilation cache key: every dependency id together with the version that was actually loaded (or <c>missing</c>). var artifact=CurrentArtifacts.TryGetValue(depId,out var path)?"#"+Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path):string.Empty;parts.Add($"{depId}@{version ?? "missing"}{artifact}");}return string.Join(";",parts);}/// <summary> Computes the cache path for one compilation: <c>&lt;CacheRoot&gt;/&lt;modId&gt;_&lt;hash&gt;.dll</c>. using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Compilation{/// <summary> Compilation order for mods that carry C# sources: a depth-first topological sort over the <c>depends</c> declarations, restricted to the mods that are actually being compiled. A dependency that ships no code simply does not participate; cycles are broken with a warning instead of deadlocking boot. Deliberately not <see cref="ModLoadOrder"/>: that one implements the gameplay load order with manual overrides and fallbacks. Compilation needs the stricter depends-only ordering so a mod referencing another mod's types always compiles after its dependency. </summary>
public static class ModCompileOrder{/// <summary> Orders <paramref name="modsWithCode"/> so that every mod appears after the mods it declares in <c>depends</c> (among those present in the input list). The input list order breaks ties, which keeps the sort deterministic for a given discovery order. </summary>
public static List<ModInfo>TopologicalSort(List<ModInfo>modsWithCode){var result=new List<ModInfo>();var visited=new HashSet<string>();var visiting=new HashSet<string>();void Visit(ModInfo mod){if(visited.Contains(mod.Id))return;if(visiting.Contains(mod.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"Circular dependency detected involving mod '{mod.Id}'",LogLevel.Warning);return;}visiting.Add(mod.Id);if(mod.Manifest.DependencyIds!=null){foreach(var depId in mod.Manifest.DependencyIds){var dep=modsWithCode.Find(m=>m.Id==depId);if(dep!=null)Visit(dep);}}visiting.Remove(mod.Id);visited.Add(mod.Id);result.Add(mod);}foreach(var mod in modsWithCode)Visit(mod);return result;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Compilation{/// <summary> Assembly-reference discovery for mod compilations plus the warmed Godot path state the rest of the pipeline reads. <see cref="Collect"/> scans, in order: the runtime directories of every loaded assembly, the Godot build output directory, precompiled <c>mods/&lt;id&gt;/dll</c> folders and the compilation cache (newest artifact per known mod id). The scan is deliberately filtered — the inline comments explain why — because a naive directory scan would resurrect stale copies of mod assemblies and break dependent compilations with CS0433/CS0121. Path state (<see cref="WarmUpPaths"/>) must be warmed on the main thread before background compilation starts: compilation itself is pure .NET and thread-safe, but <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> is not allowed off the main thread, so resolved paths are cached here instead. </summary>
public static class ModReferenceProvider{private static string _resRoot;private static string _buildOutputDir;private static bool _pathsWarmed;/// <summary> Absolute path to the Godot project root (<c>res://</c> globalized), or null outside runtime and before <see cref="WarmUpPaths"/>. public static string ProjectRoot=>_resRoot;/// <summary> Resolves the Godot project root and Mono build output directory once on the main thread. public static void WarmUpPaths(){if(_pathsWarmed)return;_pathsWarmed=true;_=ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot;if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return;try{_resRoot=GamePaths.Globalize("res://");foreach(var config in new[]{"Debug","Release"}){var buildDir=Path.Combine(_resRoot,".godot","mono","temp","bin",config);if(Directory.Exists(buildDir)){_buildOutputDir=buildDir;break;}}}catch{}}/// <summary> Builds the metadata reference set for one mod compilation: the runtime and GodotSharp basics, every DLL next to a loaded assembly, the build output directory, precompiled mod DLLs and the compilation cache. <paramref name="currentModId"/> excludes the mod's own (possibly stale) cache artifacts from its own references; <paramref name="knownModIds"/>, when provided, restricts the cache scan to at most the newest DLL per real mod id, ignoring foreign helper artifacts. </summary>
public static void Collect(List<MetadataReference>references,string currentModId=null,IReadOnlyCollection<string>knownModIds=null){AddAssemblyReference(references,typeof(object).Assembly);var basePath=Path.GetDirectoryName(typeof(object).Assembly.Location);var requiredAssemblies=new[]{"System.Runtime.dll","System.Collections.dll","System.Linq.dll","System.Text.Json.dll","GodotSharp.dll",};foreach(var asmName in requiredAssemblies){var path=Path.Combine(basePath,asmName);if(File.Exists(path))references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(path));}AddAssemblyReference(references,typeof(Godot.Node).Assembly);GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE","AddCoreReferences: scanning assembly directories for DLLs...");// Assembly cache directories are handled by the dedicated filtered scan below (newest DLL per known mod id). File-backed mod assemblies (loaded via LoadFromPath for debugger symbols, §9.2) expose those directories through Assembly.Location — adding them here unfiltered would resurrect stale copies and compile-test artifacts as references (CS0433/CS0121 in dependent mods). CacheRoot keeps the trailing separator from GlobalizePath, while Path.GetDirectoryName of a loaded mod assembly never returns one — an untrimmed comparison would never match and the AppDomain scan would resurrect every historical cache DLL as a reference (CS0121 ambiguous extension calls in mods with moved types).
var assemblyCacheDir=Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot));var testAssemblyCacheDir=Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(assemblyCacheDir,"..","test_assemblies"));var searchedDirs=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var asm in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()){if(!asm.IsDynamic&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(asm.Location)){var dir=Path.GetFullPath(Path.GetDirectoryName(asm.Location)??string.Empty);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir))continue;if(dir.Equals(assemblyCacheDir,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||dir.Equals(testAssemblyCacheDir,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(searchedDirs.Add(dir)){foreach(var dll in Directory.GetFiles(dir,"*.dll"))TryAddReference(references,dll);}}}var buildOutputDir=ResolveBuildOutputDir();if(buildOutputDir!=null&&searchedDirs.Add(buildOutputDir)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: scanning build output dir '{buildOutputDir}'");foreach(var dll in Directory.GetFiles(buildOutputDir,"*.dll"))TryAddReference(references,dll);}// Precompiled library mods (mods/<id>/dll/*.dll) are loaded from bytes at runtime, so their Assembly.Location is empty and the AppDomain scan above never sees their directories. Reference them explicitly so runtime-compiled dependants keep compiling (live2d_test needs the live2d library types).
var modsRoot=string.IsNullOrEmpty(_resRoot)?null:Path.Combine(_resRoot,"mods");if(modsRoot!=null&&Directory.Exists(modsRoot)&&searchedDirs.Add(modsRoot)){foreach(var modDir in Directory.GetDirectories(modsRoot)){// Precompiled libraries follow the same visibility rule as runtime-compiled mods: only the mod itself and its dependency closure may reference them.
var ownerId=Path.GetFileName(modDir);if(knownModIds!=null&& !string.Equals(ownerId,currentModId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !knownModIds.Contains(ownerId,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var precompiledDir=Path.Combine(modDir,"dll");if(!Directory.Exists(precompiledDir)|| !searchedDirs.Add(precompiledDir))continue;foreach(var dll in Directory.GetFiles(precompiledDir,"*.dll"))TryAddReference(references,dll);}}if(searchedDirs.Add(ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot)&&Directory.Exists(ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: scanning mod cache dir '{ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot}'");// The cache legitimately holds several <id>_<hash>.dll copies per mod (every source change leaves the previous hash behind), and test runners drop helper artifacts there too (<id>_compile_test_<hash>.dll). Referencing more than one copy of the same mod's assembly would make every dependent compilation fail with CS0433 (the type exists in both assemblies), so when the caller knows the real mod ids only the newest artifact of each known mod is referenced and everything else is ignored.
var newestById=knownModIds!=null?new Dictionary<string,(string Path,DateTime Modified)>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase):null;foreach(var dll in Directory.GetFiles(ModAssemblyCache.CacheRoot,"*.dll")){var fileName=Path.GetFileName(dll);// A mod's own stale cached DLL (<modId>_<oldHash>.dll) must not become a metadata reference of the mod being compiled: after a source change the fresh assembly would collide with the stale one and fail with CS0121 (ambiguous extension method calls). The prefix check is deliberately broader than IsSelfCacheDll: helper artifacts (<id>_compile_test_<hash>.dll) share the prefix and must equally never self-reference.
if(currentModId!=null&&fileName.StartsWith(currentModId+"_",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(newestById==null){TryAddReference(references,dll);continue;}if(!ModAssemblyCache.TryParseCacheDllName(fileName,out var ownerModId,out _)|| !knownModIds.Contains(ownerModId,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var modified=File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(dll);if(!newestById.TryGetValue(ownerModId,out var existing)||modified>existing.Modified)newestById[ownerModId]=(dll,modified);}if(newestById!=null){foreach(var entry in newestById){// The artifact this process compiled the dependency to wins over the newest file (see ModAssemblyCache.CurrentArtifacts).
var path=ModAssemblyCache.CurrentArtifacts.TryGetValue(entry.Key,out var current)&&File.Exists(current)?current:entry.Value.Path;TryAddReference(references,path);}}}var sdkAsm=typeof(IScenarioAction).Assembly;var coreAsm=typeof(ModRegistry).Assembly;AddAssemblyReference(references,sdkAsm);AddAssemblyReference(references,coreAsm);if(knownModIds==null&&references.Count>300)Console.WriteLine($"REFSCAN-BIG[{currentModId}]: from:\n"+System.Environment.StackTrace);GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: sdkAsm.Location='{sdkAsm.Location}' (empty={string.IsNullOrEmpty(sdkAsm.Location)})");GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: coreAsm.Location='{coreAsm.Location}' (empty={string.IsNullOrEmpty(coreAsm.Location)})");GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"AddCoreReferences: total references={references.Count}");foreach(var r in references){if(!r.Display?.Contains("mods/")??false)continue;GameLogger.Log("MODS_COMPILE",$"  ref: {r.Display}",LogLevel.Debug);}}/// <summary> Absolute path for a mod source file when it exists on disk inside the project. The Godot source generator derives each class's script path (<c>res://...</c>) from the syntax tree's file path, so the tree must be parsed with its real location inside the project; otherwise the generated <c>[ScriptPath]</c> points nowhere and lifecycle callbacks never fire. <para/> <paramref name="modRoot"/> is the mod's real directory (<see cref="IModFileProvider.RootPath"/>). It matters for mods whose id is not their folder name — a test suite <c>host__suite</c> lives in <c>mods/host/test_suites/suite/</c>; resolving it as <c>mods/host__suite/</c> missed and yielded <c>res://src/...</c>. Only directories inside the project are used (a zip or a <c>user://</c> folder has no <c>res://</c> path); otherwise the conventional <c>mods/&lt;modId&gt;/</c> location is tried. </summary>
public static string ResolveSourcePath(string modId,string filePath,string modRoot=null){var resRoot=_resRoot;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(resRoot))return filePath;var normalized=filePath.Replace('\\','/');var projectRoot=Path.GetFullPath(resRoot);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(modRoot)&&Directory.Exists(modRoot)){var fromRoot=Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(modRoot,normalized));if(fromRoot.StartsWith(projectRoot,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&File.Exists(fromRoot))return fromRoot;}var absolute=Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(resRoot,"mods",modId,normalized));return File.Exists(absolute)?absolute:filePath;}private static string ResolveBuildOutputDir(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return null;if(_resRoot==null)return null;if(_buildOutputDir==null)return null;return _buildOutputDir;}private static void TryAddReference(List<MetadataReference>references,string dllPath){if(!File.Exists(dllPath))return;try{AssemblyName.GetAssemblyName(dllPath);}catch{return;}try{references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(dllPath));}catch{}}private static void AddAssemblyReference(List<MetadataReference>references,Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null||assembly.IsDynamic||string.IsNullOrEmpty(assembly.Location))return;try{references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(assembly.Location));}catch{}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Compilation{/// <summary> Source-collection step of the mod compilation pipeline. Expands the source patterns declared in a mod's <c>manifest.json</c> into a flat list of <c>(path, text)</c> pairs by walking the mod's <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>, so folder mods and zip mods are collected through the same code path. A pattern splits at its last <c>/</c> into a directory prefix and a suffix filter (<c>*.cs</c> by default); matching is suffix-based rather than glob-based because providers list entries as slash-separated relative paths. When the declared patterns match nothing, the whole mod root is scanned as a fallback so a mod that just drops <c>.cs</c> files anywhere still compiles. </summary>
public static class ModSourceCollector{/// <summary> Collects all source files of a mod: every pattern from <c>Manifest.Sources</c> is expanded in declaration order, each producing (provider path, file text) pairs. If nothing matched, the full-mod fallback scan runs, so the result is empty only for a mod that truly has no C# sources. Honors <paramref name="cancellationToken"/> between provider calls to keep boot cancellation responsive. </summary>
public static List<(string FilePath,string Source)>CollectSourceFiles(ModInfo modInfo,CancellationToken cancellationToken){var result=new List<(string,string)>();foreach(var pattern in modInfo.Manifest.Sources){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*.cs";var sepIndex=pattern.LastIndexOf('/');if(sepIndex>=0){prefix=pattern.Substring(0,sepIndex);suffix=pattern.Substring(sepIndex+1);}// The walk below is always recursive, so "src/**/*.cs" means "src"; a literal "**" directory never exists and would trigger the whole-mod fallback (pulling tests/ into the production assembly).
while(prefix=="**"||prefix.EndsWith("/**",StringComparison.Ordinal))prefix=prefix.Length>2?prefix.Substring(0,prefix.Length-3):string.Empty;CollectSourceFilesRecursive(modInfo.FileProvider,prefix,file=>{if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return false;var fileName=file.Replace('\\','/');var fileNamePart=fileName.Substring(fileName.LastIndexOf('/')+1);return suffix=="*"||suffix=="*.cs"||(suffix.StartsWith("*.")&&fileNamePart.EndsWith(suffix.Substring(1),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));},result,cancellationToken);}if(result.Count==0){CollectSourceFilesRecursive(modInfo.FileProvider,"",file=>{return file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);},result,cancellationToken);}return result;}private static void CollectSourceFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,Func<string,bool>fileFilter,List<(string,string)>result,CancellationToken cancellationToken){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectSourceFilesRecursive(provider,subDir,fileFilter,result,cancellationToken);}else if(fileFilter(entry)){var source=provider.ReadFileText(entry);result.Add((entry,source));}}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Consumers{/// <summary> Ordered registry of <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer"/> implementations - the single point the assembly loader fans every mod assembly out through, and the single point unload passes run through in reverse. Kernel consumers are discovered once via reflection; mod assemblies may contribute additional consumers (deduplicated by <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer.Id"/> - a mod-provided consumer never shadows a kernel one). Ordering is by <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer.Order"/>, ties broken by id so the sequence is deterministic regardless of discovery order. Failure isolation mirrors the rest of the mod pipeline: one consumer's exception is logged and never prevents the others from running. </summary>
public static class AssemblyConsumerRegistry{private static readonly List<IAssemblyConsumer>consumers=new();private static readonly HashSet<string>consumerIds=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private static bool initialized;/// <summary>All consumers sorted by execution order. Snapshot copy.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<IAssemblyConsumer>Consumers{get{EnsureInitialized();return consumers.ToArray();}}/// <summary> Discovers kernel <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer"/> implementations once. Deliberately not tied to the mod boot pipeline: the loader needs the fan-out in every context, including unit tests that never boot. </summary>
public static void EnsureInitialized(){if(initialized)return;initialized=true;RegisterFromAssembly(typeof(AssemblyConsumerRegistry).Assembly);}/// <summary>Test/setup helper: forgets every consumer, kernel ones included.</summary>
public static void Clear(){consumers.Clear();consumerIds.Clear();initialized=false;}/// <summary> Discovers consumers in one assembly (the kernel scan, and every mod assembly through the loader). Returns the consumers that actually joined — duplicates by <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer.Id"/> are ignored — so the loader can replay the already registered assemblies to them. </summary>
public static List<IAssemblyConsumer>RegisterFromAssembly(Assembly assembly){var joined=new List<IAssemblyConsumer>();if(assembly==null)return joined;foreach(var consumer in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IAssemblyConsumer>(assembly)){if(Register(consumer))joined.Add(consumer);}return joined;}/// <summary> Registers one consumer; the first registration of an id wins, later duplicates (a mod re-contributing a kernel consumer, a kept mod re-registering during a reload) are ignored. Re-sorts after insertion. Returns whether the consumer joined. </summary>
public static bool Register(IAssemblyConsumer consumer){if(consumer==null)return false;if(!consumerIds.Add(consumer.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"AssemblyConsumerRegistry: duplicate consumer id '{consumer.Id}' ignored",LogLevel.Debug);return false;}consumers.Add(consumer);consumers.Sort(CompareConsumers);return true;}/// <summary> Delivers one already registered assembly to a consumer that joined later (the catch-up of <see cref="ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/>), isolated like the regular fan-out. </summary>
public static void CatchUp(IAssemblyConsumer consumer,Assembly assembly,string modId){try{consumer.OnAssemblyLoaded(assembly,modId);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"AssemblyConsumer '{consumer.Id}' failed on catch-up of mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Drops consumers contributed by dying mod assemblies (a kept consumer instance pins its mod's load context). Returns how many were removed. </summary>
public static int RemoveOwned(Unload.AssemblyOwnership ownership){if(ownership==null||ownership.IsEmpty)return 0;var removed=0;for(var i=consumers.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(!ownership.Owns(consumers[i].GetType()))continue;consumerIds.Remove(consumers[i].Id);consumers.RemoveAt(i);removed++;}return removed;}private static int CompareConsumers(IAssemblyConsumer a,IAssemblyConsumer b){var byOrder=a.Order.CompareTo(b.Order);return byOrder!=0?byOrder:string.CompareOrdinal(a.Id,b.Id);}/// <summary> Forward pass: delivers one assembly to every consumer in order. One consumer's failure is logged and isolated. Does not trigger kernel discovery: a cleared registry stays cleared (test isolation); production callers reach here only after <see cref="EnsureInitialized"/> ran through the load path. </summary>
public static void FanOutLoaded(Assembly assembly,string modId){foreach(var consumer in consumers.ToArray())RunConsumer(consumer,modId,c=>c.OnAssemblyLoaded(assembly,modId),"load");}/// <summary> Reverse pass: asks every consumer to release what it took from one assembly, in reverse consumer order. Never throws: unload continues past a failing consumer so the remaining ones still get a chance to release their references. Does not trigger kernel discovery (see <see cref="FanOutLoaded"/>). </summary>
public static void FanOutUnloading(Assembly assembly,string modId){for(var i=consumers.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var consumer=consumers[i];RunConsumer(consumer,modId,c=>c.OnAssemblyUnloading(assembly,modId),"unload");}}private static void RunConsumer(IAssemblyConsumer consumer,string modId,Action<IAssemblyConsumer>call,string direction){try{call(consumer);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"AssemblyConsumer '{consumer.Id}' failed on {direction} of mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/Consumers/IAssemblyConsumer.cs =====
using System;using System.Reflection;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Consumers{/// <summary> One reflection-driven subsystem that consumes mod assemblies. The declarative successor of the hard-coded fan-out list in <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Mods.ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/>: every subsystem that used to be one line there becomes a consumer class, discovered automatically in the kernel assembly, and new subsystems no longer edit shared files. The contract is symmetric on purpose - <see cref="OnAssemblyUnloading"/> is the reverse pass that makes collectible assembly unload possible. A consumer that cannot release everything it took (Godot nodes alive, delegates captured elsewhere) must log loudly here, because a silent leak keeps the <c>AssemblyLoadContext</c> alive forever and the unload silently degrades to the old "registry rewrite" behaviour. Consumers may also be contributed by mod assemblies themselves (discovered by <see cref="AssemblyConsumerRegistry.RegisterFromAssembly"/>), giving a mod the ability to own its own reflection registry - for example a registry of custom status effects - and automatically receive every mod assembly, without any kernel edit: the ones registered before it are replayed when it joins, later ones arrive through the regular fan-out. <see cref="ModTypeConsumer{T}"/> is the ready-made base for the common "collect every implementation of T" case. </summary>
public interface IAssemblyConsumer{/// <summary>Stable consumer id, used in logs and for duplicate detection.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Explicit execution order, replacing the implicit order of the old fan-out lines. Lower runs earlier. Ranges: 0-99 infrastructure bridges (buffers), 100-899 normal registries, 900+ lifecycle orchestrators that must observe fully populated registries (the initializer registry runs last at 1000). </summary>
int Order{get;}/// <summary> Receives a newly loaded mod assembly. Must not throw for expected conditions (no matching types); the registry isolates unexpected failures per consumer so one broken subsystem cannot break the others. </summary>
void OnAssemblyLoaded(Assembly assembly,string modId);/// <summary> Reverse pass before an assembly is unloaded: drop every reference this consumer took through <see cref="OnAssemblyLoaded"/> for the given mod. Called in reverse consumer order (lifecycle orchestrators first). Must not throw; report failures through the log. </summary>
void OnAssemblyUnloading(Assembly assembly,string modId);}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Consumers{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Base for a mod-owned plugin registry: "give me every <typeparamref name="T"/> any mod ships". A mod declares a subclass (public, parameterless) in its assembly and the kernel does the rest — the same consumer machinery the kernel's own registries use (<see cref="AssemblyConsumerRegistry"/>): <list type="bullet"> <item>every mod assembly the pipeline registers is scanned for public, non-abstract <typeparamref name="T"/> implementations, one instance each is created and handed to <see cref="Add"/>;</item> <item>assemblies registered before the consumer itself (dependencies, and the consumer's own assembly) are replayed to it when it joins, so load order does not matter;</item> <item>when a mod is unloaded (game switch, hot reload) each instance it contributed comes back through <see cref="Remove"/> — the registry stays exact without rescanning the AppDomain, and never re-registers a dying assembly.</item> </list> This replaces the per-mod pattern of looking an assembly up by mod id and rescanning every loaded assembly "as a safety net": the kernel stays the single place that knows which assemblies exist. </summary>
public abstract class ModTypeConsumer<T>:IAssemblyConsumer where T:class{private readonly Dictionary<Assembly,List<T>>created=new();/// <inheritdoc />
public abstract string Id{get;}/// <summary>Normal registry range (see <see cref="IAssemblyConsumer.Order"/>).</summary>
public virtual int Order=>500;/// <inheritdoc />
public void OnAssemblyLoaded(Assembly assembly,string modId){if(created.ContainsKey(assembly))return;var instances=new List<T>(Reflections.FindAndCreate<T>(assembly));created[assembly]=instances;foreach(var instance in instances)Add(instance,modId);}/// <inheritdoc />
public void OnAssemblyUnloading(Assembly assembly,string modId){if(!created.Remove(assembly,out var instances))return;foreach(var instance in instances)Remove(instance,modId);}/// <summary>A new <typeparamref name="T"/> from mod <paramref name="modId"/>.</summary>
protected abstract void Add(T instance,string modId);/// <summary>An instance previously passed to <see cref="Add"/> leaves with its mod.</summary>
protected abstract void Remove(T instance,string modId);}}
