using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.IO.Compression;using System.Linq;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Stages of a <see cref="ModDownloader.InstallAsync"/> run, reported through <see cref="ModDownloader.OnProgress"/> so the UI can render a progress bar with a human-readable message per stage. </summary>
public enum InstallStep{/// <summary>Fetching the .zip from a catalog mirror.</summary>
Downloading,/// <summary>Comparing the downloaded archive against <c>archive_sha256</c>.</summary>
VerifyingArchive,/// <summary>Extracting the archive into a staging directory.</summary>
Extracting,/// <summary>Recomputing the install hash of the extracted mod.</summary>
VerifyingInstall,/// <summary>Mod installed; a restart is required to load it.</summary>
Complete,/// <summary>Install aborted — see the reported message for the reason.</summary>
Failed,}/// <summary>Snapshot of the downloader state at one moment of an install.</summary>
public class InstallProgress{/// <summary>Current pipeline stage.</summary>
public InstallStep Step{get;set;}/// <summary>Completion fraction 0–1; 0 for stages without a measurable fraction.</summary>
public float Progress{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable status line for the UI (e.g. "Downloading... 42%").</summary>
public string Message{get;set;}}/// <summary> Downloads and installs mods from the online catalog into the user mods root (<c>user://mods/</c>). One <see cref="InstallAsync"/> run picks the catalog entry (by id and, when given, the source catalog that published it), streams the zip from the first reachable mirror, verifies <c>archive_sha256</c>, extracts through a staging directory (flattening a single wrapper folder), verifies <c>install_sha256</c>, and swaps the result into place. The new mod set only loads after a restart — like every other mod-set change. </summary>
public static class ModDownloader{private static readonly System.Net.Http.HttpClient _httpClient=new(){Timeout=TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),DefaultRequestHeaders={{"User-Agent","Cthangover/1.0"}},};private static readonly HashSet<string>_installingMods=new();/// <summary>Fired on every progress report; carries the stage, fraction and message.</summary>
public static event Action<InstallProgress>OnProgress;/// <summary>Fired once when an install finishes; <c>true</c> on success, <c>false</c> on any failure.</summary>
public static event Action<string,bool>OnCompleted;/// <summary> Installs a mod from the catalog into the user mods root. Selects the entry (optionally from a specific source catalog), picks the download matching <paramref name="version"/> (or the newest), verifies the archive hash, extracts through a staging directory, and swaps it into place. Returns <c>false</c> and reports the reason via <see cref="OnCompleted"/>(false) on any failure; concurrent installs of the same mod are rejected. </summary> <param name="modId">Canonical mod id to install.</param> <param name="version">Specific version to install, or null for the newest download.</param> <param name="sourceUrl">Catalog URL that published the entry (disambiguates variant conflicts), or null.</param>
public static async Task<bool>InstallAsync(string modId,string version=null,string sourceUrl=null){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return Fail(modId,"Mod ID is empty");if(_installingMods.Contains(modId))return false;_installingMods.Add(modId);try{CatalogService.LoadCache();var cached=CatalogService.CachedEntries;if(cached==null)return Fail(modId,"Catalog not loaded");var entry=CatalogMerger.FindEntry(cached,modId,sourceUrl);if(entry==null)return Fail(modId,"Mod not found in catalog");if(entry.Downloads==null||entry.Downloads.Count==0)return Fail(modId,"No download URLs available");var download=FindDownloadForVersion(entry.Downloads,version)??entry.Downloads[0];var tempFile=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),$"cthangover_dl_{modId}_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.zip");try{if(!await DownloadWithProgressAsync(download.Urls,tempFile))return Fail(modId,"All download mirrors failed");ReportProgress(InstallStep.VerifyingArchive,0,$"Verifying archive...");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.ArchiveSha256)){var archiveHash=ModHasher.ComputeArchiveSha256(tempFile);if(!string.Equals(archiveHash,download.ArchiveSha256,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){return Fail(modId,$"Archive SHA256 mismatch: expected {download.ArchiveSha256}, got {archiveHash}");}}ReportProgress(InstallStep.Extracting,0,$"Installing {modId}...");var targetDir=GetModTargetDir(modId);var stagingDir=targetDir+"_staging";if(Directory.Exists(stagingDir))Directory.Delete(stagingDir,recursive:true);ZipFile.ExtractToDirectory(tempFile,stagingDir);var stagingEntries=Directory.GetFileSystemEntries(stagingDir);if(stagingEntries.Length==1&&Directory.Exists(stagingEntries[0])&& !File.Exists(Path.Combine(stagingDir,"manifest.json"))){var wrapperDir=stagingEntries[0];var flatDir=stagingDir+"_flat";if(Directory.Exists(flatDir))Directory.Delete(flatDir,recursive:true);Directory.Move(wrapperDir,flatDir);Directory.Delete(stagingDir,recursive:true);stagingDir=flatDir;}if(!File.Exists(Path.Combine(stagingDir,"manifest.json"))){if(Directory.Exists(stagingDir))Directory.Delete(stagingDir,recursive:true);return Fail(modId,"Extracted zip does not contain a manifest.json");}if(Directory.Exists(targetDir))Directory.Delete(targetDir,recursive:true);Directory.Move(stagingDir,targetDir);ReportProgress(InstallStep.VerifyingInstall,0,$"Verifying install...");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(download.InstallSha256)){var installHash=ModHasher.ComputeInstallSha256(targetDir);if(!string.Equals(installHash,download.InstallSha256,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Install SHA256 mismatch for '{modId}': expected {download.InstallSha256}, got {installHash}",LogLevel.Warning);}}GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Successfully installed mod '{modId}' to '{targetDir}'");}finally{if(File.Exists(tempFile))File.Delete(tempFile);}}catch(Exception ex){return Fail(modId,ex.Message);}finally{_installingMods.Remove(modId);}ReportProgress(InstallStep.Complete,1,"Install complete. Restart required.");OnCompleted?.Invoke(modId,true);return true;}private static async Task<bool>DownloadWithProgressAsync(List<string>urls,string destinationPath){foreach(var url in urls){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))continue;try{GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Downloading '{url}'...");using var response=await _httpClient.GetAsync(url,System.Net.Http.HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();var totalBytes=response.Content.Headers.ContentLength?? -1;using var stream=await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();using var fileStream=File.Create(destinationPath);var buffer=new byte[8192];long totalRead=0;int bytesRead;while((bytesRead=await stream.ReadAsync(buffer,0,buffer.Length))>0){await fileStream.WriteAsync(buffer,0,bytesRead);totalRead+=bytesRead;if(totalBytes>0){var progress=Math.Min((float)totalRead/totalBytes,1f);ReportProgress(InstallStep.Downloading,progress,$"Downloading... {progress * 100:F0}%");}else{ReportProgress(InstallStep.Downloading,0,$"Downloading... {totalRead / 1024} KB");}}GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Downloaded {totalRead} bytes from '{url}'");return true;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Download from '{url}' failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}return false;}private static string GetModTargetDir(string modId){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){var modsRoot=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("user://mods/");if(!Directory.Exists(modsRoot))Directory.CreateDirectory(modsRoot);return Path.Combine(modsRoot,modId);}return Path.Combine("mods",modId);}private static bool Fail(string modId,string reason){ReportProgress(InstallStep.Failed,0,reason);GameLogger.Log("DOWNLOADER",$"Failed to install mod '{modId}': {reason}",LogLevel.Error);OnCompleted?.Invoke(modId,false);return false;}private static void ReportProgress(InstallStep step,float progress,string message){OnProgress?.Invoke(new InstallProgress{Step=step,Progress=progress,Message=message,});}private static CatalogEntryDownload FindDownloadForVersion(List<CatalogEntryDownload>downloads,string version){if(downloads==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(version))return null;foreach(var d in downloads)if(string.Equals(d.Version,version,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return d;return null;}}}

gdSources){CollectGdFiles(modInfo.FileProvider,pattern,(filePath,source)=>{GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Loading GDScript '{filePath}' from mod '{modInfo.Id}'");var gds=new obj=instance.AsGodotObject();if(obj==null){GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"GDScript '{filePath}' in mod '{modInfo.Id}' did not produce a GodotObject",LogLevel.Error);return;}AutoRegisterEventHandlers(obj,modInfo.Id);GDScriptHookRegistry.TryRegisterAll(obj,modInfo.Id,filePath);if(obj.HasMethod("get_name")&&obj.HasMethod("run")){var '{modInfo.Id}'");}}if(obj.HasMethod("get_item_action_id")&&obj.HasMethod("use")){var itemActionId=obj.Call("get_item_action_id").AsString();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemActionId)){ItemActionBridge.Register(new GDItemAction(itemActionId,obj));GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript item action '{itemActionId}' from mod '{modInfo.Id}'");}}if(obj.HasMethod("on_mod_loaded")||obj.HasMethod("on_mod_resources_ready")){var initializer=new GDScriptModInitializer(obj);ModInitializerRegistry.RegisterGDScript(initializer,kvp.Key);GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript initializer for mod '{modInfo.Id}'");}});}}}private static void CollectGdFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,Func<string,bool>fileFilter,Action<string,string>onFile){foreach(var entry in using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Security.Cryptography;using System.Text;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> SHA256 checksum utility for mod catalog export. Two hash modes: <b>archive_sha256</b> — hash of the entire .zip file as it sits on the server. Used after download to verify file integrity (no corruption during transfer). <b>install_sha256</b> — hash of the mod's extracted content, computed by enumerating all files, sorting by relative path, hashing each as <c>SHA256(UTF8(path) + content)</c>, then hashing the concatenation of those per-file hashes. This produces a reproducible fingerprint that the game can compare against the locally-installed copy: if the local hash differs, the player has modified the mod and overwriting from the network may lose their changes. Files whose path contains any component starting with a dot (<c>.godot/</c>, <c>.import/</c>, <c>.gitignore</c>) are automatically excluded. Additional patterns from <see cref="ModConfig.CatalogIgnorePatterns"/> are also applied. </summary>
public static class ModHasher{/// <summary> Returns lowercase hex-encoded SHA256 of the file at <paramref name="filePath"/>. </summary>
public static string ComputeArchiveSha256(string filePath){using var stream=File.OpenRead(filePath);using var sha=SHA256.Create();var hash=sha.ComputeHash(stream);return BytesToHex(hash);}/// <summary> Computes a short SHA-256 hash from a set of source files for mod compilation caching. Concatenates each file's path and source text (ordered by path for determinism), then returns the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 hash. Used by <see cref="ModCompiler"/> to determine whether a mod needs recompilation. <paramref name="dependencySignature"/> is mixed into the hash so that a change in the mod's dependencies — for example renaming a dependency mod, which changes the assembly name its compiled code links against — invalidates the cache even when the mod's own sources are unchanged. </summary>
public static string ComputeHash(List<(string FilePath,string Source)>sources,string dependencySignature=null){using var sha=SHA256.Create();var sb=new StringBuilder();foreach(var(path,source)in sources.OrderBy(s=>s.FilePath)){sb.Append(path);sb.Append(':');sb.Append(source);}if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dependencySignature)){sb.Append("#deps:");sb.Append(dependencySignature);}var hashBytes=sha.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(sb.ToString()));return Convert.ToHexString(hashBytes).Substring(0,16).ToLowerInvariant();}/// <summary> Computes the reproducible install content hash from a folder on disk. Files are enumerated recursively; directories and entries matching ignore patterns are skipped. </summary>
public static string ComputeInstallSha256(string folderPath,List<string>ignorePatterns=null){var files=new List<string>(ModContentFiles.Enumerate(folderPath));return ComputeInstallSha256FromFiles(folderPath,files,ignorePatterns);}/// <summary> Computes the reproducible install content hash through an <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>. Works for both folder and zip providers. Recursively collects all files via <see cref="IModFileProvider.ListFiles"/>. </summary>
public static string ComputeInstallSha256(IModFileProvider provider,List<string>ignorePatterns=null){var allFiles=CollectAllFilesRecursive(provider,"");return ComputeInstallSha256FromProvider(provider,allFiles,ignorePatterns);}private static List<string>CollectAllFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory){var result=new List<string>();var entries=provider.ListFiles(directory);foreach(var entry in entries){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry;result.AddRange(CollectAllFilesRecursive(provider,subDir));}else{result.Add(entry);}}return result;}private static string ComputeInstallSha256FromProvider(IModFileProvider provider,List<string>files,List<string>ignorePatterns){var sorted=files.Select(ModPath.Normalize).Where(f=> !ShouldIgnore(f,ignorePatterns)).OrderBy(f=>f,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();using var sha=SHA256.Create();var hashes=new byte[sorted.Count*32];for(int i=0;i<sorted.Count;i++){var path=sorted[i];var content=provider.ReadFileBinary(path);var fileHash=HashFile(path,content,sha);Array.Copy(fileHash,0,hashes,i*32,32);}var final=sha.ComputeHash(hashes);return BytesToHex(final);}private static string ComputeInstallSha256FromFiles(string folderPath,List<string>files,List<string>ignorePatterns){var sorted=files.Select(f=>f.Replace('\\','/')).Select(f=>new{FullPath=f,RelativePath=GetRelativePath(folderPath,f)}).Where(x=> !ShouldIgnore(x.RelativePath,ignorePatterns)).OrderBy(x=>x.RelativePath,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList();using var sha=SHA256.Create();var hashes=new byte[sorted.Count*32];for(int i=0;i<sorted.Count;i++){var content=File.ReadAllBytes(sorted[i].FullPath);var fileHash=HashFile(sorted[i].RelativePath,content,sha);Array.Copy(fileHash,0,hashes,i*32,32);}var final=sha.ComputeHash(hashes);return BytesToHex(final);}private static byte[]HashFile(string relativePath,byte[]content,SHA256 sha){var pathBytes=Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(relativePath);var combined=new byte[pathBytes.Length+content.Length];Array.Copy(pathBytes,0,combined,0,pathBytes.Length);Array.Copy(content,0,combined,pathBytes.Length,content.Length);return sha.ComputeHash(combined);}private static bool ShouldIgnore(string relativePath,List<string>ignorePatterns){var parts=relativePath.Split('/');foreach(var part in parts){if(part.Length==0)continue;if(part.StartsWith("."))return true;}if(ignorePatterns!=null){foreach(var pattern in ignorePatterns){if(MatchesWildcard(relativePath,pattern))return true;}}return false;}private static bool MatchesWildcard(string path,string pattern){return MatchesWildcardImpl(path,0,pattern,0);}private static bool MatchesWildcardImpl(string path,int pi,string pattern,int pj){while(pi<path.Length&&pj<pattern.Length&&pattern[pj]!='*'){if(pattern[pj]!='?'&&path[pi]!=pattern[pj])return false;pi++;pj++;}if(pj==pattern.Length)return pi==path.Length;if(pattern[pj]=='*'){pj++;if(pj==pattern.Length)return true;while(pi<path.Length){if(MatchesWildcardImpl(path,pi,pattern,pj))return true;pi++;}}return false;}private static string BytesToHex(byte[]bytes){var sb=new StringBuilder(bytes.Length*2);foreach(var b in bytes)sb.AppendFormat("{0:x2}",b);return sb.ToString();}private static string GetRelativePath(string basePath,string fullPath){var baseNormalized=basePath.Replace('\\','/').TrimEnd('/')+"/";var fullNormalized=fullPath.Replace('\\','/');if(fullNormalized.StartsWith(baseNormalized))return fullNormalized.Substring(baseNormalized.Length);return fullNormalized;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Runtime model for a loaded mod, combining the manifest metadata with the live <c>IModFileProvider</c> handle. <c>DisplayTitle</c> falls back to <c>Id</c> when <c>Name</c> is absent so that UI panels always have something human-readable to show even for minimally-authored mods. </summary>
public class ModInfo:IModInfo{/// <summary>Unique mod identifier (folder name or zip name minus extension).</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable name from manifest.json.</summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Author credit from manifest.json.</summary>
public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Short description from manifest.json.</summary>
public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>The storage backend handle — folder or zip — that reads this mod's files.</summary>
public IModFileProvider FileProvider{get;set;}/// <summary>Parsed manifest.json contents.</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Lifecycle orchestrator for <c>IModInitializer</c> implementations. When an assembly is registered, two things happen: 1. Every <b>existing</b> initializer receives <c>OnModLoaded(newModId)</c> — so initializers loaded earlier become aware of the new mod. 2. Every <b>new</b> initializer receives <c>OnModLoaded(alreadyLoadedModId)</c> for each mod that was loaded before it — so a late-arriving initializer sees the complete mod set, not just the mods loaded after itself. This two-way catch-up guarantees that initializer state is consistent regardless of mod load order, which is essential since mod loading order depends on filesystem enumeration and dependency graphs, both of which are non-deterministic across platforms. </summary>
public static class ModInitializerRegistry{private static readonly List<IModInitializer>_initializers=new();private static readonly List<string>_loadedModIds=new();/// <summary> Discovers <c>IModInitializer</c> implementations in the assembly, creates instances, and performs the two-way catch-up notification so that every initializer sees every loaded mod regardless of registration order. </summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){var newInitializers=new List<IModInitializer>();foreach(var init in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModInitializer>(assembly)){try{newInitializers.Add(init);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"Failed to create initializer for '{init.GetType().FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}foreach(var init in _initializers){try{init.OnModLoaded(modId);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"OnModLoaded failed for existing initializer on mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}foreach(var loadedId in _loadedModIds){foreach(var init in newInitializers){try{init.OnModLoaded(loadedId);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"OnModLoaded failed for new initializer on mod '{loadedId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}_initializers.AddRange(newInitializers);if(!_loadedModIds.Contains(modId))_loadedModIds.Add(modId);ModEventBus.Publish(new ModLoadedEvent{ModId=modId});}/// <summary> Registers a manually-constructed <c>IModInitializer</c> (e.g. from a GDScript mod) and performs the two-way catch-up notification so it sees already-loaded mods. </summary>
public static void RegisterGDScript(IModInitializer initializer,string modId){foreach(var loadedId in _loadedModIds){try{initializer.OnModLoaded(loadedId);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"OnModLoaded failed for GDScript initializer on mod '{loadedId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}_initializers.Add(initializer);if(!_loadedModIds.Contains(modId))_loadedModIds.Add(modId);ModEventBus.Publish(new ModLoadedEvent{ModId=modId});}/// <summary> Unload pass for one mod: initializers implementing <see cref="IModUnloadAware"/> contributed by the mod's assembly get <c>OnModUnloading</c> (mod code tears down while its types are still alive), then every other unload-aware initializer is informed so cross-mod references can be dropped. Initializers contributed by the dying mod are removed afterwards. Failures are logged and isolated, mirroring the load path. </summary>
public static void NotifyModUnloading(string modId){foreach(var init in _initializers.ToArray()){if(init is not IModUnloadAware unloadAware)continue;var fromUnloadingMod=init.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Name==modId;try{if(fromUnloadingMod)unloadAware.OnModUnloading();else unloadAware.OnModUnloaded(modId);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"Unload notification failed for initializer '{init.GetType().FullName}' (mod '{modId}'): {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}_initializers.RemoveAll(init=>init.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Name==modId);// The mod leaves the loaded set: initializers registered later must not get a catch-up OnModLoaded for it.
_loadedModIds.Remove(modId);}/// <summary> Notifies every registered <c>IModInitializer</c> that all mods and their JSON resources are fully loaded. Call this once, after <c>ModRegistry.Initialize()</c> has completed and factories can read mod data. </summary>
public static void NotifyResourcesReady(){foreach(var init in _initializers){try{init.OnModResourcesReady();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_INIT",$"OnModResourcesReady failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}ModEventBus.Publish(new ModResourcesReadyEvent());}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Runtime.Loader;using System.Threading;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> One collectible <see cref="AssemblyLoadContext"/> per mod — the unit of assembly unload. Replaces the flat default-context load for mod assemblies: unloading a mod (reload, disable, uninstall) can now actually release its assemblies, JIT code and static state instead of rewriting registries over a still-loaded copy. Resolution rules, in order: 1. the mod's own staged assemblies (main dll and mod-shipped dll/), 2. assemblies of the mod's dependency mods — resolved through the dependency's own context so inter-mod types are reference-equal across both sides, 3. the context the kernel was loaded into (Godot's plugin context in an export), then the default context — the kernel and GodotSharp are always the very instances the game runs on (this is what makes "mods can use core types" work without any special casing). File-backed loading keeps the debugger story of plan-mod-testing §9.2: a portable PDB written next to the dll binds by naming convention and breakpoints in mod code keep working. Unload is a protocol, not a button: the caller must run the consumer reverse fan-out (<c>AssemblyConsumerRegistry.FanOutUnloading</c>) and drop every external reference first; then <see cref="TryUnload"/> forces GC and asks the context to release. The returned diagnostic lists surviving assemblies when someone still holds a reference — that is the leak to fix, not a reason to retry. </summary>

public ModLoadContext(string modId,Func<string,ModLoadContext>dependencyResolver):base("mod:"+modId,isCollectible:true){this.modId=modId;this.dependencyResolver=dependencyResolver;}/// <summary>Mod id this context belongs to; also the context name suffix.</summary>
public string ModId=>modId;/// <summary> True once <see cref="TryUnload"/> released the context. Its assemblies stay in <see cref="AppDomain.GetAssemblies"/> until the GC collects them, so every "scan all loaded assemblies" must skip them — a scan that still sees them re-registers the dying mod's types (and, after a reload, finds two assemblies with the same name). </summary>
public bool IsReleased{get;private set;}/// <summary>True when <paramref name="assembly"/> belongs to a released mod context.</summary>
public static bool IsReleasedAssembly(Assembly assembly)=>assembly!=null&&assembly.IsCollectible&&GetLoadContext(assembly)is ModLoadContext{IsReleased:true};/// <summary> Registers a file-backed assembly (main compiled dll or a mod-shipped precompiled one) by its simple name. Must happen before the first resolve. Returns the assembly's simple name — the key for <see cref="LoadStaged"/>. It differs from the file name for cached compiled mods (<c>cooking_&lt;hash&gt;.dll</c> holds <c>cooking</c>). </summary>
public string StageAssembly(string dllPath){var name=AssemblyName.GetAssemblyName(dllPath).Name;assemblyPaths[name]=dllPath;return name;}/// <summary>True when the mod staged an assembly with this simple name.</summary>
public bool HasAssembly(string simpleName)=>assemblyPaths.ContainsKey(simpleName);/// <summary> Loads a staged assembly file-backed. Called by the loader for the mod's entry assembly; other assemblies resolve lazily. </summary>

protected override Assembly Load(AssemblyName assemblyName){var name=assemblyName?.Name;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))return null;// 1. Own assemblies.
if(assemblyPaths.TryGetValue(name,out var path))return LoadFromAssemblyPath(path);// 2. Dependency mod assemblies — through the dependency's context, so a type from the dependency is reference-equal on both sides.
var dependency=dependencyResolver?.Invoke(name);if(dependency!=null&&dependency.HasAssembly(name))return dependency.LoadStaged(name);// 3. Kernel, GodotSharp, framework — through the context the kernel itself lives in. In an export Godot loads Cthangover.dll into its plugin context, while the default context of the self-contained app finds the same file on disk and would load a second copy: mod types then implement a foreign IModInitializer and no initializer, setting or script binds. In the editor run both are the same instance anyway.
if(KernelContext!=Default){try{return KernelContext.LoadFromAssemblyName(assemblyName);}catch(Exception){// Not the kernel's: the default context decides below.

protected override IntPtr LoadUnmanagedDll(string unmanagedDllName)// Native libraries keep the ModNativeLoader path; no custom probing.
=>IntPtr.Zero;/// <summary> Starts the unload: drops the path table so nothing resolves into the context any more, then asks the runtime to release it. Collection happens on a later GC once nothing refers into the context; verify it with a <c>WeakReference</c> held by the caller (<see cref="Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload.ModUnloadTicket"/>, <see cref="CollectAndVerify"/>) — a weak reference taken inside this very frame would see <c>this</c> alive by definition. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Computes deterministic mod load order from declared dependencies and optional manual ordering. The algorithm assigns each mod a <c>dependsLevel</c> — zero for mods without dependencies, one for mods that depend on level-zero mods, etc. Within the same level, mods are ordered by user-defined manual position (if any), then alphabetically by ID for determinism. The result is a list where every mod appears after all its transitive dependencies. </summary>
public static class ModLoadOrder{/// <summary> Computes a deterministic order for the given mods. <paramref name="mods"/> maps mod ID to a list of dependency IDs (from <c>manifest.json</c>'s <c>depends</c> field). <paramref name="manualOrder"/> is an optional user-defined list of mod IDs. Mods in the manual list are ordered by their position within it; mods not present are placed at the end. Manual ordering is secondary to dependencies — a mod cannot appear before its dependency regardless of manual position. </summary>
public static List<string>Compute(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyList<string>>mods,List<string>manualOrder=null){var allIds=mods.Keys.ToList();if(allIds.Count==0)return new List<string>();var level=ComputeDependsLevels(mods,allIds);var manualIndex=new Dictionary<string,int>();if(manualOrder!=null){for(int i=0;i<manualOrder.Count;i++){if(!manualIndex.ContainsKey(manualOrder[i]))manualIndex[manualOrder[i]]=i;}}allIds.Sort((a,b)=>{var levelA=level.TryGetValue(a,out var la)?la:0;var levelB=level.TryGetValue(b,out var lb)?lb:0;var levelCmp=levelA.CompareTo(levelB);if(levelCmp!=0)return levelCmp;var manualA=manualIndex.TryGetValue(a,out var ma)?ma:int.MaxValue;var manualB=manualIndex.TryGetValue(b,out var mb)?mb:int.MaxValue;var manualCmp=manualA.CompareTo(manualB);if(manualCmp!=0)return manualCmp;return string.Compare(a,b,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);});return allIds;}/// <summary> Computes the dependency depth for every mod. Returns a dictionary mapping mod ID to its <c>dependsLevel</c> — zero for root mods, incremented for each dependency layer. Circular dependencies are broken at zero with a warning delivered via <paramref name="onCycle"/>. </summary>
public static Dictionary<string,int>ComputeDependsLevels(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyList<string>>mods,List<string>allIds,System.Action<string>onCycle=null){var result=new Dictionary<string,int>();int ComputeLevel(string modId,HashSet<string>visiting){if(result.TryGetValue(modId,out var cached))return cached;if(!visiting.Add(modId)){onCycle?.Invoke(modId);result[modId]=0;return 0;}if(!mods.TryGetValue(modId,out var deps)||deps==null||deps.Count==0){result[modId]=0;visiting.Remove(modId);return 0;}int maxDepth=0;foreach(var depId in deps){if(!mods.ContainsKey(depId))continue;var depDepth=ComputeLevel(depId,visiting);if(depDepth+1>maxDepth)maxDepth=depDepth+1;}result[modId]=maxDepth;visiting.Remove(modId);return maxDepth;}foreach(var id in allIds){if(!result.ContainsKey(id))ComputeLevel(id,new HashSet<string>());}return result;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Persists user-defined mod load order to <c>user://mod_load_order.json</c>. The stored list is a preference that is merged with mandatory dependency ordering from <c>ModManifest.Depends</c> — dependencies always override manual ordering. New mods not present in the stored list are inserted automatically at their alphabetically-appropriate position. </summary>
public static class ModLoadOrderStore{private const string FilePath="user://mod_load_order.json";/// <summary> Serialises file access. <c>user://mod_load_order.json</c> can be written from multiple contexts (mod bootstrap, save loading, parallel unit tests); unsynchronised <see cref="Save"/> calls throw <see cref="IOException"/> ("file in use by another process"). </summary>
private static readonly object _fileLock=new();/// <summary>Resolved storage path: globalised <c>user://mod_load_order.json</c> at runtime, relative fallback otherwise.</summary>
public static string Path=>GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(FilePath):"mod_load_order.json";/// <summary>Reads the saved manual order; returns an empty list when the file is absent or broken.</summary>
public static List<string>Load(){var path=Path;if(!File.Exists(path))return new List<string>();try{lock(_fileLock){var json=File.ReadAllText(path);var list=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return list??new List<string>();}}catch{return new List<string>();}}/// <summary>Persists the manual order as a compact JSON array of mod ids.</summary>
public static void Save(List<string>orderedIds){var path=Path;var dir=System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)&& !Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(orderedIds,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);lock(_fileLock){File.WriteAllText(path,json);}}/// <summary> Moves a mod up by one position in the saved order. If the mod is not in the list, it is appended first. </summary>
public static void MoveUp(string modId){var order=Load();var index=order.IndexOf(modId);if(index<0){order.Add(modId);Save(order);return;}if(index==0)return;(order[index-1],order[index])=(order[index],order[index-1]);Save(order);}/// <summary> Moves a mod down by one position in the saved order. If the mod is not in the list, it is appended first. </summary>
public static void MoveDown(string modId){var order=Load();var index=order.IndexOf(modId);if(index<0){order.Add(modId);Save(order);return;}if(index>=order.Count-1)return;(order[index+1],order[index])=(order[index],order[index+1]);Save(order);}/// <summary> Returns the existing user-defined manual order, removing IDs for mods that no longer exist. New mods (not in the saved order) are NOT added — they will be placed by alphabetical order in <see cref="ModLoadOrder.Compute"/>. Does NOT save to disk. </summary>
public static List<string>Sync(List<string>allModIds){var order=Load();order.RemoveAll(id=> !allModIds.Contains(id));return order;}/// <summary> Removes a mod id from the saved manual order and persists the change. Called by <see cref="ModUninstaller"/> after the mod's files are gone. </summary>
public static void Remove(string modId){var order=Load();if(order.Remove(modId))Save(order);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON DTO for the <c>manifest.json</c> file required inside every mod. <c>Id</c> is the canonical mod identifier used for deduplication and dependency resolution. When two mods declare the same <c>Id</c>, the one with the higher <c>Version</c> wins and the lower one is ignored. public class ModManifest{/// <summary> Canonical mod identifier. Used for deduplication (higher <c>Version</c> wins) and in <c>depends</c> lists of other mods. When absent, the filesystem entry name is used instead. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Human-readable mod name (shown in UI).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("name")]public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod author credit string.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("author")]public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Short description of what the mod does.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("description")]public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary> Optional catalog category (or combination) used to group the mod in the online catalog. Serialized as a string via <c>JsonStringEnumConverter</c> — a single name (e.g. <c>"gameplay"</c>) or a comma-separated list for mods that belong to several categories (e.g. <c>"library, gameplay"</c>). Omitted means <see cref="CategoryType.Other"/>. The Catalog Export dialog pre-checks these categories for <see cref="CatalogExportEntry.Category"/>. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("category")][JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]public CategoryType?Category{get;set;}/// <summary> Glob-style paths to C# source files (e.g. "scripts/*.cs", "src/"). <c>ModCompiler</c> collects and compiles them. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("sources")]public List<string>Sources{get;set;}/// <summary> Glob-style paths to GDScript source files (e.g. "scripts/*.gd", "gd/**/*.gd"). <c>ModGDScriptLoader</c> collects, compiles via Godot's GDScript runtime, and registers as scenario actions or mod initializers. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("gd_sources")]public List<string>GdSources{get;set;}/// <summary> Glob-style paths to C# test files (e.g. "tests/*.cs"). using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Reflection;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Loads native shared libraries from mod <c>depends_native</c> manifest declarations and wires them into the P/Invoke resolution chain via <c>NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver</c>. <b>Discovery</b> — iterates every mod whose manifest declares <c>depends_native</c> glob patterns, collects platform-appropriate files (.dll / .so / .dylib), and copies them to a stable cache directory so that even zip-based mods can serve native code. <b>Resolution</b> — a single <c>DllImportResolver</c> is installed on the core project assembly. When the runtime searches for a native library named in a <c>[DllImport]</c> attribute, the resolver checks the accumulated cache and returns the handle. Falls through to default resolution for libraries not found in the cache. <b>Placement</b> — called from <c>ModRegistry.Initialize()</c> before any managed code loads, so that P/Invoke calls in static constructors or type initializers never see a missing library. <b>Lifecycle</b> — loaded handles are tracked for cleanup during <c>ModRegistry.Reload()</c>. Each native library is loaded once; if multiple mods provide the same library name, the first one wins and duplicates are logged as warnings. </summary>
public static class ModNativeLoader{/// <summary> Absolute path to the native library cache directory (<c>user://mod_cache/native/</c>). Resolved once at static init with an OS temp fallback for non-runtime contexts. </summary>
public static readonly string CacheRoot;private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>_nameToPath=new();private static readonly Dictionary<string,IntPtr>_loadedHandles=new();private static bool _resolverInstalled;static ModNativeLoader(){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){try{CacheRoot=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("user://mod_cache/native/");}catch{CacheRoot=Path.Combine(System.Environment.GetFolderPath(System.Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),"cthangover","mod_cache","native");}}else{CacheRoot=Path.Combine(System.Environment.GetFolderPath(System.Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),"cthangover","mod_cache","native");}}/// <summary> Scans each loaded mod's <c>depends_native</c> patterns for platform-native shared libraries, copies them to the cache, and registers a <c>DllImportResolver</c> on the core assembly. Must be called before any managed code that triggers P/Invoke resolution — typically from <c>ModRegistry.Initialize()</c> right before precompiled DLL loading. </summary>
public static void LoadNativeDlls(IEnumerable<IModInfo>mods,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){if(!Directory.Exists(CacheRoot))Directory.CreateDirectory(CacheRoot);foreach(var mod in mods){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var modInfo=mod as ModInfo;var nativePatterns=modInfo?.Manifest?.DependsNative;if(nativePatterns==null||nativePatterns.Count==0)continue;var nativeFiles=CollectNativeFiles(mod.FileProvider,nativePatterns);if(nativeFiles.Count==0)continue;GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader.LoadNativeDlls: found {nativeFiles.Count} native library(s) in mod '{mod.Id}'");foreach(var(filePath,bytes)in nativeFiles){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();try{var fileName=Path.GetFileName(filePath);var libraryName=NormalizeLibraryName(fileName);var cachedPath=Path.Combine(CacheRoot,$"{mod.Id}_native_{fileName}");// Checked before the write: a library registered earlier (a previous mod, or this mod before an in-process reload) is loaded by the OS and its file must not be rewritten.
if(_nameToPath.TryGetValue(libraryName,out var registered)&&registered==cachedPath)continue;if(registered!=null){GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader.LoadNativeDlls: native library '{libraryName}' already registered "+$"(from a previous mod), skipping duplicate from mod '{mod.Id}'",LogLevel.Warning);continue;}File.WriteAllBytes(cachedPath,bytes);_nameToPath[libraryName]=cachedPath;GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader.LoadNativeDlls: registered native library '{libraryName}' "+$"from mod '{mod.Id}' -> '{cachedPath}'");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader.LoadNativeDlls: failed to cache native library '{filePath}' "+$"from mod '{mod.Id}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}if(_nameToPath.Count>0)EnsureResolverInstalled();}/// <summary> Releases all native library handles loaded through the resolver. Called during <c>ModRegistry.Reload()</c> to allow DLL files to be overwritten on the next load cycle. </summary>
public static void FreeAll(){foreach(var kvp in _loadedHandles){try{NativeLibrary.Free(kvp.Value);}catch{}}_loadedHandles.Clear();_nameToPath.Clear();}private static void EnsureResolverInstalled(){if(_resolverInstalled)return;_resolverInstalled=true;System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext.Default.ResolvingUnmanagedDll+=OnResolvingUnmanagedDll;GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE","ModNativeLoader: global native DLL resolver installed");}/// <summary> Installs the DllImportResolver on a specific assembly. Call after loading a precompiled mod assembly that may contain [DllImport] attributes. </summary>
public static void InstallResolverOnAssembly(Assembly assembly){if(_nameToPath.Count==0)return;NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver(assembly,OnResolvingUnmanagedDllAssembly);}private static IntPtr OnResolvingUnmanagedDllAssembly(string libraryName,Assembly assembly,DllImportSearchPath?searchPath){libraryName=NormalizeLibraryName(libraryName);if(_loadedHandles.TryGetValue(libraryName,out var cachedHandle))return cachedHandle;if(!_nameToPath.TryGetValue(libraryName,out var cachedPath))return IntPtr.Zero;if(NativeLibrary.TryLoad(cachedPath,out var handle)){_loadedHandles[libraryName]=handle;GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader: loaded '{libraryName}' from '{cachedPath}'");return handle;}return IntPtr.Zero;}private static IntPtr OnResolvingUnmanagedDll(Assembly assembly,string libraryName){libraryName=NormalizeLibraryName(libraryName);if(_loadedHandles.TryGetValue(libraryName,out var cachedHandle))return cachedHandle;if(!_nameToPath.TryGetValue(libraryName,out var cachedPath))return IntPtr.Zero;if(NativeLibrary.TryLoad(cachedPath,out var handle)){_loadedHandles[libraryName]=handle;GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader: loaded '{libraryName}' from '{cachedPath}'");return handle;}GameLogger.Log("MODS_NATIVE",$"ModNativeLoader: failed to load '{libraryName}' from '{cachedPath}'",LogLevel.Error);return IntPtr.Zero;}/// <summary> Platform-neutral key for a native library: no extension and no Unix <c>lib</c> prefix. <c>[DllImport("Live2DCubismCore")]</c> must find <c>Live2DCubismCore.dll</c> on Windows as well as <c>libLive2DCubismCore.so</c> / <c>.dylib</c> on Linux and macOS. </summary>
public static string NormalizeLibraryName(string name){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))return name;var fileName=Path.GetFileName(name);foreach(var ext in new[]{".dll",".so",".dylib"}){if(fileName.EndsWith(ext,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){fileName=fileName.Substring(0,fileName.Length-ext.Length);break;}}if(fileName.StartsWith("lib",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&fileName.Length>3)fileName=fileName.Substring(3);return fileName;}private static List<(string FilePath,byte[]Bytes)>CollectNativeFiles(IModFileProvider provider,List<string>patterns){var result=new List<(string,byte[])>();foreach(var pattern in patterns){var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*";var sepIndex=pattern.LastIndexOf('/');if(sepIndex>=0){prefix=pattern.Substring(0,sepIndex);suffix=pattern.Substring(sepIndex+1);}CollectNativeFilesRecursive(provider,prefix,file=>{if(!IsPlatformFile(file))return false;if(suffix=="*")return true;var fileName=file.Replace('\\','/');var fileNamePart=fileName.Substring(fileName.LastIndexOf('/')+1);return suffix=="*"||(suffix.StartsWith("*.")&&fileNamePart.EndsWith(suffix.Substring(1),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));},result);}return result;}private static void CollectNativeFilesRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,Func<string,bool>fileFilter,List<(string,byte[])>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectNativeFilesRecursive(provider,subDir,fileFilter,result);}else if(fileFilter(entry)){var bytes=provider.ReadFileBinary(entry);if(bytes!=null)result.Add((entry,bytes));}}}private static bool IsPlatformFile(string fileName){if(RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows))return fileName.EndsWith(".dll",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux))return fileName.EndsWith(".so",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.OSX))return fileName.EndsWith(".dylib",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return false;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Content layers mounted on top of the loaded mod set without reloading it. An overlay is a plain <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> registered under an id that is not a mod id (e.g. the scenario studio's per-game edit layer in <c>user://studio/</c>); content resolvers that support overlays (<see cref="Resolvers.ScenarioResolver"/>, <see cref="Resolvers.SceneDefinitionResolver"/>) read them next to the mods, and overlay scenarios override mod scenarios of the same name. <para/> Mounting does not invalidate anything by itself: the owner calls the resolvers' invalidation after it changes overlay files, exactly as it would after editing a folder mod. A full mod reload keeps the overlays — they belong to the session, not to the mod set. </summary>
public static class ModOverlays{private static readonly List<KeyValuePair<string,IModFileProvider>>overlays=new();/// <summary>Mounted overlays in mount order.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string,IModFileProvider>>All=>overlays;/// <summary>Mounts <paramref name="provider"/> as overlay <paramref name="id"/>, replacing an overlay with the same id.</summary>
public static void Mount(string id,IModFileProvider provider){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)||provider==null)throw new ArgumentException("overlay id and provider are required");Unmount(id);overlays.Add(new KeyValuePair<string,IModFileProvider>(id,provider));}/// <summary>Removes overlay <paramref name="id"/>; returns false when it was not mounted.</summary>
public static bool Unmount(string id){for(var i=0;i<overlays.Count;i++){if(overlays[i].Key!=id)continue;overlays.RemoveAt(i);return true;}return false;}/// <summary>Finds the provider of overlay <paramref name="id"/>.</summary>
public static bool TryGet(string id,out IModFileProvider provider){foreach(var overlay in overlays){if(overlay.Key!=id)continue;provider=overlay.Value;return true;}provider=null;return false;}}}

===== FILE Core/Mods/ModPath.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Canonical path arithmetic shared by every <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>. Mod-relative paths are always stored and compared in one canonical form: forward slashes, no leading root marker, no <c>.</c>/<c>..</c> segments, no trailing slash. Only providers convert to the OS-native form, and only at the filesystem boundary. The previous per-provider normalisation diverged — folder providers converted to <see cref="System.IO.Path.DirectorySeparatorChar"/> while zip providers kept forward slashes and trimmed leading slashes — so the same mod could behave differently depending on whether it shipped as a folder or a zip (most visibly: <c>${../shared/x.json}</c> includes resolved against the real filesystem for folders, but failed for zips because the <c>..</c> was never collapsed). Centralising here removes that class of bug: a path produced by one provider can be handed to any other component without re-normalisation. Escaping the mod root is neutralised rather than rejected: a leading <c>/</c>, a drive prefix (<c>C:/</c>), or a <c>..</c> that would pop past the root simply becomes a relative path inside the mod, matching the fail-closed behaviour of zip lookup. </summary>
public static class ModPath{/// <summary> Converts a path to canonical mod-relative form: backslashes become forward slashes, empty/current-directory segments are dropped, <c>..</c> pops the previous segment (ignored at the root), and a leading root or drive marker is removed. Returns an empty string for null, empty, or root-only input. </summary>
public static string Normalize(string path){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return"";var segments=path.Replace('\\','/').Split('/');var result=new List<string>(segments.Length);foreach(var segment in segments){if(segment.Length==0||segment==".")continue;if(segment==".."){if(result.Count>0)result.RemoveAt(result.Count-1);continue;}if(result.Count==0&&segment.EndsWith(":",StringComparison.Ordinal))continue;result.Add(segment);}return string.Join("/",result);}/// <summary> Canonical directory form: <see cref="Normalize"/> plus a trailing <c>/</c>. Empty input stays empty so that root listings keep the no-prefix contract. </summary>
public static string NormalizeDirectory(string path){var normalized=Normalize(path);return normalized.Length==0?"":normalized+"/";}/// <summary> Returns the canonical directory containing <paramref name="path"/>, or an empty string when the path has no directory component. </summary>
public static string GetDirectory(string path){var normalized=Normalize(path);var lastSlash=normalized.LastIndexOf('/');return lastSlash<0?"":normalized.Substring(0,lastSlash);}/// <summary> Resolves a relative include path (<c>../shared/data.json</c>) against the directory of <paramref name="currentPath"/> and returns the canonical result. This is the single implementation behind <see cref="IModFileProvider.ResolveIncludePath"/> for both folder and zip providers, so include directives cannot behave differently based on storage format. </summary>
public static string ResolveRelative(string includePath,string currentPath){var directory=GetDirectory(currentPath);if(directory.Length==0)return Normalize(includePath);return Normalize(directory+"/"+includePath);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Single case policy for mod-relative paths: a reference must match the on-disk (or in-archive) spelling exactly. Windows and macOS file systems forgive a wrong case, Linux, CI and exported <c>.pck</c> files do not — so a mod that only works on the author's machine is caught on every platform instead of breaking after export. Providers use <see cref="FindOnDisk"/> to learn the real spelling and <see cref="ReportMismatch"/> to name the correct path in the log, then treat the request as a miss. </summary>
public static class ModPathCase{private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,byte>Reported=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);/// <summary> Walks <paramref name="relative"/> (canonical <see cref="ModPath"/> form) under <paramref name="root"/> segment by segment and returns its on-disk spelling, preferring an exact match per segment and falling back to a case-insensitive one. Returns <c>null</c> when nothing matches or the entry kind (file vs directory) differs. </summary>
public static string FindOnDisk(string root,string relative,bool directory){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(relative))return directory&&Directory.Exists(root)?string.Empty:null;var segments=relative.Split('/');var actual=new string[segments.Length];var current=root;for(var i=0;i<segments.Length;i++){if(!Directory.Exists(current))return null;string match=null;foreach(var entry in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(current)){var name=Path.GetFileName(entry);if(string.Equals(name,segments[i],StringComparison.Ordinal)){match=name;break;}if(match==null&&string.Equals(name,segments[i],StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))match=name;}if(match==null)return null;actual[i]=match;current=Path.Combine(current,match);}var exists=directory?Directory.Exists(current):File.Exists(current);return exists?string.Join("/",actual):null;}/// <summary> Logs a case-only mismatch once per mod and path, so a hot lookup loop cannot flood the log while the author still sees the fix. </summary>
public static void ReportMismatch(string mod,string requested,string actual){if(!Reported.TryAdd($"{mod}|{requested}",0))return;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"[{mod}] path case mismatch: '{requested}' is spelled '{actual}' — fix the reference "+"(paths are case-sensitive on Linux and in exported .pck)",LogLevel.Error);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Mod discovery and index — the singleton facade of the mod subsystem. Owns the mod dictionaries (<c>mods</c>, <c>AllDiscoveredMods</c>) and the <c>initialized</c> flag, and delegates the actual work to the collaborators in <c>Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline</c>: boot-phase orchestration (<see cref="ModBootPipeline"/>), per-root discovery and deduplication (<see cref="ModDiscoveryService"/>), disabled/dependency filtering (<see cref="ModSetFilter"/>) and load-order computation (<see cref="ModLoadOrderService"/>); static root helpers live in <see cref="ModRoots"/>. <b>Deduplication:</b> when two mods share the same <see cref="ModManifest.Id"/> (or fall back to the same filesystem name), the one from the higher-priority root wins, and on equal priority the higher <see cref="ModManifest.Version"/>; the loser is skipped with a warning and its file provider is disposed. Mods without a version are treated as <c>"0.0.0.0"</c>. After discovery, the pipeline delegates to <c>ModAssemblyLoader</c> for precompiled DLLs and then to <c>ModCompiler</c> for source-based mods — the ordering matters because source mods may depend on APIs defined in precompiled DLLs. <c>Reload</c> clears state and re-runs discovery; <c>ModManager</c> hooks this to also flush its own caches. </summary>
public class ModRegistry:IModRegistry{private static readonly Lazy<ModRegistry>instance=new(()=>new ModRegistry());/// <summary>Thread-safe singleton.</summary>
public static ModRegistry Instance=>instance.Value;private readonly Dictionary<string,IModInfo>mods=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,IModInfo>allDiscoveredMods=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,int>_existingPriorities=new();/// <summary> True once discovery has run at least once. Published by the pipeline with a volatile write only after every game registry has been filled (<c>ModBootPipeline.FinalizeGodotInit</c>), so external readers can trust it as a readiness signal. Field name is load- bearing: test setups reset this flag via reflection. </summary>
private bool initialized;private readonly ModBootPipeline pipeline;private readonly ModLoadOrderService loadOrder;private readonly ModSetReloader reloader;private ModRegistry(){Mods=mods;pipeline=new ModBootPipeline(this,mods,allDiscoveredMods,_existingPriorities);loadOrder=new ModLoadOrderService(this,pipeline,mods,allDiscoveredMods);reloader=new ModSetReloader(this,pipeline,mods,allDiscoveredMods,_existingPriorities);}/// <summary>In-process replacement of the running mod set (game switch, hot reload).</summary>
public ModSetReloader Reloader=>reloader;/// <summary>Filesystem paths of the scanner roots resolved at boot (watched by the hot reload).</summary>
internal List<string>RootPaths{get{var paths=new List<string>();foreach(var(_,url,_)in pipeline.ResolvedRoots)paths.Add(url);return paths;}}/// <summary>Primary mods root (the first accessible scanner root, lowest priority number).</summary>

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery;/// <summary> Static helpers for resolving the mods roots (the scanned sources of mods, e.g. <c>user://mods/</c> and the game-dir <c>mods/</c>). Extracted from <see cref="ModRegistry"/> so tools and test setups can query roots without touching the registry's singleton state: these lookups only initialise the discovery registry and probe the filesystem — they never trigger mod loading or the boot pipeline. Threading contract: <c>GetRoots</c>/<c>IsCanProvide</c> may globalise paths through <c>ProjectSettings</c>, so call these members from the Godot main thread (callers — mod manager UI, uninstaller, test setups — already do). The boot pipeline resolves the same roots once per launch in <c>ModBootPipeline.PreparePaths</c> and never uses this class. <see cref="ModRegistry.ModsPath"/> and <see cref="ModRegistry.AllModsRoots"/> remain as delegating static properties for source compatibility with existing callers. </summary>
public static class ModRoots{/// <summary>Primary mods root (the first accessible scanner root, lowest priority number).</summary>
public static string ModsPath=>ResolveModsRoots().FirstOrDefault().Path;/// <summary>All currently accessible mods roots with their dedup priorities; used by the uninstaller's writable-root check.</summary>
public static List<(string Path,int Priority)>AllModsRoots=>ResolveModsRoots();/// <summary> Re-resolves every registered scanner's roots on each call (no caching — callers may run after new scanners were registered by freshly loaded mod assemblies, which must be visible immediately). A root is listed only when its scanner still answers <see cref="IModDiscoveryProvider.IsCanProvide"/>, so roots whose backing directory disappeared drop out of the result. </summary>
public static List<(string Path,int Priority)>ResolveModsRoots(){var roots=new List<(string Path,int Priority)>();ModDiscoveryRegistry.Initialize();foreach(var scanner in ModDiscoveryRegistry.Scanners){foreach(var root in scanner.GetRoots()){if(scanner.IsCanProvide(root.Url))roots.Add((root.Url,root.Priority));}}return roots;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Registry of <see cref="IModSaveable"/> implementations. When a mod assembly is loaded via <see cref="ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/>, types are scanned and instances created. On save, <see cref="CollectSaveData"/> creates a pre-filled <see cref="ModSlot"/> for each registered mod — the core sets <c>ModId</c>, <c>ModName</c>, and <c>ModVersion</c> so the mod does not need to — then calls <see cref="IModSaveable.OnSave"/>. On load, <see cref="DispatchLoad"/> distributes slots from the save file via <see cref="IModSaveable.OnLoad"/>, preferring the explicit <c>bool OnLoad(ModSlot, out string)</c> overload and falling back to exception-based <c>OnLoadVoid</c>. </summary>
public static class ModSaveableRegistry{private static readonly List<RegisteredSaveable>_saveables=new();private class RegisteredSaveable{public IModSaveable Instance;public string ModId;}/// <summary> Discovers <see cref="IModSaveable"/> implementations in the assembly and registers them under the given modId. </summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModSaveable>(assembly)){try{_saveables.Add(new RegisteredSaveable{Instance=instance,ModId=modId});GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"Registered IModSaveable '{instance.GetType().FullName}' for mod '{modId}'",LogLevel.Debug);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"Failed to create IModSaveable '{instance.GetType().FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Removes every saveable registered for <paramref name="modId"/> from the given assembly — the unload pass of the assembly consumer pipeline. Matching by both mod id and declaring assembly keeps the removal exact even when a mod ships multiple assemblies or another mod overrode the same saveable contract. </summary>
public static void UnregisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){_saveables.RemoveAll(e=>e.ModId==modId&&e.Instance.GetType().Assembly==assembly);}/// <summary> Collects save data from all registered mods. For each one, creates a <see cref="ModSlot"/> with <c>Metadata.ModId</c>, <c>Metadata.ModName</c>, and <c>Metadata.ModVersion</c> pre-filled from <see cref="IModInfo"/>, then calls <see cref="IModSaveable.OnSave"/> and stores the slot keyed by ModId. </summary>
public static Dictionary<string,ModSlot>CollectSaveData(){var result=new Dictionary<string,ModSlot>();foreach(var entry in _saveables){try{var modInfo=ModRegistry.Instance.GetMod(entry.ModId);var slot=new ModSlot{Metadata=new ModMetadata{ModId=entry.ModId,ModName=modInfo?.DisplayTitle??entry.ModId,ModVersion=modInfo?.Version??"0.0.0",}};entry.Instance.OnSave(slot);result[entry.ModId]=slot;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"OnSave failed for mod '{entry.ModId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}return result;}/// <summary> Dispatches data slots to mods on load. For each registered mod whose ID is present in the loaded slot dictionary, calls <see cref="IModSaveable.OnLoad(Cthangover.Core.Settings.ModSlot, out string)"/>. If the mod does not override the bool overload, the default implementation delegates to <see cref="IModSaveable.OnLoadVoid"/> — exceptions from either path are caught and returned as errors. Returns an empty list on success. </summary>
public static List<string>DispatchLoad(Dictionary<string,ModSlot>modData,ICollection<string>failedModIds=null){var errors=new List<string>();if(modData==null)return errors;foreach(var entry in _saveables){if(!modData.TryGetValue(entry.ModId,out var slot))continue;try{if(entry.Instance.OnLoad(slot,out var error)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"OnLoad succeeded for mod '{entry.ModId}'");}else{var modName=slot.Metadata?.ModName??entry.ModId;errors.Add($"Mod '{entry.ModId}' ({modName}): {error ?? "unspecified error"}");failedModIds?.Add(entry.ModId);}}catch(Exception ex){var modName=slot.Metadata?.ModName??entry.ModId;var errorMsg=$"Mod '{entry.ModId}' ({modName}): {ex.Message}";GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"OnLoad failed: {errorMsg}",LogLevel.Error);errors.Add(errorMsg);failedModIds?.Add(entry.ModId);}}return errors;}/// <summary> Tells every saveable whose mod had no restored slot that it joined an existing game (<see cref="IModSaveable.OnJoinedExistingGame"/>). </summary>
public static void NotifyJoined(IEnumerable<string>restoredModIds){var restored=new HashSet<string>(restoredModIds??Array.Empty<string>(),StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var entry in _saveables){if(restored.Contains(entry.ModId))continue;try{entry.Instance.OnJoinedExistingGame();GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"Mod '{entry.ModId}' joined an existing game (no data in the save)");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SAVE",$"OnJoinedExistingGame failed for mod '{entry.ModId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Utility that recursively collects all <c>.tscn</c> files under <c>res://scenes</c> and returns them sorted by name. Used by tooling and scene selection UI. </summary>
public static class ModScenes{/// <summary> Returns all .tscn files under res://scenes as (Name, Path) tuples, sorted alphabetically by name. </summary>
public static List<(string Name,string Path)>CollectTscnFiles(){var result=new List<(string,string)>();Scan("res://scenes",result);result.Sort((a,b)=>string.Compare(a.Item1,b.Item1,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));return result;}private static void Scan(string dir,List<(string,string)>result){using var d=DirAccess.Open(dir);if(d==null)return;d.ListDirBegin();var name=d.GetNext();while(name!=""){if(d.CurrentIsDir()&&name!="."&&name!="..")Scan(dir.PathJoin(name),result);else if(name.EndsWith(".tscn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))result.Add((name,dir.PathJoin(name)));name=d.GetNext();}d.ListDirEnd();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Declares a single setting that a mod exposes in the settings UI. <c>Key</c> is the unique identifier used to read/write values in <see cref="DataBlob"/>; <c>Name</c> is a localisation key (resolved via <c>TranslationServer.Translate</c>) shown as the label. <c>Type</c> determines which Godot control is spawned in the UI: <list type="bullet"> <item><b>Bool</b> → <c>CheckButton</c></item> <item><b>Integer</b> → <c>SpinBox</c> (no decimals)</item> <item><b>Float</b> → <c>SpinBox</c> (with decimals)</item> <item><b>String</b> → <c>LineEdit</c></item> <item><b>Enum</b> → <c>OptionButton</c> (populated from <c>Options</c>)</item> <item><b>Slider</b> → <c>HSlider</c> + value label (bound by <c>Min</c>/<c>Max</c>/<c>Step</c>)</item> </list> <c>DefaultValue</c> is a string representation of the initial value, used as a fallback when no persisted value exists and for the Reset button. </summary>

public string Key{get;set;}/// <summary> Localisation key shown as the label next to the control. The mod must provide the translation via its <c>locale/</c> files. </summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Widget type spawned in the UI for this setting.</summary>
public SettingType Type{get;set;}/// <summary> String representation of the default value. Used when no persisted value exists and when the user presses Reset. Interpreted by the UI according to <c>Type</c>. </summary>
public string DefaultValue{get;set;}/// <summary> Applicable only when <c>Type == SettingType.Enum</c>. Maps internal values (e.g. "fast") to localisation keys for display (e.g. "mod_ff/atb_fast"). </summary>
public Dictionary<string,string>Options{get;set;}/// <summary>Applicable only when <c>Type == SettingType.Slider</c>.</summary>
public float Min{get;set;}/// <summary>Applicable only when <c>Type == SettingType.Slider</c>.</summary>
public float Max{get;set;}/// <summary>Applicable only when <c>Type == SettingType.Slider</c>.</summary>
public float Step{get;set;}/// <summary> <c>SettingType.Action</c> only: button caption (locale key). The action runs through <see cref="IModSettingsActions.RunAction"/>. </summary>
public string ActionText{get;set;}/// <summary><c>SettingType.Action</c> only: confirmation question (locale key); null runs immediately.</summary>
public string ConfirmText{get;set;}}/// <summary> Widget type for a mod setting. Determines which Godot control is spawned and how the value is read/written. </summary>
public enum SettingType{Bool,Integer,Float,String,Enum,Slider,/// <summary>A button that runs a mod command (no stored value), e.g. purging data.</summary>
Action}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Text;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Registry of <see cref="IModSettings"/> implementations. When a mod assembly is loaded, types implementing the interface are scanned and instantiated via reflection, mirroring the pattern used by <see cref="ModSaveableRegistry"/>. Persistence: each mod's settings are stored as a JSON-serialised <see cref="DataBlob"/> at <c>user://mod_settings/{modId}.json</c>. The core owns persistence entirely; the mod only defines settings and reads/writes values through the blob API. <b>Thread safety:</b> all I/O is synchronous on the main thread. </summary>
public static class ModSettingsRegistry{private const string SettingsDir="user://mod_settings";private static readonly List<RegisteredModSettings>_entries=new();private class RegisteredModSettings{public IModSettings Instance;public string ModId;}/// <summary> Discovers <see cref="IModSettings"/> implementations in the assembly and registers them under the given modId. </summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){foreach(var instance in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IModSettings>(assembly)){try{_entries.Add(new RegisteredModSettings{Instance=instance,ModId=modId});GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Registered IModSettings '{instance.GetType().FullName}' for mod '{modId}'",LogLevel.Debug);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Failed to create IModSettings '{instance.GetType().FullName}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Removes every settings entry registered for <paramref name="modId"/> from the given assembly — the unload pass of the assembly consumer pipeline. Persisted settings on disk are intentionally kept: a reinstalled mod picks its values back up. </summary>
public static void UnregisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId){_entries.RemoveAll(e=>e.ModId==modId&&e.Instance.GetType().Assembly==assembly);}/// <summary> Returns the mod IDs of all registered mods that implement <see cref="IModSettings"/>, sorted by their display title. </summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<string>GetModsWithSettings(){return _entries.Select(e=>e.ModId).Distinct().OrderBy(id=>GetDisplayTitle(id)).ToList();}/// <summary> Returns the human-readable display title for a mod, falling back to the mod ID if the mod is not found. </summary>
public static string GetDisplayTitle(string modId){var mod=ModRegistry.Instance.GetMod(modId);return mod?.DisplayTitle??modId;}/// <summary> Returns setting descriptors for the given mod. Returns an empty list if the mod has no settings registered. </summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<ModSettingDefinition>GetDefinitions(string modId){var entry=_entries.Find(e=>e.ModId==modId);if(entry==null)return Array.Empty<ModSettingDefinition>();try{return entry.Instance.GetDefinitions()??Array.Empty<ModSettingDefinition>();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"GetDefinitions failed for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return Array.Empty<ModSettingDefinition>();}}/// <summary> Runs a <see cref="SettingType.Action"/> setting of the mod and returns the message to show (already translated by the mod or a locale key), or null when the mod has no such action. </summary>
public static string RunAction(string modId,string key){var entry=_entries.Find(e=>e.ModId==modId&&e.Instance is IModSettingsActions);if(entry==null)return null;try{return((IModSettingsActions)entry.Instance).RunAction(key);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Action '{key}' failed for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return ex.Message;}}/// <summary> Reads the mod's current values into a <see cref="DataBlob"/>. Returns an empty blob on failure. </summary>
public static DataBlob WriteCurrentValues(string modId){var entry=_entries.Find(e=>e.ModId==modId);if(entry==null)return new DataBlob();try{var blob=new DataBlob();entry.Instance.WriteValues(blob);return blob;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"WriteValues failed for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return new DataBlob();}}/// <summary> Applies values from a <see cref="DataBlob"/> to the mod. </summary>
public static void ApplyValues(string modId,DataBlob blob){var entry=_entries.Find(e=>e.ModId==modId);if(entry==null||blob==null)return;try{entry.Instance.ReadValues(blob);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"ReadValues failed for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Loads persisted settings for a single mod from disk. Returns a <see cref="DataBlob"/> with the saved values, or an empty blob if no file exists. </summary>
public static DataBlob LoadModSettings(string modId){var path=GetSettingsPath(modId);if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){if(!Godot.FileAccess.FileExists(path))return new DataBlob();}else{if(!File.Exists(path))return new DataBlob();}try{string json;if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){using var file=Godot.FileAccess.Open(path,Godot.FileAccess.ModeFlags.Read);json=file.GetAsText();}else{json=File.ReadAllText(path);}if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))return new DataBlob();var payload=Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);return new DataBlob(payload);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Failed to load settings for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return new DataBlob();}}/// <summary> Persists a <see cref="DataBlob"/> to disk for a single mod. </summary>
public static void SaveModSettings(string modId,DataBlob blob){if(blob==null)return;EnsureDirectoryExists();var path=GetSettingsPath(modId);try{var json=Encoding.UTF8.GetString(blob.GetBytes());if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){using var file=Godot.FileAccess.Open(path,Godot.FileAccess.ModeFlags.Write);file.StoreString(json);}else{File.WriteAllText(path,json);}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Failed to save settings for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Deletes persisted settings for a single mod (used by the Reset button). After deletion the mod keeps its current in-memory values — the user must reopen settings to see defaults. </summary>
public static void DeleteModSettings(string modId){var path=GetSettingsPath(modId);try{if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){if(Godot.FileAccess.FileExists(path))DirAccess.RemoveAbsolute(ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(path));}else{if(File.Exists(path))File.Delete(path);}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Failed to delete settings for mod '{modId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Loads persisted settings for every registered mod and applies them via <see cref="IModSettings.ReadValues"/>. Called once at boot, after all mods have been loaded. </summary>
public static void LoadAll(){if(_entries.Count==0)return;EnsureDirectoryExists();foreach(var entry in _entries){var blob=LoadModSettings(entry.ModId);if(blob.GetBytes().Length==0)continue;try{entry.Instance.ReadValues(blob);GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"Loaded settings for mod '{entry.ModId}'");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_SETTINGS",$"ReadValues failed during LoadAll for mod '{entry.ModId}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}private static string GetSettingsPath(string modId){var safe=new string(modId.Where(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-').ToArray());var fileName=$"{safe}.json";if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return Path.Combine(SettingsDir,fileName);return Path.Combine("mod_settings",fileName);}private static void EnsureDirectoryExists(){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){var abs=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(SettingsDir);if(!Directory.Exists(abs))Directory.CreateDirectory(abs);}else{if(!Directory.Exists("mod_settings"))Directory.CreateDirectory("mod_settings");}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Mounts the integration test suites of discovered mods (<see cref="ModManifest.TestSuites"/>). A suite is a folder inside its host (<c>test_suites/&lt;id&gt;/</c>) with an ordinary <c>manifest.json</c> (sources, gd_sources, ui, depends, …) and content laid out like a mod. When active it becomes the virtual mod <c>&lt;host&gt;__&lt;id&gt;</c> that implicitly depends on its host, so compilation, load order, resource loaders and the atlases treat it like any mod — one that sits above its host and may depend on mods the host itself must not (a test-only <c>depends</c>, without cycles). <para/> Gate: a suite is mounted only when a user arg starts with one of its <c>activate</c> prefixes, or with <see cref="AllFlag"/> (atlases). Without that the suite folder is inert data of the host: a normal launch, a game and <c>--all-mods</c> never load it. </summary>
public static class ModTestSuites{/// <summary>Default parent folder of suites inside the host mod.</summary>
public const string FolderName="test_suites";/// <summary>Mounts every suite (used by the resource and locale atlases).</summary>
public const string AllFlag="--with-test-suites";private const string Separator="__";private static readonly List<string>activeIds=new();/// <summary>Virtual mod ids mounted by the last <see cref="Mount"/>; added to a game/front-end set like <c>--with-mods</c>.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<string>ActiveIds=>activeIds;/// <summary>Virtual mod id of a suite: <c>&lt;host&gt;__&lt;suite&gt;</c>.</summary>
public static string ModIdOf(string hostId,string suiteId)=>hostId+Separator+suiteId;/// <summary>True when <paramref name="userArgs"/> mount the suite. Pure.</summary>
public static bool IsActive(ModTestSuite suite,IEnumerable<string>userArgs){if(suite==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(suite.Id))return false;var args=userArgs as ICollection<string> ??(userArgs??Array.Empty<string>()).ToList();if(args.Contains(AllFlag))return true;return(suite.Activate??new List<string>()).Where(p=> !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)).Any(prefix=>args.Any(a=>a.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal)));}/// <summary> Adds the active suites of <paramref name="mods"/> as virtual mods. Runs once per boot right after discovery, before the set filters. </summary>
public static void Mount(IDictionary<string,IModInfo>mods,IReadOnlyCollection<string>userArgs){activeIds.Clear();foreach(var host in mods.Values.OfType<ModInfo>().ToList()){foreach(var suite in host.Manifest?.TestSuites??new List<ModTestSuite>()){if(!IsActive(suite,userArgs))continue;var info=CreateSuiteMod(host,suite);if(info==null)continue;if(mods.ContainsKey(info.Id)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Test suite '{info.Id}' clashes with an installed mod id; skipped",LogLevel.Error);info.FileProvider.Dispose();continue;}mods[info.Id]=info;activeIds.Add(info.Id);GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Test suite '{info.Id}' mounted from '{host.Id}/{suite.Folder}'");}}}/// <summary> Builds the virtual mod of one suite, or null when its folder or manifest is missing. Pure apart from reading the host's files. </summary>
