using System;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Deletes an installed mod and cleans up every piece of per-mod state that would otherwise outlive it. Deletion is intentionally conservative: only mods whose files live in a writable mods root (the player's <c>user://mods</c> in runtime, the project <c>mods/</c> folder in the editor) can be removed — shipped <c>res://mods</c> content is never touched. <para/> Running mods are not unloaded: like enable/disable and install, deletion takes full effect after a restart. The caller is expected to be a pre-game UI (the mod manager) where no gameplay code reads the deleted mod's files. The provider is disposed before the delete so zip-backed mods release their file handle on Windows. </summary>
public static class ModUninstaller{/// <summary> True when the mod is known, lives under a writable mods root and can therefore be deleted by <see cref="Uninstall"/>. </summary>
public static bool CanUninstall(string modId)=>CanUninstall(ModRegistry.Instance.GetMod(modId));/// <summary>Provider overload used by tests and callers that already resolved the mod.</summary>
public static bool CanUninstall(IModInfo modInfo){var rootPath=modInfo?.FileProvider?.RootPath;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath))return false;return IsWritableModsRoot(GetParentPath(rootPath));}/// <summary> Removes the mod's files and all persisted per-mod state. Returns false (with a logged reason) when the mod is unknown, not deletable, or the filesystem refuses the delete. </summary>
public static bool Uninstall(string modId){var modInfo=ModRegistry.Instance.GetMod(modId);if(modInfo==null){GameLogger.Log("UNINSTALLER",$"Uninstall('{modId}'): mod not found",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(!CanUninstall(modInfo)){GameLogger.Log("UNINSTALLER",$"Uninstall('{modId}'): mod is not in a writable mods root",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}var rootPath=modInfo.FileProvider.RootPath;modInfo.FileProvider.Dispose();if(!DeleteModFiles(rootPath)){GameLogger.Log("UNINSTALLER",$"Uninstall('{modId}'): failed to delete '{rootPath}'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}DisabledModsStore.Remove(modId);ModLoadOrderStore.Remove(modId);ModSettingsRegistry.DeleteModSettings(modId);ModCompiler.InvalidateCache(modId);// Best-effort collectible unload: if no scene/UI objects hold the mod's types (the mod-manager UI is a pre-game context), the assemblies are released right here; otherwise the restart note below stays the honest statement.
var unloadDiagnostic=ModAssemblyLoader.UnloadMod(modId);var unloadNote=unloadDiagnostic==null?"assemblies released":$"restart required ({unloadDiagnostic})";GameLogger.Log("UNINSTALLER",$"Uninstalled mod '{modId}' from '{rootPath}'; {unloadNote}");return true;}/// <summary> Deletes a mod's directory or zip archive located at <paramref name="rootPath"/>. Exposed separately so the raw filesystem operation can be tested without a live registry. </summary>
public static bool DeleteModFiles(string rootPath){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rootPath))return false;try{if(Directory.Exists(rootPath)){Directory.Delete(rootPath,recursive:true);return true;}if(File.Exists(rootPath)){File.Delete(rootPath);return true;}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("UNINSTALLER",$"DeleteModFiles('{rootPath}') failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return false;}return false;}private static bool IsWritableModsRoot(string rootPath){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath))return false;var normalized=NormalizePath(rootPath);foreach(var root in ModRegistry.AllModsRoots){if(!string.Equals(NormalizePath(root.Path),normalized,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime&&root.Priority>0)return false;return true;}return false;}private static string GetParentPath(string path){var trimmed=path.TrimEnd('/','\\');var parent=Path.GetDirectoryName(trimmed);return string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent)?trimmed:parent;}private static string NormalizePath(string path){var slashed=(path??string.Empty).Replace('\\','/').TrimEnd('/');try{return Path.GetFullPath(slashed).Replace('\\','/').TrimEnd('/');}catch(Exception){return slashed;}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Patches{/// <summary> Internal helper for JSON array merge operations. internal static class ArrayMergeHelper{internal enum ArrayOperation{Default,Set,Add,Remove}internal static void ParseArrayOperation(string key,out string baseKey,out ArrayOperation op){if(key.Length>4&&key.EndsWith("$set",StringComparison.Ordinal)){baseKey=key.Substring(0,key.Length-4);op=ArrayOperation.Set;}else if(key.Length>4&&key.EndsWith("$add",StringComparison.Ordinal)){baseKey=key.Substring(0,key.Length-4);op=ArrayOperation.Add;}else if(key.Length>7&&key.EndsWith("$remove",StringComparison.Ordinal)){baseKey=key.Substring(0,key.Length-7);op=ArrayOperation.Remove;}else{baseKey=key;op=ArrayOperation.Default;}}/// <summary> Merges <paramref name="existingRaw"/> and <paramref name="incomingRaw"/> into a single JSON array string. If <paramref name="identityKey"/> is provided and both arrays contain objects, elements are matched by that key and merged per-field. Otherwise simple concatenation is used. Returns <paramref name="incomingRaw"/> when there is no existing value or it is not a JSON array. </summary>

If <paramref name="identityKey"/> is provided, elements in object arrays are matched by that key's value; otherwise raw text comparison is used. Returns <paramref name="existingRaw"/> unchanged when there is no existing value or it is not a JSON array. </summary>
internal static string RemoveFromArray(string existingRaw,string removeRaw,string identityKey){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(existingRaw)|| !existingRaw.StartsWith("[",StringComparison.Ordinal))return existingRaw;try{return identityKey!=null?RemoveFromObjectArray(existingRaw,removeRaw,identityKey):RemoveFromSimpleArray(existingRaw,removeRaw);}catch(JsonException ex){Core.Utils.GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"RemoveFromArray: failed to process: {ex.Message}",Core.Utils.LogLevel.Warning);return existingRaw;}}internal static string MergeJsonArrays(string existingRaw,string incomingRaw){var items=new List<string>();using(var docA=JsonDocument.Parse(existingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions)){foreach(var el in docA.RootElement.EnumerateArray())items.Add(el.GetRawText());}using(var docB=JsonDocument.Parse(incomingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions)){foreach(var el in docB.RootElement.EnumerateArray())items.Add(el.GetRawText());}return"["+string.Join(",",items)+"]";}private static string MergeObjectArrays(string existingRaw,string incomingRaw,string identityKey){var elements=new List<JsonElement>();using(var docA=JsonDocument.Parse(existingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions))foreach(var el in docA.RootElement.EnumerateArray())elements.Add(el.Clone());using var docB=JsonDocument.Parse(incomingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);foreach(var incoming in docB.RootElement.EnumerateArray()){if(incoming.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object|| !incoming.TryGetProperty(identityKey,out var incomingKey)){elements.Add(incoming.Clone());continue;}var incomingKeyRaw=incomingKey.GetRawText();var found=false;for(var i=0;i<elements.Count;i++){if(elements[i].ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object|| !elements[i].TryGetProperty(identityKey,out var existingKey))continue;if(existingKey.GetRawText()!=incomingKeyRaw)continue;elements[i]=MergeObjectFields(elements[i],incoming);found=true;break;}if(!found)elements.Add(incoming.Clone());}var parts=new List<string>();foreach(var el in elements)parts.Add(el.GetRawText());return"["+string.Join(",",parts)+"]";}private static JsonElement MergeObjectFields(JsonElement baseElement,JsonElement overlay){using var stream=new MemoryStream();using(var writer=new Utf8JsonWriter(stream)){writer.WriteStartObject();var written=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var prop in overlay.EnumerateObject()){writer.WritePropertyName(prop.Name);prop.Value.WriteTo(writer);written.Add(prop.Name);}foreach(var prop in baseElement.EnumerateObject()){if(!written.Contains(prop.Name)){writer.WritePropertyName(prop.Name);prop.Value.WriteTo(writer);}}writer.WriteEndObject();}var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(stream.ToArray(),JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);return doc.RootElement.Clone();}private static string RemoveFromSimpleArray(string existingRaw,string incomingRaw){using var docExisting=JsonDocument.Parse(existingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);using var docRemove=JsonDocument.Parse(incomingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);var toRemove=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var el in docRemove.RootElement.EnumerateArray())toRemove.Add(el.GetRawText());var remaining=new List<string>();foreach(var el in docExisting.RootElement.EnumerateArray()){if(!toRemove.Contains(el.GetRawText()))remaining.Add(el.GetRawText());}return"["+string.Join(",",remaining)+"]";}private static string RemoveFromObjectArray(string existingRaw,string incomingRaw,string identityKey){using var docExisting=JsonDocument.Parse(existingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);using var docRemove=JsonDocument.Parse(incomingRaw,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);var toRemove=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var el in docRemove.RootElement.EnumerateArray()){if(el.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Object&&el.TryGetProperty(identityKey,out var keyProp))toRemove.Add(keyProp.GetRawText());}var remaining=new List<string>();foreach(var el in docExisting.RootElement.EnumerateArray()){if(el.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Object&&el.TryGetProperty(identityKey,out var namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Patches{/// <summary> Marks a class as supporting identity-key-based array merge. When a patch uses <c>$add</c> or <c>$remove</c> on a registered array property, elements are matched by the value of <see cref="MergeKeyProperty"/> instead of raw JSON text comparison, enabling per-field property overwrite. </summary>
public interface IMergeable{/// <summary> The name of the property used as the identity key for element matching during array merge operations. </summary>
string MergeKeyProperty{get;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Patches{/// <summary> Merges mod patches into a raw entity JSON string before deserialisation. Operates purely at the JSON-text level. <para> <b>Identity-key detection for object arrays:</b> 1. Hardcoded fields: properties whose item type implements <see cref="IMergeable"/> contribute their <c>MergeKeyProperty</c> via <see cref="BuildMergeKeys{T}"/>. 2. Extra-property fields (mod-defined): identity key is detected automatically from the first element of the incoming array: <c>"Id"</c> or the first property ending in <c>"Id"</c>. 3. If nothing matches — raw-text concatenation is used. </para> </summary>
public class JsonPatchMerger{/// <summary> Scans <typeparamref name="T"/> via reflection and returns a map from property name to identity-key for every list-typed property whose item type implements <see cref="IMergeable"/>. </summary>
public static Dictionary<string,string>BuildMergeKeys<T>()where T:class{var keys=new Dictionary<string,string>();foreach(var prop in typeof(T).GetProperties()){var itemType=GetListItemType(prop.PropertyType);if(itemType==null)continue;if(!typeof(IMergeable).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))continue;try{var mergeable=(IMergeable)Activator.CreateInstance(itemType);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mergeable.MergeKeyProperty))keys[prop.Name]=mergeable.MergeKeyProperty;}catch{// type without parameterless ctor — skip
}}return keys;}/// <summary> Applies all relevant patches for <paramref name="entityId"/> into <paramref name="entityJson"/> and returns the merged JSON. </summary> <param name="identityKeys">Optional per-property identity-key map (from <see cref="BuildMergeKeys{T}"/>). public string Merge(string entityJson,string entityId,Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>allPatches,Dictionary<string,string>identityKeys=null){if(allPatches==null||allPatches.Count==0)return entityJson;using var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(entityJson,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);var root=doc.RootElement.Clone();if(allPatches.TryGetValue("*",out var wildcardPatches)){foreach(var patch in wildcardPatches)root=ApplyPatch(root,patch,identityKeys);}if(allPatches.TryGetValue(entityId,out var specificPatches)){foreach(var patch in specificPatches)root=ApplyPatch(root,patch,identityKeys);}return root.GetRawText();}private JsonElement ApplyPatch(JsonElement target,PropertyPatch patch,Dictionary<string,string>identityKeys){if(patch.ExtraProperties==null||patch.ExtraProperties.Count==0)return target;using var stream=new System.IO.MemoryStream();using(var writer=new Utf8JsonWriter(stream)){WritePatchedObject(writer,target,patch.ExtraProperties,identityKeys);}var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(stream.ToArray(),JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);return doc.RootElement.Clone();}private static void WritePatchedObject(Utf8JsonWriter writer,JsonElement source,Dictionary<string,object>patchProps,Dictionary<string,string>identityKeys){writer.WriteStartObject();// Entity JSON is read case-insensitively, so a patch key matches its property in any case; otherwise both spellings were written and the entity's own value, written last, won over the patch.
var patchedKeys=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var patchedValues=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var kvp in patchProps){if(!(kvp.Value is JsonElement incomingValue))continue;ArrayMergeHelper.ParseArrayOperation(kvp.Key,out var baseKey,out var op);if(op==ArrayMergeHelper.ArrayOperation.Default||incomingValue.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Array){writer.WritePropertyName(baseKey);incomingValue.WriteTo(writer);patchedKeys.Add(baseKey);patchedValues.Remove(baseKey);continue;}var identityKey=ResolveIdentityKey(baseKey,incomingValue,source,identityKeys);var existingRaw=patchedValues.TryGetValue(baseKey,out var pv)?pv:TryGetPropertyIgnoreCase(source,baseKey,out var ep)&&ep.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Array?ep.GetRawText():null;var incomingRaw=incomingValue.GetRawText();string result=null;switch(op){case ArrayMergeHelper.ArrayOperation.Add:result=ArrayMergeHelper.AddToArray(existingRaw,incomingRaw,identityKey);break;case ArrayMergeHelper.ArrayOperation.Remove:result=ArrayMergeHelper.RemoveFromArray(existingRaw,incomingRaw,identityKey);break;case ArrayMergeHelper.ArrayOperation.Set:result=incomingRaw;break;}if(result!=null)patchedValues[baseKey]=result;patchedKeys.Add(baseKey);}foreach(var kv in patchedValues)WriteRawJsonProperty(writer,kv.Key,kv.Value);foreach(var prop in source.EnumerateObject()){if(!patchedKeys.Contains(prop.Name)){writer.WritePropertyName(prop.Name);prop.Value.WriteTo(writer);}}writer.WriteEndObject();}/// <summary> Resolves the identity key for a property: first checks <paramref name="identityKeys"/>, then auto-detects from the first element of <paramref name="incomingValue"/>. Returns null if no identity key can be determined. </summary>
private static string ResolveIdentityKey(string propertyName,JsonElement incomingValue,JsonElement source,Dictionary<string,string>identityKeys){if(identityKeys!=null&&identityKeys.TryGetValue(propertyName,out var key))return key;if(incomingValue.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Array)return DetectIdentityKey(incomingValue);if(TryGetPropertyIgnoreCase(source,propertyName,out var existingArr)&&existingArr.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Array)return DetectIdentityKey(existingArr);return null;}/// <summary> Auto-detects the identity key from a JSON array by inspecting the first object element. public static string DetectIdentityKey(JsonElement array){if(array.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Array)return null;foreach(var el in array.EnumerateArray()){if(el.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object)return null;if(el.TryGetProperty("Id",out _))return"Id";foreach(var prop in el.EnumerateObject()){if(prop.Name.EndsWith("Id",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return prop.Name;}return null;}return null;}private static bool TryGetPropertyIgnoreCase(JsonElement source,string name,out JsonElement value){foreach(var prop in source.EnumerateObject()){if(string.Equals(prop.Name,name,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){value=prop.Value;return true;}}value=default;return false;}private static Type GetListItemType(Type propertyType){if(!propertyType.IsGenericType)return null;var genericDef=propertyType.GetGenericTypeDefinition();if(genericDef==typeof(List<>)||genericDef==typeof(IList<>)||genericDef==typeof(IEnumerable<>))return propertyType.GetGenericArguments()[0];return null;}private static void WriteRawJsonProperty(Utf8JsonWriter writer,string name,string rawJson){writer.WritePropertyName(name);using var doc=JsonDocument.Parse(rawJson,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);doc.RootElement.WriteTo(writer);}}}

Phase split follows the thread contract: <see cref="PreparePaths"/> is the only phase allowed to touch the Godot API (it runs on the main thread), <see cref="DiscoverAndCompile"/> is pure .NET for the background thread, and <see cref="FinalizeGodotInit"/> is Godot-bound again. The mod dictionaries themselves stay in <see cref="ModRegistry"/> — they are passed in at construction, so the facade can keep exposing <c>Mods</c>/<c>AllDiscoveredMods</c> and reset them on <c>Reload</c> without any extra plumbing. </summary>

Re-entrant calls from the pipeline itself are exempt: <see cref="pipelineRunning"/> marks them (GetOrderedModIds during FinalizeGodotInit). The window ends at ModsReady: Boot itself consumes mod data (EnsureRuntime, starter inventory seeding) from that phase on, so data becomes consumable there. namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline{using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery;/// <summary> Holds a discovered mod candidate before deduplication: one filesystem entry of a scanner root, already materialised into an <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> with a parsed manifest, but not yet decided against same-id candidates from other roots (the decision — root priority first, then version — happens in <c>ModDiscoveryService.RegisterCandidates</c>). A struct on purpose: candidates are short-lived loop-local values and only the winning candidate's <see cref="Info"/> (with its provider) survives into the registry; the losers' providers are disposed during deduplication so zips and folder handles never leak. </summary>
public struct ModCandidate{/// <summary>Manifest id, or the loader's filesystem-derived fallback id when the manifest omits it.</summary>
public string Id;/// <summary>Runtime model built from the manifest; owns the provider the registry will keep on win.</summary>
public ModInfo Info;/// <summary>Raw filesystem entry name (folder or file name) as reported by the scanner, for log messages.</summary>
public string FilesystemEntryName;/// <summary>Provider handle used to read the manifest; disposed if this candidate loses deduplication.</summary>
public IModFileProvider Provider;/// <summary>Parsed manifest.json; <c>null</c> candidates never reach deduplication.</summary>
public ModManifest Manifest;/// <summary>Dedup priority of the root this candidate was found in (lower wins, mirrors scanner priorities).</summary>
public int RootPriority;}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Discovery;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Discovery mechanics for one scanner root: enumerates entries, finds a matching <see cref="IModLoader"/>, materialises a <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>, reads and parses <c>manifest.json</c>, computes the install hash, then deduplicates same-id mods across roots (root priority first, version second — a mod shipped in <c>user://mods/</c> overrides its game-dir namesake). Deliberately pure .NET (file I/O through the provider, Roslyn-free, no Godot API) so it runs on the background thread during launcher boot; the roots themselves must have been resolved on the main thread beforehand (<c>ModBootPipeline.PreparePaths</c>). The target dictionaries are owned by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> and passed in per call: the service is stateless, so a reload simply clears the registry's dictionaries without any extra reset plumbing here. </summary>
public static class ModDiscoveryService{/// <summary> Scans a single root already resolved by <c>ModBootPipeline.PreparePaths</c> and registers every viable candidate into <paramref name="mods"/>. Individual unreadable entries are logged and skipped; only a failing scanner enumeration aborts the whole root (with an error log), keeping one broken entry from hiding all other mods. </summary> <param name="mods">Registry dictionary to fill (enabled mod set).</param> <param name="existingPriorities">Root priority per already-registered mod id; drives the priority half of deduplication.</param> <param name="scanner">Scanner that owns the root.</param> <param name="modsRoot">Root URL to enumerate.</param> <param name="rootPriority">Dedup priority of the root.</param> <param name="cancellationToken">Cooperative cancellation between entries.</param>
public static void DiscoverMods(Dictionary<string,IModInfo>mods,Dictionary<string,int>existingPriorities,IModScanner scanner,string modsRoot,int rootPriority,CancellationToken cancellationToken){var candidates=new List<ModCandidate>();try{foreach(var entry in scanner.Discover(modsRoot)){cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(entry.EntryName==".gdignore"||entry.EntryName==".gitkeep")continue;var loader=ModDiscoveryRegistry.FindLoader(entry.Url);if(loader==null)continue;var candidate=TryLoadModFromLoader(loader,entry.Url,entry.EntryName);if(candidate.HasValue){var c=candidate.Value;c.RootPriority=rootPriority;candidates.Add(c);}}}catch(OperationCanceledException)when(cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested){throw;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Failed to scan directory '{modsRoot}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}RegisterCandidates(mods,existingPriorities,candidates);}/// <summary> Deduplicates candidates against what is already registered. Two axes, checked in this order: a strictly higher root priority always wins (regardless of version); equal priority falls back to version comparison — only a strictly newer version replaces. Every losing candidate's provider (and, on replacement, the displaced mod's provider) is disposed, so no zip handle or directory watcher leaks. First candidate seen for an id simply registers and records its root priority for later comparisons. </summary>
private static void RegisterCandidates(Dictionary<string,IModInfo>mods,Dictionary<string,int>existingPriorities,List<ModCandidate>candidates){foreach(var candidate in candidates){if(mods.TryGetValue(candidate.Id,out var existing)){var existingInfo=(ModInfo)existing;if(candidate.RootPriority<existingPriorities.GetValueOrDefault(candidate.Id,int.MaxValue)){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Mod '{candidate.Id}' ({candidate.FilesystemEntryName}) v{candidate.Info.Version} "+$"replaces v{existingInfo.Version} from '{existingInfo.Id}' (higher-priority source)",LogLevel.Warning);existingInfo.FileProvider.Dispose();mods[candidate.Id]=candidate.Info;existingPriorities[candidate.Id]=candidate.RootPriority;}else if(candidate.RootPriority==existingPriorities.GetValueOrDefault(candidate.Id,int.MaxValue)){var cmp=VersionHelper.Compare(candidate.Info.Version??"0.0.0.0",existingInfo.Version??"0.0.0.0");if(cmp>0){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Mod '{candidate.Id}' ({candidate.FilesystemEntryName}) v{candidate.Info.Version} "+$"replaces older v{existingInfo.Version} from '{existingInfo.Id}'",LogLevel.Warning);existingInfo.FileProvider.Dispose();mods[candidate.Id]=candidate.Info;}else{var reason=cmp==0?$"same version {candidate.Info.Version}":$"older version {candidate.Info.Version} (already have {existingInfo.Version})";GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Skipping mod '{candidate.Id}' ({candidate.FilesystemEntryName}): {reason}",LogLevel.Warning);candidate.Provider.Dispose();}}else{GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Skipping mod '{candidate.Id}' ({candidate.FilesystemEntryName}): lower-priority source",LogLevel.Warning);candidate.Provider.Dispose();}}else{mods[candidate.Id]=candidate.Info;existingPriorities[candidate.Id]=candidate.RootPriority;}}}/// <summary> Loads one entry through its loader: creates the provider, reads the manifest, builds the <see cref="ModInfo"/> and defers its install SHA256 to the first read. Returns <c>null</c> for entries without a manifest or on any loader/manifest exception; the provider is disposed on those paths so a skipped entry never leaks its handle. </summary>
private static ModCandidate?TryLoadModFromLoader(IModLoader loader,string url,string entryName){try{var fileProvider=loader.CreateProvider(url,entryName);var manifest=ReadManifest(fileProvider);if(manifest==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Skipping '{entryName}': no manifest found",LogLevel.Error);fileProvider.Dispose();return null;}var id= !string.IsNullOrEmpty(manifest.Id)?manifest.Id:loader.GetFallbackModId(url,entryName);var info=new ModInfo{Id=id,Name=manifest.Name,Author=manifest.Author,Description=manifest.Description,FileProvider=fileProvider,Manifest=manifest,};info.DeferInstallSha256(()=>ComputeInstallSha256(fileProvider,id));return new ModCandidate{Id=id,Info=info,FilesystemEntryName=entryName,Provider=fileProvider,Manifest=manifest,};}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Failed to load mod '{entryName}' via {loader.Name}: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}/// <summary>The install hash of a discovered mod; a hashing failure only logs, the mod stays loadable.</summary>
private static string ComputeInstallSha256(IModFileProvider provider,string id){try{return InstallHashCache.Get(provider,ModConfig.Instance.CatalogIgnorePatterns);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Failed to compute install SHA256 for mod '{id}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}}/// <summary> Reads and deserialises <c>manifest.json</c> through the provider. Returns <c>null</c> when the file is absent, empty, or invalid JSON (parse failure is logged with the provider-agnostic message — the entry name is not known here), which makes the whole entry skipped by <see cref="TryLoadModFromLoader"/>. </summary>
private static ModManifest ReadManifest(IModFileProvider provider){if(!provider.FileExists("manifest.json"))return null;var json=provider.ReadFileText("manifest.json");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))return null;try{return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ModManifest>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Failed to parse manifest.json: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}return null;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Computes and caches the mod load order: a topological sort over manifest dependencies, refined by the user's saved manual order (<c>ModLoadOrderStore</c>) with an alphabetical fallback for determinism. One instance per <see cref="ModRegistry"/>; the mod dictionaries are shared by reference with the registry, so freshly discovered or reloaded mods are visible on the next computation. </summary>
public class ModLoadOrderService{private readonly ModRegistry registry;private readonly ModBootPipeline pipeline;private readonly Dictionary<string,IModInfo>mods;private readonly Dictionary<string,IModInfo>allDiscoveredMods;/// <summary>Cached order for the enabled (filtered) set; <c>null</c> when stale.</summary>
private List<string>orderedModIds;/// <summary> Creates the service for one <see cref="ModRegistry"/>. public void InvalidateOrder(){orderedModIds=null;}/// <summary> Returns mod IDs ordered by <c>depends</c> (topological sort), then by user-defined manual order, with alphabetical fallback for determinism. Dependencies always precede their dependents — manual ordering only applies between unrelated mods. When <paramref name="filterDisabled"/> is <c>true</c> (default), the result is cached and persisted, but only once the registry has been finalized: during the launcher boot window a main-thread caller would otherwise freeze an order computed from the half-built mod set for the rest of the session — and overwrite the saved manual order with an empty list. When <paramref name="filterDisabled"/> is <c>false</c>, the order is computed from <see cref="ModRegistry.AllDiscoveredMods"/> every call (no caching) and is NOT persisted to <see cref="ModLoadOrderStore"/> — this variant is intended for the mod configuration UI. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>GetOrderedModIds(bool filterDisabled=true){registry.Initialize();// Initialize above already refused and logged when the launcher boot owns the pipeline. Computing here would return a misleading empty order built from a half-built registry, so refuse as well. The pipeline's own re-entrant call from FinalizeGodotInit is exempt — pipelineRunning marks it, exactly as in Initialize. Ends at ModsReady: the starter-inventory seeding legitimately reads the (now final) mod set during that phase.

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;/// <summary> Decides what an in-process mod-set reload does with each mod that has code. A mod's code identity is the set of files its context runs — the content-addressed compile artifact and precompiled DLL copies — so "did it change" is a plain set comparison, no timestamps involved. <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="Unload"/> — loaded mods that leave the set, changed, were forced, or depend (transitively) on any of those: their context resolves dependency types through the old dependency context, so they must reload with it. Dependents first.</item> <item><see cref="Keep"/> — loaded mods whose code and dependencies are unchanged: the context, its static state and its live nodes survive; the registries are rebuilt, so they re-register.</item> <item><see cref="Load"/> — mods whose code loads into a fresh context (new to the set or reloaded), in dependency order.</item> </list> </summary>
public sealed class ModReloadPlan{private ModReloadPlan(List<string>unload,List<string>keep,List<string>load){Unload=unload;Keep=keep;Load=load;}/// <summary>Mods whose contexts are released, in unload order (reverse load order).</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Unload{get;}/// <summary>Loaded mods that stay, in target order.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Keep{get;}/// <summary>Mods that load into a new context, in target order.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Load{get;}/// <summary> Computes the plan. </summary> <param name="loadedOrder">Mods with a live context, in the order they loaded.</param> <param name="loadedArtifacts">Files each loaded mod's context runs.</param> <param name="targetOrder">Mods with code in the new set, in dependency order.</param> <param name="targetArtifacts">Files each target mod compiled/staged to now.</param> <param name="dependencies">Direct <c>depends</c> of the target mods.</param> <param name="forceReload">Mods to reload even when unchanged; <c>*</c> forces every loaded mod.</param>
public static ModReloadPlan Compute(IReadOnlyList<string>loadedOrder,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyCollection<string>>loadedArtifacts,IReadOnlyList<string>targetOrder,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyCollection<string>>targetArtifacts,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyCollection<string>>dependencies,IReadOnlyCollection<string>forceReload){var comparer=StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase;var loaded=(loadedOrder??Array.Empty<string>()).Distinct(comparer).ToList();var target=(targetOrder??Array.Empty<string>()).Distinct(comparer).ToList();var targetSet=new HashSet<string>(target,comparer);var force=new HashSet<string>(forceReload??Array.Empty<string>(),comparer);var forceAll=force.Contains("*");var leaving=new HashSet<string>(comparer);foreach(var id in loaded){if(!targetSet.Contains(id)||forceAll||force.Contains(id)|| !SameFiles(Lookup(loadedArtifacts,id),Lookup(targetArtifacts,id)))leaving.Add(id);}// Cascade to dependents until nothing changes: a kept mod must not keep resolving into a released dependency context.
bool grew;do{grew=false;foreach(var id in loaded){if(leaving.Contains(id))continue;if(Lookup(dependencies,id).Any(leaving.Contains)){leaving.Add(id);grew=true;}}}while(grew);var loadedSet=new HashSet<string>(loaded,comparer);var unload=loaded.Where(leaving.Contains).Reverse().ToList();var keep=new List<string>();var load=new List<string>();foreach(var id in target){if(loadedSet.Contains(id)&& !leaving.Contains(id))keep.Add(id);else load.Add(id);}return new ModReloadPlan(unload,keep,load);}private static IReadOnlyCollection<string>Lookup(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,IReadOnlyCollection<string>>map,string id){if(map==null)return Array.Empty<string>();if(map.TryGetValue(id,out var value)&&value!=null)return value;foreach(var pair in map){if(string.Equals(pair.Key,id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return pair.Value??Array.Empty<string>();}return Array.Empty<string>();}private static bool SameFiles(IReadOnlyCollection<string>a,IReadOnlyCollection<string>b){var left=new HashSet<string>(a.Select(NormalizePath),StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return left.SetEquals(b.Select(NormalizePath));}private static string NormalizePath(string path)=>(path??string.Empty).Replace('\\','/');}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Pipeline{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Pure set-filters over the discovered mod dictionary, run once by <c>ModBootPipeline.DiscoverAndCompile</c> after all roots are scanned: <see cref="FilterDisabledMods"/> removes user-disabled mods and transitively their dependents; <see cref="ValidateDependencies"/> removes mods whose declared dependencies are malformed, missing, or version-mismatched. Both record a human-readable reason on every removed mod's <c>ModInfo.LoadFailureReasons</c> (appended, never overwritten — the mod manager UI shows the full list) and keep the whole mod visible in <c>AllDiscoveredMods</c>, so filtering only affects the loadable set, never the discovery record. Stateless by design: the dictionary is passed in, reasons are stamped on the <see cref="ModInfo"/> objects themselves, and translation goes through <see cref="Tr"/> so the phase stays safe on a background thread during launcher boot. </summary>
public static class ModSetFilter{/// <summary> Removes disabled mods from <paramref name="mods"/> and then, in a fixpoint loop, every mod that (transitively) depends on a removed one — an optional dependency on a disabled mod does NOT disable the dependent. The loop is needed because dependents may appear before their dependencies in dictionary order; it repeats until no new mod is marked, so chains of arbitrary depth collapse. </summary>
public static void FilterDisabledMods(IDictionary<string,IModInfo>mods){var disabled=DisabledModsStore.Load();if(disabled.Count==0)return;var toRemove=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var id in mods.Keys){if(disabled.Contains(id)){toRemove.Add(id);var info=(ModInfo)mods[id];info.LoadFailureReasons.Add(string.Format(Tr("mods/disabled_reason"),id));}}bool changed;do{changed=false;foreach(var kvp in mods){if(toRemove.Contains(kvp.Key))continue;// A disabled optional dependency is simply absent: the mod still loads without it.
var depIds=((ModInfo)kvp.Value).Manifest?.RequiredDependencyIds;if(depIds==null||depIds.Count==0)continue;foreach(var depId in depIds){if(toRemove.Contains(depId)){toRemove.Add(kvp.Key);var info=(ModInfo)kvp.Value;info.LoadFailureReasons.Add(string.Format(Tr("mods/dep_disabled_reason"),depId));GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Mod '{kvp.Key}' disabled because dependency '{depId}' is disabled",LogLevel.Warning);changed=true;break;}}}}while(changed);foreach(var id in toRemove){mods.Remove(id);GameLogger.Log("MODS_REGISTRY",$"Mod '{id}' filtered out (disabled)",LogLevel.Message);}}/// <summary> Validates every remaining mod's <c>depends</c> entries and removes mods whose dependencies cannot be satisfied: a malformed dependency spec, a missing required mod (optional dependencies are skipped), or a loaded version failing the declared constraint. First failing dependency per mod wins (loop breaks); the reason carries both the requirement and the actually loaded version. using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> One JSON property patch targeting an existing entity: the <c>ID</c> names the entity and every entry of <c>ExtraProperties</c> overrides or extends one property. Array-valued properties are concatenated across patches instead of overwritten, so several mods can extend the same list (e.g. extra skills). </summary>
public class PropertyPatch:IIdentifiable{/// <summary>ID of the entity this patch modifies.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("Id")]public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary>Property overrides keyed by property name; arrays concatenate, scalars replace.</summary>
[JsonExtensionData]public Dictionary<string,object>ExtraProperties{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers{/// <summary> Mod file provider backed by a real directory on disk. All paths are relative to the mod root and use the canonical form defined by <see cref="ModPath"/> (forward slashes, no root or <c>..</c> escape); conversion to the OS-native separator happens only at the <see cref="System.IO.Path"/> boundary. Trailing <c>/</c> in <see cref="ListFiles"/> output distinguishes directories from files so that recursive scanners can branch without stat-calling every entry. <see cref="GetFileSystemPath"/> returns the absolute path — the critical capability that enables Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> and <c>PackedScene</c> instantiation from folder mods. Zip providers return <c>null</c> here, making this the only provider type that supports scene-based assets. <see cref="Dispose"/> is a no-op because directories don't need cleanup. Lookups follow <see cref="ModPathCase"/>: a path must match the on-disk spelling exactly on every OS, so a wrong-case reference fails on the author's Windows machine the same way it fails on Linux and in zip mods. Verified spellings are cached to keep repeated lookups cheap; entries returned by <see cref="ListFiles"/> come straight from the directory, so they count as verified (a scan that lists and then reads does not walk the path again — on slow file systems that walk dominated boot). </summary>
public class FolderModFileProvider:IModFileProvider{/// <inheritdoc />
public string Mod{get;}/// <inheritdoc />
public string RootPath{get;}private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,byte>verifiedFiles=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,byte>verifiedDirs=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);/// <summary> Creates a provider rooted at the given directory. <paramref name="modName"/> becomes the <see cref="Mod"/> value used in log messages and lookup keys. </summary> <param name="rootPath">Absolute or relative path to the mod root directory on disk.</param> <param name="modName">Short identifier for this mod.</param>
public FolderModFileProvider(string rootPath,string modName){this.RootPath=rootPath;this.Mod=modName;}/// <summary> No-op: directories do not hold native handles and need no explicit cleanup. </summary>
public void Dispose(){}/// <summary> Checks whether a file exists at the given mod-relative path with exactly this spelling (see <see cref="ModPathCase"/>). </summary>
public bool FileExists(string path){return ResolveFile(path)!=null;}/// <summary> Returns a shallow listing of the given directory inside the mod. Directories are suffixed with <c>/</c> so that recursive callers can distinguish them from files without additional stat calls. </summary> <param name="directory">Mod-relative directory path. Empty string for the mod root.</param>
public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory=""){var relativeDir=ModPath.Normalize(directory);var dir=Path.Combine(RootPath,relativeDir);if(!verifiedDirs.ContainsKey(relativeDir)){var actualDir=ModPathCase.FindOnDisk(RootPath,relativeDir,directory:true);if(actualDir==null)yield break;if(!string.Equals(actualDir,relativeDir,StringComparison.Ordinal)){ModPathCase.ReportMismatch(Mod,relativeDir,actualDir);yield break;}verifiedDirs.TryAdd(relativeDir,0);}else if(!Directory.Exists(dir))yield break;foreach(var entry in new DirectoryInfo(dir).EnumerateFileSystemInfos()){if(ModContentFiles.IsHidden(entry.Name))continue;var relative=ModPath.Normalize(Path.GetRelativePath(RootPath,entry.FullName));if(entry is DirectoryInfo){verifiedDirs.TryAdd(relative,0);relative+="/";}else verifiedFiles.TryAdd(relative,0);yield return relative;}}/// <summary> Reads the full contents of a text file at the given mod-relative path as a UTF-8 string. Returns <c>null</c> if the file does not exist. </summary>
public string ReadFileText(string path){var fullPath=ResolveFile(path);return fullPath!=null?File.ReadAllText(fullPath):null;}/// <summary> Reads the full binary content of a file inside the mod. Returns <c>null</c> if the file does not exist. </summary>
public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path){var fullPath=ResolveFile(path);return fullPath!=null?File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath):null;}/// <summary> Opens a read-only <see cref="Stream"/> for the given mod-relative path. Returns <c>null</c> if the file does not exist. The caller is responsible for disposing the stream. </summary>
public Stream OpenStream(string path){var fullPath=ResolveFile(path);return fullPath!=null?File.OpenRead(fullPath):null;}/// <summary> Returns the absolute filesystem path for the given mod-relative path, or <c>null</c> if the file does not exist. This is the only provider type that returns non-null here, which makes folder mods the only mods capable of serving Godot scenes via <c>ResourceLoader</c>. </summary>
public string GetFileSystemPath(string path){var fullPath=ResolveFile(path);return fullPath!=null?Path.GetFullPath(fullPath):null;}/// <summary> Resolves a relative include path (<c>../shared/data.json</c>) against the directory of <paramref name="currentPath"/> to produce a canonical mod-relative path. Delegates to <see cref="ModPath.ResolveRelative"/> so folder and zip mods resolve includes identically. </summary>
public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath){return ModPath.ResolveRelative(includePath,currentPath);}/// <summary> Returns the full path of an existing file whose spelling matches <paramref name="path"/> exactly, or <c>null</c>. A case-only mismatch is reported once and treated as a miss. </summary>
private string ResolveFile(string path){var relative=ModPath.Normalize(path);var fullPath=Path.Combine(RootPath,relative);if(verifiedFiles.ContainsKey(relative))return File.Exists(fullPath)?fullPath:null;var actual=ModPathCase.FindOnDisk(RootPath,relative,directory:false);if(actual==null)return null;if(!string.Equals(actual,relative,StringComparison.Ordinal)){ModPathCase.ReportMismatch(Mod,relative,actual);return null;}verifiedFiles.TryAdd(relative,0);return fullPath;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers{/// <summary> A mod-relative sub-folder of another provider seen as a mod root (test suites of zip mods). Paths are prefixed on the way in and the prefix is stripped from listings; the inner provider stays owned by its mod, so <see cref="Dispose"/> does not dispose it. </summary>
public sealed class SubdirModFileProvider:IModFileProvider{private readonly IModFileProvider inner;private readonly string prefix;public SubdirModFileProvider(IModFileProvider inner,string folder,string modName){this.inner=inner;prefix=ModPath.Normalize(folder).TrimEnd('/')+"/";Mod=modName;}public string Mod{get;}/// <summary>Not disk-backed on its own: a sub-folder of a zip has no root of its own.</summary>
public string RootPath=>null;public bool FileExists(string path)=>inner.FileExists(Full(path));public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory="")=>inner.ListFiles(Full(directory).TrimEnd('/')).Where(e=>e.StartsWith(prefix,System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(e=>e.Substring(prefix.Length));public string ReadFileText(string path)=>inner.ReadFileText(Full(path));public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path)=>inner.ReadFileBinary(Full(path));public Stream OpenStream(string path)=>inner.OpenStream(Full(path));public string GetFileSystemPath(string path)=>inner.GetFileSystemPath(Full(path));public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath)=>ModPath.ResolveRelative(includePath,currentPath);public void Dispose(){}private string Full(string path)=>prefix+ModPath.Normalize(path??string.Empty);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.IO.Compression;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers{/// <summary> Mod file provider backed by a <c>.zip</c> archive. On construction the entire zip entry table is flattened into an exact-case dictionary — this trades startup memory for O(1) lookups on every subsequent file access call, which dominates because factories repeatedly check file existence during cache-population scans. <see cref="ListFiles"/> simulates a shallow directory listing by parsing the flat zip entry list: entries whose relative path contains a <c>/</c> after the prefix become synthetic directory entries (trailing <c>/</c>), while entries at the prefix level become file entries. This preserves the same recursive-walk interface that <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> provides natively. <see cref="GetFileSystemPath"/> always returns <c>null</c> — Godot cannot load resources or scenes directly from within a zip, so callers that need filesystem paths (e.g. <c>EffectFactory</c>, shader loading) must extract files to the cache or skip zip mods entirely. Lookups follow <see cref="ModPathCase"/>: the spelling must match the archive entry exactly, like folder mods on Linux; a case-only mismatch is reported with the correct path and treated as a miss. </summary>
public class ZipModFileProvider:IModFileProvider{private readonly ZipArchive archive;private readonly Dictionary<string,ZipArchiveEntry>entryLookup;private readonly Dictionary<string,string>spellingLookup;/// <inheritdoc />
public string Mod{get;}/// <inheritdoc />
public string RootPath{get;}/// <summary> Opens the zip archive at <paramref name="zipPath"/> and builds an O(1) exact-case lookup dictionary from every entry's full path. The zip remains open until <see cref="Dispose"/> is called — callers must dispose the provider to release the native file handle. </summary> <param name="zipPath">Absolute or relative path to the <c>.zip</c> file.</param> <param name="modName">Short identifier for this mod, used in log messages and as the <see cref="Mod"/> value.</param>
public ZipModFileProvider(string zipPath,string modName){this.RootPath=zipPath;this.Mod=modName;archive=ZipFile.OpenRead(zipPath);entryLookup=new Dictionary<string,ZipArchiveEntry>(StringComparer.Ordinal);spellingLookup=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var e in archive.Entries){var name=ModPath.Normalize(e.FullName);if(name.Length>0){entryLookup[name]=e;spellingLookup[name]=name;}}GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"Opened zip '{Path.GetFileName(zipPath)}': {entryLookup.Count} entries total");foreach(var e in archive.Entries)GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"  entry: '{e.FullName}' length={e.Length}",LogLevel.Debug);}/// <summary> Closes the underlying <see cref="ZipArchive"/> and releases the native file handle. After disposal, all read operations will fail. </summary>
public void Dispose(){archive?.Dispose();}/// <summary> Checks whether the given path exists as a zip entry using the exact-case lookup dictionary built during construction. </summary>
public bool FileExists(string path){return TryGetEntry(ModPath.Normalize(path),out _);}/// <summary> Returns a simulated shallow directory listing by grouping zip entries. Entries at the given directory level become file entries; entries one level deeper become synthetic directory entries suffixed with <c>/</c>. This preserves the same recursive-walk contract that <see cref="FolderModFileProvider"/> provides natively. </summary> <param name="directory">Mod-relative directory path. Empty string for the archive root.</param>
public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory=""){var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory(directory);var seen=new HashSet<string>();var yieldList=new List<string>();foreach(var entry in archive.Entries){var rawName=entry.FullName.Replace('\\','/');var isDir=rawName.EndsWith("/");var fullName=ModPath.Normalize(rawName);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix)||fullName.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal)){var suffix=string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix)?fullName:fullName.Substring(prefix.Length);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(suffix)||ModContentFiles.IsHidden(suffix))continue;var idx=suffix.IndexOf('/');if(idx>=0){var dirPart=prefix+suffix.Substring(0,idx+1);if(seen.Add(dirPart))yieldList.Add(dirPart);}else if(isDir){var dirPart=prefix+suffix+"/";if(seen.Add(dirPart))yieldList.Add(dirPart);}else{var filePath=prefix+suffix;if(seen.Add(filePath))yieldList.Add(filePath);}}}foreach(var item in yieldList)yield return item;}/// <summary> Reads the full text content of a zip entry as a UTF-8 string. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. </summary>
public string ReadFileText(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!TryGetEntry(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ReadFileText('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found ({entry.Length} bytes)");using var reader=new StreamReader(entry.Open());return reader.ReadToEnd();}/// <summary> Reads the full binary content of a zip entry. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. </summary>
public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!TryGetEntry(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ReadFileBinary('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found ({entry.Length} bytes)");using var stream=entry.Open();using var ms=new MemoryStream();stream.CopyTo(ms);return ms.ToArray();}/// <summary> Opens a read-only stream to the zip entry. Returns <c>null</c> if the entry does not exist. The caller is responsible for disposing the stream. </summary>
public Stream OpenStream(string path){var normalized=ModPath.Normalize(path);if(!TryGetEntry(normalized,out var entry))return null;GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"OpenStream('{path}') norm='{normalized}' => found");return entry.Open();}/// <summary> Always returns <c>null</c>. Zip mods cannot provide filesystem paths — Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> requires real filesystem paths, so callers dependent on scene instantiation must use folder mods or extract assets to the cache first. </summary>
public string GetFileSystemPath(string path){return null;}/// <summary> Resolves a relative include path (<c>../shared/data.json</c>) against the directory of <paramref name="currentPath"/> to produce a canonical mod-relative path. Delegates to <see cref="ModPath.ResolveRelative"/> so zip and folder mods resolve includes identically. </summary>
public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath){var result=ModPath.ResolveRelative(includePath,currentPath);GameLogger.Log("MODS_ZIP",$"ResolveIncludePath(include='{includePath}', current='{currentPath}') => '{result}'");return result;}/// <summary> Exact-case entry lookup; a case-only mismatch is reported through <see cref="ModPathCase.ReportMismatch"/> and treated as a miss. </summary>
private bool TryGetEntry(string normalized,out ZipArchiveEntry entry){if(entryLookup.TryGetValue(normalized,out entry))return true;if(spellingLookup.TryGetValue(normalized,out var actual))ModPathCase.ReportMismatch(Mod,normalized,actual);return false;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Contract for a pluggable asset resolver — a subsystem that collects and resolves typed assets from loaded mods. Each resolver has a unique <see cref="Id"/> (e.g. "textures", "shaders") and is initialised with a <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> that provides access to the mod registry and cross-resolver lookup via <see cref="ModResolutionContext.GetResolver{T}"/>. Implementations are auto-discovered by <c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c> and registered in <see cref="ModManager"/>. Mod DLLs can ship custom resolvers that will be picked up automatically when the assembly is loaded. </summary>
public interface IModAssetResolver{/// <summary> Unique identifier for this resolver, used as a key in the resolver dictionary inside <see cref="ModManager"/>. </summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Called once during mod loading to provide the resolver with access to the mod registry, file I/O helpers, and other resolvers. Must be called before <c>Collect</c> or <c>Resolve</c> methods. </summary>
void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context);/// <summary> Clears all cached data collected from mods. Called on mod reload so that the next collection picks up changes from newly loaded or unloaded mods. </summary>
void ClearCache();}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Patches;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Single collector for every JSON-defined entity in the game. Unlike the directory-scoped resolver it replaces, this one recursively walks <b>all</b> files of <b>all</b> mods once, peeks each file's top-level <c>"Kind"</c> (see <see cref="EntityKindPeek"/>), and routes the file to the kind's cache. The kind — not the directory — decides the owner, so the old failure mode where <c>characters/actions.json</c> was parsed as a skill and killed with an enum error cannot happen: a file is only deserialised as the one DTO its kind names. <para/> Collection follows the established override semantics: mods are visited in dependency order, later mods override earlier ones by entity ID, and property patches for the kind (<c>patches/&lt;kind&gt;/</c> and <c>patches/&lt;kind&gt;.json</c>) are merged into each surviving entity. The scan and the parsed per-kind dictionaries are cached until <see cref="ClearCache"/> — one directory walk serves every factory instead of one walk per type. </summary>
public class EntityResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"entities";/// <summary>One data file queued during the scan, remembered with its owning mod for later reading.</summary>
private sealed class EntityFile{public string ModId;public string Path;}private bool _scanned;private readonly Dictionary<string,List<EntityFile>>_filesByKind=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,object>_collected=new();/// <summary> Returns all entities of the DTO <typeparamref name="T"/>. The kind is read from the DTO's <see cref="EntityKindAttribute"/>, files are matched during the shared scan, and each file is deserialised as <see cref="FileData{T}"/>. The resulting dictionary is cached per kind and returned as-is; callers treat entries as immutable. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,T>Collect<T>()where T:class,IIdentifiable{Context.Initialize();var kind=EntityKindRegistry.KindOf<T>();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(kind)){GameLogger.Log("ENTITIES",$"Collect<{typeof(T).Name}>: DTO has no [EntityKind] attribute, cannot resolve its files",LogLevel.Error);return new Dictionary<string,T>();}if(_collected.TryGetValue(kind,out var cached))return(Dictionary<string,T>)cached;EnsureScanned();var result=new Dictionary<string,T>();if(_filesByKind.TryGetValue(kind,out var files)){foreach(var file in files){ReadFile(file,kind,result);}}ApplyPatches(kind,result);GameLogger.Log("MODS",result.Count>0?$"CollectEntities<{typeof(T).Name}>('{kind}') → {result.Count} item(s)":$"CollectEntities<{typeof(T).Name}>('{kind}') — no data found",result.Count>0?LogLevel.Debug:LogLevel.Error);_collected[kind]=result;return result;}private void ReadFile<T>(EntityFile file,string kind,Dictionary<string,T>result)where T:class,IIdentifiable{var provider=Context.GetMod(file.ModId)?.FileProvider;if(provider==null)return;var jsonText=Context.ReadResolvedText(file.ModId,file.Path,provider);if(jsonText==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ReadResolvedText returned null for '{file.ModId}/{file.Path}'",LogLevel.Error);return;}try{var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<T>>(jsonText,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(fileData?.Items==null||fileData.Items.Count==0)return;if(!string.Equals(fileData.Kind,kind,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"'{file.ModId}/{file.Path}' declares kind '{fileData.Kind}' but was routed as '{kind}'",LogLevel.Error);return;}foreach(var item in fileData.Items){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"entity without Id in '{file.ModId}/{file.Path}' (kind={kind})",LogLevel.Error);continue;}if(result.ContainsKey(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"'{item.ID}' ({kind}) from mod '{file.ModId}' overrides previous definition",LogLevel.Warning);AppServices.Current.Conflicts.RecordConflict(kind,item.ID,file.ModId,null,false);}result[item.ID]=item;}}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON parse failed for '{file.ModId}/{file.Path}' (kind={kind}): {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> One-time recursive discovery pass. Every <c>.json</c> file is peeked for its kind; files without one are ignored as non-data, unknown kinds are reported as authoring errors. Paths are sorted inside a mod so override order within one mod is deterministic. </summary>
private void EnsureScanned(){if(_scanned)return;_scanned=true;_filesByKind.Clear();EntityKindRegistry.Refresh();foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.GetMod(modId)?.FileProvider;if(provider==null)continue;var paths=new List<string>();CollectJsonPaths(provider,string.Empty,paths);paths.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var path in paths){if(!EntityKindPeek.TryRead(provider.ReadFileText(path),out var kind))continue;if(!EntityKindRegistry.IsKnown(kind)){GameLogger.Log("ENTITIES",$"unknown entity kind '{kind}' in '{modId}/{path}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}if(!_filesByKind.TryGetValue(kind,out var list)){list=new List<EntityFile>();_filesByKind[kind]=list;}list.Add(new EntityFile{ModId=modId,Path=path});}}}private static void CollectJsonPaths(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,List<string>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var child=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectJsonPaths(provider,child,result);continue;}if(entry.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))result.Add(entry);}}/// <summary> Merges kind-scoped property patches into the collected entities. The patch key is the entity kind (e.g. <c>patches/character.json</c>), which is what stops a character patch from being applied to skills and actions the way the old shared <c>patches/characters/</c> key did. </summary>
private void ApplyPatches<T>(string kind,Dictionary<string,T>result)where T:class,IIdentifiable{var patchResolver=Context.GetResolver<PatchResolver>();if(patchResolver==null)return;var patches=patchResolver.Collect(kind);if(patches==null||patches.Count==0)return;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Applying patches to kind '{kind}' ({patches.Count} id set(s))");var merger=new JsonPatchMerger();var mergeKeys=JsonPatchMerger.BuildMergeKeys<T>();var opts=JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions;var ids=new List<string>(result.Keys);foreach(var id in ids){var itemJson=JsonSerializer.Serialize(result[id],opts);var mergedJson=merger.Merge(itemJson,id,patches,mergeKeys);result[id]=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(mergedJson,opts);}}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_scanned=false;_filesByKind.Clear();_collected.Clear();EntityKindRegistry.Refresh();}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="EntityResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance"/>'s resolver lookup. </summary>
public static class Entities{/// <summary>Collects every entity of the DTO's kind from all loaded mods (later mods override by id).</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,T>Collect<T>()where T:class,IIdentifiable=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<EntityResolver>()?.Collect<T>()??new Dictionary<string,T>();}}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Provides a generic file-list collection grouped by directory name. Iterates all loaded mods in dependency order, recursively collecting every file under a given directory group. Later mods override earlier ones for files with the same relative key (last-in-wins deduplication). Used as a building block by other resolvers — <see cref="ShaderResolver"/> and <see cref="TextureResolver"/> both delegate to this resolver for raw file discovery, then apply their own filtering and processing. <para/> Mounted <see cref="ModOverlays"/> are read after every mod and win silently (overriding is what an edit layer is for, not a conflict); their entries carry the overlay id, which <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> reads like a mod id. The cache is not invalidated by mounting or by new files: whoever changes the files calls <see cref="ClearCache"/>. </summary>
public class FileListResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"file_list";/// <summary> Per-group file cache. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Collect"/> may be entered concurrently (factories, parallel tests); the inner dictionaries are built locally and only published after they are complete, so they stay read-only in the cache. A plain dictionary here used to corrupt its internal state when two threads collected the same group at once. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Dictionary<string,FileEntry>>_cache=new();/// <summary> Collects all files under the given directory group (e.g. "shaders", "textures/portraits") from every loaded mod. Files are keyed by their path relative to the group directory. Later mods in load order override earlier ones with the same relative key, overlays override every mod. Caches the result per group. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(string group){Context.Initialize();if(_cache.TryGetValue(group,out var cached))return cached;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectFileList('{group}'): CACHE MISS, collecting from {Context.Mods.Count} mod(s)...");var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory(group);foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;var before=result.Count;CollectGroupFiles(provider,modId,group,prefix,result,true);if(result.Count>before){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"mod '{modId}' contributed {result.Count - before} file(s) to group '{group}'");}}foreach(var overlay in ModOverlays.All)CollectGroupFiles(overlay.Value,overlay.Key,group,prefix,result,false);_cache[group]=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectFileList('{group}') → {result.Count} file(s), keys=[{string.Join(", ", result.Keys)}]");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache.Clear();}private static void CollectGroupFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,string prefix,Dictionary<string,FileEntry>result,bool recordConflicts){var entries=provider.ListFiles(dir).ToList();GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"[{modId}]  CollectGroupFiles: dir='{dir}', provider entries count={entries.Count}, prefix='{prefix}'",LogLevel.Debug);foreach(var entry in entries){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    -> subdir '{subDir}'",LogLevel.Debug);CollectGroupFiles(provider,modId,subDir,prefix,result,recordConflicts);}else if(entry.StartsWith(prefix)){var key=entry.Substring(prefix.Length);if(recordConflicts&&result.ContainsKey(key)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"conflict: '{key}' in mod '{modId}' overrides previous entry",LogLevel.Warning);AppServices.Current.Conflicts.RecordConflict("file",key,modId,result[key].ModId,false);}result[key]=new FileEntry(modId,entry);GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    + file '{key}' <- {entry} (mod={modId})",LogLevel.Debug);}else{GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"    SKIP '{entry}': does not start with prefix '{prefix}'",LogLevel.Warning);}}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="FileListResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Files{/// <summary>Collects one directory group's files from all mods, keyed by group-relative path (last mod wins).</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(string group)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<FileListResolver>()?.Collect(group);}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Bridge that wraps a GDScript object as an <see cref="IModAssetResolver"/>. Enables GDScript mods to provide custom asset resolvers without writing C# — the GDScript object must expose <c>resolver_id</c> as a property and may implement <c>initialize()</c> and <c>clear_cache()</c> methods. Unlike C# resolvers discovered via reflection, GDScript resolvers are manually instantiated and registered by <see cref="ModGDScriptLoader"/>. </summary>
public class GDScriptModAssetResolver:IModAssetResolver{private readonly GodotObject _instance;/// <summary> The resolver ID, read from the GDScript object's <c>resolver_id</c> property. Used as the key in the resolver dictionary inside <see cref="ModManager"/>. </summary>
public string Id=>(string)_instance.Get("resolver_id");/// <summary> Creates a bridge wrapping the given GDScript object. The object must have a <c>resolver_id</c> property and may optionally implement <c>initialize</c> and <c>clear_cache</c>. </summary>
public GDScriptModAssetResolver(GodotObject instance){_instance=instance;}/// <summary> Calls the GDScript object's <c>initialize()</c> method if present. Unlike the C# interface, the context is not passed to GDScript — GDScript resolvers access mod data through their own mechanisms. </summary>
public void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context){if(_instance.HasMethod("initialize"))_instance.Call("initialize");}/// <summary> Calls the GDScript object's <c>clear_cache()</c> method if present. </summary>
public void ClearCache(){if(_instance.HasMethod("clear_cache"))_instance.Call("clear_cache");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and merges JSON property patches from mods. Patches are organised per entity kind (e.g. "item", "character") and stored in <c>patches/{kind}/</c> directories. Each patch specifies a target entity ID, a property path, and the value to apply. Also reads flat patch files named <c>patches/{kind}.json</c> for simpler single-file patch sets. The collected patches are applied by <see cref="EntityResolver"/> after collecting base entity data — patches from later mods override earlier ones. </summary>
public class PatchResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"patches";/// <summary> Per-entity-type patch cache. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because resolution may be triggered concurrently (e.g. by parallel unit tests bootstrapping mods through <see cref="Context.Initialize"/>) — a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>>_cache=new();/// <summary> Collects all patches for the given entity type from every loaded mod. Searches both <c>patches/{entityType}/</c> directories and <c>patches/{entityType}.json</c> flat files. Patches are grouped by target entity ID. Caches per type. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>Collect(string entityType){Context.Initialize();if(_cache.TryGetValue(entityType,out var cached))return cached;var result=new Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>();var prefix=ModPath.NormalizeDirectory($"patches/{entityType}");foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles($"patches/{entityType}")){if(entry.EndsWith("/"))continue;var relativePath=entry.StartsWith(prefix)?entry.Substring(prefix.Length):entry;if(!relativePath.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{LoadPatchesFromJson(entityType,modId,entry,text,result);}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Failed to parse patches for '{entityType}' from mod '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}var flatFileName=$"{entityType}.json";foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles("patches")){if(entry.EndsWith("/"))continue;var relative=entry.StartsWith("patches/")?entry.Substring("patches/".Length):entry;if(!relative.Equals(flatFileName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{LoadPatchesFromJson(entityType,modId,entry,text,result);}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Failed to parse patches for '{entityType}' from mod '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}_cache[entityType]=result;return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache.Clear();}private static void LoadPatchesFromJson(string entityType,string modId,string entry,string text,Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>result){var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<PropertyPatch>>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(fileData?.Items==null)return;foreach(var patch in fileData.Items){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(patch.ID))continue;if(!result.TryGetValue(patch.ID,out var list)){list=new List<PropertyPatch>();result[patch.ID]=list;}list.Add(patch);}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="PatchResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Patches{/// <summary>Collects the patches for one entity kind, grouped by target entity id.</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,List<PropertyPatch>>Collect(string entityType)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<PatchResolver>()?.Collect(entityType);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and resolves scenario script files (<c>.scenario</c>) from mods. Scenarios are Lua-like scripts that drive gameplay events on specific scenes. Each <c>.scenario</c> file contains YAML-like metadata headers followed by the script body. <see cref="CollectDefinitions"/> scans every mod's <c>scenarios/</c> folder recursively and groups scenario definitions by their target scene name. Resolution returns the script text for a given scenario ID, with <c>${include}</c> directives already expanded. A scenario is identified by its file name (completion history, <c>after</c> links, the studio). Adding content means a new name; a mod <b>replaces</b> another mod's scenario by shipping the same name — mods are read in load order (dependencies first), so the later one wins, the same rule as files and entities. The replacement may even move the scenario to another scene. Two mods not linked by <c>depends</c> that ship one name have no defined order; the resource atlas reports that. Overlays (<see cref="ModOverlays"/>) win over every mod: that is how an edit layer changes a scenario of a read-only zip mod. </summary>
public class ScenarioResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"scenarios";private Dictionary<string,List<ScenarioDefinition>>_defCache;/// <summary> Collects all scenario definitions from every loaded mod, grouped by target scene name. Each definition contains the scenario name, scene, mod ID, file path, priority, dependencies, conditions, and other metadata parsed from the <c>.scenario</c> file header. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,List<ScenarioDefinition>>CollectDefinitions(){Context.Initialize();if(_defCache!=null)return _defCache;var collected=new List<ScenarioDefinition>();foreach(var overlay in ModOverlays.All)CollectScenarioDefsRecursive(overlay.Value,overlay.Key,"scenarios",collected,null);var overridden=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var def in collected)overridden.Add(def.Name);foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectScenarioDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"scenarios",collected,overridden);}var result=GroupReplacing(collected);_defCache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectScenarioDefinitions → {result.Count} scene(s) with scenarios");return result;}/// <summary> Groups definitions by scene, keeping only the last definition of every scenario name across all scenes. <paramref name="inLoadOrder"/> is flat and in load order, so the last one comes from the mod loaded later — the one that depends on (and replaces) the earlier one, even when it moves the scenario into another scene. The order has to be flat: grouped by scene first, a replacement filed under a scene seen earlier lost to the original. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects scene definitions from mods. A scene definition describes a playable scene — its name, default ambient, default scenario, and backgrounds. Mods can define scenes in <c>scenes/</c> via <c>.json</c> files. When multiple mods define the same scene name, the first mod's definition is the base, and subsequent mods merge their values on top — enabling mods to extend a base scene with additional backgrounds or change the default scenario. Overlays (<see cref="ModOverlays"/>) are read after the mods, so an overlay can add new scenes or extend existing ones the same way. </summary>
public class SceneDefinitionResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"scene_definitions";private Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all scene definitions from every loaded mod. The first mod that defines a scene name becomes the base; subsequent mods merge extra backgrounds and override the default ambient and scenario via <c>MergeSceneDef</c>. Caches the result. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_cache!=null)return _cache;var result=new Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>();var foundAny=false;foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectSceneDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"scenes",result,ref foundAny);}foreach(var overlay in ModOverlays.All)CollectSceneDefsRecursive(overlay.Value,overlay.Key,"scenes",result,ref foundAny);if(!foundAny){GameLogger.Log("MODS","CollectSceneDefinitions — no scene definitions found",LogLevel.Error);}_cache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectSceneDefinitions → {result.Count} scene(s)");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache=null;}private void CollectSceneDefsRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>result,ref bool foundAny){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(dir)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectSceneDefsRecursive(provider,modId,subDir,result,ref foundAny);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{var def=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SceneDefinition>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(def==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(def.Name))continue;def.ModId=modId;foundAny=true;if(!result.TryGetValue(def.Name,out var list)){list=new List<SceneDefinition>();result[def.Name]=list;list.Add(def);}else{var baseDef=list[0];MergeSceneDef(baseDef,def);GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"scene '{def.Name}' from mod '{modId}' merged with base from '{baseDef.ModId}'");}GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"scene '{def.Name}' from mod '{modId}' ({entry})");}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON parse failed for scene '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}private static void MergeSceneDef(SceneDefinition baseDef,SceneDefinition incoming){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(incoming.DefaultAmbient))baseDef.DefaultAmbient=incoming.DefaultAmbient;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(incoming.DefaultScenario))baseDef.DefaultScenario=incoming.DefaultScenario;if(incoming.DefaultBackground?.Count>0){baseDef.DefaultBackground??=new List<string>();baseDef.DefaultBackground.AddRange(incoming.DefaultBackground);}}}/// <summary> Mod-derived registry of scene definitions. The collection itself is delegated to <see cref="SceneDefinitionResolver"/> through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>; this class adds an instance-level cache so repeated collects do not re-resolve. <para/> The registry instance lives in <see cref="AppServices.Current"/> (AppServices.SceneDefs) and participates in the data-driven rebuild loop; the static members below are a facade delegating to it, so existing callers keep working unchanged. </summary>
public class SceneDefinitions:IGameRegistry{private Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>cache;/// <summary>Shared instance the static facade delegates to.</summary>
private static SceneDefinitions Owned=>AppServices.Current.SceneDefs;/// <summary> Creates an empty registry: cheap and side-effect free per the IGameRegistry contract. </summary>
internal SceneDefinitions(){}/// <inheritdoc />
public string Id=>"scene_defs";/// <summary> Re-collects all scene definitions from every loaded mod, dropping the cached result first so a hot-reloaded mod set is picked up. The resolver re-reads only if its own cache was flushed (ModManager.Reload does that before the registries are rebuilt). </summary>
public void Rebuild(){Clear();CollectAll();}/// <summary>Drops the cached collection; the next collect re-resolves.</summary>
public void Clear(){cache=null;}/// <summary> Collects all scene definitions from every loaded mod, caching the result. The first mod that defines a scene name becomes the base; subsequent mods merge their values on top. Returns null when no <see cref="SceneDefinitionResolver"/> is registered. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>CollectAll(){if(cache!=null)return cache;var collected=ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<SceneDefinitionResolver>()?.Collect();if(collected==null)return null;cache=collected;return cache;}// ---- Static facade (legacy API, unchanged for callers) ------------ <summary>Legacy entry point; delegates to the shared instance.</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,List<SceneDefinition>>Collect()=>Owned.CollectAll();}}
