using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and resolves <c>.gdshader</c> files from mods. Uses <see cref="FileListResolver"/> to get the raw list of shader files grouped by logical name, then resolves each one to a Godot <see cref="Shader"/> resource. For folder mods the shader is loaded directly via <c>GD.Load</c> from the filesystem path. For zip mods the shader is extracted to the mod cache first via <see cref="ModCacheManager.ExtractShaders"/>. Caching is two-layer: a resolved-cache for already-loaded <see cref="Shader"/> instances, and the disk-based mod cache for extracted files. </summary>
public class ShaderResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"shaders";/// <summary> Collected shader file entries. The reference is written once after the build completes, hence <c>volatile</c> so other threads observe the fully-populated dictionary instead of a stale null. </summary>
private volatile Dictionary<string,FileEntry>_fileCache;/// <summary> Resolved Godot shaders, keyed by logical name. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Resolve"/> and <see cref="ClearCache"/> may run from different threads; a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Shader>_resolvedCache=new();/// <summary> Collects all shader file entries from mods via <see cref="FileListResolver"/>. Filters to <c>.gdshader</c> files only (excluding <c>.gdshaderinclude</c>). Caches the result so subsequent calls return the same dictionary. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_fileCache!=null)return _fileCache;var fileListResolver=Context.GetResolver<FileListResolver>();var raw=fileListResolver?.Collect("shaders")??new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();foreach(var kvp in raw){if(kvp.Key.EndsWith(".gdshader",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !kvp.Key.EndsWith(".gdshaderinclude",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){var shaderName=kvp.Key.Substring(0,kvp.Key.Length-".gdshader".Length);result[shaderName]=kvp.Value;}}_fileCache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectShaders → {result.Count} shader(s)");return result;}/// <summary> Resolves a shader by logical name. Returns the Godot <see cref="Shader"/> resource, loading from disk cache or extracting from the mod provider as needed. </summary>
public Shader Resolve(string shaderName){var cached=TryGetCached(shaderName);if(cached!=null)return cached;// The owning mod is decided first: an extracted copy on disk says nothing about which mod serves the name in the running mod set.
var shaders=Collect();if(!shaders.TryGetValue(shaderName,out var entry)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var mod=Context.GetMod(entry.ModId);if(mod==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: owning mod '{entry.ModId}' of '{shaderName}' is not loaded",LogLevel.Error);return null;}if(mod.FileProvider is FolderModFileProvider){var fsPath=mod.FileProvider.GetFileSystemPath(entry.FullPath);if(fsPath==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' file '{entry.FullPath}' missing on disk in mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var shader=GD.Load<Shader>(fsPath);if(shader!=null)_resolvedCache[shaderName]=shader;return shader;}ModCacheManager.ExtractShaders(entry.ModId,mod.FileProvider);if(ModCacheManager.IsShaderCached(entry.ModId,shaderName)){var extractedPath=ModCacheManager.GetShaderCachePath(entry.ModId,shaderName);var extractedShader=GD.Load<Shader>(extractedPath);if(extractedShader!=null)_resolvedCache[shaderName]=extractedShader;return extractedShader;}GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveShader: '{shaderName}' failed to extract from mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}/// <summary> Returns a previously resolved shader from the in-memory cache, validated with <c>GodotObject.IsInstanceValid</c>. Returns <c>null</c> if not cached or the cached instance was freed. </summary>
public Shader TryGetCached(string shaderName){if(_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(shaderName,out var cached)&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return cached;return null;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_fileCache=null;_resolvedCache.Clear();}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="ShaderResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Shaders{/// <summary>Collects the .gdshader file entries of all mods, keyed by logical name.</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.Collect();/// <summary>Loads (and caches) the named shader, extracting zip mods to the cache as needed.</summary>
public static Shader Resolve(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.Resolve(name);/// <summary>Returns the already-resolved shader instance, or null when not cached.</summary>
public static Shader TryGetCached(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<ShaderResolver>()?.TryGetCached(name);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Concurrent;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects and resolves texture files (PNG, JPG, WebP) from mods. Textures are grouped into logical directories defined by <see cref="ModConfig.TextureGroups"/> (e.g. "textures/portraits", "textures/backgrounds"). Files are collected via <see cref="FileListResolver"/>, filtered by the configured texture extensions, and deduplicated — later mods in load order override earlier ones with the same logical name. Resolution decodes the raw image bytes into a Godot <see cref="ImageTexture"/> and caches the result in memory. </summary>
public class TextureResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"textures";/// <summary> Collected file entries. The reference is written once after the build completes, hence <c>volatile</c> so other threads observe the fully-populated dictionary instead of a stale null. </summary>
private volatile Dictionary<string,FileEntry>_fileCache;/// <summary> Resolved Godot textures, keyed by logical name. <see cref="ConcurrentDictionary"/> because <see cref="Resolve"/> and <see cref="ClearCache"/> may run from different threads; a plain dictionary corrupts under concurrent writes. </summary>
private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Texture2D>_resolvedCache=new();/// <summary> Collects all texture file entries from every configured texture group directory. Deduplicates by logical name (filename without extension) — later mods in load order win. Caches the result for subsequent calls. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_fileCache!=null)return _fileCache;var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var textureGroups=ModConfig.Instance.TextureGroups;var textureExts=ModConfig.Instance.GetTextureExtensionSet();var fileListResolver=Context.GetResolver<FileListResolver>();if(fileListResolver==null){_fileCache=result;return result;}foreach(var group in textureGroups){var files=fileListResolver.Collect(group);foreach(var kvp in files){var ext=Path.GetExtension(kvp.Key);if(textureExts.Contains(ext)){var textureName=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(kvp.Key);if(result.ContainsKey(textureName)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"texture conflict: '{textureName}' from mod '{kvp.Value.ModId}' overrides previous",LogLevel.Warning);AppServices.Current.Conflicts.RecordConflict("texture",textureName,kvp.Value.ModId,result[textureName].ModId,false);}result[textureName]=kvp.Value;}}}_fileCache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectTextures → {result.Count} texture(s)");return result;}/// <summary> Resolves a texture by logical name, decoding the raw image bytes into a Godot <see cref="ImageTexture"/>. Supports PNG, JPG, and WebP formats. Returns <c>null</c> on decode failure or if the texture is not found in any mod. <see cref="Collect"/> keys textures by basename only, so an ID with a directory prefix (e.g. <c>"prolog/cloak_ground"</c>) would miss on the exact lookup. As a fallback the ID is also matched against the full relative path without extension and against the basename, letting callers address textures the same way the editor's <c>BackgroundFactory</c> does. </summary>
public Texture2D Resolve(string textureName){var cached=TryGetCached(textureName);if(cached!=null)return cached;var textures=Collect();if(!textures.TryGetValue(textureName,out var entry)){entry=FindByPathOrBasename(textures,textureName);if(entry.ModId==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: '{textureName}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}var data=Context.ReadFileBinary(entry.ModId,entry.FullPath);if(data==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: '{textureName}' could not be read from mod '{entry.ModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var ext=Path.GetExtension(entry.FullPath)?.ToLowerInvariant();var image=new Image();Error loadError;if(ext==".png")loadError=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(ext==".jpg"||ext==".jpeg")loadError=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);else if(ext==".webp")loadError=image.LoadWebpFromBuffer(data);else{GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: unsupported extension '{ext}' for '{textureName}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}if(loadError!=Error.Ok){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ResolveTexture: image decode failed for '{textureName}' ({loadError})",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();if(texture!=null)_resolvedCache[textureName]=texture;return texture;}/// <summary> Locates a texture entry when the exact basename lookup misses. First tries the full relative path without extension (so <c>"prolog/cloak_ground"</c> matches <c>"prolog/cloak_ground.png"</c>), then falls back to the bare filename (so a flat <c>"lamp"</c> ID keeps working regardless of which texture group directory it lives in). Matching is case-insensitive. Returns a default <see cref="FileEntry"/> when nothing matches. </summary>
private static FileEntry FindByPathOrBasename(Dictionary<string,FileEntry>textures,string textureName){var normalized=textureName.Replace('\\','/');foreach(var kvp in textures){var pathNoExt=Path.ChangeExtension(kvp.Key,null)?.TrimEnd('.');if(string.Equals(pathNoExt,normalized,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return kvp.Value;}foreach(var kvp in textures){var baseName=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(kvp.Key);if(string.Equals(baseName,textureName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return kvp.Value;}return default;}/// <summary> Returns a previously resolved texture from the in-memory cache, validated with <c>GodotObject.IsInstanceValid</c>. </summary>
public Texture2D TryGetCached(string textureName){if(_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(textureName,out var cached)&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return cached;return null;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_fileCache=null;_resolvedCache.Clear();}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="TextureResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Textures{/// <summary>Collects texture file entries from every configured texture group, keyed by basename.</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect()=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.Collect();/// <summary>Decodes and caches the named texture; null on miss or decode failure.</summary>
public static Texture2D Resolve(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.Resolve(name);/// <summary>Returns the already-decoded texture instance, or null when not cached.</summary>
public static Texture2D TryGetCached(string name)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TextureResolver>()?.TryGetCached(name);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects wrapper template files (<c>.wrappertmpl</c>) from mods. Wrappers are text templates that define how entities are rendered or serialised — they are collected from <c>wrappers/</c> directories and resolved by name. public override string Id=>"wrappers";private List<WrapperDefinition>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all wrapper template definitions from every loaded mod. Templates are read from <c>wrappers/</c> directories and identified by filename without extension. Caches the result. </summary>

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Convenience base class for <see cref="IModAssetResolver"/> implementations. Stores the <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> reference provided by <see cref="Initialize"/> so that derived classes can access the mod registry and cross-resolver lookup without manual plumbing. </summary>
public abstract class ModAssetResolver:IModAssetResolver{/// <summary> Unique identifier for this resolver. Must be overridden by derived classes (e.g. "textures", "shaders", "scenarios"). </summary>
public abstract string Id{get;}/// <summary> The <see cref="ModResolutionContext"/> provided during <see cref="Initialize"/>. Gives access to the mod registry, file I/O helpers, and cross-resolver lookup via <see cref="ModResolutionContext.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
protected ModResolutionContext Context{get;private set;}/// <summary> Stores the context reference for use by derived classes. Override to add custom initialisation logic — always call <c>base.Initialize(context)</c> first. </summary>
public virtual void Initialize(ModResolutionContext context){Context=context;}/// <summary> Clears all cached data. Must be overridden by derived classes to reset their collection caches so the next collection picks up changes from newly loaded or unloaded mods. </summary>

public bool IsInitialized=>_registry.IsInitialized;/// <summary>Idempotent bootstrap of the mod registry.</summary>
public void Initialize(){_registry.Initialize();}/// <summary>Discards all loaded mods and re-runs discovery.</summary>
public void Reload(){_registry.Reload();}/// <summary>Returns mod IDs in dependency-respecting order.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>GetOrderedModIds(bool filterDisabled=true)=>_registry.GetOrderedModIds(filterDisabled);/// <summary>Looks up a mod by ID from the registry.</summary>
public IModInfo GetMod(string id){return _registry.GetMod(id);}/// <summary> Checks whether the given mod-relative path exists inside the specified mod's provider. </summary>

Circular includes are detected and reported as errors. </summary>
public string ReadResolvedText(string modId,string path){var mod=GetMod(modId);if(mod==null)return null;var content=mod.FileProvider.ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;try{var visited=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){path};return ExpandModIncludes(mod.FileProvider,content,path,visited);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"Include resolution failed for '{modId}/{path}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}/// <summary> Overload of <see cref="ReadResolvedText(string, string)"/> that uses an explicit provider instead of the mod's built-in one. Used for cross-resolver dependencies — e.g. <see cref="ShaderResolver"/> looks up <see cref="FileListResolver"/> to get the raw file list. </summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> Maps script file paths and class names to compiled C# <see cref="System.Type"/> objects across all loaded mods, respecting mod load-order priority. <para/> Populated by <see cref="ModCompiler"/> after each mod's C# source is compiled. Each mod contributes a {path → Type} and {name → Type} mapping. <para/> Resolution order: 1. <see cref="ResolveByPath"/> — iterates mods in priority order, returns first match 2. <see cref="ResolveByName"/> — same priority-ordered search by class name / full name 3. <see cref="Resolve"/> — tries path first, falls back to file-name → class-name lookup <para/> This is the bridge between a .tscn's <c>path="scripts/MyScript.cs"</c> reference and the actual <c>Type</c> in the compiled mod assembly. Paths are normalized (stripped of <c>res://</c> prefix, backslashes → forward slashes) before lookup. </summary>
public static class ScriptTypeRegistry{private static readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,Type>>_modPathToType=new();private static readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,Type>>_modNameToType=new();private static readonly List<Type>_allTypes=new();private static List<(string ModId,int Priority)>_orderedModIds;static ScriptTypeRegistry(){RegisterCoreAssembly(typeof(ScriptTypeRegistry).Assembly);}/// <summary> Registers the main game assembly's Node types as the lowest-priority fallback. Mod-provided scenes reference core behaviours by their <c>res://Core/...cs</c> path; <see cref="Resolve"/> has no path entry for them, so it falls through to <see cref="ResolveByName"/>, which needs these types. Mod assemblies registered later still win because their name maps are consulted before the fallback list. </summary>
public static void RegisterCoreAssembly(Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null)return;try{foreach(var type in assembly.GetTypes()){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract|| !typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;if(!_allTypes.Contains(type))_allTypes.Add(type);}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"ScriptTypeRegistry: failed to scan core assembly: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary>Sets the mod priority order (id + load position) used by all lookups; supplied by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> after load order is computed.</summary>
public static void SetModOrder(List<(string ModId,int Priority)>orderedMods){_orderedModIds=orderedMods;}/// <summary> Indexes a freshly compiled mod assembly: adds its non-abstract <see cref="Godot.Node"/> subclasses to the name maps and, for every source file whose file name matches a class, records the path-to-type mapping used by .tscn script resolution. </summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly,string modId,IEnumerable<(string FilePath,string Source)>sourceFiles){if(!_modPathToType.ContainsKey(modId)){_modPathToType[modId]=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);_modNameToType[modId]=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}var pathDict=_modPathToType[modId];var nameDict=_modNameToType[modId];var types=assembly.GetTypes();foreach(var type in types){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract)continue;if(!typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;_allTypes.Add(type);var typeName=type.Name;if(!nameDict.ContainsKey(typeName))nameDict[typeName]=type;var fullName=type.FullName;if(!nameDict.ContainsKey(fullName))nameDict[fullName]=type;}foreach(var(filePath,_)in sourceFiles){var relative=NormalizePath(filePath);var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(relative);if(nameDict.TryGetValue(fileName,out var t)){if(!pathDict.ContainsKey(relative))pathDict[relative]=t;}else{foreach(var type in types){if(!type.IsClass||type.IsAbstract|| !typeof(Godot.Node).IsAssignableFrom(type))continue;if(type.Name.Equals(fileName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){if(!pathDict.ContainsKey(relative))pathDict[relative]=type;break;}}}}}/// <summary>Priority-ordered lookup by normalized script path; first matching mod wins, then registration order.</summary>
public static Type ResolveByPath(string tscnPath){var normalized=NormalizePath(tscnPath);if(_orderedModIds!=null){foreach(var(modId,_)in _orderedModIds){if(_modPathToType.TryGetValue(modId,out var pathDict)&&pathDict.TryGetValue(normalized,out var type))return type;}}foreach(var kvp in _modPathToType){if(kvp.Value.TryGetValue(normalized,out var type))return type;}return null;}/// <summary>Priority-ordered lookup by class name or full name, with a case-insensitive fallback scan over all indexed types.</summary>
public static Type ResolveByName(string className){if(_orderedModIds!=null){foreach(var(modId,_)in _orderedModIds){if(_modNameToType.TryGetValue(modId,out var nameDict)&&nameDict.TryGetValue(className,out var type))return type;}}foreach(var kvp in _modNameToType){if(kvp.Value.TryGetValue(className,out var type))return type;}return _allTypes.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Name.Equals(className,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||t.FullName.Equals(className,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));}/// <summary> Combined resolver for a .tscn script reference: input without separators or a dot is treated as a class name; otherwise the path is tried first and the bare file name second (as a class name). </summary>
public static Type Resolve(string tscnPath){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(tscnPath))return null;if(!tscnPath.Contains("/")&& !tscnPath.Contains("\\")&& !tscnPath.Contains("."))return ResolveByName(tscnPath);var result=ResolveByPath(tscnPath);if(result!=null)return result;var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(tscnPath);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))return ResolveByName(fileName);return null;}/// <summary> Forgets one mod's node types (a mod unload or re-registration during an in-process reload); the other mods and the kernel types stay. </summary>
public static void RemoveMod(string modId){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return;if(_modNameToType.TryGetValue(modId,out var nameDict)){var types=new HashSet<Type>(nameDict.Values);_allTypes.RemoveAll(types.Contains);}_modPathToType.Remove(modId);_modNameToType.Remove(modId);}/// <summary>Wipes every mapping and re-registers the core assembly fallback; called on mod reload.</summary>
public static void Clear(){_modPathToType.Clear();_modNameToType.Clear();_allTypes.Clear();_orderedModIds=null;RegisterCoreAssembly(typeof(ScriptTypeRegistry).Assembly);}private static string NormalizePath(string path){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return path;if(path.StartsWith("res://",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))path=path.Substring(6);return ModPath.Normalize(path);}}}

using System;using System.Globalization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Assertion failure of a mod unit test. The runner reports PASS/FAIL purely by catching this exception (plus any other exception, which is reported as Failed with the original message), so no external test framework is pulled into the game runtime. </summary>
public class ModAssertException:Exception{/// <summary>Creates a failure with a human-readable description.</summary>
public ModAssertException(string message):base(message){}}/// <summary> Minimal assertion API for mod unit tests. Every failure throws <see cref="ModAssertException"/> with a message that already names the expectation, so a failing report line reads without opening the source (the "understandable errors" step of the debug ladder, §8.2). </summary>
public static class ModAssert{/// <summary>Asserts two strings are equal.</summary>
public static void Equal(string expected,string actual,string what=null){if(!string.Equals(expected,actual,StringComparison.Ordinal))throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,$"expected '{expected}', actual '{actual}'"));}/// <summary>Asserts two ints are equal.</summary>
public static void Equal(long expected,long actual,string what=null){if(expected!=actual)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,$"expected {expected}, actual {actual}"));}/// <summary>Asserts two floats are equal within <paramref name="epsilon"/>.</summary>
public static void Equal(float expected,float actual,float epsilon=1e-4f,string what=null){if(Math.Abs(expected-actual)>epsilon)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,$"expected {expected.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}, actual {actual.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} (±{epsilon})"));}/// <summary>Asserts two doubles are equal within <paramref name="epsilon"/> (CloseTo).</summary>
public static void CloseTo(double expected,double actual,double epsilon=1e-4,string what=null){if(double.IsNaN(expected)||double.IsNaN(actual)||Math.Abs(expected-actual)>epsilon)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,$"expected {expected.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} ±{epsilon}, actual {actual.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}"));}/// <summary>Asserts the condition is true.</summary>
public static void True(bool condition,string what=null){if(!condition)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,"expected true"));}/// <summary>Asserts the condition is false.</summary>
public static void False(bool condition,string what=null){if(condition)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,"expected false"));}/// <summary>Asserts the value is null.</summary>
public static void Null(object value,string what=null){if(value!=null)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,$"expected null, actual '{value}'"));}/// <summary>Asserts the value is not null.</summary>
public static void NotNull(object value,string what=null){if(value==null)throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what??"value","is null"));}/// <summary> Asserts the action throws <see cref="ModAssertException"/> (or any exception when <paramref name="anyException"/>). Fails when nothing is thrown. </summary>
public static void Throws(Action action,string what=null,bool anyException=false){try{action();}catch(ModAssertException){return;}catch(Exception ex)when(anyException){_=ex;return;}throw new ModAssertException(Msg(what,"expected an exception, but none was thrown"));}private static string Msg(string what,string detail){return string.IsNullOrEmpty(what)?$"ModAssert failed: {detail}":$"ModAssert failed [{what}]: {detail}";}}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Marks a static method inside a mod's <c>test_sources</c> as a mod unit test. Tests are discovered by <see cref="ModTestDiscovery"/> through reflection in the separately compiled <c>{modId}__tests</c> assembly — the production pipeline never compiles or loads them (see the "tests are off the player's path" contract in plan-mod-testing.md §3.1). The method must be static, take a single <see cref="ModTestContext"/> parameter and return either <c>void</c> or <c>Task</c>. The test name comes from the attribute; failures are reported by throwing — typically via <see cref="ModAssert"/>. </summary>

public string Name{get;}/// <summary> Per-test timeout in seconds for async tests. A synchronous test cannot be aborted in-process, so the timeout applies to the returned <c>Task</c> only; hangs in sync tests are contained by the per-process isolation of the CI fan-out. </summary>
public int TimeoutSeconds{get;set;}=30;/// <summary>Optional skip reason; when non-empty the test is reported as Skipped without running.</summary>
public string Skip{get;set;}/// <summary>Declares a test with the given report name.</summary>
public ModTestAttribute(string name){Name=name;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Everything a mod unit test may touch, passed to every <c>[ModTest]</c> method. Provides mod-file access through the same <see cref="ModManager"/> pipeline production code uses, a log sink that lands both in GameLogger and in the report entry, a cancellation token and two sandboxed scratch areas: <para><see cref="SandboxDir"/> — a filesystem directory under <c>user://mod_test_sandbox/{modId}</c>, wiped before the suite starts (not after — a failing test keeps its artifacts for debugging) and listed as the report's artifacts.</para> <para><see cref="SandboxRoot"/> — a detached Godot <see cref="Node"/> for tests that exercise Node-dependent logic; the runner frees it after each test so a leaked child cannot outlive the test.</para> The context makes the correct path the most convenient one: the engine cannot intercept arbitrary file IO (honest residual zone §6.5), so tests are encouraged to write only here. </summary>
public sealed class ModTestContext{private readonly List<string>logBuffer;private readonly string sandboxDir;/// <summary>Creates a context for one test execution. Internal: tests receive it, never construct it.</summary>
internal ModTestContext(string modId,List<string>logBuffer,string sandboxDir,Node sandboxRoot,CancellationToken cancellationToken){ModId=modId;this.logBuffer=logBuffer;this.sandboxDir=sandboxDir;SandboxRoot=sandboxRoot;CancellationToken=cancellationToken;}/// <summary>Id of the mod under test; also the assembly the test code was compiled from.</summary>
public string ModId{get;}/// <summary>Cooperative cancellation — set when the per-test timeout elapses or the whole run is aborted.</summary>
public CancellationToken CancellationToken{get;}/// <summary>Detached Godot node for Node-dependent test logic; freed by the engine after the test.</summary>
public Node SandboxRoot{get;}/// <summary> Absolute path of the per-mod sandbox directory, created on first access. Wiped before the suite, kept after the run for artifacts. </summary>
public string SandboxDir{get{Directory.CreateDirectory(sandboxDir);return sandboxDir;}}/// <summary>Reads a UTF-8 text file from the mod, or null when missing.</summary>

public T ReadJson<T>(string path)where T:class{var text=ReadFileText(path);ModAssert.NotNull(text,$"mod file '{path}'");return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions)??throw new ModAssertException($"mod file '{path}' deserialized to null");}/// <summary>Lists the mod's files in <paramref name="directory"/> (entries ending with '/' are subdirectories).</summary>

public void Log(string message){lock(logBuffer)logBuffer.Add(message);GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"[{ModId}] {message}");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary>A discovered [ModTest] method bound to its declaring class for instantiation-free invocation.</summary>
public sealed class DiscoveredModTest{/// <summary>Report name from the attribute (or "Class.Method" fallback — discovery rejects null names).</summary>
public string Name{get;init;}/// <summary>Reflection handle of the static test method.</summary>
public MethodInfo Method{get;init;}/// <summary>Per-test timeout in seconds.</summary>
public int TimeoutSeconds{get;init;}/// <summary>Skip reason; non-empty means the test is reported Skipped without running.</summary>
public string Skip{get;init;}}/// <summary> Reflection scan of a compiled test assembly: finds static methods marked with <see cref="ModTestAttribute"/> in public types. Static test methods may be private — the plan's authoring convention is a bare <c>static void</c> with no access modifier, so discovery deliberately ignores visibility (the assembly is private to the test engine anyway). An unreadable type set is reported as a suite-level <see cref="ModTestStatus.Error"/> rather than silently producing an empty run. </summary>
public static class ModTestDiscovery{private const BindingFlags TestMethodBinding=BindingFlags.Static|BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic;/// <summary> Returns every [ModTest] method in <paramref name="assembly"/> in stable (type name, method name) order — deterministic reports make history diffs meaningful. </summary>
public static List<DiscoveredModTest>Discover(Assembly assembly){if(assembly==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(assembly));var result=new List<DiscoveredModTest>();Type[]types;try{types=assembly.GetTypes();}catch(ReflectionTypeLoadException ex){// Surface which types failed and why: a mod test assembly that cannot fully load is a data problem of the mod, not of the engine.
types=ex.Types.Where(t=>t!=null).ToArray();}foreach(var type in types.Where(t=>t.IsClass&& !t.IsAbstract).OrderBy(t=>t.FullName,StringComparer.Ordinal)){foreach(var method in type.GetMethods(TestMethodBinding).OrderBy(m=>m.Name,StringComparer.Ordinal)){var attr=method.GetCustomAttribute<ModTestAttribute>();if(attr==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(attr.Name))continue;result.Add(new DiscoveredModTest{Name=attr.Name,Method=method,TimeoutSeconds=attr.TimeoutSeconds>0?attr.TimeoutSeconds:30,Skip=attr.Skip,});}}return result;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Facade of the mod unit-test system (plan §5). Owns the gate (<c>--run-tests</c> / <c>run_mod_tests</c>), the separate compilation of <c>test_sources</c> into <c>{modId}__tests</c> assemblies and the run orchestration. Gate guarantees (§3.1): when not activated, no member of this class is touched — production compilation never reads <see cref="ModManifest.TestSources"/>, test DLLs cache under a dedicated directory and never land in a player's installation, and no <c>__tests</c> assembly exists in the AppDomain after a normal boot. Orchestration (§5.1): called after the boot pipeline reaches Ready, it compiles each mod's tests (Roslyn diagnostics are reported verbatim on failure — the mod is marked ERROR and the run continues), discovers and runs the tests, writes the report and returns the aggregate exit flag the entry scene turns into <c>GetTree().Quit(0|1)</c>. </summary>
public static class ModTestEngine{private static readonly ModTestLedger ledger=new();/// <summary>Roslyn errors of the last failed test compilation per mod, carried into the report's &lt;compile&gt; entry.</summary>
private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>lastCompileErrors=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>Results accumulated by the last (or current) run; kept for Report Viewer / diagnostics.</summary>
public static ModTestLedger Ledger=>ledger;/// <summary>True when <c>--run-tests</c> is present in the user command-line arguments.</summary>
public static bool IsRequestedByArgs(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return false;return OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs().Any(a=>a=="--run-tests"||a.StartsWith("--run-tests=",StringComparison.Ordinal));}/// <summary>Mod filter from <c>--mod=&lt;id&gt;</c> user args, or null when absent.</summary>
public static string RequestedModFilter(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return null;return OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs().Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--mod=",StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--mod=".Length).Trim()).FirstOrDefault(id=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id));}/// <summary>True when the test mode is active: explicit CLI flag, or run_mod_tests in mod_config.json.</summary>
public static bool IsTestMode(){if(IsRequestedByArgs())return true;try{return ModConfig.Instance.RunModTests;}catch{return false;}}/// <summary> Compiles the mod's <c>test_sources</c> into the separate <c>{modId}__tests</c> assembly. Returns null on compilation failure (diagnostics already logged); never called by the production pipeline. </summary>
public static Assembly CompileTestAssembly(ModInfo mod,CancellationToken cancellationToken){var patterns=mod?.Manifest?.TestSources;if(patterns==null||patterns.Count==0)return null;var sources=new List<(string FilePath,string Source)>();// Absolute on-disk path per source (same rule as production mods): debuggers map breakpoints and stacks show the real file.
var treePaths=new List<string>();foreach(var pattern in patterns){var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*.cs";var sepIndex=pattern.LastIndexOf('/');if(sepIndex>=0){prefix=pattern.Substring(0,sepIndex);suffix=pattern.Substring(sepIndex+1);}foreach(var file in mod.FileProvider.ListFiles(prefix)){if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var name=file.Substring(file.LastIndexOf('/')+1);var match=suffix=="*"||suffix=="*.cs"||(suffix.StartsWith("*.")&&name.EndsWith(suffix.Substring(1),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));if(match){// Deduplicate the pattern prefix: file paths already carry "tests/", and the report path keeps a single canonical "{modId}/" prefix.

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Thread-safe accumulator of every test outcome of a run (plan §7.1). Tests write nothing themselves: the runner records each outcome here and <see cref="ModTestReportWriter"/> flushes the ledger to the output channels. Suite summaries are flushed after each mod (§7.4), so a later mod crashing the process does not lose earlier statistics. </summary>
public sealed class ModTestLedger{private readonly object gate=new();private readonly List<ModTestEntry>entries=new();private readonly List<ModTestSuiteSummary>suites=new();/// <summary>Appends one test outcome.</summary>
public void Add(ModTestEntry entry){lock(gate)entries.Add(entry);}/// <summary>Appends a completed per-mod summary (snapshot taken by the runner).</summary>
public void AddSuite(ModTestSuiteSummary summary){lock(gate)suites.Add(summary);}/// <summary>Snapshot of every recorded test outcome in arrival order.</summary>
public List<ModTestEntry>SnapshotEntries(){lock(gate)return new List<ModTestEntry>(entries);}/// <summary>Snapshot of every completed per-mod summary.</summary>
public List<ModTestSuiteSummary>SnapshotSuites(){lock(gate)return new List<ModTestSuiteSummary>(suites);}/// <summary>Removes all recorded data (used between engine runs).</summary>
public void Clear(){lock(gate){entries.Clear();suites.Clear();}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary>Outcome of a single mod unit test (plan-mod-testing.md §7.2).</summary>
public enum ModTestStatus{/// <summary>Test ran to completion without a failure.</summary>
Passed,/// <summary>Test threw (assert or unexpected exception).</summary>
Failed,/// <summary>Test declared skipped via <see cref="ModTestAttribute.Skip"/>.</summary>
Skipped,/// <summary>Async test exceeded its per-test timeout.</summary>
Timeout,/// <summary>Infrastructure error: compilation failure of the test assembly or recovery self-check violation.</summary>
Error,}/// <summary> One recorded test outcome in the ledger. The test itself knows nothing about reporting: the engine records every outcome (including compile errors at mod granularity) and <see cref="ModTestReportWriter"/> is the only writer. </summary>
public class ModTestEntry{/// <summary>Mod the test belongs to.</summary>
public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Report name of the test ("group/case").</summary>
public string TestName{get;set;}/// <summary>Outcome.</summary>
public ModTestStatus Status{get;set;}/// <summary>Wall-clock duration in milliseconds.</summary>
public double DurationMs{get;set;}/// <summary>Assert/exception text; for Skipped — the skip reason.</summary>
public string Message{get;set;}/// <summary>Stack trace for Failed/Error.</summary>
public string StackTrace{get;set;}/// <summary>Lines written through <see cref="ModTestContext.Log"/> during this test.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Log{get;set;}=new List<string>();/// <summary>Artifact paths inside the mod's SandboxDir recorded by the runner.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Artifacts{get;set;}=new List<string>();}/// <summary> Per-mod summary line of a run: used by the console итоги block and the JSON report. A mod whose test assembly failed to compile gets <see cref="ModTestStatus.Error"/> with the Roslyn diagnostics. </summary>
public class ModTestSuiteSummary{/// <summary>Mod id.</summary>
public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Aggregate status: the worst of the individual outcomes (or Error for compile failure).</summary>
public ModTestStatus Status{get;set;}/// <summary>Passed test count.</summary>
public int Passed{get;set;}/// <summary>Failed test count (includes Timeout).</summary>
public int Failed{get;set;}/// <summary>Skipped test count.</summary>
public int Skipped{get;set;}/// <summary>Error count (compile failure, recovery self-check violations).</summary>
public int Errors{get;set;}/// <summary>Total suite duration in milliseconds.</summary>
public double DurationMs{get;set;}/// <summary>Per-test entries in discovery order.</summary>
public List<ModTestEntry>Tests{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Mod version from the manifest, for the report header.</summary>
public string Version{get;set;}/// <summary>Compilation cache hash of the test sources, to bind the report to the exact mod content.</summary>
public string Hash{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> The only writer of mod test results (plan §7.3). JSON — <c>user://mod_tests/last-report.json</c> (overwritten) plus a timestamped copy in <c>user://mod_tests/runs/</c>.</para> <para>3. History — one JSONL line per suite in <c>user://mod_tests/history.jsonl</c> (rotation: last 50 runs).</para> Additionally prints the unified CI contract <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=mod_units:&lt;id&gt; passed=N failed=M</c> per mod and a <c>mod_units</c> aggregate — consumed by Cthangover.TestRunner like every integration test. </summary>

"?"} (hash {ShortHash(suite.Hash)}) ===");foreach(var test in suite.Tests){var tag=test.Status switch{ModTestStatus.Passed=>"PASS",ModTestStatus.Failed=>"FAIL",ModTestStatus.Skipped=>"SKIP",ModTestStatus.Timeout=>"TIMEOUT",_=>"ERROR",};GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"[{tag}] {test.ModId}/{test.TestName} ({test.DurationMs:0} ms){Suffix(test)}");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(test.Message))GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"       {test.Message.Replace("\n", "\n       ")}");foreach(var line in test.Log)GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"       log: {line}");}GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"=== {suite.ModId}: {suite.Passed}/{suite.Tests.Count} passed, {suite.Failed} failed, {suite.Skipped} skipped, {suite.Errors} errors ({suite.DurationMs / 1000.0:0.0#} s) ===");}var totals=ComputeTotals(suites);var totalTests=totals.Passed+totals.Failed+totals.Skipped;var totalPassed=totals.Passed;var greenMods=suites.Count(s=>s.Status==ModTestStatus.Passed||s.Status==ModTestStatus.Skipped);GameLogger.Log("MODTEST","=== ИТОГИ MOD TESTS ===");foreach(var s in suites)GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"  {s.ModId,-20} {StatusTag(s.Status),-7} {s.Passed}/{s.Passed + s.Failed + s.Skipped + s.Errors,-4} {s.DurationMs / 1000.0:0.0#}s");GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"Модов: {greenMods}/{suites.Count} зелёных; тестов: {totalPassed}/{totalTests} прошедших, {totals.Failed} упавших, {totals.Skipped} пропущенных");GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"Отчёт: {root}last-report.json");// Unified CI contract lines
foreach(var s in suites)GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=mod_units:{s.ModId} passed={s.Passed} failed={s.Failed + s.Errors} skipped={s.Skipped}");GameLogger.Log("MODTEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=mod_units passed={totals.Passed} failed={totals.Failed} skipped={totals.Skipped}");// JSON report
var report=new ReportFile{RunId=runId,Mode=mode,WrittenUtc=DateTime.UtcNow,GodotVersion=Engine.GetVersionInfo()["string"].AsString(),Suites=suites,};var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(report,new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true,DefaultIgnoreCondition=JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull,Converters={new JsonStringEnumConverter()},});File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(root,"last-report.json"),json);Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(root,"runs"));File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(root,"runs",runId+".json"),json);// History (JSONL, rotated)
var historyPath=Path.Combine(root,"history.jsonl");var lines=File.Exists(historyPath)?File.ReadAllLines(historyPath).Where(l=> !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(l)).ToList():new List<string>();foreach(var s in suites){lines.Add(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new HistoryLine{RunId=runId,ModId=s.ModId,Status=s.Status.ToString(),Passed=s.Passed,Failed=s.Failed,Skipped=s.Skipped,Errors=s.Errors,DurationMs=s.DurationMs,Hash=s.Hash,}));}if(lines.Count>HistoryMaxLines)lines=lines.Skip(lines.Count-HistoryMaxLines).ToList();File.WriteAllLines(historyPath,lines);return totals.Success;}/// <summary>Aggregate counts of a run; <see cref="Failed"/> includes errors and timeouts, skips never fail a run.</summary>
public readonly record struct ModTestTotals(int Passed,int Failed,int Skipped,bool Success);/// <summary> Aggregates suite summaries for the CI contract line and the exit code: a run succeeds when no test failed, timed out or errored. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Runtime.ExceptionServices;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing{/// <summary> Executes the discovered tests of one mod and applies the automatic recovery cycle after every test (plan §6.3). using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods{/// <summary> JSON DTO for one entry of a mod manifest's <c>ui</c> array — the single, manifest-driven way a mod declares a GUI element (no C# registration API). <para/> Two kinds exist. <see cref="KindPanel"/> is a button-toggled panel: the UI registry owns a toolbar button for it and is the only one allowed to change its visibility. <see cref="KindOverlay"/> has no button; the element's own code decides when it is visible (optionally auto-shown by <see cref="ShowOnStart"/>). <para/> Entries are validated at startup by <c>UiRegistry.Initialize</c>; invalid entries are logged and skipped. <see cref="ModId"/> and <see cref="ModOrderIndex"/> are filled in during collection and never come from JSON — they carry the owning mod and its load-order position, which are needed to break ordering ties deterministically. </summary>

[JsonPropertyName("kind")]public string Kind{get;set;}/// <summary> Optional logical scene this GUI belongs to. When set, the GUI is only available in that scene and is hidden when leaving it. When absent the GUI is scene-independent and lives for the whole session. </summary>

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;/// <summary> "Does this reference belong to the code being unloaded?" — the single rule every unload sweeper applies. A value is owned when its runtime type (or any generic argument / element type of it) is declared in one of the dying assemblies; a delegate is owned when any entry of its invocation list points into them, by method or by target (lambdas close over compiler-generated classes of the mod assembly, and kernel wrappers such as the event bus close over the mod's delegate). Answers for types are cached: a sweep asks about the same few hundred types thousands of times. </summary>
public sealed class AssemblyOwnership{private readonly HashSet<Assembly>assemblies;private readonly Dictionary<Type,bool>typeCache=new();/// <summary>Creates the rule for <paramref name="assemblies"/> (the assemblies of every mod released in one unload pass).</summary>
public AssemblyOwnership(IEnumerable<Assembly>assemblies){this.assemblies=new HashSet<Assembly>(assemblies??Array.Empty<Assembly>());}/// <summary>The dying assemblies.</summary>
public IReadOnlyCollection<Assembly>Assemblies=>assemblies;/// <summary>True when nothing is being unloaded; every query then answers false.</summary>
public bool IsEmpty=>assemblies.Count==0;/// <summary>True when <paramref name="assembly"/> is one of the dying assemblies.</summary>
public bool Owns(Assembly assembly)=>assembly!=null&&assemblies.Contains(assembly);/// <summary>True when <paramref name="type"/> or a type it is built from is declared in a dying assembly.</summary>
public bool Owns(Type type){if(type==null||IsEmpty)return false;if(typeCache.TryGetValue(type,out var cached))return cached;// Placeholder against recursive generic shapes (class A : IEquatable<A>).
typeCache[type]=false;var owned=assemblies.Contains(type.Assembly);if(!owned&&type.HasElementType)owned=Owns(type.GetElementType());if(!owned&&type.IsGenericType&& !type.IsGenericTypeDefinition){foreach(var argument in type.GetGenericArguments()){if(Owns(argument)){owned=true;break;}}}typeCache[type]=owned;return owned;}/// <summary>True when one invocation-list entry of <paramref name="handler"/> belongs to a dying assembly.</summary>
public bool Owns(Delegate handler){if(handler==null||IsEmpty)return false;foreach(var entry in handler.GetInvocationList()){if(OwnsSingle(entry))return true;}return false;}/// <summary>Owned value: an owned delegate or an instance of an owned type (a Type/Assembly/member object counts by itself).</summary>
public bool OwnsValue(object value){switch(value){case null:return false;case Delegate d:return Owns(d);case Type t:return Owns(t);case Assembly a:return Owns(a);case MemberInfo m:return Owns(m.DeclaringType)||Owns(m.Module.Assembly);default:return Owns(value.GetType());}}/// <summary> Removes the owned entries from a (multicast) delegate. Returns the survivor (null when nothing survives); <paramref name="changed"/> tells whether anything was removed. </summary>
public Delegate Strip(Delegate handler,out bool changed){changed=false;if(handler==null)return null;Delegate result=null;foreach(var entry in handler.GetInvocationList()){if(OwnsSingle(entry)){changed=true;continue;}result=Delegate.Combine(result,entry);}return changed?result:handler;}private bool OwnsSingle(Delegate entry){var method=entry.Method;if(method!=null&&(Owns(method.DeclaringType)||Owns(method.Module.Assembly)))return true;var target=entry.Target;if(target==null)return false;if(Owns(target.GetType()))return true;if(target is Delegate inner)return Owns(inner);// A kernel wrapper delegate (a closure capturing a mod delegate) is owned through its closure: look one level into its delegate fields.
foreach(var field in target.GetType().GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic)){if(!typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(field.FieldType)&&field.FieldType!=typeof(object))continue;if(field.GetValue(target)is Delegate captured&& !ReferenceEquals(captured,entry)&&Owns(captured))return true;}return false;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Collections;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Releases every engine-side hold on a dying mod assembly before its load context unloads. A live Godot object whose script is a mod type keeps a strong GC handle to its managed instance (and so to the mod assembly) for as long as the native object lives; a signal connected to a mod delegate keeps the delegate alive inside the native connection. Neither is visible from managed statics, so this pass walks the engine side: <list type="number"> <item>live objects: every managed wrapper GodotSharp tracks (<c>DisposablesTracker</c> — this includes nodes outside the tree, cached UI and timers) plus the whole scene tree;</item> <item>connections to owned delegates are disconnected on every surviving object;</item> <item>owned objects are freed: nodes leave the tree and are freed immediately (callers run this outside signal emission, from a deferred step), plain objects are freed, reference-counted ones lose their script so the native object lives on as its engine base class while the mod instance dies.</item> </list> </summary>
public static class GodotObjectSweeper{/// <summary>Runs the pass; returns one report line per freed group / disconnected signal.</summary>
public static List<string>Release(SceneTree tree,AssemblyOwnership ownership){var report=new List<string>();if(ownership==null||ownership.IsEmpty|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return report;var objects=new List<GodotObject>();var seen=new HashSet<ulong>();foreach(var tracked in TrackedObjects())AddLive(tracked,objects,seen);if(tree?.Root!=null)CollectTree(tree.Root,objects,seen);var disconnected=0;var owned=new List<GodotObject>();foreach(var obj in objects){if(ownership.Owns(obj.GetType())){owned.Add(obj);continue;}disconnected+=DisconnectOwned(obj,ownership);}if(disconnected>0)report.Add($"disconnected {disconnected} signal connection(s) to mod code");var freedNodes=0;var freedObjects=0;var detached=0;// Ancestors first: freeing a parent frees its subtree, so the depth-sorted walk sees each surviving node exactly once.
foreach(var node in owned.OfType<Node>().OrderBy(Depth).ToList()){if(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(node))continue;node.GetParent()?.RemoveChild(node);node.Free();freedNodes++;}foreach(var obj in owned){if(obj is Node|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(obj))continue;if(obj is RefCounted){obj.SetScript(default(Variant));obj.Dispose();detached++;}else{obj.Free();freedObjects++;}}if(freedNodes+freedObjects+detached>0)report.Add($"freed {freedNodes} node(s) and {freedObjects} object(s) of mod types, detached {detached} reference-counted instance(s)");return report;}private static int DisconnectOwned(GodotObject obj,AssemblyOwnership ownership){var count=0;try{foreach(var signal in obj.GetSignalList()){var name=signal["name"].AsStringName();foreach(var connection in obj.GetSignalConnectionList(name)){var callable=connection["callable"].AsCallable();var target=callable.Target;var owned=(callable.Delegate!=null&&ownership.Owns(callable.Delegate))||(target!=null&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(target)&&ownership.Owns(target.GetType()));if(!owned)continue;obj.Disconnect(name,callable);count++;}}}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"GodotObjectSweeper: signal scan of '{obj.GetType().Name}' failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Debug);}return count;}private static void CollectTree(Node node,List<GodotObject>objects,HashSet<ulong>seen){AddLive(node,objects,seen);foreach(var child in node.GetChildren(includeInternal:true))CollectTree(child,objects,seen);}private static void AddLive(GodotObject obj,List<GodotObject>objects,HashSet<ulong>seen){if(obj==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(obj))return;if(seen.Add(obj.GetInstanceId()))objects.Add(obj);}private static int Depth(Node node){var depth=0;for(var parent=node.GetParent();parent!=null;parent=parent.GetParent())depth++;return depth;}/// <summary>Managed wrappers GodotSharp tracks for disposal at shutdown (internal <c>DisposablesTracker</c>).</summary>
private static IEnumerable<GodotObject>TrackedObjects(){var tracker=typeof(GodotObject).Assembly.GetType("Godot.DisposablesTracker");var property=tracker?.GetProperty("GodotObjectInstances",BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static);if(property?.GetValue(null)is not IDictionary instances){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY","GodotObjectSweeper: DisposablesTracker not found; only scene-tree nodes are released",LogLevel.Warning);return Array.Empty<GodotObject>();}var result=new List<GodotObject>();foreach(DictionaryEntry entry in instances){if(entry.Key is WeakReference<GodotObject>weak&&weak.TryGetTarget(out var target))result.Add(target);}return result;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Collections;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using System.Runtime.Loader;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Lets GodotSharp forget the script types of an unloaded mod. <c>ScriptManagerBridge</c> keeps two static maps (script pointer ↔ type, <c>res://</c> path ↔ type); a type in them pins its assembly's load context. GodotSharp already knows how to drop them — on <see cref="AssemblyLoadContext.Unloading"/> it removes every type it recorded for that context — but records types only while <c>AlcReloadCfg.IsAlcReloadingEnabled</c> is set, and GodotPlugins configures that flag to "editor only" at startup. A running game (from the editor or exported) therefore never released mod script types. <see cref="EnableTracking"/> turns the flag on before the first mod assembly loads, so GodotSharp tracks mod types itself; <see cref="PurgeOwnedTypes"/> is the fallback for types registered before that point (and for a GodotSharp that renamed its internals): it removes owned types from both maps directly. Both touch private GodotSharp state through reflection; any mismatch is logged and the unload verification reports the resulting leak. </summary>
public static class GodotScriptBridgeUnload{private const BindingFlags Private=BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Static;private const BindingFlags PrivateInstance=BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance;private static bool trackingEnabled;/// <summary> Enables GodotSharp's per-context script type tracking. Idempotent; only meaningful inside the Godot runtime. </summary>
public static void EnableTracking(){if(trackingEnabled|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return;trackingEnabled=true;var flag=typeof(Godot.Bridge.AlcReloadCfg).GetField("IsAlcReloadingEnabled",Private);if(flag==null){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY","GodotScriptBridgeUnload: AlcReloadCfg.IsAlcReloadingEnabled not found; mod script types are purged manually on unload",LogLevel.Warning);return;}flag.SetValue(null,true);}/// <summary>Registers a mod context with GodotSharp so its script types are dropped when it unloads.</summary>
public static void Track(AssemblyLoadContext context){if(context==null|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return;EnableTracking();Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.TrackAlcForUnloading(context);}/// <summary> Removes owned types still present in the script maps (after the context's <c>Unloading</c> already ran). Returns how many entries were removed; zero is the healthy case. </summary>
public static int PurgeOwnedTypes(AssemblyOwnership ownership){if(ownership==null||ownership.IsEmpty|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return 0;try{var bridge=typeof(Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge);var removed=0;var scriptMap=bridge.GetField("_scriptTypeBiMap",Private)?.GetValue(null);if(scriptMap!=null){var rwLock=scriptMap.GetType().GetField("ReadWriteLock")?.GetValue(scriptMap)as System.Threading.ReaderWriterLockSlim;rwLock?.EnterWriteLock();try{removed+=RemoveOwned(scriptMap,"_scriptTypeMap",ownership,byValue:true);removed+=RemoveOwned(scriptMap,"_typeScriptMap",ownership,byValue:false);}finally{rwLock?.ExitWriteLock();}}var pathMap=bridge.GetField("_pathTypeBiMap",Private)?.GetValue(null);if(pathMap!=null){removed+=RemoveOwned(pathMap,"_pathTypeMap",ownership,byValue:true);removed+=RemoveOwned(pathMap,"_typePathMap",ownership,byValue:false);}return removed;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS_ASSEMBLY",$"GodotScriptBridgeUnload.PurgeOwnedTypes failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);return 0;}}private static int RemoveOwned(object map,string fieldName,AssemblyOwnership ownership,bool byValue){if(map.GetType().GetField(fieldName,PrivateInstance)?.GetValue(map)is not IDictionary dictionary)return 0;var doomed=new List<object>();foreach(DictionaryEntry entry in dictionary){var type=(byValue?entry.Value:entry.Key)as Type;if(ownership.Owns(type))doomed.Add(entry.Key);}foreach(var key in doomed)dictionary.Remove(key);return doomed.Count;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Reflection;using System.Text.Json;/// <summary> Flushes System.Text.Json's reflection caches before a mod context is released. Serializing a mod type leaves its <c>JsonTypeInfo</c> in the caching context of every options instance that touched it and, worse, emitted property accessors in the process-wide <c>ReflectionEmitCachingMemberAccessor</c> — both pin the mod's <c>AssemblyLoadContext</c> (found with <c>dotnet-dump gcroot</c> on the first in-process game switch). The runtime ships the exact operation for .NET hot reload: <c>JsonSerializerOptionsUpdateHandler.ClearCache</c> (registered as a <c>MetadataUpdateHandler</c>) clears every tracked options instance and the emitted-accessor cache. namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Godot;/// <summary> What an unload leaves behind: one weak reference per released mod context. Holding nothing strong is the whole point — the ticket must not be the reference that keeps a context alive. Collection is asynchronous in .NET (the runtime finishes an unload on a later GC once no frame, handle or type refers into the context), so verification is a separate, repeatable step: <see cref="Collect"/> right away (unit tests, synchronous reloads) or <see cref="CollectAsync"/> across a few engine frames (Godot releases the GC handles of freed objects at frame boundaries). </summary>
public sealed class ModUnloadTicket{private readonly List<(string ModId,WeakReference Context)>contexts;/// <summary>Wraps the weak references taken by <see cref="ModUnloader"/> (null = nothing was released).</summary>
public ModUnloadTicket(IEnumerable<(string ModId,WeakReference Context)>contexts){this.contexts=contexts!=null?new List<(string,WeakReference)>(contexts):new List<(string,WeakReference)>();}/// <summary>Ids of the mods whose contexts were released, in unload order.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>ModIds{get{var ids=new List<string>();foreach(var(modId,_)in contexts)ids.Add(modId);return ids;}}/// <summary>Ids of the mods whose context is still alive right now.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Alive{get{var alive=new List<string>();foreach(var(modId,context)in contexts){if(context.IsAlive)alive.Add(modId);}return alive;}}/// <summary>Forces collections until every context died or <paramref name="attempts"/> ran out; returns the survivors.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>Collect(int attempts=10){for(var i=0;i<attempts&&Alive.Count>0;i++){GC.Collect(2,GCCollectionMode.Forced,blocking:true,compacting:true);GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();}return Alive;}/// <summary> Like <see cref="Collect"/> but yields an engine frame between the attempts, so objects freed this frame release their handles first. Returns the survivors (empty = every context unloaded). </summary>
public async Task<IReadOnlyList<string>>CollectAsync(SceneTree tree,int frames=30,CancellationToken cancellationToken=default){for(var i=0;i<frames;i++){if(Collect(attempts:2).Count==0)return Array.Empty<string>();cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();await tree.ToSignal(tree,SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);}return Alive;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload{using System;using System.Collections;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Reflection;/// <summary> Drops references into dying mod assemblies from the long-lived parts of the process: the static fields of the surviving assemblies (the kernel and the mods that stay) and the objects reachable from them, plus a few explicit roots (autoload nodes). This is the generic answer to the registries and "first registration wins" bridges a mod fills from its initializer and nobody ever clears — <c>LightingBridge</c> slots in the kernel, <c>SceneEventController</c> timer lists, a kept mod's own registry singleton holding another mod's types (<c>BattleCoreRegistry.Instance._cores</c>): each pins the dying mod's <see cref="System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext"/> forever. Rules, applied to every field value on the way: <list type="bullet"> <item>a delegate loses its owned invocation-list entries;</item> <item>an owned object (instance of a mod type, a mod <see cref="Type"/>) is replaced by null;</item> <item>a list/set loses owned items; a dictionary loses entries with an owned key or value;</item> <item>objects whose type comes from a surviving host assembly, and the items of collections, are walked further (up to <see cref="MaxDepth"/>, each object once). Objects of framework or engine types are never walked — only their collection contents are — so the sweep stays bounded.</item> </list> Only fields whose declared type can hold a reference into mod code are read (<see cref="CanReferenceModCode"/>): reading a static field runs the type's static constructor, which must not happen as a side effect of an unload. Static <c>readonly</c> fields cannot be reassigned, so an owned value there is reported, not cleared; collections and objects behind them are still cleaned. Every change is reported, so the log shows which subsystem forgot to unregister — the sweep is the safety net, not the contract. </summary>
public sealed class StaticReferenceSweeper{/// <summary>How far the walk goes from a static field: field → object → collection → object → …</summary>
public const int MaxDepth=6;private const BindingFlags StaticFields=BindingFlags.Static|BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;private const BindingFlags InstanceFields=BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;private readonly AssemblyOwnership ownership;private readonly HashSet<Assembly>hosts;private readonly HashSet<object>visited=new(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance);private readonly List<string>report=new();private StaticReferenceSweeper(AssemblyOwnership ownership,HashSet<Assembly>hosts){this.ownership=ownership;this.hosts=hosts;}/// <summary> Sweeps the static fields of every type in <paramref name="hostAssemblies"/> (owned assemblies are skipped: their statics die with them), the objects of host types reachable from them and the objects in <paramref name="instances"/> (walked even when their type is not a host type, up to the first GodotSharp base class). Returns one line per change or uncleanable reference. </summary>
public static List<string>Sweep(AssemblyOwnership ownership,IEnumerable<Assembly>hostAssemblies,IEnumerable<object>instances=null){if(ownership==null||ownership.IsEmpty)return new List<string>();var hosts=new HashSet<Assembly>();foreach(var assembly in hostAssemblies??Array.Empty<Assembly>()){if(assembly!=null&& !assembly.IsDynamic&& !ownership.Owns(assembly))hosts.Add(assembly);}var sweeper=new StaticReferenceSweeper(ownership,hosts);foreach(var assembly in hosts){foreach(var type in LoadableTypes(assembly)){if(type.ContainsGenericParameters)continue;foreach(var field in ReferenceFields(type,StaticFields))sweeper.TrySweepField(field,null,MaxDepth);}}foreach(var instance in instances??Array.Empty<object>()){if(instance!=null&& !ownership.Owns(instance.GetType()))sweeper.SweepObject(instance,MaxDepth);}return sweeper.report;}private void TrySweepField(FieldInfo field,object owner,int depth){try{SweepField(field,owner,depth);}catch(Exception ex){report.Add($"{field.DeclaringType?.FullName}.{field.Name}: sweep failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");}}private void SweepField(FieldInfo field,object owner,int depth){if(field.IsLiteral||ownership.Owns(field.DeclaringType))return;var value=field.GetValue(owner);if(value==null)return;var where=$"{field.DeclaringType?.FullName}.{field.Name}";if(value is Delegate handler){var stripped=ownership.Strip(handler,out var changed);if(changed)Assign(field,owner,stripped,where,"delegate entries");return;}if(ownership.OwnsValue(value)){Assign(field,owner,null,where,"reference");return;}var removed=CleanValue(value,depth-1);if(removed>0)report.Add($"{where}: removed {removed} item(s)");}private void Assign(FieldInfo field,object owner,object value,string where,string what){if(field.IsInitOnly&&field.IsStatic){report.Add($"{where}: readonly static holds a mod {what}, cannot clear (pins the mod)");return;}field.SetValue(owner,value);report.Add($"{where}: cleared mod {what}");}/// <summary>Cleans a surviving value: a collection's owned items, or the fields of a host object. Returns removed collection items.</summary>
private int CleanValue(object value,int depth){if(depth<=0||value is string||value is Array||value is Type||value is Assembly)return 0;if(value is IEnumerable enumerable)return CleanCollection(enumerable,depth);if(hosts.Contains(value.GetType().Assembly))SweepObject(value,depth);return 0;}/// <summary>Walks the instance fields of <paramref name="instance"/> once.</summary>
private void SweepObject(object instance,int depth){if(depth<=0|| !visited.Add(instance))return;for(var type=instance.GetType();type!=null&&type!=typeof(object);type=type.BaseType){if(type.Assembly==typeof(Godot.GodotObject).Assembly)break;foreach(var field in ReferenceFields(type,InstanceFields))TrySweepField(field,instance,depth);}}private int CleanCollection(IEnumerable collection,int depth){if(!visited.Add(collection))return 0;try{switch(collection){case IDictionary dictionary when!dictionary.IsReadOnly:return CleanDictionary(dictionary,depth);case IList list when!list.IsReadOnly&& !list.IsFixedSize:return CleanList(list,depth);default:return CleanGenericCollection(collection,depth);}}catch(InvalidOperationException){// A collection mutated concurrently: skip, the next unload retries.
return 0;}}private int CleanDictionary(IDictionary dictionary,int depth){// IDictionary's own enumerator yields DictionaryEntry for every implementation (ConcurrentDictionary included); the generic one would yield KeyValuePair.
var entries=new List<DictionaryEntry>();var enumerator=dictionary.GetEnumerator();while(enumerator.MoveNext())entries.Add(enumerator.Entry);var doomed=new List<object>();var removed=0;foreach(var entry in entries){if(ownership.OwnsValue(entry.Key)||ownership.OwnsValue(entry.Value)){doomed.Add(entry.Key);continue;}if(entry.Value is Delegate handler){var stripped=ownership.Strip(handler,out var changed);if(!changed)continue;if(stripped==null)doomed.Add(entry.Key);else dictionary[entry.Key]=stripped;removed++;continue;}if(entry.Value!=null)removed+=CleanValue(entry.Value,depth-1);}foreach(var key in doomed)dictionary.Remove(key);return removed+doomed.Count;}private int CleanList(IList list,int depth){var removed=0;for(var i=list.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var item=list[i];if(ownership.OwnsValue(item)){list.RemoveAt(i);removed++;continue;}if(item!=null)removed+=CleanValue(item,depth-1);}return removed;}/// <summary>Sets and other generic collections exposing <c>ICollection&lt;T&gt;.Remove</c> (HashSet, LinkedList, SortedSet).</summary>
private int CleanGenericCollection(IEnumerable collection,int depth){var collectionInterface=GenericCollectionInterface(collection.GetType());if(collectionInterface==null||(bool)collectionInterface.GetProperty("IsReadOnly").GetValue(collection))return 0;var remove=collectionInterface.GetMethod("Remove");var elementIsValueType=collectionInterface.GetGenericArguments()[0].IsValueType;var items=new List<object>();foreach(var item in collection)items.Add(item);var removed=0;foreach(var item in items){if(ownership.OwnsValue(item)){if((bool)remove.Invoke(collection,new[]{item}))removed++;}else if(item!=null&& !elementIsValueType){removed+=CleanValue(item,depth-1);}}return removed;}private static Type GenericCollectionInterface(Type type){foreach(var candidate in type.GetInterfaces()){if(candidate.IsGenericType&&candidate.GetGenericTypeDefinition()==typeof(ICollection<>))return candidate;}return null;}private static IEnumerable<Type>LoadableTypes(Assembly assembly){try{return assembly.GetTypes();}catch(ReflectionTypeLoadException ex){var loaded=new List<Type>();foreach(var type in ex.Types){if(type!=null)loaded.Add(type);}return loaded;}}private static List<FieldInfo>ReferenceFields(Type type,BindingFlags flags){var result=new List<FieldInfo>();FieldInfo[]fields;try{fields=type.GetFields(flags);}catch(Exception){return result;}foreach(var field in fields){if(CanReferenceModCode(field.FieldType))result.Add(field);}return result;}/// <summary> Field types that can hold a reference into mod code. Strings, primitives, enums and arrays cannot; sealed non-generic classes of the framework and the engine (such as <c>StringName</c> in the Godot-generated <c>MethodName</c>/<c>SignalName</c> holders) cannot either. Sealed classes of the game itself can (a registry singleton holding mod types), so they are read. </summary>
private static bool CanReferenceModCode(Type fieldType){if(fieldType.IsPrimitive||fieldType.IsEnum||fieldType.IsPointer||fieldType.IsByRefLike||fieldType==typeof(string))return false;if(fieldType.IsArray)return false;if(fieldType.IsValueType)return fieldType.IsGenericType;if(fieldType.IsSealed&& !fieldType.IsGenericType&& !typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(fieldType)&&fieldType!=typeof(Type))return!IsPlatformAssembly(fieldType.Assembly);return true;}private static bool IsPlatformAssembly(Assembly assembly){var name=assembly.GetName().Name??string.Empty;return assembly==typeof(object).Assembly||assembly==typeof(Godot.GodotObject).Assembly||name.StartsWith("System.",StringComparison.Ordinal)||name.StartsWith("Microsoft.",StringComparison.Ordinal);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenarios{/// <summary> Extracts YAML-like front-matter metadata from scenario script text. Lines before a <c>---</c> separator or the first non-key:value line are parsed as <c>key: value</c> pairs. The command parsing half of the former ScenarioParser moved to the dialog_base engine mod; this metadata-only parser stays in the core because mod asset resolvers need it without a dialog dependency. </summary>
public static class ScenarioMetadata{/// <summary> Returns both the metadata dictionary and the remaining script content after the metadata block. </summary>
public static(Dictionary<string,string>metadata,string remainingText)ParseMetadata(string text){var metadata=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var lines=text.Split('\n');var contentStart=0;var inMetadata=true;for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){var line=lines[i].Trim();if(!inMetadata){continue;}if(line=="---"){contentStart=i+1;break;}if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)){contentStart=i;break;}var colonIdx=line.IndexOf(':');if(colonIdx>0){var key=line.Substring(0,colonIdx).Trim();var val=line.Substring(colonIdx+1).Trim();metadata[key]=val;}else{contentStart=i;break;}}var remaining=string.Join("\n",lines,contentStart,lines.Length-contentStart);return(metadata,remaining);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Abstract base for all nodes in the condition expression AST produced by <see cref="ConditionParser"/>. Every node implements <see cref="Evaluate(EvaluationContext)"/> — the tree is walked polymorphically rather than via a central switch statement. This design means that a mod assembly can define a custom <see cref="ConditionNode"/> subclass, and any code that constructs an AST containing it (including the core parser once extended) automatically evaluates it — no registration, no dispatch table, no <c>_ => true</c> fallthrough. Built-in node types: <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="AndNode"/> / <see cref="OrNode"/> — binary boolean combinators with short-circuit</item> <item><see cref="NotNode"/> — unary negation</item> <item><see cref="BoolLiteral"/> — constant <c>true</c> / <c>false</c></item> <item><see cref="FlagCondition"/> — runtime flag comparison</item> <item><see cref="QuestMethodCondition"/> — quest tag membership</item> <item><see cref="QuestPropCondition"/> — quest int-property comparison</item> <item><see cref="QuestBoolPropCondition"/> — quest boolean property</item> </list> </summary>
public abstract class ConditionNode:ICondition{/// <summary> Evaluates this node against the given runtime context and returns the boolean result. Called recursively — for combinator nodes like <see cref="AndNode"/> this triggers a depth-first walk. </summary> <param name="ctx">Runtime state: flag dictionary and quest factory.</param>
public abstract bool Evaluate(EvaluationContext ctx);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Tokenizes condition expression strings and delegates tree construction to the pluggable <see cref="Parsing.ExpressionParser"/>. Operators are resolved through <see cref="Parsing.OperatorRegistry"/>; leaf values through <see cref="Parsing.LeafParserRegistry"/>. Mods can register custom parsers in either registry to extend the condition DSL without touching core code. </summary>
public static class ConditionParser{/// <summary>Lexical tokens of the condition grammar: literals, punctuation, logical operators, and comparison operators.</summary>
public enum TokenType{Ident,Number,String,Dot,LParen,RParen,Comma,And,Or,Not,Eq,Neq,Ge,Le,Gt,Lt,EOF}/// <summary>A single lexical token with its <see cref="TokenType"/> and source text.</summary>
public class Token{/// <summary>Token category produced by the tokenizer.</summary>
public TokenType Type;/// <summary>Raw source text of the token (operators keep their spelling, e.g. "&amp;&amp;").</summary>
public string Value;}private class Tokenizer{private readonly string input;private int pos;private readonly List<Token>tokens=new();public Tokenizer(string input){this.input=input;}/// <summary>Runs the tokenizer over the whole input and returns the token list ending with an EOF token.</summary>
public List<Token>Tokenize(){tokens.Clear();pos=0;while(pos<input.Length){SkipWhitespace();if(pos>=input.Length)break;var c=input[pos];if(c=='('){Add(TokenType.LParen,"(");pos++;}else if(c==')'){Add(TokenType.RParen,")");pos++;}else if(c==','){Add(TokenType.Comma,",");pos++;}else if(c=='.'){Add(TokenType.Dot,".");pos++;}else if(c=='!'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Neq,"!=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Not,"!");pos++;}}else if(c=='='){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Eq,"==");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '='");}else if(c=='>'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Ge,">=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Gt,">");pos++;}}else if(c=='<'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='='){Add(TokenType.Le,"<=");pos+=2;}else{Add(TokenType.Lt,"<");pos++;}}else if(c=='&'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='&'){Add(TokenType.And,"&&");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '&'");}else if(c=='|'){if(pos+1<input.Length&&input[pos+1]=='|'){Add(TokenType.Or,"||");pos+=2;}else throw Error("expected '|'");}else if(c=='"'||c=='\''){var quote=c;pos++;var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&input[pos]!=quote)pos++;if(pos>=input.Length)throw Error("unterminated string");var val=input.Substring(start,pos-start);Add(TokenType.String,val);pos++;}else if(char.IsDigit(c)){var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&char.IsDigit(input[pos]))pos++;Add(TokenType.Number,input.Substring(start,pos-start));}else if(char.IsLetter(c)||c=='_'){var start=pos;while(pos<input.Length&&(char.IsLetterOrDigit(input[pos])||input[pos]=='_'))pos++;Add(TokenType.Ident,input.Substring(start,pos-start));}else{throw Error($"unexpected character '{c}'");}}Add(TokenType.EOF,"");return tokens;}private void SkipWhitespace(){while(pos<input.Length&&char.IsWhiteSpace(input[pos]))pos++;}private void Add(TokenType type,string value){tokens.Add(new Token{Type=type,Value=value});}private FormatException Error(string msg){return new FormatException($"Condition parse error at pos {pos}: {msg}\n{input}\n{new string(' ', pos)}^");}}/// <summary> Parses a condition expression string into a <see cref="ConditionNode"/> AST. Delegates tokenisation to the built-in tokenizer and tree construction to the pluggable <see cref="Parsing.ExpressionParser"/> which resolves operators through <see cref="Parsing.OperatorRegistry"/> and leaf values through <see cref="Parsing.LeafParserRegistry"/>. Returns <c>null</c> for null, empty, or whitespace-only input. Throws <see cref="FormatException"/> on syntax errors with position information. </summary> <param name="input">The condition expression string to parse.</param>
public static ConditionNode Parse(string input){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))return null;var tokenizer=new Tokenizer(input);var tokens=tokenizer.Tokenize();return(ConditionNode)new Parsing.ExpressionParser().Parse(tokens);}}}
