using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing{/// <summary> Auto-discovering registry of <see cref="ISectionParser"/> implementations, indexed by SectionType. First-registered-wins; Roslyn-compiled mod assemblies can add section types via <see cref="RegisterAssembly"/>. <para/> The registry stores parser <b>types</b>, not instances, and <see cref="Get"/> creates a fresh parser per section. Parsers carry per-section state between <c>Open</c>, the property lines and <c>Close</c>; sharing one instance broke as soon as two parses ran concurrently (parallel unit tests, background scene loads), because one parse could null out another's current parser mid-section. Instantiating per call keeps <see cref="TscnParser"/> stateless and therefore safe to use from parallel threads. <para/> The registry instance lives in <see cref="AppServices.Current"/>; the static members below are a facade delegating to it, so existing callers keep working unchanged. </summary>
public class SectionParserRegistry:IGameRegistry{private readonly object Sync=new();private Dictionary<string,Type>_parsers;private bool built;/// <summary>Shared instance the static facade delegates to.</summary>
private static SectionParserRegistry Owned=>AppServices.Current.SectionParsers;/// <summary> Creates an empty registry: cheap and side-effect free per the IGameRegistry contract. <see cref="Rebuild"/> fills the data. </summary>
internal SectionParserRegistry(){}/// <inheritdoc />
public string Id=>"tscn_section_parsers";/// <summary> Scans all loaded assemblies for <see cref="ISectionParser"/> implementations unless already built. Thread-safe; keeps the old Initialize idempotence: later calls are no-ops until cleared. </summary>
public void EnsureBuilt(){lock(Sync){if(built)return;RescanLocked();built=true;}}/// <summary> Forced full re-scan of all loaded assemblies (assembly order equals load order, so first-registered-wins keeps core parsers ahead of mod-added ones), replacing the previous table. Safe to call repeatedly; picks up assemblies loaded after the previous build. </summary>
public void Rebuild(){lock(Sync){RescanLocked();built=true;}}/// <summary> Drops all registered parser types; the next build re-scans the assemblies. Called on mod reload through AppServices.ClearRegistries. </summary>
public void Clear(){lock(Sync){_parsers=null;built=false;}}// ---- Static facade (legacy API, unchanged for callers) ------------ <summary>Legacy entry point; delegates to the shared instance.</summary>
public static void Initialize()=>Owned.EnsureBuilt();/// <summary>Scans a newly-loaded mod assembly for <see cref="ISectionParser"/> implementations and registers them.</summary>
public static void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly)=>Owned.AddFromAssembly(assembly);/// <summary>Creates a fresh parser instance for the given section type, or null when none is registered.</summary>
public static ISectionParser Get(string sectionType)=>Owned.GetParser(sectionType);/// <summary>Unload pass: drops parser types contributed by the given assembly. Delegates to the shared instance.</summary>
public static void UnregisterAssembly(Assembly assembly)=>Owned.RemoveFromAssembly(assembly);// ---- Instance implementation -------------------------------------- <summary> Removes section parser types contributed by the given assembly — the unload pass of the assembly consumer pipeline. Core parsers remain: they are re-discovered by the next full build anyway. </summary>
public void RemoveFromAssembly(Assembly assembly){lock(Sync){if(_parsers==null)return;foreach(var key in _parsers.Where(kvp=>kvp.Value.Assembly==assembly).Select(kvp=>kvp.Key).ToList())_parsers.Remove(key);}}/// <summary>Full re-scan; caller must hold <see cref="Sync"/>.</summary>
private void RescanLocked(){var parsers=new Dictionary<string,Type>();foreach(var parser in Reflections.FindAndCreate<ISectionParser>()){if(!parsers.ContainsKey(parser.SectionType))parsers[parser.SectionType]=parser.GetType();}_parsers=parsers;}private void AddFromAssembly(Assembly assembly){EnsureBuilt();lock(Sync){foreach(var parser in Reflections.FindAndCreate<ISectionParser>(assembly)){if(!_parsers.ContainsKey(parser.SectionType))_parsers[parser.SectionType]=parser.GetType();}}}private ISectionParser GetParser(string sectionType){EnsureBuilt();lock(Sync){if(!_parsers.TryGetValue(sectionType,out var type))return null;return(ISectionParser)Activator.CreateInstance(type);}}}}

public string PropertyKey{get;set;}/// <summary>Raw right-hand side for <see cref="TscnTokenType.Property"/> tokens; parsing is deferred to <see cref="TscnPropertyParser"/>.</summary>
public string PropertyValue{get;set;}/// <summary>1-based source line, for diagnostics.</summary>

public static TscnToken Prop(string key,string value,int line)=>new(){Type=TscnTokenType.Property,PropertyKey=key,PropertyValue=value,LineNumber=line};/// <summary>Factory for an empty line token (preserved for source position tracking).</summary>
public static TscnToken EmptyLine(int line)=>new(){Type=TscnTokenType.Empty,LineNumber=line};}/// <summary> Line-by-line tokenizer for .tscn files. Empty lines and comment lines (starting with <c>;</c>) are skipped. <para/> Does not parse property values — that is deferred to <see cref="TscnPropertyParser"/> to keep the lexer simple and avoid creating Godot objects during tokenization. Dictionary<string,string>();var spaceIdx=inner.IndexOf(' ');string sectionName;string using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing{/// <summary> Orchestrator for .tscn parsing. Delegates section handling to <see cref="SectionParserRegistry"/> — no section-specific logic lives here. Produces a <see cref="ParsedScene"/> without creating Godot objects. </summary>
public class TscnParser{/// <summary>Parses .tscn source text into a ParsedScene. The scene contains flat lists of resources, nodes, and connections ready for <see cref="TscnBuild.SceneBuilder"/>.</summary>
public ParsedScene Parse(string source){var tokens=new TscnLexer().Tokenize(source);var scene=new ParsedScene();ISectionParser current=null;foreach(var token in tokens){if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.SectionHeader){current?.Close(scene);current=SectionParserRegistry.Get(token.SectionName);current?.Open(token.SectionAttrs??new Dictionary<string,string>());}else if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.Property&&current!=null){current.Property(token.PropertyKey,token.PropertyValue);}}current?.Close(scene);return scene;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Patching;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnBuild;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> Mod-integrated resolver for runtime TSCN scene loading. Collects .tscn files from all mods' "scenes/" directories into a deduplicated index (later mods override earlier ones), then resolves scenes by mod-relative path without requiring callers to know which mod provides the file. <para/> Connects <see cref="TscnParser"/> and <see cref="SceneBuilder"/> to the mod system: reads source text through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/>, handles recursive PackedScene instantiation with cycle detection, and caches both parsed scenes and built node trees. <para/> Registered as <c>"tscn_scenes"</c> resolver in <see cref="ModManager"/>. Cleared on mod reload (<see cref="ClearCache"/>). </summary>
public class TscnSceneResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"tscn_scenes";private Dictionary<string,FileEntry>_sceneIndex;private readonly Dictionary<string,ParsedScene>_parsedCache=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,Node>_builtCache=new();private readonly TscnParser _parser=new();private readonly HashSet<string>_buildingPaths=new();private ParsedScene _resolvingScene;/// <summary> Collects all .tscn scene files from every mod's "scenes/" directory. Builds a flat index keyed by mod-relative path (e.g. "scenes/main_menu.tscn"). Later mods in load order override earlier ones with the same path. The result is cached until <see cref="ClearCache"/> is called. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,FileEntry>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_sceneIndex!=null)return _sceneIndex;var result=new Dictionary<string,FileEntry>();var fileListResolver=Context.GetResolver<FileListResolver>();if(fileListResolver==null){_sceneIndex=result;return result;}var files=fileListResolver.Collect("scenes");foreach(var kvp in files){var ext=Path.GetExtension(kvp.Key);if(ext.Equals(".tscn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))result[kvp.Value.FullPath]=kvp.Value;}_sceneIndex=result;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"Collect → {result.Count} scene(s)");return result;}/// <summary> Loads, parses, and builds a .tscn scene from the mod system. The scene is resolved by its mod-relative path (e.g. "scenes/main_menu.tscn") — the resolver determines which mod provides the file, honouring load-order overrides. Built nodes are cached and duplicated on each hit so the caller receives a fresh instance every time. </summary> <param name="scenePath"> Mod-relative path to the .tscn file, may optionally start with "res://" (stripped internally). </param>
public Node LoadAndBuild(string scenePath){scenePath=NormalizeResourcePath(scenePath);var index=Collect();string modId=null;if(index.TryGetValue(scenePath,out var entry))modId=entry.ModId;else{var provider=ResolveProviderForPath(scenePath,out modId);if(provider==null){if(HasScenePatches(scenePath))return BuildNativePatched(scenePath);var native=LoadNative(scenePath);if(native!=null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: native fallback '{scenePath}' → root='{native.Name}' ({native.GetType().Name})");return native;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: scene '{scenePath}' not found in any mod",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}var cacheKey=scenePath;if(_builtCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey,out var cached)){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: HIT cached '{cacheKey}'",LogLevel.Debug);return DuplicateBuilt(cached);}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: loading '{cacheKey}' from mod '{modId}'...");if(!_buildingPaths.Add(cacheKey)){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver: circular reference detected for '{cacheKey}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}try{var parsed=LoadAndParse(scenePath,modId);if(parsed==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: FAILED parse for '{cacheKey}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var previousScene=_resolvingScene;_resolvingScene=parsed;var root=new SceneBuilder().Build(parsed,InstanceLoader,ResolveExtResource);_resolvingScene=previousScene;if(root!=null){_builtCache[cacheKey]=root;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndBuild: OK '{cacheKey}' → root='{root.Name}' ({root.GetType().Name})");return DuplicateBuilt(root);}return null;}finally{_buildingPaths.Remove(cacheKey);}}private Node DuplicateBuilt(Node root){// Nodes carry registered Godot scripts now, so a Duplicate keeps the script instance and its lifecycle callbacks working.
return root.Duplicate();}private ParsedScene LoadAndParse(string scenePath,string resolvedModId){var cacheKey=scenePath;if(_parsedCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey,out var cached)){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: HIT parsed cache '{cacheKey}'",LogLevel.Debug);return cached;}var mod=Context.GetMod(resolvedModId);var provider=mod?.FileProvider;if(provider==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: provider NOT FOUND for mod '{resolvedModId}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: reading '{scenePath}' from mod='{resolvedModId}', provider={provider.GetType().Name}");var text=provider.ReadFileText(scenePath);if(text==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: file text is NULL for path='{scenePath}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: got {text.Length} chars, parsing...");var parsed=ApplyScenePatches(scenePath,_parser.Parse(text));_parsedCache[cacheKey]=parsed;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.LoadAndParse: parsed OK — {parsed.ExtResources.Count} ext_resources, {parsed.SubResources.Count} sub_resources, {parsed.Nodes.Count} nodes, entry_point='{parsed.EntryPointClass ?? "none"}'");return parsed;}/// <summary> Applies all scene patches targeting <paramref name="scenePath"/> to the freshly parsed scene, before it is cached. Patch layers cascade in mod load order (see <see cref="ScenePatchResolver"/>); a scene without patches passes through untouched. </summary>
private ParsedScene ApplyScenePatches(string scenePath,ParsedScene parsed){var patchResolver=Context?.GetResolver<ScenePatchResolver>();var patches=patchResolver?.GetPatches(scenePath);if(patches==null||patches.Count==0)return parsed;var applier=new ScenePatchApplier();if(applier.ApplyAll(parsed,patches))GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver: applied {patches.Count} patch layer(s) to '{scenePath}'");else GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver: patch layers for '{scenePath}' reported errors",LogLevel.Warning);return parsed;}/// <summary> True when at least one mod patches this scene, including native <c>res://</c> scenes. The static facade uses it to route patched native scenes through the runtime builder instead of Godot's native loader. </summary>
public bool HasScenePatches(string scenePath){var patchResolver=Context?.GetResolver<ScenePatchResolver>();return patchResolver?.HasPatches(NormalizeResourcePath(scenePath))==true;}/// <summary> Builds a native <c>res://</c> scene through the runtime pipeline so its patches apply. Native scenes normally bypass <see cref="TscnParser"/> via <see cref="LoadNative"/>, which is exactly why a patched one must be read from disk and patched before build. Parsed and built results are cached like mod scenes. </summary>
private Node BuildNativePatched(string scenePath){if(_builtCache.TryGetValue(scenePath,out var cached))return(Node)cached.Duplicate();if(!_buildingPaths.Add(scenePath)){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver: circular reference detected for '{scenePath}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}try{var text=ReadNativeText(scenePath);if(text==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.BuildNativePatched: cannot read 'res://{scenePath}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var parsed=ApplyScenePatches(scenePath,_parser.Parse(text));_parsedCache[scenePath]=parsed;var previousScene=_resolvingScene;_resolvingScene=parsed;var root=new SceneBuilder().Build(parsed,InstanceLoader,ResolveExtResource);_resolvingScene=previousScene;if(root!=null){_builtCache[scenePath]=root;GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.BuildNativePatched: OK '{scenePath}' → root='{root.Name}' ({root.GetType().Name})");return(Node)root.Duplicate();}return null;}finally{_buildingPaths.Remove(scenePath);}}private static string ReadNativeText(string scenePath){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return null;try{return Godot.FileAccess.GetFileAsString("res://"+scenePath);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver: failed to read 'res://{scenePath}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}private Node InstanceLoader(string scenePath){return LoadAndBuild(scenePath);}/// <summary> Resolves ext_resource references for non-Script/non-PackedScene types (Texture2D, etc.). Looks up the ext_resource by refId in the currently building scene, normalises the path (strips res:// prefix), searches all mods in priority order for the file, reads raw bytes via IModFileProvider, and constructs the appropriate Godot Resource. </summary>
private Resource ResolveExtResource(string refId){if(_resolvingScene==null)return null;var extRes=_resolvingScene.ExtResources.FirstOrDefault(r=>r.Id==refId);if(extRes==null)return null;var path=NormalizeResourcePath(extRes.Path);GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.ResolveExtResource: refId='{refId}' type='{extRes.Type}' path='{extRes.Path}' → norm='{path}'",LogLevel.Debug);var provider=ResolveProviderForPath(path,out var modId);if(provider==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.ResolveExtResource: provider NOT FOUND for '{path}'",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}var bytes=provider.ReadFileBinary(path);if(bytes==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.ResolveExtResource: bytes NULL for '{path}'",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}var builder=ExtResourceBuilderRegistry.Get(extRes.Type)??ExtResourceBuilderRegistry.Get("Texture");if(builder==null){GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.ResolveExtResource: no builder for type='{extRes.Type}'",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}var resource=builder.Build(bytes,path);GameLogger.Log("TSCN",$"TscnSceneResolver.ResolveExtResource: OK type='{extRes.Type}' → {resource?.GetType().Name ?? "null"}",LogLevel.Debug);return resource;}/// <summary> Canonicalises a resource path: forward slashes, no <c>res://</c> scheme, no leading slash and no <c>mods/&lt;mod&gt;/</c> prefix. The last form is what the Godot editor writes when a file of one mod references a file of another mod, so stripping it lets editor-authored <c>ext_resource</c> paths and patch additions resolve unchanged. </summary>
private static string NormalizeResourcePath(string path){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return path;var n=path.Replace('\\','/');if(n.StartsWith("res://",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))n=n.Substring(6);n=n.TrimStart('/');var segments=n.Split('/');if(segments.Length>=3&&segments[0].Equals("mods",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))n=string.Join("/",segments,2,segments.Length-2);return n;}/// <summary> Fallback for scenes that still live in the project (res://) rather than in a mod. Godot's <c>ResourceLoader</c> cannot see files inside <c>mods/</c>, but native PackedScenes referenced from mod scenes (or deliberately left native) must still instantiate, mirroring PackedScene's instantiate-per-call contract for the resolver. </summary>
private static Node LoadNative(string scenePath){var resPath="res://"+scenePath;var ext=Path.GetExtension(resPath);if(!ext.Equals(".tscn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !ext.Equals(".scn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !ext.Equals(".escn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return null;if(!ResourceLoader.Exists(resPath))return null;var packed=ResourceLoader.Load<PackedScene>(resPath);return packed?.Instantiate();}private IModFileProvider ResolveProviderForPath(string scenePath,out string modId){var orderedIds=Context.GetOrderedModIds();foreach(var id in orderedIds){var mod=Context.GetMod(id);if(mod?.FileProvider==null)continue;if(mod.FileProvider.FileExists(scenePath)){modId=id;return mod.FileProvider;}}foreach(var kvp in Context.Mods){if(kvp.Value.FileProvider?.FileExists(scenePath)==true){modId=kvp.Key;return kvp.Value.FileProvider;}}modId=null;return null;}/// <summary> Drops the cached parse/build results for a single scene so the next <see cref="LoadAndBuild"/> call re-reads the source file from disk and rebuilds the node tree. Used by tooling after the scene text has been edited and saved, without flushing the whole resolver cache. </summary> <param name="scenePath">Mod-relative scene path (e.g. "scenes/foo.tscn").</param>
public void Invalidate(string scenePath){scenePath=NormalizeResourcePath(scenePath);_parsedCache.Remove(scenePath);_builtCache.Remove(scenePath);}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_sceneIndex=null;_parsedCache.Clear();_builtCache.Clear();_buildingPaths.Clear();_resolvingScene=null;}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="TscnSceneResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class TscnScenes{/// <summary> Loads and builds a scene by mod-relative path. No mod id parameter: the resolver locates the owning mod by walking loaded mods in load-order priority (native <c>res://</c> scenes fall back to the engine loader, unless patched). Returns null when nothing resolves. </summary>
public static Node LoadAndBuild(string scenePath)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TscnSceneResolver>()?.LoadAndBuild(scenePath);/// <summary> True when the scene is patched, including native <c>res://</c> scenes that normally bypass the runtime pipeline. Scene routing uses this to send patched native scenes through <see cref="LoadAndBuild"/>. </summary>
public static bool HasPatches(string scenePath)=>ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<TscnSceneResolver>()?.HasScenePatches(scenePath)??false;}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Smart container for a single logical entity (e.g. player stats, world map, textures). Each block carries its own schema version and a byte payload. Provides three data access modes: <list type="number"> <item><b>Key-value API</b> (GetInt/SetInt etc.) — lazy access via an internal dictionary, serialised to JSON on flush.</item> <item><b>JSON API</b> (ReadJson/WriteJson) — direct serialisation/deserialisation of an object into the payload.</item> <item><b>Binary API</b> (GetBytes/SetBytes) — raw byte access for textures, compressed data, etc.</item> </list> Key-value and JSON methods conflict: calling <c>WriteJson</c> overwrites the internal dictionary. Calling <c>SetInt</c> after <c>WriteJson</c> replaces the JSON object with a dictionary. </summary>
public class DataBlob{/// <summary>Schema version of the data in this block (default 1).</summary>
public int Version{get;set;}=1;private byte[]_payload=Array.Empty<byte>();/// <summary> Raw byte payload. Assigning <c>null</c> is coerced to an empty array. Unlike <see cref="GetBytes"/>, reading this property does <b>not</b> flush pending key-value entries into the bytes first. </summary>
public byte[]Payload{get=>_payload;set=>_payload=value??Array.Empty<byte>();}// Lazy cache of _payload deserialised as Dictionary. Private field, not persisted by System.Text.Json serialisation.
private Dictionary<string,object>_dict;/// <summary>Empty blob with the default schema version 1.</summary>
public DataBlob(){}/// <summary>Empty blob with an explicit schema version.</summary>
public DataBlob(int version){Version=version;}/// <summary>Creates a blob of the given version with <paramref name="data"/> serialized as the JSON payload.</summary>
public DataBlob(int version,object data){Version=version;WriteJson(data);}/// <summary>Creates a raw binary blob (version stays at the default 1).</summary>
public DataBlob(byte[]data){_payload=data??Array.Empty<byte>();}/// <summary>Reads an integer key, falling back to <paramref name="defaultValue"/> when missing or unparseable.</summary>
public int GetInt(string key,int defaultValue=0){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number)return je.GetInt32();try{return Convert.ToInt32(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}/// <summary>Reads a float key, falling back to <paramref name="defaultValue"/> when missing or unparseable.</summary>
public float GetFloat(string key,float defaultValue=0f){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number)return je.GetSingle();try{return Convert.ToSingle(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}/// <summary>Reads a string key, falling back to <paramref name="defaultValue"/> when missing.</summary>
public string GetString(string key,string defaultValue=""){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.String)return je.GetString()??defaultValue;return val?.ToString()??defaultValue;}return defaultValue;}/// <summary>Reads a bool key, falling back to <paramref name="defaultValue"/> when missing or unparseable.</summary>
public bool GetBool(string key,bool defaultValue=false){EnsureDictLoaded();if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var val)){if(val is JsonElement je&&(je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.True||je.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.False))return je.GetBoolean();try{return Convert.ToBoolean(val);}catch{return defaultValue;}}return defaultValue;}/// <summary>Writes an integer key (lazily flushed to the payload on <see cref="GetBytes"/>).</summary>
public void SetInt(string key,int value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}/// <summary>Writes a float key (lazily flushed to the payload on <see cref="GetBytes"/>).</summary>
public void SetFloat(string key,float value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}/// <summary>Writes a string key; null is stored as an empty string (lazily flushed on <see cref="GetBytes"/>).</summary>
public void SetString(string key,string value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value??"";}/// <summary>Writes a bool key (lazily flushed to the payload on <see cref="GetBytes"/>).</summary>
public void SetBool(string key,bool value){EnsureDictLoaded();_dict[key]=value;}/// <summary> Deserialises the payload as the given type. Returns <c>new T()</c> when the payload is empty or invalid. </summary>
public T ReadJson<T>()where T:new(){if(_payload==null||_payload.Length==0)return new T();try{var result=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(_payload,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return result??new T();}catch{return new T();}}/// <summary> Serialises an object into the payload, overwriting the internal dictionary if one exists. </summary>
public void WriteJson<T>(T data){if(data==null){_payload=Array.Empty<byte>();_dict=null;return;}_payload=JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(data,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);_dict=null;}/// <summary> Returns the raw byte payload. If data was written via the key-value API, flushes the dictionary to JSON first. </summary>
public byte[]GetBytes(){EnsurePayloadFromDict();return _payload;}/// <summary>Replaces the payload with raw bytes and discards any pending key-value dictionary.</summary>
public void SetBytes(byte[]data){_payload=data??Array.Empty<byte>();_dict=null;}private void EnsureDictLoaded(){if(_dict!=null)return;_dict=new Dictionary<string,object>();if(_payload==null||_payload.Length==0)return;try{var deserialized=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string,object>>(_payload,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(deserialized!=null)_dict=deserialized;}catch{_dict=new Dictionary<string,object>();}}private void EnsurePayloadFromDict(){if(_dict!=null){_payload=JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(_dict,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;/// <summary> The choices the display settings offer and how a saved value maps onto them — shared by the first-run <c>Launcher</c> and the settings menu of <c>menu_base</c>, so both show the same lists and read the same file. Pure data (no engine calls); <see cref="DisplaySettingsService"/> puts the chosen values on the window. <para/> Window size ("resolution") matters only in windowed mode: the fullscreen modes run at the monitor's own resolution, and the canvas_items stretch scales the base viewport into whatever the window is. The size list is therefore built per monitor and never offers a window larger than the monitor; a size the player saved earlier stays selectable even when it is not a common one (a window resized on another machine). </summary>
public static class DisplayOptions{/// <summary>Window modes in menu order; minimized is never offered.</summary>
public static readonly DisplayServer.WindowMode[]WindowModes={DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed,DisplayServer.WindowMode.Maximized,DisplayServer.WindowMode.Fullscreen,DisplayServer.WindowMode.ExclusiveFullscreen,};/// <summary>Locale keys of <see cref="WindowModes"/>, same order.</summary>
public static readonly string[]WindowModeKeys={"settings/window_mode_windowed","settings/window_mode_maximized","settings/window_mode_borderless","settings/window_mode_fullscreen",};/// <summary>Frame rate caps in menu order; 0 = unlimited.</summary>
public static readonly int[]FrameRates={0,30,60,120,144,165,240};private static readonly Vector2I[]CommonSizes={new(1280,720),new(1280,800),new(1366,768),new(1440,900),new(1600,900),new(1680,1050),new(1920,1024),new(1920,1080),new(1920,1200),new(2560,1080),new(2560,1440),new(2560,1600),new(3440,1440),new(3840,2160),};/// <summary>Menu index of a saved window mode; an unknown or minimized mode shows as windowed (index 0).</summary>
public static int WindowModeIndex(int mode){for(var i=0;i<WindowModes.Length;i++){if((int)WindowModes[i]==mode)return i;}return 0;}/// <summary>True for the mode whose window size the player chooses (windowed).</summary>
public static bool UsesWindowSize(int mode)=>mode==(int)DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed;/// <summary>Menu index of a saved frame rate cap; a value not in <see cref="FrameRates"/> shows as the nearest higher cap, above all of them as unlimited.</summary>
public static int FrameRateIndex(int fps){if(fps<=0)return 0;for(var i=1;i<FrameRates.Length;i++){if(FrameRates[i]>=fps)return i;}return 0;}/// <summary> Window sizes for a monitor of size <paramref name="screen"/>: the common sizes that fit, the monitor's own size and the <paramref name="saved"/> size when it fits, without repeats, sorted by width then height. </summary>
public static List<Vector2I>WindowSizes(Vector2I screen,Vector2I saved){var result=new List<Vector2I>();foreach(var size in CommonSizes)AddIfFits(result,size,screen);AddIfFits(result,screen,screen);AddIfFits(result,saved,screen);result.Sort(CompareSizes);return result;}/// <summary> Index of <paramref name="size"/> in <paramref name="sizes"/>, or of the largest size not bigger than it; 0 when every size is bigger. </summary>
public static int WindowSizeIndex(List<Vector2I>sizes,Vector2I size){var best=0;for(var i=0;i<sizes.Count;i++){if(sizes[i]==size)return i;if(sizes[i].X<=size.X&&sizes[i].Y<=size.Y)best=i;}return best;}/// <summary> Shrinks <paramref name="size"/> to fit <paramref name="area"/> (the monitor's usable rectangle: without the taskbar), so a saved window never opens bigger than the monitor it is moved to. </summary>
public static Vector2I Fit(Vector2I size,Vector2I area){return new Vector2I(Mathf.Clamp(size.X,1,Mathf.Max(1,area.X)),Mathf.Clamp(size.Y,1,Mathf.Max(1,area.Y)));}private static void AddIfFits(List<Vector2I>sizes,Vector2I size,Vector2I screen){if(size.X<=0||size.Y<=0||size.X>screen.X||size.Y>screen.Y||sizes.Contains(size))return;sizes.Add(size);}private static int CompareSizes(Vector2I a,Vector2I b)=>a.X!=b.X?a.X.CompareTo(b.X):a.Y.CompareTo(b.Y);}}

===== FILE Core/Settings/DisplaySettingsService.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Puts the saved display settings (<see cref="SettingsData"/>) on the game window: monitor, window mode, window size, V-Sync and the frame rate cap. The launcher calls <see cref="Apply"/> at start, the settings menu calls <see cref="ApplyWindow"/> / <see cref="ApplyRendering"/> on every change, so what the player sees is always what the next start restores. <para/> Moving a fullscreen window to another monitor is unreliable on some platforms, so the window leaves fullscreen first, moves, and enters the mode again on the new monitor. A windowed window is sized to fit the monitor's usable area and centred on it — otherwise a size picked on a big monitor opens half off-screen on a small one. Nothing is touched when the window is already in the requested state, so changing V-Sync does not flicker a fullscreen window. </summary>
public static class DisplaySettingsService{/// <summary>Number of monitors, at least 1.</summary>
public static int ScreenCount=>Mathf.Max(1,DisplayServer.GetScreenCount());/// <summary><paramref name="screen"/> when such a monitor exists, the primary monitor otherwise (a monitor was unplugged).</summary>
public static int ClampScreen(int screen)=>screen>=0&&screen<ScreenCount?screen:DisplayServer.GetPrimaryScreen();/// <summary>Applies everything: window first, then V-Sync and the frame rate cap.</summary>
public static void Apply(SettingsData settings){if(settings==null)return;ApplyWindow(settings);ApplyRendering(settings);}/// <summary>Monitor, window mode and (in windowed mode) the centred window size.</summary>
public static void ApplyWindow(SettingsData settings){var screen=ClampScreen(settings.CurrentScreen);var mode=DisplayOptions.WindowModes[DisplayOptions.WindowModeIndex(settings.WindowMode)];if(DisplayServer.WindowGetCurrentScreen()!=screen){if(DisplayServer.WindowGetMode()!=DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed)DisplayServer.WindowSetMode(DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed);DisplayServer.WindowSetCurrentScreen(screen);}if(mode==DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed){if(DisplayServer.WindowGetMode()!=DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed)DisplayServer.WindowSetMode(DisplayServer.WindowMode.Windowed);var area=DisplayServer.ScreenGetUsableRect(screen);var size=DisplayOptions.Fit(new Vector2I(settings.ResolutionWidth,settings.ResolutionHeight),area.Size);DisplayServer.WindowSetSize(size);DisplayServer.WindowSetPosition(area.Position+(area.Size-size)/2);}else if(DisplayServer.WindowGetMode()!=mode){DisplayServer.WindowSetMode(mode);}GameLogger.Log("UI",$"display settings: screen {screen}, mode {mode}, window {DisplayServer.WindowGetSize()}");}/// <summary>V-Sync and the frame rate cap; no window changes.</summary>
public static void ApplyRendering(SettingsData settings){DisplayServer.WindowSetVsyncMode(settings.VsyncEnabled?DisplayServer.VSyncMode.Enabled:DisplayServer.VSyncMode.Disabled);Engine.MaxFps=Mathf.Max(0,settings.MaxFps);}}}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Settings.Configs;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Thread-safe singleton holding deserialised application configuration from <c>res://config/game_config.json</c>. Wraps audio, display, language, and logging sections. Initialisation is lazy — the static <see cref="Instance"/> accessor triggers <see cref="Load"/> on first use. If the Godot engine is not running (e.g. in unit tests), loading is silently skipped so the class degrades to defaults. <para/> The single instance is owned by the <see cref="AppServices"/> composition root; the static facade stays as the public API during migration, with laziness preserved by the owning <c>Lazy</c> slot. </summary>
public class GameConfig{/// <summary> Facade over the AppServices-owned instance; kept as the public API during migration. Constructed on first access through the owning <c>Lazy</c> slot. </summary>
public static GameConfig Instance=>AppServices.Current.GameConfigService.Value;/// <summary> Creates the instance for the composition root: a fresh config with defaults, populated from game_config.json when the file is reachable (runtime uses the Godot-globalized path; outside the runtime the relative path is tried and defaults are kept). </summary>
internal static GameConfig CreateInstance(){var config=new GameConfig();config.Load();return config;}/// <summary>Audio bus preferences (volume, toggles).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("audio")]public AudioSection Audio{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Display mode, resolution, vsync, and scale.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("display")]public DisplaySection Display{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Logging verbosity and category whitelist.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("logging")]public LoggingSection Logging{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Locale code (e.g. "ru-ru", "en-us").</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("language")]public string Language{get;set;}="ru-ru";/// <summary> JSON constructor kept private to enforce singleton access through <see cref="Instance"/>. The parameterless constructor is required by <c>System.Text.Json</c> for deserialization. </summary>
[JsonConstructor]private GameConfig(){}/// <summary> Checks whether the Godot engine main loop is reachable. The result is cached after the first call so subsequent queries are cheap. Used by <see cref="Load"/> to decide whether file-system access via <c>ProjectSettings</c> is safe. </summary>
public static bool IsGodotRunning(){return GameEnvironment.IsRuntime;}/// <summary> Reads <c>res://config/game_config.json</c>, deserializes it via <c>System.Text.Json</c>, and copies each section into the corresponding property. Missing keys or malformed JSON leave defaults intact; parse errors are logged. </summary>
private void Load(){var configPath=GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?GamePaths.Globalize("res://config/game_config.json"):"config/game_config.json";if(!File.Exists(configPath))return;try{var json=File.ReadAllText(configPath);var parsed=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<GameConfig>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(parsed==null)return;Audio=parsed.Audio??new AudioSection();Display=parsed.Display??new DisplaySection();Language=parsed.Language??"ru-ru";Logging=parsed.Logging??new LoggingSection();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("CONFIG",$"Failed to parse game_config.json: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Unity-style Godot autoload that serves as the single entry point for the game state subsystem. Holds the <see cref="SettingsData"/> (persisted user preferences) and <see cref="RuntimeData"/> (session state). On <c>_Ready</c> it loads saved settings. In-game time advancement is owned by the time_base engine mod, which registers its clock tick controller on boot. The current locale and the session <see cref="RuntimeData"/> are created by the unified boot pipeline (see <see cref="Boot"/>), which runs after this autoload. </summary>
public partial class GameData:Node{static GameData(){GameEnvironment.IsRuntime=true;GameEnvironment.MarkMainThread();}/// <summary>Global singleton, set once during <c>_EnterTree</c>.</summary>
public static GameData Instance{get;private set;}/// <summary> Constructs the game data root and performs the earliest initialization pass: <see cref="GameLogger.Init"/> must run before any subsystem logs, and this constructor is the first point where that is guaranteed. </summary>
public GameData(){GameLogger.Init();}/// <summary> Registers this node as the global <see cref="Instance"/>. If a previous valid instance still exists (e.g. scene reload without proper cleanup), logs a diagnostic warning before overwriting. </summary>
public override void _EnterTree(){if(Instance!=null&&GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(Instance)){var scene=GetTree()?.CurrentScene?.Name??"?";var existingPath=Instance.GetPath().ToString();var myPath=GetPath().ToString();GameLogger.Log("DUPLICATE",$"GameData._EnterTree: Instance ALREADY SET by '{existingPath}', overwriting with duplicate at '{myPath}' on scene '{scene}'",LogLevel.Error);}Instance=this;GameLogger.Init();}/// <summary>Persisted user-facing settings (audio, display, language, etc.).</summary>
public SettingsData Settings{get;private set;}=new();private RuntimeData _runtime;/// <summary> Set when <see cref="Runtime"/> is first touched before <see cref="Boot.ModsReady"/>. Such an instance seeded its starter inventory against an empty registry — the skips are permanent — so <see cref="Boot.EnsureRuntime"/> recreates it via <see cref="ConsumePrematureRuntimeCreation"/> once the mod set is final. </summary>
private bool _runtimeCreatedPrematurely;/// <summary> All mutable session state: time, characters, inventory, recipes, lamp. Created by the boot pipeline after the mod set is final, so constructing it seeds the starter inventory through fully loaded mod factories. The getter stays lazy only as a safety net for tests and tools that touch <see cref="Runtime"/> outside the boot window: in a real runtime such a first touch before boot finished logs a loud error, because the starter inventory would then depend on who got there first instead of on the boot ordering. (xUnit tests run with GameEnvironment.IsRuntime == false and stay silent.) </summary>
public RuntimeData Runtime{get{if(_runtime==null){if(GameEnvironment.IsRuntime&& !Boot.ModsReady){_runtimeCreatedPrematurely=true;GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"RuntimeData created before boot finished (phase={Boot.Phase}) — starter inventory may be empty; the boot pipeline is supposed to create it first",LogLevel.Error);}_runtime=new RuntimeData();GameLogger.Log("GAME","RuntimeData created");}return _runtime;}}/// <summary> Reports whether <see cref="Runtime"/> was created before the boot pipeline had mods ready, resetting the flag. One-shot: the caller (boot) recreates the instance so the starter inventory seeds from fully loaded factories. </summary>
public bool ConsumePrematureRuntimeCreation(){if(!_runtimeCreatedPrematurely)return false;_runtimeCreatedPrematurely=false;return true;}/// <summary> Discards the current <see cref="RuntimeData"/> and creates a fresh one. Must be called when starting a new game: the autoload (and therefore <see cref="Runtime"/>) survives returning to the main menu, so without a reset, state from a previous playthrough — including completed one-run scenario history — would leak into the new game. </summary>
public void ResetRuntime(string reason="new game"){_runtime=new RuntimeData();GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"RuntimeData reset ({reason})");}/// <summary> Begins a "New Game": wipes the runtime state and resets every registered <see cref="IResettable"/> state owner through <see cref="AppServices.ResetForNewGame"/> — quests, world map open/hidden overrides, and any mod-registered owner. The reset loop logs each owner and isolates its exceptions, so one broken reset cannot abort the others. Afterwards publishes <see cref="Events.NewGameStartedEvent"/>: the event stays the public contract for mod listeners that re-seed per-session data on top of the fresh state — the core mod restores the starter party there, because <see cref="ResetRuntime"/> discards it and <c>IModInitializer.OnModResourcesReady</c> only runs once at boot. State owners must not reset themselves through that event; they register an <see cref="IResettable"/> instead. Call this instead of <see cref="ResetRuntime"/> whenever a fresh game starts. </summary>
public void StartNewGame(){ResetRuntime();SaveService.ClearDormant();AppServices.Current.ResetForNewGame();Events.ModEventBus.Publish(new Events.NewGameStartedEvent());}/// <summary> Called once after entering the scene tree. Loads previously saved <see cref="SettingsData"/> from disk and emits a boot log message. In-game time is driven by the time_base engine mod, which registers its own tick controller with the event system on <c>OnModResourcesReady</c>. The current locale is activated by the boot pipeline (phase <c>Locale</c>, after the mod set is final), in both launcher and sync modes. </summary>
public override void _Ready(){Settings.Load();GameLogger.Log("GAME",$"Game initialized, version={ProjectSettings.GetSetting("application/config/version")}");}}}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> The last game and save the player touched (<c>user://last_session.json</c>), recorded on every save and load of a game collection. Drives the main menu's "Continue" from any mode — including the front-end, which then restarts into that game with <c>--load</c>. </summary>
public static class LastSessionStore{private const string FilePath="user://last_session.json";public sealed class Entry{public string GameId{get;set;}public string FileName{get;set;}public DateTime Time{get;set;}}/// <summary>Remembers the save; ignored for saves made without a game collection.</summary>
public static void Record(string gameId,string fileName){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameId)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName)|| !GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return;try{var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(new Entry{GameId=gameId,FileName=fileName,Time=DateTime.UtcNow});File.WriteAllText(ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(FilePath),json);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("SAVE",$"Could not record the last session: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Warning);}}/// <summary>The last session whose save still exists, or null.</summary>
public static Entry Load(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)return null;try{var path=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(FilePath);if(!File.Exists(path))return null;var entry=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Entry>(File.ReadAllText(path));return entry!=null&&SaveService.ReadPackage(entry.GameId,entry.FileName)!=null?entry:null;}catch(Exception){return null;}}}}

Every subsystem — time, characters, inventory, recipes, lamp and skills — lives here. <see cref="SaveService.Save"/> samples all these fields into a <see cref="SavePackage"/> DTO; <see cref="SaveService.Load"/> writes them back. The <see cref="CurrentScene"/> property resolves the active scene name into a <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.GodotSceneType"/> enum for conditional logic elsewhere. </summary>
public class RuntimeData{/// <summary>In-game clock (minutes-based) driving day/night cycles.</summary>
public TimeData Time{get;set;}=new TimeData(143546335);/// <summary>Recruited character roster with attributes and battle party set.</summary>
public CharacterData CharacterData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Unlocked skills and their cooldown state.</summary>
public SkillData SkillData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Factory producing the player inventory implementation. Installed by the items mod (<c>ItemsModInitializer</c>) at resources-ready; the property below invokes it on first access, so the state bag can be constructed before the mod set is final without freezing an empty inventory. A <c>null</c> factory (items mod absent) yields a null inventory. </summary>
public static Func<IInventory>InventoryFactory{get;set;}/// <summary>Factory producing the unlocked-recipe state; see <see cref="InventoryFactory"/>.</summary>
public static Func<IRecipeData>RecipeDataFactory{get;set;}private IInventory _inventory;private IRecipeData _recipeData;/// <summary>Player inventory of item stacks; lazily produced by <see cref="InventoryFactory"/> on first access.</summary>
public IInventory Inventory{get=>_inventory??=InventoryFactory?.Invoke();set=>_inventory=value;}/// <summary>Unlocked recipe IDs and lookup helpers; lazily produced by <see cref="RecipeDataFactory"/>.</summary>
public IRecipeData RecipeData{get=>_recipeData??=RecipeDataFactory?.Invoke();set=>_recipeData=value;}/// <summary>Lamp light radius and influence state.</summary>
public LampData LampData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Persistent collection of action IDs available for assignment via the character panel.</summary>
public ActionPoolData ActionPool{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> IDs of one-run scenarios completed in the current game. Grows as one-run scenario dialogs finish (see <c>DialogRuntime.End</c>), is replaced by the save's <c>CompletedScenarios</c> blob on load and cleared when a new game starts (see <c>GameData.ResetRuntime</c>). The scenario runner filters scene events against this set, which makes <c>is_one_run: true</c> hold across scene revisits and save/load cycles instead of only within a single scene visit. </summary>
public HashSet<string>CompletedScenarioIds{get;}=new();/// <summary> Story flags of this game (<c>flag name value</c> in a scenario, <c>ScenarioCondition.SetFlag</c> from code), read by scenario conditions such as <c>door == "open"</c>. Part of the game state: saved with the core slot and gone with a new game, unlike dialog variables, which live only while one dialog runs. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,string>Flags{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> IDs of one-shot scenarios restored from a loaded save. Populated by <see cref="SaveService.Load"/> and consumed by the scenario runner to skip re-triggering. When <c>null</c>, no load has occurred yet (fresh game). Call <see cref="ClearLoadState"/> to reset after processing. </summary>
public HashSet<string>LoadedCompletedScenarioIds{get;set;}/// <summary> Clears the post-load scenario block list. Should be called after the scenario runner has consumed the IDs to prevent stale data from persisting across scene transitions. The persistent completion history itself lives in <see cref="CompletedScenarioIds"/> and is not affected. </summary>
public void ClearLoadState(){LoadedCompletedScenarioIds=null;}/// <summary> Resolves the currently active scene into a <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.GodotSceneType"/> enum value. Queries <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.SceneManager"/> first, then falls back to parsing the current scene's resource path. Defaults to <c>GodotSceneType.MainMenu</c> when unresolvable. </summary>
public GodotSceneType CurrentScene{get{var sceneManager=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneManager>("SceneManager");if(sceneManager!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneManager.CurrentSceneName)){if(System.Enum.TryParse<GodotSceneType>(sceneManager.CurrentSceneName,true,out var result))return result;}var scene=SceneContextNode.CurrentScene;if(scene!=null){var path=scene.SceneFilePath;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)){var name=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)&&System.Enum.TryParse<GodotSceneType>(name,true,out var result))return result;}}return GodotSceneType.MainMenu;}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Pure marshalling helper: packs <see cref="RuntimeData"/> into a <c>"__core__"</c> <see cref="ModSlot"/> (named <see cref="DataBlob"/> blocks per subsystem) and restores it back. Does not touch filesystem, validation, or mod dispatch — that is the responsibility of <see cref="SaveService"/>. </summary>
public static class RuntimeSerializer{/// <summary> Lightweight DTO serialised into <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/> of the <c>"__core__"</c> slot so that <see cref="SaveService.GetSaveSlots"/> can extract preview info without deserialising full game-state blobs. </summary>
public class CoreSlotPreview{/// <summary>Scene the player was in when the save was written.</summary>
public string CurrentSceneName{get;set;}/// <summary>In-game clock tick at save moment.</summary>
public long GameTime{get;set;}/// <summary>Number of recruited characters at save moment.</summary>
public int CharacterCount{get;set;}}/// <summary> Builds the <c>"__core__"</c> <see cref="ModSlot"/> with named <see cref="DataBlob"/> blocks for each subsystem (Time, Lamp, ActionPool, Skills, CompletedScenarios, MapZones) and slot-level preview metadata in <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/>. Subsystem-owned state is not part of the core slot: quest state persists through the quests engine mod's own <c>IModSaveable</c> slot, inventory and recipe state through the items engine mod's slot, and the character roster (<c>Characters</c>/<c>BattleSet</c>) through the characters engine mod's slot (<c>CharactersSaveable</c>). </summary>
public static ModSlot BuildCoreSlot(RuntimeData runtime,string coreVersion,string currentSceneName,HashSet<string>completedScenarioIds){var slot=new ModSlot{Metadata=new ModMetadata{ModId=SavePackage.CoreSlotKey,ModName="Core Game",MinCoreVersion=coreVersion,IsRequired=true,}};slot.Data["Time"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.Time.Tick);var lampBlob=new DataBlob(1);lampBlob.SetFloat("Radius",runtime.LampData.Radius);lampBlob.SetFloat("Influence",runtime.LampData.Influence);slot.Data["Lamp"]=lampBlob;slot.Data["ActionPool"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.ActionPool.ActionIds.ToList());slot.Data["Skills"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.SkillData.Skills.ToList());slot.Data["CompletedScenarios"]=new DataBlob(1,completedScenarioIds.ToList());slot.Data["MapZones"]=new DataBlob(1,Cthangover.Core.Actions.MapStateBridge.ExportState());slot.Data["Flags"]=new DataBlob(1,runtime.Flags);var preview=new CoreSlotPreview{CurrentSceneName=currentSceneName,GameTime=runtime.Time.Tick,CharacterCount=runtime.CharacterData.Characters?.Count??0,};slot.Metadata.CustomData=JsonSerializer.Serialize(preview,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);return slot;}/// <summary> Restores core state from the <c>"__core__"</c> slot's blobs back into the given <paramref name="runtime"/> instance. Silently skips any missing blob key — the corresponding subsystem keeps its previous value, except <see cref="RuntimeData.CompletedScenarioIds"/> which is always reset first: a loaded save is the authoritative completion history of its own playthrough, so completions from a previously running game must never leak into it. </summary>
public static void RestoreCoreState(ModSlot coreSlot,RuntimeData runtime){if(coreSlot.Data==null)return;runtime.CompletedScenarioIds.Clear();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Time",out var timeBlob))runtime.Time.SetTime(timeBlob.ReadJson<long>());if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Lamp",out var lampBlob)){runtime.LampData.Radius=lampBlob.GetFloat("Radius",100f);runtime.LampData.Influence=lampBlob.GetFloat("Influence",0.5f);}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("ActionPool",out var apBlob))runtime.ActionPool.ActionIds=apBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()??new List<string>();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Skills",out var skillsBlob)){runtime.SkillData.Skills.Clear();var skills=skillsBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>();if(skills!=null)foreach(var id in skills)runtime.SkillData.AddSkill(id);}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("CompletedScenarios",out var csBlob)){runtime.LoadedCompletedScenarioIds=csBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()?.ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();runtime.CompletedScenarioIds.UnionWith(runtime.LoadedCompletedScenarioIds);}if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("Flags",out var flagsBlob))runtime.Flags=flagsBlob.ReadJson<Dictionary<string,string>>()??new Dictionary<string,string>();if(coreSlot.Data.TryGetValue("MapZones",out var mapBlob))Cthangover.Core.Actions.MapStateBridge.ImportState(mapBlob.ReadJson<Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.MapZoneStateData>());}/// <summary> Reads slot preview metadata from <see cref="ModMetadata.CustomData"/> JSON. Returns defaults when the field is absent or malformed. </summary>
public static CoreSlotPreview ReadSlotPreview(ModMetadata meta){var result=new CoreSlotPreview();if(meta?.CustomData==null)return result;try{var preview=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CoreSlotPreview>(meta.CustomData,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(preview!=null)return preview;}catch{}return result;}}}

===== FILE Core/Settings/SaveCompositionDiff.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> How a game's composition changed between a save and now: mods added (they start fresh), removed (their data goes dormant) and updated (migration runs; a downgrade keeps that mod's data dormant). Shown before loading so the player knows what happens to the save. </summary>
public sealed class SaveCompositionDiff{public List<string>Added{get;}=new();public List<string>Removed{get;}=new();public List<(string ModId,string From,string To,bool Downgrade)>Updated{get;}=new();public bool IsEmpty=>Added.Count==0&&Removed.Count==0&&Updated.Count==0;/// <summary> Compares the save's snapshot with the composition the game runs now. A save without a snapshot (written without a game) yields an empty diff — there is nothing reliable to compare. </summary>
public static SaveCompositionDiff Compute(IEnumerable<SaveGameMod>saved,IEnumerable<SaveGameMod>current){var diff=new SaveCompositionDiff();if(saved==null||current==null)return diff;var before=saved.Where(m=>m?.Id!=null).GroupBy(m=>m.Id,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToDictionary(g=>g.Key,g=>g.First().Version,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var now=current.Where(m=>m?.Id!=null).GroupBy(m=>m.Id,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToDictionary(g=>g.Key,g=>g.First().Version,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var pair in now.OrderBy(p=>p.Key,StringComparer.Ordinal)){if(!before.TryGetValue(pair.Key,out var was)){diff.Added.Add(pair.Key);continue;}if(!string.Equals(was,pair.Value,StringComparison.Ordinal)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(was)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(pair.Value))diff.Updated.Add((pair.Key,was,pair.Value,Compare(was,pair.Value)>0));}foreach(var id in before.Keys.OrderBy(k=>k,StringComparer.Ordinal)){if(!now.ContainsKey(id))diff.Removed.Add(id);}return diff;}private static int Compare(string a,string b){try{return VersionHelper.Compare(a,b);}catch(Exception){return 0;}}}}

===== FILE Core/Settings/SaveDormancy.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Decides which mod slots of a save the running game restores and which stay dormant. A game keeps its saves while the player changes its mechanics, so a slot is never dropped: data of a mod that is not loaded now (or whose installed version is older than the save's) is carried forward verbatim in <see cref="SavePackage.Dormant"/> and revived as soon as the mod is back. Pure logic — the version lookup is injected — so it is covered by unit tests without Godot. </summary>
public static class SaveDormancy{public enum Reason{/// <summary>The mod is not part of the game's current composition.</summary>
NotLoaded,/// <summary>The installed mod is older than the one that wrote the slot (no downgrade migration).</summary>
Downgrade,/// <summary>The slot needs a newer core than the running one.</summary>
CoreTooOld,/// <summary>The mod rejected the slot in <c>OnLoad</c>; the data is kept for a later fix.</summary>
LoadFailed,}public sealed class Result{/// <summary>Slots to hand to the loaded mods, keyed by mod id.</summary>
public Dictionary<string,ModSlot>Live{get;}=new();/// <summary>Slots carried forward untouched, keyed by mod id.</summary>
public Dictionary<string,ModSlot>Dormant{get;}=new();/// <summary>Slots that just became dormant, with the reason.</summary>
public List<(string ModId,Reason Reason)>NewlyDormant{get;}=new();/// <summary>Previously dormant slots whose mod is back.</summary>
public List<string>Revived{get;}=new();}/// <summary> Classifies <paramref name="modData"/> (live slots of the save, core slot excluded) and <paramref name="dormant"/> (slots already dormant in the save). <paramref name="installedVersion"/> returns the loaded mod's version or null when the mod is not loaded. </summary>
public static Result Classify(IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModSlot>modData,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,ModSlot>dormant,Func<string,string>installedVersion,string coreVersion,DateTime now){var result=new Result();foreach(var pair in modData??new Dictionary<string,ModSlot>()){if(pair.Key==SavePackage.CoreSlotKey||pair.Value==null)continue;var reason=Check(pair.Key,pair.Value,installedVersion,coreVersion);if(reason==null){result.Live[pair.Key]=pair.Value;continue;}result.Dormant[pair.Key]=MarkDormant(pair.Value,reason.Value,now);result.NewlyDormant.Add((pair.Key,reason.Value));}foreach(var pair in dormant??new Dictionary<string,ModSlot>()){if(pair.Value==null||result.Dormant.ContainsKey(pair.Key))continue;// A live slot for the same mod wins: the dormant one is kept (it may hold newer data after a downgrade) until purged.
if(result.Live.ContainsKey(pair.Key)||Check(pair.Key,pair.Value,installedVersion,coreVersion)!=null){result.Dormant[pair.Key]=pair.Value;continue;}Revive(pair.Value);result.Live[pair.Key]=pair.Value;result.Revived.Add(pair.Key);}return result;}/// <summary>Flags a slot as dormant, keeping the first dormancy date.</summary>
public static ModSlot MarkDormant(ModSlot slot,Reason reason,DateTime now){slot.Metadata??=new ModMetadata();slot.Metadata.Dormant=true;slot.Metadata.DormantReason=reason.ToString();slot.Metadata.DormantSince??=now;return slot;}private static void Revive(ModSlot slot){if(slot.Metadata==null)return;slot.Metadata.Dormant=false;slot.Metadata.DormantReason=null;slot.Metadata.DormantSince=null;}private static Reason?Check(string modId,ModSlot slot,Func<string,string>installedVersion,string coreVersion){var installed=installedVersion?.Invoke(modId);if(installed==null)return Reason.NotLoaded;var meta=slot.Metadata;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(meta?.ModVersion)&&Compare(meta.ModVersion,installed)>0)return Reason.Downgrade;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(meta?.MinCoreVersion)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(coreVersion)&&Compare(coreVersion,meta.MinCoreVersion)<0)return Reason.CoreTooOld;return null;}private static int Compare(string a,string b){try{return VersionHelper.Compare(a,b);}catch(Exception){return 0;}}}}

===== FILE Core/Settings/SavePackage.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Root DTO of the save file. Contains save identification (SaveId, Timestamp, CoreVersion) and a <see cref="ModData"/> dictionary holding data slots from every mod that implements <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Mods.IModSaveable"/>, plus the reserved <c>"__core__"</c> slot that stores all core game state. The core itself does not inspect or deserialise mod blob payloads — it only routes byte arrays between the save file and the mod that owns each slot. </summary>
public class SavePackage{/// <summary>Reserved <see cref="ModData"/> key holding the core game state; mods must not write it.</summary>
public const string CoreSlotKey="__core__";/// <summary>User-facing save name (e.g. "slot_1").</summary>
public string SaveId{get;set;}/// <summary>UTC timestamp when the save was created.</summary>
public DateTime Timestamp{get;set;}/// <summary>Version of the core that created this save.</summary>
public string CoreVersion{get;set;}/// <summary> Data slots from mods, keyed by ModId. The reserved key <c>"__core__"</c> holds core game state. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,ModSlot>ModData{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Game that wrote the save (null for saves made without an active game collection, e.g. development launches with every mod). </summary>
public SaveGameInfo Game{get;set;}/// <summary> Slots of mods the game ran without (removed mechanic, older installed version, rejected data), carried forward untouched so the data comes back with the mod; see <see cref="SaveDormancy"/>. Purged on request from the save settings. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,ModSlot>Dormant{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Static utility for capturing and loading save-slot thumbnail images. On save (<see cref="CaptureAndSave"/>), it grabs the current background texture from the shell's <c>ViewBox</c> (interface mod, behind the <see cref="Cthangover.Core.UI.IBackgroundView"/> contract), scales it down to a 320×180 thumbnail, and writes a PNG next to the JSON save file. On load (<see cref="LoadScreenshot"/>), it reads the PNG back and returns a <see cref="Texture2D"/> suitable for the slot UI. A fallback solid-colour image is used when no background texture is available. </summary>
public static class SaveScreenshotService{private static string SaveDir=>SaveService.SaveDirectory;/// <summary> Captures the current background image, downscales it to 320×180, and saves it as a PNG thumbnail alongside the save file. If the background texture is unavailable, a solid fallback image is used. Silently returns on error (logged internally). </summary>
public static void CaptureAndSave(string fileName){var absDir=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(SaveDir);if(!DirAccess.DirExistsAbsolute(absDir))DirAccess.MakeDirRecursiveAbsolute(absDir);var safe=new string(fileName.Select(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-'?c:'_').ToArray());var path=$"{SaveDir}/{safe}.png";try{var image=CaptureBackgroundImage();if(image==null)return;var smallImage=ScaleImage(image,320,180);smallImage.SavePng(ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(path));}catch(Exception e){GameLogger.Log("SAVE",$"Error capturing screenshot: {e.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Loads the thumbnail PNG for a save slot and returns it as a <see cref="Texture2D"/>. Returns <c>null</c> if the file does not exist or fails to decode. </summary>
public static Texture2D LoadScreenshot(string fileName){var safe=new string(fileName.Select(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-'?c:'_').ToArray());return LoadScreenshotFromPath($"{SaveDir}/{safe}.png");}/// <summary> Loads a thumbnail by its Godot path (<see cref="SaveSlotInfo.ScreenshotPath"/>), so the save browser can show saves of any game, not only the active one. </summary>
public static Texture2D LoadScreenshotFromPath(string path){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return null;var absPath=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(path);if(!System.IO.File.Exists(absPath))return null;try{var image=new Image();var err=image.Load(path);if(err!=Error.Ok)return null;return ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);}catch{return null;}}/// <summary> Retrieves the current background texture from the shell's <c>ViewBox</c> node through the kernel <see cref="IBackgroundView"/> contract. Falls back to a 64×64 solid-dark image if no valid texture exists. </summary>
private static Image CaptureBackgroundImage(){var viewBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<Node>("ViewBox")as IBackgroundView;if(viewBox?.Background?.Texture==null)return CreateFallbackImage();var image=viewBox.Background.Texture.GetImage();if(image==null||image.IsEmpty())return CreateFallbackImage();return image;}/// <summary> Produces a 64×64 solid dark-grey fallback image used when the actual background texture is unavailable. </summary>
private static Image CreateFallbackImage(){var image=Image.CreateEmpty(64,64,false,Image.Format.Rgba8);image.Fill(new Color(0.12f,0.12f,0.12f,1));return image;}/// <summary> Resizes <paramref name="source"/> to the given dimensions using Lanczos interpolation for high-quality downscaling of thumbnails. </summary>
private static Image ScaleImage(Image source,int width,int height){source.Resize(width,height,Image.Interpolation.Lanczos);return source;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Save/load dispatcher for the game core. Serialises game state into a <see cref="SavePackage"/> (JSON) and drives a <b>three-phase</b> load with mod metadata validation. <b>Architecture:</b> core game state is stored in a reserved <c>"__core__"</c> slot inside <see cref="SavePackage.ModData"/> — exactly like any other mod. Other mods add their own slots via <see cref="IModSaveable"/>. The core never inspects mod blob payloads; it only routes byte arrays to the owning mod. <see cref="RuntimeSerializer"/> handles the actual marshalling between <see cref="RuntimeData"/> and the <see cref="DataBlob"/> blocks inside the core slot. <b>Save flow:</b> <list type="number"> <item>Build a <c>"__core__"</c> <see cref="ModSlot"/> via <see cref="RuntimeSerializer.BuildCoreSlot"/>.</item> <item>Call <see cref="ModSaveableRegistry.CollectSaveData"/> — each mod fills its own slot. Skip any slot keyed <c>"__core__"</c>.</item> <item>Serialise <see cref="SavePackage"/> to JSON and write to disk.</item> </list> <b>Load flow (three phases):</b> <list type="number"> <item><b>Phase 1 — validation via <see cref="ModMetadata"/>:</b> walk all slots, check required mods and core version compatibility.</item> <item><b>Phase 2 — core state restoration:</b> <see cref="RuntimeSerializer.RestoreCoreState"/> reads blobs from <c>ModData["__core__"]</c> and pushes them into <see cref="RuntimeData"/>.</item> <item><b>Phase 3 — <see cref="ModSaveableRegistry.DispatchLoad"/>:</b> distribute remaining slots to mods, catch exceptions.</item> </list> </summary>
public static class SaveService{private const string SavesRoot="user://saves";/// <summary> Saves of the active game live in <c>user://saves/&lt;game id&gt;/</c>, so editing the game's mechanics keeps them; without an active game (development launches with every mod) the shared root is used. </summary>
private static string SaveDir=>Games.ActiveGame.IsActive?$"{SavesRoot}/{Sanitize(Games.ActiveGame.Id)}":SavesRoot;/// <summary>Slots carried forward for mods the current game runs without; see <see cref="SaveDormancy"/>.</summary>
private static Dictionary<string,ModSlot>_dormant=new();/// <summary>Scene stored in the last successfully loaded save (null before any load).</summary>
public static string LastLoadedSceneName{get;private set;}/// <summary>Composition changes found by the last load (mods that went dormant or came back).</summary>
public static SaveDormancy.Result LastLoadDormancy{get;private set;}/// <summary>Forgets dormant slots; called when a new game starts.</summary>
public static void ClearDormant()=>_dormant=new Dictionary<string,ModSlot>();/// <summary>Directory of the active game's saves (Godot path).</summary>
public static string SaveDirectory=>SaveDir;private static string _cachedCoreVersion;private static string CoreVersion{get{if(_cachedCoreVersion==null){try{_cachedCoreVersion=(string)ProjectSettings.GetSetting("application/config/version");}catch{_cachedCoreVersion="0.0.0";}}return _cachedCoreVersion;}}/// <summary>Saves directory: globalised <c>user://saves</c> at runtime, relative fallback otherwise.</summary>
public static string Path=>GameEnvironment.IsRuntime?ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(SaveDir):"saves";/// <summary> Builds a sanitised file path for a save slot. Non-alphanumeric characters (except <c>_</c> and <c>-</c>) are replaced with <c>_</c> to prevent path traversal. </summary>
private static string GetSavePath(string fileName)=>$"{SaveDir}/{Sanitize(fileName)}.json";private static string Sanitize(string name)=>new string((name??string.Empty).Select(c=>char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)||c=='_'||c=='-'?c:'_').ToArray());/// <summary> Builds the PNG screenshot path for a save slot using the same sanitisation rules as <see cref="GetSavePath"/>. </summary>
private static string GetScreenshotPath(string fileName)=>$"{SaveDir}/{Sanitize(fileName)}.png";/// <summary> Ensures <c>user://saves/</c> directory exists, creating it recursively if needed. </summary>
private static void EnsureSaveDir(){var absDir=Path;if(!DirAccess.DirExistsAbsolute(absDir))DirAccess.MakeDirRecursiveAbsolute(absDir);}/// <summary> Resolves the currently active scene name by querying the <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Scenes.SceneManager"/> singleton first, then falling back to the current scene's filename. Returns "unknown" if neither source is available. </summary>
private static string GetCurrentSceneName(){var sceneManager=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneManager>("SceneManager");if(sceneManager!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneManager.CurrentSceneName))return sceneManager.CurrentSceneName;var scene=SceneContextNode.CurrentScene;if(scene!=null){var path=scene.SceneFilePath;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path);}return"unknown";}/// <summary> Walks the active <see cref="Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable.ExecutableMainEventChain"/> scene tree node and collects IDs of all one-shot events that have already executed. using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Metadata about a single save slot, constructed by <see cref="SaveService.GetSaveSlots"/> to populate the load-game UI. Contains both the header info read from the JSON file and derived flags such as <see cref="HasScreenshot"/> and <see cref="IsEmpty"/>. Even empty slots (no file on disk) produce an instance so the UI always has the full grid of slot entries. </summary>
public class SaveSlotInfo{/// <summary>Logical slot name (e.g. "slot_1").</summary>
public string FileName{get;set;}/// <summary>UTC timestamp of when the save was written.</summary>
public DateTime SaveTime{get;set;}/// <summary>Name of the scene the player was in at save time.</summary>
public string SceneName{get;set;}/// <summary>Godot resource path to the thumbnail PNG (e.g. "user://saves/slot_1.png").</summary>
public string ScreenshotPath{get;set;}/// <summary><c>true</c> if a thumbnail PNG exists on disk for this slot.</summary>
public bool HasScreenshot{get;set;}/// <summary><c>true</c> when no JSON save file exists for this slot.</summary>
public bool IsEmpty{get;set;}/// <summary>In-game time in minutes (<see cref="TimeData.Tick"/>) at save moment.</summary>
public long GameTime{get;set;}/// <summary>Number of recruited characters in the party.</summary>
public int CharacterCount{get;set;}/// <summary>Known placeholder: <see cref="SaveService.GetSaveSlots"/> currently always writes <c>0f</c> — no real lamp percentage is computed yet, so the UI must not rely on this value.</summary>
public float LampPercent{get;set;}/// <summary>Game that wrote the save (null for saves made without a game).</summary>
public string GameId{get;set;}/// <summary>Game display name at save time.</summary>
public string GameName{get;set;}/// <summary>Composition snapshot of the save, for the load-time comparison.</summary>
public System.Collections.Generic.List<SaveGameMod>Mods{get;set;}}}

using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> User-adjusted settings (audio, display, language, battle speed, launcher flag) persisted as indented JSON at <c>user://settings.json</c> — a separate, per-device file that only supplies overrides on top of the defaults read from <see cref="GameConfig"/>. public class SettingsData{private const string ConfigPath="user://settings.json";/// <summary>SFX master toggle.</summary>
public bool SoundsEnabled{get;set;}/// <summary>Music master toggle.</summary>
public bool MusicsEnabled{get;set;}/// <summary>Ambient audio master toggle.</summary>
public bool AmbientEnabled{get;set;}/// <summary>SFX volume 0–100.</summary>
public int SoundsVolume{get;set;}/// <summary>Music volume 0–100.</summary>
public int MusicsVolume{get;set;}/// <summary>Ambient volume 0–100.</summary>
public int AmbientVolume{get;set;}/// <summary>Language code in any form (<c>ru</c>, <c>ru-ru</c>, <c>en-en</c>); read through <see cref="Localization.LanguageCode"/>.</summary>
public string Language{get;set;}/// <summary>Battle animation speed multiplier (1 = normal).</summary>
public int BattleSpeed{get;set;}/// <summary>Godot <c>DisplayServer.WindowMode</c> value; the offered ones are listed in <see cref="DisplayWindowModes"/>.</summary>
public int WindowMode{get;set;}/// <summary>Window width in windowed mode (pixels); fullscreen modes use the monitor's own resolution.</summary>
public int ResolutionWidth{get;set;}/// <summary>Window height in windowed mode (pixels).</summary>
public int ResolutionHeight{get;set;}/// <summary>Zero-based monitor index.</summary>
public int CurrentScreen{get;set;}/// <summary>Vertical synchronization toggle.</summary>
public bool VsyncEnabled{get;set;}/// <summary>Frame rate cap (<c>Engine.MaxFps</c>); 0 = unlimited.</summary>
public int MaxFps{get;set;}/// <summary><c>true</c> if the launcher window has been shown at least once, suppressing it on subsequent launches.</summary>
public bool LauncherShown{get;set;}/// <summary> Initialises all properties from <see cref="GameConfig.Instance"/> defaults (audio, display, language) and hard-coded fallbacks for settings that have no JSON counterpart (battle speed = 1). </summary>
public SettingsData(){ApplyDefaults();}/// <summary> Resets every property to the factory defaults read from <see cref="GameConfig.Instance"/>. Called during construction and can be re-invoked to discard user overrides. </summary>
public void ApplyDefaults(){var cfg=GameConfig.Instance;SoundsEnabled=cfg.Audio.SoundsEnabled;MusicsEnabled=cfg.Audio.MusicsEnabled;AmbientEnabled=cfg.Audio.AmbientEnabled;SoundsVolume=cfg.Audio.SoundsVolume;MusicsVolume=cfg.Audio.MusicsVolume;AmbientVolume=cfg.Audio.AmbientVolume;Language=cfg.Language;BattleSpeed=1;WindowMode=cfg.Display.WindowMode;ResolutionWidth=cfg.Display.ResolutionWidth;ResolutionHeight=cfg.Display.ResolutionHeight;CurrentScreen=cfg.Display.CurrentScreen;VsyncEnabled=cfg.Display.VsyncEnabled;MaxFps=cfg.Display.MaxFps;}/// <summary>Resolves the settings file path for the current environment.</summary>

public void Save(){var path=ResolvePath();var dir=Path.GetDirectoryName(path);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)&& !Directory.Exists(dir))Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(this,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);}/// <summary> Bulk-copies all property values from another <see cref="SettingsData"/> instance.
