using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> In-game clock driven by a minute counter (<see cref="Tick"/>). Decomposes the total minutes into years, months, days, hours, and minutes, and exposes time-of-day convenience properties (<see cref="IsMorning"/>, <see cref="IsDay"/>, <see cref="IsEvening"/>, <see cref="IsNight"/>) that map to a <see cref="PhaseType"/>. The clock advances one minute per timer tick via <see cref="AddTick"/>, or can be jumped forward in bulk via <see cref="AddTime"/>. All arithmetic assumes 30-day months and 360-day years (12 months of 30 days) — the game does not simulate a real calendar. </summary>
[Serializable]public class TimeData{/// <summary>Total elapsed in-game minutes. Incremented by <c>TimeTickController.OnTimerTick</c> (time_base mod) each timer cycle.</summary>
public long Tick;// A simplified calendar: 30-day months, 12 months a year (360 days). The year used to be 365 days in SetTime but 12 × 30 in AddTime, so the tick and the components told different dates near the end of a year.
private const long MinutesPerHour=60;private const long MinutesPerDay=24*MinutesPerHour;private const long MinutesPerMonth=30*MinutesPerDay;private const long MinutesPerYear=12*MinutesPerMonth;/// <summary>Year component extracted from <see cref="Tick"/>.</summary>
public int Years{get;private set;}/// <summary>Month component (0–11).</summary>
public int Months{get;private set;}/// <summary>Day component (0–29).</summary>
public int Days{get;private set;}/// <summary>Hour component (0–23).</summary>
public int Hours{get;private set;}/// <summary>Minute component (0–59).</summary>
public int Minutes{get;private set;}/// <summary>Creates the clock seeded with an absolute minute value.</summary> <param name="time">Initial minute value to seed the clock.</param>
public TimeData(long time){SetTime(time);}/// <summary>True between 06:00 and 09:59 inclusive.</summary>
public bool IsMorning=>Hours>=6&&Hours<10;/// <summary>True between 10:00 and 17:59 inclusive.</summary>
public bool IsDay=>Hours>=10&&Hours<18;/// <summary>True between 18:00 and 21:59 inclusive.</summary>
public bool IsEvening=>Hours>=18&&Hours<22;/// <summary>True between 22:00 and 05:59 inclusive (spans midnight).</summary>
public bool IsNight=>(Hours>=22&&Hours<24)||(Hours>=0&&Hours<6);/// <summary>Floating-point hour of day (0.0–23.98), used for smooth interpolation of day/night visual effects. Equals <c>Hours + Minutes / 60f</c>.</summary>
public float Normalized=>Hours+(Minutes/60f);/// <summary>Derived <see cref="PhaseType"/> based on the current hour.</summary>
public PhaseType Phase{get{if(IsMorning)return PhaseType.Morning;if(IsDay)return PhaseType.Day;return IsEvening?PhaseType.Evening:PhaseType.Night;}}/// <summary>Formatted clock string (e.g. "14:05").</summary>
public string Text=>$"{Hours:D2}:{Minutes:D2}";/// <summary> Sets the absolute time from a minute value. Decomposes <paramref name="time"/> into years/months/days/hours/minutes using the game's simplified calendar divisions: 60 min/hour, 1440 min/day, 43200 min/month, 518400 min/year. </summary>
public void SetTime(long time){Tick=time;Years=(int)(time/MinutesPerYear);time%=MinutesPerYear;Months=(int)(time/MinutesPerMonth);time%=MinutesPerMonth;Days=(int)(time/MinutesPerDay);time%=MinutesPerDay;Hours=(int)(time/MinutesPerHour);time%=MinutesPerHour;Minutes=(int)time;}/// <summary> Advances the clock by exactly one minute. Called by <c>TimeTickController.OnTimerTick</c> (time_base mod) on each scene-event timer pulse. </summary>
public void AddTick(){SetTime(++Tick);}/// <summary> Jumps the clock forward by the given amounts. Each unit is added to its respective component with carry propagation (60 min → 1 hour, 24 hours → 1 day, 30 days → 1 month, 12 months → 1 year). <see cref="Tick"/> is recalculated from the final components to stay consistent. </summary>
public void AddTime(int years,int months,int days,int hours,int minutes){Years+=years;Months+=months;Days+=days;Hours+=hours;Minutes+=minutes;Hours+=Minutes/60;Minutes%=60;Days+=Hours/24;Hours%=24;Months+=Days/30;Days%=30;Years+=Months/12;Months%=12;Tick=Years*MinutesPerYear+Months*MinutesPerMonth+Days*MinutesPerDay+Hours*MinutesPerHour+Minutes;}}}

public override void _Ready(){_colorRect=new ColorRect();_colorRect.Name="PixelArtPostProcessRect";AddChild(_colorRect);var shader=Shaders.Resolve("pixel_art_post_process");if(shader==null){GameLogger.Log("SHADER","PixelArtPostProcess: Failed to load pixel_art_post_process.gdshader",LogLevel.Error);return;}_shaderMaterial=new ShaderMaterial();_shaderMaterial.Shader=shader;_colorRect.Material=_shaderMaterial;_colorRect.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;_colorRect.SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(LayoutPreset.FullRect);UpdateShaderParameter();}/// <summary> Ensures the overlay <c>ColorRect</c> always covers the entire viewport, even after window resize or resolution changes. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Runtime shader and texture override system for modded scenes. Walks the entire node tree of a freshly-instantiated scene, matching each <c>ShaderMaterial</c> by its resource-path name against the mod shader registry and each <c>TextureRect</c> / <c>Sprite2D</c> texture by name against the mod texture registry. Replacement is name-based (matching <c>Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension</c> of the original resource path to a mod file entry), so a mod providing <c>shaders/outline.gdshader</c> will automatically override every node whose material originally referenced <c>res://shaders/outline.gdshader</c>. Called from <c>SceneLoader</c> immediately after <c>Instantiate</c>, before <c>_Ready</c> fires on any child — thus overridden materials are in place before any node runs its init logic. </summary>
public static class ShaderModReplacer{/// <summary> Entry point called after scene instantiation. Runs both the shader-material pass and the texture pass in one tree walk, logging counts of each replacement type. </summary>
public static void PatchScene(Node root){var shaderReplaced=PatchShaderMaterials(root);var textureReplaced=PatchTextures(root);if(shaderReplaced>0)GameLogger.Log("SHADER",$"ShaderModReplacer patched {shaderReplaced} shader material(s)");if(textureReplaced>0)GameLogger.Log("SHADER",$"ShaderModReplacer patched {textureReplaced} texture(s)");}private static int PatchShaderMaterials(Node root){var shaders=Shaders.Collect();if(shaders==null||shaders.Count==0)return 0;var replaced=0;PatchShaderNode(root,shaders,ref replaced);return replaced;}private static void PatchShaderNode(Node node,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,FileEntry>shaders,ref int replaced){if(node is CanvasItem canvasItem&&canvasItem.Material is ShaderMaterial mat){var shader=mat.Shader;if(shader!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(shader.ResourcePath)){var name=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(shader.ResourcePath);if(shaders.TryGetValue(name,out var entry)){var overrideShader=Shaders.TryGetCached(name)??Shaders.Resolve(name);if(overrideShader!=null&&overrideShader!=shader){mat.Shader=overrideShader;replaced++;GameLogger.Log("SHADER",$"  replaced shader '{name}' → mod '{entry.ModId}'");}}}}foreach(var child in node.GetChildren())PatchShaderNode(child,shaders,ref replaced);}private static int PatchTextures(Node root){var textures=Textures.Collect();if(textures==null||textures.Count==0)return 0;var replaced=0;PatchTextureNode(root,textures,ref replaced);return replaced;}private static void PatchTextureNode(Node node,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,FileEntry>textures,ref int replaced){Texture2D currentTexture=null;if(node is TextureRect textureRect)currentTexture=textureRect.Texture;else if(node is Sprite2D sprite)currentTexture=sprite.Texture;if(currentTexture!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentTexture.ResourcePath)){var name=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(currentTexture.ResourcePath);if(textures.TryGetValue(name,out var entry)){var overrideTexture=Textures.TryGetCached(name)??Textures.Resolve(name);if(overrideTexture!=null&&overrideTexture!=currentTexture){if(node is TextureRect tr)tr.Texture=overrideTexture;else if(node is Sprite2D sp)sp.Texture=overrideTexture;replaced++;GameLogger.Log("SHADER",$"  replaced texture '{name}' → mod '{entry.ModId}'");}}}foreach(var child in node.GetChildren())PatchTextureNode(child,textures,ref replaced);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Event{/// <summary> Central event bus for the UI subsystem. Maintains priority-sorted subscriber lists for Update and TimerTick events (dialog-end notifications are published on the ModEventBus as DialogEndedEvent). Subscribers are dispatched by Priority ascending — lower value = earlier execution; equal priorities keep their registration order (a new listener is inserted after the last one of its priority, the list is never re-sorted). Dispatch walks a snapshot of the list, so a listener may add or remove listeners from its callback: one added during a dispatch is first called on the next one, one removed is not called any more. Runs at ProcessPriority.MaxValue, i.e. after every other node's process callback in the frame. Timer ticks fire at 1-second intervals from an accumulator to avoid drift — from the first processed frames of the app, never paused during the launcher boot. Each tick subscriber is wrapped in try/catch to prevent one faulty handler from breaking all others. IsActive lets the bus be paused mid-scene without unregistering all listeners. <para/> Tick subscribers: see the boot-window contract on <see cref="IOnTimeEvent"/> before touching game state in <see cref="IOnTimeEvent.OnTimerTick"/>. </summary>
public partial class SceneEventController:Node{private string guid;private List<IOnUpdateEvent>OnUpdateEventList=new();private List<IOnTimeEvent>OnTimerTickEventList=new();private IOnUpdateEvent[]updateSnapshot;private IOnTimeEvent[]tickSnapshot;/// <summary> <c>true</c> after <see cref="_ExitTree"/> runs and <see cref="ClearData"/> has been called. External code should check this before registering new listeners on a dead controller. </summary>
public bool IsDestroyed{get;private set;}/// <summary> Controls whether <c>_Process</c> dispatches events. When <c>false</c>, the event pump continues running but all subscriber lists are paused. Distinct from <see cref="IsActive"/> — use this for flow control. </summary>
public bool IsRunning{get;set;}/// <summary> Master enable/disable for event dispatch. When <c>false</c>, <c>_Process</c> skips all subscriber lists entirely. Use during scene transitions or loading screens to suppress UI events without unregistering listeners. </summary>
public bool IsActive{get;set;}=true;private double timerAccum;private const double TickInterval=1.0;/// <summary>Runs last among process callbacks (max priority) so listeners observe fully updated state, and keeps ticking while the game is paused.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){guid=Guid.NewGuid().ToString();ProcessPriority=int.MaxValue;ProcessMode=ProcessModeEnum.Always;}/// <summary>Drops all listener registrations and marks the controller destroyed when it leaves the tree.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){ClearData();IsDestroyed=true;}/// <summary>Accumulates time into one-second timer ticks and, when active, dispatches every registered per-frame update listener.</summary>
public override void _Process(double delta){timerAccum+=delta;while(timerAccum>=TickInterval){timerAccum-=TickInterval;TickTimer();}if(!IsActive)return;updateSnapshot??=OnUpdateEventList.ToArray();foreach(var eventSubscriber in updateSnapshot){// Removed by an earlier subscriber of this very dispatch.
if(!OnUpdateEventList.Contains(eventSubscriber))continue;// Same contract as TickTimer: one faulty (e.g. disposed across a scene switch) handler must not break the remaining subscribers, so each update is isolated.
try{eventSubscriber.OnUpdate();}catch(ObjectDisposedException ex){RemoveUpdateEventListener(eventSubscriber);GameLogger.Log("EVENT",$"Update subscriber {eventSubscriber.GetType().Name} was disposed, unregistered: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT",$"Update subscriber {eventSubscriber.GetType().Name} threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}private void TickTimer(){tickSnapshot??=OnTimerTickEventList.ToArray();foreach(var eventSubscriber in tickSnapshot){if(!OnTimerTickEventList.Contains(eventSubscriber))continue;try{eventSubscriber.OnTimerTick();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("EVENT",$"TickTimer subscriber {eventSubscriber.GetType().Name} threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}
#region Add
/// <summary>Registers an <see cref="IOnUpdateEvent"/> subscriber for per-frame updates.</summary>
public void AddUpdateEventListener(IOnUpdateEvent listener)=>AddListener(listener,OnUpdateEventList);/// <summary> Registers a timer-tick subscriber for ~1 second interval callbacks. Ticks start with the first processed frame and keep firing while the launcher boot compiles mods (this node is <c>ProcessMode.Always</c>) — a subscriber touching <c>GameData.Instance.Runtime</c>, the mod registry or factories inside <see cref="IOnTimeEvent.OnTimerTick"/> must guard with <c>Boot.ModsReady</c>; see the boot-window contract on <see cref="IOnTimeEvent"/> and the time mod's TimeTickController for the reference implementation. </summary>
public void AddTimerTickEventListener(IOnTimeEvent listener)=>AddListener(listener,OnTimerTickEventList);
#endregion
#region Remove
/// <summary>Unregisters a per-frame update subscriber.</summary>
public void RemoveUpdateEventListener(IOnUpdateEvent listener)=>RemoveListener(listener,OnUpdateEventList);/// <summary>Unregisters a timer-tick subscriber.</summary>
public void RemoveTimerTickEventListener(IOnTimeEvent listener)=>RemoveListener(listener,OnTimerTickEventList);
#endregion
private void AddListener<T>(T listener,List<T>eventList)where T:class,IEventPriority{if(listener==null||eventList.Contains(listener))return;var at=eventList.Count;while(at>0&&eventList[at-1].Priority>listener.Priority)at--;eventList.Insert(at,listener);ResetSnapshots();}private void RemoveListener<T>(T listener,List<T>eventList)where T:class,IEventPriority{if(listener==null)return;if(eventList.Remove(listener))ResetSnapshots();}// A dispatch keeps iterating the array it took; the next one takes a fresh copy.
private void ResetSnapshots(){updateSnapshot=null;tickSnapshot=null;}/// <summary> Empties all subscriber lists without calling callbacks. Called in <see cref="_ExitTree"/> to cleanly detach all listeners. </summary>
public void ClearData(){OnUpdateEventList.Clear();OnTimerTickEventList.Clear();ResetSnapshots();}}}

Log entries arrive from the worker thread via <see cref="GameLogger.LogEmitted"/>, so the handler only appends to a lock-protected queue; the actual Godot label updates happen on the main thread inside <see cref="_Process"/>. </summary>
public partial class BootLogPanel:Control{private const int VisibleLines=5;private const float FadeSeconds=3.0f;private readonly Queue<LogLine>_pending=new();private readonly object _queueLock=new();private readonly List<LogLine>_lines=new();private Label[]_labels;private struct LogLine{/// <summary>Formatted log line, including its category prefix.</summary>
public string Text;/// <summary>Seconds since the line appeared; drives the fade-out.</summary>
public float Age;}/// <summary>Builds the label stack, seeds it with recent log lines and subscribes to <see cref="GameLogger.LogEmitted"/>.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;var box=new VBoxContainer();box.SetAnchorsPreset(LayoutPreset.FullRect);box.Alignment=BoxContainer.AlignmentMode.End;box.AddThemeConstantOverride("separation",2);AddChild(box);_labels=new Label[VisibleLines];for(var i=0;i<VisibleLines;i++){var label=new Label();label.AddThemeFontSizeOverride("font_size",15);label.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.Body);label.HorizontalAlignment=HorizontalAlignment.Left;label.Modulate=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0f);box.AddChild(label);_labels[i]=label;}foreach(var line in GameLogger.GetRecentLines(VisibleLines)){_lines.Add(new LogLine{Text=line,Age=0f});}GameLogger.LogEmitted+=OnLogEmitted;}/// <summary>Unsubscribes from the logger so a freed panel cannot receive worker-thread events.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){GameLogger.LogEmitted-=OnLogEmitted;}private void OnLogEmitted(string category,string message,LogLevel level){lock(_queueLock){_pending.Enqueue(new LogLine{Text=$"[{category}] {message}",Age=0f});}}/// <summary>Main-thread drain: pulls queued lines, ages them out and repaints the fading label stack.</summary>
public override void _Process(double delta){lock(_queueLock){while(_pending.Count>0)_lines.Add(_pending.Dequeue());}// Age every line; drop ones that have faded completely.
for(var i=_lines.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var line=_lines[i];line.Age+=(float)delta;_lines[i]=line;if(line.Age>=FadeSeconds)_lines.RemoveAt(i);}// Cap history so a fast log burst (e.g. mod discovery) cannot grow the list without bound before lines age out.
while(_lines.Count>256)_lines.RemoveAt(0);// Show the newest line + up to 4 before it; older = more transparent. The newest line sits in the bottom-most label (index VisibleLines-1), so with few lines the top labels stay empty. A negative line index marks exactly those top labels; it also covers the first seconds of a run, when the logger has emitted fewer than VisibleLines lines.
var start=_lines.Count-VisibleLines;for(var i=0;i<VisibleLines;i++){var lineIndex=start+i;if(lineIndex>=0){var line=_lines[lineIndex];var alpha=Mathf.Clamp(1f-line.Age/FadeSeconds,0f,1f);_labels[i].Text=line.Text;_labels[i].Modulate=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,alpha);}else{_labels[i].Text="";_labels[i].Modulate=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0f);}}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu{/// <summary> Thin progress bar for the launcher boot overlay. Polls the thread-safe <see cref="BootProgress"/> snapshot every frame — the boot pipeline and the mod compiler run on worker threads and never touch Godot nodes, so all rendering-side updates happen here in <see cref="_Process"/>. Custom-drawn instead of a themed ProgressBar to keep the boot overlay's minimal look: a flat accent strip over a faint well. </summary>
public partial class BootProgressBar:Godot.Control{/// <summary>Displayed value chases the snapshot with this smoothing factor per second.</summary>
private const float EasePerSecond=6f;private float _displayed;/// <inheritdoc/>
public BootProgressBar(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;CustomMinimumSize=new(0,10);}/// <summary>Repaints the bar from the latest <see cref="BootProgress.GetOverall"/> snapshot.</summary>
public override void _Process(double delta){var target=BootProgress.GetOverall();// Ease toward the target; never ease backwards so a fast phase transition cannot visually rewind the bar.
if(target>_displayed)_displayed=System.Math.Min(target,_displayed+EasePerSecond*(float)delta*(target-_displayed+0.02f));else _displayed=target;QueueRedraw();}/// <summary>Draws the well and the accent fill for the current progress value.</summary>
public override void _Draw(){var size=GetSize();DrawRect(new Rect2(0,0,size.X,size.Y),UiTokens.Well);DrawRect(new Rect2(0,0,size.X,1),UiTokens.LineSoft);DrawRect(new Rect2(0,size.Y-1,size.X,1),UiTokens.LineSoft);if(_displayed<=0f)return;var fillWidth=size.X*_displayed;DrawRect(new Rect2(0,0,fillWidth,size.Y),UiTokens.Accent);// Bright leading edge so movement stays readable during long phases.
DrawRect(new Rect2(fillWidth-2,0,2,size.Y),UiTokens.AccentBright);}}}

using System;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu{/// <summary> One menu item in the <see cref="MenuRegistry"/>: a button shown in a menu block and the thing it is bound to. A button is bound either to a mod-relative scene path (pressed → the scene opens as a fullscreen child of the menu root, the declarative manifest behaviour) or to a <see cref="Handler"/> delegate (pressed → mod code runs, e.g. the built-in new game / exit actions). <para/> Entries arrive from two sources and live in one ordered list: manifest <c>main_menu</c> declarations (collected by <see cref="MenuRegistry.Rebuild"/>, <c>Section</c> fixed to <see cref="SectionMods"/>) and runtime registrations from mod initializers via <see cref="MenuRegistry.RegisterButton"/>. <see cref="ModOrderIndex"/> orders manifest entries by mod load position; runtime entries use <c>-1</c> so equal-index registrations keep their programmatic priority. </summary>
public class MenuButtonEntry{/// <summary>Buttons whose <see cref="Section"/> is not provided land in the mod block.</summary>
public const string SectionMods="mods";/// <summary>Unique button id, namespaced by convention to the owning mod ("my_mod/my_button").</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Id of the registering mod, filled by the registry.</summary>
public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary> Menu block the button belongs to. The host menu maps section names to containers; unknown sections fall back to <see cref="SectionMods"/>. </summary>
public string Section{get;set;}=SectionMods;/// <summary>Translation key for the caption (required — the button must be localizable).</summary>
public string Locale{get;set;}/// <summary>Optional icon key resolved through UIIconFactory.</summary>
public string Icon{get;set;}/// <summary>Optional theme type variation suffix ("primary", "danger"); applied as "Cthangover&lt;Suffix&gt;".</summary>
public string Variation{get;set;}/// <summary>Vertical order inside the section; smaller is higher.</summary>
public int Index{get;set;}=10;/// <summary> Optional visibility predicate evaluated each time the menu is built (e.g. "Continue" only when a last session exists); null = always. </summary>
public System.Func<bool>Visible{get;set;}/// <summary> Mod-relative scene path opened on press. Optional when <see cref="Handler"/> is set; at least one of the two is required. </summary>
public string ScenePath{get;set;}/// <summary> Press callback receiving the host menu root. Optional when <see cref="ScenePath"/> is set; at least one of the two is required. </summary>
public Action<Control>Handler{get;set;}/// <summary>Position of the owning mod in load order; <c>-1</c> for runtime registrations until resolved.</summary>
public int ModOrderIndex{get;set;}= -1;/// <summary>True when the button has a localizable caption and a press target.</summary>
internal bool IsValid=> !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Id)&& !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Locale)&&(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ScenePath)||Handler!=null);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu{/// <summary> The menu registry: a single place that knows which menu items (buttons) exist, which menu blocks (sections) they belong to, and what each button is bound to — a mod scene or a code handler. private static MenuRegistry Owned=>AppServices.Current.Menus;/// <summary> Creates an empty registry: cheap and side-effect free per the IGameRegistry contract. <see cref="Rebuild"/> fills the manifest part. </summary>
internal MenuRegistry(){}/// <inheritdoc />

namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;/// <summary> Script of <c>res://scenes/menu/mod_set_transition.tscn</c>, the scene the window shows while the process replaces its mod set (switching games, hot reload). It must be a kernel scene loaded natively, like the launcher: the previous scene belongs to mods that are about to be released, and the next one belongs to mods that are not loaded yet — no mod scene can exist across that gap. The scene's <see cref="BootLogPanel"/> streams the compile progress; on a rejected reload <see cref="ShowErrors"/> swaps it for the compile errors and a way back. The texts come from <see cref="BootMessages"/> because mod locale is not available in the gap either. </summary>
public partial class ModSetTransitionScreen:Control{/// <summary>The prefab with the layout of the screen.</summary>
public const string ScenePath="res://scenes/menu/mod_set_transition.tscn";/// <summary>Makes a new transition screen the current scene (the engine frees the previous scene at the end of the frame).</summary>
public static ModSetTransitionScreen Show(SceneTree tree){var screen=GD.Load<PackedScene>(ScenePath).Instantiate<ModSetTransitionScreen>();tree.ChangeSceneToNode(screen);return screen;}/// <summary>Applies the boot theme and the localized title.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){CthangoverTheme.Apply(this);GetNode<Label>("Title").Text=BootMessages.LoadingMods(Language);var back=GetNode<Button>("Errors/Back");back.Text=BootMessages.Back(Language);CthangoverTheme.ApplyPrimary(back);}/// <summary>Replaces the progress log with <paramref name="errors"/>; the Back button runs <paramref name="onBack"/>.</summary>
public void ShowErrors(IEnumerable<string>errors,Action onBack){GetNode<Label>("Title").Text=BootMessages.LoadingModsFailed(Language);GetNode<Control>("Log").Visible=false;GetNode<RichTextLabel>("Errors/ErrorText").Text=string.Join("\n",errors);GetNode<Button>("Errors/Back").Pressed+=onBack;GetNode<Control>("Errors").Visible=true;}private static string Language=>GameData.Instance?.Settings?.Language;}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Messages{/// <summary> Static buffer that queues notification texts before they are displayed. Notifications accumulate here and wait until a visible slot becomes available in <see cref="NotificationPanel"/>. The 10-second display timer starts only when a notification is pulled from the buffer and shown on screen — pending entries in the buffer have no timeout. </summary>
public static class NotificationBuffer{private static readonly Queue<string>_pending=new();/// <summary> Enqueues a notification text into the buffer. Null or empty strings are silently ignored. Notifications are served in FIFO order by <see cref="TryDequeue"/>. </summary> <param name="text">The notification text to enqueue.</param>
public static void Add(string text){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return;_pending.Enqueue(text);}/// <summary> Dequeues the oldest pending notification, if any. </summary> <param name="text">Receives the dequeued text, or <c>null</c> if the buffer is empty.</param> <returns><c>true</c> if a notification was dequeued; <c>false</c> otherwise.</returns>
public static bool TryDequeue(out string text){if(_pending.Count>0){text=_pending.Dequeue();return true;}text=null;return false;}/// <summary> The number of notifications currently waiting in the buffer. </summary>
public static int PendingCount=>_pending.Count;/// <summary> Removes all pending notifications from the buffer without displaying them. Safe to call at any time. </summary>
public static void Clear(){_pending.Clear();}}}

===== FILE Core/UI/NotificationBridge.cs =====
using System;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI{/// <summary> Core-side bridge for floating UI notifications. The implementation (MessagesHelper, interface engine mod) installs its hook through <see cref="Register"/> when the mod initializer runs; the kernel call sites (CharacterData.SendAddNotification) only know this delegate slot. Registration is first-wins; while no hooks are bound the message is logged and dropped instead of throwing, so a kernel-only runtime keeps working without the interface mod. Same pattern as <c>LightingBridge</c> and <see cref="UiThemeBridge"/>. </summary>
public static class NotificationBridge{private static readonly object Gate=new();private static Action<string>_showMessage;/// <summary>Installs the notification hook; first registration wins, re-registrations are logged and ignored.</summary>
public static void Register(Action<string>showMessage){if(showMessage==null)return;lock(Gate){if(_showMessage!=null){GameLogger.Log("UI","NotificationBridge: notification hook already registered; ignoring re-registration",LogLevel.Warning);return;}_showMessage=showMessage;}}/// <summary> Shows a floating UI message through the bound implementation. Logged and dropped when no interface implementation is bound. </summary>
public static void Show(string text){Action<string>hook;lock(Gate)hook=_showMessage;if(hook==null){GameLogger.Log("UI","NotificationBridge: no notification hook bound (interface mod not loaded); message dropped: "+text,LogLevel.Warning);return;}hook(text);}}}

private static StyleBoxFlat Flat(int radius,Color background,Color?border=null){var style=new StyleBoxFlat{BgColor=background,CornerRadiusTopLeft=radius,CornerRadiusTopRight=radius,CornerRadiusBottomLeft=radius,CornerRadiusBottomRight=radius,};if(border.HasValue&&border.Value.A>0f){style.BorderColor=border.Value;style.BorderWidthLeft=1;style.BorderWidthRight=1;style.BorderWidthTop=1;style.BorderWidthBottom=1;}return style;}private static StyleBoxFlat WindowBox(){var style=Flat(UiTokens.RadiusLg,UiTokens.Surface0,UiTokens.Line);style.ShadowColor=new Color(0f,0f,0f,0.6f);style.ShadowSize=18;style.ShadowOffset=new Vector2(0,8);style.ContentMarginLeft=16;style.ContentMarginRight=16;style.ContentMarginTop=16;style.ContentMarginBottom=16;return style;}private static ImageTexture MakeCircleTexture(int size,Color fill,Color border){var image=Image.CreateEmpty(size,size,false,Image.Format.Rgba8);image.Fill(new Color(0f,0f,0f,0f));var center=(size-1)/2f;var radius=size/2f-0.5f;for(var y=0;y<size;y++){for(var x=0;x<size;x++){var dx=x-center;var dy=y-center;var distance=Mathf.Sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(distance<=radius-1.1f)image.SetPixel(x,y,fill);else if(distance<=radius)image.SetPixel(x,y,border);}}return ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);}private static ImageTexture MakeArrowTexture(){const int width=11;const int height=6;var image=Image.CreateEmpty(width,height,false,Image.Format.Rgba8);image.Fill(new Color(0f,0f,0f,0f));for(var y=0;y<height;y++){var run=height-y;var start=(width-run)/2;for(var x=start;x<start+run;x++)image.SetPixel(x,y,UiTokens.Body);}return ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming{/// <summary> The switch of every <see cref="CheckButton"/>: a rounded track with a knob, drawn in the theme's tokens instead of Godot's default icons. Off is a dark track with a grey knob on the left, on is a gold track with the knob on the right. The button itself has no background in any state (it used to inherit the plain button's panel, a light box around an unchecked switch); hover and focus light up the track instead — Godot has no hover icons for a CheckButton, so every switch that enters the tree swaps in the "lit" textures while it is under the mouse or focused (icon overrides, removed again on leave). Pixels are drawn with a signed distance (anti-aliased edges), once, when the theme is built. </summary>
public static class ToggleSwitchTextures{private const int Width=38;private const int Height=22;private const float Knob=7f;/// <summary>Unchecked, resting.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D Off=Draw(false,UiTokens.Surface3,UiTokens.LineStrong,UiTokens.Muted);/// <summary>Unchecked, under the mouse or focused.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D OffLit=Draw(false,UiTokens.SurfaceHover,UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.6f),UiTokens.Body);/// <summary>Checked, resting.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D On=Draw(true,UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.28f),UiTokens.Accent,UiTokens.AccentBright);/// <summary>Checked, under the mouse or focused.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D OnLit=Draw(true,UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.4f),UiTokens.AccentBright,UiTokens.InkBright);/// <summary>Unchecked and disabled.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D OffDisabled=Draw(false,UiTokens.Surface3,UiTokens.LineDisabled,UiTokens.Faint);/// <summary>Checked and disabled.</summary>
public static readonly Texture2D OnDisabled=Draw(true,UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.1f),UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.3f),UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.AccentBright,0.45f));/// <summary>Puts the switch into <paramref name="theme"/>: track icons and empty backgrounds of <c>CheckButton</c>.</summary>
public static void Apply(Theme theme){const string type="CheckButton";foreach(var state in new[]{"normal","hover","pressed","hover_pressed","disabled","focus"}){var empty=new StyleBoxEmpty();empty.ContentMarginLeft=2;empty.ContentMarginRight=2;empty.ContentMarginTop=2;empty.ContentMarginBottom=2;theme.SetStylebox(state,type,empty);}theme.SetIcon("unchecked",type,Off);theme.SetIcon("checked",type,On);theme.SetIcon("unchecked_mirrored",type,Off);theme.SetIcon("checked_mirrored",type,On);theme.SetIcon("unchecked_disabled",type,OffDisabled);theme.SetIcon("checked_disabled",type,OnDisabled);theme.SetIcon("unchecked_disabled_mirrored",type,OffDisabled);theme.SetIcon("checked_disabled_mirrored",type,OnDisabled);if(!tracking&&Engine.GetMainLoop()is SceneTree tree){tracking=true;tree.NodeAdded+=node=>{if(node is CheckButton button)Track(button);};}}private static bool tracking;private static void Track(CheckButton button){void Refresh(){if(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(button))return;// Only switches drawn by this theme: a button with icons of its own keeps them.
button.RemoveThemeIconOverride("unchecked");button.RemoveThemeIconOverride("checked");if(button.GetThemeIcon("unchecked")!=Off)return;var lit= !button.Disabled&&(button.IsHovered()||button.HasFocus());if(!lit)return;button.AddThemeIconOverride("unchecked",OffLit);button.AddThemeIconOverride("checked",OnLit);}button.MouseEntered+=()=>Callable.From(Refresh).CallDeferred();button.MouseExited+=()=>Callable.From(Refresh).CallDeferred();button.FocusEntered+=Refresh;button.FocusExited+=Refresh;}private static Texture2D Draw(bool on,Color fill,Color border,Color knob){var image=Image.CreateEmpty(Width,Height,false,Image.Format.Rgba8);var radius=(Height-1)/2f;var knobCenter=new Vector2(on?Width-1-radius:radius,radius);for(var y=0;y<Height;y++){for(var x=0;x<Width;x++){var p=new Vector2(x,y);// Distance to the track: a capsule from the left to the right half-circle centre.
var cx=Mathf.Clamp(p.X,radius,Width-1-radius);var track=p.DistanceTo(new Vector2(cx,radius))-radius;var color=new Color(0f,0f,0f,0f);color=Over(color,fill,Coverage(track+0.5f));color=Over(color,border,Coverage(track+0.5f)-Coverage(track+1.5f));color=Over(color,knob,Coverage(p.DistanceTo(knobCenter)-Knob+0.5f));image.SetPixel(x,y,color);}}return ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);}/// <summary>Pixel coverage of a shape from its signed distance (negative inside).</summary>
private static float Coverage(float distance)=>Mathf.Clamp(0.5f-distance,0f,1f);private static Color Over(Color below,Color top,float coverage){var a=Mathf.Clamp(top.A*coverage,0f,1f);if(a<=0f)return below;var outA=a+below.A*(1f-a);var rgb=(new Vector3(top.R,top.G,top.B)*a+new Vector3(below.R,below.G,below.B)*below.A*(1f-a))/outA;return new Color(rgb.X,rgb.Y,rgb.Z,outA);}}}

Panels must not hardcode colours — they reference these tokens (directly or through <see cref="CthangoverTheme"/> and <see cref="UiKit"/>). using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool{/// <summary> Save-format DTO for <see cref="MapZoneService"/> runtime overrides. Both dictionaries store only zones whose live state differs from the authoring defaults (<see cref="MapZone.Locked"/> / <see cref="MapZone.Hidden"/>), keyed by zone <see cref="MapZone.ID"/>. <para/> Storing deltas instead of the full effective state keeps saves small and, more importantly, lets a mod update its authoring defaults without the save silently reverting them: a zone the player never touched always follows the current JSON. Unknown IDs are tolerated on load — they simply never match a zone and cost nothing if a mod is temporarily disabled. </summary>
public class MapZoneStateData{/// <summary> Explicit open/closed overrides. <c>true</c> — zone was opened by a scenario, <c>false</c> — closed; absent IDs follow the authoring default. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("open")]public Dictionary<string,bool>Open{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Explicit shown/hidden overrides. <c>true</c> — zone was revealed by a scenario, <c>false</c> — hidden; absent IDs follow the authoring default. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("visible")]public Dictionary<string,bool>Visible{get;set;}=new();}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool{/// <summary> Registry for dynamically-discovered toolbar button definitions. Scans assemblies via Reflections.FindAndCreate on construction, loading all IToolBoxButton implementations. Supports RegisterAssembly for mods to inject their own buttons at runtime. GetVisible() filters by each button's IsVisible() method, so buttons can conditionally hide. <para/> The single instance is owned by the <see cref="AppServices"/> composition root; the static facade stays as the public API during migration. Initialization moves from eager (static field) to lazy (first access through the owning <c>Lazy</c> slot). </summary>
public class ToolBoxButtonFactory{/// <summary>Facade over the AppServices-owned instance; kept as the public API during migration.</summary>
public static ToolBoxButtonFactory Instance=>AppServices.Current.ToolBoxButtons.Value;private readonly List<IToolBoxButton>_buttons=new();private readonly HashSet<Type>_buttonTypes=new();internal ToolBoxButtonFactory(){foreach(var button in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IToolBoxButton>())Register(button);GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolBoxButtonFactory: loaded {_buttons.Count} button(s)");}/// <summary> Scans all types in the given assembly for <see cref="IToolBoxButton"/> implementations, instantiates them via <c>Activator.CreateInstance</c>, and registers each one. Primary hook for mods to inject their own toolbar buttons at runtime. </summary>
public void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){ICollection<IToolBoxButton>buttons;try{buttons=Reflections.FindAndCreate<IToolBoxButton>(assembly);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolBoxButtonFactory: failed to scan assembly '{assembly.GetName().Name}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return;}foreach(var button in buttons)Register(button);}/// <summary> Adds a button definition to the registry. Buttons of the same concrete type are deduplicated (the factory may see an assembly both through the initial AppDomain scan and through <see cref="RegisterAssembly"/>). Different button types targeting the same <see cref="IToolBoxButton.ToolId"/> are still allowed because they may have different visibility rules. </summary>
public void Register(IToolBoxButton button){if(!_buttonTypes.Add(button.GetType()))return;_buttons.Add(button);GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolBoxButtonFactory: registered button for '{button.ToolId}'");}/// <summary> Removes buttons whose concrete type comes from the given assembly — the unload pass of the assembly consumer pipeline. </summary>
public void UnregisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){_buttons.RemoveAll(b=>b.GetType().Assembly==assembly);_buttonTypes.RemoveWhere(t=>t.Assembly==assembly);}/// <summary> Returns all registered buttons that currently pass <see cref="IToolBoxButton.IsVisible"/>. Used by <see cref="ToolBox.AddToolButtons"/> to dynamically populate the toolbar HUD. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<IToolBoxButton>GetVisible(){return _buttons.Where(b=>b.IsVisible()).ToList();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Reflection;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool{/// <summary> Registry for modding/dev tools (IToolProvider implementations). Discovers tools via reflection on construction; supports RegisterAssembly for mod-injected tools. Deduplicates by Id. Get/GetAll provide lookup for the tool block of the main menu and the in-game toolbox. <para/> The single instance is owned by the <see cref="AppServices"/> composition root; the static facade stays as the public API during migration. Initialization moves from eager (static field) to lazy (first access through the owning <c>Lazy</c> slot). </summary>
public class ToolFactory{/// <summary>Facade over the AppServices-owned instance; kept as the public API during migration.</summary>
public static ToolFactory Instance=>AppServices.Current.Tools.Value;private readonly Dictionary<string,IToolProvider>_tools=new();internal ToolFactory(){foreach(var tool in Reflections.FindAndCreate<IToolProvider>())Register(tool);GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolFactory: loaded {_tools.Count} tool(s)");}/// <summary> Scans all types in the given assembly for <see cref="IToolProvider"/> implementations, instantiates them via <c>Activator.CreateInstance</c>, and registers each one. Primary hook for mods to register their own tools at runtime. </summary>
public void RegisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){ICollection<IToolProvider>tools;try{tools=Reflections.FindAndCreate<IToolProvider>(assembly);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolFactory: failed to scan assembly '{assembly.GetName().Name}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return;}foreach(var tool in tools)Register(tool);}/// <summary> Registers a tool, deduplicating by <see cref="IToolProvider.Id"/>. If a tool with the same Id was already registered, the new one is silently discarded — first-come-wins. </summary>
public void Register(IToolProvider tool){if(_tools.TryGetValue(tool.Id,out var existing)){if(existing.GetType()!=tool.GetType()){GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolFactory: duplicate tool id '{tool.Id}' from '{tool.GetType().FullName}' ignored (already provided by '{existing.GetType().FullName}')",LogLevel.Warning);}return;}_tools[tool.Id]=tool;GameLogger.Log("TOOLS",$"ToolFactory: registered '{tool.Id}'");}/// <summary> Removes tools whose concrete type comes from the given assembly — the unload pass of the assembly consumer pipeline. Core tools survive; a mod reinstall re-registers through the normal fan-out. </summary>
public void UnregisterAssembly(Assembly assembly){foreach(var id in _tools.Where(kvp=>kvp.Value.GetType().Assembly==assembly).Select(kvp=>kvp.Key).ToList())_tools.Remove(id);}/// <summary> Looks up a tool by its <see cref="IToolProvider.Id"/>. Returns <c>null</c> if not found. </summary>
public IToolProvider Get(string id){_tools.TryGetValue(id,out var tool);return tool;}/// <summary> Returns all registered tools as a read-only list. Used by <see cref="MainMenu"/> to populate the Tools dropdown. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<IToolProvider>GetAll(){return _tools.Values.ToList();}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI{/// <summary> Centralized, one-shot construction of the mod GUI for a freshly loaded shell. Kept deliberately dumb: it never reacts to intermediate states and never rebuilds — <see cref="UiHost"/> calls it exactly once per <c>ShellReadyEvent</c>, and <see cref="IToolbarHost.ApplyPanelButtons"/> owns the actual node creation. </summary>
public static class UiBuilder{/// <summary> Asks the shell toolbar to materialize the buttons declared by panel-kind entries. Panel scenes themselves are built lazily on first toggle. </summary>
public static void Build(Node shellRoot){if(shellRoot==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(shellRoot))return;if(shellRoot.FindChild("TopView",true,false)is not IToolbarHost toolBox){GameLogger.Log("UI_BUILDER","Build: ToolBox 'TopView' not found in shell",LogLevel.Warning);return;}toolBox.ApplyPanelButtons(AppServices.Current.Ui.AllPanels);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI{/// <summary> Persistent autoload that owns the mod-built GUI for the whole session. Panels live under its own <see cref="CanvasLayer"/> instead of the base scene, so entering a separate native or mod-routed scene (e.g. battle) and coming back does not rebuild them — the registry only re-attaches and re-shows what is already cached. <para/> Responsibilities: instance cache keyed by <see cref="UiEntry.Id"/>, lazy construction through <see cref="TscnScenes"/>, scene-based visibility (entries bound to a logical scene hide on exit and restore on re-entry), and tree access for mod code (<see cref="FindNode"/>, <see cref="Join"/>). It subscribes to <see cref="ShellReadyEvent"/> to learn the current shell root and to trigger <see cref="UiBuilder.Build"/>. </summary>
public partial class UiHost:Node{/// <summary>Autoload singleton; null outside runtime.</summary>
public static UiHost Instance{get;private set;}private CanvasLayer layer;private Node shellRoot;private readonly Dictionary<string,Control>instances=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly Dictionary<string,bool>toggled=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly HashSet<string>hiddenByScene=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>Root of the currently loaded shell, or null before the first ShellReadyEvent.</summary>
public Node ShellRoot=>shellRoot;/// <summary>Creates the persistent canvas layer and subscribes to shell and scene lifetime events.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){Instance=this;ProcessMode=ProcessModeEnum.Always;layer=new CanvasLayer{Name="UiHostLayer",Layer=100};AddChild(layer);ModEventBus.Subscribe<ShellReadyEvent>(OnShellReady);ModEventBus.Subscribe<SceneEnteredEvent>(OnSceneEntered,priority:30);ModEventBus.Subscribe<SceneExitedEvent>(OnSceneExited,priority:30);}/// <summary>Clears the autoload singleton when the host is torn down.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){if(Instance==this)Instance=null;}/// <summary> Finds a node by name in the current shell. Backs both the registry anchoring and mod snippets that need to reach into the shell tree. </summary>
public Node FindNode(string name){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)||shellRoot==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(shellRoot))return null;return shellRoot.FindChild(name,true,false);}/// <summary> Parents an already built control to an arbitrary existing node, for mod code that wants its element to be part of that node's layout instead of a hosted overlay. Joined elements are freed together with their parent and therefore lose the app-lifetime guarantee panels normally get. </summary>
public bool Join(Node parent,Control panel){if(parent==null||panel==null)return false;parent.AddChild(panel);return true;}/// <summary> Shows or hides the entry with the given id, creating its instance on first use. Panels are toggled exclusively through this method. </summary>
public void Toggle(string id){var entry=AppServices.Current.Ui.GetById(id);if(entry==null){GameLogger.Log("UI_HOST",$"Toggle('{id}'): entry not found",LogLevel.Warning);return;}var instance=EnsureInstance(entry);if(instance==null)return;hiddenByScene.Remove(id);if(instance is IWidget widget){widget.Switch();toggled[id]=widget.Visible;}else{var visible= !instance.Visible;instance.Visible=visible;toggled[id]=visible;}}/// <summary> Returns the cached instance for an entry <b>without</b> creating it, for mod code that wants to reach an already-built panel (e.g. the map editor asking the map widget to reload). Returns <c>false</c> when the panel was never opened; use <see cref="EnsureInstance"/> to force construction. </summary>
public bool TryGetInstance(string id,out Control control){control=null;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(!instances.TryGetValue(id,out var cached)|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return false;control=cached;return true;}/// <summary> Returns the cached instance for an entry, building it on first use. Hosted entries (panels and once-overlays) are parented to the host layer; transient overlays are joined to their slot in the current shell. </summary>
public Control EnsureInstance(UiEntry entry){if(instances.TryGetValue(entry.Id,out var cached)){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached))return cached;instances.Remove(entry.Id);}var node=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(entry.ScenePath);if(node is not Control control){GameLogger.Log("UI_HOST",$"EnsureInstance('{entry.Id}'): '{entry.ScenePath}' did not build a Control",LogLevel.Error);return null;}control.Name=entry.Id;UiThemeBridge.Apply(control);if(IsHosted(entry)){layer.AddChild(control);control.SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(Control.LayoutPreset.FullRect);}else{var slot=FindNode(entry.Slot);if(slot==null){GameLogger.Log("UI_HOST",$"EnsureInstance('{entry.Id}'): slot '{entry.Slot}' not found",LogLevel.Warning);control.QueueFree();return null;}slot.AddChild(control);control.SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(Control.LayoutPreset.FullRect);}if(control is IUiLazyConstruct lazyConstruct)lazyConstruct.EnsureConstructed();instances[entry.Id]=control;SetVisible(control,false);return control;}/// <summary> Frees every cached instance and forgets the shell. Called by <see cref="ModManager"/> so a hot-reloaded mod set starts clean. </summary>
public void ClearAll(){foreach(var instance in instances.Values){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(instance))instance.QueueFree();}instances.Clear();toggled.Clear();hiddenByScene.Clear();shellRoot=null;}/// <summary> Hides every cached panel and overlay without freeing it, and forgets which ones were open. Panels live on the host layer above every scene, so without this a panel open when the player leaves the game (the pause menu's "Main menu" button, the studio, the inventory) would stay on top of the title screen. Called by the main menu when it opens; the next shell shows its start-up overlays again (<see cref="OnShellReady"/>). </summary>
public void HideAll(){foreach(var instance in instances.Values)SetVisible(instance,false);toggled.Clear();hiddenByScene.Clear();}private static bool IsHosted(UiEntry entry)=>UiRegistry.IsPanel(entry)||entry.Once;private void OnShellReady(ShellReadyEvent e){PurgeInvalidInstances();shellRoot=e.Root;UiThemeBridge.Apply(e.Root);UiBuilder.Build(e.Root);foreach(var entry in AppServices.Current.Ui.AllEntries){if(IsSceneBound(entry)||UiRegistry.IsPanel(entry)|| !entry.ShowOnStart)continue;toggled[entry.Id]=true;var instance=EnsureInstance(entry);SetVisible(instance,true);}}private void OnSceneEntered(SceneEnteredEvent e){foreach(var entry in AppServices.Current.Ui.AllEntries){if(!IsSceneBound(entry)|| !string.Equals(entry.Scene,e.SceneName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(!UiRegistry.IsPanel(entry)&&entry.ShowOnStart){toggled[entry.Id]=true;hiddenByScene.Remove(entry.Id);SetVisible(EnsureInstance(entry),true);continue;}if(hiddenByScene.Remove(entry.Id)&&toggled.GetValueOrDefault(entry.Id))SetVisible(EnsureInstance(entry),true);}}private void OnSceneExited(SceneExitedEvent e){foreach(var entry in AppServices.Current.Ui.AllEntries){if(!IsSceneBound(entry)|| !string.Equals(entry.Scene,e.SceneName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;if(!entry.Once){DestroyInstance(entry.Id);continue;}if(toggled.GetValueOrDefault(entry.Id)){hiddenByScene.Add(entry.Id);if(instances.TryGetValue(entry.Id,out var instance))SetVisible(instance,false);}}}private void PurgeInvalidInstances(){var stale=new List<string>();foreach(var pair in instances){if(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(pair.Value))stale.Add(pair.Key);}foreach(var id in stale){instances.Remove(id);toggled.Remove(id);hiddenByScene.Remove(id);}}private void DestroyInstance(string id){if(instances.TryGetValue(id,out var instance)){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(instance))instance.QueueFree();instances.Remove(id);}toggled.Remove(id);hiddenByScene.Remove(id);}private static bool IsSceneBound(UiEntry entry)=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Scene)&& !string.Equals(entry.Scene,"shell",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private static void SetVisible(Control control,bool visible){if(control==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(control))return;if(control is IWidget widget)widget.Visible=visible;else control.Visible=visible;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI{/// <summary> Data half of the mod GUI pipeline: collects, validates and orders the <c>ui</c> declarations from every loaded mod manifest. Creates no nodes — <see cref="UiBuilder"/> reads <see cref="PanelEntries"/> to build the toolbar once per shell, and <see cref="UiHost"/> resolves entries by id at runtime. <para/> Validation is mandatory and runs once per build: every problem is logged with its mod id, the offending entry is skipped, and the remaining mods still load. <see cref="IGameRegistry.Clear"/> is called on mod reload so a hot-reloaded mod set is reflected without restarting the game. <para/> The registry instance lives in <see cref="AppServices.Current"/>; the static members below are a facade delegating to it, so existing callers keep working unchanged. </summary>
public class UiRegistry:IGameRegistry{private readonly List<UiEntry>entries=new();private readonly List<UiEntry>panels=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,UiEntry>byId=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private bool built;/// <summary>Shared instance the static facade delegates to.</summary>
private static UiRegistry Owned=>AppServices.Current.Ui;/// <summary> Creates an empty registry: cheap and side-effect free per the IGameRegistry contract. <see cref="Rebuild"/> fills the data. </summary>
internal UiRegistry(){}/// <inheritdoc />
public string Id=>"ui";/// <summary> Drops all collected entries, then re-collects and re-validates the <c>ui</c> arrays of all loaded mods. Forced: safe to call repeatedly. </summary>
public void Rebuild(){Reset();built=true;Collect();}/// <summary> Drops all collected entries so the next build re-reads the manifests. Called on mod reload through AppServices.ClearRegistries. </summary>
void IGameRegistry.Clear(){Reset();}/// <summary> Collects and validates the <c>ui</c> arrays of all loaded mods unless already built. Keeps the old Initialize idempotence: later calls are no-ops until the registry is cleared. </summary>
public void EnsureBuilt(){if(!built)Rebuild();}/// <summary>Direct instance access for core consumers migrating off the static facade.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<UiEntry>AllEntries=>entries;/// <summary>Direct instance access for core consumers migrating off the static facade.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<UiEntry>AllPanels=>panels;// ---- Static facade (legacy API, unchanged for callers) ------------ <summary>All valid UI entries in mod load order (then priority, then id).</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<UiEntry>Entries=>Owned.entries;/// <summary>Panel-kind entries, pre-sorted for toolbar construction.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<UiEntry>PanelEntries=>Owned.panels;/// <summary> Collects and validates the <c>ui</c> arrays of all loaded mods. Safe to call multiple times; later calls are no-ops until <see cref="Clear"/>. </summary>
public static void Initialize()=>Owned.EnsureBuilt();/// <summary> Drops all collected entries so the next <see cref="Initialize"/> re-reads the manifests. Called by <see cref="ModManager"/> on reload/clear. </summary>
public static void Clear()=>Owned.Reset();/// <summary>Returns the entry with the given id, or null when unknown.</summary>
public static UiEntry Get(string id)=>Owned.GetById(id);/// <summary> Shows or hides the GUI element with the given id through <see cref="UiHost"/>. Panels are toggled this way; overlays may be toggled by their own actions. </summary>
public static void Toggle(string id)=>Owned.ToggleEntry(id);/// <summary>True when the entry represents a button-toggled panel.</summary>
public static bool IsPanel(UiEntry entry)=>entry!=null&&entry.Kind==UiEntry.KindPanel;// ---- Instance implementation -------------------------------------- <summary>Direct instance access for core consumers migrating off the static facade.</summary>
public void Reset(){entries.Clear();panels.Clear();byId.Clear();built=false;}/// <summary>Direct instance access for core consumers migrating off the static facade.</summary>
public UiEntry GetById(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;return byId.TryGetValue(id,out var entry)?entry:null;}/// <summary>Direct instance access for core consumers migrating off the static facade.</summary>
public void ToggleEntry(string id){var host=UiHost.Instance;if(host==null){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"Toggle('{id}'): UiHost not available",LogLevel.Error);return;}host.Toggle(id);}private void Collect(){var manager=ModManager.Instance;if(manager?.Mods==null){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY","Collect: mods not loaded",LogLevel.Error);return;}var orderedIds=ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds();for(var order=0;order<orderedIds.Count;order++){var modId=orderedIds[order];if(!manager.Mods.TryGetValue(modId,out var info)||info is not ModInfo modInfo)continue;var declarations=modInfo.Manifest?.Ui;if(declarations==null||declarations.Count==0)continue;var accepted=new List<UiEntry>();foreach(var raw in declarations){if(raw==null)continue;raw.ModId=modId;raw.ModOrderIndex=order;if(Validate(raw,modInfo))accepted.Add(raw);}accepted.Sort(CompareEntries);foreach(var entry in accepted)AddEntry(entry);}BuildPanelIndex();GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"Collect → {entries.Count} entry(ies), {panels.Count} panel(s)");}private static int CompareEntries(UiEntry a,UiEntry b){var priority=a.Priority.CompareTo(b.Priority);if(priority!=0)return priority;return string.Compare(a.Id,b.Id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}private void AddEntry(UiEntry entry){entries.Add(entry);byId[entry.Id]=entry;}private void BuildPanelIndex(){panels.Clear();foreach(var entry in entries){if(!IsPanel(entry))continue;entry.Once=true;panels.Add(entry);}panels.Sort(ComparePanelButtons);}private static int ComparePanelButtons(UiEntry a,UiEntry b){var index=a.Button.Index.CompareTo(b.Button.Index);if(index!=0)return index;var modOrder=a.ModOrderIndex.CompareTo(b.ModOrderIndex);if(modOrder!=0)return modOrder;return string.Compare(a.Id,b.Id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}private bool Validate(UiEntry entry,ModInfo modInfo){var label=$"{modInfo.Id}/{entry.Id ?? "?"}";if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Id)){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry in mod '{modInfo.Id}': missing 'id'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(byId.ContainsKey(entry.Id)){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': duplicate id",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(entry.Kind!=UiEntry.KindPanel&&entry.Kind!=UiEntry.KindOverlay){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': kind must be '{UiEntry.KindPanel}' or '{UiEntry.KindOverlay}'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Slot)){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': missing 'slot'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.ScenePath)){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': missing 'scene_path'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(entry.Kind==UiEntry.KindPanel){if(entry.Button==null){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': kind=panel requires 'button'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Button.Icon)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Button.Locale)){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': button requires 'icon' and 'locale'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}}else if(entry.Button!=null){GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"invalid ui entry '{label}': kind=overlay must not declare 'button'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}var provider=modInfo.FileProvider;if(provider!=null&& !provider.FileExists(entry.ScenePath))GameLogger.Log("UI_REGISTRY",$"ui entry '{label}': scene_path '{entry.ScenePath}' not found in mod '{modInfo.Id}'",LogLevel.Warning);return true;}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI{/// <summary> Core-side bridge for UI theming. The implementation (CthangoverTheme, interface engine mod) installs its hook through <see cref="Register"/> when the mod initializer runs; the kernel call sites (UiHost's shell and panel builds) only know this delegate slot. Registration is first-wins: reloading the mod re-runs its static initializers, and a second hook must never stack on top of the first. While no hooks are bound (kernel built without the interface mod, or calls before mods load) invocations are skipped with a warning instead of throwing. Same pattern as <c>LightingBridge</c> for the time mod. </summary>
public static class UiThemeBridge{private static readonly object Gate=new();private static Action<Node>_applyTheme;/// <summary>Installs the theme hook; first registration wins, re-registrations are logged and ignored.</summary>
public static void Register(Action<Node>applyTheme){if(applyTheme==null)return;lock(Gate){if(_applyTheme!=null){GameLogger.Log("UI","UiThemeBridge: theme hook already registered; ignoring re-registration",LogLevel.Warning);return;}_applyTheme=applyTheme;}}/// <summary> Applies the mod theme to a freshly built control or shell root. Skipped with a warning when no interface implementation is bound. </summary>
public static void Apply(Node root){if(root==null)return;Action<Node>hook;lock(Gate)hook=_applyTheme;if(hook==null){GameLogger.Log("UI","UiThemeBridge: no theme hook bound (interface mod not loaded); theme application skipped",LogLevel.Warning);return;}hook(root);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> A thread-safe, fixed-capacity cache with least-recently-used (LRU) eviction. Used to avoid redundant I/O and computation when the same data is requested repeatedly — for example, parsed scenario resources, mod asset metadata, or deserialised JSON configs. </summary> <typeparam name="TKey">The lookup key type (typically <c>string</c> or numeric IDs).</typeparam> <typeparam name="TValue">The cached payload type.</typeparam> <remarks> <para> Internally, a <see cref="Dictionary{TKey, TValue}"/> maps keys to <see cref="LinkedList{T}"/> nodes, and the linked list maintains access order. On every <see cref="Get"/> hit the accessed node is moved to the tail (most-recently-used). When the dictionary reaches <see cref="MaxSize"/> an insertion evicts the head (least-recently-used). </para> <para> The loader's <see cref="ICacheLoader{TKey, TValue}.Load"/> method is called <em>outside</em> the internal lock so that slow I/O does not block concurrent reads of already-cached entries. A double-check inside the lock ensures no duplicate loads occur for the same key. </para> <para> Every value that leaves the cache without being handed to a caller is reported to the optional eviction callback passed to the constructor: LRU eviction on insertion, a value that loses the double-check race (two threads loaded the same key, the loser is discarded un-cached), and values dropped by <see cref="Invalidate"/> or <see cref="Clear"/>. Like the loader, the callback is invoked <em>outside</em> the internal lock. This hook is the deterministic release point for payloads that own unmanaged memory — Godot resources such as <c>Texture2D</c>, <c>ImageTexture</c> or <c>AudioStream</c> keep their native/GPU allocation alive until the managed wrapper is disposed, and waiting for the .NET GC finalizer turns a bounded cache into a VRAM/audio memory leak during long sessions or frequent location changes. </para> </remarks>
public class BoundedCache<TKey,TValue>{private readonly int _maxSize;private readonly ICacheLoader<TKey,TValue>_loader;private readonly Dictionary<TKey,LinkedListNode<Entry>>_dict;private readonly LinkedList<Entry>_lru;private readonly object _lock;/// <summary> Optional sink for values leaving the cache (see class remarks); <c>null</c> for caches of plain managed values that need no explicit release. Never invoked while the internal lock is held. </summary>
private readonly Action<TValue>_onEvicted;private class Entry{/// <summary>Cache key of the entry; kept alongside the value so eviction can remove the dictionary slot.</summary>
public TKey Key;/// <summary>Cached payload produced by the loader.</summary>
public TValue Value;}/// <summary> Creates a cache with the given capacity and data-fetching strategy. A <paramref name="maxSize"/> of 0 disables the bound — entries will accumulate without eviction, which is suitable for immutable reference data that fits in memory. Values are dropped silently; use the second constructor for payloads that own unmanaged memory. </summary> <param name="maxSize">Maximum number of entries before the LRU tail is evicted.</param> <param name="loader">Delegate that produces values for cache misses.</param>
public BoundedCache(int maxSize,ICacheLoader<TKey,TValue>loader):this(maxSize,loader,null){}/// <summary> Creates a cache that additionally reports every dropped value through <paramref name="onEvicted"/> — the hook Godot-resource caches use to dispose evicted payloads deterministically (see the class remarks). The callback runs outside the internal lock, may fire from any thread that triggers a drop, and must not call back into the same cache: this instance would deadlock on re-entry. </summary> <param name="maxSize">Maximum number of entries before the LRU tail is evicted; 0 means unbounded.</param> <param name="loader">Delegate that produces values for cache misses.</param> <param name="onEvicted">Called for each value as it leaves the cache: LRU eviction, losing a duplicate-load race, <see cref="Invalidate"/>, <see cref="Clear"/>. May be <c>null</c>.</param>
public BoundedCache(int maxSize,ICacheLoader<TKey,TValue>loader,Action<TValue>onEvicted){_maxSize=maxSize;_loader=loader;_onEvicted=onEvicted;_dict=new Dictionary<TKey,LinkedListNode<Entry>>();_lru=new LinkedList<Entry>();_lock=new object();}/// <summary> The maximum number of entries this cache will hold before evicting the least-recently-used item. A value of 0 means unbounded. </summary>
public int MaxSize{get{return _maxSize;}}/// <summary> Current number of cached entries. This property acquires the internal lock for a consistent snapshot. </summary>
public int Count{get{lock(_lock)return _dict.Count;}}/// <summary> Retrieves the value for <paramref name="key"/>, either from the LRU in-memory store or by calling <see cref="ICacheLoader{TKey, TValue}.Load"/> on a miss. Newly loaded values are inserted into the cache and may trigger eviction of the least-recently-used entry if capacity is exceeded. Returning <c>null</c> from the loader causes the entry to be skipped entirely. </summary>
public TValue Get(TKey key){lock(_lock){if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var node)){_lru.Remove(node);_lru.AddLast(node);return node.Value.Value;}}var value=_loader.Load(key);List<TValue>dropped=null;TValue result;lock(_lock){if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var existing)){_lru.Remove(existing);_lru.AddLast(existing);result=existing.Value.Value;if(value!=null&& !ReferenceEquals(value,result)){// This thread lost the double-check race: the freshly loaded value is discarded un-cached. Report it so unmanaged payloads don't leak.
if(dropped==null)dropped=new List<TValue>();dropped.Add(value);}}else if(value==null){result=default;}else{if(_maxSize>0){while(_dict.Count>=_maxSize){var first=_lru.First;_lru.RemoveFirst();_dict.Remove(first.Value.Key);if(dropped==null)dropped=new List<TValue>();dropped.Add(first.Value.Value);}}var entry=new Entry{Key=key,Value=value};var newNode=new LinkedListNode<Entry>(entry);_dict[key]=newNode;_lru.AddLast(newNode);result=value;}}if(dropped!=null){for(var i=0;i<dropped.Count;i++)_onEvicted?.Invoke(dropped[i]);}return result;}/// <summary> A non-allocating lookup that returns <c>true</c> and sets <paramref name="value"/> only when the key is already cached; otherwise returns <c>false</c> <em>without</em> invoking the loader. Useful for callers that need to probe the cache without triggering side effects. </summary>
public bool TryGet(TKey key,out TValue value){lock(_lock){if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var node)){_lru.Remove(node);_lru.AddLast(node);value=node.Value.Value;return true;}}value=default;return false;}/// <summary> Removes a specific entry from the cache and the LRU tracking list, forcing the next <see cref="Get"/> call for this key to invoke the loader again. The removed value is reported to the eviction callback (outside the lock). A no-op if the key is not present. </summary>
public void Invalidate(TKey key){TValue dropped=default;lock(_lock){if(_dict.TryGetValue(key,out var node)){_lru.Remove(node);_dict.Remove(key);dropped=node.Value.Value;}}if(dropped!=null)_onEvicted?.Invoke(dropped);}/// <summary> Wipes all cached entries and resets the LRU order, typically called when a mod group is reloaded or a global configuration change makes all existing cached data stale. Every removed value is reported to the eviction callback (outside the lock). </summary>
public void Clear(){List<TValue>dropped=null;lock(_lock){if(_dict.Count>0){dropped=new List<TValue>(_dict.Count);foreach(var node in _lru)dropped.Add(node.Value);_dict.Clear();_lru.Clear();}}if(dropped!=null){for(var i=0;i<dropped.Count;i++)_onEvicted?.Invoke(dropped[i]);}}}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Generic enum parser that wraps <see cref="Enum.Parse(Type, string, bool)"/> with case-insensitive matching and a natural type-parameter syntax. Used across the project wherever config strings, serialized fields, or console commands must be converted into strongly-typed enum values without per-enum boilerplate. </summary> <typeparam name="T">The enum type to parse into.</typeparam>
public static class Enums<T>{/// <summary> Parses the case-insensitive string <paramref name="value"/> into the enum type <typeparamref name="T"/>. Throws <see cref="ArgumentException"/> if the string does not match any named constant. </summary>

using System;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> A <see cref="System.Text.Json"/> converter that deserialises a <c>[Flags]</c> enum from either a comma-separated string (e.g. <c>"OptionA, OptionB"</c>) or a raw integer value, and serialises it back as its <see cref="object.ToString"/> representation. </summary> <typeparam name="T">The <c>[Flags]</c> enum type.</typeparam> <remarks> This converter is registered with <c>JsonSerializerOptions</c> in the mod configuration pipeline, allowing human-editable JSON files to express bitmask enums as readable strings instead of opaque integers. </remarks>
public class FlagsStringEnumConverter<T>:JsonConverter<T>where T:struct,Enum{/// <summary> Reads a <typeparamref name="T"/> value from JSON. When the token is a <see cref="JsonTokenType.String"/>, delegates to <see cref="Enum.Parse(Type, string, bool)"/> with case-insensitive matching so that <c>"OptionA, OptionB"</c> maps to the combined flags value. When the token is a <see cref="JsonTokenType.Number"/>, casts the raw <c>uint</c> to the enum's underlying type. </summary>
public override T Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.String){var str=reader.GetString();return(T)Enum.Parse(typeof(T),str,ignoreCase:true);}if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.Number){var val=reader.GetUInt32();return(T)Enum.ToObject(typeof(T),val);}throw new JsonException($"Unexpected token {reader.TokenType} for enum {typeof(T).Name}");}/// <summary> Serialises the enum as its default <see cref="object.ToString"/> string, which for <c>[Flags]</c> types produces the comma-separated form (e.g. <c>"OptionA, OptionB"</c>). </summary>
public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,T value,JsonSerializerOptions options){writer.WriteStringValue(value.ToString());}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Process-wide runtime environment flags shared across the core. Distinguishes a real Godot runtime from unit-test and design-time hosts and tracks the Godot main thread so subsystems can guard Godot API calls. </summary>
public static class GameEnvironment{/// <summary> True when the process is a real game run whose boot pipeline has executed. Unit tests and design-time tooling leave it <c>false</c>, which routes file access and singleton reloads through safe non-Godot defaults. </summary>
public static bool IsRuntime{get;set;}/// <summary> Managed thread id of the Godot main thread, captured once at startup (see <see cref="MarkMainThread"/>). Used by subsystems that may be invoked from background loading threads to decide whether a Godot API call is safe on the current thread. </summary>
private static int _mainThreadId;/// <summary> True when the calling thread is the Godot main thread. Always true outside the runtime (unit tests) where no real Godot API is involved. </summary>
public static bool IsMainThread=> !IsRuntime||_mainThreadId==0||System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId==_mainThreadId;/// <summary> Captures the current thread as the Godot main thread. Called once from the static constructor of <c>GameData</c> (the first autoload), which is guaranteed to run on the main thread. </summary>
public static void MarkMainThread(){_mainThreadId=System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Central logging sink for the entire project. #if WINDOWS
[DllImport("kernel32.dll")]private static extern bool AllocConsole();[DllImport("kernel32.dll")]private static extern bool FreeConsole();

private static string _logPath;private static string _errorLogPath;private static bool _initialized;private static bool _enabled=true;private static bool _consoleAllocated;private static LogLevel _minimumLevel=LogLevel.Debug;private static HashSet<string>_enabledCategories;private static readonly object _lock=new();/// <summary> Fixed-size ring buffer of the most recent formatted log lines (category + message, no timestamp). public static readonly List<string>CompilationErrors=new();/// <summary> Explicit initialisation entry point. #if WINDOWS
try{_consoleAllocated=AllocConsole();}catch{_consoleAllocated=false;}
#else
_consoleAllocated=true;
#endif
}Log("LOGGER",$"Logger initialized, path={_logPath}");}catch{_enabled=false;}}private static bool IsGodotAvailable(){return GameEnvironment.IsRuntime;}private static bool IsModsCategory(string category){return category.StartsWith("MODS");}private static LogLevel ParseLogLevel(string value){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))return LogLevel.Debug;if(Enum.TryParse<LogLevel>(value,true,out var result))return result;return LogLevel.Debug;}
#if WINDOWS
private static ConsoleColor GetCategoryColor(string category,LogLevel level){return level switch{LogLevel.Error=>ConsoleColor.DarkRed,LogLevel.Warning=>ConsoleColor.DarkYellow,LogLevel.Debug=>ConsoleColor.DarkGray,LogLevel.Message when IsModsCategory(category)=>ConsoleColor.Yellow,_=>ConsoleColor.Gray};}private static void WriteColoredWindows(string timestamp,string category,string message,LogLevel level){var categoryColor=GetCategoryColor(category,level);Console.ForegroundColor=ConsoleColor.Gray;Console.Write($"[{timestamp}] ");Console.ForegroundColor=categoryColor;Console.Write($"[{category}]");Console.ForegroundColor=ConsoleColor.White;Console.WriteLine($" {message}");}

var timestamp=DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff");var line=$"[{timestamp}] [{category}] {message}";if(_consoleAllocated){try{
#if WINDOWS
WriteColoredWindows(timestamp,category,message,level);
#else
WriteColoredAnsi(timestamp,category,message,level);
#endif
}catch{}}else if(_initialized&&GameEnvironment.IsMainThread){try{GD.Print(line);}catch{}}lock(_lock){_recentLines[_recentWriteIndex]=$"[{category}] {message}";_recentWriteIndex=(_recentWriteIndex+1)%RecentLineCount;if(_recentCount<RecentLineCount)_recentCount++;}try{LogEmitted?.Invoke(category,message,level);}catch{}if(!_initialized|| !_enabled)return;lock(_lock){if(_logPath!=null)writeToFile(_logPath,line);if(_errorLogPath!=null&&level==LogLevel.Error)writeToFile(_errorLogPath,line);}}/// <summary> Returns a snapshot of the most recent formatted log lines (newest first, at most <paramref name="maxCount"/> entries). using System.IO;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Absolute paths of the loose game trees (<c>mods/</c>, <c>collections/</c>, <c>config/</c>) that live next to the project in the editor and next to the executable in an exported build. <para/> In an export <c>res://</c> is the pck, so <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath("res://mods/")</c> collapses to a bare <c>mods/</c> relative to the working directory: the game then finds its content only when started from its own folder, and the Godot source generators get no project dir to derive mod <c>[ScriptPath]</c>s from. The release packaging puts those trees beside the executable, so that directory is the root here. Godot API — call on the main thread. </summary>
public static class GamePaths{/// <summary> Absolute path for a <c>res://</c> path of a loose game tree, with a trailing separator kept as given; any other path (<c>user://</c>) goes through <c>ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath</c> unchanged. </summary>
public static string Globalize(string resPath){if(OS.HasFeature("editor")|| !resPath.StartsWith("res://"))return ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(resPath);var relative=resPath.Substring("res://".Length);var root=Path.GetDirectoryName(OS.GetExecutablePath());return string.IsNullOrEmpty(relative)?root.TrimEnd('/','\\')+"/":Path.Combine(root,relative).Replace('\\','/');}}}

===== FILE Core/Utils/ICacheLoader.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Core.Utils{/// <summary> Abstraction for on-demand value retrieval consumed by <see cref="BoundedCache{TKey, TValue}"/>. When a cache miss occurs, the bounded cache delegates to the implementation's <see cref="Load"/> method rather than using a closure or factory delegate. This interface-based design allows loaders to carry their own state (e.g. file handles, network connections, database context) without capturing it in lambda allocations inside the cache construction site. Implementations are invoked outside the cache's internal lock to minimise contention. </summary>
public interface ICacheLoader<TKey,TValue>{/// <summary> Produces the value for the given <paramref name="key"/>. May return <c>null</c> for reference-type values, which the cache treats as "not cacheable" and will not insert into the LRU list. </summary>
TValue Load(TKey key);}}
