public class CardBattleCore:IBattleCore,IBattleAutoPlayable{private const int PlayerCardLimit=4;private const float BaseCardWidth=230f;private const float BaseCardHeight=420f;private const float CellOffset=10f;private Character[]_playerChars;private Character[]_enemyChars;private IBattleContext _ctx;private CardBattleScreen _screen;private BattleCardPanel _playerPanel;private BattleCardPanel _enemyPanel;private CardController _cardController;private EndTurnButton _endTurnButton;private BattleSide _currentOrder;private bool _playerTurnActive;private int _round;/// <summary>Unique identifier for this battle core, used by the battle engine to select the card battle mod.</summary>
public string Id=>"card_battle";/// <summary> Provides <see cref="IActionExecutor"/> instances for the three card action types (physics/attack, physics/defence, physics/stun) used during action resolution. </summary>
public IActionExecutorProvider ActionProvider{get;}=new Actions.CardBattleActionProvider();/// <summary> Instantiates the battle screen from <c>scenes/card_battle_screen.tscn</c>, attaches it to the battle scene's <c>Panel</c> and binds the panels, end-turn button and input controller. Enemy characters are deep-copied so defeats are tracked independently per battle instance. The <see cref="CardBattleActionProvider"/> is registered with <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/>. </summary>
public void Init(Character[]playerChars,Character[]enemyChars,IBattleContext ctx){_playerChars=playerChars;_ctx=ctx;_enemyChars=new Character[enemyChars.Length];for(var i=0;i<enemyChars.Length;i++)_enemyChars[i]=enemyChars[i]?.Copy()??enemyChars[i];ActionExecutorHub.Instance.SetActiveProvider(ActionProvider);var root=ctx.RootNode as Node;var panel=root.GetNodeOrNull<Control>("Panel")??root;_screen=(CardBattleScreen)TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/card_battle_screen.tscn");_screen.Name="CardBattleScreen";_screen.EnsureConstructed();panel.AddChild(_screen);_playerPanel=_screen.PlayerPanel;_enemyPanel=_screen.EnemyPanel;_endTurnButton=_screen.EndTurnButton;_endTurnButton.SetVisible(false);_endTurnButton.OnPressed+=OnEndTurnPressed;_cardController=_screen.Controller;_cardController.Setup(_screen);}/// <summary> Calculates the pointer scale fitting both sides on screen, initializes every card and starts the first player turn. Subscribes to <c>OnCardDead</c> to record defeated enemies for the victory screen and to <c>OnActionExecuted</c> to detect automatic turn completion. </summary>
public void Start(){var enemyCount=_enemyChars?.Length??1;_enemyPanel.UseRows=enemyCount>6;var cardScale=CalculateCardScale(enemyCount);_cardController.CardScale=cardScale;_playerPanel.Init(_playerChars,true,cardScale);_enemyPanel.Init(_enemyChars,false,cardScale);_enemyPanel.OnCardDead+=OnEnemyCardDead;_cardController.OnActionExecuted+=CheckPlayerTurnEnd;BattleSceneContext.Instance.OnBattleCleared+=OnBattleCleared;_round=0;_currentOrder=BattleSide.Player;StartPlayerTurn();}private float CalculateCardScale(int enemyCount){var viewport=((Node)_ctx.RootNode).GetViewport().GetVisibleRect().Size;var enemyPanelWidth=viewport.X*0.96f;var playerPanelWidth=viewport.X*0.55f;var enemyPanelHeight=viewport.Y*0.446f;float maxCardScale;if(_enemyPanel.UseRows){var maxPerRow=_enemyPanel.GetMaxCardsPerRow();var rows=_enemyPanel.GetCurrentRowCount(enemyCount);var widthScale=(enemyPanelWidth-(maxPerRow-1)*CellOffset)/(maxPerRow*BaseCardWidth);var heightScale=(enemyPanelHeight-(rows-1)*CellOffset)/(rows*BaseCardHeight);maxCardScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,Mathf.Min(widthScale,heightScale));}else{var effectiveCount=Mathf.Max(enemyCount,1);maxCardScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,(enemyPanelWidth-(effectiveCount-1)*CellOffset)/(effectiveCount*BaseCardWidth));}var playerFitScale=Mathf.Max(0.1f,(playerPanelWidth-(PlayerCardLimit-1)*CellOffset)/(PlayerCardLimit*BaseCardWidth));return Mathf.Min(Mathf.Min(maxCardScale,playerFitScale),1f);}private void OnEnemyCardDead(CharacterCardNode card){if(card?.Card==null)return;var ctx=BattleSceneContext.Instance;if(ctx!=null){ctx.RecordEnemyDefeated(card.Card);ctx.NotifyCharacterDied(card.Card);}_screen.Hud.SetEnemiesAlive(CountAlive(_enemyPanel));BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_dead"),card.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Dead);}private void StartPlayerTurn(){_round+=1;_currentOrder=BattleSide.Player;_playerTurnActive=true;BattleSceneContext.Instance.IsWait=false;_cardController.ClearSelections();_cardController.ClearActions();_screen.ActionsPanel.ClearBody();_screen.ActionsPanel.ClearSubject();_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(true);foreach(var card in _playerPanel.CardList){StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).OnTurnStart();card.Card.Attributes.Point.Value=card.Card.Attributes.Point.BaseValue;card.UpdateInfo();}_screen.Hud.SetTurn(true);_screen.Hud.SetRound(_round);_screen.Hud.SetEnemiesAlive(CountAlive(_enemyPanel));_screen.LogPanel.SetRound(_round);_screen.Banner.Show(Translate("battle/turn_player"));BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_turn_player")+" · "+string.Format(Translate("battle/log_round"),_round),BattleLogKind.Turn);}private void OnEndTurnPressed()=>OnPlayerTurnEnd();private void CheckPlayerTurnEnd(){if(_currentOrder!=BattleSide.Player)return;if(!HasAliveCards(_enemyPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Player);return;}foreach(var card in _playerPanel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Point?.Value>0)return;}BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_out_of_points"),BattleLogKind.Info);OnPlayerTurnEnd();}/// <summary> Ends the player's turn: hides the end-turn button, pauses the battle, plays the enemy-turn banner and journal line, waits for two frames plus a short pause so the UI settles, then runs the enemy AI. public async void OnPlayerTurnEnd(){_playerTurnActive=false;_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(false);BattleSceneContext.Instance.IsWait=true;if(!HasAliveCards(_enemyPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Player);return;}_screen.Hud.SetTurn(false);_screen.Banner.Show(Translate("battle/turn_enemy"));BattleLogHub.Log(Translate("battle/log_turn_enemy"),BattleLogKind.Turn);var root=(Node)_ctx.RootNode;await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree(),"process_frame");await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree().CreateTimer(0.5f),"timeout");await RunEnemyTurn();}private async Task RunEnemyTurn(){_currentOrder=BattleSide.Enemy;_endTurnButton?.SetVisible(false);var root=(Node)_ctx.RootNode;foreach(var card in _enemyPanel.CardList.ToList()){if(card.IsDead||card.Card?.Actions==null||card.Card.Actions.Count==0)continue;StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).OnTurnStart();if(StatusEffectService.Of(card.Card).HasStun()){card.UpdateInfo();card.PlayZap();BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_stun_skip"),card.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Status);continue;}card.Card.Attributes.Point.Value=card.Card.Attributes.Point.BaseValue;var action=PickEnemyAction(card);if(action==null)continue;var target=PickEnemyTarget(card,action);if(target==null)continue;card.UpdateInfo();if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy){BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_enemy_action"),card.Card.Name,ActionCharacterUi.Translate(action.Name),target.Card.Name),BattleLogKind.Info);}var animatedAction=CreateAnimatedAction(card,target,action);if(animatedAction!=null){animatedAction.DoStart();while(!animatedAction.DoAction())await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree(),"process_frame");animatedAction.DoEnd();}await root.ToSignal(root.GetTree().CreateTimer(0.2f),"timeout");if(!HasAliveCards(_playerPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Enemy);return;}}if(!HasAliveCards(_playerPanel)){_ctx.EndBattle(BattleSide.Enemy);return;}StartPlayerTurn();}private CharacterCardNode PickEnemyTarget(CharacterCardNode source,ActionCharacter action){if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy){var alivePlayers=_playerPanel.CardList.Where(c=> !c.IsDead&&c.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0).ToList();if(alivePlayers.Count==0)return null;return alivePlayers[GD.RandRange(0,alivePlayers.Count-1)];}if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToAlias||action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToSelf)return source;GameLogger.Log("CARD_BATTLE",$"PickEnemyTarget: unsupported action type {action.Type}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}private Actions.AbstractBattleAction CreateAnimatedAction(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy)return new Actions.PhysicsAttackAction(source,target,action);if(action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToAlias||action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToSelf)return new Actions.PhysicsDefenceAction(source,target,action);GameLogger.Log("CARD_BATTLE",$"CreateAnimatedAction: unsupported action type {action.Type}",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}private static bool HasAliveCards(BattleCardPanel panel){foreach(var card in panel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0)return true;}return false;}private static int CountAlive(BattleCardPanel panel){var alive=0;foreach(var card in panel.CardList){if(!card.IsDead&&card.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0)alive++;}return alive;}private void OnBattleCleared(){_screen?.Clear();}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();/// <summary> <c>true</c> between <see cref="StartPlayerTurn"/> and the start of <see cref="OnPlayerTurnEnd"/> — matches the visibility window of the end-turn button, so automation presses exactly one turn per window. </summary>
public bool IsWaitingForPlayerInput=>_playerTurnActive;/// <summary>Automation hook: ends the player's turn without selecting cards.</summary>

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.TurnBattle;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy for <c>ToEnemy</c> actions. Validates that the target is an enemy, highlights both cards with a red attack outline, executes the action via <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> and reports the outcome: floating damage / defence-loss numbers on the target, a colour pulse on the card and a journal row through <see cref="BattleLogHub"/>. Stun actions (those with a "Turn" above 1) additionally flash the electric zap over the target instead of printing damage, matching the mockup's stun feedback. </summary>
public class AttackToEnemyStrategy:ICardActionStrategy{/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> if the action type is <c>ToEnemy</c> and the target is an enemy card.</summary>
public bool Check(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){return action.Type==ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy&&target!=null&& !target.IsPlayer;}/// <summary>Shows a red attack overlay on both the dragged action card and the target enemy card.</summary>
public void HighlightTarget(ActionCardNode actionCard,CharacterCardNode target){actionCard.Attack();target.Attack();}/// <summary> Resolves the attack and publishes its result: damage and absorbed shield as floating numbers plus journal rows, or the stun effect with its zap flash for control actions. </summary>
public void Execute(CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target,ActionCharacter action){if(source?.Card==null||target?.Card==null||action==null)return;var result=ActionExecutorHub.Instance.Execute(action,source.Card,target.Card);source.UpdateInfo();target.UpdateInfo();if(!result.Result)return;var actionName=Translate(action.Name);var sourceName=Translate(source.Card.Name);var targetName=Translate(target.Card.Name);var isStun=action.GetInt("Turn",0)>1;var defenceLost= -result.Target.Defence;if(defenceLost>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDefence(defenceLost,target,target.GlobalPosition);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_shield_absorb"),targetName,defenceLost),BattleLogKind.Shield);}if(isStun){target.PlayZap();BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_stun"),targetName,action.GetInt("Turn",0)),BattleLogKind.Status);return;}if(result.Target.Damage>0){ShowDamageBehaviour.SpawnDamage(result.Target.Damage,target,target.GlobalPosition);target.Flash(UiTokens.DangerText);BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_damage"),actionName,sourceName,targetName,result.Target.Damage),BattleLogKind.Damage);}else if(defenceLost==0){BattleLogHub.Log(string.Format(Translate("battle/log_absorbed"),actionName,sourceName,targetName),BattleLogKind.Shield);}}private static string Translate(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Factory that returns the appropriate <see cref="ICardActionStrategy"/> implementation for a given <see cref="ActionCharacter"/>. Dispatches based on <see cref="ActionCharacterType"/>: <c>ToEnemy</c> → <see cref="AttackToEnemyStrategy"/>, <c>ToAlias</c> → <see cref="SupportStrategy"/>, <c>ToSelf</c> → <see cref="SelfStrategy"/>. Used by <see cref="CardController"/> during drag-and-drop to determine valid targeting behavior and by <see cref="CanTarget"/> for pre-validation. </summary>
public static class CardActionStrategyFactory{/// <summary> Returns the matching strategy for the action's type, or <c>null</c> if any argument is null or the type is unrecognized. </summary>
public static ICardActionStrategy Get(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){if(action==null||source==null||target==null)return null;switch(action.Type){case ActionCharacterType.ToEnemy:return new AttackToEnemyStrategy();case ActionCharacterType.ToAlias:return new SupportStrategy();case ActionCharacterType.ToSelf:return new SelfStrategy();default:return null;}}/// <summary> Convenience method that gets the strategy via <see cref="Get"/> and immediately calls <see cref="ICardActionStrategy.Check"/> on it. Returns <c>false</c> if no strategy matches or any argument is null. </summary>
public static bool CanTarget(ActionCharacter action,CharacterCardNode source,CharacterCardNode target){if(action==null||source==null||target==null)return false;return Get(action,source,target)?.Check(action,source,target)??false;}}}

using Cthangover.CardBattle.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.TurnBattle;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.Player{/// <summary> Strategy for self-targeting actions (<c>ToSelf</c>). Shield gains print a floating blue number and a journal row; the card pulses to make the buff readable without reading the log. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Defines a status effect that is applied to a <see cref="Character"/> during battle and processed each turn by <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/>. Effects receive callbacks at turn start and turn end, and self-report expiration via <see cref="IsExpired"/> when their <see cref="Turns"/> counter reaches zero. The <see cref="IStatusActions"/> callback parameter allows effects to influence the character's turn (e.g. skip it). </summary>
public interface IStatusEffect{/// <summary>Integer identifier for the effect type (1 = stun). Used for serialization.</summary>
int Type{get;}/// <summary>Remaining turn count before expiry. Decremented by <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/>.</summary>
int Turns{get;set;}/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> when <see cref="Turns"/> ≤ 0, signalling removal from the queue.</summary>
bool IsExpired{get;}/// <summary>Called by <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.OnTurnStart"/> before the turn counter is decremented.</summary>
void OnTurnStart(Character character,IStatusActions actions);/// <summary>Called by <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.OnTurnEnd"/> after the character's actions have resolved.</summary>
void OnTurnEnd(Character character,IStatusActions actions);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Manages the collection of <see cref="IStatusEffect"/> instances attached to a single <see cref="Character"/>. Implements <see cref="IStatusActions"/> so that individual effects can call back into the queue (e.g. to skip the turn). During <see cref="OnTurnStart"/>, each effect's callback is invoked and its turn counter is decremented; expired effects are removed. <see cref="SkipTurn"/> is checked by <see cref="CardBattleCore.RunEnemyTurn"/> to skip stunned enemies. Supports deep copying for character duplication via <see cref="Copy"/>. </summary>
public class StatusEffectQueue:IStatusActions{private readonly Character _character;private readonly List<IStatusEffect>_effects=new();/// <summary> Set to <c>true</c> when an effect calls <see cref="IStatusActions.SkipTurn"/> during <see cref="OnTurnStart"/>. Reset to <c>false</c> at the start of each turn before effects are processed. </summary>
public bool SkipTurn{get;private set;}/// <summary> Creates a new queue bound to the given <paramref name="character"/>. </summary>
public StatusEffectQueue(Character character){_character=character;}/// <summary> Creates a deep copy of this queue bound to <paramref name="newCharacter"/>. <see cref="StatusEffectItem"/> effects are field-copied; other effect types are shared by reference. </summary>
public StatusEffectQueue Copy(Character newCharacter){var clone=new StatusEffectQueue(newCharacter);foreach(var effect in _effects){if(effect is StatusEffectItem item)clone._effects.Add(item.Copy()as IStatusEffect);else clone._effects.Add(effect);}return clone;}/// <summary> Adds a new status effect to the end of the processing list. Effects are processed in reverse order during turn callbacks (last-added first). </summary>
public void AddEffect(IStatusEffect effect){_effects.Add(effect);}/// <summary> Processes all effects at the start of the character's turn: resets <see cref="SkipTurn"/>, calls <see cref="IStatusEffect.OnTurnStart"/> for each effect in reverse order, decrements the turn counter, and removes expired effects. Called by <see cref="CardBattleCore.StartPlayerTurn"/> and <see cref="CardBattleCore.RunEnemyTurn"/>. </summary>
public void OnTurnStart(){SkipTurn=false;for(int i=_effects.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var effect=_effects[i];effect.OnTurnStart(_character,this);effect.Turns--;if(effect.IsExpired)_effects.RemoveAt(i);}}/// <summary> Processes all effects at the end of the character's turn: calls <see cref="IStatusEffect.OnTurnEnd"/> in reverse order and removes expired effects. </summary>
public void OnTurnEnd(){for(int i=_effects.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var effect=_effects[i];effect.OnTurnEnd(_character,this);if(effect.IsExpired)_effects.RemoveAt(i);}}void IStatusActions.SkipTurn(){SkipTurn=true;}void IStatusActions.RemoveStatus(IStatusEffect status){_effects.Remove(status);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.StatusEffect{/// <summary> Status effect that causes a character to skip their entire turn. On <see cref="OnTurnStart"/>, calls <see cref="IStatusActions.SkipTurn"/> which sets <see cref="StatusEffectQueue.SkipTurn"/> to <c>true</c>. <see cref="CardBattleCore.RunEnemyTurn"/> checks this flag and skips the character's action selection and resolution entirely. Created by <see cref="PhysicsStunActionCard"/> when a stun card is played, and added to the target's <see cref="StatusEffectQueue"/> via <c>Add("effect/physics/stun", turns)</c>. </summary>
public class StunStatusEffect:IStatusEffect{/// <summary>Type identifier for stun (1).</summary>
public int Type=>1;/// <summary>Number of turns this stun remains active.</summary>
public int Turns{get;set;}/// <summary>Expired when the turn counter reaches zero or below.</summary>
public bool IsExpired=>Turns<=0;/// <summary> Creates a stun effect lasting for <paramref name="turns"/> turns. </summary>
public StunStatusEffect(int turns){Turns=turns;}/// <summary> Parameterless constructor for deserialization. Sets <see cref="Turns"/> to 0 (expired immediately). </summary>
public StunStatusEffect(){}/// <summary> Calls <see cref="IStatusActions.SkipTurn"/> to mark the character's turn as skipped. </summary>
public void OnTurnStart(Character character,IStatusActions actions){actions.SkipTurn();}/// <summary> Stun has no end-of-turn effect. </summary>
public void OnTurnEnd(Character character,IStatusActions actions){}}}

public void Clear(){foreach(var child in _rows.GetChildren()){_rows.RemoveChild(child);child.QueueFree();}}/// <summary> Appends one colour-coded row and trims the oldest entries past the cap. The scroll is pushed to the bottom so the newest event stays visible. </summary>

public BattleLogPanel LogPanel{get;private set;}/// <summary>Centre-screen turn banner.</summary>

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.CardBattle.UI{/// <summary> Plays a death animation on a <see cref="CharacterCardNode"/> when its health reaches zero. The card simultaneously fades out, shrinks toward the screen center, spins 360 degrees, and applies a dissolve shader to all its <see cref="CharacterCardNode.AllImages"/> textures. The dissolve shader (<c>"scene_transition"</c>) is resolved once via <see cref="ModManager"/> and cached statically. Created and started by <see cref="BattleCardPanel.Dead"/>. </summary>
public partial class CardDeathAnimation:Node{private CharacterCardNode card;private Vector2 center;private Action onComplete;private static Shader dissolveShader;/// <summary> Begins the death animation sequence. Calculates a target position at the viewport center (relative to the card's parent), starts fading all child <see cref="Label"/> nodes, applies the dissolve shader material to all card images, and tweens position/rotation/alpha. On completion, invokes <paramref name="onComplete"/> and frees this node. </summary>
public void StartAnimation(CharacterCardNode card,Action onComplete){this.card=card;this.onComplete=onComplete;var viewportCenter=card.GetViewport().GetVisibleRect().Size/2;center=card.GetParent<Control>()is Control parent?viewportCenter-parent.GlobalPosition:viewportCenter-card.GlobalPosition+card.Position;RunAnimation();}private void RunAnimation(){float duration=0.8f;Vector2 endPos=center;StartFadeOutRecursive(card,duration);if(dissolveShader==null)dissolveShader=Shaders.Resolve("scene_transition");if(dissolveShader!=null){foreach(var img in card.AllImages){var mat=new ShaderMaterial{Shader=dissolveShader};mat.SetShaderParameter("noise_scale",5f);mat.SetShaderParameter("smoothness",0.25f);mat.SetShaderParameter("distortion",0.092f);mat.SetShaderParameter("glow_intensity",0f);mat.SetShaderParameter("hue_shift",0f);mat.SetShaderParameter("invert_direction",false);mat.SetShaderParameter("progress",0f);img.Material=mat;var matTween=CreateTween();matTween.TweenMethod(Callable.From<float>(t=>mat.SetShaderParameter("progress",t)),0f,1f,duration);}}var tween=CreateTween();tween.SetParallel(true);tween.TweenProperty(card,"position",endPos,duration);tween.TweenProperty(card,"rotation",Mathf.DegToRad(360f),duration);tween.TweenProperty(card,"modulate:a",0f,duration);tween.Finished+=()=>{onComplete?.Invoke();QueueFree();};}private static void StartFadeOutRecursive(Node node,float duration){foreach(Node child in node.GetChildren()){if(child is Label label){var t=child.CreateTween();t.TweenProperty(label,"modulate:a",0f,duration);}StartFadeOutRecursive(child,duration);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Characters{/// <summary> Implements the character panel's "reset assignments" operation: every party member's action slots go back to the first three actions of their factory template, and template actions beyond the third are pushed into the shared action pool. <para/> The critical invariant is that awarded cards survive the reset. Cards can enter the pool from sources that have no template entry at all — a skill granted through <see cref="Skills.SkillService"/> being the canonical example — and once such a card is assigned to a slot it is absent from the pool. Rebuilding the slots without first returning the old slot contents to the pool would silently destroy it. Therefore all non-empty slot IDs are collected before the slots are overwritten; template IDs are filtered back out afterwards, so the pool ends up holding exactly the awarded cards that are no longer assigned. <para/> The template lookup is injected as a delegate because the production caller resolves it through <c>CharacterFactory</c> (a mod-aware JSON factory), while tests can supply plain <see cref="Character"/> objects. </summary>
public static class ActionAssignmentReset{/// <summary> Rewrites every battle-set character's <see cref="CharacterInfoData.ActionSlots"/> from its template and replaces <see cref="ActionPoolData.ActionIds"/> with the surviving pool plus recovered awarded cards. </summary> <param name="characterData">Roster whose battle set and slots are reset.</param> <param name="actionPool">Shared action pool; may be <c>null</c>, in which case pool contents are recomputed but not stored.</param> <param name="resolveTemplate">Resolves a character ID to its factory template; may return <c>null</c> for unknown IDs.</param>
public static void Apply(CharacterData characterData,ActionPoolData actionPool,Func<string,Character>resolveTemplate){if(characterData?.BattleSet==null||characterData.Characters==null)return;var extraPoolIds=new HashSet<string>(actionPool?.ActionIds??new List<string>());var assignedAfterReset=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var characterId in characterData.BattleSet){if(!characterData.Characters.TryGetValue(characterId,out var info))continue;if(info.ActionSlots!=null)foreach(var slotId in info.ActionSlots)if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(slotId))extraPoolIds.Add(slotId);var defaultActionIds=resolveTemplate?.Invoke(characterId)?.Actions?.Select(action=>action.ID).ToList()??new List<string>();var slots=new List<string>();for(var i=0;i<3;i++){if(i<defaultActionIds.Count){slots.Add(defaultActionIds[i]);assignedAfterReset.Add(defaultActionIds[i]);}else{slots.Add(null);}}for(var i=3;i<defaultActionIds.Count;i++)extraPoolIds.Add(defaultActionIds[i]);info.ActionSlots=slots;}extraPoolIds.ExceptWith(assignedAfterReset);if(actionPool!=null)actionPool.ActionIds=extraPoolIds.ToList();}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Characters{/// <summary> Cooldown helpers for <see cref="ActionCharacterType.Active"/> cards. Active cards are one-shot abilities usable outside battle (from the character panel). The last-use timestamp is stored in <see cref="ActionCharacter.Properties"/> under 'LastUsed' - the cooldown duration (seconds) under 'ActiveCooldown' Absence of <c>LastUsed</c> means the card has never been activated. </summary>
public static class ActionCharacterActiveExtension{/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> when the card is <see cref="ActionCharacterType.Active"/> and its cooldown has expired (or it was never used). </summary>
public static bool IsReadyToUse(this ActionCharacter action,long currentTime){if(action.Type!=ActionCharacterType.Active)return false;var lastUsed=action.Properties.GetLong("LastUsed",0);var cooldown=action.GetInt("ActiveCooldown",0);if(lastUsed==0)return true;if(cooldown<=0)return false;return currentTime-lastUsed>=cooldown;}/// <summary> Seconds remaining until the cooldown expires. Returns <c>0</c> when ready, never used, or not an Active card. </summary>
public static long GetRemainingCooldown(this ActionCharacter action,long currentTime){if(action.Type!=ActionCharacterType.Active)return 0;var lastUsed=action.Properties.GetLong("LastUsed",0);var cooldown=action.GetInt("ActiveCooldown",0);if(lastUsed==0||cooldown<=0)return 0;var elapsed=currentTime-lastUsed;return elapsed>=cooldown?0:cooldown-elapsed;}/// <summary> Records the activation timestamp. Has no effect on non-Active cards. </summary>
public static void MarkUsed(this ActionCharacter action,long timestamp){if(action.Type!=ActionCharacterType.Active)return;action.Properties.SetLong("LastUsed",timestamp);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Core.Characters{/// <summary> JSON-serializable descriptor for an ActionCharacter. The Values list is a flat string array carrying the PropertyData pairs — serialized as a list rather than a dictionary to maintain JSON readability and avoid key escaping issues. Type uses a string enum converter so the JSON reads "ToSelf"/"ToAlias"/"ToEnemy" instead of integers. The Image field is a resource path string, resolved to Texture2D by the factory at load time. </summary>
[Serializable][EntityKind("action")]public class ActionCharacterInfo:IIdentifiable{/// <summary> Unique action identifier, serialized as "Id" in JSON. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("Id")]public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary> Display name for the battle action menu. </summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary> Description text for the battle action tooltip. </summary>
public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary> Targeting category, serialized as string (e.g. "ToSelf", "ToAlias", "ToEnemy") via <see cref="JsonStringEnumConverter"/> for human-readable JSON. </summary>
[JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]public ActionCharacterType Type{get;set;}/// <summary> Resource path string for the action icon. Resolved to <c>Texture2D</c> by <see cref="CharacterFactory"/> at load time. </summary>
public string Image{get;set;}/// <summary> Flat list of alternating key-value pairs that populate the <see cref="ActionCharacter.Properties"/> bag at load time. Index 0 = first key, index 1 = first value, index 2 = second key, etc. Stored as a list rather than a dictionary to simplify JSON authoring and avoid key-escaping issues. </summary>
public List<string>Values{get;set;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Core.Characters{/// <summary> JSON-serializable character descriptor loaded from data files. Only the four core battle stats (Health, Defence, Attack, Point) are hardcoded — they map directly to <see cref="Attribute"/> fields in <see cref="CharacterAttributes"/>. All other properties (any mod-defined extras) are captured by <see cref="ExtraProperties"/> and flowed into <see cref="CharacterAttributes.Properties"/> at factory time, so mods can add arbitrary stat keys without changing the DTO schema. </summary>
[Serializable][EntityKind("character")]public class CharacterInfo:IIdentifiable{/// <summary> Unique character ID, serialized as "Id" in JSON. Serves as the factory lookup key and save-data identifier. </summary>
[JsonPropertyName("Id")]public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary> AI behaviour class name for this character in battle. Resolved externally — null means no AI override. </summary>
public string Behaviour{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting level for this character when recruited. </summary>
public int Level{get;set;}/// <summary> Resource path string for the full-body portrait. Resolved to a <c>Texture2D</c> by <see cref="CharacterFactory"/> at load time. </summary>
public string Image{get;set;}/// <summary> Display name, localized via TranslationServer when shown to the player. </summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting health points (used as <see cref="Attribute"/>.BaseValue). </summary>
public int Health{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting defence value. </summary>
public int Defence{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting action points (resource pool for abilities). </summary>
public int Point{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting attack power. </summary>
public int Attack{get;set;}/// <summary> Starting experience points. </summary>
public int Exp{get;set;}/// <summary> Recruitment chance percentage (0–100) after defeating this character in battle. </summary>
public int RecruitmentChance{get;set;}/// <summary> Action ID strings, each referencing an <see cref="ActionCharacterInfo"/> entry in the action data file. Stored as a JSON array for clean mod-patching with <c>$add</c>/<c>$remove</c>/<c>$set</c> suffix operations. </summary>
public List<string>Actions{get;set;}/// <summary> Loot drop table for this character when defeated as an enemy. </summary>
public List<LootEntry>Loot{get;set;}/// <summary> Captures any JSON keys not matched by the hardcoded properties above — including former DTO fields like any mod-defined extras. These are imported into <see cref="CharacterAttributes.Properties"/> by <see cref="CharacterFactory.ImportExtraProperty"/>. </summary>
[JsonExtensionData]public Dictionary<string,object>ExtraProperties{get;set;}}}

using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Core.Characters{/// <summary> Extension for querying passive effects on a <see cref="Character"/>. Passive actions are <see cref="ActionCharacter"/> entries with <see cref="ActionCharacterType.Passive"/> whose <see cref="ActionCharacter.Properties"/> declare effect flags as boolean keys (e.g. "IgnoreArmor"). The key names are chosen by the mod author — the core imposes no registry or constants. </summary>
public static class CharacterPassiveExtension{/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> if the character has at least one Passive action whose <see cref="ActionCharacter.Properties"/> contains <paramref name="key"/> with a <c>true</c> boolean value. </summary>
public static bool HasPassiveEffect(this Character character,string key){return character?.Actions?.Any(a=>a.Type==ActionCharacterType.Passive&&a.GetBool(key))??false;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Characters{/// <summary> Engine-mod initializer for the characters subsystem. Publishes the factories living in this assembly to the kernel contracts (<see cref="CharacterTemplateRegistry"/>, <see cref="ActionTemplateRegistry"/>, <see cref="AvatarProviderRegistry"/>) as soon as the assembly is registered, so core-side consumers — <c>CharacterData</c>, inventory and skills UI, dialog avatar lookups — resolve templates without referencing a runtime-compiled mod assembly. <para/> Registration happens in <see cref="OnModLoaded"/> (the earliest and most frequent initializer callback) rather than on resources-ready: <c>CharacterData.AddCharacterToParty</c> is called from other mods' <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> (starter party), and initializer callbacks are delivered per mod registration, so being first here removes any ordering dependency between mods. The factories themselves only collect entity data lazily on the first <c>Get</c>, after the mod registry is finalized. Registration is guarded and idempotent because <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> re-runs <c>OnModLoaded</c> for every mod. </summary>
public class CharactersModInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool registered;/// <summary>Publishes this mod's factories to the kernel registries; safe to call again after a mod reload.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){if(registered)return;registered=true;CharacterTemplateRegistry.Provider=CharacterFactory.Instance;ActionTemplateRegistry.Provider=ActionCharacterFactory.Instance;AvatarProviderRegistry.Provider=AvatarFactory.Instance;GameLogger.Log("MODS","CharactersModInitializer: template providers registered (character, action, avatar)");}/// <summary> Registers the new-game roster reset owner with AppServices (idempotent — duplicates by Id are ignored). Template collection stays lazy on first lookup. Persistence needs no setup here: <see cref="CharactersSaveable"/> is an <c>IModSaveable</c> discovered by ModSaveableRegistry automatically. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){AppServices.Current.RegisterResettable(new CharactersResettable());}}/// <summary> New-game state owner of the characters mod: clears the party roster and battle set. Today the roster dies implicitly with <c>GameData.ResetRuntime</c> (it lives inside <c>RuntimeData</c>), which runs before the reset loop, so this reset is a no-op in the normal pipeline; it stays correct if the roster ever moves to mod-owned static storage (the recruiting path) or if the reset loop runs standalone, and makes the characters mod an explicit new-game state owner like quests and recruiting. Registered from <see cref="CharactersModInitializer.OnModResourcesReady"/>; <see cref="AppServices"/> deduplicates by <see cref="IResettable.Id"/>. </summary>
internal sealed class CharactersResettable:IResettable{/// <summary>Resettable key under which AppServices deduplicates registration.</summary>
public string Id=>"characters";/// <summary>Clears the party roster and battle set on "New Game".</summary>
public void ResetForNewGame(){var characterData=GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData;characterData.Characters.Clear();characterData.BattleSet.Clear();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Characters{/// <summary> Persists the character roster (party composition and per-character progression) through the generic <see cref="IModSaveable"/> contract under the mod id <c>characters_base</c>. The core save used to carry the <c>"Characters"</c> and <c>"BattleSet"</c> blobs inside the <c>__core__</c> slot (<c>RuntimeSerializer.BuildCoreSlot</c>); the roster belongs to the characters engine mod, so it moves to the mod slot like every other migrated subsystem (quests, items, recruiting). <para/> The state itself is not duplicated: <see cref="OnSave"/> marshals <c>GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData</c> — the same runtime objects the core, battle and UI read — into the mod slot, and <see cref="OnLoad"/> writes the restored dictionaries back into that runtime, so no other code changes its data path. While the transition is staged (the core slot still carries the old blobs), load order is safe: the core restores <c>__core__</c> first and this saveable re-restores the identical data afterwards from the mod slot. When the core blobs are removed, old saves degrade gracefully — <c>RuntimeSerializer.RestoreCoreState</c> skips missing blob keys, and an absent mod blob keeps the fresh runtime roster. </summary>
public class CharactersSaveable:IModSaveable{private const string CharactersBlobKey="Characters";private const string BattleSetBlobKey="BattleSet";/// <summary>Writes the roster and battle set into the mod slot.</summary>
public void OnSave(ModSlot slot){var characterData=GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData;slot.Data[CharactersBlobKey]=new DataBlob(1,characterData.Characters.Values.ToList());slot.Data[BattleSetBlobKey]=new DataBlob(1,characterData.BattleSet.ToList());}/// <summary> Restores roster and battle set from the mod slot; an absent blob keeps the corresponding part of the current runtime state. </summary>
public bool OnLoad(ModSlot slot,out string errorMessage){errorMessage=null;if(slot?.Data==null)return true;var characterData=GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData;if(slot.Data.TryGetValue(CharactersBlobKey,out var charactersBlob)){var characters=charactersBlob.ReadJson<List<CharacterInfoData>>();characterData.Characters=new Dictionary<string,CharacterInfoData>();if(characters!=null)foreach(var info in characters)characterData.Characters[info.CharacterType]=info;}if(slot.Data.TryGetValue(BattleSetBlobKey,out var battleSetBlob))characterData.BattleSet=battleSetBlob.ReadJson<List<string>>()?.ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();return true;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Factory for battle action cards equipped by characters. Returns a <b>copy</b> of the cached <c>ActionCharacter</c> on every <c>Get</c> call — action cards carry mutable battle state (cooldowns, modifiers) and must never be shared across character instances. Properties are parsed from a compact <c>key=value</c> string list rather than a full JSON object, keeping mod JSON terse for authored content. Images are loaded via <c>TextureUtils.LoadFromModGroup</c> — not through a texture factory — because action character assets live inside the same <c>"characters"</c> asset group as their PNGs, making co-location of data and art the default mod layout. The JSON definitions themselves are found by kind, not by that directory. <para/> The factory lives in the characters engine mod; its singleton is also published to the kernel through <see cref="ActionTemplateRegistry"/> by <c>CharactersModInitializer</c>, so core-side consumers resolve templates without referencing this assembly. </summary>
public class ActionCharacterFactory:ICacheLoader<string,ActionCharacter>,IActionTemplateProvider{/// <summary>Process-wide singleton for this mod assembly; the public API for action template lookups.</summary>
public static ActionCharacterFactory Instance{get;}=new ActionCharacterFactory();private Dictionary<string,ActionCharacterInfo>_allInfos;private readonly BoundedCache<string,ActionCharacter>_cache;internal ActionCharacterFactory(){var size=ModConfig.Instance.Cache.GetCacheSize("actions",128);_cache=new BoundedCache<string,ActionCharacter>(size,this);}ActionCharacter ICacheLoader<string,ActionCharacter>.Load(string id){var infos=EnsureInfos();if(infos.TryGetValue(id,out var info))return CreateActionCharacter(info);return null;}/// <summary> Returns the action definitions, collecting them on first use. Publication to <c>_allInfos</c> waits until the mod registry is finalized so an early lookup from the launcher boot window cannot freeze an empty snapshot for the session. </summary>
private Dictionary<string,ActionCharacterInfo>EnsureInfos(){// The resolver's dictionary identity is the data snapshot (see CharacterFactory.EnsureInfos).
var infos=Entities.Collect<ActionCharacterInfo>();if(!ReferenceEquals(infos,_allInfos)){_allInfos=infos;_cache.Clear();}return infos;}/// <summary> Returns an independent copy of the action definition for <paramref name="id"/>, or <c>null</c> when unknown. The copy is deliberate: action cards carry mutable battle state, so callers never share one instance. </summary>
public ActionCharacter Get(string id){EnsureInfos();var item=_cache.Get(id);return item?.Copy();}/// <summary> Returns all known action info IDs. Used by the character panel to determine which actions are not assigned to any character (the action pool). </summary>
public IReadOnlyCollection<string>GetAllActionIds(){return EnsureInfos()?.Keys;}private ActionCharacter CreateActionCharacter(ActionCharacterInfo info){if(info==null)return null;var item=new ActionCharacter{ID=info.ID,Name=info.Name,Description=info.Description,Type=info.Type,Properties=ParseValues(info.Values),Image=LoadImage(info.Image),};return item;}private Texture2D LoadImage(string imagePath){return TextureUtils.LoadFromModGroup("characters",imagePath);}private static PropertyData ParseValues(List<string>values){var props=new PropertyData();if(values==null)return props;foreach(var value in values){var idx=value.IndexOf('=');if(idx>0)props.Values[value.Substring(0,idx)]=value.Substring(idx+1);}return props;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Factory for full character definitions. Returns a <b>copy</b> of the cached <c>Character</c> on every <c>Get</c> call because <c>Character.Attributes</c> mutate during gameplay. Character actions are resolved through <c>ActionCharacterFactory</c>. Attribute fields that are missing or zero in JSON receive nonzero fallback values so incomplete mod data doesn't produce unplayable characters. Patching is handled transparently by the shared <c>EntityResolver</c> — the factory receives already-merged <c>CharacterInfo</c> DTOs routed by their <c>character</c> kind and simply maps them to the runtime model. <para/> The factory lives in the characters engine mod; its singleton is also published to the kernel through <see cref="CharacterTemplateRegistry"/> by <c>CharactersModInitializer</c>, so core-side consumers resolve templates without referencing this assembly. </summary>
public class CharacterFactory:ICacheLoader<string,Character>,ICharacterTemplateProvider{/// <summary>Process-wide singleton for this mod assembly; the public API for template lookups.</summary>
public static CharacterFactory Instance{get;}=new CharacterFactory();private Dictionary<string,CharacterInfo>_allInfos;private readonly BoundedCache<string,Character>_cache;internal CharacterFactory(){var size=ModConfig.Instance.Cache.GetCacheSize("characters",128);_cache=new BoundedCache<string,Character>(size,this);}Character ICacheLoader<string,Character>.Load(string id){var infos=EnsureInfos();GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"CharacterFactory.Load('{id}'): infos count={infos?.Count ?? -1}",LogLevel.Debug);if(infos.TryGetValue(id,out var info))return CreateCharacter(info);return null;}/// <summary> Returns the character definitions, collecting them on first use. The result is published to <c>_allInfos</c> only after the mod registry is finalized. A stale empty snapshot cannot appear: the registry refuses mod-data access until <c>Boot.IsReady</c>, so the first collection always sees the final mod set, and the cached snapshot is reset when <c>ModManager.Reload</c> rebuilds the registry. </summary>
private Dictionary<string,CharacterInfo>EnsureInfos(){// Entities.Collect is cached by the entity resolver until the next mod reload, so its dictionary identity is the data snapshot: a new one (reload, data edit, game switch with this mod kept) drops the built templates instead of serving the previous mod set's data.
var infos=Entities.Collect<CharacterInfo>();if(ReferenceEquals(infos,_allInfos))return infos;_allInfos=infos;_cache.Clear();GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"CharacterFactory.EnsureInfos: {infos?.Count ?? 0} infos (new data snapshot)",LogLevel.Debug);return infos;}/// <summary> Returns an independent copy of the character template for <paramref name="id"/>, or <c>null</c> (with an error log) when the id is unknown. The copy semantics matter: battle and party systems mutate attributes freely without touching the cached template. </summary>
public Character Get(string id){var infos=EnsureInfos();if(!infos.ContainsKey(id)){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"CharacterFactory.Get('{id}'): NOT FOUND in infos",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var item=_cache.Get(id);if(item?.Image==null)GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"CharacterFactory.Get('{id}'): found, image=null",LogLevel.Error);return item?.Copy();}private static Character CreateCharacter(CharacterInfo info){if(info==null)return null;var item=new Character{ID=info.ID,Behaviour=info.Behaviour,Name=info.Name,Level=info.Level,Exp=info.Exp,RecruitmentChance=info.RecruitmentChance,Actions=ResolveActions(info.Actions??new List<string>()),Image=LoadImage(info.Image),Loot=info.Loot,};item.Attributes.Health.Init(info.Health>0?info.Health:1);item.Attributes.Defence.Init(info.Defence);item.Attributes.Attack.Init(info.Attack);item.Attributes.Point.Init(info.Point>0?info.Point:1);PropertyData.ImportJsonProperties(item.Attributes.Properties,info.ExtraProperties);return item;}private static List<ActionCharacter>ResolveActions(List<string>actions){if(actions==null||actions.Count==0)return new List<ActionCharacter>();return actions.Select(id=>ActionCharacterFactory.Instance.Get(id)).Where(card=>card!=null).ToList();}private static Texture2D LoadImage(string imagePath){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(imagePath)){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"LoadImage: imagePath is null/empty",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var tex=TextureUtils.LoadFromModGroup("characters",imagePath);if(tex==null)GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"LoadImage: result=null",LogLevel.Error);return tex;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.CharacterPanel{/// <summary> Visual representation of a single <see cref="ActionCharacter"/> inside a character slot or in the action pool. The card never handles input itself: <see cref="CharacterPanelBehaviour"/> owns drag orchestration through its node-level <c>_Input</c> (GuiInput stops firing once the cursor leaves the card mid-drag). The card only exposes state setters (<see cref="SetSelected"/>, <see cref="SetCompact"/>) and is moved between containers by the panel/slot. </summary>

public ActionSlotBehaviour CurrentSlot{get;set;}private static readonly StyleBoxFlat NormalFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.Surface1,UiTokens.LineCard);private static readonly StyleBoxFlat HoverFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.SurfaceHover,UiTokens.LineStrong);private static readonly StyleBoxFlat SelectedFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.SurfaceSelected,UiTokens.Accent);private Panel _frame;private ColorRect _accent;private TextureRect _icon;private Label _nameLabel;private Label _idLabel;private HBoxContainer _badgesRow;private HFlowContainer _propsRow;private bool _compact;private bool _selected;private bool _hovered;/// <summary>Binds hover feedback; node references resolve lazily so the card can be bound before entering the tree.</summary>
public ActionCardBehaviour(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;MouseEntered+=OnMouseEntered;MouseExited+=OnMouseExited;}/// <summary>Re-anchors to the parent's full rect for slot placement, mirroring the scene-root layout.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){}/// <summary> Binds the action data and refreshes every rendered element: icon, translated name, ID watermark, type/cost/cooldown badges, property chips and the rich tooltip. </summary>
public void SetAction(ActionCharacter action){ActionData=action;ResolveNodes();if(action==null||_frame==null)return;_icon.Texture=action.Image;_nameLabel.Text=ActionCharacterUi.Translate(action.Name);_idLabel.Text=action.ID;TooltipText=ActionCharacterUi.BuildTooltip(action);BuildBadges(action);BuildProperties(action);}/// <summary> Compact mode drops the property chip row and shrinks the card to the single-line pool layout; slot cards use the expanded layout. </summary>

public void ReturnToOrigin(){if(CurrentSlot==null)return;if(GetParent()!=CurrentSlot){GetParent()?.RemoveChild(this);CurrentSlot.AddChild(this);}SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(LayoutPreset.FullRect);}/// <summary>Marks the card as detached from every container while it follows the cursor.</summary>
public void SetDragging(bool dragging){Modulate=dragging?UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.55f):UiTokens.White;}private void ResolveNodes(){_frame??=GetNodeOrNull<Panel>("Frame");_accent??=GetNodeOrNull<ColorRect>("Accent");_icon??=GetNodeOrNull<TextureRect>("Icon");_nameLabel??=GetNodeOrNull<Label>("Body/NameRow/NameLabel");_idLabel??=GetNodeOrNull<Label>("Body/NameRow/IdLabel");_badgesRow??=GetNodeOrNull<HBoxContainer>("Body/BadgesRow");_propsRow??=GetNodeOrNull<HFlowContainer>("Body/PropsRow");if(_frame!=null&& !_frame.HasThemeStyleboxOverride("panel"))_frame.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel",NormalFrame);}private void BuildBadges(ActionCharacter action){ClearChildren(_badgesRow);var accent=ActionCharacterUi.AccentColor(action.Type);_accent.Color=accent;_badgesRow.AddChild(ActionCharacterUi.MakeBadge(ActionCharacterUi.Translate(ActionCharacterUi.TypeLabelKey(action.Type)).ToUpperInvariant(),accent));var costText=ActionCharacterUi.CostText(action);if(costText!=null)_badgesRow.AddChild(ActionCharacterUi.MakeBadge(costText,UiTokens.AccentBright));var cooldownText=ActionCharacterUi.CooldownText(action);if(cooldownText!=null)_badgesRow.AddChild(ActionCharacterUi.MakeBadge(cooldownText,UiTokens.Cooldown));}private void BuildProperties(ActionCharacter action){ClearChildren(_propsRow);foreach(var pair in ActionCharacterUi.SortedProperties(action))_propsRow.AddChild(ActionCharacterUi.MakePropertyChip(pair.Key,pair.Value));_propsRow.Visible= !_compact&&_propsRow.GetChildCount()>0;}private static void ClearChildren(Node parent){if(parent==null)return;foreach(var child in parent.GetChildren())child.QueueFree();}private void OnMouseEntered(){_hovered=true;ApplyFrame();}private void OnMouseExited(){_hovered=false;ApplyFrame();}private void ApplyFrame(){ResolveNodes();if(_frame==null)return;_frame.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel",_selected?SelectedFrame:(_hovered?HoverFrame:NormalFrame));}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.CharacterPanel{/// <summary> A single action socket on a character card. The slot owns only its own visuals; drag input, hit-testing and swap rules live in <see cref="CharacterPanelBehaviour"/>, which asks the slot to highlight while a card hovers over it. public bool IsEmpty=>CurrentCard==null;private static readonly StyleBoxFlat EmptyFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.Surface0,UiTokens.LineFaint);private static readonly StyleBoxFlat FilledFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.Surface1,UiTokens.LineCard);private static readonly StyleBoxFlat HoverFrame=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.DropBg,UiTokens.TypePassive,2);private Panel _frame;private Label _slotLabel;private Label _emptyLabel;private bool _highlighted;/// <summary> Binds the save-data identity of the slot and renders the "СЛОТ N" caption. using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Cooking{/// <summary> Exposes a user-configurable setting for the number of rations consumed per character per in-game day. Registered automatically via <see cref="ModSettingsRegistry"/> when the cooking mod assembly loads. The static <see cref="RationsPerCharacter"/> property is the canonical source of truth shared with <c>RationStatisticsPanel</c> and any future consumption logic. public class CookingSettings:IModSettings{/// <summary> Current value for rations consumed per character per day. Default is 1. Updated by <see cref="ReadValues"/> on boot and whenever the player changes the setting in the menu. </summary>

using Cthangover.Cooking;using System;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Mods.Cooking.Rations{/// <summary> Displays live ration statistics on the dinner/ration UI screen. Shows the player the current ration count, how many rations are consumed daily (one per character), and the maximum number of days the party can survive on available rations. Listens to <see cref="Core.Items.InventoryBag.Change"/> events to refresh automatically whenever the inventory is modified. </summary>
public class RationStatisticsPanel:Widget{private RichTextLabel label;private Action<string,int>_onInventoryChange;protected override void OnceConstruct(){label=GetNode<RichTextLabel>("RationMargin/RationLabel");_onInventoryChange=(_,_)=>UpdateInfo();GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory.Change+=_onInventoryChange;}protected override void ShowConstruct(){UpdateInfo();}protected override void OnceDestruct(){GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory.Change-=_onInventoryChange;}/// <summary> Recomputes and refreshes the ration-statistics text. Reads current ration inventory via <see cref="Core.Items.InventoryBag.CheckCount"/> for <c>"food/ration"</c> and the total character count from <see cref="CharacterData"/>. Formats three localized lines: total rations, daily consumption, and remaining days (rations divided by character count, clamped to 1 minimum). </summary>
public void UpdateInfo(){if(label==null)return;var rationCount=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory.CheckCount("food/ration");var characterCount=GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData.Characters.Count;var perChar=CookingSettings.RationsPerCharacter;var dailyConsumption=characterCount*perChar;label.Text=string.Format(TranslationServer.Translate("ui/diner/rationcount"),rationCount)+"\n"+string.Format(TranslationServer.Translate("ui/diner/rationday"),dailyConsumption)+"\n"+string.Format(TranslationServer.Translate("ui/diner/rationmax"),rationCount/Mathf.Max(1,dailyConsumption));}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Mods.Cooking.Workbench{/// <summary> Renders a single ingredient row inside a <see cref="RecipeItemBehaviour"/> on the cooking workbench. Displays the ingredient's item icon and the required count. When <see cref="CheckAndUpdate"/> is called, compares inventory count against the recipe requirement and tints the icon and count text grey if the player lacks enough items. </summary>
public class RecipeIconItemBehaviour:Widget{private static readonly Color NormalColor=UiTokens.InkBright;private static readonly Color NotItemsColor=UiTokens.Muted;private TextureRect img;private Label txt;private IIngredient ingredient;protected override void OnceConstruct(){img=GetNode<TextureRect>("Img");txt=GetNode<Label>("Txt");}/// <summary> Binds this icon widget to a recipe ingredient definition. Sets the icon texture from <c>ingredient.Item.Sprite</c> (logs an error if the item reference is null) and displays the required count as text. The <paramref name="hasItems"/> flag is currently unused but reserved for future visual pre-initialization. </summary>
public void Init(IIngredient ingredient,bool hasItems){EnsureConstructed();this.ingredient=ingredient;if(ingredient.Item!=null){img.Texture=ingredient.Item.Sprite;}else{GameLogger.Log("MOD_TEST",$"RecipeIconItemBehaviour::Init ingredient.Item is NULL",LogLevel.Error);}txt.Text=ingredient.Count.ToString();}/// <summary> Evaluates whether the player's inventory contains enough of the required ingredient. Tints the icon and count text to <c>NormalColor</c> (bright ink) when satisfied or <c>NotItemsColor</c> (muted) when insufficient. Called by the parent <see cref="RecipeItemBehaviour"/> during state refresh. </summary> <returns><c>true</c> if inventory meets or exceeds the required count.</returns>
public bool CheckAndUpdate(){var result=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory.CheckCount(ingredient.Item)>=ingredient.Count;txt.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",result?NormalColor:NotItemsColor);img.Modulate=result?UiTokens.White:NotItemsColor;return result;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Mods.Cooking.Workbench{/// <summary> Represents a single recipe entry in the <see cref="WorkbenchPanel"/> list. Displays the recipe name, preparation time, and a horizontal row of ingredient icons. Supports click-to-select with visual highlight (tracked statically so only one recipe is selected at a time). Fires <see cref="RecipeClicked"/> to notify the parent panel of selection changes. Ingredient availability is checked via child <see cref="RecipeIconItemBehaviour"/> instances, greying out the entire row when any ingredient is missing. </summary>
public class RecipeItemBehaviour:Widget{private Control background;private Control recipeContent;private Label txtName;private Label txtTime;private HBoxContainer recipeContentHbox;private static readonly Color normalColor=UiTokens.White;private static readonly Color selectedColor=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.8f);private static readonly Color disableColor=UiTokens.Muted;private IRecipe recipe;private Node panel;private static RecipeItemBehaviour selected;/// <summary> The recipe currently selected across all <see cref="RecipeItemBehaviour"/> instances. Only one recipe can be selected at a time because the selection is tracked via a static backing field. Returns <c>null</c> when no recipe is selected. </summary>
public static IRecipe SelectedRecipe=>selected?.recipe;private readonly List<Node>items=new();private readonly List<RecipeIconItemBehaviour>ingredients=new();/// <summary> Fired when this recipe entry is clicked, passing the recipe data and this widget so that <see cref="WorkbenchPanel"/> can update the description and output preview panel. </summary>
public event System.Action<IRecipe,RecipeItemBehaviour>RecipeClicked;protected override void OnceConstruct(){background=GetNode<Control>("Background");recipeContentHbox=GetNode<HBoxContainer>("HBox/RecipeContent/RecipeContentHbox");recipeContent=recipeContentHbox.GetParent()as Control;txtName=GetNode<Label>("HBox/TxtName");txtTime=GetNode<Label>("HBox/TxtTime");GuiInput+=OnGuiInput;}protected override void OnceDestruct(){GuiInput-=OnGuiInput;}private void OnGuiInput(InputEvent@event){if(@event is InputEventMouseButton mouseButton&&mouseButton.Pressed&&mouseButton.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left){OnClick();}}/// <summary> Refreshes the visual availability state of this recipe. Iterates all child <see cref="RecipeIconItemBehaviour"/> widgets, calling <c>CheckAndUpdate</c> on each. If any ingredient is missing, tints the name and time labels with <c>disableColor</c> (muted); otherwise restores the accent (gold) and danger (red) colour scheme. Call after inventory changes or cooking operations. </summary>
public void UpdateState(){var hasItems=true;foreach(var ingredient in ingredients)if(!ingredient.CheckAndUpdate())hasItems=false;if(!hasItems){txtName.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",disableColor);txtTime.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",disableColor);}else{txtName.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.AccentBright);txtTime.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.DangerText);}}/// <summary> Initialises the recipe row with recipe data and the parent panel reference. Spawns <see cref="RecipeIconItemBehaviour"/> children for each ingredient, with plus-sign separators between them. Sets the translated recipe name and time, then calls <see cref="UpdateState"/> to set initial colour state. </summary>
public void Init(IRecipe recipe,Node panel){EnsureConstructed();this.recipe=recipe;this.panel=panel;for(int i=0;i<recipe.Input.Count;i++){var ingredient=recipe.Input[i];AddIngredient(ingredient,i!=recipe.Input.Count-1);}txtName.Text=TranslationServer.Translate(recipe.Name);txtTime.Text=string.Format(TranslationServer.Translate("ui/cook/recipe_time"),recipe.Time);UpdateState();}private void AddIngredient(IIngredient ingredient,bool addPlus){var inventory=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory;var item=(RecipeIconItemBehaviour)TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/recipe_icon_item.tscn");recipeContentHbox.AddChild(item);var localHasItems=inventory.CheckCount(ingredient.Item)<ingredient.Count;item.Init(ingredient,localHasItems);items.Add(item);ingredients.Add(item);if(addPlus){var plus=new Label();plus.Text="+";plus.AddThemeFontSizeOverride("font_size",UiTokens.FontBodySmall);plus.VerticalAlignment=VerticalAlignment.Center;recipeContentHbox.AddChild(plus);items.Add(plus);}}/// <summary> Tears down this recipe row by queue-freeing all child nodes (ingredient icons, plus labels, and this widget itself), then clears the internal ingredient/item lists. Called by <see cref="WorkbenchPanel"/> when the panel is hidden. </summary>
public void Destroy(){foreach(var item in items)item.QueueFree();QueueFree();ingredients.Clear();items.Clear();}/// <summary> Handles left-click selection of this recipe entry. Deselects the previously-selected entry (if any) by restoring its background to normal colour, highlights the background of this entry, updates the static <c>selected</c> tracker, and invokes <see cref="RecipeClicked"/> so the parent can update the description and output panel. </summary>
public void OnClick(){if(selected!=null)selected.background.Modulate=normalColor;background.Modulate=selectedColor;selected=this;RecipeClicked?.Invoke(recipe,this);}}}

Разблокировка рецепта выполняется публичным игровым путём: использование предмета-рецепта (<c>IItem.ItemAction.UseAction</c>) — как это делает инвентарь. Машина состояний: один шаг за тик таймера (0.4с), чтобы успевали применяться отложенные смены сцен и пересборки панелей. Каждый шаг — отдельная проверка: провал фиксируется, но не обрывает маршрут (кроме неожиданных исключений). Ожидание смены сцены — по <c>SceneManager.CurrentSceneName</c>, ожидание меню — по <c>IDialogBox.IsWaitingAnswer && IsAnswerBoxShowed</c>. Итог — контракт раннера <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=cooking_walk_test passed=N failed=M</code> и код выхода процесса; watchdog (<c>--timeout=</c>, дефолт 90с) гасит зависание с failed=1. </summary>

private void Tick(){if(step<0)return;// тест уже завершён

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.CookingWalkTest{/// <summary> Точка входа интеграционного теста «прогулка + готовка» (прецедент inventory_test: мод сам везёт драйвер и сам печатает [TEST_RESULT]). Активация — только по явному пользовательскому флагу <c>--itest=cooking_walk</c> (user-args после --), чтобы мод никогда не вмешивался в обычную игру. Стартовая сцена задаётся ядром (<c>--scene=home_outside</c>); драйверу остаётся дождаться готового шелла и провести игрока по маршруту кликами по настоящим кнопкам. </summary>
public class CookingWalkTestInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool driverQueued;/// <summary>Per-mod инициализация не требуется — драйвер ставится на resources-ready.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Разбирает user-args; при активационном флаге добавляет драйвер теста в корень дерева. Повторный <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> не должен плодить драйверы — защищено статическим флагом. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(driverQueued)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();if(!args.Any(a=>a=="--itest=cooking_walk"))return;var timeout=ParseTimeout(args);driverQueued=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"CookingWalkTestInitializer: activating cooking walk test, timeout={timeout?.ToString() ?? "none"}s");// Deferred: сцена ещё не готова; драйвер сам ждёт Boot.IsReady и появления CurrentScene, поэтому порядок с загрузкой сцены не важен.
(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root?.CallDeferred("add_child",new CookingWalkTestDriverNode(timeout));}private static float?ParseTimeout(string[]args){var raw=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--timeout=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--timeout=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();return float.TryParse(raw,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var t)&&t>0?t:null;}}}

Compiled by ModTestEngine into a separate {modId}__tests assembly, only in the explicit test mode. No scene-tree interaction: anything requiring a live scene belongs to the integration contour. </summary>
public class CookingModTests{[ModTest("recipe/wolf_meat_data_shape")]static void WolfMeatRecipeDataShape(ModTestContext ctx){// The recipe JSON declared by the mod must keep the exact shape RecipeFactory consumes: single recipe, cooking type, inputs/outputs.

Exercises the same flow the item action performs, through the public RecipeData API.
var data=new RecipeData();ModAssert.False(data.Has("recipe/wolf_meat_to_ration"),"fresh state does not know the recipe");ModAssert.True(data.Add("recipe/wolf_meat_to_ration"),"first Add unlocks");ModAssert.False(data.Add("recipe/wolf_meat_to_ration"),"second Add is a no-op");ModAssert.True(data.Has("recipe/wolf_meat_to_ration"),"recipe stays unlocked");// Round-trip through JSON: Data is a public property, the save system serializes RecipeData as a whole.
var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(data);var restored=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<RecipeData>(json);ModAssert.True(restored.Has("recipe/wolf_meat_to_ration"),"unlock survives JSON round-trip");}[ModTest("settings/rations_per_character_clamp")]static void SettingsClamp(ModTestContext ctx){// CookingSettings.ReadValues clamps below-minimum input to 1 — verify through a real DataBlob key-value round-trip.
var blob=new DataBlob();blob.SetInt("rations_per_character",-5);new global::Cthangover.Cooking.CookingSettings().ReadValues(blob);ModAssert.Equal(1,global::Cthangover.Cooking.CookingSettingsForTests.RationsPerCharacter,"negative value clamps to 1");var blob2=new DataBlob();blob2.SetInt("rations_per_character",4);new global::Cthangover.Cooking.CookingSettings().ReadValues(blob2);ModAssert.Equal(4,global::Cthangover.Cooking.CookingSettingsForTests.RationsPerCharacter,"valid value passes through");// Write/read round-trip through the blob's own serialization.
new global::Cthangover.Cooking.CookingSettings().WriteValues(blob2);ModAssert.Equal(4,blob2.GetInt("rations_per_character",0),"WriteValues stores the value");}[ModTest("manifest/declares_required_dependencies")]static void ManifestDependencies(ModTestContext ctx){// The cooking UI binds to interface widget types and item/time subsystems: the manifest must keep these declared, otherwise compilation against the dependencies breaks silently.

Before every switch the clock is set to noon (a new game starts at night and the night lighting leaves only lamps visible) and the running dialog is aborted the way the scene editor's "Go to scene" does — otherwise the entered scene's scenario waits behind it. Before the panels the inventory is seeded and Murakami joins the party, so they are not empty. Waits are tick counts, not conditions on the picture; the checks only make sure each scene, panel and the battle were really reached. public SiteShotsDriver(string shotsDir){this.shotsDir=shotsDir;Name="SiteShotsDriver";var timer=new Timer{WaitTime=TickSeconds,Autostart=true};AddChild(timer);timer.Timeout+=Tick;}/// <summary>Listens for the battle scene.</summary>
public override void _EnterTree()=>ModEventBus.Subscribe<BattleStartedEvent>(OnBattleStarted);/// <summary>Stops listening.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree()=>ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<BattleStartedEvent>(OnBattleStarted);private SceneManager Scenes=>GetTree().Root.GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("SceneManager");private static DialogBox Box=>SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");private void OnBattleStarted(BattleStartedEvent e)=>battleStarted=true;private void Tick(){if(step<0)return;elapsed+=TickSeconds;if(elapsed>TimeoutSeconds){Fail($"timeout at step {step} (scene='{SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()}')");Finish();return;}if(waitTicks>0){waitTicks--;return;}try{RunStep();}catch(System.Exception ex){Fail($"step {step}: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");Finish();}}private void RunStep(){switch(step){case 0:if(!Boot.IsReady||SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()!=Prologue)return;Check(true,$"entered '{Prologue}'");index=0;Next(PanelTicks);return;case 1:GoTo(Locations[index]);Next(0);return;case 2:if(SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()!=Locations[index])return;Check(true,$"entered '{Locations[index]}'");Next(SettleTicks);return;case 3:Shot("location_"+Locations[index]);index++;if(index<Locations.Length){step=1;return;}Seed();index=0;Next(PanelTicks);return;case 4:UiRegistry.Toggle(Panels[index]);Next(PanelTicks);return;case 5:Check(UiHost.Instance.TryGetInstance(Panels[index],out var panel)&&panel.Visible,$"panel '{Panels[index]}' is 6:GoTo(StoryScene);Next(0);return;case 7:if(SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()!=StoryScene||Box?.IsWaitingAnswer!=true)return;Check(true,$"Murakami's story waits for an answer in '{StoryScene}'");Next(SettleTicks);return;case 8:Shot("novel_menu");Check(Box.TrySelectVariant(AlleyOption),"the alley option is taken");Next(SettleTicks);return;case 9:Shot("novel_wolf");Box.NextAction();Next(SettleTicks);return;case 10:Shot("novel_marao");Next(0);return;case 11:if(battleStarted){Check(true,"the card battle started");Next(SettleTicks);return;}if(Box!=null&& !Box.IsDialogEnded&& !Box.IsWaitingAnswer)Box.NextAction();waitTicks=LineTicks;return;case 12:Shot("battle");Next(SettleTicks);return;case 13:Shot("battle_later");Finish();return;}}/// <summary>Noon, no dialog left running, then the switch.</summary>
private void GoTo(string scene){var time=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Time;time.SetTime(time.Tick-time.Tick%MinutesPerDay+Noon);Box?.Abort();Scenes.SwitchScene(scene);}/// <summary>A few stacks for the inventory and a second hero for the party panel.</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Mods.Skills;namespace Cthangover.Mods.StarterParty{/// <summary> Populates the initial player party with the default starter character <c>"Marao"</c> when the cthangover_party mod finishes loading. The party can only be populated during <c>OnModResourcesReady</c>, not earlier. <c>OnModLoaded</c> and the constructor fire inside <c>ModRegistry.Initialize</c> → <c>ModCompiler.LoadModCode</c>, where mod JSON resources are not yet guaranteed to be accessible. <c>AddCharacterToParty</c> chains into <c>CharacterFactory.Get</c>, which triggers the shared entity resolver's first scan — this requires file providers to be fully set up, which only happens after the entire <c>ModRegistry.Initialize</c> pipeline completes. <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> is invoked by <c>ModInitializerRegistry .NotifyResourcesReady</c> at the end of <c>SceneManager.Initialize</c>, after <c>ModRegistry</c> finishes discovery, <c>SceneEventRegistry</c> is primed, and scene definitions are collected. At that point all factories can safely read mod JSON data. Mods that introduce additional starter characters should implement their own <c>IModInitializer</c> and call <c>AddCharacterToParty</c> from <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> for their character IDs. </summary>
public class StarterPartyInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool newGameHookInstalled;/// <summary> No-op: cross-mod lifecycle notifications are not needed for starter party setup. Each mod's <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> handles its own default characters independently. </summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Adds the cthangover_party mod's default starter character <c>"Marao"</c> to both <c>Characters</c> and <c>BattleSet</c> via <c>CharacterData.AddCharacterToParty</c>. Called once, after all mod file providers and JSON resources are guaranteed to be accessible. Also installs the one-time <see cref="NewGameStartedEvent"/> hook so the starter party is restored after <c>ResetRuntime</c> wipes it at the start of a new game. Both operations are idempotent. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){SeedStarterParty();if(newGameHookInstalled)return;newGameHookInstalled=true;ModEventBus.Subscribe<NewGameStartedEvent>(_=>SeedStarterParty());}private static void SeedStarterParty(){GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData.AddCharacterToParty("Marao");SkillService.GrantSkill("slave_master");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog{/// <summary> Engine-mod initializer for the dialog subsystem. All operations are idempotent: <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> re-runs <c>OnModResourcesReady</c>, so node creation must tolerate repeat invocations. using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog{/// <summary> Dialog execution entry point of the dialog_base engine mod, parked at /root/DialogRunner. Implements the core <c>IInteractiveDialogRunner</c> contract: interactive click-dialogs (a scenario file combined with inline DSL commands) and standalone inline DSL commands are parsed here and executed through the mod-owned dialog runtime and the shared <see cref="DialogBox"/>. </summary>
public partial class DialogScriptRunner:ModNode,IInteractiveDialogRunner{/// <summary>Runs the click action of the interactive definition with the given id through the shared DialogBox. The definition is resolved through the interactive_base factory. Returns false when the definition is unknown, the box is missing, busy, or the definition carries no runnable commands.</summary>
public bool TryExecuteClickDialog(string definitionId){var definition=InteractiveFactory.Instance.Get(definitionId);if(definition==null){GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE",$"TryExecuteClickDialog: definition '{definitionId}' not found",LogLevel.Error);return false;}var dialogBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");if(dialogBox==null){GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE","TryExecuteClickDialog: DialogBox not found",LogLevel.Error);return false;}if(dialogBox.IsRunning){GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE","TryExecuteClickDialog: dialog already running, skipping");return false;}var dlg=BuildClickDialog(definition);if(dlg==null||dlg.Queue.Count==0)return false;return dialogBox.SetDialogQueueAndRun(dlg,null,0,null);}/// <summary>Runs inline DSL commands (hover effects and similar) through a standalone dialog runtime.</summary>
public void ExecuteInlineCommands(string dsl){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dsl))return;try{var dlg=ScenarioParser.Parse(dsl);if(dlg?.Queue==null||dlg.Queue.Count==0)return;var runtime=new DialogRuntime();runtime.SetDialogQueueAndRun(null,dlg.Queue,null,0);runtime.Run();}catch(System.Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE",$"ExecuteInlineCommands failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}private DialogQueue BuildClickDialog(InteractiveDefinition def){if(def?.Actions?.OnClick==null)return null;var clickAction=def.Actions.OnClick;var combinedText="";if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(clickAction.Scenario)){var modId=def.ModId;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))modId=ResolveModIdForScenario(clickAction.Scenario);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId)){var scenarioText=ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(modId,clickAction.Scenario);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenarioText)){var(metadata,body)=ScenarioMetadata.ParseMetadata(scenarioText);combinedText+=body+"\n";}}}if(clickAction.Commands!=null&&clickAction.Commands.Length>0){combinedText+=string.Join("\n",clickAction.Commands);}if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(combinedText))return null;return ScenarioParser.Parse(combinedText);}private string ResolveModIdForScenario(string scenarioPath){var defs=ScenarioDefs.CollectDefinitions();var fileName=System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(scenarioPath.Replace('\\','/').Split('/')[^1]);foreach(var kv in defs){foreach(var sd in kv.Value){if(sd.Name==fileName)return sd.ModId;}}return null;}}}
