using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Registry of <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> implementations, indexed by their <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy.Command"/> name. It discovers nothing itself: <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyConsumer"/> delivers the strategies of every mod as the kernel registers its assembly and takes them back when the mod unloads, so the table never holds a strategy of a dead assembly (which would pin it and keep running its old code after a hot reload). </summary>
public static class ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory{private static readonly Dictionary<string,IScenarioCommandStrategy>Strategies=new();/// <summary> Looks up the <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> registered for <paramref name="command"/>. Returns <c>null</c> if no strategy exists for the given command name. </summary>
public static IScenarioCommandStrategy Get(string command){Strategies.TryGetValue(command,out var strategy);return strategy;}/// <summary> Enumerates all registered DSL command names (lowercase). </summary>
public static IEnumerable<string>GetAllCommandNames(){return Strategies.Keys;}/// <summary> Returns the <see cref="ICommandReferenceMetadata"/> for a command if its strategy implements that interface, or <c>null</c> otherwise. Used by the build pipeline to collect asset dependencies from scenario scripts. </summary>
public static ICommandReferenceMetadata GetReferenceMetadata(string command){if(Strategies.TryGetValue(command,out var strategy)&&strategy is ICommandReferenceMetadata meta)return meta;return null;}/// <summary> Registers a strategy under its command name. The first strategy of a command wins: a mod cannot silently take over a built-in command. </summary>
public static void Register(IScenarioCommandStrategy strategy){if(strategy!=null&& !Strategies.ContainsKey(strategy.Command))Strategies[strategy.Command]=strategy;}/// <summary> Removes <paramref name="strategy"/> (its mod is being unloaded). A command owned by another strategy instance is left alone. </summary>
public static void Unregister(IScenarioCommandStrategy strategy){if(strategy!=null&&Strategies.TryGetValue(strategy.Command,out var registered)&&registered==strategy)Strategies.Remove(strategy.Command);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Strategy interface for handling a single DSL command type in scenario scripts. Each command word (e.g. <c>text</c>, <c>music</c>, <c>goto</c>) maps to one strategy implementation. The <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/> auto-discovers all implementations via reflection and dispatches commands to the matching strategy during parsing. </summary>
public interface IScenarioCommandStrategy{/// <summary> The lowercase DSL command word this strategy handles (e.g. <c>"text"</c>, <c>"music"</c>). </summary>
string Command{get;}/// <summary> Executes the command by appending one or more dialog actions to <paramref name="dlg"/>. </summary> <param name="dlg">The dialog queue to push actions onto.</param> <param name="positional">Unnamed tokens following the command word in order.</param> <param name="named">Key-value pairs parsed from <c>name=value</c> tokens (keys are lowercased).</param> <param name="arrowTarget">The target label following a <c>-&gt;</c> arrow token, if present.</param> <param name="locale">Optional localization provider for resolving <c>key=</c> lookups.</param>
void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Handles the <c>action</c> DSL command. Triggers a named interactive action (defined in the action system) and forwards any extra named parameters as context variables via <see cref="DialogQueue.Set"/>. Implements <see cref="ICommandReferenceMetadata"/> to signal that the first positional argument is an <see cref="PositionalReferenceKind.Action"/> reference. </summary>
public class ActionCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,ICommandReferenceMetadata,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <inheritdoc/>
public string Command=>"action";/// <inheritdoc/>
public PositionalReferenceKind Positional0Kind=>PositionalReferenceKind.Action;/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MinPositional=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MaxPositional=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>
public void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale){var actionName=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:"";foreach(var kv in named){if(kv.Key is"name"or"key")continue;dlg.Set(kv.Key,kv.Value);}dlg.Action(actionName);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Handles the <c>animation</c> DSL command. Supports two modes: (a) multiple sprites via <c>sprites=</c> named parameter, or (b) a single sprite base with <c>start</c>, <c>count</c>, <c>speed</c>, and <c>loop</c> controls. Delegates to <see cref="DialogQueue.Animation"/>. </summary>
public class AnimationCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <inheritdoc/>
public string Command=>"animation";/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MinArguments=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MaxPositional=>1;/// <inheritdoc/>
public IReadOnlyList<string>AllowedNamed=>new[]{"sprites","speed","loop","start","count"};/// <inheritdoc/>
public void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale){if(named.TryGetValue("sprites",out var spritesStr)){var sprites=new List<string>(spritesStr.Split(','));var speed=named.TryGetValue("speed",out var sp)?ParseFloat(sp):1f;var loop= !named.TryGetValue("loop",out var lp)||lp=="true";dlg.Animation(sprites,speed,1f,loop);}else if(positional.Count>0){var sprite=positional[0];var start=named.TryGetValue("start",out var st)?ParseInt(st):0;var count=named.TryGetValue("count",out var cn)?ParseInt(cn):1;var speed=named.TryGetValue("speed",out var sp)?ParseFloat(sp):1f;var loop= !named.TryGetValue("loop",out var lp)||lp=="true";dlg.Animation(sprite,start,count,speed,1f,loop);}}private static float ParseFloat(string s){return float.TryParse(s,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var v)?v:0f;}private static int ParseInt(string s){return int.TryParse(s,NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var v)?v:0;}}}

Delegates to <see cref="DialogQueue.BackgroundColor"/>. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Handles the <c>delay</c> DSL command. Pauses dialog execution for a number of seconds, optionally displaying a text label during the pause. If the <c>hidden</c> flag is set, the delay runs without visible text. Supports localization via the <c>key=</c> named parameter. </summary>
public class DelayCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <inheritdoc/>
public string Command=>"delay";/// <inheritdoc/>
public int MaxPositional=>2;/// <inheritdoc/>
public IReadOnlyList<string>AllowedNamed=>new[]{"key","hidden"};/// <inheritdoc/>
public void Execute(DialogQueue dlg,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrowTarget,ILocalizationProvider locale){var time=positional.Count>0?ParseFloat(positional[0]):1f;var hidden=positional.Count>1&&positional[1]=="hidden"||named.TryGetValue("hidden",out var h)&&h=="true";var showText=hidden?null:positional.Count>1?positional[1]:null;if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&&locale!=null&&showText!=null){var loc=locale.Get(key);if(loc!=null)showText=loc;}if(showText!=null)dlg.Delay(time,showText);else dlg.Delay(time,hidden);}private static float ParseFloat(string s){return float.TryParse(s,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var v)?v:0f;}}}

Supported properties: <c>enabled</c>, <c>visible</c>. Usage: <c>interactive_set door_to_kitchen enabled=false</c> <c>interactive_set door_to_kitchen visible=true</c> </summary>
public class InteractiveSetCommandStrategy:IScenarioCommandStrategy,IScenarioCommandSpec{/// <summary>The lowercase DSL keyword handled by this strategy: <c>interactive_set</c>.</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Consumers;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Feeds <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/> with every mod's <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> implementations as the mods load (dialog_base's own built-in commands included, through the join-time catch-up) and removes them when their mod unloads, so a hot-reloaded mod's commands run its fresh code and the dying assembly is not pinned. </summary>

protected override void Add(IScenarioCommandStrategy instance,string modId)=>ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.Register(instance);/// <inheritdoc />
protected override void Remove(IScenarioCommandStrategy instance,string modId)=>ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.Unregister(instance);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Localization;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios{/// <summary> Converts scenario DSL text or files into <see cref="DialogQueue"/> instances. Wraps <see cref="ScenarioParser"/> with a configurable <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/> that defaults to <see cref="GodotTranslationProvider.Instance"/> when none is supplied. </summary>
public class ScenarioConverter{private readonly ILocalizationProvider locale;/// <summary> Creates a converter with an optional localization provider. </summary> <param name="locale">Localization provider for <c>key=</c> text lookups. Defaults to Godot translations.</param>
public ScenarioConverter(ILocalizationProvider locale=null){this.locale=locale??GodotTranslationProvider.Instance;}/// <summary> Parses raw scenario script text into a dialog queue using the configured locale. </summary>
public DialogQueue Convert(string text){return ScenarioParser.Parse(text,locale);}/// <summary> Reads a scenario file from disk and parses it into a dialog queue. </summary> <param name="path">Filesystem path to the <c>.scenario</c> file.</param> <returns>The parsed <see cref="DialogQueue"/>, or <c>null</c> if the file could not be opened.</returns>
public DialogQueue ConvertFile(string path){foreach(var kvp in ModRegistry.Instance.Mods){var text=kvp.Value.FileProvider.ReadFileText(path);if(text!=null)return Convert(text);}var file=FileAccess.Open(path,FileAccess.ModeFlags.Read);if(file==null){GameLogger.Log("CONVERTER",$"Failed to open '{path}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var fileText=file.GetAsText();file.Close();return Convert(fileText);}}}

The pipeline works in two phases: first the text is split into lines, then each non-empty, non-comment line is tokenized and dispatched to the matching <see cref="IScenarioCommandStrategy"/> via <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/>. Special handling exists for <c>:label</c> anchor points, <c>select/option</c> blocks (accumulated into <see cref="ActionSelect"/>), and <c>-&gt;</c> arrow targets. </summary>
public static class ScenarioParser{/// <summary> Parses a complete scenario script text and returns the resulting dialog queue. </summary> <param name="text">Raw scenario DSL content.</param> <param name="locale">Optional localization provider for <c>key=</c> text lookups.</param>
public static DialogQueue Parse(string text,ILocalizationProvider locale=null){var dlg=new DialogQueue();var lines=text.Split('\n');ActionSelect pendingSelect=null;for(var lineIndex=0;lineIndex<lines.Length;lineIndex++){var lineNumber=lineIndex+1;var line=lines[lineIndex].Trim();if(line.Length==0||line.StartsWith('#')){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);continue;}if(line.StartsWith(':')){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);dlg.Point(line.Substring(1)).SourceLine=lineNumber;continue;}var positional=new List<string>();var named=new Dictionary<string,string>();var cmd=SplitLine(line,positional,named,out var arrowTarget);if(cmd==null)continue;if(cmd=="select"){FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);pendingSelect=new ActionSelect{SourceLine=lineNumber};var promptText=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:null;if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&&locale!=null){var loc=locale.Get(key);if(loc!=null)promptText=loc;}if(promptText!=null)pendingSelect.Text=promptText;if(named.TryGetValue("first",out var first))pendingSelect.FirstAvatar=first;if(named.TryGetValue("second",out var second))pendingSelect.SecondAvatar=second;continue;}if(cmd=="option"){if(pendingSelect==null)continue;var optText=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:"";if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&&locale!=null){var loc=locale.Get(key);if(loc!=null)optText=loc;}var goTo=arrowTarget;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(goTo)){if(named.TryGetValue("goto",out var gt))goTo=gt;else if(positional.Count>1&&positional[1].StartsWith(':'))goTo=positional[1].TrimStart(':');}if(pendingSelect.Variants==null)pendingSelect.Variants=new List<SelectVariant>();pendingSelect.Variants.Add(SelectVariant.New(optText,goTo));continue;}FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);var strategy=ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.Get(cmd);if(strategy==null)continue;var firstNew=dlg.Queue.Count;strategy.Execute(dlg,positional,named,arrowTarget,locale);for(var i=firstNew;i<dlg.Queue.Count;i++){if(dlg.Queue[i]!=null&&dlg.Queue[i].SourceLine==0)dlg.Queue[i].SourceLine=lineNumber;}}FinalizePendingSelect(dlg,ref pendingSelect);return dlg;}/// <summary> Splits one trimmed, non-empty DSL line the way <see cref="Parse"/> does: returns the lowercase command word (null for an empty line) and fills the positional tokens, the <c>name=value</c> pairs (names lowercased) and the <c>-&gt; :label</c> target. Tools that read scenarios without running them (the scenario studio) use it to agree with the parser. </summary>
public static string SplitLine(string line,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,out string arrowTarget){arrowTarget="";var tokens=Tokenize(line);if(tokens.Count==0)return null;var cmd=tokens[0].ToLowerInvariant();for(var i=1;i<tokens.Count;i++){var t=tokens[i];if(t=="->"){if(i+1<tokens.Count){arrowTarget=tokens[i+1].TrimStart(':');i++;}continue;}var eqIdx=t.IndexOf('=');if(eqIdx>0){var name=t.Substring(0,eqIdx);if(IsValidIdent(name)){named[name.ToLowerInvariant()]=t.Substring(eqIdx+1);continue;}}positional.Add(t);}return cmd;}/// <summary> Extracts YAML-like front-matter metadata from script text. public static(Dictionary<string,string>metadata,string remainingText)ParseMetadata(string text){var metadata=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var lines=text.Split('\n');var contentStart=0;var inMetadata=true;for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){var line=lines[i].Trim();if(!inMetadata){continue;}if(line=="---"){contentStart=i+1;break;}if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)){contentStart=i;break;}var colonIdx=line.IndexOf(':');if(colonIdx>0){var key=line.Substring(0,colonIdx).Trim();var val=line.Substring(colonIdx+1).Trim();metadata[key]=val;}else{contentStart=i;break;}}var remaining=string.Join("\n",lines,contentStart,lines.Length-contentStart);return(metadata,remaining);}private static void FinalizePendingSelect(DialogQueue dlg,ref ActionSelect pending){if(pending==null)return;if(pending.Variants==null||pending.Variants.Count==0){pending=null;return;}dlg.Queue.Add(pending);pending=null;}private static List<string>Tokenize(string line){var result=new List<string>();var i=0;while(i<line.Length){if(char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i])){i++;continue;}if(line[i]=='"'){i++;var start=i;while(i<line.Length&&line[i]!='"'){if(line[i]=='\\'&&i+1<line.Length)i++;i++;}result.Add(line[start..i].Replace("\\\"","\""));if(i<line.Length)i++;continue;}var tokenStart=i;while(i<line.Length&& !char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i]))i++;result.Add(line[tokenStart..i]);}return result;}private static bool IsValidIdent(string s){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))return false;for(var i=0;i<s.Length;i++){var c=s[i];if(!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)&&c!='_')return false;}return true;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action{/// <summary> Base for all dialog actions with a lifecycle of Construct → Run → Destruct. Each action gets an auto-generated GUID for targeting by GoTo/If commands. The three timing enums control when Construct and Destruct fire relative to the action's lifecycle and queue life, enabling both immediate teardown (OnEndAction) and deferred cleanup (OnEndQueue). WaitType determines whether the runtime pauses here (WaitClick/Select/Time/Event) or advances immediately (NoWait). DelayedDestruct is a set of action IDs whose Destruct should be called after this action's own destruct — used for cross-action cleanup dependencies where one action's visual state must outlast another. </summary>
public abstract class ActionCommand:IActionCommand{/// <summary>Unique identifier for this action. Auto-generated GUID by default; can be overridden via <see cref="SetID"/> for GoTo targeting.</summary>
public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary>Whether <see cref="Construct"/> has been called and <see cref="DoConstruct"/> has completed.</summary>
public bool IsConstructed{get;private set;}/// <summary>Whether <see cref="Destruct"/> has been called and this action is finished.</summary>
public bool IsDestructed{get;private set;}/// <summary>When to call <see cref="Construct"/>: OnStartQueue (preload) or OnStartAction (lazy, just before run). Default is OnStartAction.</summary>
public virtual ConstructType ConstructType{get;set;}=ConstructType.OnStartAction;/// <summary>When to call <see cref="Destruct"/>: OnEndAction (immediate), OnDelayed (manual cleanup), or OnEndQueue (when dialog finishes). Default is OnEndAction.</summary>
public virtual DestructType DestructType{get;set;}=DestructType.OnEndAction;/// <summary>Controls how the runtime advances past this action. Default is WaitClick (pause for user input).</summary>
public virtual WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.WaitClick;/// <summary>Duration in seconds for WaitTime. Used only when <see cref="WaitType"/> is WaitTime.</summary>
public virtual float WaitTime{get;set;}/// <summary>Timestamp when <see cref="Run"/> was called. Used by WaitTime actions to measure elapsed time.</summary>
public float StartTime{get;private set;}/// <summary>Action IDs whose <see cref="Destruct"/> will be triggered when this action destructs. Used for cross-action cleanup dependencies.</summary>
public ISet<string>DelayedDestruct{get;}=new HashSet<string>();/// <summary>1-based scenario line the action was parsed from; 0 when built in code.</summary>
public int SourceLine{get;set;}/// <summary> Scene node lookup seam for subclasses. Replaces direct SceneContextNode.FindNode calls so action behavior can be exercised against a fake lookup in unit tests instead of the global scene-tree singleton. Defaults to the runtime implementation (<see cref="SceneNodeServiceImpl"/>) and is instantiated per action instance — the same no-container style as ScenarioActionContext. </summary>
protected ISceneNodeService Scene{get;set;}=new SceneNodeServiceImpl();/// <summary>Generates a unique ID so every action is addressable by GoTo/If even without an explicit <see cref="SetID"/> call.</summary>
public ActionCommand(){ID=Guid.NewGuid().ToString();}/// <summary> Idempotent construction: calls <see cref="DoConstruct"/> once and sets <see cref="IsConstructed"/> to true. Construction also clears <see cref="IsDestructed"/>: an action reached again through a looping goto is a new life of the same object, so its next <see cref="Destruct"/> must release what this construction took. </summary>
public void Construct(){if(IsConstructed)return;DoConstruct();IsConstructed=true;IsDestructed=false;}/// <summary>Idempotent desctruction: calls <see cref="DoDestruct"/> once, then sets <see cref="IsConstructed"/> false and <see cref="IsDestructed"/> true.</summary>
public void Destruct(){if(IsDestructed)return;DoDestruct();IsConstructed=false;IsDestructed=true;}/// <summary>Constructs if not already done, records start time, and delegates execution to <see cref="DoRun"/>.</summary>
public void Run(DialogRuntime runtime){Construct();StartTime=(float)(Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0);DoRun(runtime);}/// <summary>Override in subclasses to implement action-specific behavior. Receives the runtime for text processing and dialog box access.</summary>
public abstract void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime);/// <summary>Override to preload resources or register listeners. Called by <see cref="Construct"/>.</summary>
public virtual void DoConstruct(){}/// <summary>Override to release resources or disconnect listeners. Called by <see cref="Destruct"/>.</summary>
public virtual void DoDestruct(){}/// <summary>Fluent setter for <see cref="ID"/>. Use to assign a named target for GoTo/If commands.</summary>
public ActionCommand SetID(string id){ID=id;return this;}}}

OnStartQueue — construct when the dialog queue is first loaded (good for preloading); OnStartAction — lazy-construct just before the action runs (saves resources for unreached branches). Default for most actions is OnStartAction. </summary>
public enum ConstructType{/// <summary>Construct when the dialog queue is first loaded. Useful for actions that need to preload resources.</summary>

===== FILE mods/dialog_base/src/UI/Dialog/Action/DestructType.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action{/// <summary> Controls when an action's Destruct() fires. OnEndAction — immediately after the action advances (typical for most commands). OnDelayed — deferred until specifically cleaned up (for visual state that must persist across actions). OnEndQueue — destruct when the entire dialog queue finishes (for resources that must survive the whole dialog but not beyond). </summary>
public enum DestructType{/// <summary>Destruct immediately when the action is advanced past. Default for most commands.</summary>
OnEndAction,/// <summary>Destruct is deferred — must be manually triggered or triggered via <see cref="ActionCommand.DelayedDestruct"/>.</summary>
OnDelayed,/// <summary>Destruct when the entire dialog queue finishes. Use for resources that must survive the whole dialog but not beyond.</summary>
OnEndQueue,}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action{/// <summary> Full dialog action contract: extends IActionDestruct with construction, execution (Run), and queryable state (WaitType, timing enums, delayed-destruct dependencies). The ID property enables cross-action references (GoTo, If). </summary>
public interface IActionCommand:IActionDestruct{
#region Properties
/// <summary>Unique action identifier, auto-generated GUID. Can be overridden for named GoTo targets.</summary>
string ID{get;set;}/// <summary>Whether <see cref="Construct"/> has completed.</summary>
bool IsConstructed{get;}/// <summary>Whether <see cref="Destruct"/> has been called and the action is finished.</summary>
bool IsDestructed{get;}/// <summary>Controls when construction fires relative to the action's lifecycle.</summary>
ConstructType ConstructType{get;}/// <summary>Controls when destruction fires relative to the action's lifecycle.</summary>
DestructType DestructType{get;}/// <summary>How the runtime should handle advancement past this action.</summary>
WaitType WaitType{get;}/// <summary>IDs of actions whose Destruct should be called when this action destructs.</summary>
ISet<string>DelayedDestruct{get;}/// <summary>Duration in seconds when WaitType is WaitTime.</summary>
float WaitTime{get;}/// <summary>Timestamp of the last <see cref="Run"/> call, in seconds since epoch.</summary>
float StartTime{get;}/// <summary> 1-based line of the scenario text this action was parsed from, 0 for actions built in code. Set by <see cref="Scenarios.ScenarioParser"/>; debugging tools map the running action back to the script with it. </summary>
int SourceLine{get;set;}
#endregion
#region Methods
/// <summary>Called by the runtime to initialize the action before execution.</summary>
void Construct();/// <summary>Called by the runtime to execute the action. Receives the runtime for context.</summary>
void Run(DialogRuntime runtime);
#endregion
}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Frame-animates the scene foreground by swapping ViewBox textures at a configurable speed: the first frame lasts 1/<see cref="Speed"/> seconds, every later one 1/<see cref="NextFrameSpeed"/>. Hard cuts, no crossfade. Frames come from <see cref="Textures"/> or are resolved from <see cref="SpriteIDs"/> through <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/> (the same texture names a <c>foreground</c> command takes) on construction (OnStartQueue). <para/> Event-driven: each frame schedules one <see cref="SceneTreeTimer"/> for the next cut — no per-frame update. The dialog does not wait (NoWait); the animation keeps playing while the dialog goes on and stops when the queue ends (OnEndQueue), when another animation starts or when a <c>foreground</c> command replaces the picture (<see cref="StopActive"/>). </summary>
public class ActionAnimatedForeground:ActionCommand{private static ActionAnimatedForeground active;/// <summary>Texture names resolved through <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/>; ignored when <see cref="Textures"/> is set.</summary>
public List<string>SpriteIDs{get;set;}/// <summary>Ready frames used instead of resolving <see cref="SpriteIDs"/> (bypasses the factory like ActionForeground.Texture).</summary>
public List<Texture2D>Textures{get;set;}/// <summary>Frames per second of the first frame.</summary>
public float Speed{get;set;}=1f;/// <summary>Frames per second of every frame after the first one.</summary>
public float NextFrameSpeed{get;set;}=1f;/// <summary>Whether playback restarts from the first frame after the last one; otherwise it stops on the last frame.</summary>
public bool IsLoop{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Whether the animation is still cutting frames.</summary>
public bool IsAnimating{get;private set;}private int currentFrame;private List<Texture2D>frames;private SceneTreeTimer frameTimer;/// <summary>Frames are resolved when the queue starts, so the first cut does not stall on loading.</summary>
public override ConstructType ConstructType{get;set;}=ConstructType.OnStartQueue;/// <summary>The animation lives until the dialog ends, not until the next action.</summary>
public override DestructType DestructType{get;set;}=DestructType.OnEndQueue;/// <summary>The dialog goes on while the foreground animates.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>Stops the animation that currently drives the foreground, if any; the shown frame stays.</summary>
public static void StopActive(){active?.Stop();}/// <summary>Resolves the frames.</summary>
public override void DoConstruct(){base.DoConstruct();LoadFrames();}/// <summary>Stops the frame timer; the last shown frame stays on the ViewBox.</summary>
public override void DoDestruct(){base.DoDestruct();Stop();}private void LoadFrames(){frames=new List<Texture2D>();var source=Textures;if(source!=null){foreach(var tex in source)if(tex!=null)frames.Add(tex);return;}if(SpriteIDs==null)return;foreach(var id in SpriteIDs){var tex=BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(id);if(tex!=null)frames.Add(tex);}}/// <summary>Stops a previous animation, shows the first frame on the ViewBox and schedules the next cut.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){StopActive();currentFrame=0;IsAnimating=frames!=null&&frames.Count>0;if(!IsAnimating)return;active=this;ShowFrame();ScheduleNextFrame(Speed);}private void ShowFrame(){var viewBox=Scene.Find<ViewBox>("ViewBox");viewBox?.SetForegroundTexture(frames[currentFrame]);}private void ScheduleNextFrame(float speed){if(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()is not SceneTree tree)return;frameTimer=tree.CreateTimer(1f/Mathf.Max(speed,0.01f));frameTimer.Timeout+=OnFrameTimeout;}private void OnFrameTimeout(){frameTimer=null;if(!IsAnimating)return;currentFrame++;if(currentFrame>=frames.Count){if(!IsLoop){Stop();return;}currentFrame=0;}ShowFrame();ScheduleNextFrame(NextFrameSpeed);}private void Stop(){IsAnimating=false;if(frameTimer!=null){frameTimer.Timeout-=OnFrameTimeout;frameTimer=null;}if(active==this)active=null;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Mods.Time;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Sets the scene background on the ViewBox, including depth and albedo maps for the lighting system. Resolves textures through BackgroundFactory on construction (OnStartQueue) — depth and albedo are loaded from the same sprite ID with "_depth" / "_albedo" suffixes. Kills any in-progress background transition before setting the new texture. Textures are nulled after application to prevent stale reuse across dialog restarts. Sets SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID so the scene manager can restore the correct background on scene revisit. </summary>
public class ActionBackground:ActionCommand{/// <summary>Sprite resource ID resolved through <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/> on construction. Also loads depth (_depth) and albedo (_albedo) variants.</summary>
public string SpriteID{get;set;}/// <summary>Direct texture override. When non-null, bypasses factory resolution. Set to null after application to prevent stale reuse.</summary>
public Texture2D Texture{get;set;}/// <summary>Depth map for the lighting system, loaded from <see cref="SpriteID"/> + "_depth".</summary>
public Texture2D DepthTexture{get;set;}/// <summary>Albedo color map for the lighting system, loaded from <see cref="SpriteID"/> + "_albedo".</summary>
public Texture2D AlbedoTexture{get;set;}/// <summary>Preloads textures when the dialog queue is first created, resolving SpriteID through the factory.</summary>
public override ConstructType ConstructType{get;set;}=ConstructType.OnStartQueue;/// <summary>Background is set imperatively — the dialog continues immediately.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>Resolves <see cref="SpriteID"/> plus its <c>_depth</c>/<c>_albedo</c> variants through the background factory.</summary>

Consumed textures are nulled so a reused action cannot re-apply stale data. </summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){if(Texture==null)return;SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID=SpriteID;var viewBox=Scene.Find<ViewBox>("ViewBox");viewBox?.KillTransitionTween();viewBox?.SetBackgroundTexture(Texture);var controller=UiLightController.Instance;controller?.SetupDepthMap(DepthTexture);controller?.SetupAlbedoMap(AlbedoTexture);Texture=null;DepthTexture=null;AlbedoTexture=null;}}}

using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Tween-driven background fade in/out. Animates the modulate alpha of the dialog box's parent Control over Duration seconds. The fade belongs to the background, not to the action: by default (NoWait) the runtime destructs the action right after it runs, and the fade must go on. So the tween is shared by all instances — a new fade kills the previous one to prevent overlap — and destructing the action leaves it running; the tween is bound to the background node and dies with it. Can optionally set WaitType to WaitTime with a matching duration so the dialog pauses during the transition. </summary>
public class ActionBackgroundShowHide:ActionCommand{/// <summary>Whether to fade the background in (Show) or out (Hide).</summary>
public BackgroundActionType ActionType{get;set;}=BackgroundActionType.Show;/// <summary>Duration of the fade tween in seconds.</summary>
public float Duration{get;set;}=1f;private static Tween activeTween;/// <summary>Default NoWait — overridden by the DialogQueue builder if the wait flag is set, changing to WaitTime to pause during transition.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>Starts an alpha tween of the dialog box parent's <c>modulate:a</c> towards fully visible (Show) or fully transparent (Hide).</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){var dialogBox=runtime.DialogBox;if(dialogBox==null)return;var targetAlpha=ActionType==BackgroundActionType.Show?1f:0f;if(dialogBox.GetParent()is Control backgroundNode){StopTween();activeTween=backgroundNode.CreateTween();activeTween.TweenProperty(backgroundNode,"modulate:a",targetAlpha,Duration);}}private static void StopTween(){if(activeTween!=null){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(activeTween))activeTween.Kill();activeTween=null;}}}}

public PackedScene Prefab{get;set;}private Node spawnedEffect;/// <summary>The dialog continues immediately — the spawned effect plays independently.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>OnDelayed keeps the effect node alive past the action's run; it is freed when the dialog ends.</summary>
public override DestructType DestructType{get;set;}=DestructType.OnDelayed;/// <summary>Resolves the effect scene (<see cref="Prefab"/> or <see cref="EffectID"/> through <see cref="EffectFactory"/>) and instantiates it.</summary>
public override void DoConstruct(){base.DoConstruct();var packedScene=Prefab;if(packedScene==null){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(EffectID))return;packedScene=EffectFactory.Instance.Get(EffectID);if(packedScene==null){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG",$"ActionEffect: effect '{EffectID}' not found",LogLevel.Error);return;}}spawnedEffect=packedScene.Instantiate();}/// <summary>Shows the instantiated effect: adds it to the ViewBox UI layer. Without a ViewBox the effect is dropped with an error.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){if(spawnedEffect==null||spawnedEffect.IsInsideTree())return;var layer=Scene.Find<ViewBox>("ViewBox")?.GetInteractiveLayer("ui");if(layer==null){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG",$"ActionEffect: no ViewBox to show effect '{EffectID}'",LogLevel.Error);spawnedEffect.QueueFree();spawnedEffect=null;return;}layer.AddChild(spawnedEffect);}/// <summary>Frees the spawned effect node (unless it already freed itself); paired with the OnDelayed destruct so effects outlive the action's run.</summary>
public override void DoDestruct(){base.DoDestruct();if(spawnedEffect!=null){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(spawnedEffect))spawnedEffect.QueueFree();spawnedEffect=null;}}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Conditional branch: evaluates a Func&lt;bool&gt; and jumps to TrueGoTo or FalseGoTo based on the result. If the chosen target is null/empty, falls through to the next action. NoWait so branching is transparent to the player: the runtime itself advances past a NoWait action, so the branch never calls <see cref="DialogRuntime.Next"/> — doing it here as well skipped the action after the <c>if</c> without running it. </summary>
public class ActionIf:ActionCommand{/// <summary>Delegate evaluated at runtime. Must return true/false to select the branch target.</summary>
public Func<bool>Condition{get;set;}/// <summary>Target action ID if <see cref="Condition"/> returns true. Empty or null causes fall-through.</summary>
public string TrueGoTo{get;set;}/// <summary>Target action ID if <see cref="Condition"/> returns false. Empty or null causes fall-through.</summary>
public string FalseGoTo{get;set;}/// <summary>Branch evaluation is transparent — the dialog jumps to the target without user input.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>Evaluates <see cref="Condition"/> and jumps to <see cref="TrueGoTo"/> or <see cref="FalseGoTo"/>; an empty target falls through to the next action.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){if(Condition==null){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG","ActionIf: Condition delegate is null",LogLevel.Error);return;}var result=Condition();var goTo=result?TrueGoTo:FalseGoTo;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(goTo))runtime.TryGoTo(goTo);}}}

public string DefinitionId{get;set;}/// <summary>Property name: "enabled" or "visible".</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Bridges the dialog system to the broader scenario action system (ScenarioActionFactory). Resolves an action by name and runs it with a ScenarioActionContext wrapping the dialog runtime. Wraps execution in try/catch so a faulty scenario action doesn't crash the dialog queue. Every error log carries the owning scenario identity (see <see cref="DescribeScenario"/>): the runtime cannot report the source file and line — the parser drops them — but it can name the scenario definition, which together with the validator's file:line report pinpoints the broken command. </summary>
public class ActionScenario:ActionCommand{/// <summary>Scenario action name resolved through <see cref="ScenarioActionFactory"/>. Empty names are logged and skipped.</summary>
public string ActionName{get;set;}/// <summary>The scenario action runs and the dialog advances — no synchronization.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.NoWait;/// <summary>Resolves <see cref="ActionName"/> through <see cref="ScenarioActionFactory"/> and runs it with a dialog-backed context; exceptions are logged, never propagated.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(ActionName)){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG","ActionScenario: ActionName is null or empty"+DescribeScenario(runtime),LogLevel.Error);return;}var action=ScenarioActionFactory.Instance.Get(ActionName);if(action==null){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG",$"ActionScenario: scenario action '{ActionName}' is not registered — the action is skipped, check the spelling and that the defining mod is loaded"+DescribeScenario(runtime),LogLevel.Error);return;}var ctx=new ScenarioActionContext(runtime);try{action.Run(ctx);}catch(System.Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG",$"ActionScenario: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}"+DescribeScenario(runtime),LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Formats the scenario suffix for error logs. The locker that started the dialog is the event owning the scenario; its ID is the scenario definition name (ScenarioId) or, for code-driven lockers, the event type name. Returns a human-readable suffix either way, so a missing action in a shipped game can be traced to its scenario from user://logs/cthangover.log alone. </summary>
private static string DescribeScenario(DialogRuntime runtime){var id=runtime?.DialogBox?.Locker?.ID;return string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)?" (scenario unknown)":$" (scenario '{id}')";}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls{/// <summary> Presents player choices by spawning answer variants in the DialogBox. WaitType is WaitSelect so the dialog pauses until the player picks an option (which triggers DialogBox.SelectVariant → Runtime.TryGoTo). Each variant's text is processed through variable substitution before display. Also sets an accompanying text message to contextualize the choice (e.g. "What will you do?"). </summary>
public class ActionSelect:ActionCommand{/// <summary>The list of selectable choice variants. Each carries display text and a GoTo target.</summary>
public List<SelectVariant>Variants{get;set;}/// <summary>Context text shown alongside the choices (e.g. "What will you do?"). Supports variable substitution.</summary>
public string Text{get;set;}/// <summary>Left avatar sprite ID shown during the choice. Null hides the slot.</summary>
public string FirstAvatar{get;set;}/// <summary>Right avatar sprite ID shown during the choice. Null hides the slot.</summary>
public string SecondAvatar{get;set;}/// <summary>Dialog pauses until the player selects a variant — then the runtime jumps to the chosen GoTo target.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.WaitSelect;/// <summary>Substitutes variables in the variants and context text, then shows the answer box; the runtime stays paused until a variant is picked.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){var dialogBox=runtime.DialogBox;if(dialogBox==null)return;foreach(var variant in Variants)variant.Text=runtime.ProcessText(variant.Text);dialogBox.SetVariants(Variants);dialogBox.SetText(runtime.ProcessText(Text));}}}

The optional Callback Func&lt;string&gt; allows lazy evaluation — if set, Value is ignored and Callback is invoked at runtime. This enables dynamic values (e.g. quest state, character names) that can't be known when the dialog script is authored. </summary>

WaitType is WaitEvent so the dialog runtime pauses until elapsed >= WaitTime, at which point the action completes itself through <see cref="DialogBox.CompleteAction"/> (event-driven — no DialogBox poll) and the box advances the queue, scheduling the timer of a following <c>delay</c> like any other advance. OnStartCallback/OnFinishCallback bracket the animation for setup/teardown. Progress follows the controller's process delta, so the timeline lasts WaitTime seconds of game time at any frame rate (and scales with <c>Engine.TimeScale</c> exactly like <c>delay</c> timers). </summary>
public class ActionTimedUpdate:ActionCommand,IOnUpdateEvent{/// <summary>Update priority. Value 0 — runs before most other listeners.</summary>
public int Priority=>0;/// <summary>Fires once when <see cref="DoRun"/> is called, before the first update frame.</summary>
public System.Action OnStartCallback{get;set;}/// <summary>Fires each frame during the active period with a normalized progress value t (0→1) over <see cref="WaitTime"/> seconds.</summary>
public System.Action<float>OnUpdateCallback{get;set;}/// <summary>Fires once when the elapsed time exceeds <see cref="WaitTime"/> or when destructed.</summary>
public System.Action OnFinishCallback{get;set;}/// <summary>Pauses the dialog until the elapsed time meets WaitTime — the action then completes itself.</summary>
public override WaitType WaitType{get;set;}=WaitType.WaitEvent;/// <summary>Total duration in seconds over which <see cref="OnUpdateCallback"/> receives normalized progress.</summary>
public override float WaitTime{get;set;}=1f;private float elapsed;private bool isRunning;private DialogRuntime runtime;private SceneEventController controller;/// <summary>Registers this action as an <see cref="IOnUpdateEvent"/> listener on the scene's event controller.</summary>
public override void DoConstruct(){base.DoConstruct();controller=Scene.Find<SceneEventController>("EventController");controller?.AddUpdateEventListener(this);}/// <summary>Starts the timeline: resets elapsed time and fires <see cref="OnStartCallback"/> before the first frame.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){this.runtime=runtime;elapsed=0f;isRunning=true;OnStartCallback?.Invoke();}/// <summary>Detaches from the update controller, stops ticking and fires <see cref="OnFinishCallback"/>.</summary>
public override void DoDestruct(){base.DoDestruct();isRunning=false;runtime=null;controller?.RemoveUpdateEventListener(this);controller=null;OnFinishCallback?.Invoke();}void IOnUpdateEvent.OnUpdate(){if(!isRunning)return;elapsed+=(float)(controller?.GetProcessDeltaTime()??0d);var t=WaitTime>0f?Mathf.Min(elapsed/WaitTime,1f):1f;OnUpdateCallback?.Invoke(t);if(elapsed<WaitTime)return;// Advancing destructs this action, which clears the runtime field: keep the runtime in a local for the whole completion.
isRunning=false;var owner=runtime;if(owner?.DialogBox!=null){owner.DialogBox.CompleteAction(this);}else if(owner!=null){owner.Next();owner.Run();}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog{/// <summary> Thin wrapper node that hosts the dialog UI. The canvas instantiates its <see cref="DialogBox"/> child at runtime from the core mod through <see cref="ModScenePrefab"/> and keeps the well-known node name <c>DialogBox</c>. The rest of the game locates it by that name via <see cref="SceneContextNode.FindNode{T}"/>, not by hardcoded paths. </summary>
public partial class DialogCanvas:Control{private static readonly ModScenePrefab DialogBoxPrefab=new("scenes/ui/dialog_box.tscn");private DialogBox dialogBox;/// <summary>The active DialogBox child, resolved in _Ready. Used by the scene tree root to access dialog without path traversal.</summary>
public DialogBox DialogBox=>dialogBox;/// <summary>Instantiates the <see cref="DialogBox"/> child from the core prefab when the scene does not ship one, keeping the well-known node name for path-free lookup.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){dialogBox??=GetNodeOrNull<DialogBox>("DialogBox");if(dialogBox==null){dialogBox=DialogBoxPrefab.Instantiate<DialogBox>();if(dialogBox!=null){dialogBox.Name="DialogBox";AddChild(dialogBox);}else{GameLogger.Log("DIALOG","DialogCanvas._Ready: failed to build 'scenes/ui/dialog_box.tscn'",LogLevel.Error);}}MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog{/// <summary> Dialog execution engine: manages the action queue with goto-based branching and variable substitution. Run() iterates actions in a tight loop, breaking only on wait points (WaitClick/Select/Time/Event). Text variables use the "${name}" syntax and are resolved via GetVariable/SetVariable — values are stored in a simple Dictionary, not a cascading scope, keeping lookups O(1). GoTo searches the queue linearly by action ID and jumps the index; the source action's destruct fires on jump. The isLastGoTo flag prevents double advancement when a GoTo is the last action in its branch. End() processes an optional cleanup queue (endDialogQueue) before tearing down, and publishes <see cref="DialogEndedEvent"/> on the <see cref="ModEventBus"/> exactly once per queue — event chains pick the next scenario from it. <para/> An action may end the queue (<c>end</c>, a goto to a missing label) or start another dialog from inside <see cref="Run"/>. Every load, end and abort bumps a generation counter, and <see cref="Run"/> stops as soon as the generation changed under it: the rest of the loop belongs to a queue that no longer runs. public bool IsWaitTime=>IsWaitType(WaitType.WaitTime);/// <summary>True when the current action is waiting for an external event (<see cref="WaitType.WaitEvent"/>).</summary>

public void SetVariable(string name,string value){variables[name]=value;}/// <summary>Scans <paramref name="text"/> for ${key} patterns and replaces them with stored variable values. Unresolved keys become "?".</summary>

public void Next(){if(isLastGoTo){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG","Next: last goto, returning");isLastGoTo=false;return;}var action=CurrentAction;if(action!=null&&action.IsConstructed&&action.DestructType==DestructType.OnEndAction)action.Destruct();if(action!=null&&Lists.IsNotEmpty(dialogQueue)&&Lists.IsNotEmpty(action.DelayedDestruct))foreach(var item in dialogQueue)if(action.DelayedDestruct.Contains(item.ID))item.Destruct();if(Lists.IsEmpty(dialogQueue)||index<0||index>=dialogQueue.Count){GameLogger.Log("DIALOG","Next: queue exhausted, ending");End();return;}index++;}/// <summary> Terminates the dialog queue. A standalone event (not inside a chain) drives itself, event-driven: it asks for a deferred check when it becomes ready, when the condition state changes (<see cref="ConditionStateChangedEvent"/>) and when a dialog ends (<see cref="DialogEndedEvent"/>), and runs when the state changed since its own last run (or on the first run) and the DialogBox is free. Checks that the DialogBox is free (IsRunning == false) before building and executing a dialog queue. IsOneRun prevents re-triggering after first execution; CanRepeat allows the event to fire again on subsequent scenes/visits. CheckConditions is virtual — ScenarioEvent overrides it to evaluate script conditions. </summary>

public bool IsFirstRun{get;private set;}=true;/// <summary> If <c>true</c>, the event fires exactly once and never again, even across scene revisits. After <see cref="RunDialog"/> completes, <see cref="IsFirstRun"/> becomes <c>false</c>. </summary>
[Export]public bool IsOneRun{get;set;}=false;/// <summary> If <c>true</c>, the event can re-trigger on subsequent scene visits. When <c>false</c>, the event only fires on the first visit to the scene. </summary>
[Export]public bool CanRepeat{get;set;}=true;/// <summary> Virtual guard evaluated before triggering. Defaults to <c>true</c>. Override to implement conditional logic (e.g. <see cref="ScenarioEvent"/> checks script conditions via <see cref="ScenarioCondition.Evaluate"/>). </summary>

public virtual string ID=>GetType().FullName;/// <summary>Finds the shared <see cref="DialogBox"/>; a standalone event (no parent chain) subscribes to its triggers and asks for the first check.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){if(dialogBox==null){var root=GetTree()?.Root;if(root!=null){dialogBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");}}isStandalone=GetParent()is not IExecutableEventChain;if(isStandalone){ModEventBus.Subscribe<ConditionStateChangedEvent>(OnConditionStateChanged);ModEventBus.Subscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);RequestCheck();}GameLogger.Log("EVENT",$"{GetType().Name}._Ready: dialogBox={(dialogBox != null ? "found" : "null")}, chain={!isStandalone}, standalone={isStandalone}",LogLevel.Debug);}/// <summary>Detaches a standalone event from its triggers when it leaves the tree.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Executable;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Executable{/// <summary> The primary event chain for a scene: picks the next ExecutableEvent to run in the dialog box. Event-driven — there is no per-frame work. A scan is requested when the condition state changes (<see cref="ConditionStateChangedEvent"/>), when a dialog ends (<see cref="DialogEndedEvent"/>), when an event is added, when the chain becomes ready and when it is re-activated. Requests are coalesced into one deferred scan at the end of the frame: a burst of flag changes costs one pass, the state is read after the change completed (some publishers raise their event before storing the value), and a scan never runs inside the dialog runtime that ended a queue. <para/> On _Ready the chain collects child ExecutableEvent nodes and replays a pending scene switch (pending scene name from SceneManager). Exposes LastBackgroundID so action commands can remember which background was active for scene restore on revisit. AddEvent/RemoveEvent/ClearEvents allow dynamic event management via code. Events are checked in insertion order; the first satisfying both IsOneRun and CheckConditions gets executed. <para/> Self-loop guard: the chain remembers, per event, the condition version at the moment its dialog ended, and does not run that event again until the state changed after it. An event's own state changes (made during its dialog) therefore never re-trigger it, A→B chaining still works, and two repeatable events cannot ping-pong A→B→A while nothing changes. </summary>
public partial class ExecutableMainEventChain:Control,IExecutableEventChain{private bool isActive=true;private List<ExecutableEvent>allEvents=new();private DialogBox dialogBox;// Condition version at the end of each event's last dialog run by this chain.
private readonly Dictionary<ExecutableEvent,long>endVersions=new();// The event whose dialog the chain started and is waiting to end.
private ExecutableEvent running;// A deferred scan is already queued for this frame.
private bool scanQueued;/// <summary> Stores the last background ID set by action commands (e.g. "bg_home"). Used on scene revisit to restore the previously active background. </summary>
public string LastBackgroundID{get;set;}/// <summary> Enables or disables event dispatch. While <c>false</c>, scans do nothing; switching back to <c>true</c> requests a scan. </summary>
public bool IsActive{get=>isActive;set{isActive=value;if(value)RequestScan();}}/// <summary> Removes and frees all currently registered events from the chain via <c>QueueFree</c> and empties the internal event list. </summary>
public void ClearEvents(){GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"ClearEvents: removing {allEvents.Count} event(s)");foreach(var evt in allEvents){var id=evt is ScenarioEvent se?se.Condition??"no_condition":evt.GetType().Name;GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"  QueueFree: {evt.GetType().Name} [condition={id}]");evt.QueueFree();}allEvents.Clear();endVersions.Clear();running=null;}/// <summary> Adds an <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> to the chain and reparents it via <c>AddChild</c>. Events are dispatched in insertion order; adding one requests a scan. </summary> <param name="evt">The event to register and parent to this chain.</param>
public void AddEvent(IExecutableEvent evt){var typed=(ExecutableEvent)evt;var id=typed is ScenarioEvent se?se.Condition??"no_condition":typed.GetType().Name;GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"AddEvent: {typed.GetType().Name} [condition={id}] — calling AddChild");AddChild(typed);allEvents.Add(typed);RequestScan();GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"  AddEvent: done, allEvents.Count={allEvents.Count}");}/// <summary> Removes an event from the chain and queues it for deletion. No-op if the event is not currently registered. </summary> <param name="evt">The event to unregister and free.</param>
public void RemoveEvent(ExecutableEvent evt){if(allEvents.Remove(evt)){endVersions.Remove(evt);if(running==evt)running=null;evt.QueueFree();GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"removed event '{evt.GetType().Name}'");}}/// <summary>Finds the shared <see cref="DialogBox"/>, subscribes to the scan triggers, collects child events, publishes the shell-ready event, replays any pending scene switch and requests the first scan.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"_Ready: starting, tree scene='{GetTree()?.CurrentScene?.Name}'");dialogBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");ModEventBus.Subscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);ModEventBus.Subscribe<ConditionStateChangedEvent>(OnConditionStateChanged);foreach(var child in GetChildren()){if(child is ExecutableEvent evt){allEvents.Add(evt);GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"collected event '{evt.GetType().Name}'");}}ModEventBus.Publish(new ShellReadyEvent{Root=this});var sceneManager=GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("/root/SceneManager");if(sceneManager!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneManager.PendingSceneName)){var pending=sceneManager.PendingSceneName;GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"_Ready: deferring SwitchScene('{pending}')");sceneManager.PendingSceneName=null;Callable.From(()=>sceneManager.SwitchScene(pending)).CallDeferred();}RequestScan();GameLogger.Log("CHAIN",$"_Ready: done, allEvents={allEvents.Count}");}/// <summary>Detaches the scan triggers when the chain leaves the tree.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<ConditionStateChangedEvent>(OnConditionStateChanged);}/// <summary> Called when any dialog queue finishes. For the chain's own running event records the version at its dialog end, so the state changes it produced are accounted for (self-loop guard); then requests a scan so the next event starts right away. </summary>
private void OnDialogEnded(DialogEndedEvent evt){if(running!=null&&evt.LockerId==running.ID){endVersions[running]=ConditionStateMonitor.Version;running=null;}RequestScan();}private void OnConditionStateChanged(ConditionStateChangedEvent evt){RequestScan();}/// <summary> Asks for a scan at the end of the frame. Any number of requests within one frame result in a single scan. </summary>
public void RequestScan(){if(scanQueued)return;scanQueued=true;Callable.From(Scan).CallDeferred();}/// <summary>Starts the first runnable event, unless the chain is inactive or the dialog box is busy or frozen (a dialog end or a state change asks again).</summary>
private void Scan(){scanQueued=false;if(!IsInstanceValid(this)|| !IsInsideTree()|| !isActive)return;if(dialogBox==null|| !IsInstanceValid(dialogBox)|| !dialogBox.IsActive||dialogBox.IsRunning)return;var dialog=FindEvent();if(dialog==null)return;if(dialog.RunDialog())running=dialog;}/// <summary> <c>true</c> if the chain has any registered events remaining. public bool HasEvents=>allEvents.Count>0;/// <summary> Deactivates the chain, preventing any further event dispatch until reactivation. </summary>
public void Stop(){isActive=false;}private ExecutableEvent FindEvent(){if(Lists.IsEmpty(allEvents))return null;var version=ConditionStateMonitor.Version;foreach(var nextEvent in allEvents){if(endVersions.TryGetValue(nextEvent,out var endVersion)&&version<=endVersion)continue;if(nextEvent.IsOneRun&& !nextEvent.IsFirstRun)continue;if(nextEvent.CheckConditions)return nextEvent;}return null;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.TestRunner{/// <summary> Мод-порт интеграционного <c>DialogAutoDriver</c>: автопроигрывает активный диалог, кликая <c>IDialogBox.NextAction()</c> каждые 0.1с и отвечая на выборы по индексам из <c>--choices=</c> (по порядку, после исчерпания — первый вариант). Тик реализован дочерним Godot <see cref="Timer"/>, а не override <c>_Process</c>: сборка мода компилируется Roslyn вне source-генератора Godot, поэтому виртуальные методы Node не диспетчеризуются, тогда как сигнал <c>Timer.Timeout</c> — это Godot-объект и работает из мод-сборок. DialogBox ищется лениво через корень дерева по имени «DialogBox» (контракт ядра <see cref="IDialogBox"/>, типы dialog_base не нужны). Завершение диалога и общий таймаут печатают строку <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=test_runner passed=N failed=M</c> — формат парсит tests/Cthangover.TestRunner (ResultParser), после чего процесс завершается с соответствующим кодом выхода. Как и в оригинале, <c>IsDialogEnded</c> истинно до загрузки первой очереди, поэтому end-обработка ждёт, пока диалог реально наблюдался запущенным, плюс стартовая пауза 0.5с на построение сцены. With <c>--dialogs=N</c> the run passes after N <see cref="DialogEndedEvent"/>s instead: hub games never go idle, because the next scene's dialog starts in the same frame the previous one ends. </summary>
public partial class DialogAutoDriverNode:Node{/// <summary>Имя, под которым раннер атрибутирует результат прогона.</summary>
private const string ResultName="test_runner";/// <summary>Пауза после старта, чтобы сцена успела построиться (как в SceneSwitcher).</summary>
private const double StartDelaySeconds=0.5;/// <summary>Сколько бокс может быть найден, но не запущен, прежде чем считаем сцену без диалога.</summary>
private const double FirstDialogGraceSeconds=3.0;/// <summary>Интервал автопрокликивания, сек (как в оригинальном драйвере).</summary>
private const double AdvanceIntervalSeconds=0.1;private readonly List<int>choices;private readonly float?timeoutSeconds;private readonly int?dialogsTarget;private IDialogBox dialogBox;private int choiceIndex;private double elapsedSeconds;private double dialogFoundAtSeconds;private bool hasSeenRunningDialog;private bool finished;private int endedDialogs;/// <summary> Создаёт драйвер; <paramref name="choices"/> — индексы вариантов по порядку появления, <paramref name="timeoutSeconds"/> — общий лимит прогона (null — без таймаута). Тикающий таймер-ребёнок ставится прямо в конструкторе (без override _EnterTree/_Ready — мод-сборка вне source-генератора Godot): WaitTime 0.1с с автостартом воспроизводит ритм оригинального драйвера, а сигнал <c>Timer.Timeout</c> — Godot-сигнал и работает из мод-сборок. <paramref name="dialogsTarget"/> — number of finished dialogs that passes the run (null — pass when the box goes idle). </summary>
public DialogAutoDriverNode(List<int>choices,float?timeoutSeconds,int?dialogsTarget){this.choices=choices??new List<int>();this.timeoutSeconds=timeoutSeconds;this.dialogsTarget=dialogsTarget;if(dialogsTarget.HasValue)ModEventBus.Subscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);var timer=new Timer{Name="TickTimer",WaitTime=AdvanceIntervalSeconds,Autostart=true,OneShot=false};AddChild(timer);timer.Timeout+=Tick;}/// <summary>Один тик автопроигрывания: ленивый поиск бокса, прокликивание, выборы, end/timeout-обработка.</summary>
private void Tick(){if(finished)return;elapsedSeconds+=AdvanceIntervalSeconds;if(timeoutSeconds.HasValue&&elapsedSeconds>=timeoutSeconds.Value){Finish(0,1,$"timeout ({timeoutSeconds.Value}s) reached");return;}if(elapsedSeconds<StartDelaySeconds)return;if(dialogBox is not GodotObject liveBox|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(liveBox)||liveBox is not Node liveNode|| !liveNode.IsInsideTree()){dialogBox=FindDialogBox();if(dialogBox==null)return;dialogFoundAtSeconds=elapsedSeconds;hasSeenRunningDialog=false;var choicesInfo=choices.Count>0?"choices=["+string.Join(",",choices)+"]":"no choices, will pick first variant each time";GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriverNode started, interval={AdvanceIntervalSeconds}, {choicesInfo}");}if(dialogBox.IsRunning)hasSeenRunningDialog=true;// IsDialogEnded истинно и до первой очереди — ждём наблюдения запущенного диалога плюс льготный период на пустых сценах.
var waitingForFirstDialog= !hasSeenRunningDialog&&elapsedSeconds-dialogFoundAtSeconds<FirstDialogGraceSeconds;if(!dialogsTarget.HasValue&&dialogBox.IsDialogEnded&& !waitingForFirstDialog){GameLogger.Log("TEST","DialogAutoDriverNode: dialog ended, quitting");Finish(1,0,null);return;}if(dialogBox.IsWaitingAnswer){HandleSelection();return;}dialogBox.NextAction();}/// <summary>Counts finished dialogs and passes the run once the --dialogs= target is reached.</summary>
private void OnDialogEnded(DialogEndedEvent evt){endedDialogs++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriverNode: dialog #{endedDialogs} ended");if(endedDialogs>=dialogsTarget.Value)Finish(1,0,$"{endedDialogs} dialog(s) ended, quitting");}/// <summary>Выбирает показанный вариант по индексу из --choices= (вне диапазона — первый).</summary>
private void HandleSelection(){var count=dialogBox.AnswerVariantCount;if(count<=0)return;var pick=0;if(choiceIndex<choices.Count){pick=choices[choiceIndex];if(pick>=count)pick=0;choiceIndex++;}GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriverNode: choice #{choiceIndex} picking index={pick} out of {count}");dialogBox.TrySelectVariant(pick);}/// <summary> Ищет DialogBox через корень дерева: драйвер часто добавляется до появления диалоговой сцены, а каст к контракту ядра избавляет мод от ссылки на конкретную реализацию. </summary>
private IDialogBox FindDialogBox(){var tree=GetTree();if(tree?.Root==null)return null;return tree.Root.FindChild("DialogBox",true,false)as IDialogBox;}/// <summary>Печатает итоговую строку для раннера и завершает процесс (0 — успех, 1 — провал).</summary>
private void Finish(int passed,int failed,string reason){if(finished)return;finished=true;if(dialogsTarget.HasValue)ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);if(reason!=null)GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"DialogAutoDriverNode: {reason}");GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={passed} failed={failed}");GetTree().Quit(failed==0?0:1);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.TestRunner{/// <summary> Точка входа тестового мода: переносит интеграционную обвязку диалогов (tests DialogAutoDriver + SceneSwitcher) в engine-мод. Активируется только при наличии пользовательских флагов <c>--choices=</c> или <c>--timeout=</c> (как <c>OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs()</c>; флаг <c>--scene=</c> мод не читает — навигацией по сценам управляет ядро). При активации создаёт <see cref="DialogAutoDriverNode"/> и добавляет его в корень дерева через deferred-вызов: <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> срабатывает до окончания построения сцены, прямой AddChild в этот момент отклоняется движком, а драйверу всё равно нужно дождаться диалога (та же задержка 0.5с, что у SceneSwitcher.ScheduleDriverAttach). Повторный <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> не должен плодить драйверы — защищено статическим флагом. </summary>
public class TestRunnerInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool driverQueued;/// <summary>Инициализация per-mod не требуется — драйвер ставится на resources-ready.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Разбирает пользовательские аргументы командной строки и при активационном флаге ставит драйвер автопроигрывания в корень дерева. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(driverQueued)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();var hasChoices=args.Any(a=>a.StartsWith("--choices=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal));var hasTimeout=args.Any(a=>a.StartsWith("--timeout=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal));if(!hasChoices&& !hasTimeout)return;var choices=ParseChoices(args);var timeout=ParseTimeout(args);var dialogs=ParseDialogs(args);// Godot. квалифицирован: в dev-компиляции модов (ToolsModCompileTests) в глобальном пространстве имён существует namespace Engine из тестовой сборки, и неквалифицированное имя резолвится в него вместо Godot.Engine.
var root=(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root;if(root==null){GameLogger.Log("TEST","TestRunnerInitializer: tree root not available, driver not attached",LogLevel.Error);return;}driverQueued=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"TestRunnerInitializer: activating dialog auto-driver, choices=[{string.Join(",", choices)}], timeout={timeout?.ToString() ?? "none"}s, dialogs={dialogs?.ToString() ?? "idle"}");// Deferred: сцена ещё строится; драйвер внутри сам выдерживает стартовую паузу и лениво ищет DialogBox, поэтому порядок с загрузкой сцены не важен.
root.CallDeferred("add_child",new DialogAutoDriverNode(choices,timeout,dialogs));}private static List<int>ParseChoices(string[]args){var raw=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--choices=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--choices=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw))return new List<int>();return raw.Split(',').Select(s=>int.TryParse(s.Trim(),out var n)?n:-1).Where(n=>n>=0).ToList();}private static int?ParseDialogs(string[]args){var raw=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--dialogs=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--dialogs=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();return int.TryParse(raw,out var n)&&n>0?n:null;}private static float?ParseTimeout(string[]args){var raw=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--timeout=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--timeout=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();return float.TryParse(raw,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var t)&&t>0?t:null;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.RegularExpressions;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.DialogBase.Tests{/// <summary>Entry point of the GDScript itest; the suite is mounted only with <c>--itest=gdscript</c>.</summary>
public class GdscriptTestInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool queued;public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(queued|| !OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs().Contains("--itest=gdscript"))return;queued=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST","GdscriptTest: activating");(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root?.CallDeferred("add_child",new GdscriptTestDriverNode());}}/// <summary> Checks the GDScript mod pipeline end to end on the suite's own <c>scripts/*.gd</c>: every script with <c>get_name()</c> + <c>run()</c> is a registered scenario action, and every <c>get_condition_name()</c> script is a working condition — <c>gds.is_rain</c> and <c>gds.flag_equals("victory")</c> are evaluated through the same <see cref="ConditionParser"/> scenarios use, against flags that must make them true and false. Prints <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=gdscript</c>. </summary>
public partial class GdscriptTestDriverNode:Node{private const string ResultName="gdscript";private const string SuiteModId="dialog_base__gdscript";private const double TimeoutSeconds=60;private static readonly Regex ReturnedName=new(@"func\s+(get_name|get_condition_name)\s*\(\s*\)\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+""([^""]+)""",RegexOptions.Compiled);private int passed;private int failed;private double elapsed;private bool done;public override void _Process(double delta){if(done)return;elapsed+=delta;if(elapsed>TimeoutSeconds){Check("boot finished in time",false);Finish();return;}if(!Boot.IsReady)return;try{Run();}catch(Exception ex){Check($"no exception ({ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message})",false);}Finish();}private void Run(){var actions=new List<string>();var conditions=new List<string>();foreach(var file in ModManager.Instance.ListFiles(SuiteModId,"scripts").Where(f=>f.EndsWith(".gd",StringComparison.Ordinal))){var text=(ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(SuiteModId,file)??string.Empty).Replace("\r\n","\n");foreach(Match match in ReturnedName.Matches(text)){if(match.Groups[1].Value=="get_condition_name")conditions.Add(match.Groups[2].Value);else if(text.Contains("func run("))actions.Add(match.Groups[2].Value);}}Check($"suite scripts found ({actions.Count} action(s), {conditions.Count} condition(s))",actions.Count>0&&conditions.Count>0);foreach(var name in actions)Check($"action '{name}' registered",ScenarioActionFactory.Instance.Get(name)!=null);Expect("gds.is_rain",new(){["weather"]="rain"},true);Expect("gds.is_rain",new(){["weather"]="sun"},false);Expect("gds.flag_equals(\"victory\")",new(){["custom_flag"]="victory"},true);Expect("gds.flag_equals(\"victory\")",new(){["custom_flag"]="defeat"},false);Expect("gds.is_rain && gds.flag_equals(\"victory\")",new(){["weather"]="rain",["custom_flag"]="victory"},true);}private void Expect(string condition,Dictionary<string,string>flags,bool expected){var node=ConditionParser.Parse(condition);var actual=node!=null&&node.Evaluate(new EvaluationContext{Flags=flags});Check($"'{condition}' with {string.Join(",", flags.Select(f => $"{f.Key}={f.Value}"))} → {expected}"+(actual==expected?string.Empty:$" (got {actual})"),actual==expected);}private void Check(string what,bool ok){if(ok)passed++;else failed++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"  [{(ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL")}] {what}");}private void Finish(){done=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={passed} failed={failed}");GetTree().Quit(failed==0?0:1);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action.Impls;using Godot;/// <summary> <see cref="ActionAnimatedForeground"/> really animates: frames are cut on the ViewBox foreground while the dialog goes on, a one-shot animation stops on its last frame, and a looping one stops when the dialog ends. </summary>
public class ActionAnimatedForegroundTests{[ModTest("animation/one_shot_reaches_last_frame",TimeoutSeconds=10)]static async Task OneShotReachesLastFrame(ModTestContext ctx){var stage=await DialogStage.Create();var view=stage.AddViewBox();await DialogStage.Frames(1);try{var frames=Frames(3);var anim=new ActionAnimatedForeground{Textures=frames,Speed=20f,NextFrameSpeed=20f,IsLoop=false};var dlg=new DialogQueue();dlg.Queue.Add(anim);dlg.Queue.Add(new ProbeAction());stage.Box.SetDialogQueueAndRun(dlg,null,0,null);ModAssert.True(view.Foreground.Texture==frames[0],"first frame is shown at once");ModAssert.True(anim.IsAnimating,"animation outlives its NoWait action");await DialogStage.Seconds(0.6);ModAssert.True(view.Foreground.Texture==frames[2],"animation reached the last frame");ModAssert.False(anim.IsAnimating,"one-shot animation stopped");}finally{stage.Free();}}[ModTest("animation/loop_stops_with_dialog_end",TimeoutSeconds=10)]static async Task LoopStopsWithDialogEnd(ModTestContext ctx){var stage=await DialogStage.Create();var view=stage.AddViewBox();await DialogStage.Frames(1);try{var frames=Frames(2);var anim=new ActionAnimatedForeground{Textures=frames,Speed=20f,NextFrameSpeed=20f,IsLoop=true};var dlg=new DialogQueue();dlg.Queue.Add(anim);dlg.Queue.Add(new ProbeAction());stage.Box.SetDialogQueueAndRun(dlg,null,0,null);await DialogStage.Seconds(0.3);ModAssert.True(anim.IsAnimating,"looping animation keeps playing while the dialog waits");stage.Box.NextAction();ModAssert.False(anim.IsAnimating,"dialog end stops the animation");var shown=view.Foreground.Texture;await DialogStage.Seconds(0.3);ModAssert.True(view.Foreground.Texture==shown,"no frame is cut after the dialog ended");}finally{stage.Free();}}private static List<Texture2D>Frames(int count){var list=new List<Texture2D>();for(var i=0;i<count;i++)list.Add(ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(Image.CreateEmpty(2,2,false,Image.Format.Rgba8)));return list;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;/// <summary> Records every <see cref="DialogEndedEvent"/> published on the mod event bus between <see cref="Start"/> and <see cref="Stop"/> — the locker id of each, in publication order. public class DialogEndRecorder{/// <summary>Locker ids of the recorded events (null for a locker-less dialog).</summary>
public List<string>LockerIds{get;}=new();/// <summary>Subscribes to the event bus.</summary>
public void Start(){ModEventBus.Subscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);}/// <summary>Unsubscribes; call it in <c>finally</c> so a failed test leaves no handler behind.</summary>
public void Stop(){ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<DialogEndedEvent>(OnDialogEnded);}private void OnDialogEnded(DialogEndedEvent evt){LockerIds.Add(evt.LockerId);}}}
