namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;using Godot;/// <summary> A minimal live dialog stage for mod tests: a host Control under <c>/root</c> with the real <c>dialog_box.tscn</c> prefab (named <c>DialogBox</c>, so <see cref="SceneContextNode.FindNode{T}"/> and the event classes find it like in a scene) and, on request, a bare <see cref="ViewBox"/> with a foreground slot. The scene-context lookup cache is cleared on build and on <see cref="Free"/>: it remembers misses, and a test box must be found even if an earlier lookup failed. The host is the box's parent Control — background fades animate it. </summary>
public class DialogStage{/// <summary>Parent of every stage node; freed by <see cref="Free"/>.</summary>
public Control Host{get;private set;}/// <summary>The dialog box built from its prefab.</summary>
public DialogBox Box{get;private set;}/// <summary>The view box, after <see cref="AddViewBox"/>.</summary>
public ViewBox View{get;private set;}/// <summary>The running scene tree.</summary>
public static SceneTree Tree=>(SceneTree)Engine.GetMainLoop();/// <summary>Builds the host and the dialog box and waits a frame for their <c>_Ready</c>.</summary>
public static async Task<DialogStage>Create(){SceneContextNode.Instance?.ClearData();var stage=new DialogStage{Host=new Control{Name="DialogTestHost"}};Tree.Root.AddChild(stage.Host);stage.Box=new ModScenePrefab("scenes/ui/dialog_box.tscn").Instantiate<DialogBox>();ModAssert.NotNull(stage.Box,"dialog_box.tscn builds a DialogBox");stage.Box.Name="DialogBox";stage.Host.AddChild(stage.Box);await Frames(1);return stage;}/// <summary>Adds a <see cref="ViewBox"/> named <c>ViewBox</c> with a <c>Foreground</c> TextureRect.</summary>
public ViewBox AddViewBox(){View=new ViewBox{Name="ViewBox"};View.AddChild(new TextureRect{Name="Foreground"});Host.AddChild(View);SceneContextNode.Instance?.ClearData();return View;}/// <summary>Removes the stage from the tree and forgets cached lookups of its nodes.</summary>
public void Free(){if(Box!=null&&Box.IsRunning)Box.Abort();if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(Host)){Tree.Root.RemoveChild(Host);Host.QueueFree();}SceneContextNode.Instance?.ClearData();}/// <summary>Waits <paramref name="count"/> process frames (deferred calls run at the end of each).</summary>
public static async Task Frames(int count){for(var i=0;i<count;i++)await Tree.ToSignal(Tree,SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);}/// <summary>Waits <paramref name="seconds"/> of game time.</summary>
public static async Task Seconds(double seconds){await Tree.ToSignal(Tree.CreateTimer(seconds),SceneTreeTimer.SignalName.Timeout);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Executable;/// <summary> A standalone <see cref="ExecutableEvent"/> (not inside a chain): a run the dialog box refused is not counted, and the event starts by itself on the next state change, without polling. </summary>
public class ExecutableEventTests{[ModTest("event/refused_run_is_not_counted",TimeoutSeconds=10)]static async Task RefusedRunIsNotCounted(ModTestContext ctx){var stage=await DialogStage.Create();try{stage.Box.IsActive=false;var evt=new ScenarioEvent{ScenarioText="text \"S\"",ScenarioId="dialog_base_test_standalone",IsOneRun=true};stage.Host.AddChild(evt);await DialogStage.Frames(2);ModAssert.False(stage.Box.IsRunning,"inactive box refused the event");ModAssert.True(evt.IsFirstRun,"refused automatic run is not counted");ModAssert.False(evt.RunDialog(),"direct run is refused too");ModAssert.True(evt.IsFirstRun,"refused direct run is not counted");stage.Box.IsActive=true;ConditionStateMonitor.MarkStateChanged();await DialogStage.Frames(2);ModAssert.True(stage.Box.Locker==evt,"one-run event starts on the next state change");ModAssert.False(evt.IsFirstRun,"the real run is counted");}finally{stage.Free();}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Executable;/// <summary> <see cref="ExecutableMainEventChain"/> is event-driven and loop-safe: the next event starts within a couple of frames after a dialog ends (no polling delay), two repeatable events do not ping-pong while the state stays the same, and a state change makes them eligible again. </summary>
public class ExecutableMainEventChainTests{[ModTest("chain/push_start_and_no_ping_pong",TimeoutSeconds=15)]static async Task PushStartAndNoPingPong(ModTestContext ctx){var stage=await DialogStage.Create();try{var chain=new ExecutableMainEventChain{Name="TestChain"};stage.Host.AddChild(chain);var a=new ScenarioEvent{ScenarioText="text \"A\"",ScenarioId="dialog_base_test_chain_a"};var b=new ScenarioEvent{ScenarioText="text \"B\"",ScenarioId="dialog_base_test_chain_b"};chain.AddEvent(a);chain.AddEvent(b);await DialogStage.Frames(2);ModAssert.True(stage.Box.Locker==a,"first event starts right after it was added");stage.Box.NextAction();await DialogStage.Frames(2);ModAssert.True(stage.Box.Locker==b,"second event starts within two frames after the first ended");stage.Box.NextAction();await DialogStage.Frames(4);ModAssert.False(stage.Box.IsRunning,"no event re-runs while the state did not change");ConditionStateMonitor.MarkStateChanged();await DialogStage.Frames(2);ModAssert.True(stage.Box.Locker==a,"a state change makes the first event eligible again");}finally{stage.Free();}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;/// <summary> Update listener for <see cref="SceneEventController"/> tests: appends its <see cref="Name"/> to a shared <see cref="Log"/> on every update and may change the controller's listener list from inside the callback — remove <see cref="RemoveOnUpdate"/>, add <see cref="AddOnUpdate"/> — to check how a dispatch copes with a list changed under it. </summary>
public class OrderListener:IOnUpdateEvent{/// <summary>Name written to <see cref="Log"/>.</summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Dispatch priority.</summary>
public int Priority{get;set;}/// <summary>Shared call log.</summary>
public List<string>Log{get;set;}/// <summary>Controller whose list the callback changes.</summary>
public SceneEventController Controller{get;set;}/// <summary>Listener to unregister during the update, if any.</summary>
public IOnUpdateEvent RemoveOnUpdate{get;set;}/// <summary>Listener to register during the update, if any.</summary>
public IOnUpdateEvent AddOnUpdate{get;set;}/// <summary>Logs the call and applies the requested list changes once.</summary>
public void OnUpdate(){Log.Add(Name);if(RemoveOnUpdate!=null){Controller.RemoveUpdateEventListener(RemoveOnUpdate);RemoveOnUpdate=null;}if(AddOnUpdate!=null){Controller.AddUpdateEventListener(AddOnUpdate);AddOnUpdate=null;}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;/// <summary> Test action that only counts its lifecycle calls: how often the runtime ran, constructed and destructed it. Waits for a click by default, so a test can park the dialog on it and look at where the runtime stands. </summary>
public class ProbeAction:ActionCommand{/// <summary>Number of <see cref="DoRun"/> calls.</summary>
public int Runs{get;private set;}/// <summary>Number of <see cref="DoConstruct"/> calls.</summary>
public int Constructs{get;private set;}/// <summary>Number of <see cref="DoDestruct"/> calls.</summary>
public int Destructs{get;private set;}/// <summary>Counts the run.</summary>
public override void DoRun(DialogRuntime runtime){Runs++;}/// <summary>Counts the construction.</summary>
public override void DoConstruct(){Constructs++;}/// <summary>Counts the destruction.</summary>
public override void DoDestruct(){Destructs++;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;/// <summary> Dispatch contract of the core <see cref="SceneEventController"/> (tested here: it is a Godot node, xUnit cannot create it; the dialog actions are its main listeners): lower priority first, registration order within a priority, and a listener list changed during a dispatch neither skips nor double-calls anyone. </summary>
public class SceneEventControllerTests{[ModTest("event_controller/lower_priority_first_then_registration_order")]static void LowerPriorityFirst(ModTestContext ctx){var log=new List<string>();var controller=new SceneEventController();try{controller.AddUpdateEventListener(new OrderListener{Name="b",Priority=1,Log=log});controller.AddUpdateEventListener(new OrderListener{Name="a",Priority=0,Log=log});controller.AddUpdateEventListener(new OrderListener{Name="c",Priority=1,Log=log});controller._Process(0.0);ModAssert.Equal("a,b,c",string.Join(",",log),"dispatch order");}finally{controller.Free();}}[ModTest("event_controller/list_changed_during_dispatch")]static void ListChangedDuringDispatch(ModTestContext ctx){var log=new List<string>();var controller=new SceneEventController();try{var removed=new OrderListener{Name="removed",Priority=1,Log=log};var added=new OrderListener{Name="added",Priority=0,Log=log};var changer=new OrderListener{Name="changer",Priority=0,Log=log,Controller=controller,RemoveOnUpdate=removed,AddOnUpdate=added,};var last=new OrderListener{Name="last",Priority=2,Log=log};controller.AddUpdateEventListener(changer);controller.AddUpdateEventListener(removed);controller.AddUpdateEventListener(last);controller._Process(0.0);ModAssert.Equal("changer,last",string.Join(",",log),"first dispatch: removed one skipped, added one waits");log.Clear();controller._Process(0.0);ModAssert.Equal("changer,added,last",string.Join(",",log),"second dispatch includes the added listener");}finally{controller.Free();}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Common{/// <summary> Base of the editors that place things over a scene background (map zones, interactive colliders, lights). Draws the background with the same aspect-preserving "fit" layout the game uses and converts between canvas pixels and the normalised [0..1] coordinates stored in the data. Getting this rectangle wrong is what made saved positions drift: the data means "fraction of the background", not "fraction of the panel". <para/> Subclasses paint their overlay in <see cref="DrawContent"/> and rebuild their <see cref="DragHandle"/>s in <see cref="RebuildHandles"/>, which is also called whenever the canvas is resized or the background changes. </summary>
public abstract partial class BackgroundCanvas:Control{private static readonly Vector2 FallbackSize=new(1920,1024);/// <summary>Live handles of the current selection.</summary>
protected readonly List<DragHandle>_handles=new();/// <summary>Reference background; <c>null</c> draws a flat placeholder.</summary>
public Texture2D Background{get;private set;}protected BackgroundCanvas(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;ClipContents=true;Resized+=OnResized;Connect("draw",Callable.From((Action)DrawAll));}/// <summary>Assigns the background texture and relayouts handles.</summary>
public void SetBackground(Texture2D texture){Background=texture;RebuildHandles();QueueRedraw();}/// <summary>Recreates the handles from the current selection.</summary>
public abstract void RebuildHandles();/// <summary>Paints the overlay above the background inside <paramref name="rect"/>.</summary>
protected abstract void DrawContent(Rect2 rect);/// <summary> Aspect-preserving rectangle the background occupies inside the canvas — identical to the runtime "fit" layout. </summary>

using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Common{/// <summary> Round draggable point used by every canvas editor (polygon vertices, rect corners, markers, lights). It is a small Control placed over its canvas: the left button drags it and reports the new centre in global coordinates, the right button reports a delete request. Input arrives through the <c>GuiInput</c> event and drawing through the <c>draw</c> signal — the forms that dispatch reliably for mod assemblies. <para/> <see cref="Index"/> is free for the owner: a vertex index or a negative role constant (marker, label, rect corner...). </summary>
public partial class DragHandle:Control{/// <summary>Owner-defined identity of the handle.</summary>
public int Index;/// <summary>Called while dragging with the handle centre in global coordinates.</summary>
public Action<Vector2>DragUpdate;/// <summary>Called on left press.</summary>
public Action Clicked;/// <summary>Called on left release after a press.</summary>
public Action DragEnd;/// <summary>Called on right press.</summary>
public Action RightClicked;private readonly Color _fill;private bool _dragging;private bool _hovered;private Vector2 _dragOffset;/// <summary>Creates a handle of the given fill colour, role index and diameter.</summary>
public DragHandle(Color fill,int index,float diameter=14f){_fill=fill;Index=index;Size=new Vector2(diameter,diameter);MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;MouseDefaultCursorShape=CursorShape.Drag;GuiInput+=OnGuiInput;MouseEntered+=()=>{_hovered=true;QueueRedraw();};MouseExited+=()=>{_hovered=false;QueueRedraw();};Connect("draw",Callable.From((Action)Paint));}/// <summary>Places the handle so that its centre sits at <paramref name="globalCenter"/>; call after it is in the tree.</summary>
public void CenterAt(Vector2 globalCenter){GlobalPosition=globalCenter-Size/2f;}private void Paint(){var center=Size/2f;var radius=Size.X/2f-1f;DrawCircle(center,radius,UiTokens.Surface0);DrawCircle(center,radius-2f,_fill);DrawArc(center,radius,0f,Mathf.Tau,24,_hovered||_dragging?UiTokens.AccentHover:UiTokens.Ink,1.5f,true);}private void OnGuiInput(InputEvent@event){if(@event is InputEventMouseButton mb){if(mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left){if(mb.Pressed){_dragging=true;_dragOffset=GetGlobalMousePosition()-GlobalPosition;Clicked?.Invoke();}else if(_dragging){_dragging=false;DragEnd?.Invoke();}AcceptEvent();}else if(mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Right&&mb.Pressed){RightClicked?.Invoke();AcceptEvent();}}else if(@event is InputEventMouseMotion&&_dragging){GlobalPosition=GetGlobalMousePosition()-_dragOffset;DragUpdate?.Invoke(GlobalPosition+Size/2f);AcceptEvent();}}}}

public string SelectedId=>_selectedId;/// <summary>Creates the list; <paramref name="minHeight"/> is the list part's minimum height.</summary>
public FilteredList(float minHeight=140f,string placeholderKey="tools/common/search"){AddThemeConstantOverride("separation",UiTokens.Space1);_search=new LineEdit{PlaceholderText=TranslationServer.Translate(placeholderKey),ClearButtonEnabled=true};_search.TextChanged+=_=>Rebuild();AddChild(_search);_list=new ItemList{CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(0,minHeight),SizeFlagsVertical=SizeFlags.ExpandFill,AllowReselect=true};_list.ItemSelected+=OnItemSelected;_list.ItemActivated+=index=>Activated?.Invoke(IdAt((int)index));AddChild(_list);}/// <summary>Turns rows into an icon grid of <paramref name="iconSize"/> px thumbnails.</summary>

using System;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Tools.Common;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.InteractiveEditor{/// <summary> Preview of the interactives of one file over a scene background. Every collider is drawn (others faint, the selected one filled), so the author sees how objects of the same scene sit next to each other; clicking a collider selects it. The selected collider gets handles: <list type="bullet"> <item>rect — top-left and bottom-right corners plus a centre handle that moves the whole rect;</item> <item>circle — centre and a radius handle;</item> <item>polygon — one handle per vertex (right-click deletes it); a click on empty background appends a vertex.</item> </list> Geometry is in the same normalised background space as <c>InteractiveObject</c>: x/y/width/height are fractions of the background size, a circle radius is a fraction of its shorter side. </summary>
public partial class InteractiveEditorCanvas:BackgroundCanvas{private const int TopLeft=0;private const int BottomRight=1;private const int Move=2;private const int RadiusHandle=1;private const float MinExtent=0.005f;/// <summary>Data being edited; set once by the window.</summary>
public InteractiveEditorController Controller;/// <summary>Raised whenever geometry of the selected item changes.</summary>
public event Action Changed;/// <summary>Raised when a click on the canvas selects another item (-1: none).</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.InteractiveEditor{/// <summary> Data model of the interactive editor: every definition of one <c>interactives/*.json</c> file plus the selection. Definitions are edited in place (the same objects the game deserialises), so the file round-trips without a parallel field-by-field copy that could forget a property. <see cref="Ensure"/> fills the optional sub-objects the editor needs (hit area, highlight, actions) before a definition is shown. </summary>
public class InteractiveEditorController{/// <summary>Collider kinds understood by <c>InteractiveObject</c>.</summary>
public static readonly string[]HitTypes={"rect","circle","polygon"};/// <summary>Render layers understood by the interactive layer host.</summary>
public static readonly string[]Layers={"foreground","background","ui"};/// <summary>Definitions of the open file, in file order.</summary>
public List<InteractiveDefinition>Items{get;private set;}=new();/// <summary>Index of the selected definition, or -1.</summary>
public int SelectedIndex{get;private set;}= -1;/// <summary>The selected definition, or <c>null</c>.</summary>
public InteractiveDefinition Selected=>SelectedIndex>=0&&SelectedIndex<Items.Count?Items[SelectedIndex]:null;/// <summary>Replaces the items with the contents of a <c>{"Items": [...]}</c> file. Throws on malformed JSON.</summary>
public void FromJson(string json){var data=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)?null:JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<InteractiveDefinition>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);Items=data?.Items??new List<InteractiveDefinition>();foreach(var item in Items)Ensure(item);SelectedIndex=Items.Count>0?0:-1;}/// <summary>Serialises all items into the standard envelope (indented, nulls omitted).</summary>
public string ToJson(){var data=new FileData<InteractiveDefinition>{Items=Items};return JsonSerializer.Serialize(data,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);}/// <summary>Drops all items.</summary>
public void Clear(){Items=new List<InteractiveDefinition>();SelectedIndex= -1;}/// <summary>Selects by index; out of range clears the selection.</summary>
public void Select(int index){SelectedIndex=index>=0&&index<Items.Count?index:-1;}/// <summary>Appends a new clickable rect in the middle of the background and selects it.</summary>
public InteractiveDefinition Add(){var def=new InteractiveDefinition{ID=MakeUniqueId("interactive"),Cursor="PointingHand",HitArea=new HitAreaDefinition{Type="rect",X=0.45f,Y=0.45f,Width=0.1f,Height=0.1f}};Ensure(def);Items.Add(def);SelectedIndex=Items.Count-1;return def;}/// <summary>Appends a deep copy of the selected definition with a fresh ID, slightly offset.</summary>
public InteractiveDefinition DuplicateSelected(){var source=Selected;if(source==null)return null;var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(source,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);var copy=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<InteractiveDefinition>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);copy.ID=MakeUniqueId(source.ID);Ensure(copy);Offset(copy.HitArea,new Vector2(0.02f,0.02f));Items.Add(copy);SelectedIndex=Items.Count-1;return copy;}/// <summary>Removes the selected definition and keeps a sensible selection.</summary>
public void RemoveSelected(){if(Selected==null)return;Items.RemoveAt(SelectedIndex);SelectedIndex=Items.Count==0? -1:Math.Min(SelectedIndex,Items.Count-1);}/// <summary> Changes the collider kind of a definition, converting the current shape so it stays roughly where it was (rect ↔ circle by bounds, polygon from the bounds' corners). </summary>
public static void SetHitType(InteractiveDefinition def,string type){var hit=def.HitArea;if(hit.Type==type)return;var bounds=Bounds(hit);hit.Type=type;switch(type){case"circle":hit.X=bounds.GetCenter().X;hit.Y=bounds.GetCenter().Y;hit.Radius=Mathf.Max(0.01f,Mathf.Min(bounds.Size.X,bounds.Size.Y)/2f);break;case"polygon":hit.Vertices=new[]{bounds.Position,new Vector2(bounds.End.X,bounds.Position.Y),bounds.End,new Vector2(bounds.Position.X,bounds.End.Y)};break;default:hit.X=bounds.Position.X;hit.Y=bounds.Position.Y;hit.Width=bounds.Size.X;hit.Height=bounds.Size.Y;break;}}/// <summary> Normalised bounding box of a hit area (circle radius taken as a fraction of both axes — an approximation good enough for conversions and duplication offsets). </summary>
public static Rect2 Bounds(HitAreaDefinition hit){switch(hit?.Type){case"circle":return new Rect2(hit.X-hit.Radius,hit.Y-hit.Radius,hit.Radius*2f,hit.Radius*2f);case"polygon"when hit.Vertices is{Length:>0}:var min=hit.Vertices[0];var max=hit.Vertices[0];foreach(var v in hit.Vertices){min=new Vector2(Mathf.Min(min.X,v.X),Mathf.Min(min.Y,v.Y));max=new Vector2(Mathf.Max(max.X,v.X),Mathf.Max(max.Y,v.Y));}return new Rect2(min,max-min);case null:return new Rect2(0.45f,0.45f,0.1f,0.1f);default:return new Rect2(hit.X,hit.Y,hit.Width,hit.Height);}}/// <summary>Makes sure the optional parts the editor binds to exist.</summary>
public static void Ensure(InteractiveDefinition def){def.HitArea??=new HitAreaDefinition();def.HitArea.Type=HitTypes.Contains(def.HitArea.Type)?def.HitArea.Type:"rect";def.Highlight??=new HighlightDefinition();def.Actions??=new InteractiveActionDefinition();}/// <summary>ID not used by another item: <c>base</c>, <c>base_2</c>, <c>base_3</c>…</summary>
public string MakeUniqueId(string baseId){var used=new HashSet<string>(Items.Select(i=>i.ID??string.Empty),StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);if(!used.Contains(baseId))return baseId;var suffix=2;while(used.Contains($"{baseId}_{suffix}"))suffix++;return$"{baseId}_{suffix}";}private static void Offset(HitAreaDefinition hit,Vector2 delta){hit.X+=delta.X;hit.Y+=delta.Y;if(hit.Vertices!=null)hit.Vertices=hit.Vertices.Select(v=>v+delta).ToArray();}}}

using Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Tool;namespace Cthangover.Tools.InteractiveEditor{/// <summary> Registers the interactive editor as a tool window in the developer toolbox. public class InteractiveEditorToolProvider:IToolProvider{/// <summary>Unique tool identifier referenced by the toolbox UI.</summary>
public string Id=>"interactive_editor";/// <summary>Translation key for the tool's display name.</summary>
public string LocaleKey=>"tools/interactive_editor/title";/// <summary>Creates the editor window instance.</summary>
public Window CreateWindow()=>new InteractiveEditorWindow();/// <summary>Adds the interactive editor's launcher button to the main menu tool block.</summary>
public void AddMenuButton(Container container)=>ToolMenuButton.Attach(container,this);}/// <summary> Provides a button in the developer toolbox that opens the interactive editor. Controls visibility via the <see cref="IsVisible"/> policy. </summary>
public class InteractiveEditorToolBoxButton:IToolBoxButton{/// <summary>Matches <see cref="InteractiveEditorToolProvider.Id"/>.</summary>
public string ToolId=>"interactive_editor";/// <summary>No custom icon — uses the tool title text.</summary>
public string IconPath=>"";/// <summary>Translation key for the button label.</summary>
public string LocaleKey=>"tools/interactive_editor/title";/// <summary>Always visible in the toolbox.</summary>
public bool IsVisible()=>true;}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Tools.Common;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.LightEditor{/// <summary> Night-time preview of a scene with its static lights. The background is drawn through the game's <c>timed_sprite</c> shader (set as this control's material), so the preview lights the picture exactly like the game; the lights' positions are pushed to the shader in this canvas' coordinates and their radii scaled from the 1920-px game width to the drawn background width. public partial class LightEditorCanvas:BackgroundCanvas{private readonly Control _overlay;/// <summary>Data being edited; set once by the window.</summary>
public LightEditorController Controller;/// <summary>Preview material (may be null when the shader is missing).</summary>
public ShaderMaterial PreviewMaterial{get=>Material as ShaderMaterial;set=>Material=value;}/// <summary>Raised when a light moved or was added on the canvas.</summary>
public event Action Changed;/// <summary>Raised when the selection changed on the canvas.</summary>
public event Action SelectionChanged;public LightEditorCanvas(){_overlay=new Control{MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore};AddChild(_overlay);_overlay.SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(LayoutPreset.FullRect);_overlay.Connect("draw",Callable.From((Action)DrawRings));GuiInput+=OnGuiInput;}/// <summary>One handle per light, coloured like the light.</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Time;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.LightEditor{/// <summary> Data of the light editor: the static lights of one scenario and their place in the scenario text. Static lights live in a <c>light_set</c> line (<c>light_set [{"x":…,"y":…,"radius":…,"influence":…,"color":…}]</c>) that <c>UiLightController.SetStaticLights</c> reads at runtime: x/y are fractions of the viewport, radius is in viewport pixels at the game resolution. The controller parses that line, edits the list and writes the line back (or inserts one right after the scenario header), and feeds the <c>timed_sprite</c> shader of the preview the same way the game does, so the preview shows the real night lighting. </summary>
public class LightEditorController{/// <summary>Static light slots the shader has (slot 0 is the dynamic light).</summary>
public const int MaxLights=10;/// <summary>Viewport width the stored radii refer to.</summary>
public const float GameWidth=1920f;private const string Command="light_set";private const int ShaderSlots=11;private static readonly Vector2 Offscreen=new(-1000f,-1000f);/// <summary>The edited lights, in file order.</summary>
public List<LightDef>Lights{get;private set;}=new();/// <summary>Index of the selected light, or -1.</summary>
public int SelectedIndex{get;private set;}= -1;/// <summary>The selected light, or <c>null</c>.</summary>
public LightDef Selected=>SelectedIndex>=0&&SelectedIndex<Lights.Count?Lights[SelectedIndex]:null;/// <summary>Selects by index; out of range clears the selection.</summary>
public void Select(int index)=>SelectedIndex=index>=0&&index<Lights.Count?index:-1;/// <summary>Adds a warm light at the given normalised point and selects it; null when all slots are used.</summary>
public LightDef Add(Vector2 position){if(Lights.Count>=MaxLights)return null;var light=new LightDef{X=position.X,Y=position.Y,Radius=400f,Influence=1f,ColorHex="#ffcc66"};Lights.Add(light);SelectedIndex=Lights.Count-1;return light;}/// <summary>Removes the selected light.</summary>
public void RemoveSelected(){if(Selected==null)return;Lights.RemoveAt(SelectedIndex);SelectedIndex=Math.Min(SelectedIndex,Lights.Count-1);}/// <summary>Compact JSON array exactly as written into the <c>light_set</c> line.</summary>
public string ToJson()=>JsonSerializer.Serialize(Lights,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteCompactOptions);/// <summary>The scenario line for the current lights.</summary>
public string ToScenarioLine()=>Command+" "+ToJson();/// <summary> Loads the lights of the first <c>light_set</c> line of a scenario. Returns <c>false</c> when the scenario has none (the list is then empty and saving inserts a new line). Throws on malformed JSON. </summary>
public bool LoadFromScenario(string text){Lights=new List<LightDef>();SelectedIndex= -1;var index=FindLine(text,out var lines);if(index<0)return false;var json=ArgumentOf(lines[index]);Lights=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<LightDef>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions)??new List<LightDef>();SelectedIndex=Lights.Count>0?0:-1;return true;}/// <summary> Returns the scenario text with its <c>light_set</c> line replaced by the current lights, or — when it has none — with a new line inserted right after the <c>---</c> header separator (at the top otherwise). </summary>
public string WriteToScenario(string text){var index=FindLine(text,out var lines);var newline=text.Contains("\r\n")?"\r\n":"\n";if(index>=0){var indent=lines[index].Substring(0,lines[index].Length-lines[index].TrimStart().Length);lines[index]=indent+ToScenarioLine();}else{var separator=lines.FindIndex(l=>l.Trim()=="---");lines.Insert(separator+1,ToScenarioLine());}return string.Join(newline,lines);}/// <summary>True when the scenario text contains a <c>light_set</c> line.</summary>
public static bool HasLights(string text)=>FindLine(text,out _)>=0;private static int FindLine(string text,out List<string>lines){lines=new List<string>((text??string.Empty).Replace("\r\n","\n").Split('\n'));return lines.FindIndex(l=>l.TrimStart().StartsWith(Command+" ",StringComparison.Ordinal));}/// <summary>Argument of a <c>light_set</c> line; the old quoted form (<c>"[{\"x\":…}]"</c>) is unescaped.</summary>
private static string ArgumentOf(string line){var arg=line.Trim().Substring(Command.Length).Trim();if(arg.Length>=2&&arg[0]=='"'&&arg[arg.Length-1]=='"')arg=arg.Substring(1,arg.Length-2).Replace("\\\"","\"");return arg;}// ── shader preview ───────────────────────────────────────── <summary> Material of the preview: the game's <c>timed_sprite</c> shader at night weights. <c>null</c> when the shader is not installed. </summary>
public static ShaderMaterial CreatePreviewMaterial(){var shader=Shaders.Resolve("timed_sprite");if(shader==null)return null;var material=new ShaderMaterial{Shader=shader};material.SetShaderParameter("time_weights",new Vector4(0,0,0,1));material.SetShaderParameter("use_time",true);return material;}/// <summary>Binds the background and its optional depth/albedo masks to the preview material.</summary>
public static void SetPreviewTextures(ShaderMaterial material,Texture2D depth,Texture2D albedo){if(material==null)return;material.SetShaderParameter("depth_mask",depth);material.SetShaderParameter("albedo_map",albedo);}/// <summary> Uploads the lights into the shader uniforms. <paramref name="toCanvas"/> maps a normalised position into the preview's canvas coordinates (the space of the shader's <c>world_pos</c>); <paramref name="radiusScale"/> shrinks game-resolution radii to the preview size. </summary>
public void UpdatePreview(ShaderMaterial material,Func<Vector2,Vector2>toCanvas,float radiusScale){if(material==null)return;var positions=new Godot.Collections.Array<Vector2>();var colors=new Godot.Collections.Array<Color>();var radii=new Godot.Collections.Array<float>();var influence=new Godot.Collections.Array<float>();// Slot 0 is the dynamic (cursor) light at runtime; keep it off.
positions.Add(Offscreen);colors.Add(UiTokens.White);radii.Add(0f);influence.Add(0f);var count=Math.Min(Lights.Count,MaxLights);for(var i=0;i<ShaderSlots-1;i++){var on=i<count;positions.Add(on?toCanvas(new Vector2(Lights[i].X,Lights[i].Y)):Offscreen);colors.Add(on?Lights[i].ToColor():UiTokens.White);radii.Add(on?Lights[i].Radius:0f);influence.Add(on?Lights[i].Influence:0f);}material.SetShaderParameter("light_count",count+1);material.SetShaderParameter("light_positions",positions);material.SetShaderParameter("light_colors",colors);material.SetShaderParameter("light_radii",radii);material.SetShaderParameter("light_influence",influence);material.SetShaderParameter("light_radius_scale",radiusScale);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Mods.Map;using Cthangover.Tools.Common;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.MapEditor{/// <summary> Interactive preview of the edited map: the background (laid out by <see cref="BackgroundCanvas"/> exactly like <c>MapWidget</c>), every zone polygon, marker and text label, and the draggable handles of the selected zone. public void SetMode(string mode){Mode=mode==ModeDraw?ModeDraw:ModeSelect;MouseDefaultCursorShape=Mode==ModeDraw?CursorShape.Cross:CursorShape.Arrow;RebuildHandles();QueueRedraw();}/// <summary>Leaves draw mode (double-click, Enter, Esc) and tells the window.</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Map;using Cthangover.Tools.Services;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.MapEditor{/// <summary> Data model for the map editor. Holds the zone list being edited, the current selection and all structural operations (add/remove zone, add/remove/move vertex, move marker and label, toggle label mode). Contains no UI and no runtime state: it edits raw authoring data that <see cref="MapFileService"/> serialises back into <c>mods/&lt;mod&gt;/map/*.json</c>, while the live game state belongs to <c>MapZoneService</c>. <para/> New zones get unique IDs automatically and a sensible default shape (a small square for regions, centre position for markers and labels), so an author can place an element first and refine it afterwards. All coordinates are normalised [0..1] and clamped by the canvas, not here. </summary>
public class MapEditorController{private const float DefaultRegionHalfSize=0.06f;private static readonly Vector2 DefaultCenter=new(0.5f,0.5f);/// <summary>Zones currently being edited, in map file order.</summary>
public List<MapZone>Zones{get;private set;}=new();/// <summary>Index of the selected zone, or -1 when nothing is selected.</summary>
public int SelectedIndex{get;private set;}= -1;/// <summary>The selected zone, or <c>null</c> when the selection is empty.</summary>
public MapZone Selected=>SelectedIndex>=0&&SelectedIndex<Zones.Count?Zones[SelectedIndex]:null;/// <summary>Replaces all zones with the contents of a map file JSON envelope.</summary>
public void FromJson(string json){Zones=MapFileService.ParseZones(json);SelectedIndex=Zones.Count>0?0:-1;}/// <summary>Serialises the current zone list into the map file JSON envelope.</summary>
public string ToJson()=>MapFileService.BuildJson(Zones);/// <summary>Drops all zones and the selection.</summary>
public void Clear(){Zones.Clear();SelectedIndex= -1;}/// <summary>Creates a rectangular region around the map centre and selects it.</summary>
public MapZone AddRegion(){var zone=new MapZone{ID=MakeUniqueId("region"),Title=string.Empty,Points=new List<Vector2>{DefaultCenter+new Vector2(-DefaultRegionHalfSize,-DefaultRegionHalfSize),DefaultCenter+new Vector2(DefaultRegionHalfSize,-DefaultRegionHalfSize),DefaultCenter+new Vector2(DefaultRegionHalfSize,DefaultRegionHalfSize),DefaultCenter+new Vector2(-DefaultRegionHalfSize,DefaultRegionHalfSize),},};return Append(zone);}/// <summary> Creates a region without vertices and selects it — the start of drawing a polygon point by point on the canvas. </summary>
public MapZone StartRegion(){var zone=new MapZone{ID=MakeUniqueId("region"),Title=string.Empty,Points=new List<Vector2>(),};return Append(zone);}/// <summary> Creates an icon marker at the map centre with no icon chosen yet and selects it. The author assigns <c>image</c> and <c>scene</c> in the sidebar. </summary>
public MapZone AddMarker(){var zone=new MapZone{ID=MakeUniqueId("marker"),Title=string.Empty,ImagePos=DefaultCenter,};return Append(zone);}/// <summary> Creates a free-standing text label at the map centre and selects it. The label exists as soon as <c>label_pos</c> is set; <c>MapWidget</c> draws zones without an icon as inscriptions. </summary>
public MapZone AddLabel(){var zone=new MapZone{ID=MakeUniqueId("label"),Title=string.Empty,LabelPos=DefaultCenter,};return Append(zone);}/// <summary>Removes the zone at the given index and adjusts the selection.</summary>
public void RemoveAt(int index){if(index<0||index>=Zones.Count)return;Zones.RemoveAt(index);if(Zones.Count==0)SelectedIndex= -1;else if(SelectedIndex>index)SelectedIndex--;else if(SelectedIndex==index)SelectedIndex=Math.Min(index,Zones.Count-1);}/// <summary>Selects the zone at the given index; out-of-range clears the selection.</summary>
public void Select(int index){SelectedIndex=index>=0&&index<Zones.Count?index:-1;}/// <summary>Appends a vertex to the selected region's polygon.</summary>
public void AddVertex(Vector2 normalized){var zone=Selected;if(zone==null)return;zone.Points??=new List<Vector2>();zone.Points.Add(normalized);}/// <summary>Moves one vertex of the selected region.</summary>
public void SetVertex(int index,Vector2 normalized){var zone=Selected;if(zone?.Points==null||index<0||index>=zone.Points.Count)return;zone.Points[index]=normalized;}/// <summary>Removes one vertex of the selected region.</summary>
public void RemoveVertex(int index){var zone=Selected;if(zone?.Points==null||index<0||index>=zone.Points.Count)return;zone.Points.RemoveAt(index);}/// <summary>Moves the icon marker of the selected zone.</summary>
public void SetImagePos(Vector2 normalized){var zone=Selected;if(zone!=null)zone.ImagePos=normalized;}/// <summary>Moves the text label of the selected zone.</summary>
public void SetLabelPos(Vector2 normalized){var zone=Selected;if(zone!=null)zone.LabelPos=normalized;}/// <summary> Enables or disables the free-standing label of the selected zone. Enabling without a known position places it at the map centre. </summary>
public void SetLabelEnabled(bool enabled){var zone=Selected;if(zone==null)return;zone.LabelPos=enabled?zone.LabelPos??DefaultCenter:null;}/// <summary>ID set of every zone in the list, for duplicate validation.</summary>
public HashSet<string>UsedIds(){var ids=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var zone in Zones){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(zone.ID))ids.Add(zone.ID);}return ids;}/// <summary> Builds an ID that is not used yet by appending a numeric suffix (<c>region</c>, <c>region_2</c>, <c>region_3</c>, ...). </summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Tools.Services;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.ScenarioEditor{/// <summary> Layered left-to-right layout of the scene graph: a scene's column is its distance (in scene switches) from the start scenes — the <c>start_scene</c> node, or every scene nothing switches to when there is none — so the story reads from left to right. Scenes no start reaches are stacked in one extra column on the right. Inside a column scenes are sorted by name, which keeps the picture stable between rebuilds. </summary>
public static class ScenarioGraphLayout{private const float ColumnWidth=300f;private const float RowHeight=130f;private const float Margin=40f;/// <summary>Canvas position per lower-cased scene name.</summary>
public static Dictionary<string,Vector2>Compute(SceneGraphData data){var names=data.Nodes.Select(n=>n.SceneName.ToLowerInvariant()).Distinct().ToList();var outgoing=names.ToDictionary(n=>n,_=>new List<string>());var incoming=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var edge in data.Edges){var from=edge.FromScene.ToLowerInvariant();var to=edge.ToScene.ToLowerInvariant();if(!outgoing.ContainsKey(from)|| !outgoing.ContainsKey(to)||from==to)continue;outgoing[from].Add(to);incoming.Add(to);}var starts=data.Nodes.Where(n=>n.IsStartScene).Select(n=>n.SceneName.ToLowerInvariant()).ToList();if(starts.Count==0)starts=names.Where(n=> !incoming.Contains(n)).ToList();var depth=new Dictionary<string,int>();var queue=new Queue<string>();foreach(var start in starts){depth[start]=0;queue.Enqueue(start);}while(queue.Count>0){var current=queue.Dequeue();foreach(var next in outgoing[current]){if(depth.ContainsKey(next))continue;depth[next]=depth[current]+1;queue.Enqueue(next);}}var unreachableColumn=depth.Count>0?depth.Values.Max()+1:0;var result=new Dictionary<string,Vector2>();foreach(var column in names.GroupBy(n=>depth.TryGetValue(n,out var d)?d:unreachableColumn).OrderBy(g=>g.Key)){var row=0;foreach(var name in column.OrderBy(n=>n,StringComparer.Ordinal))result[name]=new Vector2(Margin+column.Key*ColumnWidth,Margin+row++ *RowHeight);}return result;}}}

Builds an interactive node hierarchy tree, tracks selection for the highlight overlay, and reads/writes the raw tscn source so the tool can edit and save mod scenes in place. Mod scene listing is sourced from <see cref="TscnSceneResolver.Collect"/> (deduplicated by mod load order), while base scenes come from <see cref="ModScenes.CollectTscnFiles"/>. </summary>

public Node LoadBaseScene(string path,SubViewport viewport){UnloadScene();var packed=GD.Load<PackedScene>(path);if(packed==null)return null;var instance=packed.Instantiate();viewport.AddChild(instance);AttachHighlight(instance);_loadedRoot=instance;return instance;}/// <summary> Loads an empty full-rect <see cref="Control"/> as the preview root, used when no base scene is selected so mod scenes still have a parent. </summary>
public Node LoadEmptyScene(SubViewport viewport){UnloadScene();var root=new Control{Name="EmptyScene"};root.AnchorRight=1f;root.AnchorBottom=1f;viewport.AddChild(root);AttachHighlight(root);_loadedRoot=root;return root;}/// <summary> Builds a mod scene via the runtime tscn pipeline and adds it as a child of the current base root. using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Snapshot of the raw node properties currently stored in a .tscn source text: node address → property key → unparsed literal. The inspector uses it to show what the FILE contains rather than post-layout live values — after Godot lays out a control its position/size reflect computed layout, which previously made anchored nodes look like they had none. Rebuild via <see cref="Build"/> whenever the source text changes. Section addressing matches <see cref="TscnTextSurgery"/> through <see cref="TscnNodeAddressing"/>. </summary>
public class TscnFileProps{private readonly Dictionary<string,Dictionary<string,string>>_nodes=new();/// <summary>Parses tscn source into the snapshot; empty snapshot for null/empty text.</summary>
public static TscnFileProps Build(string text){var result=new TscnFileProps();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return result;Dictionary<string,string>current=null;foreach(var token in new TscnLexer().Tokenize(text)){if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.SectionHeader){current=null;if(token.SectionName=="node"){var path=TscnNodeAddressing.ComputePath(token.SectionAttrs);if(path!=null&& !result._nodes.ContainsKey(path)){current=new Dictionary<string,string>();result._nodes[path]=current;}}}else if(token.Type==TscnTokenType.Property&&current!=null){if(!current.ContainsKey(token.PropertyKey))current[token.PropertyKey]=token.PropertyValue;}}return result;}/// <summary>Raw property literals of one node; null when the section is absent from the file.</summary>
public IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string>GetNodeProperties(string nodePath){return _nodes.TryGetValue(nodePath??"",out var props)?props:null;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes.TscnParsing;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Targeted line edits of raw .tscn source without a full re-serialization: the file is tokenized with <see cref="TscnLexer"/> (which reports 1-based line numbers), the affected <c>[node]</c> sections are located by their Godot address path (via <see cref="TscnNodeAddressing"/>, shared with <see cref="TscnFileProps"/>), and only the involved lines are touched. Everything outside them — comments, blank lines, formatting — survives. Beyond property upsert/removal it can insert a whole new node section right after its parent's block (parent-before-child order is what the runtime builder relies on) and delete a node subtree together with any dangling [connection] entries. Newly inserted properties follow Godot's layout convention (<c>layout_mode</c> → anchors → grow → offsets → rest) so the builder applies them in a valid sequence. </summary>
public static class TscnTextSurgery{/// <summary> Inserts or replaces one property line inside the given node's section. nodePath uses .tscn addressing relative to the scene root ("", "Panel", "Panel/Btn"); "" addresses the root node section itself. public static bool TryRemoveProperty(string text,string nodePath,string key,out string newText){newText=text;if(text==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))return false;var lines=SplitLines(text,out var crlf);var tokens=new TscnLexer().Tokenize(text);var blocks=CollectBlocks(tokens);if(!TryFindBlock(blocks,nodePath,out var block)|| !block.IsNode)return false;foreach(var token in tokens){if(token.Type!=TscnTokenType.Property||token.LineNumber<=block.Start||token.LineNumber>block.End)continue;if(token.PropertyKey!=key)continue;lines.RemoveAt(token.LineNumber-1);newText=JoinLines(lines,crlf);return true;}return false;}/// <summary> Inserts a complete <c>[node]</c> section directly after its parent's block so the runtime builder meets the parent first. parentPath "" adds a child of the scene root (parent="."). Trailing blank lines of each removed range are swallowed to avoid blank-line buildup. Returns false when no matching section exists. </summary>
public static bool TryRemoveNodeSubtree(string text,string nodePath,out string newText){newText=text;if(text==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodePath))return false;var lines=SplitLines(text,out var crlf);var blocks=CollectBlocks(new TscnLexer().Tokenize(text));var subtreePrefix=nodePath+"/";// (startIndex, endExclusiveIndex) removal ranges in descending order later.

using System.Globalization;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.SceneBuilder{/// <summary> Serializes editor-side <see cref="Variant"/> values into .tscn literal syntax accepted by the runtime parser (<c>TscnPropertyParser</c>): floats always carry a decimal point, strings are quoted with Godot escape sequences, composite types use the <c>Type(a, b, ...)</c> constructor form. Returns null for values the text format cannot represent (non-finite floats, unsupported variants) so callers can skip the write-back instead of corrupting the scene file. </summary>
public static class TscnValueFormatter{/// <summary>Formats a Variant as a .tscn property value; null when not representable.</summary>
public static string Format(Variant value){switch(value.VariantType){case Variant.Type.Nil:return"null";case Variant.Type.Bool:return value.AsBool()?"true":"false";case Variant.Type.Int:return value.AsInt64().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);case Variant.Type.Float:return FormatFloat(value.AsDouble());case Variant.Type.String:return Quote(value.AsString());case Variant.Type.Vector2:{var v=value.AsVector2();var x=FormatFloat(v.X);var y=FormatFloat(v.Y);return x==null||y==null?null:$"Vector2({x}, {y})";}case Variant.Type.Color:{var c=value.AsColor();var r=FormatFloat(c.R);var g=FormatFloat(c.G);var b=FormatFloat(c.B);var a=FormatFloat(c.A);return r==null||g==null||b==null||a==null?null:$"Color({r}, {g}, {b}, {a})";}default:return null;}}/// <summary> Formats a float in invariant culture with a guaranteed decimal point ("1" → "1.0"). Values pass through float precision first because every numeric property edited here originates from Godot float properties — that yields the short canonical form ("0.35" instead of the double expansion "0.34999999403953552"). Null for NaN/Infinity. </summary>
public static string FormatFloat(double v){var f=(float)v;if(!float.IsFinite(f))return null;var s=f.ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);if(!s.Contains('.')&& !s.Contains('e')&& !s.Contains('E'))s+=".0";return s;}private static string Quote(string s){var escaped=s.Replace("\\","\\\\").Replace("\"","\\\"").Replace("\n","\\n").Replace("\r","\\r").Replace("\t","\\t");return"\""+escaped+"\"";}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Mods.Map;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> (De)serialisation of world map zone files (<c>mods/&lt;mod&gt;/map/*.json</c>) for the map editor. File access itself goes through <see cref="ModFileService"/>. </summary>
public static class MapFileService{/// <summary>Folder of map zone files inside a mod.</summary>
public const string MapDir="map";/// <summary> Parses the standard <c>{"Items": [...]}</c> envelope into zones. Throws <see cref="JsonException"/> on malformed JSON so the editor can show the error instead of silently opening an empty map. </summary>
public static List<MapZone>ParseZones(string json){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json))return new List<MapZone>();var data=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<MapZone>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return data?.Items??new List<MapZone>();}/// <summary> Serialises zones into the standard envelope with indentation and without null fields, so hand-editing the result stays pleasant and optional properties such as <c>label_pos</c> only appear when used. </summary>
public static string BuildJson(IEnumerable<MapZone>zones){var data=new FileData<MapZone>{Items=zones?.ToList()??new List<MapZone>()};return JsonSerializer.Serialize(data,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Providers;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> File access shared by the editors: listing a mod's files by folder and extension, reading them through the mod provider and writing them back. Reading works for every mod (folder, zip, test-suite subdir), writing only for folder-backed mods — the only ones with a real directory behind them. New files are created under the provider's <c>RootPath</c> because <c>GetFileSystemPath</c> reports <c>null</c> for files that do not exist yet, and an editor must be able to author a brand-new file. </summary>
public static class ModFileService{/// <summary>IDs of every loaded folder-backed (writable) mod, sorted.</summary>
public static List<string>ListWritableMods(){var result=new List<string>();var manager=ModManager.Instance;if(manager?.Mods==null)return result;foreach(var pair in manager.Mods){if(pair.Value?.FileProvider is FolderModFileProvider)result.Add(pair.Key);}result.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return result;}/// <summary>True when the mod is folder-backed, i.e. the editors can save into it.</summary>
public static bool IsWritable(string modId){return!string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId)&&ModManager.Instance.GetMod(modId)?.FileProvider is FolderModFileProvider;}/// <summary> Mod-relative paths of the files under <paramref name="directory"/> (recursively) ending with <paramref name="extension"/>, sorted. </summary>
public static List<string>ListFiles(string modId,string directory,string extension){var result=new List<string>();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return result;Collect(modId,directory,extension,result);result.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return result;}/// <summary>Reads a file through the mod provider; <c>null</c> when missing.</summary>
public static string ReadText(string modId,string relativePath){return ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(modId,relativePath);}/// <summary> Writes a file into a folder-backed mod, creating missing directories. Returns <c>false</c> for zip/virtual mods, unknown mods and empty paths. </summary>
public static bool WriteText(string modId,string relativePath,string text){var absolute=GetWritablePath(modId,relativePath);if(absolute==null)return false;var directory=Path.GetDirectoryName(absolute);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory))Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);File.WriteAllText(absolute,text);return true;}/// <summary> Absolute path a file of a folder-backed mod has (or would have once written); <c>null</c> for read-only mods and empty paths. </summary>
public static string GetWritablePath(string modId,string relativePath){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(relativePath))return null;if(ModManager.Instance.GetMod(modId)?.FileProvider is not FolderModFileProvider provider||string.IsNullOrEmpty(provider.RootPath))return null;return Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(provider.RootPath,relativePath.Replace('\\','/')));}private static void Collect(string modId,string directory,string extension,List<string>result){foreach(var entry in ModManager.Instance.ListFiles(modId,directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){Collect(modId,entry.TrimEnd('/'),extension,result);continue;}if(entry.EndsWith(extension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))result.Add(entry.Replace('\\','/'));}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> Static service for discovering and loading mod background resources. Queries <see cref="Files.Collect"/> for files under <c>"backgrounds"</c>, strips extensions to produce IDs, and loads textures via <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/>. Used by the light editor, interactive editor, and scenario editor to populate background selection lists and render previews. </summary>
public static class ModResourceService{/// <summary> Returns all unique background IDs (filenames without extension) from the <c>"backgrounds"</c> file collection across all installed mods, sorted, without the <c>_albedo</c>/<c>_depth</c> lighting masks. </summary>
public static List<string>GetBackgroundIds(){var ids=new List<string>();var files=Files.Collect("backgrounds");var exts=GetExt();foreach(var kvp in files){var id=kvp.Key;var ext=Path.GetExtension(id);if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id)&&exts.Contains(ext.ToLower())){var cleanId=id.Substring(0,id.LastIndexOf('.'));var bare=cleanId.TrimEnd('_');if(!bare.EndsWith("_albedo")&& !bare.EndsWith("_depth"))ids.Add(cleanId);}}ids.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return ids;}/// <summary>Ids of every sound (group <c>sounds</c>, path without extension): the choices for a scene's ambient.</summary>
public static List<string>GetSoundIds(){var ids=new List<string>();var exts=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var ext in ModConfig.Instance.AudioExtensions)exts.Add(ext);foreach(var id in Files.Collect("sounds").Keys){var ext=Path.GetExtension(id);if(exts.Contains(ext))ids.Add(id.Substring(0,id.Length-ext.Length));}ids.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return ids;}private static HashSet<string>GetExt(){var set=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var ext in ModConfig.Instance.TextureExtensions){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ext))continue;set.Add(ext.ToLower());}return set;}/// <summary> Returns every texture logical name (filename without extension) from all configured texture groups, sorted for stable UI lists. Used by the map editor's marker icon picker: these are exactly the IDs that <c>MapZone.Image</c> accepts, because resolution also keys textures by basename. </summary>
public static List<string>GetTextureIds(){var ids=new List<string>();var textures=Textures.Collect();if(textures==null)return ids;foreach(var kvp in textures)ids.Add(kvp.Key);ids.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return ids;}/// <summary> Texture IDs that make sense as small icons (map markers): every texture except backgrounds and their <c>_depth</c>/<c>_albedo</c> masks. Textures are keyed by file name, so backgrounds are excluded by the file-name part of their IDs. </summary>
public static List<string>GetIconIds(){var backgrounds=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var id in GetBackgroundIds())backgrounds.Add(id.Substring(id.LastIndexOf('/')+1));var result=new List<string>();foreach(var id in GetTextureIds()){if(backgrounds.Contains(id)||id.EndsWith("_depth",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||id.EndsWith("_albedo",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;result.Add(id);}return result;}/// <summary> Loads a background texture by ID via <see cref="BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get"/>. Returns <c>null</c> on any error (missing resource, load failure). </summary>
public static Texture2D LoadBackgroundTexture(string id){try{return BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(id);}catch{return null;}}}}

public static List<ModScenarioTree>ScanScenarioFiles(){var result=new List<ModScenarioTree>();var manager=ModManager.Instance;foreach(var mod in manager.Mods.Values.OrderBy(m=>m.Id,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){var files=new List<ScenarioFileInfo>();CollectScenarioFiles(manager,mod.Id,ScenariosDir,files);if(files.Count==0)continue;var groups=files.GroupBy(f=>f.RelativeDir).OrderBy(g=>g.Key,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Select(g=>new ScenarioGroup{DirectoryPath=g.Key,Files=g.OrderBy(f=>f.Name,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToList()}).ToList();result.Add(new ModScenarioTree{ModId=mod.Id,Groups=groups});}return result;}private static void CollectScenarioFiles(ModManager manager,string modId,string directory,List<ScenarioFileInfo>result){foreach(var entry in manager.ListFiles(modId,directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){CollectScenarioFiles(manager,modId,entry.TrimEnd('/'),result);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(ScenarioExtension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var path=entry.Replace('\\','/');var lastSlash=path.LastIndexOf('/');var fileName=lastSlash>=0?path.Substring(lastSlash+1):path;var dirPath=lastSlash>=0?path.Substring(0,lastSlash):"";var relativeDir="";if(dirPath.StartsWith(ScenariosDir+"/",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))relativeDir=dirPath.Substring(ScenariosDir.Length+1);else if(!dirPath.Equals(ScenariosDir,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))relativeDir=dirPath;result.Add(new ScenarioFileInfo{ModId=modId,RelativePath=path,Name=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName),RelativeDir=relativeDir});}}/// <summary>Builds the stable UI identity for a scenario file.</summary>
public static string MakeKey(string modId,string relativePath)=>modId+KeySeparator+relativePath;/// <summary>Splits a key produced by <see cref="MakeKey"/> back into mod ID and mod-relative path.</summary>
public static bool TryParseKey(string key,out string modId,out string relativePath){modId=null;relativePath=null;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))return false;var separator=key.IndexOf(KeySeparator,StringComparison.Ordinal);if(separator<=0||separator>=key.Length-1)return false;modId=key.Substring(0,separator);relativePath=key.Substring(separator+1);return true;}/// <summary> Parses the header block (before first <c>---</c> line) in YAML-like <c>key: value</c> format to extract scene, priority, and condition. </summary>
public static ScenarioMetadata ParseMetadata(string text){var meta=new ScenarioMetadata();var metaEnd=text.IndexOf("\n---");var metaText=metaEnd>=0?text.Substring(0,metaEnd):"";foreach(var line in metaText.Split('\n')){var t=line.Trim();if(t.Length==0||t.StartsWith("#"))continue;var ci=t.IndexOf(':');if(ci<=0)continue;var key=t.Substring(0,ci).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();var val=t.Substring(ci+1).Trim();switch(key){case"scene":meta.Scene=val;break;case"priority":meta.Priority=val;break;case"condition":meta.Condition=val;break;}}return meta;}/// <summary> Walks the body of the scenario (after <c>---</c>) and extracts references: background IDs, scene switch targets, locale keys, and quest IDs. Uses <see cref="ScenarioSyntaxService.ExtractCommandParams"/> to tokenise each line and <see cref="ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory"/> metadata to classify positional parameters. </summary> <param name="text">Full scenario file text including header.</param>
public static ScenarioReferences ExtractReferences(string text){var refs=new ScenarioReferences();var metaEnd=text.IndexOf("\n---");var content=metaEnd>=0?text.Substring(metaEnd+4):text;foreach(var rawLine in content.Split('\n')){var line=rawLine.Trim();if(line.Length==0||line.StartsWith("#")||line.StartsWith(":"))continue;ScenarioSyntaxService.ExtractCommandParams(line,out var cmd,out var positional,out var named);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(cmd))continue;var meta=ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.GetReferenceMetadata(cmd);if(meta!=null&&positional.Count>0){switch(meta.Positional0Kind){case PositionalReferenceKind.Background:refs.BackgroundRefs.Add(positional[0]);break;case PositionalReferenceKind.Scene:refs.SwitchTargets.Add(positional[0]);break;}}if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var lk))refs.LocaleKeys.Add(lk);if(named.TryGetValue("quest_id",out var qid))refs.QuestRefs.Add(qid);}return refs;}/// <summary>Reads a scenario file through its mod provider. Returns <c>null</c> when not found.</summary>
public static string ReadAllText(string modId,string relativePath){return ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(modId,relativePath);}/// <summary> Writes a scenario file back to disk. Returns <c>false</c> when the owning mod is not filesystem-backed (zip mods are read-only). </summary>
public static bool WriteAllText(string modId,string relativePath,string text){var absolutePath=ModManager.Instance.GetFileSystemPath(modId,relativePath);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(absolutePath))return false;File.WriteAllText(absolutePath,text);return true;}/// <summary> Creates <c>scenarios/&lt;scene&gt;[_n].scenario</c> in a folder mod: a header bound to <paramref name="scene"/> and one line of text to replace. Returns the file key, or null when the mod is not writable. </summary>
public static string CreateForScene(string modId,string scene,string firstLine){var path=$"{ScenariosDir}/{scene}{ScenarioExtension}";for(var n=2;ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(modId,path)!=null;n++)path=$"{ScenariosDir}/{scene}_{n}{ScenarioExtension}";var text=$"scene: {scene}\npriority: 10\n---\n{firstLine}\nend\n";return ModFileService.WriteText(modId,path,text)?MakeKey(modId,path):null;}/// <summary>Absolute filesystem path of a scenario file, or <c>null</c> for zip-backed mods.</summary>
public static string GetAbsolutePath(string modId,string relativePath){return ModManager.Instance.GetFileSystemPath(modId,relativePath);}/// <summary>Project-style display path (<c>mods/&lt;modId&gt;/&lt;relativePath&gt;</c>).</summary>
public static string GetDisplayPath(string modId,string relativePath){return"mods/"+modId+"/"+relativePath;}/// <summary>Scans every mod's scenarios and builds the cross-scene graph (nodes per scene, edges per switch target).</summary>
public static SceneGraphData BuildSceneGraph(){var data=new SceneGraphData();var sceneNodes=new Dictionary<string,SceneGraphNode>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var edgeSet=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in ScanScenarioFiles()){foreach(var group in mod.Groups){foreach(var file in group.Files){var text=ReadAllText(file.ModId,file.RelativePath);if(text==null)continue;var metadata=ParseMetadata(text);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(metadata.Scene)||metadata.Scene=="-")continue;var sceneKey=metadata.Scene.ToLowerInvariant();if(!sceneNodes.TryGetValue(sceneKey,out var node)){node=new SceneGraphNode{SceneName=metadata.Scene,ModId=file.ModId,IsStartScene=string.Equals(metadata.Scene,"start_scene",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)};sceneNodes[sceneKey]=node;}node.ScenarioCount++;node.Scenarios.Add(new ScenarioGraphLink{Name=file.Name,Priority=int.TryParse(metadata.Priority,out var p)?p:0,Key=file.Key});var refs=ExtractReferences(text);foreach(var target in refs.SwitchTargets){var srcKey=metadata.Scene.ToLowerInvariant();var dstKey=target.ToLowerInvariant();var edgeKey=srcKey+"|"+dstKey;if(!edgeSet.Contains(edgeKey)){edgeSet.Add(edgeKey);data.Edges.Add(new SceneGraphEdge{FromScene=metadata.Scene,ToScene=target});}}}}}foreach(var node in sceneNodes.Values)data.Nodes.Add(node);return data;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> Static service providing scenario DSL syntax highlighting, tokenisation, and command-line parsing. <see cref="CreateHighlighter"/> produces a <see cref="CodeHighlighter"/> for the scenario editor's <see cref="TextEdit"/>. <see cref="ExtractCommandParams"/> tokenises a scenario command line into a command name, positional arguments, and named (<c>key=value</c>) parameters — used by <see cref="ScenarioFileService.ExtractReferences"/> for reference analysis. </summary>
public static class ScenarioSyntaxService{/// <summary> Builds a <see cref="CodeHighlighter"/> for scenario DSL syntax. Comments (lines starting with <c>#</c>) are green, strings are bright gold, command names are blue, and argument keywords (e.g. <c>key</c>, <c>wait</c>, <c>quest_id</c>) are amber — all from <see cref="UiTokens"/>. </summary>
public static CodeHighlighter CreateHighlighter(){var hl=new CodeHighlighter();hl.AddColorRegion("#",null,UiTokens.Success,true);hl.AddColorRegion("\"","\"",UiTokens.AccentBright,false);hl.NumberColor=UiTokens.Info;hl.SymbolColor=UiTokens.Muted;var cmdColor=UiTokens.Info;hl.KeywordColors=new Godot.Collections.Dictionary();foreach(var cmd in ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.GetAllCommandNames())hl.KeywordColors[cmd]=cmdColor;foreach(var cmd in new[]{"option","select"})hl.KeywordColors[cmd]=cmdColor;var argColor=UiTokens.Accent;foreach(var kw in new[]{"key","first","second","hide_color","wait","speed","hidden","sprites","loop","target","quest_id","show","hide","duration"})hl.KeywordColors[kw]=argColor;return hl;}/// <summary> Splits a line into tokens, handling quoted strings (with backslash escaping) and whitespace. Returns all non-whitespace tokens in order. </summary>
public static List<string>Tokenize(string line){var result=new List<string>();var i=0;while(i<line.Length){if(char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i])){i++;continue;}if(line[i]=='"'){i++;var start=i;while(i<line.Length&&line[i]!='"'){if(line[i]=='\\'&&i+1<line.Length)i++;i++;}result.Add(line.Substring(start,i-start));if(i<line.Length)i++;continue;}var tok=i;while(i<line.Length&& !char.IsWhiteSpace(line[i]))i++;result.Add(line.Substring(tok,i-tok));}return result;}/// <summary>Strips surrounding double quotes from a value if present.</summary>
public static string StripQuotes(string val){if(val.Length>=2&&val.StartsWith("\"")&&val.EndsWith("\""))return val.Substring(1,val.Length-2);return val;}/// <summary> Parses a scenario command line into its components. Tokenises via <see cref="Tokenize"/>, then extracts the first token as the command name (lowercased), remaining bare tokens as positional arguments, and <c>key=value</c> pairs as named arguments. The <c>-></c> arrow token is consumed but discarded. </summary> <param name="line">A single scenario command line (trimmed).</param> <param name="cmd">The command name, lowercased.</param> <param name="positional">Positional arguments in order.</param> <param name="named">Named arguments keyed by lowercased name.</param>
public static void ExtractCommandParams(string line,out string cmd,out List<string>positional,out Dictionary<string,string>named){positional=new List<string>();named=new Dictionary<string,string>(System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);cmd="";var tokens=Tokenize(line);if(tokens.Count==0)return;cmd=tokens[0].ToLowerInvariant();for(int t=1;t<tokens.Count;t++){var tk=tokens[t];if(tk=="->"){t++;continue;}var eq=tk.IndexOf('=');if(eq>0)named[tk.Substring(0,eq).ToLowerInvariant()]=StripQuotes(tk.Substring(eq+1));else positional.Add(tk);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> Finds which background an editor should show for a piece of content, so the author does not have to guess it from a list of hundreds: <list type="bullet"> <item>a scene's background is the first <c>defaultBackground</c> of its <c>scenes/*.json</c> definition;</item> <item>an interactive belongs to the scene of the scenario that adds it (<c>interactive_add &lt;id&gt;</c>).</item> </list> Both are best-effort hints: <c>null</c> means "no idea", and the author can always pick another background by hand. </summary>
public static class SceneBackgroundService{private const string InteractiveAddCommand="interactive_add";/// <summary>Default background ID of a logical scene, or <c>null</c>.</summary>
public static string ForScene(string sceneName){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(sceneName)||sceneName=="-")return null;var defs=SceneDefinitions.Collect();if(defs==null)return null;foreach(var pair in defs){if(!string.Equals(pair.Key,sceneName,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||pair.Value==null)continue;// Several mods may define the scene; the last one wins at runtime.
for(var i=pair.Value.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(pair.Value[i]?.DefaultBackground is{Count:>0}list)return list[0];}}return null;}/// <summary> Scans every scenario once and maps interactive IDs to the scene of the first scenario that adds them. </summary>
public static Dictionary<string,string>MapInteractivesToScenes(){var result=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in ScenarioFileService.ScanScenarioFiles()){foreach(var group in mod.Groups){foreach(var file in group.Files){var text=ScenarioFileService.ReadAllText(file.ModId,file.RelativePath);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)||text.IndexOf(InteractiveAddCommand,StringComparison.Ordinal)<0)continue;var scene=ScenarioFileService.ParseMetadata(text).Scene;foreach(var raw in text.Split('\n')){var tokens=ScenarioSyntaxService.Tokenize(raw.Trim());if(tokens.Count>=2&&tokens[0]==InteractiveAddCommand&& !result.ContainsKey(tokens[1]))result[tokens[1]]=scene;}}}}return result;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> One mod's file of a logical scene (<c>scenes/&lt;name&gt;.json</c>). The game merges the files of all mods into one <see cref="SceneDefinition"/> (backgrounds add up, a later non-empty ambient or default scenario wins); the scene editor works on the files themselves, because only one of them — the chosen mod's — is written. </summary>
public sealed class SceneFileEntry{/// <summary>Mod that owns the file.</summary>
public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod-relative path of the file.</summary>
public string RelativePath{get;set;}/// <summary>Scene name (the logical scene id).</summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Backgrounds this file adds; the game shows one of the merged list at random.</summary>
public List<string>Backgrounds{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Ambient sound id (group <c>sounds</c>), empty for none.</summary>
public string Ambient{get;set;}=string.Empty;/// <summary>Mod-relative path of the scenario played when nothing else starts, empty for none.</summary>
public string DefaultScenario{get;set;}=string.Empty;/// <summary>Default path of a scene file: <c>scenes/&lt;name&gt;.json</c>.</summary>
public static string PathFor(string name)=>"scenes/"+name+".json";/// <summary>Reads a scene file with the game's own JSON options; null when it is not a scene.</summary>
public static SceneFileEntry Parse(string modId,string relativePath,string json){SceneDefinition definition;try{definition=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SceneDefinition>(json??string.Empty,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);}catch(JsonException){return null;}if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(definition?.Name))return null;return new SceneFileEntry{ModId=modId,RelativePath=relativePath,Name=definition.Name,Backgrounds=definition.DefaultBackground??new List<string>(),Ambient=definition.DefaultAmbient??string.Empty,DefaultScenario=definition.DefaultScenario??string.Empty,};}/// <summary> The file text in the style of the hand-written scene files (two-space indent, LF, camelCase keys). Empty fields are left out, so a file of a mod that only adds a background does not reset another mod's ambient or default scenario. </summary>
public string ToJson(){var json=new StringBuilder("{\n  \"name\": ").Append(Quote(Name));if(Backgrounds.Count>0){json.Append(",\n  \"defaultBackground\": [");for(var i=0;i<Backgrounds.Count;i++)json.Append(i==0?string.Empty:", ").Append(Quote(Backgrounds[i]));json.Append(']');}if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Ambient))json.Append(",\n  \"defaultAmbient\": ").Append(Quote(Ambient));if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultScenario))json.Append(",\n  \"defaultScenario\": ").Append(Quote(DefaultScenario));return json.Append("\n}\n").ToString();}private static string Quote(string value)=>JsonSerializer.Serialize(value??string.Empty);}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Text.RegularExpressions;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Services{/// <summary> Scene files (<c>scenes/**.json</c>) of the loaded mods for the scene editor: reading them per mod in load order (the order the game merges them in), writing and deleting one. After a write the caller runs <see cref="SceneManager.ReloadContent"/>, so a new scene can be entered without a mod reload. </summary>
public static class SceneFileService{private const string ScenesDir="scenes";private static readonly Regex NamePattern=new("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$");/// <summary>Every scene file of the loaded mods and of the studio layer, in load order.</summary>
public static List<SceneFileEntry>Scan(){var result=new List<SceneFileEntry>();var manager=ModManager.Instance;if(manager?.Mods==null)return result;foreach(var modId in ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds()){if(manager.Mods.TryGetValue(modId,out var mod)&&mod?.FileProvider!=null)Collect(mod.FileProvider,modId,ScenesDir,result);}foreach(var overlay in ModOverlays.All)Collect(overlay.Value,overlay.Key,ScenesDir,result);return result;}/// <summary>The scene name typed by the author, trimmed and lowercased; null when it is not an id (latin letters, digits, _).</summary>
public static string ValidName(string name){name=(name??string.Empty).Trim().ToLowerInvariant();return NamePattern.IsMatch(name)?name:null;}/// <summary>Writes the entry to its mod; false when the mod is not a folder mod.</summary>
public static bool Write(SceneFileEntry entry){return ModFileService.WriteText(entry.ModId,entry.RelativePath,entry.ToJson());}/// <summary>Deletes the entry's file; false when the mod is not a folder mod or the file is gone.</summary>
public static bool Delete(SceneFileEntry entry){var path=ModFileService.GetWritablePath(entry.ModId,entry.RelativePath);if(path==null|| !File.Exists(path))return false;File.Delete(path);return true;}private static void Collect(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string directory,List<SceneFileEntry>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(directory)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){Collect(provider,modId,entry.TrimEnd('/'),result);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var scene=SceneFileEntry.Parse(modId,entry,provider.ReadFileText(entry));if(scene!=null)result.Add(scene);}}}}

using System;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool.ScenarioEditor;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Tool;using Cthangover.Tools.Common;using Cthangover.Tools.Hub;using Cthangover.Tools.Services;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Tests.Windows{/// <summary> Play-test round trip of the scenario editor opened from the <see cref="NovelEditorHub"/>: plays this suite's own scenario (so the editor's save-before-play rewrites a test file, not game content), lets the play end the way a finished dialog ends it (<see cref="SceneManager.IsTestPlayActive"/> drops), then plays again and presses Stop. Both times the game must come back to the hub with the editor visible — not to the engine's main menu. Advanced one step per driver tick; <see cref="Tick"/> returns true when done. </summary>
public class ScenarioPlayReturnCheck{private const string SuiteModId="editor_tools__windows";private const string ScenarioPath="scenarios/playtest_return.scenario";private const int ShellSettleTicks=3;private readonly Action<bool,string>_check;private ScenarioEditorWindow _window;private int _step;private int _settle;/// <summary>Creates the check; <paramref name="check"/> records one assertion.</summary>
public ScenarioPlayReturnCheck(Action<bool,string>check){_check=check;}/// <summary>Advances the round trip by one step; true once finished.</summary>
public bool Tick(SceneTree tree){switch(_step){case 0:_window=(ScenarioEditorWindow)ToolWindow.ShowWindow(new ScenarioEditorWindow());var tabs=_window.FindChildren("*","",true,false).OfType<ScenarioEditTabs>().FirstOrDefault();tabs?.OpenFile(ScenarioFileService.MakeKey(SuiteModId,ScenarioPath));_check(tabs?.HasActiveFile==true,"scenario_editor: test scenario opened");break;case 1:case 4:PressButton(_window,"tools/scenario_editor/play");_settle=ShellSettleTicks;break;case 2:if(!InGame(tree))return false;SceneManager.IsTestPlayActive=false;break;case 5:if(!InGame(tree))return false;PressButton(tree.Root,"tools/scenario_editor/stop");break;case 3:case 6:if(tree.CurrentScene is not NovelEditorHub|| !_window.Visible)return false;_check(true,_step==3?"scenario_editor: the scenario's end returns to the editor hub":"scenario_editor: Stop returns to the editor hub");if(_step==6){_window.QueueFree();return true;}break;}_step++;return false;}/// <summary>The play-test left the hub for the game shell and the shell settled.</summary>
private bool InGame(SceneTree tree){if(tree.CurrentScene is NovelEditorHub||GodotSceneService.IsTransitioning|| --_settle>0)return false;_check(!_window.Visible,"scenario_editor: play hides the editor and enters the game");return true;}private static void PressButton(Node root,string textKey){var text=ToolUi.Tr(textKey);var button=root.FindChildren("*",nameof(Button),true,false).OfType<Button>().FirstOrDefault(b=>b.Text==text);button?.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Tools.Tests.Windows{/// <summary> Engine logger that records every error Godot reports while the test runs. An exception thrown inside a signal handler (a button toggled during construction, a draw callback) never reaches the code that opened the window — Godot only prints it — so without this the test would pass windows that are visibly broken. Errors may arrive from any thread. </summary>
public partial class ToolWindowsErrorLogger:Logger{private readonly object _lock=new();private readonly List<string>_errors=new();/// <summary>Records the error text (rationale or code, whichever is set).</summary>
public override void _LogError(string function,string file,int line,string code,string rationale,bool editorNotify,int errorType,Godot.Collections.Array<ScriptBacktrace>scriptBacktraces){if(errorType==(int)ErrorType.Warning)return;lock(_lock)_errors.Add($"{(string.IsNullOrEmpty(rationale) ? code : rationale)} ({file}:{line})");}/// <summary>Returns and clears the errors collected so far.</summary>
public List<string>Drain(){lock(_lock){var copy=new List<string>(_errors);_errors.Clear();return copy;}}}}
