public ToolWindowsTestDriverNode(string shotsDir){_shotsDir=shotsDir;OS.AddLogger(_errors);var timer=new Timer{WaitTime=TickSeconds,Autostart=true};AddChild(timer);timer.Timeout+=Tick;}private void Tick(){if(_finished)return;_elapsed+=TickSeconds;if(_elapsed>=TimeoutSeconds){Fail($"timeout ({TimeoutSeconds:0}s) at tool #{_toolIndex}");Finish();return;}if(_toolIndex<0){var tree=Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree;if(!Boot.IsReady||tree?.CurrentScene==null)return;_inHub=ActiveGame.Id==NovelEditorHub.SceneName;if(_inHub&&tree.CurrentScene is not NovelEditorHub)return;_tools.AddRange(ToolFactory.Instance.GetAll());Check(_tools.Count>0,$"tools registered ({_tools.Count})");if(_inHub)CheckHub(tree.CurrentScene);OpenNext();return;}if(_playCheck!=null){if(_playCheck.Tick(GetTree()))Finish();return;}if(_window==null)return;if(--_settle==ExerciseTick){try{ToolWindowsExercises.Run(_tools[_toolIndex].Id,_window,Check);}catch(System.Exception ex){Fail($"{_tools[_toolIndex].Id}: interaction threw {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");}}if(_settle>0)return;InspectAndClose();OpenNext();}private void OpenNext(){_toolIndex++;if(_toolIndex>=_tools.Count){if(_inHub)_playCheck=new ScenarioPlayReturnCheck(Check);else Finish();return;}var tool=_tools[_toolIndex];_errors.Drain();try{_window=ToolWindow.ShowWindow(tool.CreateWindow());_settle=SettleTicks;}catch(System.Exception ex){Fail($"{tool.Id}: open threw {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");_window=null;OpenNext();}}/// <summary>Every registered tool has its launcher button on the hub screen.</summary>
private void CheckHub(Node hub){var keys=new HashSet<string>();CollectButtonKeys(hub,keys);foreach(var tool in _tools)Check(keys.Contains(tool.LocaleKey),$"hub: launcher button for {tool.Id}");SaveShot("novel_editor_hub");}private static void CollectButtonKeys(Node node,HashSet<string>keys){if(node is Button button&&button.HasMeta(MenuBuilder.LocaleMetaKey))keys.Add(button.GetMeta(MenuBuilder.LocaleMetaKey).AsString());foreach(var child in node.GetChildren())CollectButtonKeys(child,keys);}private void InspectAndClose(){var id=_tools[_toolIndex].Id;var window=_window;_window=null;var errors=_errors.Drain();Check(errors.Count==0,$"{id}: no engine errors while opening"+(errors.Count>0?": "+string.Join(" | ",errors):""));Check(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(window)&&window.IsInsideTree()&&window.Visible,$"{id}: window visible in tree");if(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(window))return;var viewport=GetTree().Root.GetVisibleRect().Size;Check(window.Size.X<=viewport.X+1&&window.Size.Y<=viewport.Y+1,$"{id}: window {window.Size} fits viewport {viewport}");SaveShot(id);window.QueueFree();}private void SaveShot(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_shotsDir)||DisplayServer.GetName()=="headless")return;var dir=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(_shotsDir);Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);var path=Path.Combine(dir,id+".png");ViewportCapture.SavePng(GetViewport(),path);Log($"screenshot {path}");}private void Check(bool ok,string name){if(ok){_passed++;Log($"[PASS] {name}");}else{Fail(name);}}private void Fail(string message){_failed++;Log($"[FAIL] {message}");}private void Finish(){if(_finished)return;_finished=true;OS.RemoveLogger(_errors);GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={_passed} failed={_failed}");GetTree().Quit(_failed==0?0:1);}private static void Log(string message)=>GameLogger.Log("TEST",message);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Effects.Animation{/// <summary> Frame-by-frame sprite animation via crossfade between two TextureRect nodes. Rather than using a spritesheet, it keeps a "current" and "next" texture and lerps their modulate between transparent and opaque, creating smooth transitions. A built-in wait/waitPercent mechanism holds the "next" frame fully visible for a configurable interval before advancing, producing a paced flip-book effect. Exposes NextFrame/NextCycle events so external systems can sequence or react to animation milestones without polling. </summary>
public partial class AnimationController:Control,IOnUpdateEvent{[Export]private TextureRect current;[Export]private TextureRect next;[Export]private Texture2D empty;[Export]private bool isLoop=true;[Export]private float speed=1f;[Export]private float nextFrameSpeed=0.2f;/// <summary>Fires when the current frame transition completes and the next frame texture is assigned.</summary>
public event Action NextFrame;/// <summary>Fires when the animation wraps around (looping) or reaches the final frame (non-looping).</summary>
public event Action NextCycle;[Export]private Color clearColor=new(1f,1f,1f,0f);[Export]private Color completeColor=new(1f,1f,1f,1f);private int currentFrame;private double timestamp;private float percent;private bool wait;private float waitPercent;private bool isStarted;/// <summary>When true, the animation wraps from the last frame back to the first. When false, playback stops at the final frame.</summary>
public bool IsLoop{get=>isLoop;set=>isLoop=value;}/// <summary>Crossfade speed multiplier between frames. Higher values produce faster transitions.</summary>
public float Speed{get=>speed;set=>speed=value;}/// <summary>Hold duration multiplier for the "wait" phase after a frame transition completes.</summary>
public float NextFrameSpeed{get=>nextFrameSpeed;set=>nextFrameSpeed=value;}/// <summary>Whether playback is currently active. False on startup and after <see cref="Pause"/> or <see cref="Clear"/>.</summary>
public bool IsStarted=>isStarted;/// <summary>Ordered list of textures to cycle through. Set externally before calling <see cref="Play"/>.</summary>
public List<Texture2D>FrameSet{get;set;}/// <summary>Resets to idle state: stops playback, clears frame set, and blanks both texture nodes to transparent.</summary>
public void Clear(){isStarted=false;FrameSet=null;current.Texture=empty;current.Modulate=Colors.Transparent;next.Texture=empty;next.Modulate=Colors.Transparent;}/// <summary>Stops playback without clearing textures, freezing on the current frame.</summary>
public void Pause(){isStarted=false;}/// <summary>Starts or restarts playback from the first frame in <see cref="FrameSet"/>.</summary>
public void Play(){currentFrame=0;isStarted=true;timestamp=Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;current.Texture=empty;next.Modulate=clearColor;next.Texture=FrameSet[currentFrame];}/// <summary>Update priority. Lower numbers run earlier in the frame. Default 1.</summary>
public int Priority=>1;/// <summary>Advances the crossfade each frame. Handles both the transition phase (lerping modulate) and the wait phase (holding the next frame visible).</summary>
public void OnUpdate(){if(!isStarted)return;if(Lists.IsEmpty(FrameSet)){Clear();return;}double now=Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;if(!wait){float delta=(float)(now-timestamp)*speed;percent=Mathf.Min(percent+delta,1f);current.Modulate=completeColor.Lerp(Colors.Transparent,percent);next.Modulate=Colors.Transparent.Lerp(completeColor,percent);}else{float delta=(float)(now-timestamp)*nextFrameSpeed;waitPercent=Mathf.Min(waitPercent+delta,1f);}timestamp=now;if(percent>=1f&& !wait){wait=true;SwitchNextFrame();percent=0f;}if(waitPercent>=1f&&wait){wait=false;waitPercent=0f;}}private void SwitchNextFrame(){NextFrame?.Invoke();if(Lists.IsEmpty(FrameSet)){Clear();return;}var needNextCycle=false;currentFrame++;if(FrameSet.Count<=currentFrame){if(isLoop)currentFrame=0;else{currentFrame--;Pause();}needNextCycle=true;}current.Modulate=completeColor;current.Texture=next.Texture;next.Modulate=clearColor;next.Texture=FrameSet[currentFrame];if(needNextCycle)NextCycle?.Invoke();}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Effects.Animation{/// <summary> Lightweight, code-only alternative to EffectAnimator that does NOT require a shader. Constructs an AtlasTexture and shifts its Region rect each frame to scroll through a horizontal spritesheet. Designed for runtime spawning via the static SpawnOn factory — it anchors to fill the target Control and self-destructs when playback finishes, requiring no scene file setup. </summary>
public partial class EffectAnimNode:TextureRect{private AtlasTexture atlas;private int frameCount;private float frameInterval;private float elapsed;private int currentFrame= -1;private int frameWidth;private float totalDuration;/// <summary>Factory method that creates the node, attaches it to <paramref name="target"/> filling the full rect, and initializes the spritesheet animation. Returns null if target or sheet is null.</summary> <param name="target">Parent Control to anchor the animation to.</param> <param name="sheet">Horizontal spritesheet texture. Frame width = sheet width / frameCount.</param> <param name="frameCount">Number of frames in the spritesheet.</param> <param name="totalDuration">Total playback time in seconds; frameInterval = totalDuration / frameCount.</param>
public static EffectAnimNode SpawnOn(Control target,Texture2D sheet,int frameCount,float totalDuration){if(target==null||sheet==null)return null;var node=new EffectAnimNode();target.AddChild(node);node.AnchorLeft=0;node.AnchorTop=0;node.AnchorRight=1;node.AnchorBottom=1;node.OffsetLeft=0;node.OffsetTop=0;node.OffsetRight=0;node.OffsetBottom=0;node.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;node.ZIndex=100;node.Init(sheet,frameCount,totalDuration);return node;}private void Init(Texture2D sheet,int frameCount,float totalDuration){this.frameCount=frameCount;this.totalDuration=totalDuration;frameInterval=totalDuration/frameCount;frameWidth=sheet.GetWidth()/frameCount;atlas=new AtlasTexture{Atlas=sheet,Region=new Rect2(0,0,frameWidth,sheet.GetHeight()),};Texture=atlas;ExpandMode=ExpandModeEnum.IgnoreSize;StretchMode=StretchModeEnum.KeepAspectCentered;SetFrame(0);}/// <summary>Steps the atlas region forward per frame interval and frees the node once the total duration has played.</summary>
public override void _Process(double delta){elapsed+=(float)delta;var frame=Mathf.Min((int)(elapsed/frameInterval),frameCount-1);if(frame!=currentFrame)SetFrame(frame);if(elapsed>=totalDuration)QueueFree();}private void SetFrame(int frame){currentFrame=frame;atlas.Region=new Rect2(frame*frameWidth,0,frameWidth,atlas.Region.Size.Y);}}}

This means all animation frames live in a single GPU texture atlas and the shader selects the visible frame. Auto-destroys (QueueFree) after totalDuration elapses, making it suitable for fire-and-forget VFX that don't need external cleanup. </summary>
public partial class EffectAnimator:Control,IOnUpdateEvent{[Export]private TextureRect image;[Export]private float totalDuration=5f;[Export]private int frameCount=5;private ShaderMaterial materialInstance;private double startTime;private float frameInterval;private int currentFrame;private static readonly StringName FrameIndexId="_FrameIndex";private static readonly StringName FrameCountId="_FrameCount";/// <summary>Precomputes the frame interval and pushes the frame count uniform into the shader material.</summary>

public override void _EnterTree(){}/// <summary>Starts the shader animation from frame 0, resetting the elapsed timer.</summary>
public void Play(){startTime=Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;currentFrame=0;if(materialInstance!=null)materialInstance.SetShaderParameter(FrameIndexId,0f);}/// <summary>Update priority. Default 1.</summary>
public int Priority=>1;/// <summary>Advances the shader's _FrameIndex uniform each frame based on elapsed time. Self-destructs when <c>totalDuration</c> elapses.</summary>
public void OnUpdate(){double now=Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec()/1_000_000.0;var elapsed=now-startTime;var newFrame=Mathf.Min((int)(elapsed/frameInterval),frameCount-1);if(newFrame!=currentFrame&&materialInstance!=null){currentFrame=newFrame;materialInstance.SetShaderParameter(FrameIndexId,currentFrame);}if(elapsed>=totalDuration)QueueFree();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Effects{/// <summary> Factory for <c>PackedScene</c> visual effects. Overrides <c>LoadFromMods</c> to use <c>ResourceLoader.Load</c> from the file system instead of <c>ConvertFromBytes</c>, because Godot's scene format is a proprietary binary blob that cannot be reconstructed from raw bytes in managed code. This imposes a hard constraint: effect scenes are only loadable from <b>folder mods</b> — zip mods skip them with a warning — so mod authors distributing visual effects must ship them unpacked. <para/> The single instance is a self-contained lazy singleton owned by this mod assembly; consumers resolve it through <see cref="Instance"/>. </summary>
public class EffectFactory:PrefabFactory<PackedScene>{private static readonly Lazy<EffectFactory>instance=new(()=>new EffectFactory());/// <summary>Process-wide instance; laziness matches the former AppServices slot.</summary>
public static EffectFactory Instance=>instance.Value;private EffectFactory():base("effects",64){}/// <summary>Mod asset group scanned by this factory — files live under <c>mods/*/effects</c>.</summary>
public override string GroupName=>"effects";/// <summary>Scene file extensions accepted during the mod scan.</summary>
protected override List<string>Extensions{get;}=new(){".tscn",".scn"};/// <summary>Always fails with a log — PackedScene is a proprietary Godot blob; use <see cref="LoadFromMods"/> (folder mods only).</summary>
protected override PackedScene ConvertFromBytes(string id,byte[]data,string extension){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"PackedScene cannot be constructed from bytes; use folder mods for '{id}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}/// <summary> Loads the scene via <c>ResourceLoader</c> from the mod's real file system path — which only folder mods can provide; zip mods are skipped with a warning. </summary>
protected override PackedScene LoadFromMods(string id,string extension){var files=Files.Collect(GroupName);string matchedKey=null;foreach(var key in files.Keys){if(key==id||key.Equals(id+extension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){matchedKey=key;break;}}if(matchedKey==null|| !files.TryGetValue(matchedKey,out var entry)){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"effect '{id}' - not found in group '{GroupName}'!",LogLevel.Error);return null;}var fsPath=ModManager.Instance.GetFileSystemPath(entry.ModId,entry.FullPath);if(fsPath==null){GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"effect '{id}' - only folder mods support PackedScene (zip mod '{entry.ModId}' skipped)",LogLevel.Warning);return null;}return ResourceLoader.Load<PackedScene>(fsPath);}}}

Subclasses implement their animation logic in <c>DoInternalStart/DoInternalAction/DoInternalEnd</c> and are instantiated by <see cref="FFBattleCore"/> when a player or enemy action is executed. The <see cref="Speed"/> multiplier scales all timing, used e.g. to speed up enemy turn animations (<c>0.8f</c>). </summary>

protected double Timestamp{get;set;}= -1;/// <summary>Animation speed multiplier; lower values produce faster animations.</summary>
protected float Speed{get;set;}=1f;/// <summary>The action descriptor being executed (determines which executor runs).</summary>
protected ActionCharacter Action{get;set;}/// <summary>The character widget performing the action.</summary>
protected FFCharacterWidget Source{get;set;}/// <summary>The character widget receiving the action.</summary>
protected FFCharacterWidget Target{get;set;}/// <summary>World position of <see cref="Source"/> captured at <see cref="DoStart"/>.</summary>
protected Vector2 SourcePos{get;set;}/// <summary>World position of <see cref="Target"/> captured at <see cref="DoStart"/>.</summary>
protected Vector2 TargetPos{get;set;}/// <summary>Creates an animation binding a source, target, and action with an optional speed override.</summary>
protected FFAbstractAnimation(FFCharacterWidget source,FFCharacterWidget target,ActionCharacter action,float speed=1f){Source=source;Target=target;Action=action;Speed=speed;}/// <summary> Advances the animation by one frame. Returns <c>true</c> when the animation sequence has completed. Called in a tight <c>while</c> loop by <see cref="FFBattleCore.RunAnimation"/> each process frame. </summary>
public bool DoAction(){if(Source==null||Target==null||Action==null)return true;// The target's death animation may free its widget mid-animation; finish early and let DoEnd snap the source back.
if(!IsAlive(Source)|| !IsAlive(Target))return true;return DoInternalAction();}/// <summary>True while the widget is still in the tree and not queued for deletion.</summary>
protected static bool IsAlive(FFCharacterWidget widget)=>GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(widget)&& !widget.IsQueuedForDeletion();/// <summary>Captures the initial world positions of source and target, then delegates to subclass setup.</summary>
public void DoStart(){if(Source==null||Target==null||Action==null)return;SourcePos=Source.GlobalPosition;TargetPos=Target.GlobalPosition;DoInternalStart();}/// <summary>Restores source to original position and delegates cleanup to subclass.</summary>
public void DoEnd(){if(Source==null||Target==null||Action==null)return;DoInternalEnd();}/// <summary>Frame tick of the animation; implementors advance phases and return true when finished.</summary>
protected abstract bool DoInternalAction();/// <summary>Phase setup called once by <see cref="DoStart"/> after positions are captured.</summary>
protected abstract void DoInternalStart();/// <summary>Cleanup called once by <see cref="DoEnd"/> — restore captured positions here.</summary>
protected abstract void DoInternalEnd();/// <summary>Quadratic ease-out: fast start, decelerating to the target. Used for return-to-start motion.</summary>
protected float EaseOutQuad(float t)=>1f-(1f-t)*(1f-t);/// <summary>Quadratic ease-in-out: slow start and end, fast in the middle. Used for approach motion.</summary>
protected float EaseInOutQuad(float t)=>t<0.5f?2f*t*t:1f-Mathf.Pow(-2f*t+2f,2f)/2f;}}

public class FFAttackAnimation:FFAbstractAnimation{private enum Phase{MoveForward,Impact,MoveBack,Done}private Phase _phase;private bool _damageApplied;private Vector2 _midPoint;/// <summary>Creates an attack animation for source→target with the given action descriptor and speed.</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.Actions{/// <summary> Handles item usage during battle. This separation exists because items carry their own <see cref="IItem.ItemAction"/> delegate for effects, unlike standard actions which use the executor pattern. Registered under ID <c>"ff/item"</c>. </summary>
public class FFItemExecutor:IActionExecutor{/// <summary>The action ID string that maps to this executor in <see cref="FFActionProvider"/>.</summary>
public string ActionId=>"ff/item";/// <summary>No-op — item effects are applied via <see cref="TryUseItem"/>.</summary>

public static bool TryUseItem(IItem item,Character user,Character target){if(item==null||user==null)return false;if(user.Attributes.Point.Value<1){GameLogger.Log("FF_BATTLE",$"Not enough points to use item {item.Name}",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}var inventory=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory;if(!inventory.HasItem(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("FF_BATTLE",$"No {item.ID} in inventory",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}user.Attributes.Point.Value-=1;inventory.Remove(item.ID,1);if(item.ItemAction!=null)item.ItemAction.UseAction(item);GameLogger.Log("FF_BATTLE",$"{user.Name} uses item {item.Name}",LogLevel.Debug);return true;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.CharacterPanel;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.UI{/// <summary> Action/item passport shown to the left of the command menu. The panel exists so the small FF-style menu can stay a compact list while the player still sees what the highlighted command actually does. Node structure lives in <c>scenes/ff_action_detail_panel.tscn</c>; the class fills it and reuses <see cref="ActionCharacterUi"/> for badges and properties so the battle and the character panel can never disagree about an action's presentation. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.UI{/// <summary> Centered announcement strip ("Player turn", "Enemy turn", escape results). The banner is purely informational, so it ignores the mouse and the core places it on its own anchored strip between the enemy grid and the party row. </summary>
public partial class FFBattleBanner:ModWidget{private Label _label;private Tween _tween;/// <summary>Builds the centre-screen turn/outcome banner label.</summary>
protected override void Construct(){CthangoverTheme.Apply(this);_label=GetNode<Label>("Center/Panel/Label");_label.AddThemeColorOverride("font_color",UiTokens.InkBright);var style=UiKit.Frame(0,UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Page,0.62f),new Color(0f,0f,0f,0f));style.BorderWidthTop=1;style.BorderWidthBottom=1;style.BorderColor=UiTokens.AccentLine;style.ContentMarginLeft=44;style.ContentMarginRight=44;style.ContentMarginTop=12;style.ContentMarginBottom=12;GetNode<PanelContainer>("Center/Panel").AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel",style);Modulate=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0f);}/// <summary>Shows the given caption and restarts the 1.6s fade cycle.</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.UI{/// <summary> Defines the six states of the battle UI state machine, driving which input handler is active and what the player sees. </summary>
public enum FFBattleState{/// <summary>No menu open; player can select a character to act.</summary>
Idle,/// <summary>Main action menu (attack/items/defend/escape) is visible.</summary>
MenuOpen,/// <summary>Sub-menu (action list or item list) is visible.</summary>
SubMenuOpen,/// <summary>Player must click a valid target character widget.</summary>
TargetSelect,/// <summary>An animation is playing; all input is blocked.</summary>
AnimationPlaying,/// <summary>Battle has concluded.</summary>
Ended}/// <summary> Input dispatch layer for the FF battle UI. Extends <see cref="InputHandlerNode"/> so that keyboard events from Godot's input system are forwarded to this node even in mod assemblies. Routes arrow keys, Enter, Space, and Escape to the appropriate handler based on current <see cref="State"/>. Also provides mouse-driven character selection via <see cref="SelectCharacter"/>. Events are raised to <see cref="FFBattleCore"/> which wires up the actual logic. </summary>
public partial class FFBattleController:InputHandlerNode{private FFBattleState _state=FFBattleState.Idle;/// <summary>Reference to the player-side character panel for idle-state character selection.</summary>
public FFPlayerPanel PlayerPanel{get;set;}/// <summary>Reference to the enemy-side panel for visual context (not directly used for input).</summary>
public FFEnemyPanel EnemyPanel{get;set;}/// <summary>The main menu panel; <see cref="HandleMenuInput"/> delegates up/down/confirm to it.</summary>
public FFMenuPanel MenuPanel{get;set;}/// <summary>The sub-menu panel; <see cref="HandleSubMenuInput"/> delegates to it.</summary>
public FFMenuPanel SubMenuPanel{get;set;}/// <summary>Raised when a character widget is selected (via mouse click or keyboard).</summary>
public event System.Action<FFCharacterWidget>OnCharacterSelected;/// <summary>Raised when a menu item is confirmed. The int is the entry index.</summary>
public event System.Action<int>OnMenuAction;/// <summary>Raised when a sub-menu item is confirmed.</summary>
public event System.Action<int>OnSubMenuAction;/// <summary>Raised when Escape is pressed while the main menu is open.</summary>
public event System.Action OnMenuCancel;/// <summary>Raised when Escape is pressed while a sub-menu is open.</summary>
public event System.Action OnSubMenuCancel;/// <summary>Raised when a target widget is confirmed in target-select mode.</summary>
public event System.Action<FFCharacterWidget>OnTargetSelected;/// <summary> Current UI state. Setting this property logs the transition via <see cref="GameLogger"/> for debugging battle flow. </summary>
public FFBattleState State{get=>_state;set{_state=value;Cthangover.Core.Utils.GameLogger.Log("FF_BATTLE",$"Controller state → {value}",Cthangover.Core.Utils.LogLevel.Debug);}}/// <summary>Ensures the controller processes input even when the scene tree is paused.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){ProcessMode=ProcessModeEnum.Always;}/// <summary>Routes menu/confirm input into the FF battle state machine (target select, turn advance).</summary>
protected override void OnInput(InputEvent@event){if(State==FFBattleState.AnimationPlaying||State==FFBattleState.Ended)return;if(@event is InputEventKey key&&key.Pressed){HandleKeyboardInput(key);if(State!=FFBattleState.Idle)GetViewport().SetInputAsHandled();}}private void HandleKeyboardInput(InputEventKey key){switch(State){case FFBattleState.Idle:HandleIdleInput(key);break;case FFBattleState.MenuOpen:HandleMenuInput(key);break;case FFBattleState.SubMenuOpen:HandleSubMenuInput(key);break;case FFBattleState.TargetSelect:HandleTargetInput(key);break;}}private void HandleIdleInput(InputEventKey key){if(key.Keycode==Key.Enter||key.Keycode==Key.Space){SelectFirstAvailableCharacter();}}private void HandleMenuInput(InputEventKey key){switch(key.Keycode){case Key.Up:case Key.W:MenuPanel?.SelectPrevious();break;case Key.Down:case Key.S:MenuPanel?.SelectNext();break;case Key.Enter:case Key.Space:MenuPanel?.ConfirmSelection();break;case Key.Escape:OnMenuCancel?.Invoke();break;}}private void HandleSubMenuInput(InputEventKey key){switch(key.Keycode){case Key.Up:case Key.W:SubMenuPanel?.SelectPrevious();break;case Key.Down:case Key.S:SubMenuPanel?.SelectNext();break;case Key.Enter:case Key.Space:SubMenuPanel?.ConfirmSelection();break;case Key.Escape:OnSubMenuCancel?.Invoke();break;}}private void HandleTargetInput(InputEventKey key){if(key.Keycode==Key.Escape){OnMenuCancel?.Invoke();}}private void SelectFirstAvailableCharacter(){if(PlayerPanel==null)return;foreach(var widget in PlayerPanel.Widgets){if(!widget.IsDead&&widget.Card?.Attributes?.Point?.Value>0){OnCharacterSelected?.Invoke(widget);return;}}}/// <summary> Selects a character widget, raising <see cref="OnCharacterSelected"/>. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.UI{/// <summary> Panel that arranges enemy character widgets in a grid layout and handles their lifecycle. Listens to each widget's health change and triggers <see cref="FFCharacterWidget.PlayDeathAnimation"/> when HP reaches zero, then removes the dead widget and re-grids the survivors. Raises <see cref="OnEnemyDead"/> so <see cref="FFBattleCore"/> can check win conditions. </summary>
public partial class FFEnemyPanel:ModWidget{private const float BASE_W=180f;private const float BASE_H=260f;private const float MIN_SCALE=0.25f;private const float MAX_SCALE=1.0f;private const float CELL_PADDING=10f;/// <summary>All enemy character widgets currently in the panel, including dead ones until removed.</summary>
public List<FFCharacterWidget>Widgets{get;}=new();/// <summary>Raised when a widget's death animation completes and the widget is removed.</summary>
public event System.Action<FFCharacterWidget>OnEnemyDead;/// <summary>Raised when an enemy widget is clicked (used for target selection).</summary>
public event System.Action<FFCharacterWidget>OnEnemyClicked;/// <summary>Builds the enemy grid panel and lays out enemy widgets.</summary>
protected override void Construct(){CthangoverTheme.Apply(this);}/// <summary>Number of enemy widget instances currently managed (including dead).</summary>
public int EnemyCount=>Widgets.Count;/// <summary> Creates <see cref="FFCharacterWidget"/> instances for each enemy, scales them uniformly, wires click and health-change handlers, and calls <see cref="GridLayout"/> to arrange them. </summary>
public void Init(Character[]enemies,float scale){foreach(var child in Widgets)child.QueueFree();Widgets.Clear();for(int i=0;i<enemies.Length;i++){var widget=(FFCharacterWidget)TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/ff_character_widget.tscn");widget.EnsureConstructed();widget.Scale=new Vector2(scale,scale);widget.IsPlayer=false;widget.Init(enemies[i]);widget.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;widget.GuiInput+=(evt)=>{if(evt is InputEventMouseButton mb&&mb.Pressed&&mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left)OnEnemyClicked?.Invoke(widget);};AddChild(widget);Widgets.Add(widget);enemies[i].Attributes.Health.OnChange+=(value,baseValue)=>{if(value<=0&& !widget.IsDead)HandleDeath(widget);};}GridLayout();}/// <summary> Computes a uniform scale factor so all enemies fit within <paramref name="panelSize"/> with padding. Uses <see cref="GetGridDimensions"/> to determine layout, then chooses the tighter of width-based and height-based scales, clamped to [<c>MIN_SCALE</c>, <c>MAX_SCALE</c>]. </summary>
public static float CalculateScale(int enemyCount,Vector2 panelSize){var(cols,rows)=GetGridDimensions(enemyCount);float availW=panelSize.X-CELL_PADDING*2;float availH=panelSize.Y-CELL_PADDING*2;float scaleByW=(availW-(cols-1)*CELL_PADDING)/(cols*BASE_W);float scaleByH=(availH-(rows-1)*CELL_PADDING)/(rows*BASE_H);float scale=Mathf.Min(scaleByW,scaleByH);scale=Mathf.Clamp(scale,MIN_SCALE,MAX_SCALE);return scale;}/// <summary> Determines grid dimensions for a given count: 1–4 → single row, 5–10 → 2 rows, 11–16 → 3 rows, 17+ → 4 rows. </summary>
public static(int cols,int rows)GetGridDimensions(int count){if(count<=4)return(count,1);if(count<=10)return((count+1)/2,2);if(count<=16)return((count+2)/3,3);return((count+3)/4,4);}/// <summary>Repositions all widgets into the calculated grid, with optional 0.3s cubic tween animation.</summary>
public void GridLayout(bool animate=true){var(cols,rows)=GetGridDimensions(Widgets.Count);for(int i=0;i<Widgets.Count;i++){var widget=Widgets[i];if(widget==null)continue;int row=i/cols;int col=i%cols;var totalColsInRow=row<rows-1?cols:(Widgets.Count-row*cols);if(totalColsInRow<=0)totalColsInRow=1;var effW=widget.Size.X*widget.Scale.X;var effH=widget.Size.Y*widget.Scale.Y;float startX=(Size.X-(totalColsInRow*effW+(totalColsInRow-1)*CELL_PADDING))/2f;float startY=CELL_PADDING;var targetPos=new Vector2(startX+col*(effW+CELL_PADDING),startY+row*(effH+CELL_PADDING));if(animate){var tween=CreateTween();tween.SetEase(Tween.EaseType.Out).SetTrans(Tween.TransitionType.Cubic);tween.TweenProperty(widget,"position",targetPos,0.3f);}else{widget.Position=targetPos;}}}private void HandleDeath(FFCharacterWidget widget){if(widget.IsDead)return;widget.PlayDeathAnimation(()=>{RemoveWidget(widget);GridLayout(true);OnEnemyDead?.Invoke(widget);});}/// <summary>Removes a widget from the panel, frees it, and re-grids the remaining widgets.</summary>
public void RemoveWidget(FFCharacterWidget widget){Widgets.Remove(widget);widget.QueueFree();GridLayout();}/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> if any widget in the panel is not marked dead.</summary>
public bool HasAlive(){foreach(var w in Widgets)if(!w.IsDead)return true;return false;}/// <summary>Frees all widget instances and clears the widget list. Called on battle cleanup.</summary>
public void ClearAll(){foreach(var widget in Widgets.ToList()){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(widget))widget.QueueFree();}Widgets.Clear();GridLayout(false);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Cthangover.FFBattle.UI{/// <summary> Panel that arranges player character widgets horizontally at the bottom of the battle screen. Creates one <see cref="FFCharacterWidget"/> per player character, wires click and health-change handlers, and positions them using fixed horizontal spacing via <see cref="Redraw"/>. When a player's HP drops to zero, the widget plays its death animation and is removed; the remaining widgets are repositioned. Exposes <see cref="HasAlive"/> for win/loss checks. </summary>
public partial class FFPlayerPanel:ModWidget{private const float CELL_SPACING=20f;/// <summary>All player character widgets, including dead ones until their death animation completes.</summary>
public List<FFCharacterWidget>Widgets{get;}=new();/// <summary>Raised when a player widget is clicked — routed to <see cref="FFBattleCore"/> for character selection.</summary>
public event System.Action<FFCharacterWidget>OnWidgetClicked;/// <summary>Builds the bottom player-party panel hosting one widget per party member.</summary>
protected override void Construct(){CthangoverTheme.Apply(this);}/// <summary> Creates <see cref="FFCharacterWidget"/> instances for each player, scales them uniformly, wires click and health-change handlers, and calls <see cref="Redraw"/> to position them horizontally. </summary>
public void Init(Character[]players,float scale){foreach(var child in Widgets)child.QueueFree();Widgets.Clear();for(int i=0;i<players.Length;i++){var widget=(FFCharacterWidget)TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild("scenes/ff_character_widget.tscn");widget.EnsureConstructed();widget.Scale=new Vector2(scale,scale);widget.IsPlayer=true;widget.Init(players[i]);widget.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;widget.GuiInput+=(evt)=>{if(evt is InputEventMouseButton mb&&mb.Pressed&&mb.ButtonIndex==MouseButton.Left)OnWidgetClicked?.Invoke(widget);};AddChild(widget);Widgets.Add(widget);players[i].Attributes.Health.OnChange+=(value,baseValue)=>{widget.UpdateInfo();if(value<=0&& !widget.IsDead){widget.PlayDeathAnimation(()=>{RemoveWidget(widget);Redraw();});}};}Redraw();}/// <summary>Repositions all widgets in a horizontal row with fixed <c>CELL_SPACING</c> between them.</summary>
public void Redraw(){for(int i=0;i<Widgets.Count;i++){var widget=Widgets[i];if(widget==null)continue;var effWidth=widget.Size.X*widget.Scale.X;var effHeight=widget.Size.Y*widget.Scale.Y;widget.Position=new Vector2(i*(effWidth+CELL_SPACING)+CELL_SPACING,Size.Y-effHeight-CELL_SPACING);}}/// <summary>Returns <c>true</c> if any widget is alive and has positive health.</summary>
public bool HasAlive(){return Widgets.Any(w=> !w.IsDead&&w.Card?.Attributes?.Health?.Value>0);}/// <summary>Frees all widget instances and clears the widget list. Called on battle cleanup.</summary>
public void ClearAll(){foreach(var widget in Widgets.ToList()){if(GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(widget))widget.QueueFree();}Widgets.Clear();Redraw();}/// <summary>Removes a widget from the panel, frees it, and repositions remaining widgets.</summary>
public void RemoveWidget(FFCharacterWidget widget){Widgets.Remove(widget);widget.QueueFree();Redraw();}}}

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Interactive{/// <summary> JSON-driven definition of an interactive scene object loaded from mods. The texture is always full-screen (alpha determines visibility outside the collider). The collider defines the clickable region in normalised 0..1 viewport coordinates. Interactives keep their own resolver and <c>{"Items": [...]}</c> envelope; unlike other entity kinds they are not part of the kind-routed pipeline. </summary>
public class InteractiveDefinition:IIdentifiable{/// <summary>Unique identifier used in scenario commands and registry lookups.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("id")]public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary>Owning mod identifier set by ModManager during collection.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public string ModId{get;set;}/// <summary>Texture key resolved via <c>ModManager.ResolveTexture</c>. Full-screen with alpha.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("texture")]public string Texture{get;set;}/// <summary>Visual layer: "background", "foreground" or "ui". Defaults to "foreground".</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("layer")]public string Layer{get;set;}="foreground";/// <summary>Z-index for ordering within the layer. Higher = on top.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("zIndex")]public int ZIndex{get;set;}/// <summary>Whether the object is initially enabled (responds to input). Default true.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("enabled")]public bool Enabled{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Whether the object is initially visible. Default true.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("visible")]public bool Visible{get;set;}=true;/// <summary>Mouse cursor override when hovering (Godot CursorShape enum name, e.g. "PointingHand").</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("cursor")]public string Cursor{get;set;}/// <summary>Collider shape and position in normalised viewport coordinates (0..1).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("hitArea")]public HitAreaDefinition HitArea{get;set;}/// <summary>Visual highlight settings applied on hover.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("highlight")]public HighlightDefinition Highlight{get;set;}/// <summary>Actions triggered by pointer events.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("actions")]public InteractiveActionDefinition Actions{get;set;}}/// <summary> Shape and position of the clickable collider in normalised viewport coordinates (0..1), where (0,0) is the top-left corner and (1,1) is bottom-right. </summary>
public class HitAreaDefinition{/// <summary><c>"rect"</c>, <c>"circle"</c> or <c>"polygon"</c>. Defaults to <c>"rect"</c>.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("type")]public string Type{get;set;}="rect";/// <summary>X position of the collider origin (top-left for rect, centre for circle). Normalised 0..1.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("x")]public float X{get;set;}/// <summary>Y position of the collider origin. Normalised 0..1.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("y")]public float Y{get;set;}/// <summary>Width for rect type. Normalised 0..1.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("width")]public float Width{get;set;}=0.1f;/// <summary>Height for rect type. Normalised 0..1.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("height")]public float Height{get;set;}=0.1f;/// <summary>Radius for circle type. Normalised 0..1 (relative to viewport min dimension).</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("radius")]public float Radius{get;set;}=0.05f;/// <summary>Polygon vertices as an array of normalised Vector2 points. Only for "polygon" type.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("vertices")][JsonConverter(typeof(Vector2ArrayJsonConverter))]public Vector2[]Vertices{get;set;}}/// <summary> Highlight effect applied when the pointer hovers over the collider. Uses a shader-based colour modulation on the full-screen texture. </summary>
public class HighlightDefinition{/// <summary>Modulate colour as a hex string (e.g. "#FFFF0033"). Parsed to Godot.Color at runtime.</summary>

[JsonPropertyName("scale")]public float Scale{get;set;}=1.02f;/// <summary>Duration in seconds of the hover/unhover animation.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("duration")]public float Duration{get;set;}=0.15f;/// <summary>Parsed Godot.Color from ColorHex. Computed at load time, not serialised.</summary>
[JsonIgnore]public Color Color=>ParseColor(ColorHex);private static Color ParseColor(string hex){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(hex))return UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.3f);try{return new Color(hex);}catch{return UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Accent,0.3f);}}}/// <summary> Actions dispatched on pointer events. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Factory for <c>InteractiveDefinition</c> lookups. Wraps <c>ModManager.CollectInteractives()</c> with a thread-safe singleton accessor. Since the underlying collection is already cached by <c>ModManager</c>, this factory is a thin forwarding layer that provides the same <c>Instance.Get(id)</c> API convention as every other factory in the project. <para/> The single instance lives in this mod assembly as a static lazy singleton; the static facade stays as the public API. </summary>
public class InteractiveFactory{private static InteractiveFactory _instance;/// <summary>Static lazy singleton; kept as the public API.</summary>
public static InteractiveFactory Instance=>_instance??=new InteractiveFactory();private InteractiveFactory(){}/// <summary> Looks up an interactive definition by its unique ID. Returns <c>null</c> if no definition with that ID exists in any mod. </summary> <param name="id">The <c>ID</c> from the definition JSON.</param>
public InteractiveDefinition Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;var dict=Interactives.Collect();if(dict!=null&&dict.TryGetValue(id,out var def))return def;GameLogger.Log("FACTORY",$"InteractiveFactory: definition '{id}' not found",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Interactive{/// <summary> Central registry for active interactive objects on the current scene. Created and owned by <c>SceneContextNode</c> so its state is automatically cleared when the scene changes. Access via <c>InteractiveManager.Instance</c> (set during <c>SceneContextNode._Ready</c>). </summary>
public class InteractiveManager{private static InteractiveManager _instance;/// <summary> Singleton instance, valid only while a scene is active. Set by <c>SceneContextNode</c> on scene enter, cleared on scene exit. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interactive{/// <summary> Engine-mod initializer for the interactive subsystem. Takes over the lifecycle <c>SceneContextNode</c> owned before the migration: on resources-ready it initializes the <c>InteractiveManager</c> singleton and subscribes the per-scene teardown (<c>InteractiveManager.Shutdown</c>) to <c>SceneExitedEvent</c>, so tracked interactive objects are destroyed on every scene change. All operations are idempotent: <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> re-runs <c>OnModResourcesReady</c>, so repeat invocations must not corrupt state. </summary>
public class InteractiveModInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool initialized;/// <summary>No per-mod setup is required; lifecycle happens on resources-ready.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Initializes the manager singleton and wires the scene-exit teardown. Safe to call again after a mod reload. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(initialized)return;initialized=true;InteractiveManager.Initialize();GameLogger.Log("INTERACTIVE","InteractiveModInitializer: manager initialized");ModEventBus.Subscribe<SceneExitedEvent>(_=>InteractiveManager.Shutdown());}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Interactive;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers{/// <summary> Collects interactive object definitions from mods. Interactives are environment objects that the player can interact with in scenes — they are defined in <c>.json</c> files under <c>interactives/</c> directories. Each definition specifies an interaction type, position, appearance, and behaviour. Collected in mod load order — later mods override earlier ones for the same interactive ID, enabling mods to replace or extend base game interactives. </summary>
public class InteractiveResolver:ModAssetResolver{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"interactives";private Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>_cache;/// <summary> Collects all interactive definitions from every loaded mod, keyed by interactive ID. Later mods in load order override earlier ones for the same ID. Caches the result. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>Collect(){Context.Initialize();if(_cache!=null)return _cache;var result=new Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>();foreach(var modId in Context.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=Context.Mods[modId].FileProvider;CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(provider,modId,"interactives",result);}_cache=result;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"CollectInteractives -> {result.Count} definition(s)");return result;}/// <inheritdoc />
public override void ClearCache(){_cache=null;}private void CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(IModFileProvider provider,string modId,string dir,Dictionary<string,InteractiveDefinition>result){foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(dir)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){var subDir=entry.TrimEnd('/');CollectInteractiveDefsRecursive(provider,modId,subDir,result);continue;}if(!entry.EndsWith(".json",System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=Context.ReadResolvedText(modId,entry,provider);if(text==null)continue;try{var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<InteractiveDefinition>>(text,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);if(fileData?.Items==null||fileData.Items.Count==0)continue;foreach(var item in fileData.Items){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ID))continue;item.ModId=modId;if(result.ContainsKey(item.ID)){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"interactive '{item.ID}' from mod '{modId}' overrides previous definition",LogLevel.Warning);AppServices.Current.Conflicts.RecordConflict("interactive",item.ID,modId,result[item.ID].ModId,false);}result[item.ID]=item;GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"interactive '{item.ID}' from mod '{modId}' ({entry})");}}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MODS",$"JSON parse failed for interactive '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}/// <summary> Static convenience accessor for <see cref="InteractiveResolver"/>, proxying through <see cref="ModManager.Instance.GetResolver{T}"/>. </summary>
public static class Interactives{/// <summary>Collects every interactive definition from all mods, keyed by id (later mods override).</summary>

using System;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.Interactive{/// <summary> Custom JSON converter for <c>Godot.Vector2</c>. System.Text.Json cannot natively deserialise Godot's Vector2 from <c>{"x":0.72,"y":0.45}</c> because its X/Y members are fields, not properties. This converter handles the <c>{"x":...,"y":...}</c> object format used throughout interactive definition JSON files. </summary>
public class Vector2JsonConverter:JsonConverter<Vector2>{/// <summary>Reads a JSON object with "x" and "y" number members into a Vector2.</summary>
public override Vector2 Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.StartObject)throw new JsonException("Expected object for Vector2");float x=0f;float y=0f;while(reader.Read()){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.EndObject)break;if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.PropertyName){var prop=reader.GetString();reader.Read();if(string.Equals(prop,"x",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))x=reader.GetSingle();else if(string.Equals(prop,"y",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))y=reader.GetSingle();else reader.Skip();}}return new Vector2(x,y);}/// <summary>Writes a Vector2 as {"x":...,"y":...}.</summary>
public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,Vector2 value,JsonSerializerOptions options){writer.WriteStartObject();writer.WriteNumber("x",value.X);writer.WriteNumber("y",value.Y);writer.WriteEndObject();}}/// <summary> JSON converter for <c>Vector2[]</c> arrays. Each element uses the <c>Vector2JsonConverter</c> for deserialisation. </summary>
public class Vector2ArrayJsonConverter:JsonConverter<Vector2[]>{/// <summary>Reads a JSON array of <c>{"x":...,"y":...}</c> objects into a Vector2[].</summary>
public override Vector2[]Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader,Type typeToConvert,JsonSerializerOptions options){if(reader.TokenType!=JsonTokenType.StartArray)throw new JsonException("Expected array for Vector2[]");var list=new System.Collections.Generic.List<Vector2>();var vecConverter=new Vector2JsonConverter();while(reader.Read()){if(reader.TokenType==JsonTokenType.EndArray)break;list.Add(vecConverter.Read(ref reader,typeof(Vector2),options));}return list.ToArray();}/// <summary>Writes a Vector2[] as an array of {"x":...,"y":...} objects.</summary>
public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer,Vector2[]value,JsonSerializerOptions options){var vecConverter=new Vector2JsonConverter();writer.WriteStartArray();foreach(var v in value)vecConverter.Write(writer,v,options);writer.WriteEndArray();}}}

lamp.EmitSignal(Control.SignalName.MouseExited);Check("hover enter/exit handled, lamp still enabled",lamp.IsEnabled&&lamp.IsInsideTree());lamp._GuiInput(new InputEventMouseButton{ButtonIndex=MouseButton.Left,Pressed=true,Position=lamp.Size/2});Next();return;case 3:var box=SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");var clicked=box?.Runtime.GetVariable("lamp_clicked");if(clicked!="yes"&& !Waited(5))return;Check("click started the onClick dialog (waits on its text)",box is{IsDialogEnded:false});Check("onClick scenario ran (lamp_clicked=yes)"+(clicked=="yes"?string.Empty:$" (got '{clicked}')"),clicked=="yes");Finish();return;}}private bool Waited(double seconds)=>elapsed-stepStarted>seconds;private void Next(){step++;stepStarted=elapsed;}private void Check(string what,bool ok){if(ok)passed++;else failed++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"  [{(ok ? using System;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Items{/// <summary> Restores health of the chosen party member (<c>"ItemAction": "action/heal"</c>). The amount is item data, not code: the item's <c>"heal"</c> key (an extra JSON key, so it lands in <see cref="IItem.Properties"/>), which lets one action serve a mushroom and an elixir alike. Health never rises above its base value, and a fallen character (health 0) is not revived — that is a different effect. The party member's attributes are the very objects the battle uses, so a heal in the inventory during a battle shows on the battle widgets at once. </summary>
public class HealItemAction:ITargetedItemAction{/// <summary>Item property with the amount of health restored.</summary>
public const string HealProperty="heal";/// <summary>Action id referenced by item definitions.</summary>
public string ID=>"action/heal";/// <summary>Healing always needs a target; without one nothing happens.</summary>
public bool UseAction(IItem item)=>false;/// <summary> Adds the item's <c>heal</c> amount to the target's health, capped at the base value. Returns <c>false</c> (item not spent) for a missing target, a non-positive amount, a fallen target or one already at full health. </summary>
public bool UseOn(IItem item,CharacterInfoData target){var health=target?.Attributes?.Health;var amount=item?.Properties?.GetInt(HealProperty)??0;if(health==null||amount<=0||health.Value<=0||health.Value>=health.BaseValue)return false;health.Value=Math.Min(health.BaseValue,health.Value+amount);return true;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Items{/// <summary> Concrete player inventory backed by an ordered <c>List&lt;IItemContainer&gt;</c>. Uses LINQ scans (<c>FirstOrDefault</c>, <c>Any</c>) rather than a <c>Dictionary</c> because inventory sizes in this game are small enough that O(n) lookups are imperceptible, and list ordering directly drives UI slot layout — the first container appears in the first grid cell. On <c>Remove</c>, when a stack count reaches zero the entire container is deleted from the list rather than kept as an empty slot, preventing the UI from rendering gaps. The constructor seeds wolf meat and branches for testing convenience — in production, save data would override this initial state. The <c>Change</c> event fires with <c>(itemId, delta)</c> so subscribers receive full context. Additionally, each mutation publishes an <c>InventoryChangedEvent</c> to the global <c>ModEventBus</c>. </summary>
public class Inventory:IInventory{/// <summary>Ordered slot list; order drives UI layout and empty slots are removed on zero stacks.</summary>
public List<IItemContainer>Items{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Stacks a loaded save names but no loaded mod defines (the mod was removed or the id renamed). They are no usable stacks — every container in <see cref="Items"/> has an item — but the items slot writes them back, so they return with their mod. </summary>
public List<Settings.CItem>UnresolvedItems{get;}=new();/// <summary>Fires on every successful add/remove with (itemId, signed delta); also mirrored as <see cref="Events.InventoryChangedEvent"/> on the ModEventBus.</summary>
public event Action<string,int>Change;/// <summary>True when any slot holds the given item (null-safe).</summary>
public bool HasItem(IItem item){if(item==null)return false;return HasItem(item.ID);}/// <summary>True when any slot holds the item with the given id; null/empty ids return false.</summary>
public bool HasItem(string id){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id))return false;return Items.Any(o=>o.Item!=null&&o.Item.ID==id);}/// <summary>Returns the slot holding the given item, or <c>null</c> (null-safe).</summary>
public IItemContainer TryGet(IItem item){if(item==null)return null;return TryGet(item.ID);}/// <summary>Returns the slot holding the given id, or <c>null</c> for null/empty ids.</summary>
public IItemContainer TryGet(string id){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id))return null;return Items.FirstOrDefault(o=>o.Item!=null&&o.Item.ID==id);}/// <summary>Total count across slots for the given item (0 when absent or null).</summary>
public int CheckCount(IItem item){if(item==null)return 0;return CheckCount(item.ID);}/// <summary>Total count across slots for the given id (0 when absent).</summary>
public int CheckCount(string id){var container=TryGet(id);return container?.Count??0;}/// <summary>Adds the item (delegates to the id overload); null items are ignored.</summary>
public void Add(IItem item,int count=1){if(item==null)return;Add(item.ID,count);}/// <summary> Stacks onto an existing slot or creates a new one by resolving the id through <see cref="Factories.Impls.ItemFactory"/>; unknown ids are silently ignored. Fires <see cref="Change"/> and publishes <see cref="Events.InventoryChangedEvent"/> on success. </summary>
public void Add(string id,int count=1){if(count<=0){GameLogger.Log("INVENTORY",$"Add('{id}', {count}): count must be positive, ignored",LogLevel.Warning);return;}var container=TryGet(id);if(container!=null){container.Count+=count;Change?.Invoke(id,count);PublishInventoryChanged(id,count,container.Count);return;}var item=ItemFactory.Instance.Get(id);if(item!=null){container=new ItemContainer{Item=item,Count=count,};Items.Add(container);Change?.Invoke(id,count);PublishInventoryChanged(id,count,count);}}/// <summary>Removes the item (delegates to the id overload); null items return false.</summary>
public bool Remove(IItem item,int count=1){if(item==null)return false;return Remove(item.ID,count);}/// <summary> Removes <paramref name="count"/> items from the slot, deleting the container when the stack reaches zero. Returns <c>false</c> without changes when the slot holds fewer items than requested. </summary>
public bool Remove(string id,int count=1){// A negative count would pass the stock check and grow the stack.
if(count<=0)return false;var container=TryGet(id);if(container==null)return false;var delta=container.Count-count;if(delta<0)return false;if(delta==0)Items.Remove(container);else container.Count-=count;var newCount=delta==0?0:delta;Change?.Invoke(id,-count);PublishInventoryChanged(id,-count,newCount);return true;}private static void PublishInventoryChanged(string itemId,int delta,int newCount){ModEventBus.Publish(new InventoryChangedEvent{ItemId=itemId,Delta=delta,NewCount=newCount,});}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Items;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Registry of item action behaviours, indexed by <c>ID</c>. It discovers nothing itself: C# actions of every mod arrive through <c>ItemActionConsumer</c> as the kernel registers their assembly and leave with their mod, and GDScript-declared actions arrive through <c>ItemActionBridge</c>. A mod therefore introduces a new item action simply by containing a public class that implements the interface. The <c>"null"</c> ID string is treated as a no-op action (the fallback for items that don't have an on-use effect), avoiding the need for a sentinel <c>NullItemAction</c> class. <para/> The single instance lives in this mod assembly as a static lazy singleton; the static facade stays as the public API. </summary>
public class ItemActionFactory{private static ItemActionFactory _instance;/// <summary>Static lazy singleton; kept as the public API.</summary>
public static ItemActionFactory Instance=>_instance??=new ItemActionFactory();private readonly IDictionary<string,IItemAction>data=new Dictionary<string,IItemAction>();internal ItemActionFactory(){}/// <summary>Registers a single action under its <see cref="IItemAction.ID"/>; the first action of an id wins, null/empty ids are ignored.</summary>
public void Register(IItemAction action){if(action!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(action.ID)&& !data.ContainsKey(action.ID))data[action.ID]=action;}/// <summary> Removes exactly <paramref name="action"/> (its mod is being unloaded); an id owned by another action instance is left alone. </summary>
public void Unregister(IItemAction action){if(action!=null&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(action.ID)&&data.TryGetValue(action.ID,out var registered)&&registered==action)data.Remove(action.ID);}/// <summary> Resolves the behaviour registered under <paramref name="id"/>. The special id <c>"null"</c> (or an empty value) is an explicit no-action marker and returns <c>null</c>, as does an unknown id. </summary>
public IItemAction Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id)||id=="null")return null;return data[id];}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> The single instance lives in this mod assembly as a static lazy singleton; the static facade stays as the public API. </summary>
public class ItemFactory{private static ItemFactory _instance;/// <summary>Static lazy singleton; kept as the public API.</summary>
public static ItemFactory Instance=>_instance??=new ItemFactory();/// <summary> Builds a fresh <see cref="Item"/> from the collected <see cref="ItemInfo"/>, resolving the sprite through <see cref="ItemSpriteFactory"/>, the on-use action through <see cref="ItemActionFactory"/>, and importing extra JSON keys into <see cref="Item.Properties"/>. Unknown or empty ids return <c>null</c>. </summary>
public IItem Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;// Entities.Collect is cached by the entity resolver until the next mod reload, so reading it every time serves the current data.

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Items;namespace Cthangover.Core.Settings{/// <summary> Tracks which crafting recipes the player has unlocked. Internally a <see cref="HashSet{String}"/> of recipe IDs that provides <c>O(1)</c> lookup. Recipes can be queried by <see cref="IRecipe.WorkbenchType"/> via <see cref="GetRecipesByType"/>, which resolves each ID through <see cref="Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls.RecipeFactory"/> and filters the resulting <see cref="IRecipe"/> objects. </summary>
public class RecipeData:IRecipeData{/// <summary>Set of known recipe IDs (duplicate insertion is silently ignored).</summary>
public HashSet<string>Data{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Unlocks a recipe by ID. Returns <c>false</c> if the recipe was already known (duplicate). </summary>
public bool Add(string id){return Data.Add(id);}/// <summary><c>true</c> if the recipe with the given ID is already unlocked.</summary>
public bool Has(string id){return Data.Contains(id);}/// <summary> Returns all known recipes that belong to the specified <see cref="WorkbenchType"/>. public List<IRecipe>GetRecipesByType(WorkbenchType type){return Data.Select(o=>RecipeFactory.Instance.Get(o)).Where(o=>o.WorkbenchType==type).ToList();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls{/// <summary> Factory for crafting recipes. Uses <c>BoundedCache</c> because the crafting UI may repeatedly query recipes during scrolling and the ingredient resolution (through <c>ItemFactory</c>) is non-trivial. Recipes are treated as immutable value objects — <c>Get</c> returns the cached instance directly without copying. Missing ingredient items emit an error and skip that ingredient rather than failing the whole recipe, so a mod author's typo in one input doesn't silently break the crafting UI for unrelated recipes. <para/> The single instance lives in this mod assembly as a static lazy singleton; the static facade stays as the public API. </summary>
public class RecipeFactory:ICacheLoader<string,IRecipe>{private static RecipeFactory _instance;/// <summary>Static lazy singleton; kept as the public API.</summary>
public static RecipeFactory Instance=>_instance??=new RecipeFactory();private Dictionary<string,RecipeInfo>_allInfos;private readonly BoundedCache<string,IRecipe>_cache;internal RecipeFactory(){var size=ModConfig.Instance.Cache.GetCacheSize("recipes",128);_cache=new BoundedCache<string,IRecipe>(size,this);}IRecipe ICacheLoader<string,IRecipe>.Load(string id){var infos=EnsureInfos();if(infos.TryGetValue(id,out var info))return CreateRecipe(info);return null;}/// <summary> Returns the recipe definitions, collecting them on first use. Publication to <c>_allInfos</c> waits until the mod registry is finalized so an early lookup from the launcher boot window cannot freeze an empty snapshot for the session. </summary>
private Dictionary<string,RecipeInfo>EnsureInfos(){// The resolver's dictionary identity is the data snapshot: a new one drops the built recipes.
var infos=Entities.Collect<RecipeInfo>();if(!ReferenceEquals(infos,_allInfos)){_allInfos=infos;_cache.Clear();}return infos;}/// <summary> Returns the cached recipe for <paramref name="id"/> (resolved lazily through <see cref="RecipeFactory.Load"/>), or <c>null</c> for unknown or empty ids. The shared instance is returned without copying — recipes are treated as immutable. </summary>
public IRecipe Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;EnsureInfos();return _cache.Get(id);}private static Recipe CreateRecipe(RecipeInfo info){return new Recipe{ID=info.ID,Name=info.Name,Description=info.Description,Time=info.Time,WorkbenchType=info.Type,Input=info.Input.Select(i=>CreateIngredient(i)).Where(i=>i!=null).ToList(),Output=info.Output.Select(i=>CreateIngredient(i)).Where(i=>i!=null).ToList()};}private static IIngredient CreateIngredient(IngredientInfo info){var item=ItemFactory.Instance.Get(info.ID);if(item==null){GameLogger.Log("MOD_TEST",$"RecipeFactory: item '{info.ID}' not found in ItemFactory",LogLevel.Error);return null;}return new Ingredient{Item=item,Count=info.Count};}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Core.UI.Inventory{/// <summary> Shared presentation rules for inventory items, used by both the grid cell and the item passport so the two can never disagree about an item's affordances. <see cref="ItemType"/> is a flags enum, so every question ("can this be used?", "what badge colour?") has to pick a priority among possibly overlapping flags — the order in <see cref="BadgeOrder"/> defines that priority consistently. A custom verb can be supplied by mods through the item's <c>Properties</c> bag under the <c>verb</c> key; it is treated as a locale key when it contains a slash and as a literal otherwise. </summary>
public static class InventoryItemUi{/// <summary>Badge order from most narrative to most technical flag.</summary>
public static readonly IReadOnlyList<ItemType>BadgeOrder=new[]{ItemType.Quest,ItemType.Used,ItemType.TargetUsed,ItemType.Food,ItemType.Resource,ItemType.Recipe,ItemType.CantDrop,};/// <summary> Mirrors <c>InventoryPanelBehaviour</c> use-button rule: an item is usable only when it carries an action and one of the "used" flags. Food or resources without an <see cref="IItemAction"/> are inert. </summary>
public static bool IsUsable(IItem item){if(item==null||item.ItemAction==null)return false;return item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.Used)||item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.TargetUsed);}/// <summary>False only for <see cref="ItemType.CantDrop"/> items (quest objectives, key items).</summary>
public static bool CanDrop(IItem item){return item!=null&& !item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.CantDrop);}/// <summary> Locale key (or literal) of the verb shown on the action button. Resolution order: mod-provided <c>verb</c> property, recipe, targeted, food, generic use. </summary>
public static string VerbKey(IItem item){if(item==null)return"ui/inventory/verb_use";var custom=item.Properties?.GetStr("verb");if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(custom))return custom;if(item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.Recipe))return"ui/inventory/verb_recipe";if(item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.TargetUsed))return"ui/inventory/verb_target";if(item.ItemType.HasFlag(ItemType.Food))return"ui/inventory/verb_eat";return"ui/inventory/verb_use";}/// <summary> Short corner tag for the grid cell. Only actionable items get a tag — an inert resource must not advertise a verb it cannot run. </summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.InventoryTest{/// <summary> Драйвер интеграционного GUI-теста инвентаря. Проходит по реальному UI теми же контрактами, что и игрок: открывает панель через публичный <see cref="UiRegistry.Toggle"/> (тот же путь, что кнопка тулбара), сеет детерминированные предметы через публичный <c>IInventory.Add</c>, кликает ячейку эмуляцией Godot-сигнала <c>gui_input</c> (обработчик ячейки подписан на него — мод не может переопределять виртуальные методы, но сигналы из мод-сборок работают), фильтрует через <c>LineEdit</c>-сигнал <c>text_changed</c> и закрывает панель. Машина состояний: один шаг за тик таймера (0.4с), чтобы отложенные пересборки сетки успевали примениться. Каждый шаг — отдельная проверка: исход фиксируется, провал не прерывает остальные. Итог — контракт раннера <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=inventory_test passed=N failed=M</c> и код выхода процесса. Общий watchdog (<c>--timeout=</c>, по умолчанию 60с) гасит зависание с failed=1 — тем же контрактом, что и у DialogAutoDriverNode. </summary>
public partial class InventoryTestDriverNode:Node{private const string ResultName="inventory_test";private const string PanelEntryId="inventory";private const float TickSeconds=0.4f;private const float DefaultTimeoutSeconds=60f;private readonly float?timeoutSeconds;private readonly List<string>failures=new();private int passed;private int failed;private int step;private double elapsed;private Control panel;private Control gridContent;private LineEdit search;/// <summary>Создаёт драйвер с watchdog-таймаутом (null — дефолт 60с) и ставит тикающий таймер-ребёнок.</summary>
public InventoryTestDriverNode(float?timeoutSeconds){this.timeoutSeconds=timeoutSeconds;var timer=new Timer{Name="TickTimer",WaitTime=TickSeconds,Autostart=true,OneShot=false};AddChild(timer);timer.Timeout+=Tick;}/// <summary>Один шаг машины состояний: ожидание готовности, затем проверки по очереди.</summary>
private void Tick(){if(step<0)return;// тест уже завершён
elapsed+=TickSeconds;var limit=timeoutSeconds??DefaultTimeoutSeconds;if(elapsed>=limit){Finish($"timeout ({limit:0}s) reached at step {step}");return;}try{RunStep();}catch(System.Exception ex){failures.Add($"step {step}: unhandled {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");failed++;Log($"[FAIL] step {step}: {ex.Message}");Finish(null);}}private void RunStep(){// Шаг 0: ждём готовности — бут завершён и сцена вошла в дерево.
if(step==0){var ready=Boot.IsReady&&GameData.Instance?.Runtime!=null&&(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.CurrentScene!=null;if(!ready)return;// ждём дальше, watchdog страхует
Log("environment ready (boot complete, scene entered)");Next();return;}// Шаг 1: UI-запись инвентаря зарегистрирована модом cthangover_game.
if(step==1){Check("entry registered",()=>{var entry=AppServices.Current.Ui.GetById(PanelEntryId);if(entry==null)throw new CheckException($"ui entry '{PanelEntryId}' not found");});Next();return;}// Шаг 2: сеем детерминированные предметы через публичный API инвентаря (в этой сессии; сохранения тест не пишет).
if(step==2){Check("inventory seed via IInventory.Add",()=>{var inv=GameData.Instance.Runtime.Inventory;if(inv==null)throw new CheckException("Runtime.Inventory is null (items mod factory missing?)");inv.Add("food/ration",3);inv.Add("food/wolf_meat",2);if(inv.CheckCount("food/ration")<3)throw new CheckException("food/ration count < 3 after Add");if(inv.CheckCount("food/wolf_meat")<2)throw new CheckException("food/wolf_meat count < 2 after Add");});Next();return;}// Шаг 3: открываем панель тем же вызовом, что и кнопка тулбара.
if(step==3){Check("open via UiRegistry.Toggle",()=>{UiRegistry.Toggle(PanelEntryId);if(!UiHost.Instance.TryGetInstance(PanelEntryId,out panel)||panel==null)throw new CheckException("panel instance not created by Toggle");if(!panel.Visible)throw new CheckException("panel not visible after Toggle");});Next();return;}// Шаг 4: сетка отрисовала засеянные предметы.
if(step==4){Check("grid renders seeded items",()=>{gridContent=panel.FindChild("GridContent",true,false)as Control;if(gridContent==null)throw new CheckException("GridContent node not found");// Один кадр на пересборку после Add: если ячейки ещё не успели, тик-ждать нельзя (шаг уже выполняется), поэтому сравниваем с запасом на асинхронность через событие Change, которое панель обрабатывает синхронно.
if(gridContent.GetChildCount()<2)throw new CheckException($"grid has {gridContent.GetChildCount()} cell(s), expected >= 2");});Next();return;}// Шаг 5: клик по первой ячейке — эмуляция gui_input, как будто щёлкнул игрок; панель выбирает предмет и наполняет паспорт.
if(step==5){Check("cell click fills passport",()=>{var cell=gridContent.GetChildCount()>0?gridContent.GetChild(0)as Control:null;if(cell==null)throw new CheckException("no cell to click");var click=new InputEventMouseButton{ButtonIndex=MouseButton.Left,Pressed=true};cell.EmitSignal("gui_input",click);var passport=panel.FindChild("Passport",true,false);if(passport==null)throw new CheckException("Passport node not found");var hasText=false;foreach(var child in passport.FindChildren("*","Label",true,false)){if(child is Label l&& !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(l.Text)){hasText=true;break;}}if(!hasText)throw new CheckException("passport has no non-empty label after selection");});Next();return;}// Шаг 6: поиск-фильтр через сигнал LineEdit. Старые ячейки сетка удаляет через QueueFree — они исчезают лишь в конце кадра, поэтому в этом же тике проверяем синхронный индикатор ShownLabel ("показано 0"), а количество нод — на следующем тике.
if(step==6){Check("no-match filter zeroes the shown counter",()=>{search=panel.FindChild("Search",true,false)as LineEdit;if(search==null)throw new CheckException("Search LineEdit not found");search.Text="zzz_no_such_item";search.EmitSignal("text_changed",search.Text);var shown=panel.FindChild("ShownLabel",true,false)as Label;var text=shown?.Text??"";if(!text.Contains("0"))throw new CheckException($"ShownLabel '{text}' does not show zero after no-match filter");});Next();return;}// Шаг 7: кадр прошёл — ячейки после no-match фильтра реально удалены из дерева; затем возвращаем фильтр в пустое значение.
if(step==7){Check("grid empties after filter, restores after reset",()=>{var after=gridContent.GetChildCount();if(after!=0)throw new CheckException($"grid has {after} cell(s) after no-match filter, expected 0");search.Text="";search.EmitSignal("text_changed",search.Text);});Next();return;}// Шаг 8: сетка восстановлена; повторный Toggle закрывает панель.
if(step==8){Check("grid restored and second Toggle closes",()=>{var restored=gridContent.GetChildCount();if(restored<2)throw new CheckException($"grid has {restored} cell(s) after filter reset, expected >= 2");UiRegistry.Toggle(PanelEntryId);if(panel.Visible)throw new CheckException("panel still visible after second Toggle");});Finish(null);}}private void Next(){step++;}private void Check(string title,System.Action body){var sw=Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec();try{body();passed++;Log($"[PASS] {title} ({(Godot.Time.GetTicksUsec() - sw) / 1000.0:0.0} ms)");}catch(CheckException ex){failed++;failures.Add($"{title}: {ex.Message}");Log($"[FAIL] {title}: {ex.Message}");}}/// <summary>Печатает итог и завершает процесс; после вызова шаги не выполняются.</summary>
private void Finish(string reason){if(step<0)return;step= -1;if(reason!=null){failed++;Log($"[FAIL] {reason}");}foreach(var f in failures)Log($"       failed: {f}");Log($"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={passed} failed={failed}");GetTree().Quit(failed==0?0:1);}private void Log(string message){GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"InventoryTest: {message}");}/// <summary>Отличает ожидаемую проверку от неожиданного исключения шага.</summary>
private sealed class CheckException:System.Exception{public CheckException(string message):base(message){}}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.InventoryTest{/// <summary> Точка входа интеграционного теста инвентаря (прецедент live2d_test: мод сам везёт драйвер и сам печатает [TEST_RESULT]). Активация — только по явному пользовательскому флагу <c>--itest=inventory</c> (user-args после --), чтобы мод никогда не вмешивался в обычную игру и в другие смоук-прогоны. Само переключение сцен выполняет ядро (<c>--scene=</c>), драйверу остаётся только дождаться готового шелла. Драйвер ставится в корень дерева отложенно: <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> срабатывает в фазе Scenes, до окончания бута и до входа в сцену. </summary>
public class InventoryTestInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool driverQueued;/// <summary>Per-mod инициализация не требуется — драйвер ставится на resources-ready.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Разбирает user-args; при активационном флаге добавляет драйвер теста в корень дерева. Повторный <c>ModManager.Reload()</c> не должен плодить драйверы — защищено статическим флагом. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(driverQueued)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();// Ровно свой флаг: широкая проверка StartsWith("--itest=") активировала бы этот тест и при запуске чужого itest-мода, а его драйвер квитит процесс в конце — второй тест не успевал бы отработать.
if(!args.Any(a=>a=="--itest=inventory"))return;var timeout=ParseTimeout(args);driverQueued=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"InventoryTestInitializer: activating inventory GUI test, timeout={timeout?.ToString() ?? "none"}s");// Deferred: сцена ещё не готова; драйвер сам ждёт Boot.IsReady и появления CurrentScene, поэтому порядок с загрузкой сцены не важен.
(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root?.CallDeferred("add_child",new InventoryTestDriverNode(timeout));}private static float?ParseTimeout(string[]args){var raw=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--timeout=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--timeout=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();return float.TryParse(raw,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var t)&&t>0?t:null;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Items.Tests{using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;/// <summary> Stack arithmetic of <see cref="Inventory"/>: a count that is not positive is no operation at all — a negative removal must not grow a stack and an addition must not create an empty or negative one. </summary>
public class InventoryTests{[ModTest("inventory/non_positive_counts_change_nothing")]static void NonPositiveCountsChangeNothing(ModTestContext ctx){var id=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.First();var inventory=new Inventory();inventory.Add(id,2);var before=inventory.CheckCount(id);ModAssert.False(inventory.Remove(id,-5),"negative removal is refused");ModAssert.False(inventory.Remove(id,0),"zero removal is refused");inventory.Add(id,-3);inventory.Add(id,0);ModAssert.Equal(before,inventory.CheckCount(id),"stack count after non-positive operations");var other=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.FirstOrDefault(k=> !inventory.HasItem(k));if(other==null)return;inventory.Add(other,0);ModAssert.False(inventory.HasItem(other),"zero addition creates no stack");}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Items.Tests{using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;/// <summary><c>action item.add</c> from a scenario: a count defaults to one, a bad one adds nothing.</summary>
public class ItemAddActionTests{private static FakeActionContext Context(string id,string count){var ctx=new FakeActionContext{Inventory=new Inventory()};if(id!=null)ctx.Params["id"]=id;if(count!=null)ctx.Params["count"]=count;return ctx;}[ModTest("item_add/adds_count")]static void AddsCount(ModTestContext test){var id=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.First();var ctx=Context(id,"3");var before=ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id);new ItemAddAction().Run(ctx);ModAssert.Equal(before+3,ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id),"three added");ModAssert.Equal(0,ctx.Warnings.Count,"no warnings");}[ModTest("item_add/count_defaults_to_one")]static void CountDefaultsToOne(ModTestContext test){var id=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.First();var ctx=Context(id,null);var before=ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id);new ItemAddAction().Run(ctx);ModAssert.Equal(before+1,ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id),"one added");}[ModTest("item_add/bad_arguments_add_nothing")]static void BadArgumentsAddNothing(ModTestContext test){var id=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.First();foreach(var count in new[]{"0","-2","many"}){var ctx=Context(id,count);var before=ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id);new ItemAddAction().Run(ctx);ModAssert.Equal(before,ctx.Inventory.CheckCount(id),"count="+count);ModAssert.Equal(1,ctx.Warnings.Count,"warned about count="+count);}var noId=Context(null,"1");new ItemAddAction().Run(noId);ModAssert.Equal(1,noId.Warnings.Count,"warned about the missing id");var noInventory=new FakeActionContext();noInventory.Params["id"]=id;new ItemAddAction().Run(noInventory);ModAssert.Equal(1,noInventory.Warnings.Count,"warned about the missing inventory");}[ModTest("item_add/name")]static void Name(ModTestContext test){ModAssert.Equal("item.add",new ItemAddAction().Name,"DSL name");}}}
