namespace Cthangover.Mods.Items.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;/// <summary> The items slot across a change of the game's content: a save may name an item no loaded mod defines any more (its mod was removed or the id renamed). Loading it must keep the rest of the inventory usable, and the next save must still be written — with the unknown stack kept, so it comes back with its mod. </summary>
public class ItemsSaveableTests{private const string UnknownId="__test/no_such_item";[ModTest("save/unknown_item_survives_load_and_save")]static void UnknownItemSurvivesLoadAndSave(ModTestContext ctx){var known=Entities.Collect<ItemInfo>().Keys.First();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;var original=runtime.Inventory;try{runtime.Inventory=new Inventory();var slot=new ModSlot();slot.Data["Inventory"]=new DataBlob(1,new List<CItem>{new(){ID=known,Count=4},new(){ID=UnknownId,Count=3},});var saveable=new ItemsSaveable();ModAssert.True(saveable.OnLoad(slot,out _),"slot with an unknown item loads");ModAssert.Equal(4,runtime.Inventory.CheckCount(known),"known stack restored");ModAssert.False(runtime.Inventory.HasItem(UnknownId),"unknown item is not a usable stack");var saved=new ModSlot();saveable.OnSave(saved);var items=saved.Data["Inventory"].ReadJson<List<CItem>>();ModAssert.Equal(4,items.Single(i=>i.ID==known).Count,"known stack saved");ModAssert.Equal(3,items.Single(i=>i.ID==UnknownId).Count,"unknown stack kept in the save");}finally{runtime.Inventory=original;}}}}

Provides direct access to model loading, updating, and data querying at the C level. All methods are unsafe and return raw pointers into CubismCore's internal arrays. <see cref="CubismNativeModel"/> wraps this layer into a managed API with proper memory alignment and lifetime management. </summary>
public static class CubismCoreBindings{/// <summary>Name of the native DLL loaded at runtime.</summary>
public const string DllName="Live2DCubismCore";/// <summary>Required byte alignment for .moc3 data buffers before revival.</summary>
public const int AlignofMoc=64;/// <summary>Required byte alignment for model instance memory.</summary>
public const int AlignofModel=16;/// <summary>Flag: drawable uses additive blending.</summary>
public const byte BlendAdditive=1<<0;/// <summary>Flag: drawable uses multiplicative blending.</summary>
public const byte BlendMultiplicative=1<<1;/// <summary>Flag: drawable is double-sided (no back-face culling).</summary>
public const byte IsDoubleSided=1<<2;/// <summary>Flag: drawable's mask is inverted.</summary>
public const byte IsInvertedMask=1<<3;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: drawable is currently visible.</summary>
public const byte IsVisible=1<<0;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: drawable visibility changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte VisibilityDidChange=1<<1;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: drawable opacity changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte OpacityDidChange=1<<2;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: drawable draw order changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte DrawOrderDidChange=1<<3;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: drawable render order changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte RenderOrderDidChange=1<<4;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: vertex positions changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte VertexPositionsDidChange=1<<5;/// <summary>Dynamic flag: blend color changed this frame.</summary>
public const byte BlendColorDidChange=1<<6;/// <summary>2D vector used in CubismCore struct layouts.</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct csmVector2{public float X;public float Y;}/// <summary>4D vector used in CubismCore color struct layouts.</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct csmVector4{public float X;public float Y;public float Z;public float W;}/// <summary>Returns the CubismCore SDK version number.</summary>
[DllImport(DllName,CallingConvention=CallingConvention.StdCall)]public static extern uint csmGetVersion();/// <summary>Revives a .moc3 binary from an aligned memory buffer. Returns a moc handle or IntPtr.Zero.</summary>
[DllImport(DllName,CallingConvention=CallingConvention.StdCall)]public static extern unsafe IntPtr csmReviveMocInPlace(void*address,uint size);/// <summary>Native log callback: receives a pointer to a NUL-terminated csmChar* message.</summary>
[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]public delegate void CsmLogDelegate(IntPtr messagePtr);/// <summary> Installs the Core log handler. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Abstract base for all Live2D Cubism motions (animations and expressions). Порт ACubismMotion из Cubism SDK for Native 5-r.5: владеет временами фейда, весом, цикличностью и колбэками; очередь (<see cref="CubismMotionQueueManager"/>) вызывает <see cref="UpdateParameters"/> раз в кадр, тот в свою очередь — <see cref="SetupMotionQueueEntry"/> (при старте), <see cref="UpdateFadeWeight"/> и виртуальный <see cref="DoUpdateParameters"/>. Завершение выставляется по EndTime: сам моушен ставит IsFinished в DoUpdateParameters (незацикленный), а обёртка <see cref="UpdateParameters"/> после применения параметров закрывает запись, когда текущее время прошло EndTime (например, после запущенного через очередь fade-out). Колбэки при этом не дублируются: OnFinishedMotion вызывается только самим моушеном. </summary>
public abstract class ACubismMotion{/// <summary> Callback invoked when the motion finishes (non-looping only). The finished motion is passed as the argument. </summary>
public delegate void FinishedMotionCallback(ACubismMotion motion);/// <summary> Callback invoked when the motion begins playback. Called from <see cref="SetupMotionQueueEntry"/> right after the entry's times are configured. </summary>
public delegate void BeganMotionCallback(ACubismMotion motion);protected float _fadeInSeconds= -1f;protected float _fadeOutSeconds= -1f;protected float _weight=1f;protected float _offsetSeconds;protected bool _isLoop;protected bool _isLoopFadeIn=true;protected bool _previousLoopState;/// <summary>Сработавшие события (UserData); наполняется в <see cref="GetFiredEvent"/>.</summary>
protected readonly List<string>_firedEventValues=new();/// <summary> Duration of the fade-in transition in seconds. A negative value means the default (1 second) will be used by <see cref="SetupMotionQueueEntry"/> and <see cref="UpdateFadeWeight"/>. </summary>
public float FadeInSeconds{get=>_fadeInSeconds;set=>_fadeInSeconds=value;}/// <summary> Duration of the fade-out transition in seconds. A negative value means the default (1 second) will be used. </summary>
public float FadeOutSeconds{get=>_fadeOutSeconds;set=>_fadeOutSeconds=value;}/// <summary> Overall motion weight (0..1). Multiplied with the fade-in/fade-out factors in <see cref="UpdateFadeWeight"/> to produce the final blend weight. </summary>
public float Weight{get=>_weight;set=>_weight=value;}/// <summary> Time offset in seconds applied to the motion's start time. Allows starting playback from an arbitrary point. </summary>
public float OffsetSeconds{get=>_offsetSeconds;set=>_offsetSeconds=value;}/// <summary> Whether the motion loops. When enabled, <see cref="CubismMotion"/> wraps timeOffset back to the beginning after the duration elapses. </summary>
public bool IsLoop{get=>_isLoop;set=>_isLoop=value;}/// <summary> When true and looping, the motion performs a fade-in at each loop restart. When false, the fade-in is skipped on subsequent loops. </summary>
public bool IsLoopFadeIn{get=>_isLoopFadeIn;set=>_isLoopFadeIn=value;}/// <summary> Invoked when the motion finishes (non-looping only). Автоматически вызывается самим моушеном в DoUpdateParameters по достижении длительности; очередь этот колбэк не дублирует. </summary>
public FinishedMotionCallback OnFinishedMotion{get;set;}/// <summary> Invoked when the motion begins. Fires at the start of <see cref="SetupMotionQueueEntry"/> after the entry is initialized. </summary>
public BeganMotionCallback OnBeganMotion{get;set;}/// <summary> Returns the total motion duration in seconds. Override in <see cref="CubismMotion"/> to return the motion3.json duration, or -1 for looping motions. </summary>
public virtual float GetDuration()=> -1f;/// <summary> Returns the loop cycle duration in seconds. Override in <see cref="CubismMotion"/> to return the full duration even when looping is active. </summary>
public virtual float GetLoopDuration()=> -1f;/// <summary> Порт ACubismMotion::UpdateParameters — кадровая обёртка, вызываемая очередью. Проверяет доступность записи, инициализирует её при старте, считает fade-вес, применяет параметры и после этого закрывает запись, если время прошло EndTime. </summary>
public void UpdateParameters(CubismNativeModel model,CubismMotionQueueEntry entry,float userTimeSeconds){if(!entry.IsAvailable||entry.IsFinished){return;}SetupMotionQueueEntry(entry,userTimeSeconds);float fadeWeight=UpdateFadeWeight(entry,userTimeSeconds);DoUpdateParameters(model,userTimeSeconds,fadeWeight,entry);// Пост-проверка SDK: EndTime > 0 и уже пройден — запись завершена.
if((entry.EndTime>0f)&&(entry.EndTime<userTimeSeconds)){entry.IsFinished=true;}}/// <summary> Порт ACubismMotion::SetupMotionQueueEntry: при первом кадре записывает StartTime (с учётом OffsetSeconds), FadeInStartTime и EndTime (если EndTime ещё не выставлен извне, например фейдаутом от очереди). </summary>
public void SetupMotionQueueEntry(CubismMotionQueueEntry entry,float userTimeSeconds){if(!entry.IsAvailable||entry.IsFinished){return;}if(entry.IsStarted){return;}entry.IsStarted=true;entry.StartTime=userTimeSeconds-_offsetSeconds;entry.FadeInStartTime=userTimeSeconds;// EndTime мог быть выставлен заранее (SetFadeout до старта).
if(entry.EndTime<0f){AdjustEndTime(entry);}OnBeganMotion?.Invoke(this);}/// <summary> Порт ACubismMotion::UpdateFadeWeight: вес = Weight x fadeIn x fadeOut с синус-эйзингом. При fadeIn/fadeOut == 0 соответствующий множитель = 1. </summary>
public float UpdateFadeWeight(CubismMotionQueueEntry entry,float userTimeSeconds){if(entry==null){return-1f;}float fadeWeight=_weight;float fadeIn=_fadeInSeconds==0f?1f:CubismMath.GetEasingSine((userTimeSeconds-entry.FadeInStartTime)/_fadeInSeconds);float fadeOut=(_fadeOutSeconds==0f||entry.EndTime<0f)?1f:CubismMath.GetEasingSine((entry.EndTime-userTimeSeconds)/_fadeOutSeconds);fadeWeight=fadeWeight*fadeIn*fadeOut;entry.SetState(userTimeSeconds,fadeWeight);return fadeWeight;}/// <summary> Порт ACubismMotion::AdjustEndTime: EndTime = StartTime + GetDuration(); для цикличных моушенов (GetDuration() <= 0) EndTime = -1 (бесконечность). </summary>
protected void AdjustEndTime(CubismMotionQueueEntry entry){float duration=GetDuration();float endTime=duration<=0f? -1f:entry.StartTime+duration;entry.EndTime=endTime;}/// <summary> Порт ACubismMotion::GetFiredEvent: базовая реализация не содержит событий. <see cref="CubismMotion"/> переопределяет и наполняет список по UserData. </summary>
public virtual List<string>GetFiredEvent(float beforeCheckTimeSeconds,float motionTimeSeconds){return _firedEventValues;}/// <summary> Applies motion parameter values to the model for the current frame. Called every frame by <see cref="ACubismMotion.UpdateParameters"/>. </summary> <param name="model">The native Cubism model to modify.</param> <param name="userTimeSeconds">Elapsed user time in seconds.</param> <param name="weight">Blend weight already multiplied by fade factors.</param> <param name="entry">The queue entry containing start/end timing.</param>
public abstract void DoUpdateParameters(CubismNativeModel model,float userTimeSeconds,float weight,CubismMotionQueueEntry entry);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Defines a sinusoidal breathing parameter. Each breath parameter oscillates a model parameter value around an offset with a given peak amplitude, cycle period, and weight. </summary>
public struct BreathParameterData{/// <summary>Model parameter ID to apply the breath to.</summary>
public string ParameterId;/// <summary>Base offset added to the sinusoidal value.</summary>
public float Offset;/// <summary>Amplitude of the sine wave.</summary>
public float Peak;/// <summary>Full cycle duration in seconds.</summary>
public float Cycle;/// <summary>Multiplier applied to the final breath value.</summary>
public float Weight;}/// <summary> Applies sinusoidal breathing animation to model parameters. Operates additively on top of existing parameter values — the breath oscillation is multiplied by <see cref="BreathParameterData.Weight"/> and added to the current parameter value every frame. Configured with a list of <see cref="BreathParameterData"/> entries, each targeting a specific parameter ID. Called from <see cref="CubismModelNode.OnUpdate"/> alongside other effect layers (eye blink, pose, physics). </summary>
public class CubismBreath{private readonly List<BreathParameterData>_parameters=new();private float _currentTime;/// <summary> Replaces the current breath parameter set. Previously configured parameters are cleared. </summary>
public void SetParameters(List<BreathParameterData>parameters){_parameters.Clear();_parameters.AddRange(parameters);}/// <summary> Applies the breath oscillation to matching model parameters. Accumulates internal time and evaluates a sine wave per parameter: <c>offset + peak * sin(2 * pi * time / cycle)</c>, then adds the weighted result to the native parameter value. </summary>
public unsafe void UpdateParameters(CubismNativeModel model,float deltaTimeSeconds){_currentTime+=deltaTimeSeconds;var idsPtr=model.GetParameterIds();var values=model.GetParameterValues();for(int i=0;i<model.ParameterCount;i++){var id=CubismNativeModel.ReadStringFromPtrArray(idsPtr,i);foreach(var bp in _parameters){if(bp.ParameterId!=id)continue;var value=bp.Offset+bp.Peak*MathF.Sin(2f*MathF.PI*_currentTime/bp.Cycle);values[i]+=bp.Weight*value;break;}}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Blend mode for expression parameters. Determines how the expression value is combined with the existing parameter value during animation. </summary>
public enum ExpressionBlendType{Additive=0,Multiply=1,Overwrite=2}/// <summary> A single parameter entry in an expression motion. Targets a model parameter by ID with a specific blend type and value. </summary>
public struct ExpressionParameter{/// <summary>Target model parameter ID.</summary>
public string ParameterId;/// <summary>How to combine this value with existing parameter data.</summary>
public ExpressionBlendType BlendType;/// <summary>The target value (interpretation depends on <see cref="BlendType"/>).</summary>
public float Value;}/// <summary> Expression motion, parsed from a Cubism .exp3.json file. Inherits fade and weight management from <see cref="ACubismMotion"/>. Формулы применения — точный порт CubismExpressionMotion::DoUpdateParameters через Set/Add/MultiplyParameterValue из CubismModel (SDK 5-r.5), weight — fade-вес: <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="ExpressionBlendType.Additive"/> — <c>value + expValue * weight</c></item> <item><see cref="ExpressionBlendType.Multiply"/> — <c>value * (1 + (expValue - 1) * weight)</c></item> <item><see cref="ExpressionBlendType.Overwrite"/> — <c>value * (1 - weight) + expValue * weight</c></item> </list> Как и в SDK, результат зажимается в [min, max] параметра (порт CubismModel::SetParameterValue), а параметры применяются в порядке их перечисления в exp3.json: при нескольких записях с одним Id побеждает последняя. Fade-время по умолчанию — 1 c (DefaultFadeTime), если в файле не задано. Загружается и запускается через <see cref="CubismModelNode.StartExpression"/>. </summary>
public class CubismExpressionMotion:ACubismMotion{/// <summary>Порт DefaultFadeTime из CubismExpressionMotion.cpp.</summary>
private const float DefaultFadeTime=1f;private readonly List<ExpressionParameter>_parameters=new();/// <summary> Parses an .exp3.json byte buffer into an expression motion. Reads fade-in/out times and the list of target parameters with their blend types and values. </summary>
public CubismExpressionMotion(byte[]jsonBytes){var json=JsonDocument.Parse(jsonBytes);var root=json.RootElement;// Порт CubismExpressionMotion::Parse: root[FadeInTime].ToFloat(DefaultFadeTime).
_fadeInSeconds=root.TryGetProperty("FadeInTime",out var fi)&&fi.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number?fi.GetSingle():DefaultFadeTime;_fadeOutSeconds=root.TryGetProperty("FadeOutTime",out var fo)&&fo.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number?fo.GetSingle():DefaultFadeTime;if(root.TryGetProperty("Parameters",out var paramsArr)){foreach(var p in paramsArr.EnumerateArray()){// "Blend": null or absent -> Additive (SDK ToBlendFunction default).
var blend=p.TryGetProperty("Blend",out var b)&&b.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.String?ParseBlendType(b.GetString()):ExpressionBlendType.Additive;_parameters.Add(new ExpressionParameter{ParameterId=p.GetProperty("Id").GetString(),Value=p.TryGetProperty("Value",out var val)&&val.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Number?val.GetSingle():0f,BlendType=blend});}}}private static ExpressionBlendType ParseBlendType(string value)=>value switch{"Multiply"=>ExpressionBlendType.Multiply,"Overwrite"=>ExpressionBlendType.Overwrite,_=>ExpressionBlendType.Additive};/// <summary> Applies all expression parameters to the model using their respective blend modes. Called every frame by the queue manager. </summary>
public override unsafe void DoUpdateParameters(CubismNativeModel model,float userTimeSeconds,float weight,CubismMotionQueueEntry entry){var idsPtr=model.GetParameterIds();var values=model.GetParameterValues();var minValues=model.GetParameterMinimumValues();var maxValues=model.GetParameterMaximumValues();var indexById=new Dictionary<string,int>(model.ParameterCount);for(int i=0;i<model.ParameterCount;i++)indexById[CubismNativeModel.ReadStringFromPtrArray(idsPtr,i)]=i;// Порт: цикл по параметрам выражения (в порядке exp3.json).
foreach(var ep in _parameters){if(!indexById.TryGetValue(ep.ParameterId,out int pi))continue;switch(ep.BlendType){case ExpressionBlendType.Additive:// AddParameterValue: value + (expValue * weight)
values[pi]=ClampParameterValue(values[pi]+ep.Value*weight,minValues[pi],maxValues[pi]);break;case ExpressionBlendType.Multiply:// MultiplyParameterValue: value * (1 + (expValue - 1) * weight)
values[pi]=ClampParameterValue(values[pi]*(1f+(ep.Value-1f)*weight),minValues[pi],maxValues[pi]);break;case ExpressionBlendType.Overwrite:// SetParameterValue(id, value, weight): expValue зажимается, затем лерп

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Drives a state-machine based eye blink animation on target model parameters. Cycles through five states: First -> Interval -> Closing -> Closed -> Opening, modulating the specified parameter values from 1 (open) to 0 (closed) and back. Blink timing is randomized per cycle: each interval between blinks is a random value in <c>(0, 2 * BlinkIntervalSeconds)</c>. The actual blink consists of configurable closing, closed, and opening phase durations. Used by <see cref="CubismModelNode"/> when <see cref="CubismModelNode.EnableEyeBlink"/> is true and the model3.json defines EyeBlink parameter group. </summary>
public class CubismEyeBlink{private enum EyeState{First,Interval,Closing,Closed,Opening}private EyeState _state=EyeState.First;private float _nextBlinkTime;private float _stateStartTime;private float _userTimeSeconds;private readonly List<string>_parameterIds=new();/// <summary> Average interval between successive blinks, in seconds. Actual interval is randomized in range (0, 2 * this value). Default is 4 seconds. </summary>
public float BlinkIntervalSeconds{get;set;}=4f;/// <summary> Duration of the eyelid closing transition, in seconds. Default 0.1. </summary>
public float ClosingSeconds{get;set;}=0.1f;/// <summary> Duration the eyes stay fully closed, in seconds. Default 0.05. </summary>
public float ClosedSeconds{get;set;}=0.05f;/// <summary> Duration of the eyelid opening transition, in seconds. Default 0.15. </summary>
public float OpeningSeconds{get;set;}=0.15f;/// <summary> Sets the parameter IDs that represent eye open/close. Typically sourced from the model3.json EyeBlink group. Clears any previously set IDs. </summary>
public void SetParameterIds(IEnumerable<string>ids){_parameterIds.Clear();_parameterIds.AddRange(ids);}/// <summary> Advances the blink state machine and writes eye openness to model parameters. 1.0 = fully open, 0.0 = fully closed. Linear interpolation between phases. Call every frame from <see cref="CubismModelNode.OnUpdate"/>. </summary>
public void UpdateParameters(CubismNativeModel model,float deltaTimeSeconds){_userTimeSeconds+=deltaTimeSeconds;switch(_state){case EyeState.First:_state=EyeState.Interval;_nextBlinkTime=_userTimeSeconds+Random.Shared.NextSingle()*(2f*BlinkIntervalSeconds-1f);break;case EyeState.Interval:SetParameterValues(model,1f);if(_userTimeSeconds>=_nextBlinkTime){_state=EyeState.Closing;_stateStartTime=_userTimeSeconds;}break;case EyeState.Closing:{var elapsed=_userTimeSeconds-_stateStartTime;var value=1f-Math.Clamp(elapsed/ClosingSeconds,0f,1f);SetParameterValues(model,value);if(elapsed>=ClosingSeconds){_state=EyeState.Closed;_stateStartTime=_userTimeSeconds;}break;}case EyeState.Closed:SetParameterValues(model,0f);if(_userTimeSeconds-_stateStartTime>=ClosedSeconds){_state=EyeState.Opening;_stateStartTime=_userTimeSeconds;}break;case EyeState.Opening:{var elapsed=_userTimeSeconds-_stateStartTime;var value=Math.Clamp(elapsed/OpeningSeconds,0f,1f);SetParameterValues(model,value);if(elapsed>=OpeningSeconds){_state=EyeState.Interval;_nextBlinkTime=_userTimeSeconds+Random.Shared.NextSingle()*(2f*BlinkIntervalSeconds-1f);}break;}}}private unsafe void SetParameterValues(CubismNativeModel model,float value){var idsPtr=model.GetParameterIds();var values=model.GetParameterValues();for(int i=0;i<model.ParameterCount;i++){var id=CubismNativeModel.ReadStringFromPtrArray(idsPtr,i);if(_parameterIds.Contains(id))values[i]=value;}}}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Math utilities shared across the Cubism animation pipeline. Includes easing functions (sine), angle utilities, linear interpolation helpers, and bezier curve evaluators with both analytic (Cardano) and binary search approaches. The bezier methods handle Cubism's segmented animation curves: <see cref="BezierEvaluate"/> calculates a value at a given time, <see cref="CardanoAlgorithmForBezier"/> solves for the exact bezier parameter t, and <see cref="BezierEvaluateBinarySearch"/> is a fallback when beziers are restricted (non-standard). </summary>
public static class CubismMath{/// <summary> Sine-based easing function mapping [0,1] -> [0,1] with smooth acceleration and deceleration. Used for fade-in/fade-out curves in motion transitions. <c>0.5 - 0.5 * cos(pi * t)</c>, clamped to [0,1]. </summary>
public static float GetEasingSine(float t){if(t<0f)return 0f;if(t>1f)return 1f;return 0.5f-0.5f*MathF.Cos(MathF.PI*t);}/// <summary>Converts degrees to radians.</summary>
public static float DegreesToRadian(float degrees){return degrees*(MathF.PI/180f);}/// <summary>Converts radians to degrees.</summary>
public static float RadianToDegrees(float radian){return radian*(180f/MathF.PI);}/// <summary> Computes the signed angle in radians from vector (fromX,fromY) to vector (toX,toY). Uses Atan2(det, dot) for the angle between two vectors. </summary>
public static float DirectionToRadian(float fromX,float fromY,float toX,float toY){var dot=fromX*toX+fromY*toY;var det=fromX*toY-fromY*toX;return MathF.Atan2(det,dot);}/// <summary> Converts a radian angle to a unit direction vector (sin, cos). </summary>
public static void RadianToDirection(float radian,out float x,out float y){x=MathF.Sin(radian);y=MathF.Cos(radian);}/// <summary>Standard linear interpolation between two float values.</summary>
public static float LinearEvaluation(float startValue,float endValue,float time){return startValue+(endValue-startValue)*time;}/// <summary> Linear interpolation between two <see cref="CubismMotionPoint"/> values, using their stored Time properties to compute the interpolation factor. </summary>
public static float LinearEvaluation(ref CubismMotionPoint p0,ref CubismMotionPoint p1,float time){var t=(time-p0.Time)/(p1.Time-p0.Time);return p0.Value+(p1.Value-p0.Value)*t;}/// <summary> De Casteljau cubic bezier evaluation. Given 4 control points (cp0..cp3), each with a time and value, returns the bezier value at the specified time. </summary>
public static float BezierEvaluate(float cp0Time,float cp0Value,float cp1Time,float cp1Value,float cp2Time,float cp2Value,float cp3Time,float cp3Value,float time){var t=(time-cp0Time)/(cp3Time-cp0Time);var t1=1f-t;var t2=t*t;var t12=t1*t1;var value=t12*t1*cp0Value+3f*t12*t*cp1Value+3f*t1*t2*cp2Value+t2*t*cp3Value;return value;}/// <summary> Cardano cubic formula to solve for the exact bezier parameter t given a target time. Used when beziers are not restricted — the analytic solution is faster than binary search. Returns the t value that, when applied to the bezier equation, produces the targetTime (or very close to it). </summary>
public static float CardanoAlgorithmForBezier(float cp0Time,float cp1Time,float cp2Time,float cp3Time,float targetTime){var dx=cp0Time-targetTime;var cx=cp1Time-cp0Time;var bx=cp2Time-cp1Time;var ax=cp3Time-cp2Time;var a2=ax-cx;var ab=2f*(ax-2f*bx+cx);var a0=3f*(bx-cx);var ad= -cx;var a=a2/dx;var b=ab/dx;var c=a0/dx;var d=ad/dx;var r=(-2f*b*b*b+9f*a*b*c-27f*a*a*d)/(54f*a*a*a);var q=(b*b-3f*a*c)/(9f*a*a);var q3=q*q*q;var floorTerm=r*r-q3;if(MathF.Abs(floorTerm)<1e-7f)floorTerm=0f;if(floorTerm<0f){var theta=MathF.Acos(r/MathF.Sqrt(q3));var sqrtQ=MathF.Sqrt(q);return-2f*sqrtQ*MathF.Cos(theta/3f)-b/(3f*a);}var sqrtTerm=MathF.Sqrt(floorTerm);var aTerm=MathF.Cbrt(MathF.Abs(r+sqrtTerm));var bTerm=r>0f?MathF.Cbrt(MathF.Abs(r-sqrtTerm)):-MathF.Cbrt(MathF.Abs(r-sqrtTerm));return aTerm-bTerm-b/(3f*a);}/// <summary> Binary search bezier evaluation — fallback for when <see cref="CubismMotionJson.AreBeziersRestricted"/> is true. Iteratively narrows t in [0,1] until the bezier time at t is within epsilon of the target time, then evaluates the value. Capped at 20 iterations with 1e-5 tolerance. </summary>
public static float BezierEvaluateBinarySearch(float cp0Time,float cp1Time,float cp2Time,float cp3Time,float cp0Value,float cp1Value,float cp2Value,float cp3Value,float targetTime){const int maxIterations=20;const float epsilon=1e-5f;var tMin=0f;var tMax=1f;for(var i=0;i<maxIterations;i++){var t=(tMin+tMax)*0.5f;var t1=1f-t;var t2=t*t;var t12=t1*t1;var timeAtT=t12*t1*cp0Time+3f*t12*t*cp1Time+3f*t1*t2*cp2Time+t2*t*cp3Time;if(MathF.Abs(timeAtT-targetTime)<epsilon)return t12*t1*cp0Value+3f*t12*t*cp1Value+3f*t1*t2*cp2Value+t2*t*cp3Value;if(timeAtT<targetTime)tMin=t;else tMax=t;}var tf=(tMin+tMax)*0.5f;var tf1=1f-tf;var tf2=tf*tf;var tf12=tf1*tf1;return tf12*tf1*cp0Value+3f*tf12*tf*cp1Value+3f*tf1*tf2*cp2Value+tf2*tf*cp3Value;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Port of CubismModelMatrix.cpp (Cubism SDK for Native 5-r.5). Manages the 2D transformation (scale, translation, alignment) of a Cubism model inside its logical coordinate space. SDK semantics to be aware of: <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="SetWidth"/> and <see cref="SetHeight"/> MULTIPLY the current scale by target / canvas-size (they do not assign it), exactly like the C++ original.</item> <item>The (width, height) constructor performs <c>SetHeight(2.0f)</c> like the SDK, i.e. the model is initially scaled to occupy 2 logical units of height.</item> <item>Translation methods are INCREMENTAL in the SDK: SetX/SetY, SetPosition, Top, Left (via TranslateX/Y) add to the current translation. SetupFromLayout is unaffected because it starts from a fresh matrix (translation 0).</item> <item>CenterX/CenterY/Bottom/Right compute their offset from the full scaled size (canvas size × current scale).</item> </list> <see cref="SetupFromLayout"/> reads positioning keys from a Cubism .model3.json "Layout" section; <see cref="ApplyToNode"/> writes the final transform to a Godot <see cref="Node2D"/>. </summary>
public class CubismModelMatrix{private float _width;private float _height;private float _scaleX=1f;private float _scaleY=1f;private float _translateX;private float _translateY;/// <summary>Creates an identity matrix with no known canvas size.</summary>
public CubismModelMatrix(){}/// <summary> Creates a matrix referenced to the given canvas dimensions. Like the SDK constructor, this calls <see cref="SetHeight"/>(2.0f), so the model initially occupies 2 logical units of height. </summary>
public CubismModelMatrix(float width,float height){_width=width;_height=height;SetHeight(2.0f);}/// <summary>Current scale on the X axis.</summary>
public float ScaleX=>_scaleX;/// <summary>Current scale on the Y axis.</summary>
public float ScaleY=>_scaleY;/// <summary>Current X translation offset.</summary>
public float TranslateX=>_translateX;/// <summary>Current Y translation offset.</summary>
public float TranslateY=>_translateY;/// <summary>SDK CubismModelMatrix::Scale — multiplies the current scale.</summary>
public void Scale(float scaleX,float scaleY){_scaleX*=scaleX;_scaleY*=scaleY;}/// <summary> SDK SetWidth: multiplies the current uniform scale by w / canvasWidth. Ignored when the canvas width is zero or unknown (the SDK would divide by zero). </summary>
public void SetWidth(float w){if(_width<=0f)return;var scaleX=w/_width;var scaleY=scaleX;Scale(scaleX,scaleY);}/// <summary> SDK SetHeight: multiplies the current uniform scale by h / canvasHeight. Ignored when the canvas height is zero or unknown (the SDK would divide by zero). </summary>
public void SetHeight(float h){if(_height<=0f)return;var scaleX=h/_height;var scaleY=scaleX;Scale(scaleX,scaleY);}/// <summary>SDK Translate — adds x and y to the current translation (the SDK's TranslateX/TranslateY helpers are folded in here; the TranslateX/TranslateY properties above are the read accessors).</summary>
public void Translate(float x,float y){_translateX+=x;_translateY+=y;}/// <summary>SDK SetPosition — incremental (adds to the current translation).</summary>
public void SetPosition(float x,float y)=>Translate(x,y);/// <summary>SDK SetX — incremental (adds to the current X translation).</summary>
public void SetX(float x)=>_translateX+=x;/// <summary>SDK SetY — incremental (adds to the current Y translation).</summary>
public void SetY(float y)=>_translateY+=y;/// <summary> Centers the model horizontally and vertically at the given point. Equivalent to calling <see cref="CenterX"/> then <see cref="CenterY"/>. </summary>
public void SetCenterPosition(float x,float y){CenterX(x);CenterY(y);}/// <summary>SDK CenterX — adds x - (width × scaleX) / 2 to the X translation.</summary>
public void CenterX(float x){var w=_width*_scaleX;_translateX+=x-(w/2f);}/// <summary>SDK CenterY — adds y - (height × scaleY) / 2 to the Y translation.</summary>
public void CenterY(float y){var h=_height*_scaleY;_translateY+=y-(h/2f);}/// <summary>SDK Top — adds y to the Y translation (via SetY).</summary>
public void Top(float y)=>SetY(y);/// <summary>SDK Bottom — adds y - (height × scaleY) to the Y translation.</summary>
public void Bottom(float y){var h=_height*_scaleY;_translateY+=y-h;}/// <summary>SDK Left — adds x to the X translation (via SetX).</summary>
public void Left(float x)=>SetX(x);/// <summary>SDK Right — adds x - (width × scaleX) to the X translation.</summary>
public void Right(float x){var w=_width*_scaleX;_translateX+=x-w;}/// <summary> SDK SetupFromLayout — configures scale and position from a layout dictionary (lowercased keys). Width/height are applied first (they affect scale), then the position keys: "x", "y", "center_x", "center_y", "top", "bottom", "left", "right". </summary>
public void SetupFromLayout(Dictionary<string,float>layout){foreach(var kvp in layout){switch(kvp.Key){case"width":SetWidth(kvp.Value);break;case"height":SetHeight(kvp.Value);break;}}foreach(var kvp in layout){switch(kvp.Key){case"x":SetX(kvp.Value);break;case"y":SetY(kvp.Value);break;case"center_x":CenterX(kvp.Value);break;case"center_y":CenterY(kvp.Value);break;case"top":Top(kvp.Value);break;case"bottom":Bottom(kvp.Value);break;case"left":Left(kvp.Value);break;case"right":Right(kvp.Value);break;}}}/// <summary> Writes the current scale and translation to a Godot <see cref="Node2D"/>. Sets both <c>Scale</c> and <c>Position</c> properties. </summary>
public void ApplyToNode(Node2D node){node.Scale=new Vector2(_scaleX,_scaleY);node.Position=new Vector2(_translateX,_translateY);}}}

public enum CubismMotionCurveTarget{Model,Parameter,PartOpacity}/// <summary> Segment interpolation type within a motion curve. <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="Linear"/> — straight line between two points</item> <item><see cref="Bezier"/> — cubic bezier (4 control points per segment)</item> <item><see cref="Stepped"/> — hold previous value until the segment ends</item> <item><see cref="InverseStepped"/> — jump to next value at segment start</item> </list> </summary>

Соседние сегменты кривой разделяют общую точку: BasePointIndex следующего сегмента равен индексу последней точки предыдущего, а оценка кривой ищет сегмент по времени первой точки СЛЕДУЮЩЕГО сегмента. </summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Represents one enqueued motion in the playback queue. Holds timing data (start time, end time, fade-in start time), lifecycle flags (available, started, finished, auto-delete), and a reference to the motion itself. Created by <see cref="CubismMotionQueueManager.StartMotion"/> and consumed frame-by-frame in <see cref="CubismMotionQueueManager.DoUpdateMotion"/>. </summary>
public class CubismMotionQueueEntry{/// <summary>Absolute user time when motion playback begins. -1 until the first update.</summary>
public float StartTime= -1f;/// <summary> Absolute user time when playback ends. -1 for infinite (looping) motions. </summary>
public float EndTime= -1f;/// <summary>Absolute user time when fade-in begins (may differ from StartTime for offset motions).</summary>
public float FadeInStartTime;/// <summary>Whether this entry should be processed during updates.</summary>
public bool IsAvailable=true;/// <summary>Flag set when playback completes. Checked by the queue manager during cleanup.</summary>
public bool IsFinished;/// <summary>Flag set on the first update — порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::_started.</summary>
public bool IsStarted;/// <summary>Время последнего кадра (состояние), порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::SetState.</summary>
public float StateTime;/// <summary>Вес последнего кадра (состояние), порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::SetState.</summary>
public float StateWeight;/// <summary>Абсолютное время последней проверки событий UserData (сдвигается каждый кадр).</summary>
public float LastCheckEventTime;/// <summary>Длительность фейда-аута, назначенного при вытеснении новым моушеном.</summary>
public float FadeOutSeconds;/// <summary>Флаг вытеснения: фейд-аут начат, EndTime будет назначен при следующем обновлении.</summary>
public bool IsTriggeredFadeOut;/// <summary>The motion instance driving parameter updates.</summary>
public ACubismMotion Motion;/// <summary>If true, the entry is automatically removed from the queue when finished.</summary>
public bool AutoDelete;/// <summary>Arbitrary user data attached to this queue entry.</summary>
public object CustomData;/// <summary> Creates a new queue entry for the given motion. AutoDelete controls whether the entry is removed on finish. </summary>
public CubismMotionQueueEntry(ACubismMotion motion,bool autoDelete){Motion=motion;AutoDelete=autoDelete;}/// <summary> Порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::SetFadeout: помечает запись для фейда-аута (вызывается очередью, когда стартует новый моушен). </summary>
public void SetFadeout(float fadeOutSeconds){FadeOutSeconds=fadeOutSeconds;IsTriggeredFadeOut=true;}/// <summary> Порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::StartFadeout: назначает EndTime, сокращая его, если фейд-аут уже был запущен раньше и раньше должен закончиться. </summary>
public void StartFadeout(float fadeOutSeconds,float userTimeSeconds){float newEndTimeSeconds=userTimeSeconds+fadeOutSeconds;IsTriggeredFadeOut=true;if(EndTime<0f||newEndTimeSeconds<EndTime){EndTime=newEndTimeSeconds;}}/// <summary>Порт CubismMotionQueueEntry::SetState — сохраняет время и вес последнего кадра.</summary>
public void SetState(float timeSeconds,float weight){StateTime=timeSeconds;StateWeight=weight;}}/// <summary> Manages a queue of <see cref="ACubismMotion"/> instances for a single model. Поддержка вытеснения по приоритету (ReserveMotion), параллельного проигрывания и автосборки завершённых записей. Порт CubismMotionQueueManager из SDK 5-r.5: - StartMotion назначает всем прежним записям фейд-аут; - каждый кадр DoUpdateMotion вызывает <see cref="ACubismMotion.UpdateParameters"/>, затем проверяет события UserData (<see cref="ACubismMotion.GetFiredEvent"/>) и удаляет finished-записи; - колбэком завершения владеет сам моушен: очередь его НЕ дублирует. </summary>
public class CubismMotionQueueManager{private readonly List<CubismMotionQueueEntry>_entries=new();private readonly List<string>_firedEventValues=new();private int _reservedPriority= -1;/// <summary> Событие, вызываемое для каждого сработавшего UserData-события за кадр (порт _eventCallback из CubismMotionQueueManager). </summary>
public event Action<ACubismMotion,string>EventFired;/// <summary> События, собранные за последний кадр DoUpdateMotion по всем записям очереди. Список очищается в начале каждого обновления — читайте его сразу после вызова. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>FiredEventValues=>_firedEventValues;/// <summary> Sets the reserved priority threshold. Motions with priority below this are rejected by <see cref="ReserveMotion"/>. </summary>
public void SetReservePriority(int priority)=>_reservedPriority=priority;/// <summary> Attempts to reserve the given priority level. Returns true if the priority is accepted (higher than current reserved), false if a higher-priority motion is already reserved. </summary>
public bool ReserveMotion(int priority){if(_reservedPriority>=0&&_reservedPriority>priority)return false;_reservedPriority=priority;return true;}/// <summary> Enqueues a motion for playback. Прежним записям назначается фейд-аут (SetFadeout), после чего они плавно завершаются; сама запись инициализируется при первом кадре <see cref="ACubismMotion.UpdateParameters"/>. Параметр userTimeSeconds оставлен для совместимости вызовов. </summary> <param name="motion">The motion to play.</param> <param name="autoDelete">Whether to auto-remove on finish.</param> <param name="userTimeSeconds">Current user time (не используется, порт сигнатуры).</param>

Resets priority reservation. </summary>
public void StopAllMotions(){_entries.Clear();_reservedPriority= -1;}/// <summary> Returns true if all entries in the queue are finished. </summary>
public bool IsFinished(){foreach(var entry in _entries)if(entry!=null&& !entry.IsFinished)return false;return true;}/// <summary> Per-frame update — порт CubismMotionQueueManager::DoUpdateMotion. Для каждой записи: UpdateParameters (фейд + применение значений + финализация IsFinished самим моушеном), сборUserData-событий за кадр, затем удаление finished-записей и старт отложенного фейда-аута вытесненных. Обход прямой, как в SDK: моушены применяются от старых к новым. </summary>
public void DoUpdateMotion(CubismNativeModel model,float userTimeSeconds){_firedEventValues.Clear();int i=0;while(i<_entries.Count){CubismMotionQueueEntry entry=_entries[i];if(entry==null){_entries.RemoveAt(i);continue;}ACubismMotion motion=entry.Motion;if(motion==null){_entries.RemoveAt(i);continue;}// ------ Применение значений (финализация — внутри моушена/обёртки) ------
motion.UpdateParameters(model,entry,userTimeSeconds);// ------ Проверка UserData-событий за кадр ------
var fired=motion.GetFiredEvent(entry.LastCheckEventTime-entry.StartTime,userTimeSeconds-entry.StartTime);for(int e=0;e<fired.Count;e++)EventFired?.Invoke(motion,fired[e]);_firedEventValues.AddRange(fired);entry.LastCheckEventTime=userTimeSeconds;// ------ Удаление завершённых записей ------
if(entry.IsFinished){_entries.RemoveAt(i);continue;}// Фейд-аут, запланированный при вытеснении, стартует после обновления.
if(entry.IsTriggeredFadeOut){entry.StartFadeout(entry.FadeOutSeconds,userTimeSeconds);}i++;}}}}

External code can read/write <see cref="Value"/> and call <see cref="ApplyToModel"/> to push changes back to the CubismCore native arrays. </summary>
public class CubismParameter{public CubismNativeModel Model{get;}public CubismParameter(CubismNativeModel model){Model=model;}/// <summary>Cubism parameter ID string (e.g. "ParamAngleX", "ParamMouthOpenY").</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Zero-based index into the native parameter arrays.</summary>
public int Index{get;set;}/// <summary>Current parameter value. Writes to native model when <see cref="ApplyToModel"/> is called.</summary>
public float Value{get;set;}/// <summary>Minimum allowed value for this parameter.</summary>
public float MinimumValue{get;set;}/// <summary>Maximum allowed value for this parameter.</summary>
public float MaximumValue{get;set;}/// <summary>Default (rest) value for this parameter from the moc3.</summary>
public float DefaultValue{get;set;}/// <summary> Writes <see cref="Value"/> directly to the native model's parameter array. No clamping is performed — the caller should enforce bounds if needed. </summary>

public float GetOutputAngleScale(int subRigIndex,int outputIndex)=>GetFloat(GetOutputEntry(subRigIndex,outputIndex),"Scale");/// <summary>Output weight (Output[i].Weight).</summary>
public float GetOutputWeight(int subRigIndex,int outputIndex)=>GetFloat(GetOutputEntry(subRigIndex,outputIndex),"Weight");/// <summary>Destination parameter id (Output[i].Destination.Id).</summary>
public string GetOutputsDestinationId(int subRigIndex,int outputIndex){var entry=GetOutputEntry(subRigIndex,outputIndex);return entry.TryGetProperty("Destination",out var destination)?GetString(destination,"Id"):null;}/// <summary>Output type tag (Output[i].Type): "X", "Y" or "Angle".</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Manages pose-based part visibility from a Cubism .pose3.json file. Pose groups organize model parts into mutual-exclusion groups — only one part in each group is visible at a time. Commonly used for eye states (open/closed/surprised) and other multi-state part switches. This is a faithful port of CubismPose.cpp (Cubism SDK for Native 5-r.5): <list type="number"> <item>Part groups are stored as a flattened list with per-group counts (matching the SDK layout, so index arithmetic in Reset/DoFade is identical).</item> <item>Each group part references both a part index (for opacity) and a parameter index (for visibility). The visible part of a group is decided by the PARAMETER VALUE (&gt; Epsilon), not by the part opacity. If a pose parameter/part does not exist in the model, the SDK's "not exist" maps are emulated, and the group falls back to its first part with opacity 1.</item> <item>Reset (on model change): the first part of each group gets parameter value 1 / part opacity 1, all others get 0; linked parts resolve their indices too.</item> <item>DoFade: the visible part fades toward 1 at rate deltaTime / fadeTimeSeconds while all other parts are pushed toward 0 with the SDK's piecewise-linear crossing formula (Phi = 0.5) and back-opacity threshold (0.15). If no part is visible, the group falls back to its first part with opacity 1. If fadeTimeSeconds is 0, the visible part becomes fully opaque immediately.</item> <item>CopyPartOpacities: parts with a "Link" list copy their current part opacity to every linked part.</item> </list> </summary>

public void Initialize(CubismNativeModel model,CubismPose owner){ParameterIndex=owner.FindParameterIndex(model,PartId);PartIndex=owner.FindPartIndex(model,PartId);owner.SetParameterValue(model,ParameterIndex,PartId,1f);}}private readonly List<PartData>_partGroups=new();private readonly List<int>_partGroupCounts=new();private float _fadeTimeSeconds=DefaultFadeInSeconds;private IntPtr _lastModel=IntPtr.Zero;// Emulation of the SDK's _notExistParameterValues / _notExistPartOpacities maps: pose3.json may reference parameters/parts that do not exist in the model. They are keyed by id here (the SDK keys parameter entries by synthesized indices; per-id keys are equivalent for this emulation).
private readonly Dictionary<string,float>_notExistParameterValues=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,float>_notExistPartOpacities=new();/// <summary> Parses a .pose3.json byte buffer. using System;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework{/// <summary> Smooth target-point tracking for face/eye movement parameters. Drives the ParamAngleX/Y and ParamEyeBallX/Y model parameters in <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>. Bit-exact port of Cubism SDK for Native 5-r.5 Math/CubismTargetPoint.cpp: a velocity-based follower that accelerates toward the target with a capped acceleration (reaching top speed in 0.15 s), then smoothly decelerates so the configured acceleration can still brake before the target. All time is expressed in internal 30 fps frame units. </summary>
public class CubismTargetPoint{/// <summary>Internal reference frame rate (SDK FrameRate).</summary>
private const int FrameRate=30;/// <summary>Threshold below which no movement is applied (SDK Epsilon).</summary>
private const float Epsilon=0.01f;private float _faceTargetX,_faceTargetY;private float _faceX,_faceY;private float _faceVX,_faceVY;private float _lastTimeSeconds;private float _userTimeSeconds;/// <summary>Current smoothed X position.</summary>
public float X=>_faceX;/// <summary>Current smoothed Y position.</summary>
public float Y=>_faceY;/// <summary> Sets the target point immediately. The actual position will smoothly approach this target over subsequent calls to <see cref="Update"/>. </summary>
public void Set(float x,float y){_faceTargetX=x;_faceTargetY=y;}/// <summary> Advances the smoothing simulation by one frame (SDK CubismTargetPoint::Update). The very first call only anchors the internal clock and performs no integration, matching the native implementation. </summary>
public void Update(float deltaTimeSeconds){// Add the delta time.
_userTimeSeconds+=deltaTimeSeconds;// The average speed of swinging the head from center to side is about 1 second. Considering acceleration/deceleration, twice that is the maximum speed. The face direction is 0.0 at center and +-1.0 at the sides.
const float FaceParamMaxV=40f/10f;// Moves 40 in 7.5 seconds (5.3/sc)
float MaxV=FaceParamMaxV*1f/FrameRate;// Upper speed limit per frame First call only anchors the clock; no integration (SDK behavior).
if(_lastTimeSeconds==0f){_lastTimeSeconds=_userTimeSeconds;return;}float deltaTimeWeight=(_userTimeSeconds-_lastTimeSeconds)*FrameRate;_lastTimeSeconds=_userTimeSeconds;// Time until maximum speed, expressed in internal frames.
const float TimeToMaxSpeed=0.15f;const float FrameToMaxSpeed=TimeToMaxSpeed*FrameRate;// sec * frame/sec
float MaxA=deltaTimeWeight*MaxV/FrameToMaxSpeed;// Acceleration per frame The target direction is the vector (dx, dy).
float dx=_faceTargetX-_faceX;float dy=_faceTargetY-_faceY;if(MathF.Abs(dx)<=Epsilon&&MathF.Abs(dy)<=Epsilon){return;// No change.
}// Slow down when the distance requires more than the maximum speed.
float d=MathF.Sqrt((dx*dx)+(dy*dy));// Maximum speed vector toward the target.
float vx=MaxV*dx/d;float vy=MaxV*dy/d;// Acceleration needed to change from the current velocity to the new one.
float ax=vx-_faceVX;float ay=vy-_faceVY;float a=MathF.Sqrt((ax*ax)+(ay*ay));// While accelerating.
if(a< -MaxA||a>MaxA){ax*=MaxA/a;ay*=MaxA/a;}// Add the acceleration to the original velocity to get the new velocity.
_faceVX+=ax;_faceVY+=ay;// When approaching the target direction, decelerate smoothly: from the relation between acceleration, speed and distance, compute the maximum speed that can still be stopped with the configured acceleration, and clamp the current speed to it.
{// Relation between acceleration, velocity and distance. 2 6 2 3 sqrt(a t + 16 a h t - 8 a h) - a t v = -------------------------------------- 2 4 t - 2 (t=1)
float maxV=0.5f*(MathF.Sqrt((MaxA*MaxA)+16f*MaxA*d-8f*MaxA*d)-MaxA);float curV=MathF.Sqrt((_faceVX*_faceVX)+(_faceVY*_faceVY));if(curV>maxV){// Current speed > maximum speed: decelerate to the maximum.
_faceVX*=maxV/curV;_faceVY*=maxV/curV;}}_faceX+=_faceVX;_faceY+=_faceVY;}}}

using Godot;using Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Framework;namespace Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Services{/// <summary> Configuration for <see cref="Live2DService.CreateModel(Node, Live2DModelConfig)"/>. When <see cref="Position"/> is set, <see cref="ScaleFit"/> defaults to <see cref="FitMode.None"/> to disable automatic layout, giving manual coordinates full control. Otherwise <see cref="FitMode.FitAuto"/> is used. </summary>
public class Live2DModelConfig{public string ModelPath;public string ModId;public string NodeName;public Vector2?Position;public Vector2?Scale;public float AnchorX=0.5f;public float AnchorY=0.5f;public FitMode ScaleFit=FitMode.FitAuto;/// <summary> Enables the automatic eye-blink effect. Disable for pixel-deterministic rendering (screenshot/visual tests): the blink fires on a random timer and would otherwise change pixels between captures. </summary>
public bool EnableEyeBlink=true;}/// <summary> High-level factory for creating Live2D model nodes and attaching them to the scene tree. Encapsulates the boilerplate of instantiating <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>, adding to a parent, and calling <see cref="CubismModelNode.LoadModelFromMod"/>. </summary>
public static class Live2DService{/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="CubismModelNode"/>, adds it to <paramref name="parent"/>, and loads the model from the specified mod. </summary> <param name="parent">Parent node to attach the model to.</param> <param name="modelPath">Path to the .model3.json file, relative to the mod root.</param> <param name="modId">Registered mod ID containing the model assets.</param> <param name="nodeName">Godot node name for the model instance.</param> <returns>The created and loaded model node.</returns>
public static CubismModelNode CreateModel(Node parent,string modelPath,string nodeName,string modId=null){return CreateModel(parent,new Live2DModelConfig{ModelPath=modelPath,ModId=modId,NodeName=nodeName});}/// <summary> Creates a <see cref="CubismModelNode"/> using full configuration. When <see cref="Live2DModelConfig.Position"/> is provided, <see cref="Live2DModelConfig.ScaleFit"/> is forced to <see cref="FitMode.None"/> — manual coordinates take priority over the automatic <see cref="CubismModelNode.DeferredApplyLayout"/>. </summary>
public static CubismModelNode CreateModel(Node parent,Live2DModelConfig config){var fitMode=config.Position.HasValue?FitMode.None:config.ScaleFit;var model=new CubismModelNode{Name=config.NodeName,AnchorX=config.AnchorX,AnchorY=config.AnchorY,ScaleFit=fitMode,EnableEyeBlink=config.EnableEyeBlink};parent.AddChild(model);if(config.Position.HasValue)model.Position=config.Position.Value;if(config.Scale.HasValue)model.Scale=config.Scale.Value;model.LoadModelFromMod(config.ModelPath,config.ModId);return model;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Live2D.Cubism.Services;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;namespace Mods.Live2D{public class AddLive2DModelAction:IScenarioAction{public string Name=>"add_live2d_model";public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var modelPath=ctx.GetParam("model_path");var modId=ctx.GetParam("mod_id");var nodeName=ctx.GetParam("node_name")??"Live2DModel";if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modelPath)){ctx.LogWarning("LIVE2D","AddLive2DModelAction: missing 'model_path'");return;}var viewBox=SceneContextNode.FindNode<Control>("ViewBox");if(viewBox==null){ctx.LogWarning("LIVE2D","AddLive2DModelAction: ViewBox not found");return;}var existing=viewBox.GetNodeOrNull<Node>(nodeName);if(existing!=null){ctx.Log("LIVE2D",$"AddLive2DModelAction: '{nodeName}' already exists, skipping");return;}var config=new Live2DModelConfig{ModelPath=modelPath,ModId=modId,NodeName=nodeName};var xStr=ctx.GetParam("x");var yStr=ctx.GetParam("y");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xStr)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(yStr)&&float.TryParse(xStr,out var x)&&float.TryParse(yStr,out var y)){config.Position=new Vector2(x,y);}var scaleStr=ctx.GetParam("scale");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scaleStr)&&float.TryParse(scaleStr,out var s))config.Scale=new Vector2(s,s);Live2DService.CreateModel(viewBox,config);ctx.Log("LIVE2D",$"AddLive2DModelAction: loaded '{modelPath}' from mod '{modId}' as '{nodeName}'");}}}

int poseDiff=CountChangedPixels(lowered,raised);double poseRatio=poseDiff/(double)framePixels;if(poseRatio>=0.003)Pass($"pose change visible: {poseDiff} changed px ({poseRatio:P3})");else Fail($"pose change too small: {poseDiff} changed px ({poseRatio:P3})");// 3) CV: поднятая рука добавляет силуэт ЗА пределами опущенного bbox'а на высоте плеча (лево или право — модель может быть зеркальна зрителю). using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.LocaleAtlas{/// <summary> Runs one pass after the boot: scans every installed mod (loaded ones in load order, then the rest — localization belongs to the mod, not to the game that happens to load it) on a worker thread, writes the report, logs every error as <c>[FAIL]</c> and prints <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=locale_atlas passed=&lt;clean mods&gt; failed=&lt;mods with errors&gt;</c> before quitting with 0/1. A watchdog ends a hung pass with a failure instead of blocking the test run. </summary>
public partial class LocaleAtlasDriverNode:Node{private const string ResultName="locale_atlas";private readonly string directory;private readonly float timeoutSeconds;private double elapsed;private bool started;private bool finished;private Task<LocaleAtlasResult>pass;public LocaleAtlasDriverNode(){}public LocaleAtlasDriverNode(string directory,float timeoutSeconds){this.directory=directory;this.timeoutSeconds=timeoutSeconds;Name="LocaleAtlasDriver";}public override void _Process(double delta){if(finished)return;elapsed+=delta;if(elapsed>timeoutSeconds){Finish(null,$"timeout after {timeoutSeconds:F0}s");return;}if(!started){if(!Boot.IsReady)return;started=true;var mods=SnapshotMods();GameLogger.Log("LOCALE_ATLAS",$"building locale map for {mods.Count} mod(s)");pass=Task.Run(()=>LocaleAtlasBuilder.Build(mods));return;}if(pass is{IsCompleted:true}){if(pass.IsFaulted)Finish(null,$"locale atlas pass failed: {pass.Exception?.GetBaseException()}");else Finish(pass.Result,null);}}private static List<(string,IModFileProvider)>SnapshotMods(){var registry=ModRegistry.Instance;var result=new List<(string,IModFileProvider)>();var seen=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var id in registry.GetOrderedModIds()){if(registry.Mods.TryGetValue(id,out var info)&&info?.FileProvider!=null&&seen.Add(id))result.Add((id,info.FileProvider));}foreach(var info in registry.AllDiscoveredMods.Values.OrderBy(m=>m.Id,StringComparer.Ordinal)){if(info?.FileProvider!=null&&seen.Add(info.Id))result.Add((info.Id,info.FileProvider));}foreach(var collection in ModCollectionStore.LoadAll()){if(collection.Package!=null)result.Add((LocaleAtlasBuilder.CollectionSourcePrefix+collection.Id,collection.Package));}return result;}private void Finish(LocaleAtlasResult result,string failure){if(finished)return;finished=true;var passed=0;var failed=0;if(result!=null){try{LocaleAtlasReportWriter.Write(result,directory);}catch(Exception ex){failure=$"report write failed: {ex.Message}";}foreach(var error in result.Errors){GameLogger.Log("LOCALE_ATLAS",$"[FAIL] {error.ModId}: {error.Code} '{error.Key}' [{error.Language}] {error.Message} ({error.File}{(error.Line > 0 ? ":" + error.Line : string.Empty)})");}var failing=result.FailingMods();failed=failing.Count;passed=result.Mods.Count-failed;GameLogger.Log("LOCALE_ATLAS",$"locale atlas: {result.Keys.Count} key(s), {result.InterestingKeys.Count()} need attention, "+$"{result.Errors.Count()} error(s), {result.Warnings.Count()} warning(s); report: {Path.Combine(directory, "report.md")}");}if(failure!=null){failed++;GameLogger.Log("LOCALE_ATLAS",$"[FAIL] {failure}",LogLevel.Error);}GameLogger.Log("LOCALE_ATLAS",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={passed} failed={failed}");GetTree().Quit(failed==0?0:1);}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.LocaleAtlas{/// <summary> Activates the key map only on demand: the <c>--locale-atlas</c> user arg (after <c>--</c>) queues <see cref="LocaleAtlasDriverNode"/>, which waits for the boot, writes the report and quits. Optional <c>--locale-out=&lt;dir&gt;</c> (res://, user:// or absolute) sets the report directory, <c>--timeout=&lt;s&gt;</c> the watchdog. </summary>

public sealed class LocaleReference{public string Key{get;set;}public string ModId{get;set;}public string File{get;set;}public int Line{get;set;}public string Via{get;set;}/// <summary>Text shown when the key is absent (scenario literal); null when there is none.</summary>

public string Fix{get;set;}}/// <summary> Everything known about one key: declarations per language across all mods and every reference. A key is "complete" when each project language has a non-empty declaration in every mod that declares it. </summary>

public Dictionary<string,List<string>>PartialMods{get;}=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);public bool Declared=>Declarations.Count>0;public bool Complete=>Declared&&MissingLanguages.Count==0&&EmptyLanguages.Count==0&&PartialMods.Count==0;public IEnumerable<string>DeclaringMods=>Declarations.Values.SelectMany(e=>e).Select(e=>e.ModId).Distinct();}/// <summary>Encoding facts of one locale file.</summary>

<summary>In-memory mod: paths are mod-relative with '/' separators.</summary>
private sealed class MemoryProvider:IModFileProvider{private readonly Dictionary<string,byte[]>files=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);public MemoryProvider(string mod)=>Mod=mod;public string Mod{get;}public string RootPath=>null;public MemoryProvider Add(string path,string text){files[path]=Utf8.GetBytes(text);return this;}public bool FileExists(string path)=>files.ContainsKey(path);public IEnumerable<string>ListFiles(string directory=""){var prefix=string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory)?string.Empty:directory.TrimEnd('/')+"/";var seen=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var path in files.Keys.Where(p=>p.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal))){var rest=path.Substring(prefix.Length);var slash=rest.IndexOf('/');var entry=slash<0?path:prefix+rest.Substring(0,slash+1);if(seen.Add(entry))yield return entry;}}public string ReadFileText(string path)=>files.TryGetValue(path,out var bytes)?Utf8.GetString(bytes):null;public byte[]ReadFileBinary(string path)=>files.TryGetValue(path,out var bytes)?bytes:null;public Stream OpenStream(string path)=>files.TryGetValue(path,out var bytes)?new MemoryStream(bytes):null;public string GetFileSystemPath(string path)=>null;public string ResolveIncludePath(string includePath,string currentPath)=>includePath;public void Dispose(){}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Closes a map zone for travel by ID. Used for zones that were open by default but must become unavailable at some story point, or to take back access granted earlier. The override is stored by the map service and persisted in the save, so the closure survives scene changes and play sessions. </summary>
public class MapCloseZoneAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary> Registered as "map.close_zone" — closes the zone named by the required "zone_id" dialog variable. Unknown IDs are ignored with a warning. </summary>
public string Name=>"map.close_zone";/// <summary> Reads "zone_id" and delegates to the map service. Missing "zone_id" is logged and the action does nothing instead of throwing inside dialog execution. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var zoneId=ctx.GetParam("zone_id");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(zoneId)){ctx.Log("EVENT","MapCloseZoneAction: missing 'zone_id' variable");return;}ctx.Map.Close(zoneId);ctx.Log("MAP",$"MapCloseZoneAction: close '{zoneId}'");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Hides a map zone by ID, removing it from the map until it is shown again. Useful when a location is destroyed or temporarily inaccessible in the story and the marker should disappear rather than appear closed. The override is stored by the map service and persisted in the save. </summary>
public class MapHideZoneAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary> Registered as "map.hide_zone" — hides the zone named by the required "zone_id" dialog variable. Unknown IDs are ignored with a warning. </summary>
public string Name=>"map.hide_zone";/// <summary> Reads "zone_id" and delegates to the map service. Missing "zone_id" is logged and the action does nothing instead of throwing inside dialog execution. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var zoneId=ctx.GetParam("zone_id");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(zoneId)){ctx.Log("EVENT","MapHideZoneAction: missing 'zone_id' variable");return;}ctx.Map.Hide(zoneId);ctx.Log("MAP",$"MapHideZoneAction: hide '{zoneId}'");}}}

===== FILE mods/map_base/src/Actions/MapOpenZoneAction.cs =====
using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Opens a map zone for travel by ID. The counterpart of <see cref="MapCloseZoneAction"/>: authors close a zone in the map JSON (<c>"locked": true</c>) and then open it from a scenario when the story allows visiting it, e.g. after a quest tag is granted. The override is stored by the map service and persisted in the save, so the zone stays open across scene changes and play sessions. </summary>
public class MapOpenZoneAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary> Registered as "map.open_zone" — opens the zone named by the required "zone_id" dialog variable. Unknown IDs are ignored with a warning, so a scenario can safely reference a zone added by another mod that may not be installed. </summary>
public string Name=>"map.open_zone";/// <summary> Reads "zone_id" and delegates to the map service. Missing "zone_id" is a script authoring error: it is logged and the action does nothing instead of throwing inside dialog execution. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var zoneId=ctx.GetParam("zone_id");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(zoneId)){ctx.Log("EVENT","MapOpenZoneAction: missing 'zone_id' variable");return;}ctx.Map.Open(zoneId);ctx.Log("MAP",$"MapOpenZoneAction: open '{zoneId}'");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Reveals a hidden map zone by ID. Hidden zones are completely absent from the map — no polygon, no marker, no label, no zone counter entry — which lets authors keep late-game locations out of the early map without shipping separate map files. The override is stored by the map service and persisted in the save. </summary>
public class MapShowZoneAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary> Registered as "map.show_zone" — reveals the zone named by the required "zone_id" dialog variable. Unknown IDs are ignored with a warning. </summary>
public string Name=>"map.show_zone";/// <summary> Reads "zone_id" and delegates to the map service. Missing "zone_id" is logged and the action does nothing instead of throwing inside dialog execution. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var zoneId=ctx.GetParam("zone_id");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(zoneId)){ctx.Log("EVENT","MapShowZoneAction: missing 'zone_id' variable");return;}ctx.Map.Show(zoneId);ctx.Log("MAP",$"MapShowZoneAction: show '{zoneId}'");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Actions;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Thin adapter from the scenario action layer to the process-wide <see cref="MapZoneService"/> singleton, following the same shape as <see cref="QuestServiceImpl"/>: the interface exists so <see cref="IActionContext"/> can be mocked in tests, while the actual state always lives in the singleton and therefore survives for the whole session and lands in the save through <c>RuntimeSerializer</c>. </summary>
public class MapZoneServiceImpl:IMapZoneService{/// <summary>True when the zone is currently open for travel.</summary>
public bool IsOpen(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.IsOpen(id);/// <summary>True when the zone is currently visible on the map.</summary>
public bool IsVisible(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.IsVisible(id);/// <summary>Opens the zone for travel (overrides the map JSON's "locked" flag; persisted in the save).</summary>
public void Open(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.Open(id);/// <summary>Closes the zone — the marker stays but travel is blocked (persisted in the save).</summary>
public void Close(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.Close(id);/// <summary>Reveals a hidden zone on the map (persisted in the save).</summary>
public void Show(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.Show(id);/// <summary>Hides a zone from the map entirely (persisted in the save).</summary>
public void Hide(string id)=>MapZoneService.Instance.Hide(id);}}

public class MapModInitializer:IModInitializer{/// <summary>No per-mod work: the bridge binding happens once the whole mod set is ready.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary>Installs the zone-state hooks (first registration wins).</summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){var service=MapZoneService.Instance;// Runs again after every mod reload; the service outlives it when map_base stays loaded.

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Describes one interactive zone on the world map. Defines its bounding polygon (for a semi-transparent highlight), a clickable marker icon, a localised title label, and the target scene that opens when clicked. All coordinate properties (<see cref="Points"/> and <see cref="ImagePos"/>) use normalised values in the [0.0 .. 1.0] range, relative to the map background image dimensions. This makes zone layouts resolution-independent and safe to share across mods. Maps use the standard <c>{"Items": [...]}</c> JSON envelope in <c>mods/&lt;name&gt;/map/</c>. using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Shared rule that decides whether a map zone is actually enterable. Lives outside <see cref="MapWidget"/> because three views must agree on what "closed" means: the live map, the map editor's game-like preview and the map editor canvas (plus its availability hint). <para/> The authoring flag alone is not the whole story: a zone with an empty or unregistered target scene is closed in the running game no matter what the flag says, because authors routinely sketch regions before the target scene exists and travelling must stay blocked. Without this shared helper the editor showed such zones as open while the player blocked them — the editor must surface the same result the player gets. </summary>
public static class MapZoneRules{/// <summary> Effective locked state of a zone. <paramref name="open"/> is the open state owned by the caller: the runtime override in the live map or the authoring <see cref="MapZone.Locked"/> flag in the editor. A zone is locked when it is missing, has no target scene, is closed by its state, or when its scene is not registered in the running game. </summary>
public static bool IsLocked(MapZone zone,bool open){if(zone==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(zone.Scene))return true;if(!open)return true;var sceneManager=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneManager>("SceneManager");return sceneManager!=null&& !sceneManager.HasScene(zone.Scene);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Single owner of the world map zone list and its live state. Overrides are what <see cref="ExportState"/> writes into the save and <see cref="ImportState"/> restores, so a mod update that changes the defaults is immediately reflected for every zone the player never touched. <para/> Every effective state change publishes <see cref="MapZoneChangedEvent"/> — <see cref="MapWidget"/> rebuilds its layers from it and <see cref="Scenes.ConditionStateMonitor"/> invalidates cached scenario conditions, because zone state can gate scenario headers. <para/> The single instance is process-wide and deliberately not owned by <see cref="AppServices"/>: zone overrides are identity-sensitive across the whole process (map widget, saves, scenario conditions). New-game reset goes through the AppServices resettable adapter ("map_zones", see <see cref="ResetOverrides"/>); unit tests inject zones via <see cref="LoadZones"/> while <c>GameEnvironment.IsRuntime</c> is false. </summary>
public sealed class MapZoneService{/// <summary>Owns the process-wide instance; lazily created and alive for the whole session.</summary>
private static readonly Lazy<MapZoneService>instance=new(()=>new MapZoneService());/// <summary>Process-wide singleton. Deliberately NOT owned by AppServices: zone state is identity-sensitive across the process (map widget, saves, scenario conditions); reset goes through the AppServices resettable adapter instead.</summary>
public static MapZoneService Instance=>instance.Value;private readonly List<MapZone>zones=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,MapZone>byId=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly Dictionary<string,bool>openOverrides=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly Dictionary<string,bool>visibleOverrides=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private bool loaded;private MapZoneService(){}/// <summary> All loaded zones in mod load order, hidden ones included. public IReadOnlyList<MapZone>Zones=>zones;/// <summary> Loads the zone list from the given data, replacing the previous list but preserving runtime overrides. public void LoadZones(IEnumerable<MapZone>newZones){zones.Clear();byId.Clear();if(newZones!=null){foreach(var zone in newZones){if(zone==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(zone.ID))continue;if(byId.TryGetValue(zone.ID,out var replaced)){GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"zone '{zone.ID}' replaced by a later definition",LogLevel.Warning);zones[zones.IndexOf(replaced)]=zone;}else zones.Add(zone);byId[zone.ID]=zone;}}loaded=true;GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"MapZoneService loaded {zones.Count} zone(s)");}/// <summary> Reads every loaded mod's <c>map/*.json</c> through its <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> and rebuilds the zone list. public void ReloadFromMods(){if(!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime){loaded=true;return;}var result=new List<MapZone>();var options=JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions;foreach(var modId in ModRegistry.Instance.GetOrderedModIds()){var provider=ModManager.Instance.GetMod(modId)?.FileProvider;if(provider==null)continue;foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles("map")){if(entry.EndsWith("/")|| !entry.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var jsonText=provider.ReadFileText(entry);if(jsonText==null){GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"failed to read map json '{modId}/{entry}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}try{var fileData=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<MapZone>>(jsonText,options);if(fileData?.Items==null)continue;foreach(var zone in fileData.Items){result.Add(zone);GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"loaded zone '{zone.ID}' from '{modId}'");}}catch(JsonException ex){GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"JSON parse failed for '{modId}/{entry}': {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}LoadZones(result);}/// <summary> Loads zones on first use and re-reads nothing afterwards; call <see cref="Reload"/> when the mod set or the map files changed. </summary> <summary>Drops the loaded zones so the next <see cref="EnsureLoaded"/> reads the current mod set (called after every mod set load).</summary>

public void Reload(){ReloadFromMods();ModEventBus.Publish(new MapZoneChangedEvent{ZoneId=string.Empty,Change=MapZoneChangeKind.Reload});}/// <summary>Returns the zone with the given ID, or <c>null</c> when unknown.</summary>
public MapZone Get(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return null;return byId.TryGetValue(id,out var zone)?zone:null;}/// <summary>True when a zone with the given ID is loaded from any mod.</summary>
public bool Contains(string id)=>Get(id)!=null;/// <summary> Effective open state: runtime override when present, otherwise the authoring default (<see cref="MapZone.Locked"/> negated). Unknown IDs are closed. Note that a zone is only actually enterable when its scene also resolves — that check stays in <see cref="MapWidget"/>. </summary>
public bool IsOpen(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(openOverrides.TryGetValue(id,out var value))return value;return Get(id)is{Locked:false};}/// <summary> Effective visibility: runtime override when present, otherwise the authoring default (<see cref="MapZone.Hidden"/> negated). Unknown IDs are invisible. </summary>
public bool IsVisible(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(visibleOverrides.TryGetValue(id,out var value))return value;return Get(id)is{Hidden:false};}/// <summary>Opens the zone for travel, overriding the authoring default.</summary>
public void Open(string id)=>SetOpen(id,true);/// <summary>Closes the zone for travel, overriding the authoring default.</summary>
public void Close(string id)=>SetOpen(id,false);/// <summary>Reveals a hidden zone on the map.</summary>
public void Show(string id)=>SetVisible(id,true);/// <summary>Removes the zone from the map entirely until shown again.</summary>
public void Hide(string id)=>SetVisible(id,false);/// <summary> Drops both overrides, returning the zone to its authoring defaults. Unlike the other mutators this one works on unknown IDs too, so stale overrides of removed zones can be cleaned up. </summary>
public void ResetZone(string id){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return;var changed=openOverrides.Remove(id);changed|=visibleOverrides.Remove(id);if(changed)PublishChange(id,MapZoneChangeKind.Reset);}/// <summary> Forgets every override, returning all zones to their authoring defaults. Called when a new game starts so progression from the previous playthrough does not leak into it. </summary>
public void ResetOverrides(){if(openOverrides.Count==0&&visibleOverrides.Count==0)return;openOverrides.Clear();visibleOverrides.Clear();PublishChange(string.Empty,MapZoneChangeKind.Reset);}/// <summary>Copies the sparse overrides for the save system.</summary>
public MapZoneStateData ExportState(){return new MapZoneStateData{Open=new Dictionary<string,bool>(openOverrides,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase),Visible=new Dictionary<string,bool>(visibleOverrides,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase),};}/// <summary> Replaces the overrides with the values from a save. A save is the authoritative override set of its own playthrough, so the previous overrides are dropped entirely; zone IDs that no longer exist are kept (they cost nothing and survive a temporarily disabled mod). </summary>
public void ImportState(MapZoneStateData data){openOverrides.Clear();visibleOverrides.Clear();if(data?.Open!=null){foreach(var pair in data.Open)openOverrides[pair.Key]=pair.Value;}if(data?.Visible!=null){foreach(var pair in data.Visible)visibleOverrides[pair.Key]=pair.Value;}PublishChange(string.Empty,MapZoneChangeKind.Restore);}private void SetOpen(string id,bool value){if(!ChangeOverride(openOverrides,id,value,"open/close"))return;PublishChange(id,value?MapZoneChangeKind.Open:MapZoneChangeKind.Close);}private void SetVisible(string id,bool value){if(!ChangeOverride(visibleOverrides,id,value,"show/hide"))return;PublishChange(id,value?MapZoneChangeKind.Show:MapZoneChangeKind.Hide);}private bool ChangeOverride(Dictionary<string,bool>overrides,string id,bool value,string operation){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return false;if(!Contains(id)){GameLogger.Log("MAP",$"cannot {operation} unknown zone '{id}'",LogLevel.Warning);return false;}if(overrides.TryGetValue(id,out var current)&&current==value)return false;overrides[id]=value;return true;}private static void PublishChange(string zoneId,string change){ModEventBus.Publish(new MapZoneChangedEvent{ZoneId=zoneId,Change=change});}}}
