using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Single source of truth for world map zone visuals, shared by the live map (<see cref="MapZonesLayer"/>, which also backs the map editor's game-like preview) and the map editor's editing canvas. The editor and the game read the same colours, pattern and outline parameters here, so the two views cannot drift apart when the style is tuned. <para/> Zone visuals are built from a two-tone accent pair — gold with orange as its partner — instead of flat washes of a single hue, so a zone reads as an area while staying in the gold UI family: <list type="bullet"> <item>the fill is a diagonal hatch whose stripes alternate gold and orange, stamped through polygon UVs at a low state-dependent alpha so the map texture stays readable through the gaps;</item> <item>hover and selection use a two-tone dashed keyline: a solid orange polyline with gold dashes stamped on top, the classic marching-ants alternation repeated in the same accent pair.</item> </list> State only changes the hatch opacity and the outline weight, so the visual language is identical across normal, hover, selected and locked zones; the editor additionally uses the muted hidden state for zones the game would omit. The hatch is a tiny repeating texture stamped through polygon UVs rather than CPU line clipping, because the editor redraws on every drag frame and geometry clipping per frame would be wasteful. </summary>
public static class MapZoneStyle{/// <summary>Side of the repeating hatch tile in pixels.</summary>
public const int HatchTile=12;/// <summary>Thickness of one hatch stripe in pixels; the orange stripe follows the gold one immediately.</summary>
public const int HatchStripe=2;/// <summary>Gold half of the zone accent pair, used for hatch stripes and keyline dashes.</summary>
public static readonly Color Gold=UiTokens.AccentBright;/// <summary> Orange half of the zone accent pair, the deeper tone of the hatch and the keyline underlay. Deliberately close to <see cref="Gold"/> (the <c>TypeUsed</c> token) so the hatch reads as one warm texture instead of two fighting colours. </summary>
public static readonly Color Orange=UiTokens.TypeUsed;private static readonly Color NormalFill=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.4f);private static readonly Color HoverFill=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.6f);private static readonly Color SelectedFill=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.8f);private static readonly Color LockedFill=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0.18f);private static readonly Color HiddenFill=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.Faint,0.8f);private static readonly Color OutlineSolid=UiTokens.Alpha(Orange,0.95f);private static readonly Color OutlineDash=UiTokens.Alpha(Gold,0.95f);private static readonly Color OutlineSolidSoft=UiTokens.Alpha(Orange,0.6f);private static readonly Color OutlineDashSoft=UiTokens.Alpha(Gold,0.7f);private const float HoverOutlineWidth=1.6f;private const float SelectedOutlineWidth=2.6f;private const float OutlineDashLength=7f;/// <summary>Handle colour of a polygon vertex on the editing canvas.</summary>
public static readonly Color VertexHandle=UiTokens.AccentBright;/// <summary>Handle colour of a marker position on the editing canvas.</summary>
public static readonly Color MarkerHandle=UiTokens.TypePassive;/// <summary>Handle colour of a label position on the editing canvas.</summary>
public static readonly Color LabelHandle=UiTokens.AccentDim;private static Texture2D _hatchTexture;/// <summary> Enables texture repeat and filtering needed by the hatch fills. Call once from the drawing control (the map zones layer and the editing canvas both do it when they enter the tree). </summary>
public static void Prepare(CanvasItem canvas){canvas.TextureRepeat=CanvasItem.TextureRepeatEnum.Enabled;canvas.TextureFilter=CanvasItem.TextureFilterEnum.Linear;}/// <summary> Draws one zone polygon in pixel coordinates with the shared style. Polygons that cannot be triangulated (a self-intersecting outline produced while authoring) skip the hatch fill, so Godot does not report a native triangulation error on every frame; the keyline is still drawn for the selected and hovered states, which is enough for the author to find and repair the shape. <para/> <paramref name="hidden"/> is only passed by the editing canvas: the game and the preview omit hidden zones entirely, but the author still has to see and edit them, so they are painted with the muted hidden hatch and a soft keyline instead of disappearing. </summary>
public static void Draw(CanvasItem canvas,Vector2[]polygon,bool selected,bool hovered,bool locked,bool hidden=false){if(canvas==null||polygon==null||polygon.Length<2)return;var fill=hidden?HiddenFill:locked?LockedFill:selected?SelectedFill:hovered?HoverFill:NormalFill;if(polygon.Length>=3&&Geometry2D.TriangulatePolygon(polygon).Length>0)DrawHatch(canvas,polygon,fill);if(selected)DrawDashedKeyline(canvas,polygon,OutlineSolid,OutlineDash,SelectedOutlineWidth);else if(hidden||(hovered&& !locked))DrawDashedKeyline(canvas,polygon,OutlineSolidSoft,OutlineDashSoft,HoverOutlineWidth);}/// <summary> Colour of the repeating hatch pattern at a pixel offset: a 45° diagonal where the gold stripe is immediately followed by the orange one. using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map{/// <summary> Invisible interactive layer of the world map that draws every zone polygon and reports pointer activity through signals. Polygons arrive as normalised [0..1] point lists — the same data <see cref="MapZone"/> reads from <c>mods/&lt;mod&gt;/map/*.json</c> — and are scaled by the layer's own size, which keeps the map resolution-independent and makes the polygon a much larger click target than the tiny marker icon. <para/> The layer never selects anything by itself: <see cref="MapWidget"/> owns the selected zone and controls the outline through <see cref="SetSelected"/>. Hover is deliberately split in two: <see cref="SetHovered"/> is the cross-highlight entry point used when the pointer is over the paired marker, while pointer motion inside the layer emits <see cref="ZoneHoveredEventHandler"/>. Because the setter does not emit, marker and polygon can highlight each other without signal loops. <para/> All painting is delegated to <see cref="MapZoneStyle"/>, the single style definition shared with the map editor canvas, so the game and the editor render zones identically. Closed zones stay selectable (the location card explains the block): they use the dimmed locked hatch, and unlike before the selection keyline is still drawn for them, so a picked locked zone is visible too. </summary>
public partial class MapZonesLayer:Control{[Signal]public delegate void ZoneClickedEventHandler(string zoneId);[Signal]public delegate void ZoneHoveredEventHandler(string zoneId,bool hovered);private sealed class ZoneShape{/// <summary>Zone id this shape highlights on hover and reports on click.</summary>
public string ZoneId;/// <summary>Polygon vertices scaled to layer pixels at draw time.</summary>
public Vector2[]Points;/// <summary>True when the zone's effective open state is closed; switches the hatch to the dimmed locked style.</summary>
public bool Locked;}private readonly List<ZoneShape>_shapes=new();private string _selectedId;private string _hoverId;/// <summary>Prepares the canvas for hatch painting and subscribes pointer and resize handlers.</summary>
public override void _Ready(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;MapZoneStyle.Prepare(this);GuiInput+=OnGuiInput;MouseExited+=OnMouseExited;Resized+=OnResized;}/// <summary>Drops every registered polygon; call before rebuilding the zone set.</summary>
public void ClearZones(){_shapes.Clear();_selectedId=null;_hoverId=null;QueueRedraw();}/// <summary> Registers one normalised polygon. Shapes with fewer than three points have no interior and are skipped — such a zone can still be reached through its marker. </summary>
public void AddZone(string zoneId,IReadOnlyList<Vector2>normalizedPoints,bool locked){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(zoneId)||normalizedPoints==null||normalizedPoints.Count<3)return;var points=new Vector2[normalizedPoints.Count];for(var i=0;i<points.Length;i++)points[i]=normalizedPoints[i];_shapes.Add(new ZoneShape{ZoneId=zoneId,Points=points,Locked=locked});QueueRedraw();}/// <summary>Updates the closed state of a registered zone, e.g. after the active scene changed.</summary>
public void SetLocked(string zoneId,bool locked){foreach(var shape in _shapes){if(shape.ZoneId!=zoneId)continue;shape.Locked=locked;QueueRedraw();return;}}/// <summary>Marks the zone as selected; its outline is painted above every other polygon.</summary>
public void SetSelected(string zoneId){_selectedId=zoneId;QueueRedraw();}/// <summary> Applies a hover state coming from the paired marker. Does not emit <see cref="ZoneHoveredEventHandler"/> on purpose, so the marker's hover and the polygon's hover never bounce off each other. </summary>
public void SetHovered(string zoneId,bool hovered){if(hovered){if(_hoverId==zoneId)return;_hoverId=zoneId;}else{if(_hoverId!=zoneId)return;_hoverId=null;}QueueRedraw();}/// <summary>Paints every zone polygon, redrawing the selected one last so its keyline sits on top.</summary>
public override void _Draw(){if(_shapes.Count==0)return;ZoneShape selected=null;foreach(var shape in _shapes){if(shape.ZoneId==_selectedId){selected=shape;continue;}DrawShape(shape,Size);}if(selected!=null)DrawShape(selected,Size);}/// <summary> Paints one zone polygon through <see cref="MapZoneStyle"/>. Polygons that cannot be triangulated — a self-intersecting outline or a degenerate sliver produced while authoring — skip the fill entirely, because Godot's textured polygon draw reports a native triangulation error for them on every frame; the outline is still drawn so the author can see and repair the shape. </summary>

private ZoneShape HitTest(Vector2 point){for(var i=_shapes.Count-1;i>=0;i--){var shape=_shapes[i];if(Geometry2D.IsPointInPolygon(point,ScaledPolygon(shape,Size)))return shape;}return null;}private void ApplyPointer(ZoneShape shape){var nextId=shape?.ZoneId;var nextCursor=shape==null?CursorShape.Arrow:CursorShape.PointingHand;if(MouseDefaultCursorShape!=nextCursor)MouseDefaultCursorShape=nextCursor;if(_hoverId==nextId)return;var previous=_hoverId;_hoverId=nextId;QueueRedraw();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(previous))EmitSignal(SignalName.ZoneHovered,previous,false);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nextId))EmitSignal(SignalName.ZoneHovered,nextId,true);}private static Vector2[]ScaledPolygon(ZoneShape shape,Vector2 size){var result=new Vector2[shape.Points.Length];for(var i=0;i<result.Length;i++)result[i]=shape.Points[i]*size;return result;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Map.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;/// <summary> Zone lists arrive in mod load order, and a mod that ships a zone with an id already defined replaces it — the same rule as every other mod resource, so a dependent mod can reshape a zone of the mod it builds on. </summary>
public class MapZoneServiceTests{[ModTest("zones/later_definition_replaces_earlier")]static void LaterDefinitionReplacesEarlier(ModTestContext ctx){var service=MapZoneService.Instance;try{service.LoadZones(new List<MapZone>{new(){ID="test_zone",Title="owner"},new(){ID="test_other",Title="other"},new(){ID="TEST_ZONE",Title="dependent"},});ModAssert.Equal(2,service.Zones.Count,"zone count");ModAssert.Equal("dependent",service.Get("test_zone").Title,"the later definition wins");ModAssert.Equal("dependent",service.Zones[0].Title,"it keeps the replaced zone's place");}finally{service.ReloadFromMods();}}}}

MenuRegistry.RegisterMenuButton(new MenuButtonEntry{Id="new_game",ModId=ModId,Section="game",Locale="menu/newgame",Index=15,Visible=()=> !ActiveGame.IsFrontendOnly,Handler=BaseMenuActions.NewGame,});MenuRegistry.RegisterMenuButton(new MenuButtonEntry{Id="load",ModId=ModId,Section="game",Locale="ui/menu/load",Index=20,Handler=BaseMenuActions.Load,});MenuRegistry.RegisterMenuButton(new MenuButtonEntry{Id="settings",ModId=ModId,Section="game",Locale="menu/settings",Index=30,Handler=BaseMenuActions.Settings,});MenuRegistry.RegisterMenuButton(new MenuButtonEntry{Id="exit",ModId=ModId,Section="exit",Locale="menu/exit",Variation="danger",Index=1000,Handler=BaseMenuActions.Exit,});}}/// <summary> Handlers for the built-in menu buttons. using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.BaseMenu{/// <summary> Menu-side rules for entering games: "Continue", starting a game and loading a save. A game other than the running one (or any game from the front-end) is entered by replacing the mod set in-process (<see cref="GameSession.SwitchToAsync"/>). Before a save is loaded into a changed composition the player sees what changes (added mechanics start fresh, removed ones keep their data dormant) and a backup is taken. </summary>
internal static class GameFlow{/// <summary>Set after installing mods in this process: entering any game, even the running one, reloads the mod set to pick them up.</summary>
public static bool ReloadRequired{get;set;}public static bool HasContinue()=>LastSessionStore.Load()!=null;public static void Continue(Node host){var last=LastSessionStore.Load();if(last!=null)RequestLoad(host,last.GameId,last.FileName);}public static void StartGame(Node host,string gameId){if(IsRunning(gameId)&& !ReloadRequired)GameSession.StartNew(host);else Switch(host,gameId,null);}/// <summary> Loads <paramref name="fileName"/> of <paramref name="gameId"/> (null = a save made without a game), comparing compositions first. </summary>
public static void RequestLoad(Node host,string gameId,string fileName){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameId)){// Development launch with every mod: the save belongs to that mod set, load it as before.
if(!ActiveGame.IsActive&& !ActiveGame.IsFrontendOnly){GameSession.LoadAndEnter(host,fileName);return;}ChooseGameForSave(host,fileName);return;}var package=SaveService.ReadPackage(gameId,fileName);var diff=SaveCompositionDiff.Compute(package?.Game?.Mods,GameCatalog.Composition(gameId));if(diff.IsEmpty){Proceed(host,gameId,fileName,backup:false);return;}Confirm(host,TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/diff_title"),DescribeDiff(diff),TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/diff_ok"),()=>Proceed(host,gameId,fileName,backup:true));}private static void Proceed(Node host,string gameId,string fileName,bool backup){if(backup)SaveService.BackupSave(gameId,fileName);if(IsRunning(gameId)&& !ReloadRequired)GameSession.LoadAndEnter(host,fileName);else Switch(host,gameId,fileName);}private static async void Switch(Node host,string gameId,string fileName){if(await GameSession.SwitchToAsync(host,gameId,fileName))ReloadRequired=false;}/// <summary> The game is loaded and still matches its collection — only then can it be entered without a mod-set switch (an edited collection must apply). </summary>
private static bool IsRunning(string gameId)=>ActiveGame.IsActive&&string.Equals(ActiveGame.Id,gameId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !GameCatalog.IsActiveOutdated();/// <summary>Lists what a composition change does to the save, in player terms.</summary>
public static string DescribeDiff(SaveCompositionDiff diff){var text=new StringBuilder(TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/diff_intro"));void Section(string key,IEnumerable<string>lines){var list=lines.ToList();if(list.Count==0)return;text.Append("\n\n").Append(TranslationServer.Translate(key));foreach(var line in list)text.Append("\n  • ").Append(line);}Section("menu/load/diff_added",diff.Added.Select(ModTitle));Section("menu/load/diff_removed",diff.Removed.Select(ModTitle));Section("menu/load/diff_updated",diff.Updated.Select(u=>$"{ModTitle(u.ModId)}: {u.From} → {u.To}"+(u.Downgrade?" "+TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/diff_downgrade"):string.Empty)));text.Append("\n\n").Append(TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/diff_backup"));return text.ToString();}private static string ModTitle(string modId)=>ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods.TryGetValue(modId,out var info)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.DisplayTitle)?$"{info.DisplayTitle} ({modId})":modId;/// <summary>A save made before games existed: the player picks the game it belongs to; it moves there.</summary>
private static void ChooseGameForSave(Node host,string fileName){var games=GameCatalog.Games().Where(g=>g.IsReady).ToList();if(games.Count==0){Confirm(host,TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/legacy_title"),TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/legacy_no_games"),null,null);return;}var select=new OptionButton();foreach(var game in games)select.AddItem(game.Name??game.Collection.Id);var content=new VBoxContainer();content.AddChild(new Label{Text=TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/legacy_text"),AutowrapMode=TextServer.AutowrapMode.WordSmart,CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(420,0),});content.AddChild(select);var dialog=new ConfirmationDialog{Title=TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/legacy_title"),OkButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("menu/load/legacy_ok"),CancelButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("ui/save/cancel_button"),Exclusive=true,};dialog.AddChild(content);dialog.Confirmed+=()=>{var gameId=games[Math.Max(0,select.Selected)].Collection.Id;dialog.QueueFree();var slot=SaveService.AdoptLegacySave(fileName,gameId);RequestLoad(host,gameId,slot);};dialog.Canceled+=dialog.QueueFree;host.AddChild(dialog);dialog.PopupCentered();}/// <summary>Message or confirmation dialog; without <paramref name="onConfirm"/> it is a plain notice.</summary>
public static void Confirm(Node host,string title,string text,string okText,Action onConfirm){AcceptDialog dialog=onConfirm==null?new AcceptDialog():new ConfirmationDialog{CancelButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("ui/save/cancel_button")};dialog.Title=title;dialog.DialogText=text;dialog.Exclusive=true;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(okText))dialog.OkButtonText=okText;dialog.Confirmed+=()=>{dialog.QueueFree();onConfirm?.Invoke();};dialog.Canceled+=dialog.QueueFree;host.AddChild(dialog);if(onConfirm!=null)CthangoverTheme.ApplyPrimary(dialog.GetOkButton());dialog.PopupCentered();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Tool;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Menu;namespace Cthangover.BaseMenu{/// <summary> Title screen main menu, fully driven by <see cref="MenuRegistry"/>. The scene only defines named section containers (game, mods, exit, tools); every button — built-in or mod-provided — is created from registry entries, so mods can add, replace or re-order entries without touching this scene. Below the sections, every registered tool appends its own launcher button via <see cref="IToolProvider.AddMenuButton"/>, so no tool list is hardcoded here. If GameLogger reports mod compilation errors, a popup lists them. The SettingsMenu and SaveLoadMenu panels are instantiated at ready time but stay hidden; they are registered in <see cref="MenuRegistry"/> as panels "settings" and "save_load", so other mods can open them by id. </summary>
public partial class MainMenu:Control{private SettingsMenu _settingsMenu;private SaveLoadMenu _saveLoadMenu;private GamePickerPanel _gamePicker;private readonly Dictionary<Button,string>_btnKeys=new();public override void _Ready(){try{BuildUi();}catch(System.Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("MAIN_MENU",$"_Ready failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}{System.Environment.NewLine}{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);throw;}}/// <summary> Assembles the runtime UI: theme, hidden settings and save/load panels, telegram link wiring, scene manager initialization and registry/tool driven buttons. </summary>
private void BuildUi(){CthangoverTheme.Apply(this);// Panels of the session (pause menu, inventory, studio...) live on the persistent UI layer above every scene; none of them belongs on the title screen.
UiHost.Instance?.HideAll();_settingsMenu=new ModScenePrefab("scenes/menu/settings_menu.tscn").Instantiate<SettingsMenu>();_settingsMenu.Name="SettingsPanel";_settingsMenu.Visible=false;_settingsMenu.LanguageChanged+=RefreshButtons;AddChild(_settingsMenu);_saveLoadMenu=new ModScenePrefab("scenes/menu/save_load_menu.tscn").Instantiate<SaveLoadMenu>();_saveLoadMenu.Name="SaveLoadPanel";_saveLoadMenu.Visible=false;AddChild(_saveLoadMenu);_gamePicker=new ModScenePrefab("scenes/menu/game_picker.tscn").Instantiate<GamePickerPanel>();_gamePicker.Name="GamePickerPanel";AddChild(_gamePicker);_gamePicker.SavesRequested+=gameId=>{_gamePicker.Visible=false;_saveLoadMenu.OpenForGame(gameId);};var telegramLink=GetNode<RichTextLabel>("TelegramLink");telegramLink.MetaClicked+=OnTelegramLinkClicked;var sceneManager=GetNode<SceneManager>("/root/SceneManager");sceneManager.Initialize();BuildRegistryButtons();BuildToolButtons();CheckModCompilationErrors();RefreshButtons();StartWarmUp();}/// <summary> Compiles the mods of every ready game into the assembly cache in the background while the player looks at the menu (<see cref="GameSession.WarmUp"/>), the last played game first, so Play / Continue / Load only load cached assemblies instead of compiling behind the loading screen. </summary>
private static void StartWarmUp(){var last=LastSessionStore.Load()?.GameId;var ids=new List<string>();foreach(var game in GameCatalog.Games()){if(!game.IsReady)continue;if(string.Equals(game.Collection.Id,last,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))ids.Insert(0,game.Collection.Id);else ids.Add(game.Collection.Id);}GameSession.WarmUp(ids);}/// <summary> Creates one button per <see cref="MenuRegistry"/> entry, routed to the section container matching its <c>Section</c> ("game", "mods", "exit", "tools"). Runs after <see cref="SceneManager.Initialize"/> because the registry is built during boot and filled by mod initializers; the defensive Initialize call keeps direct scene launches working. Each button's translation key is registered so <see cref="RefreshButtons"/> keeps it localized. </summary>
private void BuildRegistryButtons(){var sections=new Dictionary<string,Container>{{"game",GetNode<Container>("MenuContainer/GameButtons")},{MenuButtonEntry.SectionMods,GetNode<Container>("MenuContainer/ModMenuButtons")},{"exit",GetNode<Container>("MenuContainer/ExitButtons")},{"tools",GetNode<Container>("MenuContainer/ToolMenuButtons")},};MenuBuilder.Build(this,sections);foreach(var container in sections.Values)MenuBuilder.CollectLocaleKeys(container,_btnKeys);}/// <summary> Lets every registered tool append its launcher button to the tool block below Exit (<c>MenuContainer/ToolMenuButtons</c>). Tools register themselves in <see cref="ToolFactory"/>, so the block stays empty when no tools are installed and needs no changes when a mod introduces a new tool. Each button carries its translation key in metadata, keeping <see cref="RefreshButtons"/> aware of it. </summary>
private void BuildToolButtons(){var container=GetNodeOrNull<VBoxContainer>("MenuContainer/ToolMenuButtons");if(container==null)return;foreach(var tool in ToolFactory.Instance.GetAll())tool.AddMenuButton(container);MenuBuilder.CollectLocaleKeys(container,_btnKeys);GameLogger.Log("MAIN_MENU",$"Built {container.GetChildCount()} tool button(s)");}private void CheckModCompilationErrors(){if(GameLogger.CompilationErrors.Count==0)return;var errorText=string.Join("\r\n",GameLogger.CompilationErrors);ShowModErrorPopup(errorText);}private void RefreshButtons(){foreach(var kv in _btnKeys)kv.Key.Text=TranslationServer.Translate(kv.Value);}private void ShowModErrorPopup(string errorText){var dialog=new AcceptDialog();dialog.Title="Mod Compilation Error";dialog.DialogText=errorText;dialog.OkButtonText="OK";dialog.Exclusive=true;AddChild(dialog);dialog.PopupCentered();}private void OnTelegramLinkClicked(Variant meta){OS.ShellOpen($"https://{meta.AsString()}");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.BaseMenu{/// <summary> Save/load browser with unlimited slots, in the menu window shell (<see cref="MenuWindowShell"/>; the game selector sits in the header). The grid shows 3×2 slots per screen and scrolls past that. Saves belong to games: in a game the panel shows that game's slots (save mode appends one empty "new" slot); from the front-end the selector at the top switches between games with saves and the saves made before games existed. This is intentional: the save grid has a fixed visual size and doesn't need scrolling or dynamic content sizing. [Export]public int ColumnCount{get;set;}=4;/// <summary>Number of rows in the save slot grid. Editor-configurable.</summary>
[Export]public int RowCount{get;set;}=3;/// <summary>Spacing between adjacent slots in pixels. Editor-configurable.</summary>
[Export]public float SlotPadding{get;set;}=8f;private List<SaveSlotInfo>_slotModels;/// <summary>Width kept free for the vertical scroll bar of the parent <see cref="ScrollContainer"/>.</summary>

public void Refresh(){ClearItems();if(_slotModels==null||_itemScene==null)return;var contentSize=ViewportSize();if(contentSize.X<=0||contentSize.Y<=0)return;// One screen holds ColumnCount × RowCount slots; more rows extend the list and the parent ScrollContainer scrolls.

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.HotReload;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.CollectionEditTest{/// <summary> The player edits the collection of the game that is running, in ONE process: <list type="number"> <item>The novel template is entered; it matches its collection and the editors are not loaded.</item> <item>The collection gets the developer toolset (<c>dev_tools</c>: editors, the scenario studio, …), saved the way the collection editor saves it (a user package with the same id): the running game is now outdated.</item> <item>The pause menu's "Main menu" button leaves the game like a player does, and the pause menu does not stay above the title screen.</item> <item>Menu → Play → New game of the same game switches the mod set in place: the editors and the studio are loaded, the studio's button is on the game's toolbar and the game matches its collection again.</item> </list> A player's own package of the game is moved aside for the run and put back afterwards. Prints <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=collection_edit</c>. </summary>
public partial class CollectionEditTestDriverNode:Node{public const string Flag="--itest=collection_edit";private const string GameId="novel_template";private const string AddedToolset="dev_tools";private const string AddedMod="editor_tools";private const string StudioMod="scenario_studio";private const string GameMenuId="game_menu";private const float TimeoutSeconds=240f;private readonly List<string>failures=new();private readonly List<string>enteredScenes=new();private readonly List<(string From,string To)>movedAside=new();private bool startedOnPlayerPackage;private int passed;private int step;private double elapsed;private double stepAt;private bool done;public override void _Ready(){// The driver must keep ticking across the mod-set switch.
ProcessMode=ProcessModeEnum.Always;ModEventBus.Subscribe<SceneEnteredEvent>(OnSceneEntered);}public override void _ExitTree(){ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<SceneEnteredEvent>(OnSceneEntered);}public override void _Process(double delta){if(done)return;elapsed+=delta;if(elapsed>TimeoutSeconds){failures.Add($"timeout at step {step} (scene='{SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()}', game='{ActiveGame.Id}')");Finish();return;}if(elapsed-stepAt<0.25)return;stepAt=elapsed;try{RunStep();}catch(Exception ex){failures.Add($"step {step}: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");Finish();}}private Control Menu=>GetTree().CurrentScene as Control;private static bool Busy=>GameSession.IsSwitching||ModManager.Instance.IsReloading||ModHotReloadService.IsReloadRunning;private static bool EditorsLoaded=>ModRegistry.Instance.Mods.ContainsKey(AddedMod);/// <summary>Scenes of the game entered since the last clear; the main menu does not count.</summary>
private void OnSceneEntered(SceneEnteredEvent e){if(!string.Equals(e.SceneName,"mainmenu",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))enteredScenes.Add(e.SceneName);}private void RunStep(){switch(step){case 0:if(!Boot.IsReady||Busy||ActiveGame.Id!=GameId||enteredScenes.Count==0)return;Check($"game '{GameId}' entered ('{enteredScenes[0]}')",true);Check("a freshly entered game matches its collection",!GameCatalog.IsActiveOutdated());MoveUserPackageAside();// A player's own package of the game (say, with the editors added) was what the game started on: then the editors may already be loaded and New game need not switch the set. The package is restored at the end.
startedOnPlayerPackage=movedAside.Count>0;if(startedOnPlayerPackage)GameLogger.Log("TEST","CollectionEditTest: the game started on the player's own package; the before/switch checks are skipped");else Check($"'{AddedMod}' is not loaded before the edit",!EditorsLoaded);AddEditorsToCollection();Check("the edited collection makes the running game outdated",GameCatalog.IsActiveOutdated());AppServices.Current.Ui.ToggleEntry(GameMenuId);break;case 1:{var open=UiHost.Instance.TryGetInstance(GameMenuId,out var menu)&&menu.Visible;Check("the pause menu is open",open);if(menu?.FindChild("MainMenuBtn",true,false)is not Button mainMenu){failures.Add("the pause menu has no Main menu button");Finish();return;}mainMenu.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);break;}case 2:if(Busy||GetTree().CurrentScene is not Cthangover.BaseMenu.MainMenu)return;Check("the pause menu is closed on the title screen",!UiHost.Instance.TryGetInstance(GameMenuId,out var left)|| !left.IsVisibleInTree());break;case 3:if(Busy|| !PressMenuPlay())return;enteredScenes.Clear();break;case 4:if(!StartFromPicker())return;break;case 5:{if(Busy||ActiveGame.Id!=GameId||enteredScenes.Count==0)return;var reload=ModManager.Instance.LastReload;if(!startedOnPlayerPackage)Check("New game after the edit switched the mod set",reload?.Applied==true&&reload.Plan?.Load.Contains(AddedMod)==true);Check($"'{AddedMod}' is loaded after the edit",EditorsLoaded);Check($"'{StudioMod}' is loaded after the edit",ModRegistry.Instance.Mods.ContainsKey(StudioMod));Check("the studio's button is on the game's toolbar",HasToolbarButton(StudioButtonTooltip()));Check("the game matches its edited collection",!GameCatalog.IsActiveOutdated());Check($"entered a scene of '{GameId}' ('{enteredScenes[0]}')",true);Finish();return;}}step++;}/// <summary> Saves the game's collection with the developer toolset included, as a user package — what the collection editor does when the player adds it. </summary>
private void AddEditorsToCollection(){var source=GameCatalog.LoadCollections()[GameId];var edited=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ModCollection>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(source));edited.Package=source.Package;edited.Includes??=new List<ModCollectionInclude>();edited.Includes.Add(new ModCollectionInclude{Ref=AddedToolset+">=1",Role="tools"});var user=ModCollectionStore.LoadUser().Where(c=> !string.Equals(c.Id,GameId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();user.Add(edited);ModCollectionStore.SaveUser(user);}private void MoveUserPackageAside(){// UserPath ends with a separator: without the trim the "parent" is the collections folder itself, the backup was scanned as a package and Cleanup's RemoveUser(GameId) deleted the player's package with it.
var root=ModCollectionStore.UserPath.TrimEnd('/','\\');foreach(var path in new[]{Path.Combine(root,GameId),Path.Combine(root,GameId+".zip")}){var aside=Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(root)??root,$"collection_edit_backup_{Path.GetFileName(path)}");if(Directory.Exists(path))Directory.Move(path,aside);else if(File.Exists(path))File.Move(path,aside);else continue;movedAside.Add((path,aside));}}private void Cleanup(){ModCollectionStore.RemoveUser(GameId);foreach(var(from,aside)in movedAside){if(Directory.Exists(aside))Directory.Move(aside,from);else if(File.Exists(aside))File.Move(aside,from);}}/// <summary> Tooltip of the studio's toolbar button, read from the panel entry the studio registered: the suite does not depend on the studio (it is added by the edit), so its locale key must not be hard-coded here. </summary>
private static string StudioButtonTooltip(){var locale=UiRegistry.PanelEntries.FirstOrDefault(e=>e.ModId==StudioMod&&e.Button!=null)?.Button.Locale;return locale==null?null:TranslationServer.Translate(locale).ToString();}private bool HasToolbarButton(string tooltip)=>GetTree().Root.FindChildren("*","Button",true,false).OfType<Button>().Any(b=>b.TooltipText==tooltip&&b.IsVisibleInTree());/// <summary>The main menu's Play button, pressed; false while it is not on screen.</summary>
private bool PressMenuPlay(){if(Menu?.FindChild("play",true,false)is not Button play)return false;play.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);return true;}/// <summary>Presses New game on the game's card in the picker; false until the picker is open.</summary>
private bool StartFromPicker(){var picker=Menu?.FindChild("GamePickerPanel",true,false)as Control;if(picker?.Visible!=true)return false;var game=GameCatalog.Games().FirstOrDefault(g=>g.Collection.Id==GameId);var start=StartButton(picker,game?.Name??GameId);Check($"'{GameId}' card has an enabled New game button",start is{Disabled:false});if(start==null||start.Disabled){Finish();return false;}start.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);return true;}/// <summary>The New game button on the card titled <paramref name="title"/>.</summary>
private static Button StartButton(Node picker,string title){var newGameText=TranslationServer.Translate("menu/play/new_game").ToString();// A card is the innermost panel holding exactly one New game button (the picker frame holds them all).
foreach(var card in picker.FindChildren("*","PanelContainer",true,false)){var starts=card.FindChildren("*","Button",true,false).OfType<Button>().Where(b=>b.Text==newGameText).ToList();if(starts.Count==1&&card.FindChildren("*","Label",true,false).OfType<Label>().Any(l=>l.Text==title))return starts[0];}return null;}private void Check(string name,bool ok){if(ok){passed++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"CollectionEditTest: [OK] {name}");}else{failures.Add(name);GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"CollectionEditTest: [FAIL] {name}",LogLevel.Error);}}private void Finish(){if(done)return;done=true;Cleanup();foreach(var failure in failures)GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"CollectionEditTest: failed: {failure}");GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=collection_edit passed={passed} failed={failures.Count}");GetTree().Quit(failures.Count==0?0:1);}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.CollectionEditTest{/// <summary>Queues <see cref="CollectionEditTestDriverNode"/> only for <c>--itest=collection_edit</c>.</summary>

namespace HotReloadProbeApp
{
    public partial class ProbeNode : Node

    }

    public class ProbeAppInitializer : Cthangover.Core.Mods.IModInitializer

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.HotReload;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Dialog;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Mods.NewGameTest{/// <summary> Plays the games the way a player does, in ONE process: no restart happens anywhere, every game switch replaces the mod set in place. <list type="number"> <item>The front-end menu warms every game's mods up in the background; once done, Play → the <c>cthangover</c> card → New game: the process switches to the game, enters <c>prolog_alley</c> and the opening dialog about the hungover Marao is clicked through.</item> <item>Hot reload inside the game (forced reload of <c>cthangover_party</c>): the session is parked, the mod reloads into a new context and the game comes back in <c>prolog_alley</c>.</item> <item>Back to the menu → <c>novel_template</c>: mods outside that game are unloaded and a scene of the game is entered.</item> <item>Back to the menu → <c>cthangover</c> again → <c>prolog_alley</c>.</item> </list> After every switch the released mod contexts must be collected (<c>ModManager.LastReload.Leaked</c> empty). Scene entries are taken from <see cref="SceneEnteredEvent"/>, not by polling the current scene name: a game's entry scene may move on to the next scene within a frame. Prints <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=new_game</c>. </summary>
public partial class NewGameTestDriverNode:Node{public const string Flag="--itest=new_game";private const string MainGame="cthangover";private const string SecondGame="novel_template";private const string PrologScene="prolog_alley";private const string HotReloadedMod="cthangover_party";private const float TimeoutSeconds=420f;private readonly List<string>failures=new();private readonly List<string>enteredScenes=new();private int passed;private int step;private double elapsed;private double stepAt;private bool done;private bool sawMarao;private int clicks;private bool hotReloadDone;public override void _Ready(){// The driver must keep ticking across every mod-set switch of the run.
ProcessMode=ProcessModeEnum.Always;ModEventBus.Subscribe<SceneEnteredEvent>(OnSceneEntered);}public override void _ExitTree(){ModEventBus.Unsubscribe<SceneEnteredEvent>(OnSceneEntered);}public override void _Process(double delta){if(done)return;elapsed+=delta;if(elapsed>TimeoutSeconds){failures.Add($"timeout at step {step} (scene='{SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()}', game='{ActiveGame.Id}')");Finish();return;}if(elapsed-stepAt<0.25)return;stepAt=elapsed;try{RunStep();}catch(Exception ex){failures.Add($"step {step}: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");Finish();}}private Control Menu=>GetTree().CurrentScene as Control;private static bool Busy=>GameSession.IsSwitching||ModManager.Instance.IsReloading||ModHotReloadService.IsReloadRunning;private void OnSceneEntered(SceneEnteredEvent e)=>enteredScenes.Add(e.SceneName);private void RunStep(){switch(step){case 0:// The menu compiles the games' mods in the background; the switch below must then only load them from the cache (see the log).
if(!Boot.IsReady||GetTree().CurrentScene is not Cthangover.BaseMenu.MainMenu||GameSession.IsWarmingUp)return;if(!PressMenuPlay())return;Check("the menu warmed the games up in the background",true);Check("front-end menu offers Play",ActiveGame.IsFrontendOnly);break;case 1:if(!StartFromPicker(MainGame))return;break;case 2:if(Busy||ActiveGame.Id!=MainGame|| !enteredScenes.Contains(PrologScene))return;CheckSwitch(MainGame,expectUnload:false);Check($"entered '{PrologScene}'",true);break;case 3:{var box=DialogBox();if(box==null|| !box.IsRunning)return;Check("prologue dialog runs",true);break;}case 4:{// Click through the opening like a player, watching the text for Marao.
var box=DialogBox();sawMarao|=DialogMentionsMarao();if(box!=null&& !box.IsDialogEnded){if(box.IsWaitingAnswer)box.TrySelectVariant(0);else box.NextAction();clicks++;return;}Check("prologue text is about Marao",sawMarao);Check("opening dialog has several lines",clicks>=5);Check($"still in '{PrologScene}' after the opening",SceneManager.GetCurrentSceneName()==PrologScene);enteredScenes.Clear();StartHotReload();break;}case 5:{if(!hotReloadDone||Busy|| !enteredScenes.Contains(PrologScene))return;var reload=ModManager.Instance.LastReload;Check("in-game hot reload applied",reload?.Applied==true);Check($"hot reload reloaded '{HotReloadedMod}'",reload?.Plan?.Load.Contains(HotReloadedMod)==true);Check("hot reload kept the front-end loaded",reload?.Plan?.Keep.Contains("menu_base")==true);Check("hot reload released every old context",reload?.Leaked.Count==0);Check($"hot reload kept the game '{MainGame}'",ActiveGame.Id==MainGame);Check($"session came back in '{PrologScene}'",true);GetTree().Root.GetNode<GodotSceneService>("GodotSceneService").SwitchToMenu();break;}case 6:if(Busy|| !PressMenuPlay())return;enteredScenes.Clear();break;case 7:if(!StartFromPicker(SecondGame))return;break;case 8:if(Busy||ActiveGame.Id!=SecondGame||enteredScenes.Count==0)return;CheckSwitch(SecondGame,expectUnload:true);Check($"entered a scene of '{SecondGame}' ('{enteredScenes[0]}')",true);GetTree().Root.GetNode<GodotSceneService>("GodotSceneService").SwitchToMenu();break;case 9:if(Busy|| !PressMenuPlay())return;enteredScenes.Clear();break;case 10:if(!StartFromPicker(MainGame))return;break;case 11:if(Busy||ActiveGame.Id!=MainGame|| !enteredScenes.Contains(PrologScene))return;CheckSwitch(MainGame,expectUnload:false);Check($"back in '{PrologScene}' after switching games twice",true);Finish();return;}step++;}private async void StartHotReload(){await ModHotReloadService.ReloadNowAsync(new[]{HotReloadedMod});hotReloadDone=true;}/// <summary>The launcher's or the main menu's Play button, pressed; false while neither is on screen.</summary>
private bool PressMenuPlay(){if(GetTree().CurrentScene?.FindChild("LauncherPlay",true,false)is Button launcherPlay){launcherPlay.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);return false;}if(Menu?.FindChild("play",true,false)is not Button play)return false;play.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);return true;}/// <summary>Presses New game on the game's card in the picker; false until the picker is open.</summary>
private bool StartFromPicker(string gameId){var picker=Menu?.FindChild("GamePickerPanel",true,false)as Control;if(picker?.Visible!=true)return false;var game=FindGame(gameId);Check($"game '{gameId}' is listed and ready",game?.IsReady==true);var start=StartButton(picker,game?.Name??gameId);Check($"'{gameId}' card has an enabled New game button",start is{Disabled:false});if(start==null||start.Disabled||failures.Count>0){Finish();return false;}start.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);Check($"New game of '{gameId}' switches in-process, without a restart",!OS.IsRestartOnExitSet());return true;}private void CheckSwitch(string gameId,bool expectUnload){var reload=ModManager.Instance.LastReload;Check($"switch into '{gameId}' applied",reload?.Applied==true);Check($"switch into '{gameId}' kept the front-end loaded",reload?.Plan?.Keep.Contains("menu_base")==true);if(expectUnload)Check($"switch into '{gameId}' unloaded mods outside the game",reload?.Plan?.Unload.Count>0);Check($"switch into '{gameId}' released every old context",reload?.Leaked.Count==0);if(reload?.Leaked.Count>0)GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"NewGameTest: leaked contexts: {string.Join(", ", reload.Leaked)}",LogLevel.Error);}private static ModCollectionGameSummary FindGame(string gameId){foreach(var game in GameCatalog.Games()){if(game.Collection.Id==gameId)return game;}return null;}/// <summary>The New game button on the card titled <paramref name="title"/>.</summary>
private static Button StartButton(Node picker,string title){if(picker==null)return null;var newGameText=TranslationServer.Translate("menu/play/new_game").ToString();// A card is the innermost panel holding exactly one New game button (the picker frame holds them all).
foreach(var card in picker.FindChildren("*","PanelContainer",true,false)){Button start=null;var starts=0;foreach(var child in card.FindChildren("*","Button",true,false)){if(child is Button button&&button.Text==newGameText){start=button;starts++;}}if(starts==1&&HasLabel(card,title))return start;}return null;}private static bool HasLabel(Node card,string title){foreach(var child in card.FindChildren("*","Label",true,false)){if(child is Label label&&label.Text==title)return true;}return false;}private IDialogBox DialogBox()=>GetTree().Root.FindChild("DialogBox",true,false)as IDialogBox;private bool DialogMentionsMarao(){if(DialogBox()is not Node node)return false;foreach(var child in node.FindChildren("*","",true,false)){var text=child switch{RichTextLabel r=>r.Text,Label l=>l.Text,_=>null,};if(text!=null&&(text.Contains("Марао")||text.Contains("Marao")))return true;}return false;}private void Check(string name,bool ok){if(ok){passed++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"NewGameTest: [OK] {name}");}else{failures.Add(name);GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"NewGameTest: [FAIL] {name}",LogLevel.Error);}}private void Finish(){if(done)return;done=true;foreach(var failure in failures)GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"NewGameTest: failed: {failure}");GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=new_game passed={passed} failed={failures.Count}");GetTree().Quit(failures.Count==0?0:1);}}}

namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> User-triggered mod operation. The screen resolves a tile's primary action via <see cref="ModActions.GetPrimary"/> and executes the kind here; the detail view maps its buttons to the same kinds. Every kind is persisted to disk immediately but only takes effect after a restart. </summary>
public enum ModActionKind{/// <summary>Download and install the selected catalog version.</summary>
Install,/// <summary>Install a newer catalog version over the local copy.</summary>
Update,/// <summary>Install an older catalog version over the local copy.</summary>
Downgrade,/// <summary>Reinstall the same version to replace locally modified files.</summary>
Reinstall,/// <summary>Delete the installed mod (user mods root only), then clean per-mod state.</summary>
Delete,/// <summary>Allow the mod to load on next start.</summary>
Enable,/// <summary>Prevent the mod from loading on next start.</summary>
Disable,}}

===== FILE mods/mod_manager/src/Model/ModActions.cs =====
namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Business rules deciding which operation a mod tile offers. The tile shows a single contextual button; its meaning follows the state machine: catalog-only → Install, newer remote → Update, older remote → Downgrade, same version but edited locally → Reinstall, otherwise → Delete for deletable local mods and nothing for protected/shipped ones. </summary>
public static class ModActions{/// <summary>Primary action for a tile/detail page, or null when there is nothing to do.</summary>
public static ModActionKind?GetPrimary(ModCardData data){if(data==null)return null;if(!data.IsInstalled)return data.HasRemote?ModActionKind.Install:null;if(data.HasRemote){switch(data.Status){case ModItemStatus.UpdateAvailable:return ModActionKind.Update;case ModItemStatus.DowngradeAvailable:return ModActionKind.Downgrade;case ModItemStatus.ModifiedLocally:return ModActionKind.Reinstall;}}return data.IsDeletable?ModActionKind.Delete:null;}/// <summary>True for actions that download and install files.</summary>
public static bool IsInstall(ModActionKind kind)=>kind==ModActionKind.Install||kind==ModActionKind.Update||kind==ModActionKind.Downgrade||kind==ModActionKind.Reinstall;}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> One row of the mod manager grid: everything the tile and the detail page need to render a mod, regardless of whether it exists locally, in the online catalog, or both. The manager builds these in <see cref="ModManagerModel.Reload"/> by merging <c>ModRegistry.AllDiscoveredMods</c> with <c>CatalogService.CachedEntries</c>. <para/> <see cref="Status"/> is derived (not stored by the registry) from the local version, the selected catalog download and the local install hash — call <see cref="RecomputeStatus"/> after changing <see cref="SelectedDownload"/>, <see cref="IsDisabled"/> or the install state. </summary>
public class ModCardData{/// <summary>Stable mod id shared by the local mod and the catalog entry.</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Localized display title (local manifest name or catalog locale name).</summary>
public string Title{get;set;}/// <summary>Author string from whichever source is available.</summary>
public string Author{get;set;}/// <summary>Localized description.</summary>
public string Description{get;set;}/// <summary>Installed version string, or null for catalog-only mods.</summary>
public string LocalVersion{get;set;}/// <summary>Manifest category (local) or catalog category (remote), flags combined.</summary>
public CategoryType Category{get;set;}=CategoryType.Other;/// <summary>Loaded local mod, or null when only the catalog knows this id.</summary>
public ModInfo LocalInfo{get;set;}/// <summary>Merged catalog entry, or null for local-only (development) mods.</summary>
public CatalogExportEntry Catalog{get;set;}/// <summary>True when a local copy exists (including an install done in this session).</summary>
public bool IsInstalled{get;set;}/// <summary>True when the local copy is listed in <c>disabled_mods.json</c>.</summary>
public bool IsDisabled{get;set;}/// <summary>True when <see cref="ModUninstaller"/> may delete the local copy.</summary>
public bool IsDeletable{get;set;}/// <summary>True for the mod manager itself, which cannot be disabled or deleted.</summary>
public bool IsProtected{get;set;}/// <summary>Derived tile state; see <see cref="RecomputeStatus"/>.</summary>
public ModItemStatus Status{get;set;}/// <summary>Catalog downloads, newest first (as merged by the catalog service).</summary>
public List<CatalogEntryDownload>Downloads{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Version chosen in the tile/detail combo box; defaults to the newest download.</summary>
public CatalogEntryDownload SelectedDownload{get;set;}/// <summary>True when an online catalog entry exists for this mod.</summary>
public bool HasRemote=>Catalog!=null;/// <summary> True when several catalogs publish this id with the same version and title but different content — the tile and detail page warn about it. </summary>
public bool IsConflict=>Catalog?.VariantConflict==true;/// <summary> How many <see cref="ModCollectionKind.Game"/> collections reference this mod (directly or through includes). Computed by the manager screen via <see cref="ModCollectionGallery.FindGamesUsingMod"/> on every grid refresh; zero means the mod belongs to no playable game. </summary>
public int CollectionsCount{get;set;}/// <summary>Catalog URLs that published this variant, or null for local-only mods.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>SourceUrls=>Catalog?.SourceUrls;/// <summary>First catalog URL; used to install exactly this variant and to match cards after reload.</summary>
public string PrimarySource=>ModCatalogSource.FirstUrl(SourceUrls);/// <summary> Identity of a card across model reloads: the mod id plus the catalog variant it represents. Needed because conflicting variants share an id. </summary>
public string MatchKey=>$"{Id}|{PrimarySource ?? string.Empty}";/// <summary>True when the tile should show the enable/disable switch.</summary>
public bool CanToggleEnabled=>IsInstalled&& !IsProtected;/// <summary>Version to display next to the title: installed version or newest catalog version.</summary>
public string DisplayVersion=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalVersion)?LocalVersion:SelectedDownload?.Version??Catalog?.Version;/// <summary> Derives <see cref="Status"/> from the local and selected remote versions. Priority: not installed → disabled → version comparison → hash comparison. A missing catalog entry always yields <see cref="ModItemStatus.Installed"/> for a local copy. </summary>
public void RecomputeStatus(){if(!IsInstalled){Status=ModItemStatus.NotInstalled;return;}if(IsDisabled){Status=ModItemStatus.Disabled;return;}var remoteVersion=SelectedDownload?.Version??Catalog?.Version;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteVersion)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalVersion)){Status=ModItemStatus.Installed;return;}var comparison=VersionHelper.Compare(remoteVersion,LocalVersion);if(comparison>0){Status=ModItemStatus.UpdateAvailable;return;}if(comparison<0){Status=ModItemStatus.DowngradeAvailable;return;}var remoteHash=SelectedDownload?.InstallSha256;if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(remoteHash)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalInfo?.InstallSha256)&& !string.Equals(LocalInfo.InstallSha256,remoteHash,System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){Status=ModItemStatus.ModifiedLocally;return;}Status=ModItemStatus.Installed;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Live filter state of the manager. Empty status/category sets mean "all", which matches Nexus-style sidebars where checkboxes only ever narrow the list. Search matches title, id and author case-insensitively. The state also owns the sort mode and the optional grouping toggle. </summary>
public class ModFilterState{/// <summary>Free-text query matched against title, id and author.</summary>
public string Search{get;set;}=string.Empty;/// <summary>Selected statuses; empty means no status restriction.</summary>
public HashSet<ModItemStatus>Statuses{get;}=new();/// <summary>Selected categories; empty means no category restriction.</summary>
public HashSet<CategoryType>Categories{get;}=new();/// <summary>Grid ordering mode.</summary>
public ModSortMode Sort{get;set;}=ModSortMode.Name;/// <summary>When true the grid renders category headers between groups.</summary>
public bool GroupByCategory{get;set;}/// <summary>Full match: search + status + category.</summary>
public bool Matches(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesStatuses(item)&&MatchesCategories(item);/// <summary>Match ignoring the category set — used to compute category counts.</summary>
public bool MatchesExceptCategory(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesStatuses(item);/// <summary>Match ignoring the status set — used to compute status counts.</summary>
public bool MatchesExceptStatus(ModCardData item)=>MatchesSearch(item)&&MatchesCategories(item);/// <summary>Returns matching items in the configured order.</summary>
public List<ModCardData>Apply(IEnumerable<ModCardData>source){var result=new List<ModCardData>();foreach(var item in source){if(Matches(item))result.Add(item);}result.Sort(Compare);return result;}/// <summary>Clears search, statuses and categories; keeps sort and grouping.</summary>
public void Reset(){Search=string.Empty;Statuses.Clear();Categories.Clear();}private int Compare(ModCardData a,ModCardData b){switch(Sort){case ModSortMode.Author:var byAuthor=string.Compare(a.Author,b.Author,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return byAuthor!=0?byAuthor:CompareTitle(a,b);case ModSortMode.Status:var byStatus=ModStatusNames.SortRank(a.Status).CompareTo(ModStatusNames.SortRank(b.Status));return byStatus!=0?byStatus:CompareTitle(a,b);default:return CompareTitle(a,b);}}private static int CompareTitle(ModCardData a,ModCardData b)=>string.Compare(a.Title,b.Title,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private bool MatchesSearch(ModCardData item){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Search))return true;var query=Search.Trim();return Contains(item.Title,query)||Contains(item.Id,query)||Contains(item.Author,query);}private bool MatchesStatuses(ModCardData item)=>Statuses.Count==0||Statuses.Contains(item.Status);private bool MatchesCategories(ModCardData item)=>Categories.Count==0||(item.Category&AsFlags())!=0;private CategoryType AsFlags(){var flags=(CategoryType)0;foreach(var category in Categories)flags|=category;return flags;}private static bool Contains(string value,string query)=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)&&value.Contains(query,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}}

namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> UI-level state of a mod tile. Combines the local install state with the online catalog comparison so a single value drives the tile badge and the contextual action button. <see cref="ModifiedLocally"/> means the local content hash differs from the catalog entry of the same version — the player edited the mod and overwriting would lose their changes. </summary>
public enum ModItemStatus{/// <summary>No local copy exists; only the catalog entry is shown.</summary>
NotInstalled,/// <summary>Installed and up-to-date with the selected catalog version (or no catalog entry).</summary>
Installed,/// <summary>The catalog has a newer version than the installed one.</summary>
UpdateAvailable,/// <summary>The catalog's selected version is older than the installed one.</summary>
DowngradeAvailable,/// <summary>Same version as the catalog, but the local content hash differs.</summary>
ModifiedLocally,/// <summary>Installed but disabled by the player (<c>disabled_mods.json</c>).</summary>
Disabled,}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Merges everything known about mods into the manager's grid model: local mods discovered by <see cref="ModRegistry"/> (with enable state and deletability) and online catalog entries from <see cref="CatalogService"/>. A mod present in both sources becomes one combined card; catalog-only mods appear as installable tiles. <para/> The model also owns the session overrides that keep the UI honest after file operations: a mod installed or deleted from the manager is not yet reflected by the registry (which is loaded once per launch), so <see cref="MarkInstalled"/> / <see cref="MarkRemoved"/> adjust the view and the restart banner tells the player when the change becomes real. </summary>
public class ModManagerModel{/// <summary>Id of the mod that renders this UI; it can never be disabled or removed.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Read-only cross-mod lookups used by the detail page: direct dependencies, reverse dependencies (which mods depend on this one) and declared conflicts. Prefers local manifest data and falls back to the catalog entry for mods that are not installed. </summary>
public static class ModQueries{/// <summary>Dependency strings (<c>core&gt;=1</c> format) of a mod, whatever source knows it.</summary>
public static List<string>GetDependencies(ModCardData data){var manifestDeps=data?.LocalInfo?.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(manifestDeps!=null&&manifestDeps.Count>0)return manifestDeps;return data?.Catalog?.Depends??new List<string>();}/// <summary>Ids of installed mods whose manifests depend on <paramref name="modId"/>.</summary>
public static List<string>GetDependents(string modId){var result=new List<string>();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(modId))return result;var allMods=ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods;if(allMods==null)return result;foreach(var pair in allMods){if(pair.Key==modId||pair.Value is not ModInfo info)continue;var deps=info.Manifest?.DependencyIds;if(deps!=null&&deps.Contains(modId))result.Add(pair.Key);}return result;}/// <summary>Declared mutually exclusive mod ids (manifest first, catalog fallback).</summary>
public static List<string>GetConflicts(ModCardData data){var manifestConflicts=data?.LocalInfo?.Manifest?.ConflictsWith;if(manifestConflicts!=null&&manifestConflicts.Count>0)return manifestConflicts;return data?.Catalog?.ConflictsWith??new List<string>();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Transparent overlay that paints the scheme's dependency lines above the group cards, the Godot counterpart of the mockup's SVG layer. Drawing is connected through the <c>"draw"</c> signal rather than a <c>_Draw</c> override, because virtual overrides are unreliable in mod assemblies. <para/> The layer stores only edge descriptors and chip references; coordinates are read from the chips' global rectangles at paint time, so the canvas never has to update line geometry — it only calls <see cref="QueueRedraw"/> after a drag or resize. </summary>
public partial class CollectionEdgeLayer:ModWidget{private readonly List<CollectionEdge>_edges=new();private readonly Dictionary<string,CollectionModChip>_chips=new();private Control _canvas;/// <summary>Replaces the drawn edges. <paramref name="canvas"/> anchors the local coordinate space.</summary>
public void SetEdges(IEnumerable<CollectionEdge>edges,Dictionary<string,CollectionModChip>chips,Control canvas){EnsureConstructed();_canvas=canvas;_edges.Clear();_chips.Clear();if(edges!=null){foreach(var edge in edges)_edges.Add(edge);}if(chips!=null){foreach(var pair in chips)_chips[pair.Key]=pair.Value;}QueueRedraw();}protected override void Construct(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;SetAnchorsAndOffsetsPreset(LayoutPreset.FullRect);Connect("draw",Callable.From((Action)DrawAll));}private void DrawAll(){if(_canvas==null|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(_canvas))return;var origin=_canvas.GetGlobalRect().Position;foreach(var edge in _edges){if(!_chips.TryGetValue(edge.FromModId,out var from)|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(from))continue;if(!_chips.TryGetValue(edge.ToModId,out var to)|| !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(to))continue;var a=from.GetGlobalRect().GetCenter()-origin;var b=to.GetGlobalRect().GetCenter()-origin;var points=BuildCurve(a,b);var color=edge.Cross?(edge.Active?UiTokens.Danger:UiTokens.Warning):(edge.Active?UiTokens.Accent:UiTokens.LineStrong);var width=edge.Cross?(edge.Active?3f:2f):(edge.Active?2.5f:1.5f);if(edge.Cross){for(var i=0;i<points.Count-1;i++)DrawDashedLine(points[i],points[i+1],color,width,5f);DrawCircle(points[^1],2.5f,color);}else{DrawPolyline(points.ToArray(),color,width,true);}}}private static List<Vector2>BuildCurve(Vector2 a,Vector2 b){var dx=b.X-a.X;var dy=b.Y-a.Y;Vector2 c1,c2;if(Mathf.Abs(dx)>=Mathf.Abs(dy)){c1=new Vector2(a.X+dx*0.4f,a.Y);c2=new Vector2(b.X-dx*0.4f,b.Y);}else{c1=new Vector2(a.X,a.Y+dy*0.4f);c2=new Vector2(b.X,b.Y-dy*0.4f);}var points=new List<Vector2>();const int steps=24;for(var i=0;i<=steps;i++)points.Add(Cubic(a,c1,c2,b,i/(float)steps));return points;}private static Vector2 Cubic(Vector2 a,Vector2 c1,Vector2 c2,Vector2 b,float t){var u=1f-t;return u*u*u*a+3f*u*u*t*c1+3f*u*t*t*c2+t*t*t*b;}}}

public void RefreshCounts(Dictionary<CategoryType,int>categoryCounts,Dictionary<ModItemStatus,int>statusCounts){foreach(var pair in _statusBoxes){var count=statusCounts.GetValueOrDefault(pair.Key);pair.Value.Text=$"{ModStatusNames.Translate(pair.Key)} ({count})";}foreach(var pair in _categoryBoxes){var count=categoryCounts.GetValueOrDefault(pair.Key);pair.Value.Text=$"{ModCategoryNames.Translate(pair.Key)} ({count})";}}private void AddStatusCheck(ModItemStatus status){var box=new CheckBox{Text=ModStatusNames.Translate(status),ButtonPressed=_state.Statuses.Contains(status),};box.Toggled+=pressed=>OnStatusToggled(status,pressed);_statusBoxes[status]=box;_statusList.AddChild(box);}private void AddCategoryCheck(CategoryType category){var box=new CheckBox{Text=ModCategoryNames.Translate(category),ButtonPressed=_state.Categories.Contains(category),};box.Toggled+=pressed=>OnCategoryToggled(category,pressed);_categoryBoxes[category]=box;_categoryList.AddChild(box);}private void OnStatusToggled(ModItemStatus status,bool pressed){if(pressed)_state.Statuses.Add(status);else _state.Statuses.Remove(status);Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnCategoryToggled(CategoryType category,bool pressed){if(pressed)_state.Categories.Add(category);else _state.Categories.Remove(category);Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnGroupToggled(bool pressed){_state.GroupByCategory=pressed;Changed?.Invoke();}private void OnResetPressed(){_state.Reset();foreach(var box in _statusBoxes.Values)box.SetPressedNoSignal(false);foreach(var box in _categoryBoxes.Values)box.SetPressedNoSignal(false);ResetRequested?.Invoke();Changed?.Invoke();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Scrollable grid of <see cref="ModCard"/> tiles, composed of <see cref="ModGridGroup"/> sections (see <c>scenes/components/mod_grid_view.tscn</c>). Cards flow inside <see cref="HFlowContainer"/>s, so the number of columns adapts to the viewport width — the Godot answer to Nexus's responsive auto-fill grid. In grouping mode one section per category is created with a header; in flat mode a single header-less section is used. </summary>
public partial class ModGridView:ScrollContainer{private const string GroupScene="scenes/components/mod_grid_group.tscn";private const string CardScene="scenes/components/mod_card.tscn";private VBoxContainer _host;/// <summary>Raised when a card body is clicked.</summary>
public event Action<ModCardData>CardClicked;/// <summary>Raised when a card's action button is pressed.</summary>
public event Action<ModCardData>ActionPressed;/// <summary>Raised when a card's enable switch is flipped.</summary>
public event Action<ModCardData>EnabledToggled;/// <summary>Raised after a card's version selection changes.</summary>
public event Action<ModCardData>VersionChanged;/// <summary>Raised when any card's "in N collections" cross-link is pressed.</summary>
public event Action CollectionsLinkRequested;/// <summary>Rebuilds the grid from scratch; called on every filter change.</summary>
public void SetItems(IReadOnlyList<ModCardData>items,bool groupByCategory){if(_host==null)_host=GetNode<VBoxContainer>("Host");foreach(var child in _host.GetChildren())child.QueueFree();if(items==null||items.Count==0){_host.AddChild(BuildEmptyLabel());return;}if(!groupByCategory){FillGroup(AddGroup(null),items);return;}foreach(var category in ModCategoryNames.Ordered){var group=new List<ModCardData>();foreach(var item in items){if(ModCategoryNames.Primary(item.Category)==category)group.Add(item);}if(group.Count==0)continue;var header=$"{ModCategoryNames.Translate(category)}  ·  {group.Count}";FillGroup(AddGroup(header),group);}}private ModGridGroup AddGroup(string header){var group=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(GroupScene)as ModGridGroup;if(group==null){GameLogger.Log("MOD_MANAGER",$"Grid: failed to build '{GroupScene}'",LogLevel.Error);return null;}group.SetHeader(header);_host.AddChild(group);return group;}private void FillGroup(ModGridGroup group,IReadOnlyList<ModCardData>items){if(group==null)return;foreach(var data in items){var card=TscnScenes.LoadAndBuild(CardScene)as ModCard;if(card==null){GameLogger.Log("MOD_MANAGER",$"Grid: failed to build '{CardScene}'",LogLevel.Error);continue;}group.Flow.AddChild(card);card.Clicked+=OnCardClicked;card.ActionPressed+=OnCardActionPressed;card.EnabledToggled+=OnCardEnabledToggled;card.VersionChanged+=OnCardVersionChanged;card.CollectionsLinkRequested+=()=>CollectionsLinkRequested?.Invoke();card.Init(data);}}private static Label BuildEmptyLabel(){return UiKit.EmptyState(TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/no_results"));}private void OnCardClicked(ModCardData data)=>CardClicked?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardActionPressed(ModCardData data)=>ActionPressed?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardEnabledToggled(ModCardData data)=>EnabledToggled?.Invoke(data);private void OnCardVersionChanged(ModCardData data)=>VersionChanged?.Invoke(data);}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Deleting a player's game collection, shared by the gallery card and the scheme editor header so both ask the same question. Only the player's own collections can go: a collection a mod or the catalog ships would come back on the next merge (its edited version is dropped with "Revert to built-in" instead). Deleting touches only <c>user://collections/</c> — the mods of the collection stay installed and its saves stay on disk (they reappear if a collection with the same id comes back), which the confirmation spells out. </summary>
public static class CollectionDeletion{/// <summary>True for a player-made collection (saved or still a draft) that no mod or catalog ships.</summary>
public static bool CanDelete(ModCollection collection){return collection!=null&&collection.Origin==ModCollectionOrigin.User&& !ModCollectionStore.HasShippedVersion(collection.Id);}/// <summary> Asks for confirmation under <paramref name="host"/>; on "delete" removes the saved collection and calls <paramref name="deleted"/> (the caller also drops its unsaved draft and refreshes its view). </summary>
public static void Confirm(Node host,ModCollection collection,Action deleted){if(host==null|| !CanDelete(collection))return;var name=CollectionText.Resolve(collection.GetLocalizedName(TranslationServer.GetLocale()));var dialog=new ConfirmationDialog{Title=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/collection_delete"),DialogText=string.Format(TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/collection_delete_confirm"),name,SaveService.ListSaves(collection.Id).Count),OkButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/collection_delete"),CancelButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("mod_manager/cancel"),Exclusive=true,};dialog.Confirmed+=()=>{ModCollectionStore.RemoveUser(collection.Id);dialog.QueueFree();deleted?.Invoke();};dialog.Canceled+=dialog.QueueFree;host.AddChild(dialog);dialog.PopupCentered();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Presentation helpers for catalog provenance. The manager shows where a mod comes from without cluttering the tile: a short host label plus the full URL list in the tooltip, and a "+N" marker when several catalogs publish the same build. </summary>
public static class ModCatalogSource{/// <summary>First source URL, or null when there are none.</summary>
public static string FirstUrl(IReadOnlyList<string>urls)=>urls!=null&&urls.Count>0?urls[0]:null;/// <summary>Host of a URL (fallback: the raw string when it does not parse).</summary>
public static string Host(string url){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))return null;if(Uri.TryCreate(url,UriKind.Absolute,out var uri)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Host))return uri.Host;return url;}/// <summary>Short label: host plus "+N" for extra catalogs, or null when unknown.</summary>
public static string Label(IReadOnlyList<string>urls){var first=FirstUrl(urls);if(first==null)return null;var host=Host(first);var extra=urls.Count-1;return extra>0?$"{host} +{extra}":host;}/// <summary>Newline-joined full URL list for tooltips.</summary>
public static string Tooltip(IReadOnlyList<string>urls)=>urls==null||urls.Count==0?null:string.Join("\n",urls);}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Caches;using Godot;namespace Mods.ModManager{/// <summary> Loads preview images for mod tiles and the detail page. Local mods use their bundled <c>mod.png</c> / <c>mod.jpg</c>; catalog-only mods fall back to <see cref="ModIconCache"/>, which downloads and caches the entry's <c>icon_url</c> under <c>user://mod_cache/icons</c>. Returning null is a normal outcome — the card then keeps its flat placeholder. </summary>
public static class ModPreviewLoader{/// <summary>Reads the mod's bundled preview image, or null when absent/unreadable.</summary>
public static Texture2D LoadLocal(ModInfo info){var provider=info?.FileProvider;if(provider==null)return null;byte[]data=null;if(provider.FileExists("mod.png"))data=provider.ReadFileBinary("mod.png");else if(provider.FileExists("mod.jpg"))data=provider.ReadFileBinary("mod.jpg");if(data==null||data.Length==0)return null;var image=new Image();Error error;if(data[0]==0x89)error=image.LoadPngFromBuffer(data);else if(data[0]==0xFF)error=image.LoadJpgFromBuffer(data);else return null;if(error!=Error.Ok){image.Dispose();return null;}var texture=ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);image.Dispose();return texture;}/// <summary> Asynchronously resolves a catalog icon; the callback may fire later (network) or immediately (memory/disk cache). </summary>
public static void LoadRemote(string modId,string iconUrl,Action<Texture2D>onLoaded){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconUrl))return;ModIconCache.GetOrDownload(modId,iconUrl,onLoaded);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Actions.Atomic{/// <summary> Adds a string tag to a quest. Tags are used for conditional logic in scenario scripts — a quest can be checked for tag presence to branch dialog. The tag is added via QuestBase.AddTag, which likely stores it in the quest's save data. </summary>
public class QuestAddTagAction:IScenarioAction{/// <summary> Registered as "quest.add_tag" — attaches a string tag to a quest for use in conditional logic. Tags are queried by the scenario DSL's "has_tag" condition to branch dialog or gate quest progression. Both "quest_id" and "tag" dialog variables are required — returns early with a warning if either is missing. </summary>
public string Name=>"quest.add_tag";/// <summary> Reads "quest_id" and "tag" from dialog variables and delegates to ctx.Quests.AddTag. Routes through QuestServiceImpl.TryGet — missing quests are silently skipped. Tags are persisted with save data and survive game restart. </summary>
public void Run(IActionContext ctx){var questId=ctx.GetParam("quest_id");var tag=ctx.GetParam("tag");if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(questId)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag)){ctx.Log("EVENT","QuestAddTagAction: missing 'quest_id' or 'tag' variable");return;}ctx.Quests.AddTag(questId,tag);ctx.Log("QUEST",$"QuestAddTagAction: {questId}.AddTag('{tag}')");}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Actions{/// <summary> Quest service implementation with internal TryGet for safe fallback. Public methods (SetStatus, SetDataStatus, AddTag, etc.) use TryGet which catches KeyNotFoundException from QuestFactory — this prevents scenario scripts from crashing when referencing non-existent quests. The separation of SetStatus (global quest state like Active/Completed) from SetDataStatus (numeric progress level) matches QuestBase's dual-state design. Exists() returns false on any exception, so missing or broken quest data is treated as "doesn't exist" rather than throwing. </summary>
internal class QuestServiceImpl:IQuestService{/// <summary> Direct lookup from QuestFactory by ID. Throws KeyNotFoundException if the quest doesn't exist — use Exists() or TryGet() when the quest may legitimately be absent from the registry. </summary>
public IQuest Get(string id)=>QuestFactory.Instance.Get(id);/// <summary> Safe existence check. Wraps QuestFactory.Get in try/catch and returns false on any exception — corrupted save data or broken quest definitions are treated as "doesn't exist" rather than propagating errors to the dialog engine. </summary>
public bool Exists(string id){try{return QuestFactory.Instance.Get(id)!=null;}catch{return false;}}/// <summary> Internal safe-get pattern that catches KeyNotFoundException from QuestFactory. Returns null for missing quests so callers can use the null-conditional operator (?.) rather than try/catch blocks. All mutating methods (SetStatus, AddTag, etc.) route through TryGet to prevent scenario scripts from crashing on broken quest references. </summary>
public QuestBase TryGet(string id){QuestBase result=null;try{result=QuestFactory.Instance.Get(id);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("QUEST",$"try get quest '{id}' exception - {ex.Message}");}return result;}/// <summary> Sets the global quest status (Active, Completed, Failed, etc.) by parsing the status string via Enums&lt;QuestStatus&gt;.Parse. Invalid status strings are caught and logged as errors without throwing — the dialog continues with the quest unchanged. Routes through TryGet so missing quests are silently skipped. Publishes a <see cref="QuestStatusChangedEvent"/> only when the status actually changed; setting the same status is a no-op that publishes nothing. </summary>
public void SetStatus(string id,string status){var quest=TryGet(id);if(quest==null)return;try{var newStatus=Enums<QuestStatus>.Parse(status);if(quest.Status==newStatus)return;var oldStatus=quest.Status.ToString();quest.Status=newStatus;ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestStatusChangedEvent{QuestId=id,OldStatus=oldStatus,NewStatus=status,});}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("QUEST",$"status '{status}' invalid - {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}/// <summary> Updates the numeric progress level within the quest's data object (quest.Data.Status). Separate from SetStatus which controls the global lifecycle state. Routes through TryGet with null-conditional access — if the quest doesn't exist, the call is silently skipped. No bounds checking: the caller is responsible for meaningful level values. The <see cref="QuestDataStatusChangedEvent"/> is published by <see cref="QuestData.SetStatus"/> itself. </summary>
public void SetDataStatus(string id,int level){TryGet(id)?.Data.SetStatus(level);}/// <summary> Attaches a string tag to the quest's tag collection via QuestBase.AddTag. Tags are persisted with save data and queried by scenario conditions (has_tag). Adding a duplicate tag is handled by the underlying collection. Routes through TryGet for safe fallback on missing quests. The <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> is published by <see cref="QuestBase.AddTag"/> itself (change-only). </summary>
public void AddTag(string id,string tag){TryGet(id)?.AddTag(tag);}/// <summary> Removes a tag from the quest. Used for clearing temporary conditions in branching scenarios. Removing a non-existent tag is a collection-level no-op. Routes through TryGet. The <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> is published by <see cref="QuestBase.RemoveTag"/> itself (change-only). </summary>
public void RemoveTag(string id,string tag){TryGet(id)?.RemoveTag(tag);}/// <summary> Dispatches a UI notification for the quest (e.g. "Quest Updated" popup) via QuestBase.SendNotification. Does not modify quest state — call SetStatus/SetDataStatus before this to ensure the notification reflects the new state. Routes through TryGet. </summary>
public void SendNotification(string id){TryGet(id)?.SendNotification();}}}
