using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Primary concrete implementation of <see cref="IQuest"/> that serves as both the runtime quest instance (created by <see cref="QuestFactory"/> from <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> data) and the serialization unit written into save files. Because it is marked <c>[Serializable]</c>, Godot's JSON serialization can round-trip the entire quest graph — including the mutable <see cref="Data"/> payload — when the player saves or loads a game. The <see cref="StatusToDescription"/> dictionary maps raw <see cref="QuestStatus"/> integer values to localised description strings that the journal UI renders for each progression stage. </summary>
[Serializable]public class QuestBase:IQuest{/// <summary> Unique string identifier matching the quest's definition key in the mod data. Used by <see cref="QuestFactory.Get"/> for lookup and preserved in save files so that loaded state can be reattached to the correct definition. </summary>
public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary> Localised display name shown in the quest journal and notification banners. This value originates from the mod definition file and is translated before display. </summary>
public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary> Current progression state of the quest. Defaults to <see cref="QuestStatus.NotStarted"/>. This property is updated at runtime by quest‑advancement logic and restored from save data by <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/>. </summary>
public QuestStatus Status{get;set;}=QuestStatus.NotStarted;/// <summary> Mutable runtime payload holding the quest's numeric status and the collection of string tags accumulated during gameplay. The factory overwrites this object when restoring a save file via <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/>, so any modifications to tags or status through <see cref="AddTag"/>, <see cref="RemoveTag"/>, or <see cref="QuestData.SetStatus"/> persist until the next load. </summary>
public QuestData Data{get;set;}=new QuestData();/// <summary> Lookup table that maps integer <see cref="QuestStatus"/> values to human‑readable description strings. The journal window uses this to select which narrative text to display underneath the quest title as the player advances through <c>NotStarted</c>, <c>Progress</c>, and <c>End</c> states. </summary>
public IDictionary<int,string>StatusToDescription{get;set;}=new Dictionary<int,string>();/// <summary> Returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="tag"/> is present in the underlying <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set. Tags act as boolean flags for sub‑objective completion; dialogue conditions and scene‑transition gates call this to decide whether a particular branch should be available. </summary>
public bool ContainsTag(string tag){return Data.Tags.Contains(tag);}/// <summary> Syntactic negation helper that returns <c>true</c> when <paramref name="tag"/> is absent from the quest's tag set. Exists so that scenario scripts can express "tag not yet earned" conditions as a direct method call without writing a negation operator in YAML condition strings. </summary>
public bool NotContainsTag(string tag){return!ContainsTag(tag);}/// <summary> Inserts <paramref name="tag"/> into the mutable <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set, marking a sub‑objective or milestone as completed. Typically called from scenario action nodes or dialogue event handlers when the player reaches a logical checkpoint. Publishes a <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> only when the tag was actually added (duplicates are a no-op and publish nothing), so condition caches invalidate exactly on real change. </summary>
public void AddTag(string tag){if(Data.Tags.Add(tag))ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestTagChangedEvent{QuestId=ID,Tag=tag,Added=true});}/// <summary> Removes <paramref name="tag"/> from the mutable <see cref="Data"/>.<see cref="QuestData.Tags"/> set, effectively revoking a previously earned milestone. Useful for branching narratives where the player can lose access to a completed sub‑objective through a different choice path. Publishes a <see cref="QuestTagChangedEvent"/> only when the tag was actually present and removed. </summary>
public void RemoveTag(string tag){if(Data.Tags.Remove(tag))ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestTagChangedEvent{QuestId=ID,Tag=tag,Added=false});}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Serialisable payload that holds the mutable, per‑save‑file runtime state of a single quest. Separating this from the immutable <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> allows the save system to persist only the dirty data (current status and earned tags) without duplicating the static definition fields that are reloaded from mod JSON every session. An instance of this class lives inside <see cref="QuestBase.Data"/> and is replaced wholesale by <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/> when the player loads a game. </summary>
[Serializable]public class QuestData{/// <summary> Numeric representation of the current quest stage, castable to <see cref="QuestStatus"/>. The journal UI maps this to a description string via <see cref="QuestBase.StatusToDescription"/>. </summary>
public int Status{get;set;}/// <summary> Set of string tags earned during this playthrough. Each tag represents a branching milestone or sub‑objective; scenario scripts query membership via <see cref="IQuest.ContainsTag"/> to gate dialogue options and scene transitions. </summary>
public HashSet<string>Tags{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Sets the numeric status to <paramref name="value"/>, advancing (or potentially resetting) the quest's progression stage. public void SetStatus(int value){if(Status==value)return;ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestDataStatusChangedEvent{Old=Status,New=value});Status=value;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Thread‑safe singleton that manages the entire lifecycle of <see cref="QuestBase"/> instances: lazy initialisation from mod JSON definitions, on‑demand lookup by ID, and restoration of mutable state when the player loads a save file. The factory defers loading until the first access (via <see cref="Get"/> or <see cref="GetAll"/>) and rebuilds the definitions whenever the entity resolver hands out a new data snapshot (a mod reload keeps this mod but may change the quests). Because quest definitions come from <see cref="QuestDefinition"/> objects collected by <see cref="ModManager.GetResolver{EntityResolver}()"/> through the DTO's <c>[EntityKind("quest")]</c> attribute, the factory remains decoupled from any directory layout — new mods register quests simply by shipping a JSON file whose envelope declares the quest kind. <para/> The single instance is process-wide and deliberately not owned by <see cref="AppServices"/>: quest state is identity-sensitive across the whole process (save/restore, scenario conditions), and a swappable owner would break parallel test runs. The new-game reset is wired through the AppServices resettable adapter registered by QuestsModInitializer (see <see cref="ResetAll"/>). </summary>
public class QuestFactory{/// <summary> Owns the process-wide instance; laziness defers construction to the first access, avoiding order-dependent initialisation races with other subsystems. </summary>
private static Lazy<QuestFactory>instance=new(()=>new QuestFactory());/// <summary> Process-wide singleton. Deliberately NOT owned by AppServices: quest state is identity-sensitive across the whole process (save/restore, scenario conditions), and a swappable owner breaks that contract in parallel test runs. Reset goes through the AppServices resettable adapter, construction timing stays lazy. </summary>
public static QuestFactory Instance=>instance.Value;private readonly IDictionary<string,QuestBase>dataByID=new Dictionary<string,QuestBase>();private readonly List<QuestBase>unresolved=new();private Dictionary<string,QuestDefinition>loadedDefinitions;private QuestFactory(){}/// <summary> Seeds the internal <c>dataByID</c> dictionary from mod JSON if it has not been seeded from the current data snapshot. When <see cref="ModManager"/> is still mid‑initialisation, the call is deferred so that early code paths don't crash; the next access retries. <c>Entities.Collect</c> is cached by the entity resolver until the next mod reload, so a new dictionary means new data: the quests are rebuilt from it, a quest that stays keeps its instance and state, a new one starts with default status and an empty tag set. </summary>
private void EnsureLoaded(){if(!ModManager.Instance.IsInitialized){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","mods not initialized, quest loading deferred");return;}Dictionary<string,QuestDefinition>definitions;try{definitions=Entities.Collect<QuestDefinition>();}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","failed to load quests from mods: "+ex.Message,LogLevel.Error);return;}if(ReferenceEquals(definitions,loadedDefinitions))return;loadedDefinitions=definitions;var previous=new Dictionary<string,QuestBase>(dataByID);dataByID.Clear();foreach(var def in definitions.Values){var quest=previous.TryGetValue(def.ID,out var kept)?kept:new QuestBase{ID=def.ID};quest.Name=def.Name;quest.StatusToDescription=def.StatusToDescription??new Dictionary<int,string>();dataByID[quest.ID]=quest;}GameLogger.Log("QUEST","loaded '"+dataByID.Count+"' quests");}/// <summary> Looks up a quest by its unique string identifier and returns the shared <see cref="QuestBase"/> runtime instance. Throws <c>KeyNotFoundException</c> when no definition for <paramref name="id"/> was loaded from mod data, which typically indicates a typo in a scenario script's quest reference. </summary>
public QuestBase Get(string id){EnsureLoaded();if(dataByID.TryGetValue(id,out var quest))return quest;GameLogger.Log("QUEST","quest '"+id+"' not registered",LogLevel.Error);throw new KeyNotFoundException(id);}/// <summary> Returns a snapshot list of every <see cref="QuestBase"/> instance known to the factory. Used primarily by the save system to serialise the full quest state for the save file, and by the journal UI to populate the quest list window. </summary> <summary> Quests of the loaded save that no loaded mod defines (their mod left the game). They take no part in the game, but the save writes them back, so their progress returns with the mod. Cleared by a new game. </summary>
public IReadOnlyList<QuestBase>Unresolved=>unresolved;public List<QuestBase>GetAll(){EnsureLoaded();return dataByID.Values.ToList();}/// <summary> Restores mutable quest state from a deserialised save file. Iterates over every quest in the provided list, looks up the corresponding entry by ID, and overwrites its <see cref="QuestBase.Data"/> and <see cref="QuestBase.Status"/> properties. Entries whose ID is not registered (a removed mod or a quest renamed between sessions) go to <see cref="Unresolved"/> with a warning, so an ageing save neither blocks loading nor loses them. Reads from empty or <c>null</c> lists are silently ignored so that save files created before the quest system existed (or with no quest progress) do not break the pipeline. Publishes a single <see cref="QuestStateRestoredEvent"/> marker after the restore loop (not per-quest) so condition caches invalidate once without a per-quest event storm. </summary>
public void SetAll(List<QuestBase>quests){EnsureLoaded();unresolved.Clear();if(Lists.IsEmpty(quests))return;foreach(var questFromSave in quests){if(!dataByID.TryGetValue(questFromSave.ID,out var quest)){GameLogger.Log("QUEST","quest '"+questFromSave.ID+"' from save is not registered; its state is kept in the save",LogLevel.Warning);unresolved.Add(questFromSave);continue;}quest.Data=questFromSave.Data;quest.Status=questFromSave.Status;}ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestStateRestoredEvent());}/// <summary> Returns every quest to the state it has right after mod loading: <see cref="QuestStatus.NotStarted"/>, numeric stage zero, and an empty tag set. Called by <c>GameData.StartNewGame</c> because the factory is a process‑wide singleton that survives returning to the main menu — without this reset, tags and statuses earned in the previous playthrough would leak into a new game and satisfy (or block) prologue conditions that test for absent tags. Publishes <see cref="QuestStateRestoredEvent"/> so cached scenario conditions invalidate once. </summary>
public void ResetAll(){EnsureLoaded();unresolved.Clear();foreach(var quest in dataByID.Values){quest.Status=QuestStatus.NotStarted;quest.Data=new QuestData();}ModEventBus.Publish(new QuestStateRestoredEvent());}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Localization;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Maps quest tags to locale keys and resolves their display text. A bare tag id is only unique inside its quest — the same word may mean different milestones in different quests — so the key is composed from the quest's locale prefix (<see cref="IQuest.Name"/>) and the tag: <c>{quest.Name}/tag/{tag}</c>. For <c>MeetingMurakamiQuest</c> (<c>Name = quest/meeting/murakami</c>) the tag <c>go_home</c> maps to <c>quest/meeting/murakami/tag/go_home</c>, sharing the namespace of the quest's own name and stage descriptions. The journal renders every earned tag as a stamp through <see cref="Translate(IQuest, string)"/>; when no translation exists the raw tag id is shown, which is the behaviour tags had before locale support was added. </summary>
public static class QuestTagLocale{/// <summary> Builds the composite locale key for <paramref name="tag"/> inside <paramref name="quest"/>: <c>{quest.Name}/tag/{tag}</c>. Returns <c>null</c> when the quest is missing, has no locale prefix, or the tag is empty, so callers can distinguish "no key to look up" from "key not translated" and fall back to the raw tag. </summary>
public static string Key(IQuest quest,string tag){if(quest==null||string.IsNullOrEmpty(quest.Name)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag))return null;return quest.Name+"/tag/"+tag;}/// <summary> Returns the display text of <paramref name="tag"/> in the player's current language, falling back to the raw tag id when the composite key is absent from all loaded mods' properties files. </summary>
public static string Translate(IQuest quest,string tag){return Translate(quest,tag,GodotTranslationProvider.Instance);}/// <summary> Provider-injected variant of <see cref="Translate(IQuest, string)"/> for tests and for callers that already hold an <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/>. A provider that returns <c>null</c> for the composite key (the "untranslated" signal of <see cref="ILocalizationProvider"/>) also yields the raw tag. </summary>
public static string Translate(IQuest quest,string tag,ILocalizationProvider provider){var key=Key(quest,tag);if(key==null||provider==null)return tag;return provider.Get(key)??tag;}}}

Registered from <see cref="QuestsModInitializer.OnModResourcesReady"/>; AppServices deduplicates by <see cref="Id"/>, so repeated registration is a no-op. </summary>
internal sealed class QuestsResettable:IResettable{/// <summary>Resettable key under which AppServices deduplicates registration.</summary>
public string Id=>"quests";/// <summary>Resets all quest statuses, stages and tags on "New Game".</summary>
public void ResetForNewGame()=>QuestFactory.Instance.ResetAll();}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Quests{/// <summary> Persists quest state through the generic <see cref="IModSaveable"/> contract under the mod id <c>quests_base</c>. The core save used to carry a <c>"Quests"</c> blob inside the <c>__core__</c> slot (<c>RuntimeSerializer.BuildCoreSlot</c>), but quest state now belongs to the quests engine mod — so it saves through the mod slot like every other migrated subsystem. <para/> <see cref="OnLoad"/> feeds the deserialised list into <see cref="QuestFactory.SetAll"/>, which restores mutable state per quest ID, skips quests that are no longer registered and publishes the single <c>QuestStateRestoredEvent</c> invalidation marker — exactly the behaviour the core save path had. Backward compatibility with the old core blob is intentionally not provided (same decision as the recruiting mod): old saves start with fresh quest state. </summary>
public class QuestsSaveable:IModSaveable{private const string BlobKey="Quests";/// <summary>Writes the full quest state list into the mod slot.</summary>
public void OnSave(ModSlot slot){var quests=QuestFactory.Instance.GetAll();quests.AddRange(QuestFactory.Instance.Unresolved);slot.Data[BlobKey]=new DataBlob(1,quests);}/// <summary>Restores quest state from the mod slot; an absent blob keeps fresh quest state.</summary>
public bool OnLoad(ModSlot slot,out string errorMessage){errorMessage=null;if(slot?.Data!=null&&slot.Data.TryGetValue(BlobKey,out var blob))QuestFactory.Instance.SetAll(blob.ReadJson<List<QuestBase>>());return true;}}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes.Parsing.Impls{/// <summary> Parses quest expressions: <c>QuestId.method("arg")</c> and <c>QuestId.Property comparison</c>. Matches when the stream contains an identifier followed by a dot that is NOT <c>true.</c> or <c>false.</c> (those are quest IDs, not boolean literals followed by quest access — handled here because <see cref="BoolLiteralParser"/> already rejected them). </summary>
public class QuestParser:ILeafParser{/// <summary>True for identifiers followed by a dot (dot-forms that survived the boolean-literal check are quest references).</summary>
public bool CanParse(TokenPeeker peeker){if(peeker.AtEnd||peeker.Peek.Type!=ConditionParser.TokenType.Ident)return false;var next=peeker.PeekAhead(1);return next.Type==ConditionParser.TokenType.Dot;}/// <summary>Dispatches on the member after the dot: <c>hasTag</c>/<c>notHasTag</c>, <c>IsActive</c>, or <c>Status</c>/<c>DataStatus</c> comparisons; unknown members throw.</summary>
public ICondition Parse(TokenPeeker peeker,Func<ICondition>parseSubExpr){var questId=peeker.Advance().Value;peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.Dot,"expected '.' after quest id");var methodToken=peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.Ident,"expected method or property name after '.'");var method=methodToken.Value;if(method=="hasTag"||method=="notHasTag"){peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.LParen,"expected '('");var tag=peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.String,"expected string argument");peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.RParen,"expected ')'");return new QuestMethodCondition(questId,method,tag.Value);}if(method=="IsActive"){return new QuestBoolPropCondition(questId,method);}if(method=="Status"||method=="DataStatus"){var op=ParseCompOp(peeker);var num=peeker.Expect(ConditionParser.TokenType.Number,"expected number after comparison");return new QuestPropCondition(questId,method,op,int.Parse(num.Value));}throw new FormatException($"Condition parse error: unknown quest property/method '{method}'");}private static string ParseCompOp(TokenPeeker peeker){if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Eq)){peeker.Advance();return"==";}if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Neq)){peeker.Advance();return"!=";}if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Ge)){peeker.Advance();return">=";}if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Le)){peeker.Advance();return"<=";}if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Gt)){peeker.Advance();return">";}if(peeker.Check(ConditionParser.TokenType.Lt)){peeker.Advance();return"<";}throw new FormatException($"Condition parse error: expected comparison operator, got '{peeker.Peek.Value}'");}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> An AST leaf node that checks a boolean property on a quest instance. public QuestBoolPropCondition(string questId,string property){QuestId=questId;Property=property;}/// <summary>Resolves the quest and reads the boolean property; unknown quest IDs evaluate to <c>false</c>.</summary>

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> An AST leaf node invoking a boolean method on a quest instance: either <c>hasTag</c> or <c>notHasTag</c>. Returns <c>false</c> (with a log warning) when the quest ID is not found in the factory. </summary>
public class QuestMethodCondition:ConditionNode{/// <summary>The quest identifier to query.</summary>
public string QuestId{get;}/// <summary>The method name: <c>"hasTag"</c> or <c>"notHasTag"</c>.</summary>
public string Method{get;}/// <summary>The tag string passed as the method argument.</summary>
public string Tag{get;}/// <summary> Creates a quest method invocation condition node. </summary> <param name="questId">The quest identifier.</param> <param name="method">The method name (<c>"hasTag"</c> or <c>"notHasTag"</c>).</param> <param name="tag">The tag argument for the method call.</param>
public QuestMethodCondition(string questId,string method,string tag){QuestId=questId;Method=method;Tag=tag;}/// <summary>Resolves the quest and invokes the tag check; unknown quest IDs evaluate to <c>false</c>.</summary>
public override bool Evaluate(EvaluationContext ctx){try{var quest=ctx.QuestFactory.Get(QuestId);return Method=="hasTag"?quest.ContainsTag(Tag):!quest.ContainsTag(Tag);}catch(KeyNotFoundException){GameLogger.Log("COND",$"quest '{QuestId}' not found, condition → false",LogLevel.Error);return false;}}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Scenes{/// <summary> An AST leaf node comparing a quest's integer property (<c>Status</c> or <c>DataStatus</c>) against a numeric value. Fetches the quest via <see cref="EvaluationContext.QuestFactory"/> at evaluation time, reads the corresponding property, and compares using <see cref="ConditionCompare.Compare"/>. Returns <c>false</c> (with a log warning) when the quest ID is not found. </summary>
public class QuestPropCondition:ConditionNode{/// <summary>The quest identifier to query.</summary>
public string QuestId{get;}/// <summary>The property name: <c>"Status"</c> or <c>"DataStatus"</c>.</summary>
public string Property{get;}/// <summary>The comparison operator (<c>==</c>, <c>!=</c>, <c>&gt;=</c>, etc.).</summary>
public string Op{get;}/// <summary>The integer value to compare the quest property against.</summary>
public int Value{get;}/// <summary> Creates a quest property comparison condition node. </summary> <param name="questId">The quest identifier.</param> <param name="property">The property name (<c>"Status"</c> or <c>"DataStatus"</c>).</param> <param name="op">The comparison operator.</param> <param name="value">The integer value to compare against.</param>
public QuestPropCondition(string questId,string property,string op,int value){QuestId=questId;Property=property;Op=op;Value=value;}/// <summary>Resolves the quest and compares the numeric property; unknown quest IDs evaluate to <c>false</c>.</summary>
public override bool Evaluate(EvaluationContext ctx){try{var quest=ctx.QuestFactory.Get(QuestId);var actual=Property=="Status"?(int)quest.Status:((QuestBase)quest).Data.Status;return ConditionCompare.Compare(Op,actual,Value);}catch(KeyNotFoundException){GameLogger.Log("COND",$"quest '{QuestId}' not found, condition → false",LogLevel.Error);return false;}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Quests.Tests{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;using Cthangover.Core.Quests;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;/// <summary> The quests slot holds the state of every content mod's quests, so a quest whose mod left the game is still in a loaded save: it must not take part in the game, and the next save must write it back so its progress returns with the mod. </summary>
public class QuestsSaveableTests{private const string UnknownId="__test_no_such_quest";[ModTest("save/unknown_quest_survives_load_and_save")]static void UnknownQuestSurvivesLoadAndSave(ModTestContext ctx){var factory=QuestFactory.Instance;var before=JsonSerializer.Serialize(factory.GetAll());try{var unknown=new QuestBase{ID=UnknownId,Status=QuestStatus.Progress};unknown.Data.Tags.Add("met");var slot=new ModSlot();slot.Data["Quests"]=new DataBlob(1,new List<QuestBase>{unknown});var saveable=new QuestsSaveable();ModAssert.True(saveable.OnLoad(slot,out _),"slot with an unknown quest loads");ModAssert.False(factory.GetAll().Any(q=>q.ID==UnknownId),"unknown quest takes no part in the game");var saved=new ModSlot();saveable.OnSave(saved);var kept=saved.Data["Quests"].ReadJson<List<QuestBase>>().SingleOrDefault(q=>q.ID==UnknownId);ModAssert.NotNull(kept,"unknown quest written back");ModAssert.True(kept.Status==QuestStatus.Progress&&kept.Data.Tags.Contains("met"),"its status and tags kept");}finally{factory.SetAll(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<QuestBase>>(before));}}}}

===== FILE mods/recruiting/src/DefeatedCharactersRecruiter.cs =====
using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Turns a <see cref="CharactersDefeatedEvent"/> into recruit attempts. The recruiting mod subscribes to the core-neutral event, so the system that defeated the characters (battle, trap, script) does not know about recruiting — and recruiting does not depend on any combat mod. This replaces the old hardcoded call inside the victory screen. <para/> For every reported id the character template is resolved through <see cref="CharacterFactory"/> (the battle copy and the template share <c>RecruitmentChance</c>), skipped when that enemy is already captured (only one recruit per enemy type is allowed), checked against the condition gate (<see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.CanRecruit"/>), rolled 1–100 and, on success, added to the roster. The roll is skipped entirely when no conditions are registered or the chance is zero, matching the old flow. <para/> The event also marks the end of a fight for the recruiting mod, so the final health of every squad recruit is pulled back from its placeholder card before new recruits are resolved. </summary>
public static class DefeatedCharactersRecruiter{/// <summary>Event-bus handler; safe to call with a null or empty payload.</summary>
public static void Process(CharactersDefeatedEvent evt){if(evt?.CharacterIds==null)return;var runtime=GameData.Instance?.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;var registry=RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance;// A defeat resolves the battle: pull the final health of every squad recruit back from its placeholder card, since battle writes into the shared attributes object while the mod keeps its own data.
foreach(var recruit in RecruitingData.Instance.Data)RecruitPartyBridge.SyncFromCard(recruit);foreach(var id in evt.CharacterIds){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))continue;var enemy=CharacterFactory.Instance.Get(id);if(enemy==null||enemy.RecruitmentChance<=0)continue;if(RecruitingData.Instance.HasCharacterID(enemy.ID))continue;if(!registry.CanRecruit(enemy,runtime))continue;if(System.Random.Shared.Next(1,101)>enemy.RecruitmentChance)continue;RecruitingData.Instance.Add(enemy.ID,enemy.ID);GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"Recruited '{enemy.ID}' after '{evt.Source}' defeat",LogLevel.Message);}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Relationship;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Recruitment condition that gates the "enslave" recruit option behind the <c>slave_master</c> skill. When the player attempts to recruit an NPC, the recruitment system queries all registered <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/> implementations; if this condition is present and the player does not have the skill, the enslavement option is hidden or disabled. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Per-recruit behaviour plugin discovered via reflection from mod assemblies. Each implementation is registered into <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> by <see cref="Mods.ModAssemblyLoader.RegisterAssembly"/> and then invoked for <b>every</b> active recruit — not just those from the owning mod — during tick, configure, and removal lifecycle events. This cross-recruit dispatch pattern is intentional: a behaviour might want to introspect all recruits (e.g. a "rivalry" system that checks for conflicting personalities), so the registry passes the full recruit list to every behaviour rather than filtering by ownership. </summary>
public interface IRecruitBehaviour{/// <summary>Unique identifier for lookup via <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Get</c>.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary> Called once when a recruit is added to the party (via <c>RecruitingData.Add</c>). Use for initial stat setup, buff application, or spawning companion nodes. </summary>
void ConfigureRecruit(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime);/// <summary> Called every game tick for each active recruit. The <paramref name="currentTick"/> value is the global <c>RuntimeData.Time.Tick</c> counter — use it for cooldown-based or periodic logic rather than maintaining a private timer. </summary>
void OnTick(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime,long currentTick);/// <summary> Called when a recruit is removed from the party (via <c>RecruitingData.Remove</c>). Clean up any persisted state, buffs, or companion nodes. </summary>
void OnRemove(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime);}}

using Cthangover.Core.Relationship;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Tracks nutrition and starvation for party recruits. Works by recording the tick when a recruit last ate (<c>FullnessTime</c>), then each tick computes the elapsed time as a percentage of a 24-hour window. Once the fullness window expires (100%+), the recruit loses 1 HP per tick until fed again via a ration or meal action. Registered with the <see cref="Recruit"/> behaviour pipeline and called by the time system on each global tick. </summary>
public class NutritionBehaviour:IRecruitBehaviour{/// <summary> Unique behaviour identifier used to look up and configure this behaviour from <see cref="Recruit"/>'s behaviour collection. </summary>
public string Id=>"nutrition";/// <summary> Called when the behaviour is first attached to a recruit. Seeds <c>FullnessTime</c> with the current global tick so that starve-damage begins counting from this point. </summary>
public void ConfigureRecruit(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime){recruit.Properties.SetLong("FullnessTime",runtime.Time.Tick);}/// <summary> Evaluates whether the recruit has gone beyond the fullness window (24 in-game hours, represented as <c>24 * 4 * 60</c> ticks) since <c>FullnessTime</c>. If the window is exceeded, reduces the recruit's <c>PROP_HEALTH</c> by 1 per tick until they are fed. Tick-driven starvation allows gradual death when rations run out. </summary>
public void OnTick(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime,long currentTick){var fullnessTime=recruit.Properties.GetLong("FullnessTime");if(fullnessTime==0)return;var windowSize=24*4*60L;var deltaTime=currentTick-fullnessTime;var fullness=(float)deltaTime/windowSize*100f;if(fullness>100){var hp=recruit.Properties.GetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH);if(hp>0){recruit.Properties.SetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH,hp-1);RecruitPartyBridge.SyncToCard(recruit);}}}/// <summary> Cleanup hook invoked when the behaviour is detached from a recruit. No persistent state requires teardown; exists for interface contract. </summary>
public void OnRemove(Recruit recruit,RuntimeData runtime){}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Central registry and lifecycle dispatcher for recruit behaviours and conditions. Behaviours (<see cref="IRecruitBehaviour"/>) and conditions (<see cref="IRecruitCondition"/>) of every mod arrive through the kernel's assembly consumers (<see cref="RecruitBehaviourConsumer"/>, <see cref="RecruitConditionConsumer"/>) as mods load, and leave again when their mod unloads — the kernel stays the only place that enumerates assemblies. <b>Condition gating</b> — <see cref="CanRecruit"/> evaluates every registered condition conjunctively (logical AND), so a single <c>false</c> blocks recruitment. This allows mods to compose recruitment gates without coordination. <b>Id-based deduplication</b> — a registration replaces any earlier implementation with the same <c>Id</c>, so two mods shipping the same id never double-dispatch notifications. <b>Tick registration</b> — the first call to any lifecycle method triggers <see cref="RecruitTickController.EnsureRegistered"/>, which registers for the scene's timer event. This avoids paying the tick overhead unless at least one behaviour is active. <b>Singleton</b> — accessed via the static <c>Instance</c> field rather than a <c>Lazy&lt;T&gt;</c> wrapper because Godot reflection-based discovery must tolerate partial-initialisation scenarios where <c>Lazy</c>'s thread-safety check could deadlock. </summary>
public class RecruitBehaviourRegistry{/// <summary>Eagerly-initialised singleton for reflection-safe access.</summary>
public static readonly RecruitBehaviourRegistry Instance=new();private readonly List<IRecruitBehaviour>_behaviours=new();private readonly List<IRecruitCondition>_conditions=new();private readonly RecruitTickController _tickController=new();private void EnsureTickRegistered(){_tickController.EnsureRegistered();}/// <summary> Registers a behaviour, replacing an earlier one with the same Id. Fed by <see cref="RecruitBehaviourConsumer"/> for every mod assembly. </summary>
public void RegisterBehaviour(IRecruitBehaviour behaviour){if(behaviour==null)return;_behaviours.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==behaviour.Id);_behaviours.Add(behaviour);}/// <summary>Removes exactly <paramref name="behaviour"/> (its mod is being unloaded).</summary>
public void UnregisterBehaviour(IRecruitBehaviour behaviour){_behaviours.Remove(behaviour);}/// <summary> Registers a condition, replacing an earlier one with the same Id. Fed by <see cref="RecruitConditionConsumer"/> for every mod assembly. </summary>
public void RegisterCondition(IRecruitCondition condition){if(condition==null)return;_conditions.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==condition.Id);_conditions.Add(condition);}/// <summary>Removes exactly <paramref name="condition"/> (its mod is being unloaded).</summary>
public void UnregisterCondition(IRecruitCondition condition){_conditions.Remove(condition);}/// <summary> Conjunctive gate: returns <c>true</c> only if every registered <see cref="IRecruitCondition"/> returns <c>true</c> for the given enemy and runtime state. </summary>
public bool CanRecruit(Character enemy,RuntimeData runtime){return _conditions.All(c=>c.CanRecruit(enemy,runtime));}/// <summary> Looks up a behaviour by its <c>Id</c> (linear scan — behaviour lists are small enough that a dictionary is unnecessary). Returns <c>null</c> if not found. </summary>
public IRecruitBehaviour Get(string id){return _behaviours.Find(b=>b.Id==id);}/// <summary>Returns all registered behaviours for external enumeration.</summary>
public IEnumerable<IRecruitBehaviour>All(){return _behaviours;}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.OnTick"/> to every behaviour for every active recruit. Ensures tick registration on first call via lazy init. </summary>
public void OnTick(){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;var recruits=RecruitingData.Instance.Data;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours){foreach(var recruit in recruits){behaviour.OnTick(recruit,runtime,runtime.Time.Tick);}}}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.ConfigureRecruit"/> to every behaviour for the newly-added <paramref name="recruit"/>. </summary>
public void OnConfigure(Recruit recruit){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours)behaviour.ConfigureRecruit(recruit,runtime);}/// <summary> Dispatches <see cref="IRecruitBehaviour.OnRemove"/> to every behaviour for the departing <paramref name="recruit"/>. </summary>
public void OnRemove(Recruit recruit){EnsureTickRegistered();var runtime=GameData.Instance.Runtime;if(runtime==null)return;foreach(var behaviour in _behaviours)behaviour.OnRemove(recruit,runtime);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Bridge between the mod-owned recruit roster and the core party model. Core knows nothing about recruiting, so the mod materializes a placeholder <see cref="CharacterInfoData"/> for every recruit the player puts into the squad: the entry is keyed by the template <see cref="Recruit.CharacterID"/> (the roster guarantees at most one recruit per enemy, so the template id stays a unique party key) and therefore needs no core changes — the character panel, battle, item targeting and the save system all pick the recruit up as a normal party member. <para/> The recruit itself remains the source of truth outside battle: the mod calls <see cref="SyncToCard"/> whenever its own data changes (starvation tick, joining the squad) and <see cref="SyncFromCard"/> once battle is over, where the battle systems have already written the final health back through the shared <see cref="CharacterInfoData.Attributes"/> reference. <see cref="SyncToCard"/> must mutate the attribute in place — reassigning the attributes object would detach it from the battle copies that still point at the original instance. </summary>
public static class RecruitPartyBridge{/// <summary>True when the recruit currently occupies a slot in the active party.</summary>
public static bool IsInSquad(Recruit recruit){var characterData=GetCharacterData();return characterData!=null&&recruit!=null&&characterData.BattleSet.Contains(recruit.CharacterID);}/// <summary> Adds the recruit to the active party. On the first join a placeholder card is created from the character template (attributes, portrait and default action slots); the card is then immediately synchronized with the recruit's own health. Repeated calls are idempotent. <para/> The template is resolved by <c>CharacterData.AddCharacterToParty</c>, which refuses unknown IDs; a refusal aborts the join so the battle set never references a card that the roster does not have (the battle scene indexes the roster directly for every battle-set entry). </summary>
public static void AddToSquad(Recruit recruit){var characterData=GetCharacterData();if(characterData==null||recruit==null)return;if(!characterData.Characters.ContainsKey(recruit.CharacterID)&& !characterData.AddCharacterToParty(recruit.CharacterID)){GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"AddToSquad: no template for recruit '{recruit.CharacterID}' — join aborted",LogLevel.Error);return;}characterData.BattleSet.Add(recruit.CharacterID);SyncToCard(recruit);GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"Recruit '{recruit.CharacterID}' joined the squad",LogLevel.Message);}/// <summary> Removes the recruit from the active party but keeps the placeholder card in <see cref="CharacterData.Characters"/> — the player's action assignments and battle-earned experience survive a temporary leave and are restored when the recruit joins again. </summary>
public static void RemoveFromSquad(Recruit recruit){var characterData=GetCharacterData();if(characterData==null||recruit==null)return;if(characterData.BattleSet.Remove(recruit.CharacterID))GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"Recruit '{recruit.CharacterID}' left the squad",LogLevel.Message);}/// <summary> Drops every trace of the recruit: leaves the party and deletes the placeholder card. Called when the recruit is removed from the roster for good, so no orphan party entry survives in the core save. </summary>
public static void Forget(Recruit recruit){var characterData=GetCharacterData();if(characterData==null||recruit==null)return;RemoveFromSquad(recruit);characterData.Characters.Remove(recruit.CharacterID);}/// <summary> Pushes the recruit's health from its property bag into the placeholder card. The attribute is mutated in place: battle copies share the same <see cref="CharacterAttributes"/> instance, so a reassignment here would leave the fight running on the stale object. </summary>
public static void SyncToCard(Recruit recruit){var info=GetCard(recruit);if(info==null)return;info.Attributes??=new CharacterAttributes();info.Attributes.Health.Value=recruit.Properties.GetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH);}/// <summary> Pulls the health written by battle back into the recruit's property bag. Called on the core-neutral <c>characters_defeated</c> event, which the battle mod publishes after the victory screen resolves, so the mod's own data stays authoritative once the fight is over. </summary>
public static void SyncFromCard(Recruit recruit){var info=GetCard(recruit);if(info?.Attributes?.Health==null)return;recruit.Properties.SetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH,info.Attributes.Health.Value);}private static CharacterInfoData GetCard(Recruit recruit){var characterData=GetCharacterData();if(characterData?.Characters==null||recruit==null)return null;return characterData.Characters.TryGetValue(recruit.CharacterID,out var info)?info:null;}private static CharacterData GetCharacterData(){return GameData.Instance?.Runtime?.CharacterData;}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Lazy bridge between the scene timer system and the recruit behaviour tick loop. Implements <see cref="IOnTimeEvent"/> so it can be registered with <see cref="SceneEventController"/> via <c>AddTimerTickEventListener</c>. Registration is lazy (<see cref="EnsureRegistered"/> is a no-op after the first call) because the recruit system should not force the timer subsystem to activate if no behaviours are actually loaded. The first behaviour lifecycle method in <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> calls <c>EnsureRegistered</c>, which finds the scene's <c>EventController</c> node and subscribes. <c>Priority = 0</c> so recruit ticks fire at a neutral point in the timer event chain — before or after other listeners as determined by their relative priorities. </summary>
public class RecruitTickController:IOnTimeEvent{/// <summary>Neutral priority — doesn't preempt or follow any specific listener.</summary>
public int Priority=>0;private bool _registered;/// <summary> Finds the scene's <c>EventController</c> node and subscribes this controller as a timer-tick listener. Idempotent — subsequent calls do nothing. </summary>
public void EnsureRegistered(){if(_registered)return;var eventController=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneEventController>("EventController");if(eventController==null)return;eventController.AddTimerTickEventListener(this);_registered=true;}/// <summary> Called by <see cref="SceneEventController"/> on every timer tick. Delegates to <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnTick"/>. Ticks also fire during the launcher boot window, so the registry side must not touch <c>GameData.Instance.Runtime</c> or mod data until <c>Boot.ModsReady</c> (see the boot-window contract on <c>IOnTimeEvent</c>; core-side reference: TimeTickController). </summary>
public void OnTimerTick(){RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnTick();}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Container and factory for the party's recruit roster. The roster is owned by the recruiting mod through the static <see cref="Instance"/> instead of living in the core <c>RuntimeData</c>, so the core knows nothing about recruiting. Persistence is handled by the mod's <c>RecruitingSaveable</c> (<c>IModSaveable</c>), and a new game clears the roster through the <c>RecruitingReset</c> <c>IResettable</c> that <c>RecruitingInitializer</c> registers with AppServices. <para/> Provides ID-based lookup, duplicate-safe addition (auto-generates a unique <c>Guid</c> if the requested ID collides, and rejects a second recruit of the same enemy type), and removal that notifies <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry"/> so behaviours can clean up and detaches the recruit from the squad through <see cref="RecruitPartyBridge"/>. <see cref="Add"/> initialises the recruit's <c>Properties</c> with a default health of 10 via <see cref="Recruit.PROP_HEALTH"/> and immediately calls <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnConfigure</c>, giving every registered behaviour a chance to set up per-recruit state before the next tick fires. </summary>
public class RecruitingData{/// <summary> Session-wide roster. There is exactly one roster per playthrough — starting a new game clears it, loading a save replaces its contents. </summary>
public static readonly RecruitingData Instance=new();/// <summary>The current recruit roster.</summary>
public List<Recruit>Data{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>True if a recruit with the given ID exists in the roster.</summary>
public bool HasID(string id){return GetByID(id)!=null;}/// <summary>Returns the recruit with the given ID, or null if not found.</summary>
public Recruit GetByID(string id){foreach(var item in Data){if(item.ID==id)return item;}return null;}/// <summary> True if a recruit spawned from the given character template is already in the roster. Recruitment allows only one instance per enemy type, which also keeps the template id usable as a unique party key. </summary>
public bool HasCharacterID(string characterID){return GetByCharacterID(characterID)!=null;}/// <summary>Returns the recruit spawned from the given template, or null if not found.</summary>
public Recruit GetByCharacterID(string characterID){foreach(var item in Data){if(item.CharacterID==characterID)return item;}return null;}/// <summary> Generates a unique ID: if <paramref name="id"/> is free, returns it unchanged; otherwise appends a <c>Guid</c> suffix. Loops until an unused ID is found (guaranteed because Guid is unique enough for any practical roster size). </summary>
private string GenID(string id){for(;;){if(!HasID(id))return id;id=Guid.NewGuid().ToString();}}/// <summary> Creates a new <see cref="Recruit"/> from the given <paramref name="characterID"/>, assigns a unique instance ID, initialises default health, appends to the roster, and fires <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnConfigure</c> so behaviours can set up per-recruit state. <para/> Only one recruit per enemy type is allowed: a second attempt for an already captured <paramref name="characterID"/> is ignored and the existing entry is returned, so callers cannot create duplicates and the template id remains a unique party card key. </summary>
public Recruit Add(string id,string characterID){var existing=GetByCharacterID(characterID);if(existing!=null){GameLogger.Log("RECRUIT",$"Recruit '{characterID}' already captured, duplicate ignored",LogLevel.Warning);return existing;}var data=new Recruit{ID=GenID(id),CharacterID=characterID,};data.Properties.SetInt(Recruit.PROP_HEALTH,10);Data.Add(data);RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnConfigure(data);return data;}/// <summary> Removes the recruit with the given ID from the roster. Notifies <see cref="RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnRemove"/> before deleting the entry so behaviours can persist state or clean up companion nodes, then detaches the recruit from the party and deletes its placeholder card via <see cref="RecruitPartyBridge.Forget"/>, so no orphan party member survives in the core save. </summary>
public void Remove(string id){for(int i=Data.Count-1;i>=0;i--){if(Data[i].ID==id){RecruitBehaviourRegistry.Instance.OnRemove(Data[i]);RecruitPartyBridge.Forget(Data[i]);Data.RemoveAt(i);return;}}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Lifecycle entry point of the recruiting mod. Behaviours and conditions of all mods are not discovered here: the kernel delivers them through <see cref="RecruitBehaviourConsumer"/> and <see cref="RecruitConditionConsumer"/>. <list type="number"> <item>It registers a <see cref="RecruitingReset"/> with <see cref="AppServices"/>, so the core's "New Game" pipeline (<c>GameData.StartNewGame</c> → <c>AppServices.ResetForNewGame</c>) clears the roster — the core used to discard it implicitly with RuntimeData, but the roster now lives in <see cref="RecruitingData.Instance"/> and must be reset explicitly on "New Game". Registration is idempotent: AppServices deduplicates by <c>IResettable.Id</c>, so a repeated <c>OnModResourcesReady</c> is safe.</item> <item>It subscribes to <see cref="CharactersDefeatedEvent"/> and routes it into <see cref="DefeatedCharactersRecruiter"/> — the publisher (battle, trap, script) stays unaware of recruiting, so the whole system can be disabled by removing this mod.</item> </list> Persistence is not handled here: <see cref="RecruitingSaveable"/> is an <c>IModSaveable</c> and is discovered by ModSaveableRegistry automatically. </summary>
public class RecruitingInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool _defeatedSubscribed;/// <summary>Nothing to do per mod: recruit plugins arrive through the kernel's assembly consumers.</summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Registers the roster reset owner with AppServices (idempotent — duplicates by Id are ignored) and installs the <see cref="CharactersDefeatedEvent"/> subscription. The roster is no longer cleared through a <c>NewGameStartedEvent</c> subscription: the core's reset loop invokes <see cref="RecruitingReset"/> instead. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){AppServices.Current.RegisterResettable(new RecruitingReset());EnsureDefeatedSubscription();}private static void EnsureDefeatedSubscription(){if(_defeatedSubscribed)return;_defeatedSubscribed=true;ModEventBus.Subscribe<CharactersDefeatedEvent>(DefeatedCharactersRecruiter.Process);}}/// <summary> New-game state owner of the recruiting mod: clears the session roster (<see cref="RecruitingData.Data"/>). Registered from <see cref="RecruitingInitializer.OnModResourcesReady"/>; <see cref="AppServices"/> deduplicates by Id, so repeated registration is a no-op. The clear is a plain list clear with no per-recruit side effects — unlike <see cref="RecruitingData.Remove"/> it does not notify <c>RecruitBehaviourRegistry.OnRemove</c> or detach companions through <c>RecruitPartyBridge</c> — matching the previous <c>NewGameStartedEvent</c> handler's behavior. Save loading is a separate path: <c>RecruitingSaveable</c> replaces the roster contents when a save is loaded. </summary>
internal sealed class RecruitingReset:IResettable{/// <summary>Resettable key under which AppServices deduplicates registration.</summary>
public string Id=>"recruiting";/// <summary>Clears the roster wholesale on "New Game", without per-recruit notifications.</summary>
public void ResetForNewGame()=>RecruitingData.Instance.Data.Clear();}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Relationship{/// <summary> Persists the recruit roster in the mod's own save slot. The core save used to carry a <c>"Recruits"</c> blob inside the <c>__core__</c> slot, but the roster now belongs to the recruiting mod — so it saves through the generic <see cref="IModSaveable"/> contract under the mod id <c>recruiting</c>. <para/> <see cref="OnLoad"/> replaces the roster wholesale and does not re-fire <c>ConfigureRecruit</c>: persisted per-recruit properties (for example the nutrition timer) are already in the blob and behaviours continue their tick logic from the restored state, matching the old core behaviour. using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.ResourceAtlas{/// <summary>One resource a mod makes available under a resolver key.</summary>
public sealed class AtlasProvision{/// <summary>Resource kind: validator kinds (background, sound, character, scene...) plus texture, shader, action, entity_kind, locale, scene_file.</summary>
public string Kind{get;init;}/// <summary>Resolver key inside the kind (texture basename, sound path, entity id, "lang:key"...).</summary>
public string Id{get;init;}public string ModId{get;init;}public string File{get;init;}}/// <summary>One place where a mod asks for a resource by key.</summary>
public sealed class AtlasRequest{public string Kind{get;init;}public string Id{get;init;}public string ModId{get;init;}public string File{get;init;}public int Line{get;init;}/// <summary>Channel the request was found in: data, code, scenario, res, entity_data.</summary>
public string Via{get;init;}/// <summary>Provider named by the reference itself (<c>res://mods/&lt;id&gt;/...</c>); null when resolved by key.</summary>
public string ExplicitProvider{get;init;}}/// <summary>An intentional edit of another mod's resource through <c>patches/</c>.</summary>
public sealed class AtlasPatch{public string Kind{get;init;}public string Id{get;init;}public string ModId{get;init;}public string File{get;init;}/// <summary>Explicit target owner from the patch header, or null to resolve by key.</summary>
public string ExplicitOwner{get;init;}}public enum AtlasSeverity{Info,Warning,Error,}public enum AtlasFindingKind{/// <summary>A mod uses another mod's resource and declares that mod in its depends closure.</summary>
DeclaredUse,/// <summary>A mod uses another mod's resource without a depends path to it — breaks once that mod is absent.</summary>
UndeclaredUse,/// <summary>No loaded mod provides the requested key.</summary>
Unresolved,/// <summary>The winner of a shared key depends on the losers — the override is intended and ordered.</summary>
DeclaredOverride,/// <summary>Several unrelated mods provide one key; the winner is decided by incidental load order.</summary>
UnorderedOverride,/// <summary>A mod patches another mod's resource and depends on it.</summary>
DeclaredPatch,/// <summary>A mod patches another mod's resource without depending on it.</summary>
UndeclaredPatch,/// <summary>A patch targets a key no other loaded mod provides.</summary>
PatchTargetMissing,/// <summary> Inside a game: the key is provided only by an installed mod that is not part of the game — the isolated game will not find it. </summary>
OutsideGame,}public sealed class AtlasFinding{public AtlasFindingKind Kind{get;init;}public AtlasSeverity Severity{get;init;}/// <summary>Mod the finding is attributed to (requester, overriding winner, patcher).</summary>
public string ModId{get;init;}/// <summary>The other side: providers, overridden mods or patch owners.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<string>OtherMods{get;init;}=new List<string>();public string ResourceKind{get;init;}public string ResourceId{get;init;}public string File{get;init;}public int Line{get;init;}public string Message{get;init;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Validator;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.ResourceAtlas{/// <summary> Runs one atlas pass after the boot: snapshots the loaded mods in load order, builds the validator graph and the atlas on a worker thread, writes the report, logs every error as <c>[FAIL]</c> and prints <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=resource_atlas passed=&lt;clean mods&gt; failed=&lt;mods with errors&gt;</c> before quitting with 0/1. A watchdog ends a hung pass with a failure instead of blocking the test run. </summary>
public partial class ResourceAtlasDriverNode:Node{private const string ResultName="resource_atlas";private readonly string directory;private readonly float timeoutSeconds;private double elapsed;private bool started;private bool finished;private Task<ResourceAtlasResult>pass;public ResourceAtlasDriverNode(){}public ResourceAtlasDriverNode(string directory,float timeoutSeconds){this.directory=directory;this.timeoutSeconds=timeoutSeconds;Name="ResourceAtlasDriver";}public override void _Process(double delta){if(finished)return;elapsed+=delta;if(elapsed>timeoutSeconds){Finish(null,$"timeout after {timeoutSeconds:F0}s");return;}if(!started){if(!Boot.IsReady)return;started=true;ValidatorService.WarmUp();var mods=SnapshotMods();var actions=ScenarioActionFactory.Instance.GetAll().Select(a=>(a.Name,a.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Name)).ToList();GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"building atlas for {mods.Count} mod(s)");var loaded=new HashSet<string>(mods.Select(m=>m.Id),StringComparer.Ordinal);var outside=ModRegistry.Instance.AllDiscoveredMods.Values.Where(m=> !loaded.Contains(m.Id)).ToList();if(outside.Count>0)GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"{outside.Count} installed mod(s) are outside the loaded set; keys only they provide are errors");pass=Task.Run(()=>{var context=ValidatorService.Analyze(mods,null,CancellationToken.None);var outsideContext=outside.Count>0?ValidatorService.Analyze(outside,null,CancellationToken.None):null;return ResourceAtlasBuilder.Build(mods,context.Graph,actions,outside,outsideContext?.Graph);});return;}if(pass is{IsCompleted:true}){if(pass.IsFaulted)Finish(null,$"atlas pass failed: {pass.Exception?.GetBaseException().Message}");else Finish(pass.Result,null);}}private static List<IModInfo>SnapshotMods(){var registry=ModRegistry.Instance;var result=new List<IModInfo>();foreach(var id in registry.GetOrderedModIds()){if(registry.Mods.TryGetValue(id,out var info)&&info!=null)result.Add(info);}return result;}private void Finish(ResourceAtlasResult result,string failure){if(finished)return;finished=true;var passed=0;var failed=0;if(result!=null){try{ResourceAtlasReportWriter.Write(result,directory);}catch(Exception ex){failure=$"report write failed: {ex.Message}";}foreach(var error in result.Errors.GroupBy(e=>(e.Kind,e.ModId,Others:string.Join(",",e.OtherMods),e.ResourceKind,e.ResourceId)).Select(g=>g.First())){GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"[FAIL] {error.ModId} -> {string.Join("/", error.OtherMods)}: {error.ResourceKind} '{error.ResourceId}' {error.Message} ({error.File}{(error.Line > 0 ? ":" + error.Line : string.Empty)})");}var failing=result.FailingMods();failed=failing.Count;passed=result.LoadOrder.Count-failed;GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"atlas: {result.Errors.Count()} error(s), {result.Warnings.Count()} warning(s); report: {Path.Combine(directory, "report.md")}");}if(failure!=null){failed++;GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"[FAIL] {failure}",LogLevel.Error);}GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"[TEST_RESULT] name={ResultName} passed={passed} failed={failed}");GetTree().Quit(failed==0?0:1);}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.ResourceAtlas{/// <summary> Activates the atlas only on demand: the <c>--resource-atlas</c> user arg (after <c>--</c>) queues <see cref="ResourceAtlasDriverNode"/>, which waits for the boot, writes the report and quits. Optional <c>--atlas-out=&lt;dir&gt;</c> (res://, user:// or absolute) sets the report directory, <c>--timeout=&lt;s&gt;</c> the watchdog. </summary>
public class ResourceAtlasInitializer:IModInitializer{public const string Flag="--resource-atlas";private const string OutPrefix="--atlas-out=";private const string DefaultOut="user://resource_atlas";private static bool queued;public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(queued)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();if(!args.Contains(Flag))return;var output=args.FirstOrDefault(a=>a.StartsWith(OutPrefix,System.StringComparison.Ordinal))?.Substring(OutPrefix.Length);if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(output))output=DefaultOut;queued=true;var directory=ProjectSettings.GlobalizePath(output);GameLogger.Log("RESOURCE_ATLAS",$"resource atlas requested, report directory '{directory}'");(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root?.CallDeferred("add_child",new ResourceAtlasDriverNode(directory,ParseTimeout(args)));}private static float ParseTimeout(string[]args){var raw=args.FirstOrDefault(a=>a.StartsWith("--timeout=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal))?.Substring("--timeout=".Length);return float.TryParse(raw,System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out var seconds)&&seconds>0?seconds:120f;}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text;using System.Text.Encodings.Web;using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.ResourceAtlas{/// <summary> Writes <c>report.md</c> (read first: errors with the fix, then the mod-to-mod picture) and <c>report.json</c> (every finding, for tools). Repeated occurrences of one link are folded into a count with the first location, so the markdown stays readable for agents and people. </summary>
public static class ResourceAtlasReportWriter{private const int Samples=5;public static void Write(ResourceAtlasResult result,string directory){Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory,"report.md"),BuildMarkdown(result),new UTF8Encoding(false));File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory,"report.json"),BuildJson(result),new UTF8Encoding(false));}public static string BuildMarkdown(ResourceAtlasResult result){var md=new StringBuilder();var errors=Fold(result.Errors).ToList();var warnings=result.Warnings.ToList();md.AppendLine("# Карта ресурсов модов");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine($"Создано: {DateTime.UtcNow:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC · модов: {result.LoadOrder.Count} · "+$"ресурсов: {result.Provisions.Count} · запросов: {result.Requests.Count} · патчей: {result.Patches.Count}");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine($"**Ошибок: {errors.Count}** (моды: {string.Join(", ", result.FailingMods()).OrEmpty("нет")}) · "+$"предупреждений: {warnings.Count}");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine("Как читать: связь «A → B» значит, что мод A берёт ресурс мода B по ключу. Связь корректна, "+"когда B есть в транзитивных `depends` мода A. При совпадении ключа выигрывает мод, загруженный позже, "+"и это детерминировано только вдоль цепочки `depends`.");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine("## Ошибки");md.AppendLine();if(errors.Count==0)md.AppendLine("Нет.");foreach(var group in errors.GroupBy(e=>e.First.Kind)){md.AppendLine($"### {Title(group.Key)}");md.AppendLine();foreach(var error in group){var f=error.First;md.AppendLine($"- `{f.ModId}` → `{string.Join("`, `", f.OtherMods)}`: {f.ResourceKind} `{f.ResourceId}` — {f.Message}. "+$"{Location(f)}{(error.Count > 1 ? $" (+{error.Count - 1})" : string.Empty)}");}md.AppendLine();}AppendLinks(md,result);AppendOverrides(md,result);AppendPatches(md,result);AppendUnresolved(md,warnings);AppendModTable(md,result);md.AppendLine("## Порядок загрузки");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine(string.Join(" → ",result.LoadOrder.Select(m=>$"`{m}`")));return md.ToString();}private static void AppendLinks(StringBuilder md,ResourceAtlasResult result){md.AppendLine("## Связи между модами (кто чьи ресурсы использует)");md.AppendLine();var links=result.Findings.Where(f=>f.Kind is AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredUse or AtlasFindingKind.UndeclaredUse).SelectMany(f=>f.OtherMods.Select(other=>(f,other))).GroupBy(x=>(x.f.ModId,x.other)).OrderBy(g=>g.Key.ModId,StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(g=>g.Key.other,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();if(links.Count==0){md.AppendLine("Нет.");md.AppendLine();return;}md.AppendLine("| Мод | Берёт ресурсы у | В depends | Запросов | Виды | Примеры |");md.AppendLine("|---|---|---|---|---|---|");foreach(var link in links){var declared=result.Closures[link.Key.ModId].Contains(link.Key.other);var kinds=string.Join(", ",link.Select(x=>x.f.ResourceKind).Distinct());var samples=string.Join(", ",link.Select(x=>$"`{x.f.ResourceId}`").Distinct().Take(Samples));md.AppendLine($"| `{link.Key.ModId}` | `{link.Key.other}` | {(declared ? "да" : "**нет**")} | {link.Count()} | {kinds} | {samples} |");}md.AppendLine();}private static void AppendOverrides(StringBuilder md,ResourceAtlasResult result){md.AppendLine("## Переопределения (один ключ у нескольких модов)");md.AppendLine();var overrides=result.Findings.Where(f=>f.Kind is AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredOverride or AtlasFindingKind.UnorderedOverride).GroupBy(f=>(f.ModId,Other:f.OtherMods[0],f.Kind)).OrderBy(g=>g.Key.Kind).ThenBy(g=>g.Key.ModId,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();if(overrides.Count==0){md.AppendLine("Нет.");md.AppendLine();return;}md.AppendLine("| Побеждает | Перекрывает | Упорядочено depends | Ключей | Виды | Примеры |");md.AppendLine("|---|---|---|---|---|---|");foreach(var group in overrides){var kinds=string.Join(", ",group.Select(f=>f.ResourceKind).Distinct());var samples=string.Join(", ",group.Select(f=>$"`{f.ResourceId}`").Distinct().Take(Samples));var ordered=group.Key.Kind==AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredOverride?"да":"**нет**";md.AppendLine($"| `{group.Key.ModId}` | `{group.Key.Other}` | {ordered} | {group.Count()} | {kinds} | {samples} |");}md.AppendLine();}private static void AppendPatches(StringBuilder md,ResourceAtlasResult result){md.AppendLine("## Патчи чужих ресурсов");md.AppendLine();var patches=result.Findings.Where(f=>f.Kind is AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredPatch or AtlasFindingKind.UndeclaredPatch).ToList();if(patches.Count==0){md.AppendLine("Нет.");md.AppendLine();return;}md.AppendLine("| Мод | Патчит мод | В depends | Ресурс | Файл |");md.AppendLine("|---|---|---|---|---|");foreach(var patch in patches.OrderBy(p=>p.ModId,StringComparer.Ordinal)){var declared=patch.Kind==AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredPatch?"да":"**нет**";md.AppendLine($"| `{patch.ModId}` | `{string.Join("`, `", patch.OtherMods)}` | {declared} | {patch.ResourceKind} `{patch.ResourceId}` | `{patch.File}` |");}md.AppendLine();}private static void AppendUnresolved(StringBuilder md,List<AtlasFinding>warnings){md.AppendLine("## Предупреждения: ключ не найден ни в одном моде");md.AppendLine();if(warnings.Count==0){md.AppendLine("Нет.");md.AppendLine();return;}foreach(var group in Fold(warnings).OrderBy(w=>w.First.ModId,StringComparer.Ordinal)){var f=group.First;md.AppendLine($"- `{f.ModId}`: {f.ResourceKind} `{f.ResourceId}` — {f.Message}. {Location(f)}{(group.Count > 1 ? $" (+{group.Count - 1})" : string.Empty)}");}md.AppendLine();}private static void AppendModTable(StringBuilder md,ResourceAtlasResult result){md.AppendLine("## Сводка по модам");md.AppendLine();md.AppendLine("| Мод | depends | Берёт у | Его ресурсы берут | Перекрывает | Ошибок |");md.AppendLine("|---|---|---|---|---|---|");var uses=result.Findings.Where(f=>f.Kind is AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredUse or AtlasFindingKind.UndeclaredUse).ToList();var overrides=result.Findings.Where(f=>f.Kind is AtlasFindingKind.DeclaredOverride or AtlasFindingKind.UnorderedOverride).ToList();foreach(var mod in result.LoadOrder){var takesFrom=uses.Where(f=>f.ModId==mod).SelectMany(f=>f.OtherMods).Distinct().OrderBy(m=>m,StringComparer.Ordinal);var usedBy=uses.Where(f=>f.OtherMods.Contains(mod)).Select(f=>f.ModId).Distinct().OrderBy(m=>m,StringComparer.Ordinal);var covers=overrides.Where(f=>f.ModId==mod).SelectMany(f=>f.OtherMods).Distinct().OrderBy(m=>m,StringComparer.Ordinal);var errors=result.Errors.Count(f=>f.ModId==mod);md.AppendLine($"| `{mod}` | {Join(result.Depends[mod])} | {Join(takesFrom)} | {Join(usedBy)} | {Join(covers)} | {(errors > 0 ? $"**{errors}**" : "0")} |");}md.AppendLine();}public static string BuildJson(ResourceAtlasResult result){var report=new{generatedAt=DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"),summary=new{mods=result.LoadOrder.Count,provisions=result.Provisions.Count,requests=result.Requests.Count,patches=result.Patches.Count,errors=result.Errors.Count(),warnings=result.Warnings.Count(),failingMods=result.FailingMods(),},loadOrder=result.LoadOrder,mods=result.LoadOrder.Select(m=>new{id=m,depends=result.Depends[m],closure=result.Closures[m].OrderBy(x=>x,StringComparer.Ordinal)}),findings=result.Findings.Select(f=>new{severity=f.Severity.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(),kind=f.Kind.ToString(),mod=f.ModId,otherMods=f.OtherMods,resourceKind=f.ResourceKind,resourceId=f.ResourceId,file=f.File,line=f.Line,message=f.Message,}),};return JsonSerializer.Serialize(report,new JsonSerializerOptions{WriteIndented=true,Encoder=JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping,});}/// <summary>Groups repeated occurrences of one logical finding (same mods, kind and key).</summary>
private static IEnumerable<(AtlasFinding First,int Count)>Fold(IEnumerable<AtlasFinding>findings)=>findings.GroupBy(f=>(f.Kind,f.ModId,Others:string.Join(",",f.OtherMods),f.ResourceKind,f.ResourceId)).Select(g=>(g.First(),g.Count()));private static string Title(AtlasFindingKind kind)=>kind switch{AtlasFindingKind.UndeclaredUse=>"Используется чужой ресурс без зависимости в depends",AtlasFindingKind.UnorderedOverride=>"Переопределение без порядка (победитель случаен)",AtlasFindingKind.UndeclaredPatch=>"Патч чужого ресурса без зависимости",AtlasFindingKind.OutsideGame=>"Ресурс есть только в модах вне игры",_=>kind.ToString(),};private static string Location(AtlasFinding finding)=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(finding.File)?string.Empty:finding.Line>0?$"`{finding.File}:{finding.Line}`":$"`{finding.File}`";private static string Join(IEnumerable<string>ids){var list=ids.ToList();return list.Count==0?"—":string.Join(", ",list);}private static string OrEmpty(this string value,string fallback)=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)?fallback:value;}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.ResourceAtlas{/// <summary> Everything the atlas learned in one pass: load order and depends closures, every provision/request/patch, and the findings derived from them. Report writers and the test driver read only this object. </summary>
public sealed class ResourceAtlasResult{public List<string>LoadOrder{get;}=new();public Dictionary<string,List<string>>Depends{get;}=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);public Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>>Closures{get;}=new(StringComparer.Ordinal);public List<AtlasProvision>Provisions{get;}=new();/// <summary>Provisions of installed mods that are not loaded (only when the atlas runs inside a game).</summary>
public List<AtlasProvision>OutsideProvisions{get;}=new();public List<AtlasRequest>Requests{get;}=new();public List<AtlasPatch>Patches{get;}=new();public List<AtlasFinding>Findings{get;}=new();/// <summary>Keys the kernel provides (e.g. scenario actions from Core); always available, never a cross-mod link.</summary>
public HashSet<(string Kind,string Id)>KernelKeys{get;}=new();public IEnumerable<AtlasFinding>Errors=>Findings.Where(f=>f.Severity==AtlasSeverity.Error);public IEnumerable<AtlasFinding>Warnings=>Findings.Where(f=>f.Severity==AtlasSeverity.Warning);/// <summary>Mods with at least one error finding, in load order.</summary>
public List<string>FailingMods(){var failing=new HashSet<string>(Errors.Select(f=>f.ModId),StringComparer.Ordinal);return LoadOrder.Where(failing.Contains).ToList();}}}

using System;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> The random-battle roll made after each step on a map with an <see cref="RpgEncounterTable"/>. Takes the random source from outside so a test can make it deterministic. </summary>
public static class RpgEncounterRoller{/// <summary> Returns the enemy group of the battle this step starts, or null for no battle (no table, encounters off, no groups, or the roll missed). </summary>
public static string Roll(RpgEncounterTable table,Random random){if(table==null||table.Steps<=0||table.Groups==null||table.Groups.Count==0||random==null)return null;if(random.Next(table.Steps)!=0)return null;var group=table.Groups[random.Next(table.Groups.Count)];return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(group)?null:group;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> One tile map of the RPG world. The map id is also the name of the logical scene that shows it: entering scene <c>X</c> (any <c>switch_scene X</c>, a teleport, the return from a battle, loading a save) mounts map <c>X</c> over the shell. Because the scene stays an ordinary scene, everything the engine attaches to scenes works on a map unchanged — entry scenarios, ambience and music from <c>scenes/X.json</c>, the default background (which also becomes the backdrop of battles started here), saving rules. <para/> Files declare <c>"Kind": "rpg_map"</c>. Layers are parsed by <see cref="RpgMapGrid"/>; a dependent mod replaces a whole map by id, the usual entity override. </summary>
[EntityKind("rpg_map")]public class RpgMap:IIdentifiable{/// <summary>Map id = logical scene name.</summary>

public string Name{get;set;}/// <summary>Id of the <see cref="RpgTileset"/> the indices refer to.</summary>
public string Tileset{get;set;}/// <summary>Columns.</summary>
public int Width{get;set;}/// <summary>Rows.</summary>
public int Height{get;set;}/// <summary>Screen pixels per tile pixel; pixel art is scaled by a whole number.</summary>
public int Zoom{get;set;}=2;/// <summary>The three drawn layers.</summary>
public RpgMapLayers Layers{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Rows of <see cref="RpgCollision"/> codes, one character per cell; may be empty.</summary>
public List<string>Collision{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Where the player appears when entering the map without a teleport target.</summary>
public RpgTeleport Spawn{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Events placed on the map.</summary>
public List<RpgMapEvent>Events{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Random battles; null for a safe map.</summary>
public RpgEncounterTable Encounters{get;set;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Something placed on a map cell that reacts to the player, in the spirit of RPG Maker events: an NPC, a sign, a chest, a door. What it looks like and what it does are independent: <list type="bullet"> <item>look — a charset <see cref="Sprite"/>, or one atlas <see cref="Tile"/>, or nothing (an invisible trigger);</item> <item>effect — a <see cref="Teleport"/>, handled natively, or a dialog built from a <see cref="Scenario"/> file followed by inline <see cref="Commands"/> (the full scenario DSL, so <c>action rpg.battle …</c>, <c>flag …</c>, quests).</item> </list> A <see cref="Condition"/> in the scenario condition language hides the event while false; it is re-checked whenever game state changes, so a defeated boss (<c>flag boss_dead 1</c>) disappears at once. </summary>
public class RpgMapEvent{/// <summary>Id unique within the map.</summary>
public string Id{get;set;}/// <summary>Column.</summary>
public int X{get;set;}/// <summary>Row.</summary>
public int Y{get;set;}/// <summary>Charset image in the <c>charsets</c> group (3 frames × 4 facings).</summary>
public string Sprite{get;set;}/// <summary>Atlas index of the map's tileset drawn as the event when it has no sprite; -1 for none.</summary>
public int Tile{get;set;}= -1;/// <summary>Initial facing of a sprite.</summary>
public RpgDirection Dir{get;set;}=RpgDirection.Down;/// <summary>When the event fires.</summary>
public RpgEventTrigger Trigger{get;set;}=RpgEventTrigger.Action;/// <summary>The event occupies its cell. Null means "solid when it is visible" (a sprite or a tile).</summary>
public bool?Solid{get;set;}/// <summary>Scenario path inside the <c>scenarios</c> group (extension optional), played as a dialog.</summary>
public string Scenario{get;set;}/// <summary>Inline DSL lines appended after the scenario.</summary>
public List<string>Commands{get;set;}/// <summary>Moves the player instead of starting a dialog.</summary>
public RpgTeleport Teleport{get;set;}/// <summary>Scenario condition; the event exists only while it is true.</summary>
public string Condition{get;set;}/// <summary>Effective solidity: explicit value, else whether the event is drawn.</summary>
public bool IsSolid=>Solid??(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Sprite)||Tile>=0);}}
