===== FILE mods/rpg/src/Data/RpgMapGrid.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Parsed cells of an <see cref="RpgMap"/>: the three tile layers as atlas indices (-1 = empty) and the collision codes. The map file keeps rows as text (<see cref="RpgMapLayers"/>); this is the form the world and the editor work with, and <see cref="WriteTo"/> turns it back into rows. <para/> Parsing is forgiving, because maps are edited by hand: short rows and missing rows are empty cells, extra cells are cut off, an unreadable token is empty. The grid always has exactly the map's declared size. </summary>
public class RpgMapGrid{private const string EmptyToken=".";private int[][]layers;private char[]collision;/// <summary>Columns.</summary>
public int Width{get;private set;}/// <summary>Rows.</summary>
public int Height{get;private set;}/// <summary>Creates an empty grid: no tiles, collision from tiles everywhere.</summary>
public RpgMapGrid(int width,int height){Width=Math.Max(1,width);Height=Math.Max(1,height);layers=new int[3][];for(var i=0;i<layers.Length;i++)layers[i]=Enumerable.Repeat(-1,Width*Height).ToArray();collision=Enumerable.Repeat(RpgCollision.Auto,Width*Height).ToArray();}/// <summary>Reads the layers and the collision rows of <paramref name="map"/>.</summary>
public static RpgMapGrid Parse(RpgMap map){var grid=new RpgMapGrid(map?.Width??1,map?.Height??1);if(map==null)return grid;grid.ReadLayer(RpgLayer.Back,map.Layers?.Back);grid.ReadLayer(RpgLayer.Main,map.Layers?.Main);grid.ReadLayer(RpgLayer.Front,map.Layers?.Front);var rows=map.Collision??new List<string>();for(var y=0;y<grid.Height&&y<rows.Count;y++){var row=rows[y]??string.Empty;for(var x=0;x<grid.Width&&x<row.Length;x++)grid.SetCollision(x,y,row[x]);}return grid;}/// <summary>True when the cell lies on the map.</summary>
public bool InBounds(int x,int y)=>x>=0&&y>=0&&x<Width&&y<Height;/// <summary>Atlas index on a layer, -1 for empty or outside the map.</summary>
public int GetTile(RpgLayer layer,int x,int y)=>InBounds(x,y)?layers[(int)layer][y*Width+x]:-1;/// <summary>Puts an atlas index (-1 clears); outside the map it does nothing.</summary>
public void SetTile(RpgLayer layer,int x,int y,int index){if(InBounds(x,y))layers[(int)layer][y*Width+x]=index<0? -1:index;}/// <summary>Collision code of a cell; outside the map it is <see cref="RpgCollision.Block"/>.</summary>
public char GetCollision(int x,int y)=>InBounds(x,y)?collision[y*Width+x]:RpgCollision.Block;/// <summary>Sets a collision code; an unknown code becomes <see cref="RpgCollision.Auto"/>.</summary>
public void SetCollision(int x,int y,char code){if(!InBounds(x,y))return;collision[y*Width+x]=code==RpgCollision.Block||code==RpgCollision.Open?code:RpgCollision.Auto;}/// <summary> Changes the size keeping the top-left content; new cells are empty. Used by the editor; the map's events are not moved. </summary>
public void Resize(int width,int height){var resized=new RpgMapGrid(width,height);for(var y=0;y<Math.Min(Height,resized.Height);y++){for(var x=0;x<Math.Min(Width,resized.Width);x++){foreach(RpgLayer layer in Enum.GetValues(typeof(RpgLayer)))resized.SetTile(layer,x,y,GetTile(layer,x,y));resized.SetCollision(x,y,GetCollision(x,y));}}Width=resized.Width;Height=resized.Height;layers=resized.layers;collision=resized.collision;}/// <summary>Copy of the grid, so editor undo steps never share cells.</summary>
public RpgMapGrid Clone(){var copy=new RpgMapGrid(Width,Height);for(var i=0;i<layers.Length;i++)Array.Copy(layers[i],copy.layers[i],layers[i].Length);Array.Copy(collision,copy.collision,collision.Length);return copy;}/// <summary> Writes size, layer rows and collision rows into <paramref name="map"/>. Indices are right-aligned to one width per layer, so columns line up in the file. An all-auto collision layer is written as no rows. </summary>
public void WriteTo(RpgMap map){map.Width=Width;map.Height=Height;map.Layers??=new RpgMapLayers();map.Layers.Back=WriteLayer(RpgLayer.Back);map.Layers.Main=WriteLayer(RpgLayer.Main);map.Layers.Front=WriteLayer(RpgLayer.Front);var rows=new List<string>();if(collision.Any(c=>c!=RpgCollision.Auto)){for(var y=0;y<Height;y++)rows.Add(new string(collision,y*Width,Width));}map.Collision=rows;}private void ReadLayer(RpgLayer layer,List<string>rows){if(rows==null)return;for(var y=0;y<Height&&y<rows.Count;y++){var tokens=(rows[y]??string.Empty).Split(' ',StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);for(var x=0;x<Width&&x<tokens.Length;x++)SetTile(layer,x,y,int.TryParse(tokens[x],out var index)?index:-1);}}private List<string>WriteLayer(RpgLayer layer){var cells=layers[(int)layer];var width=cells.Select(Token).Max(t=>t.Length);var rows=new List<string>();var line=new StringBuilder();for(var y=0;y<Height;y++){line.Clear();for(var x=0;x<Width;x++){if(x>0)line.Append(' ');line.Append(Token(cells[y*Width+x]).PadLeft(width));}rows.Add(line.ToString());}return rows;}private static string Token(int index)=>index<0?EmptyToken:index.ToString();}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> The three drawn layers of a map, each a list of rows. A row is a string of space-separated atlas indices, <c>.</c> for an empty cell, so a map file stays readable and diffable by hand (see <see cref="RpgMapGrid"/>). <list type="bullet"> <item><see cref="Back"/> — ground: grass, floors, water.</item> <item><see cref="Main"/> — objects at the actors' level: walls, trunks, fences.</item> <item><see cref="Front"/> — drawn over the actors: tree crowns, roofs' eaves, arches.</item> </list> </summary>
public class RpgMapLayers{/// <summary>Ground layer rows.</summary>
public List<string>Back{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Object layer rows.</summary>
public List<string>Main{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Overhead layer rows.</summary>
public List<string>Front{get;set;}=new();}}

===== FILE mods/rpg/src/Data/RpgPassability.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Whether the terrain of a cell can be walked on: the collision layer decides when painted, otherwise a solid tile on the back or the main layer blocks. Front-layer tiles never block — they are what the player walks under. Events are not terrain: the world adds their cells on top. </summary>
public static class RpgPassability{/// <summary>True when the cell is inside the map and its terrain lets the player in.</summary>
public static bool IsWalkable(RpgMapGrid grid,RpgTileset tileset,int x,int y){if(grid==null|| !grid.InBounds(x,y))return false;var code=grid.GetCollision(x,y);if(code==RpgCollision.Block)return false;if(code==RpgCollision.Open)return true;if(tileset==null)return true;return!tileset.IsSolid(grid.GetTile(RpgLayer.Back,x,y))&& !tileset.IsSolid(grid.GetTile(RpgLayer.Main,x,y));}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Cthangover.Core.Factories;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> A square-tile atlas: one image cut into <see cref="TileSize"/> cells, <see cref="Columns"/> per row, addressed by a row-major index. Maps store only these indices, so a pack can redraw its tiles without touching maps. <para/> Files declare <c>"Kind": "rpg_tileset"</c> and live anywhere in a mod; the image is resolved in the <c>tilesets</c> file group (last mod wins), so a dependent mod can reskin a tileset by shipping an image of the same path. </summary>
[EntityKind("rpg_tileset")]public class RpgTileset:IIdentifiable{private HashSet<int>solid;/// <summary>Tileset id that maps reference.</summary>
[JsonPropertyName("Id")]public string ID{get;set;}/// <summary>Image path inside the <c>tilesets</c> group, extension optional.</summary>
public string Image{get;set;}/// <summary>Edge of one square tile in image pixels.</summary>
public int TileSize{get;set;}=32;/// <summary>Atlas cells per row.</summary>
public int Columns{get;set;}=8;/// <summary>Per-cell properties; cells without an entry are walkable.</summary>
public List<RpgTileInfo>Tiles{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>True when the atlas cell blocks walking. Built once from <see cref="Tiles"/>.</summary>
public bool IsSolid(int index){if(index<0)return false;if(solid==null){solid=new HashSet<int>();foreach(var tile in Tiles??new List<RpgTileInfo>()){if(tile.Solid)solid.Add(tile.Index);}}return solid.Contains(index);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Starts a battle of the active battle core from the map and brings the player back to the same map cell afterwards. It is a thin layer over the platform (<see cref="BattleService.Init"/> + the <c>Battle</c> route): <list type="bullet"> <item>the return scene is the current map's scene, and the position is already in <see cref="RpgState"/>, so the world restores it;</item> <item>the backdrop is the map scene's default background (captured by the platform from the scene), so a map chooses its battle background in <c>scenes/&lt;map&gt;.json</c>;</item> <item>an optional win flag becomes the story flag "1" on victory — how a map monster disappears after it is beaten (its event's condition).</item> </list> </summary>
public static class RpgBattleService{private const string BattleRoute="Battle";private const string VictoryResult="victory";/// <summary> Requests the encounter and switches to the battle route on the next frame (deferred like <c>switch_scene</c>, so a running dialog finishes its current command first). Returns false when there is no scene to come back to. </summary>
public static bool Start(string enemies,string winFlag){var sceneManager=FindSceneManager();var returnScene=sceneManager?.CurrentSceneName;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnScene)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(enemies)){GameLogger.Log("RPG",$"battle not started: scene='{returnScene}', enemies='{enemies}'",LogLevel.Error);return false;}RpgState.Instance.PendingWinFlag=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(winFlag)?null:winFlag.Trim();BattleService.Init(returnScene,enemies.Replace(" ",string.Empty));GameLogger.Log("RPG",$"battle '{enemies}' from '{returnScene}' (win flag: {RpgState.Instance.PendingWinFlag ?? "none"})");Callable.From(()=>sceneManager.SwitchScene(BattleRoute)).CallDeferred();return true;}/// <summary>Applies the pending win flag of the battle that just ended.</summary>
public static void OnBattleEnded(BattleEndedEvent evt){var flag=RpgState.Instance.PendingWinFlag;RpgState.Instance.PendingWinFlag=null;if(flag!=null&&evt?.Result==VictoryResult)ScenarioCondition.SetFlag(flag,"1");}private static SceneManager FindSceneManager(){var tree=Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree;return tree?.Root?.GetNodeOrNull<SceneManager>("SceneManager");}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Saves the player's map position in the rpg mod's slot. The scene itself is saved by the core (the map is the current scene); loading enters that scene and the world reads the position back from <see cref="RpgState"/>. </summary>
public class RpgSaveable:IModSaveable{private const string BlobKey="Position";/// <summary>Writes the position.</summary>
public void OnSave(ModSlot slot){slot.Data[BlobKey]=new DataBlob(1,RpgState.Instance.Data);}/// <summary>Restores the position; a slot without it leaves the player at the spawn.</summary>
public bool OnLoad(ModSlot slot,out string errorMessage){errorMessage=null;RpgState.Instance.Reset();if(slot?.Data!=null&&slot.Data.TryGetValue(BlobKey,out var blob))RpgState.Instance.Data=blob.ReadJson<RpgStateData>()??new RpgStateData();return true;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Session state of the RPG world, outliving the map node: the shell (and with it the world) is rebuilt after every battle, so the position must live here. <para/> The position doubles as the arrival point: a teleport writes the target map and cell, then switches the scene; a map that is entered while <see cref="Data"/> names it starts the player there, any other entry uses the map's spawn. The same rule restores the player after a battle and after loading a save. <para/> <see cref="PendingWinFlag"/> is transient: the flag a running battle sets on victory. It is not saved, because battles cannot be saved mid-way. </summary>
public class RpgState{/// <summary>The session's state.</summary>
public static RpgState Instance{get;}=new();/// <summary>Saved position.</summary>
public RpgStateData Data{get;set;}=new();/// <summary>Story flag set to "1" when the running battle is won; null when none.</summary>
public string PendingWinFlag{get;set;}/// <summary>Stores a position (and the map it is on).</summary>
public void Place(string map,int x,int y,RpgDirection dir){Data=new RpgStateData{Map=map,X=x,Y=y,Dir=dir};}/// <summary>Back to "nowhere": the next map entry uses the spawn.</summary>
public void Reset(){Data=new RpgStateData();PendingWinFlag=null;}}}

using System;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Something standing on a map cell: the player, an NPC, a chest. Drawn either from a charset — 3 frames by 4 facings, rows in <see cref="RpgDirection"/> order, the middle frame is the standing pose — or from one atlas tile. The frame is bottom-aligned and centred on the cell, so taller charsets overlap the cell above like in RPG Maker. <para/> Movement is grid based: <see cref="StepTo"/> starts a step to the next cell, the node slides there at <see cref="TilesPerSecond"/> and then raises <see cref="StepFinished"/>. using System.Text;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Fires a map event. A teleport moves the player natively (no dialog, so a door costs nothing). Anything else becomes one dialog in the shell's dialog box: the event's scenario body followed by its inline commands — the same composition the interactive objects use for click dialogs, so every DSL command, action and condition is available to map events. </summary>
public static class RpgEventRunner{/// <summary>Runs the event; returns false when it has nothing to run or the dialog box is busy.</summary>
public static bool Run(RpgMapEvent mapEvent,string currentMap){if(mapEvent==null)return false;if(mapEvent.Teleport!=null){var target=mapEvent.Teleport;RpgWorldHost.Teleport(new RpgTeleport{Map=string.IsNullOrEmpty(target.Map)?currentMap:target.Map,X=target.X,Y=target.Y,Dir=target.Dir,});return true;}var text=new StringBuilder();if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mapEvent.Scenario)){var body=RpgScenarioSource.ReadBody(mapEvent.Scenario);if(body==null)GameLogger.Log("RPG",$"event '{mapEvent.Id}' on '{currentMap}': scenario '{mapEvent.Scenario}' not found",LogLevel.Error);else text.AppendLine(body);}foreach(var line in mapEvent.Commands??new())text.AppendLine(line);if(text.Length==0)return false;var dialogBox=RpgInput.FindDialogBox();if(dialogBox==null||dialogBox.IsRunning)return false;var dialog=ScenarioParser.Parse(text.ToString());if(dialog?.Queue==null||dialog.Queue.Count==0)return false;GameLogger.Log("RPG",$"event '{mapEvent.Id}' on '{currentMap}'");return dialogBox.SetDialogQueueAndRun(dialog,null,0,null);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Keyboard of the RPG world. Keys are read by their <b>physical</b> position (<see cref="Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed"/>), so WASD and E/F stay where they are on a Russian or any other layout; the arrows work too. <para/> The world must not walk while something else owns the keyboard or the player's attention: a dialog, a toolbar panel (inventory, journal) or a window-like overlay opened by a scenario (a trade window, a workbench), a focused editor window or text field, a paused tree, a scene transition. <see cref="IsWalkBlocked"/> collects those checks in one place. </summary>
public static class RpgInput{/// <summary>The held direction, or null. Vertical keys win over horizontal ones when both are held.</summary>
public static RpgDirection?HeldDirection(){if(Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.W)||Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.Up))return RpgDirection.Up;if(Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.S)||Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.Down))return RpgDirection.Down;if(Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.A)||Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.Left))return RpgDirection.Left;if(Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.D)||Input.IsPhysicalKeyPressed(Key.Right))return RpgDirection.Right;return null;}/// <summary>True for a fresh press of the action key (E or F).</summary>
public static bool IsActionPress(InputEvent@event){return@event is InputEventKey key&&key.Pressed&& !key.Echo&&(key.PhysicalKeycode==Key.E||key.PhysicalKeycode==Key.F);}/// <summary>The shell's dialog box, or null outside the shell.</summary>
public static DialogBox FindDialogBox()=>SceneContextNode.FindNode<DialogBox>("DialogBox");/// <summary>True when the player must not walk or interact right now.</summary>
public static bool IsWalkBlocked(Node node){if(node==null|| !node.IsInsideTree()||node.GetTree().Paused||GodotSceneService.IsTransitioning)return true;if(FindDialogBox()?.IsRunning==true)return true;var viewport=node.GetViewport();var focus=viewport.GuiGetFocusOwner();if(focus is LineEdit||focus is TextEdit)return true;foreach(var window in viewport.GetEmbeddedSubwindows()){if(window.Visible&&window.HasFocus())return true;}return IsPanelOpen();}// Panels and "once" overlays opened on demand are window-like entries on the host layer. private static bool IsPanelOpen(){var host=UiHost.Instance;if(host==null)return false;foreach(var entry in UiRegistry.Entries){if(!UiRegistry.IsPanel(entry)&& !(entry.Once&& !entry.ShowOnStart))continue;if(host.TryGetInstance(entry.Id,out var panel)&&panel.IsVisibleInTree())return true;}return false;}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenarios;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Reads the scenario a map event points to. Event scenarios are not scene scenarios: they have no header (or one that is ignored) and play only when the event fires. The path is relative to the <c>scenarios</c> file group with an optional extension, and the usual file override applies (a dependent mod's file of the same path wins), so the map does not need to know which mod ships the text. </summary>
public static class RpgScenarioSource{private const string Group="scenarios";private const string Extension=".scenario";/// <summary>Scenario body without its header, or null when no mod has the file.</summary>
public static string ReadBody(string path){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))return null;var wanted=path.Replace('\\','/').Trim('/');if(wanted.StartsWith(Group+"/",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))wanted=wanted.Substring(Group.Length+1);if(!wanted.EndsWith(Extension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))wanted+=Extension;foreach(var pair in Files.Collect(Group)){if(!string.Equals(pair.Key,wanted,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var text=ModManager.Instance.ReadFileText(pair.Value.ModId,pair.Value.FullPath);return text==null?null:ScenarioMetadata.ParseMetadata(text).remainingText;}return null;}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg{/// <summary> Turns an <see cref="RpgTileset"/> and its atlas image into a Godot <see cref="TileSet"/> with a single atlas source (id 0), so maps are drawn by <see cref="TileMapLayer"/> — batched, culled, pixel-exact. Atlas index <c>i</c> is atlas coordinate <c>(i % Columns, i / Columns)</c>; the world and the editor both convert through <see cref="AtlasCoords"/>. </summary>
public static class RpgTileSetBuilder{/// <summary>The only atlas source id of a built tile set.</summary>
public const int SourceId=0;/// <summary>Builds the tile set; every whole cell of the image becomes a tile.</summary>
public static TileSet Build(RpgTileset tileset,Texture2D texture){var size=new Vector2I(tileset.TileSize,tileset.TileSize);var tileSet=new TileSet{TileSize=size};var source=new TileSetAtlasSource{Texture=texture,TextureRegionSize=size};var columns=texture.GetWidth()/tileset.TileSize;var rows=texture.GetHeight()/tileset.TileSize;for(var y=0;y<rows;y++){for(var x=0;x<columns;x++)source.CreateTile(new Vector2I(x,y));}tileSet.AddSource(source,SourceId);return tileSet;}/// <summary>Atlas coordinate of a row-major index.</summary>
public static Vector2I AtlasCoords(RpgTileset tileset,int index){var columns=System.Math.Max(1,tileset.Columns);return new Vector2I(index%columns,index/columns);}/// <summary>Number of tiles the image holds.</summary>
public static int TileCount(RpgTileset tileset,Texture2D texture){if(texture==null||tileset.TileSize<=0)return 0;return(texture.GetWidth()/tileset.TileSize)*(texture.GetHeight()/tileset.TileSize);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Games;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg.Tests{/// <summary> Plays the rpg_demo village like a player: key events go through <see cref="Input.ParseInputEvent"/>, so the world reads them exactly as it reads a keyboard (physical keys, held state, unhandled action key). <para/> One step per timer tick; a step either waits (returns without advancing) or checks and moves on. A failed check is recorded and the run goes on; an exception ends it. Result line: <c>[TEST_RESULT] name=rpg_walk passed=N failed=M</c>, exit code 0/1, and a 90 s watchdog. </summary>
public partial class RpgWalkTestDriver:Node{private const float TickSeconds=0.1f;private const float TimeoutSeconds=90f;private const string Village="rpg_village";private const string House="rpg_elder_house";private const string WinFlag="rpg_test_win";private const string SaveSlot="slot_9901";private readonly string shotsDir;private readonly List<string>failures=new();private int passed;private int step;private int waitTicks;private double elapsed;/// <summary>Creates the driver; <paramref name="shotsDir"/> null disables screenshots.</summary>
public RpgWalkTestDriver(string shotsDir){this.shotsDir=shotsDir;Name="RpgWalkTestDriver";var timer=new Timer{WaitTime=TickSeconds,Autostart=true};AddChild(timer);timer.Timeout+=Tick;}private static RpgWorldView View=>RpgWorldHost.Current?.View;private void Tick(){if(step<0)return;elapsed+=TickSeconds;if(elapsed>TimeoutSeconds){Fail($"timeout at step {step}");Finish();return;}try{RunStep();}catch(System.Exception ex){Fail($"step {step}: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");Finish();}}private void RunStep(){switch(step){case 0:if(Boot.IsReady&&View?.Map?.ID==Village)Next();return;case 1:// The intro dialog: the action key advances it.
if(AdvanceDialog())return;Check(GameData.Instance.Runtime.CharacterData.Characters.ContainsKey("rpg_hero"),"party.add put the hero into the party");Check(View.Player.Cell==new Vector2I(15,14),$"player at the spawn (15,14), got {View.Player.Cell}");CheckActionTexts();Shot("village");Press(Key.W,true);Next();return;case 2:if(View.Player.Cell.Y>12)return;Press(Key.W,false);Next();return;case 3:if(View.Player.IsMoving)return;Check(View.Player.Cell.X==15&&View.Player.Cell.Y<=12,$"W walked up the path, at {View.Player.Cell}");Check(RpgState.Instance.Data.Map==Village&&RpgState.Instance.Data.Y==View.Player.Cell.Y,"the position is stored after the step");View.PlacePlayer(14,11,RpgDirection.Up);Press(Key.S,true);Next();return;case 4:if(++waitTicks<4)return;Press(Key.S,false);Check(View.Player.Cell==new Vector2I(14,11),$"the well blocks the way, at {View.Player.Cell}");Check(View.Player.Facing==RpgDirection.Down,"a blocked key still turns the player");Next();return;case 5:// The S release is read on the next frame; placing the player before it would let the still-held key walk them away.
View.PlacePlayer(16,12,RpgDirection.Up);Tap(Key.E);Next();return;case 6:Check(RpgInput.FindDialogBox()?.IsRunning==true,"E on the sign opens a dialog");Next();return;case 7:if(AdvanceDialog())return;View.PlacePlayer(10,10,RpgDirection.Left);Tap(Key.F);Next();return;case 8:Check(RpgInput.FindDialogBox()?.IsRunning==true,"F talks to the villager");Check(View.FindEvent("villager")?.Facing==RpgDirection.Right,"the villager turns to the player");Next();return;case 9:if(AdvanceDialog())return;View.PlacePlayer(6,7,RpgDirection.Up);Press(Key.W,true);Next();return;case 10:if(!View.Player.IsMoving&&View.Map.ID==Village)return;Press(Key.W,false);Next();return;case 11:if(View?.Map?.ID!=House)return;if(AdvanceDialog())return;Check(View.Player.Cell==new Vector2I(6,8),$"the door teleports into the house at (6,8), got {View.Player.Cell}");Check(View.FindEvent("elder_quest")?.Visible==true&&View.FindEvent("elder_thanks")?.Visible==false,"before the wolf the elder gives the quest");Shot("house");ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("rpg_wolf_dead","1");Next();return;case 12:Check(View.FindEvent("elder_quest")?.Visible==false&&View.FindEvent("elder_thanks")?.Visible==true,"a story flag swaps the elder's events at once");ScenarioCondition.SetFlag("rpg_wolf_dead","0");Check(RpgBattleService.Start("rpg_slime",WinFlag),"a battle starts from the map");Godot.Engine.TimeScale=4;Next();return;case 13:if(GetTree().CurrentScene is not BattleSceneContext battle)return;// The core's auto turn only passes, so the hero would lose: once the core waits for the player, take the platform's victory path.
if(battle.ActiveBattleCore is not IBattleAutoPlayable auto|| !auto.IsWaitingForPlayerInput)return;// The shot waits for the fade-in too, otherwise it catches the blank transition.
if(GodotSceneService.IsTransitioning)return;Shot("battle");battle.ShowWinground();Next();return;case 14:if(GetTree().Root.FindChild("ContinueButton",true,false)is not Button button|| !button.IsVisibleInTree())return;Shot("victory");button.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed);Next();return;case 15:if(View?.Map?.ID!=House||GodotSceneService.IsTransitioning)return;Godot.Engine.TimeScale=1;Check(View.Player.Cell==new Vector2I(6,8),$"the battle returns to the same cell, got {View.Player.Cell}");Check(GameData.Instance.Runtime.Flags.TryGetValue(WinFlag,out var won)&&won=="1","the win flag is set after the victory");// The menu's path: save in the game, go to the main menu, load.
SaveService.Save(SaveSlot);GameSession.OpenMainMenu(GetTree());Next();return;case 16:if(RpgWorldHost.Current!=null|| ++waitTicks<5)return;Check(GameSession.LoadAndEnter(this,SaveSlot),"the save loads");Next();return;case 17:if(View?.Map?.ID!=House||GodotSceneService.IsTransitioning|| ++waitTicks<5)return;Shot("loaded");var dialog=RpgInput.FindDialogBox();Check(dialog!=null&& !dialog.IsRunning&& !dialog.IsVisibleInTree(),$"no dialog box after loading (running={dialog?.IsRunning}, visible={dialog?.IsVisibleInTree()})");Check(View.Player.Cell==new Vector2I(6,8),$"the loaded game puts the player on the saved cell, got {View.Player.Cell}");SaveService.DeleteSave(SaveSlot);Finish();return;}}/// <summary> The battle shows the names and descriptions of the hero's action cards: their keys must be translated by a mod of this game, not only by another game's content mod. </summary>
private void CheckActionTexts(){var hero=CharacterFactory.Instance.Get("rpg_hero");Check(hero?.Actions?.Count>0,"the hero has action cards");foreach(var action in hero?.Actions??new List<ActionCharacter>()){foreach(var key in new[]{action.Name,action.Description})Check(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)&&TranslationServer.Translate(key)!=key,$"action text '{key}' is translated");}}/// <summary>Advances a running dialog with the action key; true while it is still running.</summary>
private bool AdvanceDialog(){var box=RpgInput.FindDialogBox();if(box==null|| !box.IsRunning)return false;Tap(Key.E);return true;}private static void Press(Key key,bool pressed){Input.ParseInputEvent(new InputEventKey{PhysicalKeycode=key,Keycode=key,Pressed=pressed});}private static void Tap(Key key){Press(key,true);Press(key,false);}private void Next(){step++;waitTicks=0;}private void Check(bool condition,string what){if(condition){passed++;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[PASS] {what}");}else{Fail(what);}}private void Fail(string what){failures.Add(what);GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[FAIL] {what}",LogLevel.Error);}private void Shot(string name){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(shotsDir)||DisplayServer.GetName()=="headless")return;DirAccess.MakeDirRecursiveAbsolute(shotsDir);ViewportCapture.SavePng(GetViewport(),shotsDir.TrimEnd('/')+"/rpg_"+name+".png");}private void Finish(){step= -1;Godot.Engine.TimeScale=1;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"[TEST_RESULT] name=rpg_walk passed={passed} failed={failures.Count}");GetTree().Quit(failures.Count==0?0:1);}}}

using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Rpg.Tests{/// <summary> Entry point of the rpg_walk integration test: adds the driver to the tree root when the exact flag <c>--itest=rpg_walk</c> is given (the driver quits the process, so it must never run in another test). Optional <c>--shots=&lt;dir&gt;</c> makes the driver save screenshots. </summary>
public class RpgWalkTestInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool driverQueued;/// <summary>Nothing per mod.</summary>

public void OnModResourcesReady(){var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();if(driverQueued|| !args.Any(a=>a=="--itest=rpg_walk"))return;driverQueued=true;var shots=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--shots=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--shots=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"RpgWalkTestInitializer: activating rpg_walk, shots={shots ?? using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Cthangover.Mods.Rpg;namespace Cthangover.Tools.RpgEditor{/// <summary> The map being edited, free of any UI: the <see cref="RpgMap"/> with its cells parsed into an <see cref="RpgMapGrid"/>, the edit operations of the window and an undo history. <para/> Undo works on whole states: before an edit the window calls <see cref="BeginChange"/>, which stores the grid and the map's other data (events, spawn, size…) as JSON. A paint stroke is one change, however many cells it touches. The grid is the only source of the cells while editing; <see cref="ToJson"/> writes it back into the map rows. </summary>
public class RpgMapDocument{private const int HistoryLimit=200;private readonly List<RpgMapSnapshot>undo=new();private readonly List<RpgMapSnapshot>redo=new();/// <summary>Map data (events, spawn, encounters…); its layer rows are stale until <see cref="ToJson"/>.</summary>
public RpgMap Map{get;private set;}/// <summary>The cells.</summary>
public RpgMapGrid Grid{get;private set;}/// <summary>True when there is a step to undo.</summary>
public bool CanUndo=>undo.Count>0;/// <summary>True when there is a step to redo.</summary>
public bool CanRedo=>redo.Count>0;private RpgMapDocument(RpgMap map){Map=map;Map.Events??=new List<RpgMapEvent>();Map.Spawn??=new RpgTeleport();Grid=RpgMapGrid.Parse(map);}/// <summary> A new map filled with one ground tile, its id taken from the file name. The spawn is the centre, so a fresh map is playable at once. </summary>
public static RpgMapDocument Create(string id,string tileset,int width,int height,int groundTile){var map=new RpgMap{ID=id,Tileset=tileset,Width=width,Height=height};var document=new RpgMapDocument(map);for(var y=0;y<document.Grid.Height;y++){for(var x=0;x<document.Grid.Width;x++)document.Grid.SetTile(RpgLayer.Back,x,y,groundTile);}map.Spawn=new RpgTeleport{X=document.Grid.Width/2,Y=document.Grid.Height/2};return document;}/// <summary> Reads a map file (<c>{"Kind":"rpg_map","Items":[…]}</c>, the first item). Throws <see cref="JsonException"/> on broken JSON and <see cref="InvalidOperationException"/> on a file without maps, so the window can show the reason instead of opening an empty map. </summary>
public static RpgMapDocument Load(string json){var data=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FileData<RpgMap>>(json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);var map=data?.Items?.FirstOrDefault()??throw new InvalidOperationException("the file has no rpg_map item");return new RpgMapDocument(map);}/// <summary>The map file text: cells written into rows, nulls left out, indented.</summary>
public string ToJson(){Grid.WriteTo(Map);var data=new FileData<RpgMap>{Kind="rpg_map",Items=new List<RpgMap>{Map}};return JsonSerializer.Serialize(data,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedIgnoreNullOptions);}/// <summary>Remembers the current state as one undo step and forgets the redo branch.</summary>
public void BeginChange(){undo.Add(Snapshot());if(undo.Count>HistoryLimit)undo.RemoveAt(0);redo.Clear();}/// <summary>Steps back; false when there is nothing to undo.</summary>
public bool Undo()=>Swap(undo,redo);/// <summary>Steps forward again; false when there is nothing to redo.</summary>
public bool Redo()=>Swap(redo,undo);/// <summary>Writes a tile (-1 clears) or a collision code into one cell. Returns true when the cell changed.</summary>
public bool Paint(RpgEditLayer layer,int x,int y,int tile,char collision){if(!Grid.InBounds(x,y))return false;if(layer==RpgEditLayer.Collision){if(Grid.GetCollision(x,y)==collision)return false;Grid.SetCollision(x,y,collision);return true;}if(layer==RpgEditLayer.Events||Grid.GetTile((RpgLayer)layer,x,y)==tile)return false;Grid.SetTile((RpgLayer)layer,x,y,tile);return true;}/// <summary> Flood-fills (4-neighbourhood) the area of cells equal to the start cell with a tile or a collision code. Returns the number of cells changed. </summary>
public int Fill(RpgEditLayer layer,int x,int y,int tile,char collision){if(!Grid.InBounds(x,y)||layer==RpgEditLayer.Events)return 0;var target=Read(layer,x,y);var replacement=layer==RpgEditLayer.Collision?collision:tile;if(target==replacement)return 0;var changed=0;var stack=new Stack<(int X,int Y)>();stack.Push((x,y));while(stack.Count>0){var(cx,cy)=stack.Pop();if(!Grid.InBounds(cx,cy)||Read(layer,cx,cy)!=target)continue;Paint(layer,cx,cy,tile,collision);changed++;stack.Push((cx+1,cy));stack.Push((cx-1,cy));stack.Push((cx,cy+1));stack.Push((cx,cy-1));}return changed;}/// <summary>The events on a cell, top-most (last) first.</summary>
public List<RpgMapEvent>EventsAt(int x,int y){var found=Map.Events.Where(e=>e.X==x&&e.Y==y).ToList();found.Reverse();return found;}/// <summary>Adds an action event with a fresh id (<c>event_N</c>) on a cell and returns it.</summary>
public RpgMapEvent AddEvent(int x,int y){var number=1;while(Map.Events.Any(e=>string.Equals(e.Id,"event_"+number,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))number++;var mapEvent=new RpgMapEvent{Id="event_"+number,X=x,Y=y};Map.Events.Add(mapEvent);return mapEvent;}/// <summary>Removes an event; false when it is not on this map.</summary>
public bool RemoveEvent(RpgMapEvent mapEvent)=>Map.Events.Remove(mapEvent);/// <summary>Changes the map size; events left outside are moved to the nearest edge cell.</summary>
public void Resize(int width,int height){Grid.Resize(width,height);foreach(var mapEvent in Map.Events){mapEvent.X=Math.Clamp(mapEvent.X,0,Grid.Width-1);mapEvent.Y=Math.Clamp(mapEvent.Y,0,Grid.Height-1);}Map.Spawn.X=Math.Clamp(Map.Spawn.X,0,Grid.Width-1);Map.Spawn.Y=Math.Clamp(Map.Spawn.Y,0,Grid.Height-1);}/// <summary> Problems that would make the map misbehave in the game, as locale keys with an argument; empty when the map can be saved. </summary>
public List<(string Key,string Argument)>Validate(){var problems=new List<(string,string)>();if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Map.Tileset))problems.Add(("tools/rpg_editor/problem_tileset",Map.ID));foreach(var mapEvent in Map.Events){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mapEvent.Id))problems.Add(("tools/rpg_editor/problem_event_id",$"{mapEvent.X},{mapEvent.Y}"));}foreach(var group in Map.Events.Where(e=> !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(e.Id)).GroupBy(e=>e.Id,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){if(group.Count()>1)problems.Add(("tools/rpg_editor/problem_event_duplicate",group.Key));}return problems;}private int Read(RpgEditLayer layer,int x,int y){return layer==RpgEditLayer.Collision?Grid.GetCollision(x,y):Grid.GetTile((RpgLayer)layer,x,y);}private RpgMapSnapshot Snapshot(){return new RpgMapSnapshot(Grid.Clone(),JsonSerializer.Serialize(Map));}private bool Swap(List<RpgMapSnapshot>from,List<RpgMapSnapshot>to){if(from.Count==0)return false;to.Add(Snapshot());var state=from[^1];from.RemoveAt(from.Count-1);Grid=state.Grid.Clone();Map=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<RpgMap>(state.MapJson);return true;}}}

protected override bool HandleKey(InputEventKey key){if(key.CtrlPressed&&key.Keycode==Key.Z){if(key.ShiftPressed)Redo();else Undo();return true;}if(key.CtrlPressed&&key.Keycode==Key.Y){Redo();return true;}if(key.CtrlPressed||key.AltPressed)return false;switch(key.Keycode){case Key.Key1:SelectLayer(RpgEditLayer.Back);return true;case Key.Key2:SelectLayer(RpgEditLayer.Main);return true;case Key.Key3:SelectLayer(RpgEditLayer.Front);return true;case Key.Key4:SelectLayer(RpgEditLayer.Collision);return true;case Key.Key5:SelectLayer(RpgEditLayer.Events);return true;case Key.B:SelectTool(RpgEditTool.Pencil);return true;case Key.E:SelectTool(RpgEditTool.Eraser);return true;case Key.G:SelectTool(RpgEditTool.Fill);return true;case Key.Delete:DeleteSelectedEvent();return true;}return false;}}}

===== FILE mods/scenario_studio/src/Model/StudioMoment.cs =====
namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;/// <summary> What the novice mode shows instead of a listing: the line on screen now (<see cref="Say"/>), the lines said right before it, and — for a question — every answer with the place it leads to. Service lines (lights, labels, <c>end</c>) never appear; an answer's <c>-&gt; :label</c> is followed to the first meaningful line after the label (through <c>goto</c> hops), so <c>option → :exit → switch_scene</c> reads as "goes to the scene". An answer without a target or with a missing label is <see cref="StudioOutcomeKind.Broken"/>. When no dialog runs, the moment is the scenario's first line or question. </summary>
public sealed class StudioMoment{public StudioCodeLine Say{get;private set;}public List<StudioCodeLine>Before{get;}=new();public List<StudioBranch>Branches{get;}=new();public bool IsQuestion=>Say!=null&&Say.Kind==StudioLineKind.Choice;public static StudioMoment Build(StudioSession session){var moment=new StudioMoment();var lines=session.Lines;var index=FindAnchor(lines,session.CurrentIndex);if(index<0)return moment;moment.Say=lines[index];for(var i=index-1;i>=0&&lines[i].Kind==StudioLineKind.Line;i--)moment.Before.Insert(0,lines[i]);if(!moment.IsQuestion)return moment;for(var next=index+1;next<lines.Count&&lines[next].Kind==StudioLineKind.Option;next++)moment.Branches.Add(Resolve(lines,lines[next]));return moment;}private static int FindAnchor(List<StudioCodeLine>lines,int current){if(current<0)current=0;if(lines.Count==0)return-1;if(lines[current].Kind==StudioLineKind.Option){for(var i=current;i>=0;i--){if(lines[i].Kind==StudioLineKind.Choice)return i;}return-1;}for(var i=current;i<lines.Count;i++){if(lines[i].Kind==StudioLineKind.Line||lines[i].Kind==StudioLineKind.Choice)return i;}return-1;}private static StudioBranch Resolve(List<StudioCodeLine>lines,StudioCodeLine option){var branch=new StudioBranch{Line=option,Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.Broken};var label=string.IsNullOrEmpty(option.Target)? -1:FindLabel(lines,option.Target);if(label<0)return branch;var hops=0;for(var i=label+1;i<lines.Count;i++){var line=lines[i];switch(line.Kind){case StudioLineKind.Goto:i=string.IsNullOrEmpty(line.Target)? -1:FindLabel(lines,line.Target);if(i<0|| ++hops>8)return branch;continue;case StudioLineKind.Jump:branch.Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.Scene;branch.Target=line.Target;return branch;case StudioLineKind.Action:branch.Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.Action;branch.Target=line.Target;return branch;case StudioLineKind.End:branch.Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.End;return branch;case StudioLineKind.Line:case StudioLineKind.Choice:branch.Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.Continue;return branch;}}branch.Kind=StudioOutcomeKind.End;return branch;}private static int FindLabel(List<StudioCodeLine>lines,string name){for(var i=0;i<lines.Count;i++){if(lines[i].Kind==StudioLineKind.Label&&lines[i].Target==name)return i;}return-1;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;/// <summary> Everything the dock shows at one moment, built by <see cref="StudioSessionBuilder"/> from the live game: where the player is (scene, scenario, label), the run state, which mod owns the scenario and where edits go, the scenario lines (with pending edits) and debugger marks, the scene candidates, game state, the log and the scene map. A plain view model: pages render it and never change the game through it. </summary>
public sealed class StudioSession{public string SceneName{get;set;}public string ScenarioName{get;set;}/// <summary>Label the current line belongs to; null before the first label.</summary>
public string LabelName{get;set;}public StudioRunState RunState{get;set;}/// <summary>Mod (or layer) that owns the open scenario file; null without a scenario.</summary>
public StudioModScope FileScope{get;set;}/// <summary>Where edits are written: the file's own folder mod, or the studio layer.</summary>
public StudioModScope EditScope{get;set;}/// <summary>Unapplied edits of the open scenario.</summary>
public int PendingCount{get;set;}public List<StudioCodeLine>Lines{get;}=new();public List<StudioCandidate>Candidates{get;}=new();public List<StudioStateEntry>State{get;}=new();public List<StudioLogEntry>Log{get;}=new();public List<StudioSceneNode>Nodes{get;}=new();public bool HasScenario=> !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ScenarioName);/// <summary>Index of the line the dialog stands on, or -1.</summary>
public int CurrentIndex=>Lines.FindIndex(IsCurrentLine);/// <summary> Line index (into the scenario text, 0-based) where "insert after the current line" puts a line: right after it, or after the whole answer list of a question — a line between <c>select</c> and its options would cut the question short in the parser. Without a current line: the end. </summary>
public int InsertionTextIndexAfterCurrent(){var index=CurrentIndex;if(index<0)return Lines.Count==0?0:Lines[^1].Number;var at=index;if(Lines[index].Kind==StudioLineKind.Choice){while(at+1<Lines.Count&&Lines[at+1].Kind==StudioLineKind.Option)at++;}return Lines[at].Number;}private static bool IsCurrentLine(StudioCodeLine line)=>line.IsCurrent;}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Player-facing text of the studio model kept as a localization key plus format arguments and translated only when shown, so the dock follows a language switch and no prose lives in code. Arguments may themselves be <see cref="StudioText"/> (e.g. a scenario's own <c>key=</c> inside a studio phrase) and are resolved recursively; plain arguments are data — scene, scenario, mod and quest ids, numbers. <see cref="Raw"/> wraps such data where a text is expected. </summary>
public sealed class StudioText{private readonly string _raw;public string Key{get;}public object[]Args{get;}public StudioText(string key,params object[]args){Key=key;Args=args??System.Array.Empty<object>();}private StudioText(string raw,bool _){_raw=raw;Args=System.Array.Empty<object>();}/// <summary>Untranslated data (an id or a number) used where a text is expected.</summary>
public static StudioText Raw(string value)=>new(value,true);public string Resolve(){if(Key==null)return _raw??string.Empty;var format=TranslationServer.Translate(Key).ToString();if(Args.Length==0)return format;var resolved=new object[Args.Length];for(var i=0;i<Args.Length;i++)resolved[i]=Args[i]is StudioText text?text.Resolve():Args[i];try{return string.Format(format,resolved);}catch(System.FormatException){GameLogger.Log("UI",$"Scenario studio: '{Key}' expects other arguments than {Args.Length}",LogLevel.Warning);return format;}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;using Godot;/// <summary> "Log" tab: what happened, newest last — scene entries, skipped scenarios with the reason, scenario starts and ends, stops and studio edits. Skips are tinted as warnings because they are the usual answer to "nothing happened". </summary>

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;using Cthangover.Core.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI;using Godot;/// <summary> Backgrounds as the studio offers them: ids of the <c>backgrounds</c> file group of every mod and of the studio layer (the layer wins, see <see cref="FileListResolver"/>), without the <c>_depth</c>/<c>_albedo</c> lighting maps that belong to a background. <para/> The author drops a picture into a folder mod or into the layer while the game runs; both the file list of the group and the texture cache of <see cref="BackgroundFactory"/> were filled before, so <see cref="Reload"/> drops both and shows the current background again — a replaced picture (or its depth map) is visible at once, a new one can be picked for a scene. </summary>
public static class StudioBackgrounds{private const string DepthSuffix="_depth";private const string AlbedoSuffix="_albedo";/// <summary>Background ids (group-relative paths without extension), sorted.</summary>
public static List<string>Ids(){var ids=new List<string>();var files=Files.Collect(BackgroundFactory.Instance.GroupName);if(files==null)return ids;var seen=new HashSet<string>();foreach(var key in files.Keys){if(!IsTexture(key))continue;var id=key.Substring(0,key.Length-Path.GetExtension(key).Length);if(!id.EndsWith(DepthSuffix,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&& !id.EndsWith(AlbedoSuffix,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&seen.Add(id))ids.Add(id);}ids.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);return ids;}/// <summary>The mod (or the layer) whose file the background <paramref name="id"/> is read from; null when unknown.</summary>
public static string SourceOf(string id){var files=Files.Collect(BackgroundFactory.Instance.GroupName);if(files==null)return null;foreach(var extension in ModConfig.Instance.TextureExtensions){if(files.TryGetValue(id+extension,out var entry))return entry.ModId;}return null;}/// <summary> Re-reads the background files: drops the collected file lists and the cached background textures, then puts the current background and its lighting maps on screen again from the files as they are now. </summary>
public static void Reload(){ModManager.Instance.GetResolver<FileListResolver>()?.ClearCache();BackgroundFactory.Instance.Clear();var id=SceneContextNode.LastBackgroundID;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))return;var view=SceneContextNode.FindNode<Node>("ViewBox")as IBackgroundView;var texture=BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(id);if(view==null||texture==null)return;view.SetBackgroundTexture(texture);LightingBridge.SetupBackgroundMaps(BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(id+DepthSuffix),BackgroundFactory.Instance.Get(id+AlbedoSuffix));}private static bool IsTexture(string key){var extension=Path.GetExtension(key);foreach(var known in ModConfig.Instance.TextureExtensions){if(string.Equals(known,extension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return true;}return false;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Action;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Executable;/// <summary> The studio's <see cref="IDialogDebugger"/>: pause, step and breakpoints for scenario dialogs. Only dialogs shown in the <see cref="DialogBox"/> with a <see cref="ScenarioEvent"/> as locker are held — standalone runtimes (hover commands) and click dialogs cannot be resumed and always run through. Breakpoints are keyed by scenario name, the identity that survives an edit moving the file into the studio layer. <para/> "Pause" holds the dialog before the next action; "continue" and "step" let exactly one action pass the hold (<c>allowOnce</c>), step then holds again. The first action of every new scenario event raises <see cref="ScenarioStarted"/> before anything runs, which is when the rollback snapshot is taken. </summary>
public sealed class StudioDebugger:IDialogDebugger{private readonly Dictionary<string,HashSet<int>>_breakpoints=new();private readonly HashSet<int>_executed=new();private int _allowOnce;/// <summary>The scenario event the debugger last saw run.</summary>
public ScenarioEvent Event{get;private set;}public bool IsPaused{get;private set;}/// <summary>Scenario line the dialog is held at, 0 when not held.</summary>
public int HeldLine{get;private set;}/// <summary>Raised before the first action of a new scenario event runs.</summary>
public event Action<ScenarioEvent>ScenarioStarted;/// <summary>Raised when the dialog is held at a line (pause or breakpoint).</summary>
public event Action<int,bool>Held;/// <summary>Raised after any change worth redrawing (an action ran, a hold, a toggle).</summary>
public event Action Changed;public bool ShouldHold(DialogRuntime runtime,IActionCommand action){if(runtime.DialogBox==null||runtime.DialogBox.Locker is not ScenarioEvent scenario)return false;if(scenario!=Event){Event=scenario;_executed.Clear();HeldLine=0;ScenarioStarted?.Invoke(scenario);}if(_allowOnce>0){_allowOnce--;return Pass(action);}var breakpoint=action.SourceLine>0&&HasBreakpoint(scenario.ID,action.SourceLine);if(!IsPaused&& !breakpoint)return Pass(action);IsPaused=true;HeldLine=action.SourceLine;Held?.Invoke(action.SourceLine,breakpoint);Changed?.Invoke();return true;}public bool IsExecuted(int line)=>_executed.Contains(line);public bool HasBreakpoint(string scenario,int line)=>scenario!=null&&_breakpoints.TryGetValue(scenario,out var lines)&&lines.Contains(line);public void ToggleBreakpoint(string scenario,int line){if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(scenario))return;if(!_breakpoints.TryGetValue(scenario,out var lines))_breakpoints[scenario]=lines=new HashSet<int>();if(!lines.Remove(line))lines.Add(line);Changed?.Invoke();}/// <summary>Turns pause on: the next action of a scenario dialog will be held.</summary>
public void Pause(){IsPaused=true;Changed?.Invoke();}/// <summary> Turns pause off and lets the held action run (<paramref name="box"/> resumes it); without a hold it only clears the pause. </summary>
public void Continue(DialogBox box){IsPaused=false;ReleaseHold(box);Changed?.Invoke();}/// <summary> Runs exactly one action and holds before the next. When the dialog is not held but waits for a click, the click is made for the user. </summary>
public void Step(DialogBox box){IsPaused=true;if(box==null|| !box.IsRunning)return;if(box.Runtime.IsHeld){ReleaseHold(box);}else if(!box.IsWaitingAnswer){_allowOnce=1;box.NextAction();}Changed?.Invoke();}/// <summary> "Set next statement" of an IDE: the action of scenario line <paramref name="line"/> becomes the next one to run and the dialog is held before it in pause, whether it was held, waited for a click or for an answer. Skipped and re-run lines change nothing in the game state on their own. False when the line has no action in the queue of the running dialog (a comment, an answer, a line added in the studio). </summary>

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Godot;/// <summary> What happened in the session, for the "Log", "Scene" and "Map" tabs: log entries (scene entries, skipped candidates with the reason, scenario starts and ends, breakpoints, studio edits), the order of visited scenes and the last composition report of every scene. public sealed class StudioJournal{private const int MaxEntries=300;private readonly ulong _startMsec=Time.GetTicksMsec();private readonly Dictionary<string,SceneComposedEvent>_composed=new();public List<StudioLogEntry>Entries{get;}=new();/// <summary>Scenes in the order they were entered (repeats included).</summary>
public List<string>SceneHistory{get;}=new();public void Add(StudioLogCategory category,StudioText text,bool warning=false){Entries.Add(new StudioLogEntry{Time=Now(),Category=category,Text=text,IsWarning=warning});if(Entries.Count>MaxEntries)Entries.RemoveAt(0);}/// <summary>Last composition report of <paramref name="scene"/>, or null.</summary>

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;/// <summary> Reads scenario text into <see cref="StudioCodeLine"/>s for the dock: one entry per non-empty line, numbered like the parser numbers <c>SourceLine</c> (1-based, header included), classified by command with the player-visible text (<see cref="StudioCodeLine.Say"/>: the literal, or the line's own <c>key=</c> translated when shown) and the line's target. Lines are split by <see cref="ScenarioParser.SplitLine"/> so the dock never disagrees with the engine; on top of the parser it reports what the parser silently skips — unknown commands, answers and jumps to missing labels. </summary>
public static class StudioLineReader{public static List<StudioCodeLine>Read(string text){var result=new List<StudioCodeLine>();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return result;var lines=text.Replace("\r\n","\n").Split('\n');var headerEnd=HeaderEnd(lines);var labels=new HashSet<string>();for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){var trimmed=lines[i].Trim();if(trimmed.Length==0)continue;var line=new StudioCodeLine{Number=i+1,Text=lines[i].TrimEnd()};if(i<=headerEnd)line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Header;else Classify(line,trimmed);if(line.Kind==StudioLineKind.Label)labels.Add(line.Target);result.Add(line);}foreach(var line in result)CheckTarget(line,labels);return result;}private static int HeaderEnd(string[]lines){for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){if(lines[i].Trim()=="---")return i;}return-1;}private static void Classify(StudioCodeLine line,string trimmed){if(trimmed.StartsWith('#')){line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Comment;return;}if(trimmed.StartsWith(':')){line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Label;line.Target=trimmed.Substring(1).Trim();return;}var positional=new List<string>();var named=new Dictionary<string,string>();var cmd=ScenarioParser.SplitLine(trimmed,positional,named,out var arrow);switch(cmd){case"text":case"ptext":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Line;line.Say=SayOf(positional,named);return;case"select":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Choice;line.Say=SayOf(positional,named);return;case"option":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Option;line.Say=SayOf(positional,named);line.Target=OptionTarget(positional,named,arrow);return;case"goto":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Goto;line.Target= !string.IsNullOrEmpty(arrow)?arrow:named.GetValueOrDefault("target");return;case"switch_scene":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Jump;line.Target=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:null;return;case"action":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Action;line.Target=positional.Count>0?positional[0]:null;return;case"end":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.End;return;case"light_set":case"light_use_time":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Light;return;case"background":case"foreground":line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Background;return;}line.Kind=StudioLineKind.Command;if(cmd!=null&&ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.Get(cmd)==null)line.Error=new StudioText("studio/error_unknown_command",cmd);}private static StudioText SayOf(List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named){if(named.TryGetValue("key",out var key)&& !string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))return new StudioText(key);return positional.Count>0?StudioText.Raw(positional[0]):null;}private static string OptionTarget(List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrow){if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(arrow))return arrow;if(named.TryGetValue("goto",out var target))return target;return positional.Count>1&&positional[1].StartsWith(':')?positional[1].TrimStart(':'):null;}private static void CheckTarget(StudioCodeLine line,HashSet<string>labels){if(line.Kind!=StudioLineKind.Option&&line.Kind!=StudioLineKind.Goto)return;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(line.Target))line.Error??=new StudioText("studio/error_no_target");else if(!labels.Contains(line.Target))line.Error??=new StudioText("studio/error_label_missing",":"+line.Target);}}}

public StudioAssetReload ReloadAssets(){var before=new HashSet<string>(StudioBackgrounds.Ids());StudioBackgrounds.Reload();var result=new StudioAssetReload();foreach(var id in StudioBackgrounds.Ids()){result.Total++;if(!before.Contains(id))result.Added.Add(id);}Journal.Add(StudioLogCategory.Edit,new StudioText("studio/log_text_assets_reloaded",result.Total,result.Added.Count));GameLogger.Log("UI",$"Scenario studio: backgrounds re-read, {result.Total} in total, new: [{string.Join(", ", result.Added)}]");Touch();return result;}/// <summary>Exports the layer as mod <paramref name="modId"/>; null on a bad id.</summary>

public void EditState(StudioStateEntry entry,string value){switch(entry.Editor){case StudioStateEditor.DialogVariable:Box?.Runtime.SetVariable(entry.Id,value);break;case StudioStateEditor.Inventory:var inventory=GameData.Instance?.Runtime.Inventory;if(inventory==null|| !int.TryParse(value,out var count)||count<0)return;var delta=count-inventory.CheckCount(entry.Id);if(delta>0)inventory.Add(entry.Id,delta);else if(delta<0)inventory.Remove(entry.Id,-delta);break;case StudioStateEditor.Quest:QuestServiceRegistry.Provider?.SetStatus(entry.Id,value);break;default:return;}Journal.Add(StudioLogCategory.Edit,new StudioText("studio/log_text_state",entry.Id,value));Touch();}// ── bus and debugger callbacks ─────────────────────────────

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Godot;/// <summary> The DSL the dock writes. New lines are written in the current language as literals (what an author would type; the locale atlas convention for scenario text). Edits rewrite one line through <see cref="ScenarioParser.SplitLine"/> and keep its other arguments, so changing an answer's text does not lose its target and vice versa; a literal replaces a <c>key=</c>, because the new text is no longer the translated one. </summary>
public static class StudioScriptEdits{public static string NewLine()=>"text "+Quote(Tr("studio/new_line_text"));public static string NewQuestion()=>"select "+Quote(Tr("studio/new_choice_text"));public static string NewAnswer()=>"option "+Quote(Tr("studio/new_option_text"));public static string Jump(string scene)=>"switch_scene "+scene;/// <summary><paramref name="line"/> with its player-visible text replaced by <paramref name="text"/>.</summary>
public static string WithSay(string line,string text){var positional=new List<string>();var named=new Dictionary<string,string>();var cmd=ScenarioParser.SplitLine(line.Trim(),positional,named,out var arrow);if(cmd==null)return line;named.Remove("key");if(positional.Count>0)positional[0]=text;else positional.Insert(0,text);return Indent(line)+Compose(cmd,positional,named,arrow);}/// <summary><paramref name="line"/> (an answer or goto) pointing at label <paramref name="label"/>.</summary>
public static string WithTarget(string line,string label){var positional=new List<string>();var named=new Dictionary<string,string>();var cmd=ScenarioParser.SplitLine(line.Trim(),positional,named,out _);if(cmd==null)return line;named.Remove("goto");named.Remove("target");if(positional.Count>1&&positional[1].StartsWith(':'))positional.RemoveAt(1);return Indent(line)+Compose(cmd,positional,named,label);}/// <summary> Makes sure the scenario has a label block that leads to scene <paramref name="scene"/> (<c>:to_scene</c> → <c>switch_scene</c> → <c>end</c>), appending it at the end when missing; returns the label name. </summary>
public static string EnsureSceneExit(StudioWorkingCopy copy,string scene){var label="to_"+scene;if(copy.FindLabel(label)<0)copy.Append("",":"+label,Jump(scene),"end");return label;}/// <summary>Makes sure the scenario has a label that just ends it; returns the label name.</summary>
public static string EnsureEnd(StudioWorkingCopy copy){const string label="finish";if(copy.FindLabel(label)<0)copy.Append("",":"+label,"end");return label;}public static string Quote(string text)=>"\""+(text??string.Empty).Replace("\"","\\\"")+"\"";private static string Compose(string cmd,List<string>positional,Dictionary<string,string>named,string arrow){var result=new StringBuilder(cmd);var sayCommand=cmd=="text"||cmd=="ptext"||cmd=="select"||cmd=="option";for(var i=0;i<positional.Count;i++){var value=positional[i];result.Append(' ').Append((i==0&&sayCommand)||NeedsQuotes(value)?Quote(value):value);}foreach(var pair in named)result.Append(' ').Append(pair.Key).Append('=').Append(pair.Value);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(arrow))result.Append(" -> :").Append(arrow);return result.ToString();}private static bool NeedsQuotes(string value)=>value.Length==0||value.Contains(' ')||value.Contains('"')||value.Contains('=');private static string Indent(string line)=>line.Substring(0,line.Length-line.TrimStart().Length);private static string Tr(string key)=>TranslationServer.Translate(key).ToString();}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;/// <summary> Game state at the moment a scenario started: a full save package (<see cref="SaveService.BuildPackage"/>) kept serialized in memory, plus the scenario and scene it belongs to. It is kept as JSON because applying a package may reuse its slots, and one snapshot is restored again and again while a scenario is being polished. </summary>

public bool Restore(){var package=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SavePackage>(_json,JsonOptionsProvider.ReadOptions);return package!=null&&SaveService.ApplyPackage(package,"studio snapshot of "+ScenarioName);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Collections.Generic;/// <summary> Unapplied edits of one scenario: its text as lines plus which lines were added or changed since the copy was taken. Every dock edit (insert, edit a line's text, choose an answer's target, edit the whole text) goes here first and reaches the game only on Apply, so an author can prepare several changes and replay them at once. Every line remembers its number in the original text (0 for added lines): the running dialog's actions carry original numbers, so the debugger's marks and breakpoints are mapped through it while edits shift the displayed numbering. </summary>

public int OriginalNumber(int number)=>number>=1&&number<=_origin.Count?_origin[number-1]:0;public string Text=>string.Join("\n",_lines);public int LineCount=>_lines.Count;/// <summary>Number of added or changed lines.</summary>
public int PendingCount{get{var count=0;foreach(var changed in _changed){if(changed)count++;}return count;}}/// <summary>Whether the line at 0-based <paramref name="index"/> was added or changed.</summary>
public bool IsChanged(int index)=>index>=0&&index<_changed.Count&&_changed[index];public string Line(int index)=>index>=0&&index<_lines.Count?_lines[index]:string.Empty;/// <summary>Inserts lines before 0-based <paramref name="index"/> (clamped to the text).</summary>
public void Insert(int index,params string[]lines){index=System.Math.Clamp(index,0,_lines.Count);_lines.InsertRange(index,lines);_changed.InsertRange(index,NewFlags(lines.Length));_origin.InsertRange(index,new int[lines.Length]);}/// <summary>Appends lines at the end of the text.</summary>
public void Append(params string[]lines)=>Insert(_lines.Count,lines);public void Replace(int index,string line){if(index<0||index>=_lines.Count||_lines[index]==line)return;_lines[index]=line;_changed[index]=true;}/// <summary> Replaces the whole text (the inline text editor). public void ReplaceAll(string text){var lines=(text??string.Empty).Replace("\r\n","\n").Split('\n');for(var i=0;i<lines.Length;i++){var changed=i>=_lines.Count||_lines[i]!=lines[i]||_changed[i];if(i<_lines.Count){_lines[i]=lines[i];_changed[i]=changed;}else{_lines.Add(lines[i]);_changed.Add(true);_origin.Add(0);}}if(_lines.Count>lines.Length){_lines.RemoveRange(lines.Length,_lines.Count-lines.Length);_changed.RemoveRange(lines.Length,_changed.Count-lines.Length);_origin.RemoveRange(lines.Length,_origin.Count-lines.Length);}}/// <summary>0-based index of the label line <c>:name</c>, or -1.</summary>

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using Godot;/// <summary> Small studio button that carries what it acts on — a scenario line, a scenario or scene name — and reports itself when pressed, so one dock handler serves every row without a closure per button. </summary>
public partial class StudioActionButton:Button{/// <summary>Name the action applies to (scenario, scene), if any.</summary>
public string Payload{get;set;}/// <summary>Scenario line the action applies to, if any.</summary>
public StudioCodeLine Line{get;set;}/// <summary>Raised with the button itself when pressed.</summary>
public event Action<StudioActionButton>Chosen;public StudioActionButton(){Pressed+=OnPressed;}/// <summary>Small studio-styled button with a localized caption.</summary>
public static StudioActionButton Create(string key,Action<StudioActionButton>chosen,bool primary=false){var button=new StudioActionButton();StudioStyles.SmallButton(button,TranslationServer.Translate(key),primary);button.Chosen+=chosen;return button;}private void OnPressed()=>Chosen?.Invoke(this);}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Theming;using Godot;/// <summary> One answer of the current question for the novice (<c>.ct-branch</c>): the answer text and, under it, where it leads — a scene, an action, the end of the scenario — with the label hop already followed. public partial class StudioBranchView:PanelContainer{public bool IsBroken{get;}public StudioBranchView(StudioBranch branch,Action<StudioActionButton>edit,Action<StudioActionButton>chooseTarget){IsBroken=branch.Kind==StudioOutcomeKind.Broken;var isNew=branch.Line.IsNew;MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel",StudioStyles.Branch(IsBroken,isNew));var row=UiKit.Row(StudioStyles.BarGap);AddChild(row);if(isNew)row.AddChild(StudioStyles.Bar(UiTokens.Success));var body=UiKit.Column(UiTokens.Space1);body.SizeFlagsHorizontal=SizeFlags.ExpandFill;row.AddChild(body);var text=UiKit.Label(StudioSayView.Quote(branch.Line),UiTokens.FontBodyLarge,UiTokens.Ink);text.AutowrapMode=TextServer.AutowrapMode.WordSmart;body.AddChild(text);body.AddChild(BuildOutcome(branch));var actions=UiKit.Column(UiTokens.Space1);actions.SizeFlagsVertical=SizeFlags.ShrinkCenter;row.AddChild(actions);var target=StudioActionButton.Create("studio/choose_target",chooseTarget,primary:IsBroken);target.Line=branch.Line;actions.AddChild(target);if(IsBroken)return;var editText=StudioActionButton.Create("studio/edit",edit);editText.Line=branch.Line;actions.AddChild(editText);}private static Control BuildOutcome(StudioBranch branch){var color=StudioStyles.OutcomeColor(branch.Kind);var row=UiKit.Row(UiTokens.Space2);row.AddChild(StudioStyles.Text("→",UiTokens.FontBodySmall,UiTokens.Faint));row.AddChild(StudioStyles.Text(TranslationServer.Translate(OutcomeKey(branch.Kind)),UiTokens.FontBodySmall,color));if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(branch.Target))row.AddChild(StudioStyles.Text(branch.Target,UiTokens.FontBodySmall,color,mono:true));return row;}private static string OutcomeKey(StudioOutcomeKind kind){switch(kind){case StudioOutcomeKind.Scene:return"studio/outcome_scene";case StudioOutcomeKind.Action:return"studio/outcome_action";case StudioOutcomeKind.End:return"studio/outcome_end";case StudioOutcomeKind.Continue:return"studio/outcome_continue";default:return"studio/outcome_broken";}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;/// <summary> One script line of the author mode (<c>.ct-code__line</c>): gutter with the breakpoint dot, line number and the ▶ marker of the current line, then the coloured source. A click on the gutter toggles the breakpoint, like in an IDE. The ▶ marker of the current line is a handle of its own: dragging it onto another line is the IDE's "set next statement" — the view only reports where the mouse is (<see cref="MarkerDragged"/>, <see cref="MarkerDropped"/> in canvas coordinates); the page decides which line is under it. Godot keeps sending motion and release to the control the press started on, so the marker sees the whole drag even over other lines. A parse error is shown as a faint comment after the source so the line keeps its place. The source label has a fixed line height instead of fit-content: a fitted label without wrapping demands its full text width and would widen the whole dock for one long line. </summary>

public StudioCodeLine Line=>_line;/// <summary>The clickable gutter (breakpoint dot, number, marker).</summary>
public Control Gutter=>_gutter;/// <summary>The ▶ marker of the current line, the handle dragged to choose the next line.</summary>
public Control Marker=>_marker;/// <summary>Raised when the gutter is clicked.</summary>
public event Action<StudioCodeLine>BreakpointToggled;/// <summary>Raised while the marker is dragged, with the mouse position in canvas coordinates.</summary>
public event Action<Vector2>MarkerDragged;/// <summary>Raised when the dragged marker is released, with the mouse position in canvas coordinates.</summary>

dotSlot=new CenterContainer{CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(14,0),MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore};var dot=new Panel{CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(28,0);number.HorizontalAlignment=HorizontalAlignment.Right;_gutter.AddChild(number);_marker=StudioStyles.Text(current?" ▶":"",UiTokens.FontTiny,UiTokens.AccentBright);_marker.CustomMinimumSize=new Vector2(16,0);_marker.VerticalAlignment=VerticalAlignment.Center;if(current){_marker.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;_marker.MouseDefaultCursorShape=CursorShape.Drag;_marker.TooltipText=TranslationServer.Translate("studio/drag_next_line");_marker.GuiInput+=OnMarkerInput;}_gutter.AddChild(_marker);var namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using Godot;/// <summary> Mouse drag on one handle of the dock (<c>Frame</c> in <c>scenes/studio_panel.tscn</c>): the header moves the frame, the edge and corner grips resize it. The handles and their cursors live in the scene; this only listens to the handle's <c>GuiInput</c>. <para/> Each motion is measured from the press, not from the previous motion, so a drag that hits a limit (screen border, smallest size) does not leave the frame lagging behind the mouse once it comes back. The frame keeps its anchors (right edge, full height): <c>Position</c>/<c>Size</c> rewrite only the offsets, so a moved dock still follows the right edge when the window is resized. The smallest size is <see cref="StudioStyles.DockMinSize"/> or what the dock's content demands, whichever is larger — a narrower frame would let the panel overflow it. </summary>
public sealed class StudioDockDrag{private readonly Control _frame;private readonly Control _dock;private readonly Control _handle;private readonly StudioDockEdge _edges;private bool _dragging;private Vector2 _pressedAt;private Rect2 _startRect;public StudioDockDrag(Control frame,Control dock,Control handle,StudioDockEdge edges){_frame=frame;_dock=dock;_handle=handle;_edges=edges;handle.GuiInput+=OnInput;}private void OnInput(InputEvent@event){switch(@event){case InputEventMouseButton{ButtonIndex:MouseButton.Left}mouse when mouse.Pressed:_dragging=true;_pressedAt=_handle.GetGlobalTransform()*mouse.Position;_startRect=new Rect2(_frame.Position,_frame.Size);_handle.AcceptEvent();break;case InputEventMouseButton{ButtonIndex:MouseButton.Left}when _dragging:_dragging=false;_handle.AcceptEvent();break;case InputEventMouseMotion motion when _dragging:Apply(_handle.GetGlobalTransform()*motion.Position-_pressedAt);_handle.AcceptEvent();break;}}private void Apply(Vector2 delta){var bounds=_frame.GetParentAreaSize();var min=StudioStyles.DockMinSize.Max(_dock.GetCombinedMinimumSize());var left=_startRect.Position.X;var top=_startRect.Position.Y;var right=_startRect.End.X;var bottom=_startRect.End.Y;if(_edges==StudioDockEdge.Move){var dx=Mathf.Clamp(delta.X,-left,bounds.X-right);var dy=Mathf.Clamp(delta.Y,-top,bounds.Y-bottom);left+=dx;right+=dx;top+=dy;bottom+=dy;}else{if(_edges.HasFlag(StudioDockEdge.Left))left=Mathf.Clamp(left+delta.X,0,right-min.X);if(_edges.HasFlag(StudioDockEdge.Right))right=Mathf.Clamp(right+delta.X,left+min.X,bounds.X);if(_edges.HasFlag(StudioDockEdge.Top))top=Mathf.Clamp(top+delta.Y,0,bottom-min.Y);if(_edges.HasFlag(StudioDockEdge.Bottom))bottom=Mathf.Clamp(bottom+delta.Y,top+min.Y,bounds.Y);}_frame.Position=new Vector2(left,top);_frame.Size=new Vector2(right-left,bottom-top);}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;/// <summary> The dock's small modal questions: a one-line text input (edit a line, name a scene or an exported mod) and a pick list (where an answer leads, which scene to link). They are plain Godot popups themed like the game, added under the dock and freed when closed. </summary>
public static class StudioPrompt{/// <summary>Asks for a line of text; <paramref name="done"/> gets it on OK.</summary>
public static ConfirmationDialog AskText(Node parent,string title,string initial,Action<string>done){var dialog=new ConfirmationDialog{Title=title,MinSize=new Vector2I(460,0)};CthangoverTheme.Apply(dialog);dialog.OkButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("studio/ok");dialog.CancelButtonText=TranslationServer.Translate("studio/cancel");var field=new LineEdit{Text=initial??string.Empty,SelectAllOnFocus=true};dialog.AddChild(field);dialog.RegisterTextEnter(field);var relay=new StudioPromptRelay(field,done);dialog.Confirmed+=relay.OnConfirmed;dialog.Confirmed+=dialog.QueueFree;dialog.Canceled+=dialog.QueueFree;dialog.AddChild(relay);parent.AddChild(dialog);dialog.PopupCentered();field.GrabFocus();return dialog;}/// <summary>Shows a pick list under the mouse; <paramref name="picked"/> gets the item id.</summary>
public static PopupMenu Pick(Node parent,PopupMenu.IdPressedEventHandler picked){var menu=new PopupMenu();CthangoverTheme.Apply(menu);menu.IdPressed+=picked;menu.PopupHide+=menu.QueueFree;parent.AddChild(menu);return menu;}/// <summary>Opens a pick list built with <see cref="Pick"/> at the mouse position.</summary>
public static void Open(PopupMenu menu){menu.ResetSize();menu.Position=(Vector2I)menu.GetViewport().GetMousePosition();menu.Popup();}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio{using System.Text;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using Godot;/// <summary> Colours one scenario DSL line as BBCode with the studio palette of the style guide: command word gold, quoted text ink, <c>:labels</c> teal, <c>name=</c> keys chip-key, comments faint. A light single-pass scanner is enough for display: it never fails on malformed lines, it just colours less of them, and the real parser stays the only judge of validity. </summary>
public static class StudioSyntax{/// <summary> Highlighter for the inline text editor with the same palette: every registered command word (plus <c>select</c>/<c>option</c>) gold, quoted text ink, comments faint, <c>:labels</c> teal. </summary>
public static CodeHighlighter CreateHighlighter(){var highlighter=new CodeHighlighter{NumberColor=UiTokens.Body,SymbolColor=UiTokens.Muted,FunctionColor=UiTokens.Body,MemberVariableColor=UiTokens.Body,};foreach(var command in ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.GetAllCommandNames())highlighter.AddKeywordColor(command,UiTokens.AccentBright);highlighter.AddKeywordColor("select",UiTokens.AccentBright);highlighter.AddKeywordColor("option",UiTokens.AccentBright);highlighter.AddColorRegion("\"","\"",UiTokens.Ink);highlighter.AddColorRegion("#","",UiTokens.Faint,true);highlighter.AddColorRegion(":"," ",UiTokens.TypeTarget,true);return highlighter;}public static string ToBbCode(string line){var text=line??string.Empty;var trimmed=text.TrimStart();var indent=text.Substring(0,text.Length-trimmed.Length);var result=new StringBuilder(Escape(indent));if(trimmed.StartsWith('#'))return result.Append(Paint(trimmed,UiTokens.Faint)).ToString();if(trimmed.StartsWith(':'))return result.Append(Paint(trimmed,UiTokens.TypeTarget)).ToString();var i=0;var first=true;while(i<trimmed.Length){var c=trimmed[i];if(c==' '){result.Append(' ');i++;continue;}if(c=='#'){result.Append(Paint(trimmed.Substring(i),UiTokens.Faint));break;}var end=c=='"'?CloseQuote(trimmed,i):NextSpace(trimmed,i);var token=trimmed.Substring(i,end-i);result.Append(PaintToken(token,first));first=false;i=end;}return result.ToString();}private static string PaintToken(string token,bool first){if(first)return Paint(token,UiTokens.AccentBright);if(token.StartsWith('"'))return Paint(token,UiTokens.Ink);if(token.StartsWith(':'))return Paint(token,UiTokens.TypeTarget);if(token=="->")return Paint(token,UiTokens.Muted);var eq=token.IndexOf('=');if(eq>0)return namespace Cthangover.Mods.ScenarioStudio.Tests.Live{using System.Linq;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;/// <summary> Entry point of the studio live test, active only with <c>--itest=studio_live</c>; <c>--shots=&lt;dir&gt;</c> also saves a screenshot per checked state (needs a real display, e.g. xvfb). The test expects <c>--studio-write=layer</c> and its own <c>--studio-layer=</c> so it never writes into a mod. The driver is added deferred because resources-ready fires before the shell scene exists. </summary>
public class StudioLiveTestInitializer:IModInitializer{private static bool driverQueued;public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}public void OnModResourcesReady(){if(driverQueued)return;var args=OS.GetCmdlineUserArgs();if(!args.Any(a=>a=="--itest=studio_live"))return;var shots=args.Where(a=>a.StartsWith("--shots=",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(a=>a.Substring("--shots=".Length)).FirstOrDefault();driverQueued=true;GameLogger.Log("TEST",$"StudioLiveTestInitializer: activating studio live test, shots='{shots ?? ""}'");(Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree)?.Root?.CallDeferred("add_child",new StudioLiveDriverNode(shots));}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Skills{/// <summary> Represents the rarity tier of a skill card, determining its drop probability, visual frame treatment, and relative power budget. Higher tiers correspond to more potent effects and rarer acquisition chances. </summary>
public enum RareType{/// <summary>Standard skill with the highest drop rate and baseline power.</summary>
Common,/// <summary>Slightly improved stats and a lower drop rate than <c>Common</c>.</summary>
Uncommon,/// <summary>Notably stronger, appearing infrequently in loot pools.</summary>
Rare,/// <summary>Powerful skill with significant gameplay impact; very low drop chance.</summary>
Epic,/// <summary>The highest tier — game-changing abilities with extremely rare availability.</summary>
Legendary}}
