using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Battle.Actions;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.TurnBattle{/// <summary> GDScript hook of the turn-battle mod. The core's ModGDScriptLoader walks every <c>.gd</c> file generically and hands objects to registered hooks; this hook recognizes the two battle-side contracts: <list type="bullet"> <item><c>get_action_id()</c> + <c>execute(action, user, target)</c> — wraps the script in a <see cref="GDBattleActionExecutor"/> and registers it in the global <see cref="ActionExecutorHub"/> pool.</item> <item><c>get_winground_listener_id()</c> plus any of the three <c>on_winground_*</c> methods — wraps the script in a <see cref="GDWingroundListener"/>.</item> </list> Keeping the recognition here means the core loader no longer mentions any battle method name. </summary>
public class TurnBattleGDScriptHook:IGDScriptHook{/// <summary>Stable id used by <see cref="GDScriptHookRegistry"/> for replacement on reload.</summary>
public string Id=>"turn_battle_base.gd_hook";/// <summary>Inspects one compiled script and registers an adapter when a contract matches.</summary>
public void TryRegister(GodotObject obj,string modId,string filePath){if(obj==null)return;if(obj.HasMethod("get_action_id")&&obj.HasMethod("execute")){var actionId=obj.Call("get_action_id").AsString();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(actionId)){ActionExecutorHub.Instance.RegisterGlobal(new GDBattleActionExecutor(actionId,obj));GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript battle executor '{actionId}' from mod '{modId}' ({filePath})");}}var hasWingroundHook=obj.HasMethod("on_winground_before_exp")||obj.HasMethod("on_winground_after_loot")||obj.HasMethod("on_winground_before_show");if(hasWingroundHook&&obj.HasMethod("get_winground_listener_id")){var listenerId=obj.Call("get_winground_listener_id").AsString();if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(listenerId)){WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.RegisterListener(new GDWingroundListener(listenerId,obj));GameLogger.Log("GDS_MOD",$"Registered GDScript winground listener '{listenerId}' from mod '{modId}' ({filePath})");}}}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Audio;using Cthangover.Core.Battle;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;namespace Cthangover.TurnBattle{/// <summary> Lifecycle entry point of the turn-battle mod. Two responsibilities: <list type="number"> <item>Publishes the logical "Battle" scene route with fade transition and combat music, so the core can route <c>switch_scene Battle</c> without hardcoding a battle path.</item> <item>Registers <see cref="TurnBattleGDScriptHook"/> so GDScript mods can still supply action executors and winground listeners after the battle bridge moved out of the core loader.</item> </list> Battle cores, winground listeners and status effect behaviours of all mods reach their registries through the kernel's assembly consumers (<see cref="BattleCoreConsumer"/>, <see cref="WingroundListenerConsumer"/>, <see cref="StatusActionsConsumer"/>), not from here. </summary>

public void OnModLoaded(string modId){GDScriptHookRegistry.Register(new TurnBattleGDScriptHook());}/// <summary>Publishes the scene route.</summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){SceneRouteRegistry.Register("Battle",BattleScenePath,fade:true,musicScene:"Battle",music:MusicType.Combat);}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Items;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Mutable context passed to <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> hooks during the victory-screen pipeline. Listeners receive the same instance across all three phases (before EXP, after loot, before show) and can mutate any field — including removing enemies, adjusting earned EXP per character, or modifying the generated loot list. The <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> reads these fields after each hook, so changes take effect immediately. </summary>
public class WingroundContext{/// <summary> Per-character EXP earned during this battle, keyed by <see cref="Character.ID"/>. Populated from <see cref="BattleSceneContext.PlayerExpGained"/> before the first hook and consumed by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> to award EXP to <see cref="CharacterData"/>. </summary>
public Dictionary<string,int>PlayerExpGained{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Enemies defeated during this battle. Used by the victory screen for loot generation and recruitment rolls. Null entries are skipped by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/>. </summary>
public List<Character>DefeatedEnemies{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> Loot items generated from <see cref="DefeatedEnemies"/>. Filled by <see cref="WingroundBehaviour"/> between the "before EXP" and "after loot" hooks. Listeners can add, remove, or modify entries before the items are committed to inventory. </summary>
public List<ItemContainer>GeneratedLoot{get;set;}=new();/// <summary> The <see cref="BattleData"/> that started this battle. Read-only reference — do not mutate the object itself (it is shared with the quest system) but its fields such as <c>ReturnScene</c> are writable. </summary>
public BattleData BattleData{get;set;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Consumers;/// <summary> Feeds <see cref="WingroundListenerRegistry"/> with every mod's C# <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> implementations, and removes them when their mod unloads. GDScript listeners still register through the hook. </summary>
public class WingroundListenerConsumer:ModTypeConsumer<IWingroundListener>{/// <inheritdoc />
public override string Id=>"turn_battle_base.winground_listeners";/// <inheritdoc />
protected override void Add(IWingroundListener instance,string modId)=>WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.RegisterListener(instance);/// <inheritdoc />
protected override void Remove(IWingroundListener instance,string modId)=>WingroundListenerRegistry.Instance.UnregisterListener(instance);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Core.Battle{/// <summary> Singleton registry that collects <see cref="IWingroundListener"/> implementations (C# from every mod through <see cref="WingroundListenerConsumer"/>, GDScript via <see cref="RegisterListener"/>) and broadcasts winground lifecycle hooks to all of them in registration order. </summary>
public class WingroundListenerRegistry{public static readonly WingroundListenerRegistry Instance=new();private readonly List<IWingroundListener>_listeners=new();/// <summary> Registers a listener, replacing any earlier one with the same <see cref="IWingroundListener.Id"/> (used by the GDScript bridge <see cref="GDWingroundListener"/> and by <see cref="WingroundListenerConsumer"/>). Safe to call from any thread — the underlying list is not thread-safe but all registrations happen during mod initialisation before battle scenes are loaded. </summary>
public void RegisterListener(IWingroundListener listener){if(listener==null)return;_listeners.RemoveAll(existing=>existing.Id==listener.Id);_listeners.Add(listener);GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: registered listener '{listener.Id}'");}/// <summary>Removes exactly <paramref name="listener"/> (its mod is being unloaded).</summary>
public void UnregisterListener(IWingroundListener listener){_listeners.Remove(listener);}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnBeforeExpAward"/> to every registered listener. Exceptions from individual listeners are logged and swallowed so one broken mod cannot break the victory screen for others. </summary>
public void NotifyBeforeExpAward(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnBeforeExpAward(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnBeforeExpAward threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnAfterLootGenerated"/> to every registered listener. </summary>
public void NotifyAfterLootGenerated(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnAfterLootGenerated(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnAfterLootGenerated threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}/// <summary> Broadcasts <see cref="IWingroundListener.OnBeforeShow"/> to every registered listener. </summary>
public void NotifyBeforeShow(WingroundContext ctx){foreach(var listener in _listeners){try{listener.OnBeforeShow(ctx);}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("BATTLE",$"WingroundListenerRegistry: {listener.Id}.OnBeforeShow threw: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);}}}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.TurnBattle.Tests{using Cthangover.Core.Cards.StatusEffect;using Cthangover.Core.Characters;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Testing;/// <summary> Lifetime of status effects: the countdown runs once per turn start, a duration from the effect's data counts like an explicit one, and the turn-end hook does not shorten an effect a second time. </summary>
public class StatusEffectQueueTests{private const string Stun="effect/physics/stun";[ModTest("status/data_duration_expires")]static void DataDurationExpires(ModTestContext ctx){var queue=StatusEffectService.Of(new Character{ID="status_test"});ModAssert.True(queue.Add(Stun),"stun applied with its data duration");queue.OnTurnStart();queue.OnTurnStart();ModAssert.True(queue.HasStun(),"stun still active after 2 of 3 turns");queue.OnTurnStart();ModAssert.False(queue.HasStun(),"stun expired after its 3 turns");}[ModTest("status/turn_end_does_not_shorten")]static void TurnEndDoesNotShorten(ModTestContext ctx){var queue=StatusEffectService.Of(new Character{ID="status_test"});queue.Add(Stun,2);queue.OnTurnEnd();queue.OnTurnStart();ModAssert.True(queue.HasStun(),"one turn of two left after a full turn");queue.OnTurnEnd();queue.OnTurnStart();ModAssert.False(queue.HasStun(),"expired after two turns");}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists{/// <summary> Contract for a single item in a list widget. Construct binds a model; Destruct tears down (typically QueueFree). The Rect getter exposes the item's Control for layout positioning by the parent list. </summary>

Control Rect{get;}/// <summary>The bound data model. Set via <see cref="Construct"/>.</summary>
TModel Model{get;}/// <summary>Binds the item to a data model. Called by the list widget after instantiation, before layout positioning.</summary>
void Construct(TModel model);/// <summary>Cleans up the item — typically disconnects signals and calls QueueFree. Called when the list is destroyed or refreshed.</summary>
void Destruct();}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists{/// <summary> Generic list widget contract: binds a collection of models to Item widgets. The two-step CreateModels() → CreateContent() pattern separates data sourcing from instantiation, so subclasses can pull models from anywhere (runtime state, config, save data) while the framework handles layout. ConstructUI/DestructUI manage the full lifecycle of child items. </summary>
public interface IListWidget<TItem,TModel>:IWidget where TItem:class,IListItem<TModel>{/// <summary>Padding between items in pixels, stored as Vector2(X, Y). The X component is horizontal gap, Y is vertical gap.</summary>
Vector2 ItemsCellPadding{get;}/// <summary>The container Control that holds all child item nodes. Items are added as children of this node.</summary>
Control Content{get;}/// <summary>The collection of instantiated item widgets. Populated by <see cref="ConstructUI"/> and cleared by <see cref="DestructUI"/>.</summary>
List<TItem>Items{get;set;}/// <summary>Implementations return the collection of data models to display. Called once per <see cref="ConstructUI"/> cycle.</summary>
ICollection<TModel>CreateModels();/// <summary>Instantiates item widgets from the model collection. Separates model sourcing from instantiation so subclasses control both steps.</summary>
List<TItem>CreateContent(ICollection<TModel>models);/// <summary>Calculates the total content size in pixels for <paramref name="count"/> items, used for scroll container sizing.</summary>
Vector2 GetContentSize(int count);/// <summary>Builds the full item tree: creates models, instantiates items, and positions them via layout.</summary>
void ConstructUI();/// <summary>Tears down all child items by calling each item's <see cref="IListItem{TModel}.Destruct"/> and clearing the Items list.</summary>
void DestructUI();}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists.Impls{/// <summary> Grid-based list layout with configurable column count, aspect-ratio cells, and border/padding offsets. Cell dimensions are computed dynamically from the content area width, so they scale with the parent. GetContentSize calculates the total scrollable height from item count and cell geometry, enabling vertical scrolling through a grid. PutToLayout positions items by flat-index-to-grid conversion. The isScaledCanvas flag supports resolution-independent layouts. </summary>
public abstract partial class ColumnCellListWidget<TItem,TModel>:ListWidget<TItem,TModel>,ICellListWidget<TItem,TModel>where TItem:Control,IListItem<TModel>{[Export]private int columnCount;[Export]private float aspectHeight=1f;[Export]private float borderLeft;[Export]private float borderRight;[Export]private float borderTop;[Export]private float borderBottom;[Export]private bool isScaledCanvas=true;private Border contentBorder=>new(){left=borderLeft,right=borderRight,top=borderTop,bottom=borderBottom};/// <summary>Dynamically computed cell dimensions in pixels. Width = (content width - borders - padding * (columns - 1)) / columns; height = width * aspectHeight.</summary>
public Vector2 CellSize=>GetCellSize(Content.Size);private Vector2 GetCellSize(Vector2 contentSize){var size=contentSize;var effectiveWidth=size.X-contentBorder.left-contentBorder.right;var cellWidth=(effectiveWidth-(columnCount-1)*ItemsCellPadding.X)/columnCount;var cellHeight=cellWidth*aspectHeight;return new Vector2(cellWidth,cellHeight);}/// <summary>Number of cells visible in the viewport: X = columnCount, Y = floor((content height - borders) / (cell height + padding)).</summary>
public Vector2I ViewCellsCount{get{var size=Content.Size;return new Vector2I(columnCount,Mathf.FloorToInt((size.Y-contentBorder.top-contentBorder.bottom)/(CellSize.Y+ItemsCellPadding.Y)));}}/// <summary>Calculates total scrollable content height: top border + bottom border + rows * cellHeight + (rows - 1) * padding.</summary>
public override Vector2 GetContentSize(int count){if(count==0)return Vector2.Zero;var rect=Content.Size;var effectiveWidth=rect.X-contentBorder.left-contentBorder.right;var cellWidth=(effectiveWidth-(columnCount-1)*ItemsCellPadding.X)/columnCount;var cellHeight=cellWidth*aspectHeight;var rows=Mathf.CeilToInt((float)count/columnCount);var contentHeight=contentBorder.top+contentBorder.bottom+rows*cellHeight+(rows-1)*ItemsCellPadding.Y;var contentWidth=rect.X;return new Vector2(contentWidth,contentHeight);}protected override void PutToLayout(TItem item,int index,Control container,Vector2 contentSize){var rectTransform=item;var cellIndex=GetIndex(index);var cellSize=GetCellSize(contentSize);if(rectTransform.GetParent()!=container)rectTransform.Reparent(container,false);rectTransform.Position=new Vector2(contentBorder.left+cellIndex.X*(cellSize.X+ItemsCellPadding.X),contentBorder.top+cellIndex.Y*(cellSize.Y+ItemsCellPadding.Y));rectTransform.Size=cellSize;}private Vector2I GetIndex(int flatIndex){var count=ViewCellsCount;return new Vector2I(flatIndex%count.X,flatIndex/count.X);}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists.Impls{/// <summary> Simple vertical stack layout. Items are placed top-to-bottom with padding between them, offset so the list grows upward from the content center. Content height is the sum of all item heights plus padding — no pooling or virtualization, so it's intended for short lists. </summary>
public abstract partial class VerticalListWidget<TItem,TModel>:ListWidget<TItem,TModel>where TItem:Control,IListItem<TModel>{protected override void PutToLayout(TItem item,int index,Control container,Vector2 contentSize){var posY=index*(PrefabRect.Size.Y+ItemsCellPadding.Y);var itemRect=item;var pos=new Vector2(itemRect.Position.X,-posY+contentSize.Y*0.5f);itemRect.Position=pos;}/// <summary>Content height = count * (prefab height + Y padding). Width is inherited from the Content container.</summary>
public override Vector2 GetContentSize(int count){var boxSize=Content.Size;boxSize.Y=count*(PrefabRect.Size.Y+ItemsCellPadding.Y);return boxSize;}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists{/// <summary> Base list item: stores the bound model and provides a Rect for layout. The virtual Construct saves the model reference; Destruct is abstract so subclasses must explicitly implement cleanup (signal disconnection, QueueFree). </summary>
public abstract partial class ListItem<TModel>:Control,IListItem<TModel>{/// <summary>The data model bound to this list item. Set by <see cref="Construct"/>.</summary>
public TModel Model{get;private set;}/// <summary>The Control that this item occupies for layout. Returns itself — ListItem is its own layout root.</summary>

protected abstract void PutToLayout(T item,int index,Control container,Vector2 contentSize);/// <summary>Subclasses implement model sourcing. Called by <see cref="ConstructUI"/> before item instantiation.</summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists{/// <summary> Shader-based scene transition: animates a "progress" uniform on the background's ShaderMaterial via a Godot Tween, then reveals content after a configurable delay. The shader is resolved through the mod system (ModManager.ResolveShader), allowing mods to replace the transition effect. Uses an easeInOut curve for the progress ramp. Material is duplicated on first use so each instance gets its own shader parameters. On tree exit, the duplicated material is disposed to avoid leaks. </summary>
public abstract partial class TransitionWidget:Widget{private static readonly StringName ProgressParam="progress";[Export]private TextureRect imgBackground;[Export]private Control contentGroup;[Export]private float transitionDuration=0.8f;[Export]private float contentDelay=0.05f;private ShaderMaterial materialInstance;private Tween transitionTween;/// <summary> Shows the widget base, then creates or reuses a shader material for the background and starts the transition tween. Material is duplicated from <c>imgBackground.Material</c> on first call so each instance gets independent shader parameters. </summary>
public override void Show(){base.Show();if(materialInstance==null&&imgBackground!=null){materialInstance=imgBackground.Material?.Duplicate()as ShaderMaterial;if(materialInstance==null){materialInstance=new ShaderMaterial();var shader=Shaders.Resolve("scene_transition");if(shader!=null)materialInstance.Shader=shader;}imgBackground.Material=materialInstance;materialInstance.SetShaderParameter(ProgressParam,0f);}if(transitionTween!=null){transitionTween.Kill();transitionTween=null;}RunShowAnimation();}/// <summary>Kills the active transition tween if one is running, then calls base <see cref="Widget.Hide"/>.</summary>
public override void Hide(){if(transitionTween!=null){transitionTween.Kill();transitionTween=null;}base.Hide();}private void RunShowAnimation(){if(contentGroup!=null){contentGroup.Modulate=UiTokens.Alpha(UiTokens.White,0f);contentGroup.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;}transitionTween=CreateTween();transitionTween.SetProcessMode(Tween.TweenProcessMode.Physics);transitionTween.TweenMethod(Callable.From<float>(OnProgressUpdate),0f,1f,transitionDuration);transitionTween.Finished+=OnTweenFinished;}private void OnProgressUpdate(float t){float curvedT=EaseInOut(t);if(imgBackground?.Material is ShaderMaterial mat)mat.SetShaderParameter(ProgressParam,curvedT);}private void OnTweenFinished(){if(imgBackground?.Material is ShaderMaterial mat)mat.SetShaderParameter(ProgressParam,1f);var timer=GetTree().CreateTimer(contentDelay);timer.Timeout+=()=>{if(contentGroup!=null){contentGroup.Modulate=UiTokens.White;contentGroup.MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Stop;}};transitionTween=null;}private static float EaseInOut(float t){return t<0.5f?2f*t*t:1f-Mathf.Pow(-2f*t+2f,2f)/2f;}/// <summary>Disposes the per-instance shader material created for the transition.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){if(materialInstance!=null){materialInstance.Dispose();materialInstance=null;}base._ExitTree();}}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base{/// <summary> Lifecycle forwarder for Node scripts compiled from mods. using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Event{/// <summary> Stateless input abstraction that maps mouse to a virtual single-touch source. Tracks mouse-down state between frames to derive touch phases (Began/Moved/ Ended/Stationary), enabling touch-aware code to work with mouse-only devices. Provides both UI-space (UITouchPosition) and screen-space (TouchPosition) coordinate access. Update() must be called each frame to refresh the wasMouseDownLastFrame flag. </summary>
public static class DeviceInput{/// <summary> Index of the active touch (always 0 for the mouse-backed single-touch model). Exposed for API compatibility with potential multi-touch support. </summary>
public static int CurrentTouchIndex{get;set;}/// <summary> Derives a <see cref="TouchPhase"/> from mouse button state across frames. Compares the current left-button state against <c>wasMouseDownLastFrame</c>: Began on fresh press, Moved on hold, Ended on release. </summary>
public static TouchPhase GetTouchPhase{get{if(Input.IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton.Left)){if(Input.IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton.Left)&& !wasMouseDownLastFrame)return TouchPhase.Began;if(Input.IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton.Left)&&wasMouseDownLastFrame)return TouchPhase.Moved;}else{if(wasMouseDownLastFrame)return TouchPhase.Ended;}return TouchPhase.Stationary;}}private static bool wasMouseDownLastFrame;/// <summary> Must be called each frame to snapshot the mouse button state. The saved state drives <see cref="GetTouchPhase"/> for press/release transitions. </summary>
public static void Update(){wasMouseDownLastFrame=Input.IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton.Left);}/// <summary> Returns 1 when the left mouse button is pressed, 0 otherwise. Maps the mouse to a single-touch model. </summary>
public static int TouchCount{get{return Input.IsMouseButtonPressed(MouseButton.Left)?1:0;}}/// <summary> Mouse position in UI space (top-left origin, Control coordinate system). Used for hit-testing against Control nodes in the UI layer. </summary>
public static Vector2 UITouchPosition{get{var mp=GetViewport()?.GetMousePosition()??Vector2.Zero;// In Godot, UI coordinates match mouse coordinates (top-left origin in Control nodes)
return mp;}}/// <summary> Mouse position in screen space. Used for raycasting against 2D/3D world objects. </summary>
public static Vector2 TouchPosition{get{return GetViewport()?.GetMousePosition()??Vector2.Zero;}}/// <summary> Converts <see cref="TouchPosition"/> to a 3D vector (z=0) for ray-origin calculations in the 3D input pipeline. </summary>
public static Vector3 TouchPosition3D{get{var pos=TouchPosition;return new Vector3(pos.X,pos.Y,0);}}/// <summary> Last-frame mouse velocity from Godot's <c>Input.GetLastMouseVelocity()</c>. Used by drag handlers to compute movement deltas. </summary>
public static Vector2 TouchDelta{get{return Input.GetLastMouseVelocity();}}/// <summary> Returns the current touch position. The <paramref name="index"/> parameter is ignored in the single-touch model — always returns <see cref="TouchPosition"/>. Exists for multi-touch API compatibility. </summary> <param name="index">Touch index (ignored in current implementation).</param>
public static Vector2 GetTouchPosition(int index){return TouchPosition;}private static Viewport GetViewport(){var tree=Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree;return tree?.Root?.GetViewport();}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Menu;using Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Base.Lists;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Menu{/// <summary> Materializes the buttons collected in the <see cref="MenuRegistry"/> into the containers of a host menu. The host supplies a section → container map (""game"", ""mods"", ""exit"", ""tools"", …); every registry button is added to the container of its section, in registry order, and carries its translation key in node metadata (<see cref="LocaleMetaKey"/>) so the host can retranslate it on language change. <para/> A button is bound either to a scene path (pressed → the scene opens as a fullscreen child of the menu root and owns its lifetime) or to a handler delegate (pressed → the delegate runs). Unknown sections fall back to the ""mods"" container; sections without a container are skipped loudly. </summary>
public static class MenuBuilder{/// <summary>Node metadata key holding the button's translation key.</summary>
public const string LocaleMetaKey="main_menu_locale";/// <summary> Creates one button per registry entry inside the section containers. The host menu is passed in because pressed handlers instantiate mod scenes as its children. </summary>
public static void Build(Control menuRoot,IReadOnlyDictionary<string,Container>sections){if(menuRoot==null||sections==null)return;foreach(var entry in AppServices.Current.Menus.Buttons){if(entry.Visible!=null&& !SafeVisible(entry))continue;if(!sections.TryGetValue(entry.Section??MenuButtonEntry.SectionMods,out var container)&& !sections.TryGetValue(MenuButtonEntry.SectionMods,out container)){GameLogger.Log("MENU_BUILDER",$"No container for section '{entry.Section}' (button '{entry.Id}')");continue;}if(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(container)){GameLogger.Log("MENU_BUILDER",$"Container for section '{entry.Section}' is gone (button '{entry.Id}')");continue;}container.AddChild(CreateButton(menuRoot,entry));}}/// <summary> Collects buttons created by <see cref="Build"/> (or by tools) that carry a locale meta key into the host's translation map, so the host keeps them localized across language switches. </summary>

using Cthangover.Core.Events;using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Messages;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Messages{/// <summary> Static factory for floating UI messages (like "Quest updated" or item pickup notifications). Each message is instantiated from message.tscn and parented to the Background node (found via scene tree search). Messages auto-fade and self-destruct via UiMessage's OnUpdate. </summary>
public static class MessagesHelper{private const int maxMessageIndex=5;private static int lastMessageIndex=0;private static ModScenePrefab prefab;private static int GetNextIndex(int index){if(index++ >=maxMessageIndex)index=0;return index;}private static float GetPositionByLastIndex(int index){return(index-1)*60;}/// <summary> Resets the cycling position index to 0. Call when UI state resets to prevent messages from accumulating at high Y positions. </summary>
public static void ClearLastIndex(){lastMessageIndex=0;}/// <summary> Shows a message in the default warning colour at the next vertical slot. </summary> <param name="text">The message text to display.</param> <param name="speed">Fade speed multiplier (higher = faster fade, default 1).</param>
public static void AddMessage(string text,float speed=1f){AddMessage(text,UiTokens.Warning,speed);}/// <summary> Shows a message with a custom color at the next vertical slot. Messages auto-fade and self-destruct after ~3 seconds of display plus a fade duration determined by <paramref name="speed"/>. </summary> <param name="text">The message text to display.</param> <param name="color">The text color.</param> <param name="speed">Fade speed multiplier (higher = faster fade, default 1).</param>
public static void AddMessage(string text,Color color,float speed=1f){var nextIndex=GetNextIndex(lastMessageIndex);AddMessage(GetPositionByLastIndex(nextIndex),text,color,speed);lastMessageIndex=nextIndex;}/// <summary> Shows a message in the default warning colour at a specific vertical position, bypassing the cycling slot system. </summary> <param name="position">Y-offset in pixels for this message.</param> <param name="text">The message text to display.</param> <param name="speed">Fade speed multiplier (default 1).</param>

public override void _Ready(){MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore;if(SceneContextNode.Instance!=null){var eventController=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneEventController>("EventController");eventController?.AddUpdateEventListener(this);}}/// <summary>Unsubscribes from notification requests and detaches from the update controller.</summary>

i=0;i<_slots.Count;i++){if(_slots[i].IsDead)_dyingIndices.Add(i);}for(int j=_dyingIndices.Count-1;j>=0;j--){var idx=_dyingIndices[j];_slots[idx].Container.QueueFree();_slots.RemoveAt(idx);}while(_slots.Count<MaxVisibleSlots&&NotificationBuffer.TryDequeue(out var text)){CreateSlot(text,currentTime);}RepositionSlots();}private void CreateSlot(string text,float time){var container=new Panel{SizeFlagsHorizontal=SizeFlags.ShrinkBegin,MouseFilter=MouseFilterEnum.Ignore,};var style=UiKit.Frame(UiTokens.RadiusMd,UiTokens.ToastBg,UiTokens.Line);style.ContentMarginLeft=UiTokens.Space4;style.ContentMarginRight=UiTokens.Space4;style.ContentMarginTop=UiTokens.Space2;style.ContentMarginBottom=UiTokens.Space2;container.AddThemeStyleboxOverride("panel",style);var label=new slot=new NotificationSlot{Container=container,Text=text,DisplayedAt=time,};_slots.Add(slot);var tween=CreateTween();tween.TweenProperty(label,"modulate",Colors.White,FadeInDuration);}private void FadeOutSlot(int index){var slot=_slots[index];slot.IsFadingOut=true;var label=slot.Container.GetChildOrNull<Label>(0);if(label!=null){var tween=CreateTween();tween.TweenProperty(label,"modulate",UiTokens.Alpha(Colors.White,0f),FadeOutDuration);tween.TweenCallback(Callable.From(()=>{slot.IsDead=true;}));}else{slot.IsDead=true;}}private void RepositionSlots(){for(int i=0;i<_slots.Count;i++){var targetY=i*(SlotHeight+SlotSpacing);var container=_slots[i].Container;if(Mathf.Abs(container.Position.Y-targetY)>0.5f){var using Cthangover.Core.Scenes;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Event;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;using Cthangover.Core.UI.Messages;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Messages{/// <summary> Floating text message with auto-fade. Appears at a vertical position, stays visible for 3 seconds, then fades over 2/Speed seconds. Self- destructs (QueueFree) when fully transparent. Registers with SceneEventController for per-frame updates; unregisters on tree exit to prevent leaks. Speed affects only the fade duration, not the display duration, so faster speed = shorter fade = message disappears more quickly. </summary>
public partial class UiMessage:Control,IOnUpdateEvent{[Export]private Label textField;/// <summary>Tint of the message text; defaults to the warning colour.</summary>
[Export]public Color Color{get;set;}=UiTokens.Warning;/// <summary>Fade speed multiplier — 1 is normal; higher values shorten the fade-out.</summary>
[Export]public float Speed{get;set;}=1f;private float timestamp;/// <summary> The text content displayed by this message. Reads/writes the child <c>textField</c> label directly. </summary>
public string Text{get=>textField.Text;set=>textField.Text=value;}/// <summary> Initializes the message: positions it, sets text/speed/color, records the start timestamp, and registers with the <see cref="SceneEventController"/> for per-frame updates. Called by <see cref="MessagesHelper"/>. </summary> <param name="pos">Vertical Y-offset in pixels.</param> <param name="text">The message text.</param> <param name="speed">Fade speed multiplier.</param> <param name="color">The text color.</param>
public void Setup(float pos,string text,float speed,Color color){OffsetLeft=50;OffsetRight= -10;Size=new Vector2(Size.X,50);Position=new Vector2(0,pos+200);Text=text;Speed=speed;Color=color;timestamp=(float)Godot.Time.GetTicksMsec()/1000f;if(SceneContextNode.Instance!=null){var eventController=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneEventController>("EventController");eventController?.AddUpdateEventListener(this);}}/// <summary>Detaches from the event controller so a freed message stops receiving updates.</summary>
public override void _ExitTree(){if(SceneContextNode.Instance!=null){var eventController=SceneContextNode.FindNode<SceneEventController>("EventController");eventController?.RemoveUpdateEventListener(this);}}/// <summary> Priority <c>1</c> — lightweight enough for many concurrent messages. </summary>
public int Priority=>1;/// <summary> Per-frame update: displays for 3 seconds, then fades out over <c>2 / <see cref="Speed"/></c> seconds. Self-destructs via <c>QueueFree</c> when fully transparent. </summary>
public void OnUpdate(){var currentTime=(float)Godot.Time.GetTicksMsec()/1000f;var elapsed=currentTime-timestamp;if(elapsed<3f)return;var fadeDuration=2f/Speed;var fadeElapsed=elapsed-3f;var progress=Mathf.Clamp(fadeElapsed/fadeDuration,0f,1f);textField.SelfModulate=UiTokens.Alpha(Colors.White,1f-progress);if(progress>=1f)QueueFree();}}}

using Cthangover.Core.UI.Theming;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.Tool{/// <summary> Dense variant of <see cref="CthangoverTheme"/> for developer tool windows. The game theme is tuned for player panels (buttons padded 18×11, inputs 12×9), which makes an editor toolbar of ten controls overflow even a full-HD window. This theme keeps every colour, radius and type variation of the shared theme — the style guide still holds — and only tightens the content margins of the boxes, so tools fit more controls without a second palette. Built once by copying the shared theme and replacing its flat boxes with tightened duplicates; the shared theme is never mutated. </summary>
public static class ToolTheme{private const int MaxVerticalMargin=5;private const int MaxHorizontalMargin=10;private static Theme instance;/// <summary>Shared dense theme instance, built lazily from the game theme.</summary>
public static Theme Get()=>instance??=Build();private static Theme Build(){var theme=(Theme)CthangoverTheme.Get().Duplicate();theme.DefaultFontSize=UiTokens.FontBody;foreach(var type in theme.GetTypeList()){foreach(var name in theme.GetStyleboxList(type)){if(theme.GetStylebox(name,type)is not StyleBoxFlat flat)continue;var dense=(StyleBoxFlat)flat.Duplicate();dense.ContentMarginTop=Mathf.Min(dense.ContentMarginTop,MaxVerticalMargin);dense.ContentMarginBottom=Mathf.Min(dense.ContentMarginBottom,MaxVerticalMargin);dense.ContentMarginLeft=Mathf.Min(dense.ContentMarginLeft,MaxHorizontalMargin);dense.ContentMarginRight=Mathf.Min(dense.ContentMarginRight,MaxHorizontalMargin);theme.SetStylebox(name,type,dense);}if(theme.HasFontSize("font_size",type)&&theme.GetFontSize("font_size",type)>UiTokens.FontBody)theme.SetFontSize("font_size",type,UiTokens.FontBody);}return theme;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View{/// <summary> 9-point alignment grid for viewport content positioning. The naming uses horizontal-first, vertical-second convention (LeftTop, CenterCenter, RightBottom) — matching the intuitive order for CSS-like layout. </summary>
public enum AlignType{/// <summary>Content aligned to top-left corner of the viewport.</summary>
LeftTop,/// <summary>Content horizontally left, vertically centered in the viewport.</summary>
LeftCenter,/// <summary>Content horizontally left, vertically at the bottom of the viewport.</summary>
LeftBottom,/// <summary>Content horizontally centered, vertically at the top of the viewport.</summary>
CenterTop,/// <summary>Content centered both horizontally and vertically in the viewport.</summary>
CenterCenter,/// <summary>Content horizontally centered, vertically at the bottom of the viewport.</summary>
CenterBottom,/// <summary>Content horizontally right, vertically at the top of the viewport.</summary>
RightTop,/// <summary>Content horizontally right, vertically centered in the viewport.</summary>
RightCenter,/// <summary>Content aligned to the bottom-right corner of the viewport.</summary>
RightBottom,}}

using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View{/// <summary> Static utility that calculates content positioning offsets for the 9-point AlignType grid. Uses the viewport's visible rect as the camera/view area and computes offsets so the content aligns correctly within it. The CenterCenter case negates X because the content position is treated as a negative offset from top-left in Godot's coordinate space. </summary>
public static class ViewBoxNavigator{/// <summary> Calculates the content node position offset for the given 9-point <see cref="AlignType"/>. Uses the visible viewport rect size as the camera area and computes offsets relative to the top-left corner. Negative X coordinates are intentional: Godot positions content relative to the container origin, so aligning center or right requires negative offsets when content is larger than the viewport. </summary> <param name="align">The target alignment from the 9-point grid.</param> <param name="contentSize">The size of the content node being positioned.</param> <returns>A position offset that places the content correctly for the chosen alignment.</returns>
public static Vector2 GetPositionByAlign(AlignType align,Vector2 contentSize){var viewport=Godot.Engine.GetMainLoop()as SceneTree;var screenSize=viewport?.Root?.GetVisibleRect().Size??new Vector2(1920,1024);var cameraSize=screenSize;var alignPos=Vector2.Zero;switch(align){case AlignType.LeftTop:break;case AlignType.LeftCenter:alignPos.Y=(contentSize.Y-cameraSize.Y)*0.5f;break;case AlignType.LeftBottom:alignPos.Y=contentSize.Y-cameraSize.Y;break;case AlignType.CenterTop:alignPos.X= -(contentSize.X-cameraSize.X)*0.5f;break;case AlignType.CenterCenter:alignPos=(contentSize-cameraSize)*0.5f;alignPos.X= -alignPos.X;break;case AlignType.CenterBottom:alignPos.X= -(contentSize.X-cameraSize.X)*0.5f;alignPos.Y=contentSize.Y-cameraSize.Y;break;case AlignType.RightTop:alignPos.X= -(contentSize.X-cameraSize.X);break;case AlignType.RightCenter:alignPos.Y=(contentSize.Y-cameraSize.Y)*0.5f;alignPos.X= -(contentSize.X-cameraSize.X);break;case AlignType.RightBottom:alignPos.X= -(contentSize.X-cameraSize.X);alignPos.Y=contentSize.Y-cameraSize.Y;break;}return alignPos;}}}

namespace Cthangover.Mods.Interface.View{using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;using Godot;/// <summary> Takes a screenshot of a viewport the way the player sees it. </summary> <remarks> The project renders 2D in HDR (<c>rendering/viewport/hdr_2d</c>): the viewport texture then holds linear colour, and Godot converts it to sRGB only when it blits to the window. A plain <c>GetTexture().GetImage().SavePng()</c> wrote those linear values, so every screenshot (the site's gallery included) came out much darker than the game, shadows most of all. The conversion runs on float data before the 8-bit quantisation, so dark gradients do not band. </remarks>
public static class ViewportCapture{/// <summary>The current frame of <paramref name="viewport"/> as RGBA8 sRGB, or null without a frame.</summary>
public static Image Take(Viewport viewport){var image=viewport.GetTexture()?.GetImage();if(image==null|| !viewport.UseHdr2D)return image;image.Convert(Image.Format.Rgbaf);var floats=MemoryMarshal.Cast<byte,float>(image.GetData());var bytes=new byte[floats.Length];for(var i=0;i<floats.Length;i++){var v=Math.Clamp(floats[i],0f,1f);if(i%4!=3)v=v<=0.0031308f?v*12.92f:1.055f*MathF.Pow(v,1f/2.4f)-0.055f;bytes[i]=(byte)MathF.Round(v*255f);}return Image.CreateFromData(image.GetWidth(),image.GetHeight(),false,Image.Format.Rgba8,bytes);}/// <summary>Saves the current frame of <paramref name="viewport"/> as a PNG; false without a frame.</summary>
public static bool SavePng(Viewport viewport,string path){var image=Take(viewport);return image!=null&&image.SavePng(path)==Error.Ok;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Declarative map "scenario action → named argument → <see cref="ValidationKind"/>" for actions whose arguments reference declared content. The runtime <c>IScenarioAction</c> contract carries no parameter metadata, so the validator keeps the knowledge here instead: each entry names one action argument and the entity kind it must resolve to. Scenario validation adds a graph reference per literal value (see <see cref="ScenarioCommandValidationStrategy"/>), and <see cref="ReferenceStrategy"/> reports a missing declaration with the exact scenario file and line — the static answer to the typo class the runtime factories can only log. <para/> The table intentionally covers only actions with literal content ids today (party.add / character.send_notification / character.add_skill / battle.init). Comma-separated lists (battle.init enemies=) and runtime-computed values (the ${name} marker) are supported by the caller, not here. </summary>

public static bool TryGetKinds(string actionName,out IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string>kinds){return Table.TryGetValue(actionName,out kinds);}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Contracts. Parses every mod's declared C# sources with Roslyn and extracts typed property accesses (<c>GetInt("Turn")</c>, <c>SetFloat("Attack", ...)</c>) from <c>DataBlob</c>, <c>PropertyData</c> and <c>ActionCharacter</c>, which share the same method names. The analysis is syntactic on purpose: it needs no metadata references, so it runs on the background thread and never triggers assembly loading. Findings: non-literal keys (<c>DYNAMIC_KEY</c>, info), the same key used with different value types (<c>TYPE_CONFLICT</c>, error), reads of keys that are neither declared in JSON nor written anywhere (<c>READ_UNDECLARED</c> / <c>READ_UNDECLARED_WITH_DEFAULT</c>), and writes that no code ever reads (<c>WRITE_UNUSED</c>, info). </summary>
public class CSharpPropertyStrategy:IValidationStrategy{private static readonly Dictionary<string,string>TypeByMethod=new(StringComparer.Ordinal){{"GetInt","int"},{"SetInt","int"},{"GetFloat","float"},{"SetFloat","float"},{"GetString","string"},{"SetString","string"},{"GetStr","string"},{"SetStr","string"},{"GetBool","bool"},{"SetBool","bool"},{"GetLong","long"},{"SetLong","long"},};public string Id=>"csharp_properties";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Contracts;public int Order=>200;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.CSharp;/// <summary>Scans mod C# sources for DataBlob key usages and checks the keys against the persisted blobs, reporting unknown or mistyped keys.</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var usages=new List<CodePropertyUsage>();var literalCounts=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();foreach(var file in CollectSources(mod)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();ParseSource(mod.Id,file.Path,file.Source,usages,literalCounts);}}ReportDynamicKeys(context,usages);ReportTypeConflicts(context,usages);ReportUndeclaredReads(context,usages);ReportUnusedWrites(context,usages,literalCounts);}private static List<(string Path,string Source)>CollectSources(IModInfo mod){var result=new List<(string Path,string Source)>();var provider=mod.FileProvider;if(provider==null)return result;var patterns=(mod as ModInfo)?.Manifest?.Sources;if(patterns!=null&&patterns.Count>0){foreach(var pattern in patterns){var prefix=pattern;var suffix="*.cs";var separator=pattern.LastIndexOf('/');if(separator>=0){prefix=pattern.Substring(0,separator);suffix=pattern.Substring(separator+1);}foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,prefix,true)){if(!MatchesSource(file,suffix))continue;var source=provider.ReadFileText(file);if(source!=null)result.Add((file,source));}}}if(result.Count==0){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,string.Empty,true)){if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var source=provider.ReadFileText(file);if(source!=null)result.Add((file,source));}}return result;}private static bool MatchesSource(string file,string suffix){if(!file.EndsWith(".cs",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return false;if(suffix=="*"||suffix=="*.cs")return true;if(suffix.StartsWith("*.",StringComparison.Ordinal))return file.EndsWith(suffix.Substring(1),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return file.EndsWith(suffix,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}private static void ParseSource(string modId,string path,string source,List<CodePropertyUsage>usages,Dictionary<string,int>literalCounts){var tree=CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source,new CSharpParseOptions(),path);var root=tree.GetRoot();foreach(var token in root.DescendantTokens()){if(!token.IsKind(SyntaxKind.StringLiteralToken))continue;var text=token.ValueText;literalCounts.TryGetValue(text,out var count);literalCounts[text]=count+1;}foreach(var node in root.DescendantNodes()){if(node is not InvocationExpressionSyntax invocation)continue;if(invocation.Expression is not MemberAccessExpressionSyntax member)continue;var method=member.Name.Identifier.ValueText;if(!TypeByMethod.TryGetValue(method,out var type))continue;var arguments=invocation.ArgumentList.Arguments;if(arguments.Count==0)continue;var key=TryGetLiteralKey(arguments[0].Expression);// A helper of the shape GetString(value, "Name", "ID", ...) has nothing to do with property bags, so it must not surface as a dynamic-key finding.
if(key==null&&HasOnlyStringLiteralTail(arguments))continue;usages.Add(new CodePropertyUsage{ModId=modId,File=path,Line=invocation.GetLocation().GetLineSpan().StartLinePosition.Line+1,Key=key,Type=type,IsWrite=method.StartsWith("Set",StringComparison.Ordinal),HasDefault=arguments.Count>1,Method=method,});}}private static string TryGetLiteralKey(ExpressionSyntax expression){if(expression is LiteralExpressionSyntax literal&&literal.IsKind(SyntaxKind.StringLiteralExpression))return literal.Token.ValueText;return null;}private static bool HasOnlyStringLiteralTail(SeparatedSyntaxList<ArgumentSyntax>arguments){if(arguments.Count<2)return false;for(var i=1;i<arguments.Count;i++){if(arguments[i].Expression is not LiteralExpressionSyntax literal|| !literal.IsKind(SyntaxKind.StringLiteralExpression))return false;}return true;}private static void ReportDynamicKeys(ValidationContext context,List<CodePropertyUsage>usages){foreach(var usage in usages){if(usage.Key!=null)continue;context.AddInfo("DYNAMIC_KEY",$"{usage.Method}(...) uses a non-literal key; static analysis skipped",usage.ModId,usage.File,usage.Line);}}private static void ReportTypeConflicts(ValidationContext context,List<CodePropertyUsage>usages){var byKey=new Dictionary<string,List<CodePropertyUsage>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var usage in usages){if(usage.Key==null)continue;if(!byKey.TryGetValue(usage.Key,out var list)){list=new List<CodePropertyUsage>();byKey[usage.Key]=list;}list.Add(usage);}foreach(var entry in byKey){var types=new List<string>();foreach(var usage in entry.Value){if(!types.Contains(usage.Type))types.Add(usage.Type);}if(types.Count<2)continue;var first=entry.Value[0];var related=new List<string>();for(var i=1;i<entry.Value.Count;i++){var other=entry.Value[i];related.Add($"{other.ModId}:{other.File}:{other.Line} ({other.Type})");}context.AddError("TYPE_CONFLICT",$"property '{entry.Key}' is accessed as {string.Join(", ", types)}",first.ModId,first.File,first.Line,"use one type for all readers and writers of this property",related);}}private static void ReportUndeclaredReads(ValidationContext context,List<CodePropertyUsage>usages){var writeKeys=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var usage in usages){if(usage.IsWrite&&usage.Key!=null)writeKeys.Add(usage.Key);}var reported=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var usage in usages){if(usage.IsWrite||usage.Key==null)continue;if(context.Graph.IsKeyDeclared(usage.Key)||writeKeys.Contains(usage.Key))continue;if(!reported.Add(usage.ModId+"|"+usage.File+"|"+usage.Key))continue;var message=$"property '{usage.Key}' is read as {usage.Type} but is never declared or written";var suggestion="declare the property in JSON (Values/extra fields) or write it before reading";if(usage.HasDefault)context.AddWarning("READ_UNDECLARED_WITH_DEFAULT",message,usage.ModId,usage.File,usage.Line,suggestion);else context.AddError("READ_UNDECLARED",message,usage.ModId,usage.File,usage.Line,suggestion);}}private static void ReportUnusedWrites(ValidationContext context,List<CodePropertyUsage>usages,Dictionary<string,int>literalCounts){var readKeys=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var writeCounts=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var usage in usages){if(usage.Key==null)continue;if(usage.IsWrite){writeCounts.TryGetValue(usage.Key,out var count);writeCounts[usage.Key]=count+1;}else{readKeys.Add(usage.Key);}}var reported=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var usage in usages){if(!usage.IsWrite||usage.Key==null)continue;if(readKeys.Contains(usage.Key))continue;if(!reported.Add(usage.ModId+"|"+usage.Key))continue;// A key that appears as a string literal more often using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Reconciliation. Checks manifest <c>depends</c> entries: malformed strings, required dependencies missing from the loaded set, and circular dependency chains. The registry already filters mods with broken dependencies at load time and the compiler only logs a warning for cycles, so this strategy is what turns those silent conditions into reportable findings. </summary>
public class DependsStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"depends";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Reconciliation;public int Order=>100;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;/// <summary>Re-checks every manifest's depends pins and cycles, reporting broken chains the loader only logs at runtime.</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var manifests=new Dictionary<string,ModManifest>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var manifest=(mod as ModInfo)?.Manifest;if(manifest!=null)manifests[mod.Id]=manifest;}foreach(var entry in manifests){var depends=entry.Value.Depends;if(depends==null)continue;foreach(var dependency in depends){if(!dependency.IsValid){context.AddError("SCHEMA_WRONG_TYPE",$"invalid dependency string: {dependency.Error}",entry.Key,"manifest.json",0,"use format modId[op][version][?]");continue;}if(dependency.IsOptional||manifests.ContainsKey(dependency.ModId))continue;context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"required dependency '{dependency.ModId}' is not loaded",entry.Key,"manifest.json",0,$"install mod '{dependency.ModId}' or mark the dependency optional with '?'");}}DetectCycles(context,manifests);}private static void DetectCycles(ValidationContext context,Dictionary<string,ModManifest>manifests){var state=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);var path=new List<string>();var reported=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var modId in manifests.Keys)Visit(context,manifests,modId,state,path,reported);}private static void Visit(ValidationContext context,Dictionary<string,ModManifest>manifests,string modId,Dictionary<string,int>state,List<string>path,HashSet<string>reported){if(state.TryGetValue(modId,out var existing)){if(existing==1)ReportCycle(context,modId,path,reported);return;}state[modId]=1;path.Add(modId);var depends=manifests[modId].Depends;if(depends!=null){foreach(var dependency in depends){if(!dependency.IsValid|| !manifests.ContainsKey(dependency.ModId))continue;Visit(context,manifests,dependency.ModId,state,path,reported);}}path.RemoveAt(path.Count-1);state[modId]=2;}private static void ReportCycle(ValidationContext context,string repeated,List<string>path,HashSet<string>reported){var start= -1;for(var i=0;i<path.Count;i++){if(string.Equals(path[i],repeated,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){start=i;break;}}if(start<0)return;var cycle=new List<string>();for(var i=start;i<path.Count;i++)cycle.Add(path[i]);cycle.Add(repeated);var key=BuildCycleKey(cycle);if(!reported.Add(key))return;context.AddError("REF_CIRCULAR",$"circular dependency: {string.Join(" -> ", cycle)}",repeated,"manifest.json",0,"break the cycle by removing one of the dependencies");}private static string BuildCycleKey(List<string>cycle){var sorted=new List<string>(cycle);sorted.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);return string.Join("|",sorted);}}}

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Shared extraction helpers for <see cref="IEntityKindStrategy"/> implementations. Keeps the per-kind strategies focused on "what is interesting about my entities" while the mechanical work — walking declared object keys, action property keys, loot and ingredient references — lives in one place. All helpers are schema-light (case-insensitive raw <see cref="JsonElement"/> reads) so they survive DTO field changes. </summary>
public static class EntityFactCollector{/// <summary>Declares every top-level property name of an entity as a known key.</summary>
public static void CollectObjectKeys(ValidationGraph graph,JsonElement entity){if(entity.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object)return;foreach(var property in entity.EnumerateObject())graph.AddDeclaredKey(property.Name);}/// <summary>Declares the <c>Key=Value</c> property bag keys of an action's <c>Values</c> array.</summary>
public static void CollectActionKeys(ValidationGraph graph,JsonElement values){foreach(var value in values.EnumerateArray()){if(value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String)continue;var text=value.GetString();if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))continue;var separator=text.IndexOf('=');if(separator>0)graph.AddDeclaredKey(text.Substring(0,separator));}}/// <summary>Records item references from a recipe's ingredient array (e.g. <c>Input</c>, <c>Output</c>).</summary>
public static void CollectIngredientReferences(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,string file,JsonElement entity,string field){var ingredients=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(entity,field);if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(ingredients))return;foreach(var ingredient in ingredients.Value.EnumerateArray()){var itemId=JsonReadHelper.GetString(ingredient,"Id","ID","id");if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(itemId))context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Item,itemId,mod.Id,file,0);}}/// <summary>Records item references from a character's <c>Loot</c> table.</summary>
public static void CollectLootReferences(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,string file,JsonElement entity){var loot=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(entity,"Loot");if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(loot))return;foreach(var drop in loot.Value.EnumerateArray()){var itemId=JsonReadHelper.GetString(drop,"ItemId");if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(itemId))context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Item,itemId,mod.Id,file,0);}}/// <summary>Records action references from a character's <c>Actions</c> array.</summary>
public static void CollectActionReferences(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,string file,JsonElement entity){var actions=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(entity,"Actions");if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(actions))return;foreach(var action in actions.Value.EnumerateArray()){if(action.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String)continue;var actionId=action.GetString();if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(actionId))context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Action,actionId,mod.Id,file,0);}}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Registry of <see cref="IEntityKindStrategy"/> implementations, indexed by the entity kind each one handles. It discovers nothing itself: <see cref="EntityKindStrategyConsumer"/> delivers the strategies of every mod as the kernel registers its assembly and takes them back when the mod unloads, so the map never holds a strategy of a dead assembly. Adding kind handling is just shipping a new public class with a parameterless constructor in any mod. </summary>
public static class EntityKindStrategyRegistry{private static readonly object sync=new();private static readonly Dictionary<string,IEntityKindStrategy>strategies=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary> Returns the strategy registered for the entity kind, or <c>null</c> when no strategy claims it — the caller reports the unknown kind as a validation warning. </summary>
public static IEntityKindStrategy Resolve(string kind){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(kind))return null;lock(sync){strategies.TryGetValue(kind,out var strategy);return strategy;}}/// <summary> Registers a strategy under its kind. The first strategy of a kind wins; a second one is reported as an error and ignored. </summary>
public static void Register(IEntityKindStrategy strategy){if(strategy==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strategy.Kind))return;lock(sync){if(strategies.TryGetValue(strategy.Kind,out var existing)){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"entity kind '{strategy.Kind}' is handled by both '{existing.GetType().Name}' and '{strategy.GetType().Name}'; keeping the first",LogLevel.Error);return;}strategies[strategy.Kind]=strategy;}}/// <summary> Removes <paramref name="strategy"/> (its mod is being unloaded). A kind owned by another strategy instance is left alone. </summary>
public static void Unregister(IEntityKindStrategy strategy){if(strategy==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strategy.Kind))return;lock(sync){if(strategies.TryGetValue(strategy.Kind,out var registered)&&registered==strategy)strategies.Remove(strategy.Kind);}}}}

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> One collection strategy per entity kind, discovered by reflection like every other plugin point in the project (<c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c>). The JSON entity walker (<see cref="JsonEntityStrategy"/>) scans every file once, reads the envelope's <c>"Kind"</c> and delegates the items to the strategy registered for that kind — so adding a new entity type means shipping one class, not editing a switch. <para/> A strategy fills <see cref="ValidationContext.Graph"/> with declarations and references for its kind. It must not throw on malformed data: missing ids are skipped silently, missing references are reported through the context. </summary>
public interface IEntityKindStrategy{/// <summary> Entity kind this strategy handles — matches the <c>"Kind"</c> string in the JSON envelope and the <see cref="ValidationKind"/> used in the graph. Duplicate kinds across strategies are logged and the first discovery wins. </summary>
string Kind{get;}/// <summary> Collects facts for one file of this strategy's kind. The caller has already verified the envelope shape and that the declared kind matches <see cref="Kind"/>. </summary> <param name="context">Validation pass state and report sink.</param> <param name="mod">Mod that owns the file.</param> <param name="file">Mod-relative file path, used as the declaration/reference source.</param> <param name="items">The envelope's <c>Items</c> array.</param>

namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> One self-contained validation step, discovered by reflection like every other plugin point in the project (<c>Reflections.FindAndCreate</c>). Strategies run sequentially in (Phase, Order, Id) order on the validator background thread: Schema strategies validate source shapes, Contracts strategies fill <see cref="ValidationContext.Graph"/> with declarations, references and code usages, and Reconciliation strategies compare those facts and emit findings. To add scenario validation, implement this interface in a new class: extract declarations and references into the graph in the Contracts phase and match them in Reconciliation — no service changes are needed. </summary>
public interface IValidationStrategy{/// <summary>Stable identifier used in logs and in the sort order.</summary>
string Id{get;}/// <summary>Execution stage; strategies of earlier phases run first.</summary>
ValidationPhase Phase{get;}/// <summary>Order inside the phase; lower runs first.</summary>
int Order{get;}/// <summary>Capability group gated by the user settings.</summary>
ValidationFeature Feature{get;}/// <summary> Runs the strategy. Data problems must be reported through the <see cref="ValidationContext"/> and must not throw; unexpected exceptions are caught and logged by <see cref="ValidatorService"/>. </summary>
void Validate(ValidationContext context);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Contracts. Walks every mod's JSON entities the same way the runtime resolver does — every <c>.json</c> file is opened and routed by its top-level <c>"Kind"</c>, with <c>${include}</c> expansion applied — and records declarations and references in the shared graph. Files without a kind (manifests, collections, live2d models, scene definitions, patches) are not entity data and are skipped; scene and interactive definitions plus raw asset files keep their directory-based collection. It also validates manifest <c>ui</c>/<c>main_menu</c> <c>scene_path</c> entries against the owning mod's files and turns <c>ui[].scene</c> into a scene reference. Extraction is intentionally schema-light (raw <see cref="JsonDocument"/> plus case-insensitive reads) so it keeps working when DTOs gain fields and so it can run on the background thread without touching Godot types that some DTOs embed. </summary>
public class JsonEntityStrategy:IValidationStrategy{private static readonly HashSet<string>EffectExtensions=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){".tscn",".scn"};public string Id=>"json_entities";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Contracts;public int Order=>100;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;/// <summary>Walks every mod's JSON entities, scene definitions, interactives and texture assets, recording declarations and references into the fact graph.</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var provider=mod.FileProvider;if(provider==null)continue;CollectEntities(context,mod,provider);CollectSceneDefinitions(context,mod,provider);CollectEnvelopes(context,mod,provider,"interactives",true,ValidationKind.Interactive);var textureExtensions=ModConfig.Instance.GetTextureExtensionSet();CollectAssets(context,mod,provider,"backgrounds",ValidationKind.Background,textureExtensions);CollectAssets(context,mod,provider,"avatars",ValidationKind.Avatar,textureExtensions);var audioExtensions=new HashSet<string>(ModConfig.Instance.AudioExtensions,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);CollectAssets(context,mod,provider,"music",ValidationKind.Music,audioExtensions);CollectAssets(context,mod,provider,"sounds",ValidationKind.Sound,audioExtensions);CollectAssets(context,mod,provider,"effects",ValidationKind.Effect,EffectExtensions);ValidateManifestEntries(context,mod,provider);}}/// <summary> Scans every JSON file of the mod and routes it by its declared <c>"Kind"</c>, mirroring the runtime <c>EntityResolver</c>. The kind resolves to an <see cref="IEntityKindStrategy"/> that records the declarations, declared keys and references for that entity type — so an action can no longer be mistaken for a character just because both lived in the same directory, and a new kind is a new strategy class instead of a new switch case. </summary>
private static void CollectEntities(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,string.Empty,true)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!file.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var document=ReadDocument(context,mod,file);if(document==null)continue;using(document){var kind=JsonReadHelper.GetString(document.RootElement,"Kind","kind");if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(kind))continue;var envelope=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(document.RootElement,"Items");if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(envelope))continue;var strategy=EntityKindStrategyRegistry.Resolve(kind);if(strategy==null){context.AddWarning("UNKNOWN_ENTITY_KIND",$"unknown entity kind '{kind}'",mod.Id,file,0);continue;}strategy.Collect(context,mod,file,envelope.Value);}}}private static void CollectSceneDefinitions(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,"scenes",true)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!file.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var document=ReadDocument(context,mod,file);if(document==null)continue;using(document){var name=JsonReadHelper.GetString(document.RootElement,"name","Name");if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)){context.AddWarning("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD","scene definition has no 'name'",mod.Id,file);continue;}context.Graph.AddDeclaration(ValidationKind.Scene,name,mod.Id,file,0);CollectBackgroundReferences(context,mod,document.RootElement,file);}}}private static void CollectEnvelopes(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider,string directory,bool recursive,string kind){var documents=new List<JsonDocument>();var items=new List<JsonElement>();try{OpenEnvelopes(context,mod,provider,directory,recursive,documents,items);foreach(var item in items){var id=JsonReadHelper.GetString(item,"Id","ID","id");context.Graph.AddDeclaration(kind,id,mod.Id,directory,0);}}finally{DisposeAll(documents);}}private static void CollectAssets(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider,string directory,string kind,HashSet<string>extensions){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,directory,true)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!ModFileReader.HasExtension(file,extensions))continue;var prefixLength=directory.Length+1;var relative=file.Length>prefixLength?file.Substring(prefixLength):file;var dot=relative.LastIndexOf('.');if(dot<=0)continue;context.Graph.AddDeclaration(kind,relative.Substring(0,dot),mod.Id,file,0);}}private static void ValidateManifestEntries(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider){var manifest=(mod as ModInfo)?.Manifest;if(manifest==null)return;if(manifest.Ui!=null){foreach(var entry in manifest.Ui){if(entry==null)continue;if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.ScenePath)&& !provider.FileExists(entry.ScenePath))context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"ui scene_path '{entry.ScenePath}' not found in mod '{mod.Id}'",mod.Id,"manifest.json",0,"fix scene_path or add the scene file");if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Scene)&& !string.Equals(entry.Scene,"shell",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Scene,entry.Scene,mod.Id,"manifest.json",0);}}if(manifest.MainMenu!=null){foreach(var entry in manifest.MainMenu){if(entry==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.ScenePath))continue;if(!provider.FileExists(entry.ScenePath))context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"main_menu scene_path '{entry.ScenePath}' not found in mod '{mod.Id}'",mod.Id,"manifest.json",0,"fix scene_path or add the scene file");}}}private static void OpenEnvelopes(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,IModFileProvider provider,string directory,bool recursive,List<JsonDocument>documents,List<JsonElement>items){foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,directory,recursive)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!file.EndsWith(".json",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;var document=ReadDocument(context,mod,file);if(document==null)continue;var envelope=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(document.RootElement,"Items");if(!JsonReadHelper.IsArray(envelope)){document.Dispose();continue;}documents.Add(document);foreach(var item in envelope.Value.EnumerateArray())items.Add(item);}}private static JsonDocument ReadDocument(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,string file){string text;try{text=ModFileReader.ReadResolved(mod.FileProvider,file);}catch(Exception ex){context.AddError("JSON_PARSE_ERROR",$"include resolution failed: {ex.Message}",mod.Id,file);return null;}if(text==null)return null;try{return JsonDocument.Parse(text,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);}catch(JsonException ex){context.AddError("JSON_PARSE_ERROR",$"invalid JSON: {ex.Message}",mod.Id,file);return null;}}private static void CollectBackgroundReferences(ValidationContext context,IModInfo mod,JsonElement root,string file){var background=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(root,"defaultBackground","DefaultBackground");if(background==null)return;if(background.Value.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.String){context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Background,background.Value.GetString(),mod.Id,file,0);return;}if(background.Value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Array)return;foreach(var entry in background.Value.EnumerateArray()){if(entry.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.String)context.Graph.AddReference(ValidationKind.Background,entry.GetString(),mod.Id,file,0);}}private static void DisposeAll(List<JsonDocument>documents){foreach(var document in documents)document.Dispose();}}}

using System;using System.Text.Json;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Case-insensitive reads over <see cref="JsonElement"/> used by the JSON contract strategy. Mod JSON deliberately mixes naming styles (<c>"Id"</c>, <c>"id"</c>, <c>"defaultBackground"</c>) and the runtime reads it with case-insensitive options, so the validator must not depend on exact casing either. </summary>
public static class JsonReadHelper{/// <summary> Returns the first matching property by exact name, then by case-insensitive comparison. Null when the element is not an object or no name matches. </summary>
public static JsonElement?GetProperty(JsonElement element,params string[]names){if(element.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.Object)return null;foreach(var name in names){if(element.TryGetProperty(name,out var exact))return exact;}foreach(var property in element.EnumerateObject()){foreach(var name in names){if(string.Equals(property.Name,name,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return property.Value;}}return null;}/// <summary>Returns the string value of the first matching property, or null.</summary>
public static string GetString(JsonElement element,params string[]names){var value=GetProperty(element,names);if(value==null||value.Value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String)return null;return value.Value.GetString();}/// <summary>True when the element exists and is an array.</summary>
public static bool IsArray(JsonElement?element)=>element!=null&&element.Value.ValueKind==JsonValueKind.Array;}}

using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Schema. Validates the mandatory shape of every mod's <c>manifest.json</c>: <c>id</c> and <c>version</c> must be present and be strings, and <c>id</c> must not be empty. The runtime silently falls back to the filesystem entry name for a missing id and tolerates a missing version, so these are exactly the problems an author should fix before publishing. </summary>
public class ManifestSchemaStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"manifest_schema";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Schema;public int Order=>100;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;/// <summary>Checks the required manifest.json fields: non-empty string id and string version.</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var text=mod.FileProvider?.ReadFileText("manifest.json");if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)){context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD","manifest.json is missing or empty",mod.Id,"manifest.json");continue;}JsonDocument document;try{document=JsonDocument.Parse(text,JsonOptionsProvider.DocumentOptions);}catch(JsonException ex){context.AddError("JSON_PARSE_ERROR",$"manifest.json is not valid JSON: {ex.Message}",mod.Id,"manifest.json");continue;}using(document){ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"id",required:true);ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"version",required:true);ValidateStringField(context,mod.Id,document.RootElement,"name",required:false);}}}private static void ValidateStringField(ValidationContext context,string modId,JsonElement root,string field,bool required){var value=JsonReadHelper.GetProperty(root,field);if(value==null){if(required)context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD",$"manifest.json has no '{field}'",modId,"manifest.json");return;}if(value.Value.ValueKind!=JsonValueKind.String){context.AddError("SCHEMA_WRONG_TYPE",$"'{field}' must be a string",modId,"manifest.json");return;}if(required&&string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Value.GetString()))context.AddError("SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD",$"'{field}' must not be empty",modId,"manifest.json");}}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Resolvers;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Pure .NET file access used by validation strategies. Works with both folder and zip providers through <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> and resolves the project's <c>${include}</c> directives with the same public helper the runtime resolvers use, so the validator sees exactly the JSON the game will see. Safe on the background validation thread because it touches neither Godot nor the resolver caches. </summary>
public static class ModFileReader{/// <summary> Lists files under a mod-relative directory. Directories are pushed onto the work stack only when <paramref name="recursive"/> is set, so the caller can mirror the recursive entity scan or the recursive scene scan. </summary>
public static List<string>ListFiles(IModFileProvider provider,string directory,bool recursive){var result=new List<string>();if(provider==null)return result;var pending=new Stack<string>();pending.Push(directory??string.Empty);while(pending.Count>0){var current=pending.Pop();foreach(var entry in provider.ListFiles(current)){if(entry.EndsWith("/")){if(recursive)pending.Push(entry.TrimEnd('/'));continue;}result.Add(entry);}}return result;}/// <summary> Reads a mod file and expands every <c>${path}</c> include. Returns null when the file is absent; include failures propagate as <see cref="InvalidOperationException"/> so the caller can report them with the owning file name. </summary>
public static string ReadResolved(IModFileProvider provider,string path){var content=provider.ReadFileText(path);if(content==null)return null;var visited=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase){path};return ModResolutionContext.ExpandModIncludes(provider,content,path,visited);}/// <summary>True when the file path ends with one of the given extensions.</summary>
public static bool HasExtension(string path,HashSet<string>extensions){var dot=path.LastIndexOf('.');return dot>0&&extensions.Contains(path.Substring(dot));}}}

namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Reconciliation. Matches every reference collected by contract strategies against the declarations in the graph and reports <c>REF_NOT_FOUND</c> for the missing ones. Because the graph is global, a reference in one mod may resolve to a declaration in another — exactly how the runtime factories and scene loader resolve content. </summary>
public class ReferenceStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"references";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Reconciliation;public int Order=>200;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;/// <summary>Reports every recorded reference whose target id has no declaration in the merged fact graph (REF_NOT_FOUND).</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){foreach(var reference in context.Graph.References){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(context.Graph.HasDeclaration(reference.Kind,reference.TargetId))continue;context.AddError("REF_NOT_FOUND",$"{reference.Kind} '{reference.TargetId}' is referenced but never declared",reference.ModId,reference.File,reference.Line,$"declare {reference.Kind} '{reference.TargetId}' or fix the reference");}}}}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Text.Json;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Persists the completed <see cref="ValidationReport"/> as JSON. Called from the background validation task, so it relies only on plain <c>System.IO</c>; the Godot-style directory is resolved to an absolute path earlier, on the main thread, by <see cref="ValidatorSettings.GetReportDirectory"/>. </summary>
public static class ReportWriter{/// <summary>File name inside the configured report directory.</summary>
public const string FileName="report.json";/// <summary> Writes the report and returns the absolute path, or null when the directory could not be resolved or the write failed. Never throws — a failed report must not interrupt the game. </summary>
public static string Write(ValidationReport report,string directory){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(directory)){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR","validator: report directory is not resolved",LogLevel.Error);return null;}try{Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);var path=Path.Combine(directory,FileName);var json=JsonSerializer.Serialize(report,JsonOptionsProvider.WriteIndentedOptions);File.WriteAllText(path,json);GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: report written to {path}");return path;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: report write failed: {ex.Message}",LogLevel.Error);return null;}}}}

public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var sceneKeys=CollectSceneKeys(context);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();var provider=mod.FileProvider;if(provider==null)continue;foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,ScenePatchResolver.PatchDirectory,true)){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(!file.EndsWith(".tscn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))continue;ValidatePatch(context,mod,provider,file,sceneKeys);}}}private static HashSet<string>CollectSceneKeys(ValidationContext context){var keys=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var mod in context.Mods){var provider=mod.FileProvider;if(provider==null)continue;foreach(var file in ModFileReader.ListFiles(provider,"scenes",true)){if(file.EndsWith(".tscn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||file.EndsWith(".scn",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))keys.Add(file.Replace('\\','/'));}}return
