using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Phase: Reconciliation. Reports declarations that no static reference points at. Coverage is deliberately limited to kinds whose references are fully collected today — items (loot, recipe ingredients) and actions (character action lists). Backgrounds, avatars and scenes are consumed mostly from <c>.scenario</c> files, so they stay out until a scenario strategy contributes those references; otherwise every asset would be flagged. </summary>
public class UnusedDeclarationStrategy:IValidationStrategy{public string Id=>"unused_declarations";public ValidationPhase Phase=>ValidationPhase.Reconciliation;public int Order=>300;public ValidationFeature Feature=>ValidationFeature.Json;/// <summary>Reports items and actions that are declared but never referenced (DECL_UNUSED).</summary>
public void Validate(ValidationContext context){var used=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);foreach(var reference in context.Graph.References)used.Add(Key(reference.Kind,reference.TargetId));foreach(var declaration in context.Graph.Declarations){context.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();if(declaration.Kind!=ValidationKind.Item&&declaration.Kind!=ValidationKind.Action)continue;if(used.Contains(Key(declaration.Kind,declaration.Id)))continue;context.AddInfo("DECL_UNUSED",$"{declaration.Kind} '{declaration.Id}' is never referenced statically",declaration.ModId,declaration.File,declaration.Line);}}private static string Key(string kind,string id)=>kind+"|"+id;}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Everything a strategy needs: the mod snapshot, the report to fill, the shared fact graph and the cancellation token. Instances are created per pass on the validator background thread; strategies run sequentially, so no locking is required inside the context or the graph. </summary>
public class ValidationContext{public ValidationContext(IReadOnlyList<IModInfo>mods,ValidationReport report,ValidationGraph graph,CancellationToken cancellationToken){Mods=mods;Report=report;Graph=graph;CancellationToken=cancellationToken;}/// <summary>Ordered snapshot of the mods to validate.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<IModInfo>Mods{get;}/// <summary>Report being assembled; strategies append issues to it.</summary>
public ValidationReport Report{get;}/// <summary>Facts collected by contract strategies.</summary>
public ValidationGraph Graph{get;}/// <summary>Cooperative cancellation checked between mods and documents.</summary>

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Shared fact base of a validation pass. Contract strategies append to it and reconciliation strategies query it, which keeps cross-cutting checks (missing references, type conflicts, unused declarations) independent of the parser that produced the facts. A scenario strategy added later only needs to call <see cref="AddDeclaration"/> and <see cref="AddReference"/>. The graph is filled and read sequentially by one background thread, so it needs no synchronisation; it is never exposed to the main thread. </summary>
public class ValidationGraph{private readonly Dictionary<string,List<ValidationDeclaration>>declarations=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);private readonly List<ValidationReference>references=new();private readonly HashSet<string>declaredKeys=new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);/// <summary>All references collected so far.</summary>
public IReadOnlyList<ValidationReference>References=>references;/// <summary>All declarations collected so far, flattened across kinds.</summary>
public IEnumerable<ValidationDeclaration>Declarations=>declarations.Values.SelectMany(list=>list);/// <summary> Registers an entity declaration. Empty kinds/ids are ignored so parsers can call this without nil-checks. </summary>
public void AddDeclaration(string kind,string id,string modId,string file,int line){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(kind)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id))return;if(!declarations.TryGetValue(kind,out var list)){list=new List<ValidationDeclaration>();declarations[kind]=list;}list.Add(new ValidationDeclaration{Kind=kind,Id=id,ModId=modId,File=file,Line=line,});}/// <summary> Registers a reference to an entity. Empty kinds/targets are ignored. </summary>
public void AddReference(string kind,string targetId,string modId,string file,int line){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(kind)||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetId))return;references.Add(new ValidationReference{Kind=kind,TargetId=targetId,ModId=modId,File=file,Line=line,});}/// <summary> Registers a property key seen in JSON entity data. Used by the C# strategy to distinguish declared properties from typos. </summary>
public void AddDeclaredKey(string key){if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))declaredKeys.Add(key);}/// <summary>True when at least one declaration of the given kind and id exists.</summary>
public bool HasDeclaration(string kind,string id){return declarations.TryGetValue(kind,out var list)&&list.Any(d=>string.Equals(d.Id,id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));}/// <summary>True when the key was seen in any JSON entity or action Values list.</summary>
public bool IsKeyDeclared(string key)=>declaredKeys.Contains(key);}}

===== FILE mods/validator/src/ValidationStrategyRegistry.cs =====
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Registry of all <see cref="IValidationStrategy"/> implementations, served in deterministic execution order. It discovers nothing itself: <see cref="ValidationStrategyConsumer"/> delivers the strategies of every mod as the kernel registers its assembly and takes them back when the mod unloads (game switch, hot reload), so a validation run never executes a strategy of a dead assembly. Adding a new strategy (for example scenario validation) is just shipping a new public class with a parameterless constructor in any mod. </summary>
public static class ValidationStrategyRegistry{private static readonly object sync=new();private static readonly List<IValidationStrategy>strategies=new();/// <summary>Returns a snapshot of the registered strategies sorted by phase and order.</summary>
public static IReadOnlyList<IValidationStrategy>GetStrategies(){lock(sync)return strategies.ToArray();}/// <summary>Adds a strategy and keeps the execution order.</summary>
public static void Register(IValidationStrategy strategy){if(strategy==null)return;lock(sync){strategies.Add(strategy);strategies.Sort(Compare);}}/// <summary>Removes exactly <paramref name="strategy"/> (its mod is being unloaded).</summary>
public static void Unregister(IValidationStrategy strategy){lock(sync)strategies.Remove(strategy);}private static int Compare(IValidationStrategy a,IValidationStrategy b){var phase=a.Phase.CompareTo(b.Phase);if(phase!=0)return phase;var order=a.Order.CompareTo(b.Order);if(order!=0)return order;return string.Compare(a.Id,b.Id,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);}}}

using Cthangover.Core.Mods;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Lifecycle entry point of the validator mod. <see cref="OnModResourcesReady"/> is the earliest moment when every mod has been discovered, compiled and registered, so it is the only reliable trigger for a global pass — the mod list cannot be assembled from <see cref="IModInitializer.OnModLoaded"/>, because asset-only mods (JSON/PNG without code) never produce an assembly and therefore never raise <c>ModLoadedEvent</c>. The hook runs on the main thread; all Godot-bound work (settings load, <c>user://</c> path resolution) happens inside <see cref="ValidatorService.Start"/>, and the validation itself continues on a background task so the game start is never blocked. On unload (or re-registration during an in-process reload) the pass in flight is stopped, see <see cref="ValidatorService.Stop"/>. </summary>
public class ValidatorInitializer:IModInitializer,IModUnloadAware{/// <summary> Intentionally empty: asset-only mods are invisible to this callback, so the validator always works from the complete <c>ModRegistry</c> snapshot taken in <see cref="ValidatorService.Start"/> instead of accumulating mods here. </summary>
public void OnModLoaded(string modId){}/// <summary> Starts the background validation pass once all mods and their JSON resources are available. </summary>
public void OnModResourcesReady(){ValidatorService.Start();}/// <summary>Stops the background pass while the validator's types are still alive.</summary>
public void OnModUnloading(){ValidatorService.Stop();}/// <summary>Nothing to drop: the validator keeps no references to other mods between passes.</summary>
public void OnModUnloaded(string modId){}}}

using System;using Cthangover.Mods.Dialog.Scenarios;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Threading;using System.Threading.Tasks;using Cthangover.Core.Factories.Impls;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> Orchestrates the validator pass. <see cref="Start"/> is called on the main thread and returns immediately: it snapshots the ordered mod list and the resolved report directory, then hands pure .NET work to a background task so the game start is never blocked. The background task may touch only <see cref="IModInfo"/> and <see cref="IModFileProvider"/> — never Godot types and never resolver caches — because mod providers are disposed by <c>ModManager.Reload</c> on the main thread. Strategies are discovered by reflection and executed in (Phase, Order, Id) order: contract strategies fill the shared <see cref="ValidationGraph"/>, reconciliation strategies consume it. A pass in flight is cancelled by <see cref="Stop"/> when the mod is unloaded or re-registered by an in-process mod-set reload: its thread runs validator code (and reflects over other mods' assemblies), so a pass left running would keep every one of those assemblies loaded, and it would read file providers the reload disposes. </summary>
public static class ValidatorService{/// <summary>Version reported in the JSON report; bump alongside the manifest.</summary>
public const string Version="0.1.0";private static readonly object stateLock=new();private static bool running;private static CancellationTokenSource cancellation;private static Task pass;private static List<IModInfo>queuedMods;private static string queuedReportDirectory;/// <summary>True while a validation pass is in flight.</summary>
public static bool IsRunning{get{lock(stateLock)return running;}}/// <summary> Main-thread entry point invoked once after all mods are loaded. Reloads settings (persisted values are not applied by the engine yet at this point), checks the enable flags, guards against concurrent passes, takes the mod snapshot, and schedules the background run. </summary>
public static void Start(){ValidatorSettings.Reload();if(!ValidatorSettings.Enabled|| !ValidatorSettings.RunOnStart){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR","validator: disabled by settings");return;}lock(stateLock){if(running)return;running=true;}var mods=SnapshotMods();var reportDirectory=ValidatorSettings.GetReportDirectory();WarmUp();GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: started, {mods.Count} mod(s) queued");lock(stateLock){queuedMods=mods;queuedReportDirectory=reportDirectory;cancellation=new CancellationTokenSource();pass=Task.Run(RunQueued);}}/// <summary> Cancels the pass in flight and waits (bounded) until its thread has left validator code. Main thread, from the unload notification. </summary>
public static void Stop(){Task running;lock(stateLock){cancellation?.Cancel();running=pass;}if(running==null)return;try{if(!running.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)))GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR","validator: pass did not stop within 10 s; its mods stay in memory until it ends",LogLevel.Warning);}catch(AggregateException){// Run logs its own failures; a cancelled pass is the expected outcome here.
}}private static void RunQueued(){List<IModInfo>mods;string reportDirectory;CancellationToken token;lock(stateLock){mods=queuedMods;reportDirectory=queuedReportDirectory;token=cancellation.Token;queuedMods=null;}Run(mods,reportDirectory,token);}private static List<IModInfo>SnapshotMods(){var result=new List<IModInfo>();var registry=ModRegistry.Instance;foreach(var modId in registry.GetOrderedModIds()){if(registry.Mods.TryGetValue(modId,out var info)&&info!=null)result.Add(info);}return result;}private static void Run(List<IModInfo>mods,string reportDirectory,CancellationToken token){try{var report=BuildReport(mods,token);GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: {report.Summary.Errors} errors, {report.Summary.Warnings} warnings, {report.Summary.Infos} infos");if(ValidatorSettings.WriteReport)ReportWriter.Write(report,reportDirectory);}catch(OperationCanceledException){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR","validator: pass cancelled (mod set reloading)");}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: failed: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);}finally{lock(stateLock)running=false;}}private static ValidationReport BuildReport(List<IModInfo>mods,CancellationToken token){var report=new ValidationReport{GeneratedAt=DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"),GameVersion=ValidatorSettings.GameVersion,ValidatorVersion=Version,};foreach(var mod in mods){report.Mods.Add(new ValidationModStatus{Id=mod.Id,Version=mod.Version,InstallSha256=(mod as ModInfo)?.InstallSha256,Status="ok",});}Analyze(mods,report,token);ApplySummary(report);return report;}/// <summary> Runs every enabled strategy over <paramref name="mods"/> and returns the populated context — declarations, references and issues — without writing a report. Other tool mods (e.g. the resource atlas) build on the same graph instead of re-parsing scenarios and data. Call <see cref="WarmUp"/> on the main thread first. </summary>
public static ValidationContext Analyze(IReadOnlyList<IModInfo>mods,ValidationReport report,CancellationToken cancellationToken){var graph=new ValidationGraph();var context=new ValidationContext(mods,report??new ValidationReport(),graph,cancellationToken);var strategies=ValidationStrategyRegistry.GetStrategies();GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: running {strategies.Count} strategy(ies)");foreach(var strategy in strategies){if(!IsFeatureEnabled(strategy.Feature)){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: strategy {strategy.Id} skipped, feature {strategy.Feature} disabled",LogLevel.Debug);continue;}GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: strategy {strategy.Id} ({strategy.Phase})",LogLevel.Debug);try{strategy.Validate(context);}catch(OperationCanceledException){throw;}catch(Exception ex){GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: strategy {strategy.Id} failed: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}",LogLevel.Error);}}return context;}private static bool IsFeatureEnabled(ValidationFeature feature){switch(feature){case ValidationFeature.CSharp:return ValidatorSettings.ParseCSharp;case ValidationFeature.GdScript:return ValidatorSettings.ParseGdScript;case ValidationFeature.Scenarios:return ValidatorSettings.ParseScenarios;default:return true;}}/// <summary> Touches the scenario command and action registries while still on the main thread. Both are static/Lazy registries that instantiate plugin classes on first use; warming them here keeps the background validation pass free of first-touch instantiation of game types. </summary>
public static void WarmUp(){var commands=0;foreach(var _ in ScenarioCommandStrategyFactory.GetAllCommandNames())commands++;var actions=0;foreach(var action in ScenarioActionFactory.Instance.GetAll())actions++;GameLogger.Log("VALIDATOR",$"validator: scenario registries warmed ({commands} command(s), {actions} action(s))",LogLevel.Debug);}private static void ApplySummary(ValidationReport report){var errors=0;var warnings=0;var infos=0;foreach(var issue in report.Issues){switch(issue.Severity){case ValidationSeverity.Error:errors++;break;case ValidationSeverity.Warning:warnings++;break;case ValidationSeverity.Info:infos++;break;}}report.Summary.Errors=errors;report.Summary.Warnings=warnings;report.Summary.Infos=infos;foreach(var status in report.Mods)status.Status=HasErrors(report,status.Id)?"errors":"ok";}private static bool HasErrors(ValidationReport report,string modId){foreach(var issue in report.Issues){if(issue.Severity==ValidationSeverity.Error&&string.Equals(issue.Mod,modId,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return true;}return false;}}}

using System.Collections.Generic;using Cthangover.Core.Mods;using Cthangover.Core.Settings;using Cthangover.Core.Utils;using Godot;namespace Cthangover.Validator{/// <summary> User-facing settings of the validator, discovered by <see cref="ModSettingsRegistry"/> from the compiled mod assembly and rendered by the standard mod settings tab. public static string GameVersion{get;private set;}="";/// <inheritdoc/>
